rooms.Name: The gates of the Minotaur Village
rooms.Description:
Directly south you see a huge pair of gates. These gates appear to be 
carved almost completely out of wood. A huge city appears to be on the 
other side of these gates. There is also a possibility of going back 
north.

Exits.Description: To the south is a strong, sturdy gate.

rooms.Name: The city streets of Mahn-Tor
rooms.Description:
You walk among the various shops and homes. Most of the doors are 
closed and only the light from the windows betrays the presence of 
inhabitants. A cold wind blows through here. Small streets lead south 
and east.

rooms.Name: Inside the gates of Mahn-Tor
rooms.Description:
You stand just inside the gates to the city of Mahn-Tor. The city 
itself spreads out in front of you. The buildings are sturdy, as they 
appear to be made from the very hard rock. Small city streets lead east 
and west, while a main road appears to lead south.

rooms.Name: The city streets of Mahn-Tor
rooms.Description:
You trudge among the streets of Mahn-Tor. The streets themselves are 
made of cobblestone and are quite treacherous. Small homes and 
businesses along the street are closed tight and light from their 
windows throws eerie shadows across the dark street. Small streets lead 
west and south here.

rooms.Name: The city streets of Mahn-Tor
rooms.Description:
You trudge through the streets of the city. The street itself is made 
of cobblestones and the footing is quite treacherous. To the south, you 
see what appears to be a small tavern. Bright lights shine through the 
windows. Small streets also lead north and east. A small sign hangs 
outside the tavern.

rooms.Name: The Square of Mahn-Tor
rooms.Description:
This appears to be the main square of Mahn-Tor. Small streets lead 
east and west. To the north, you see the gates to the city. You also 
notice a small store to the south. A small sign hangs outside the store.

rooms.Name: The streets of Mahn-Tor
rooms.Description:
You walk among the small stores and homes of Mahn-Tor. The wind blows
fiercely. Small streets lead in all directions. There appears to be a 
large building to the east, but the sun obscures your view.

rooms.Name: The Inn of the Broken Horn
rooms.Description:
You enter a warm tavern. The room is lit mainly by two huge 
fireplaces at each end of the room. Small tables and a large bar furnish 
the room. The inhabitants of the inn are all minotaurs of varying size 
and disposition. Most seem to regard you with suspicion. Few approach 
you. A large door leads north, out of the bar and back out into the 
city, and some stairs are leading up.

rooms.Name: The Mahn-Tor Equipment Shop
rooms.Description:
You are in a crude equipment shop. The store is filled with racks of 
various items that adventurers could use. Large fireplaces light and 
heat the room. A large desk occupies the back of the room. The door to 
the shop lies to the north.

rooms.Name: The Mahn-Tor General Store
rooms.Description:
You enter a small store that is dark and cold. Old empty shelves line 
the walls and dust blows across the stony floor. It is evident that this 
store was once used, but it is no more. A small doorway leads north out 
into the streets of the city.

rooms.Name: Aegithus's Training Room
rooms.Description:
This room is full of all sorts of weapons and armors. Pieces of old 
targets and practice dummies lie all around. The walls are chipped and 
scored from weapon blows. This is obviously the room of an avid warrior. 
A red door leads east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

rooms.Name: Pythian's Dark Study
rooms.Description:
This room is dark. It reeks of death and evil. A black door leads east.
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

rooms.Name: Creon's Inner Sanctum
rooms.Description:
Idols to Dirk fill the room. White furniture and decorations give the 
room a holy appearance. It is evident that some being of supreme 
goodness lives here. A white door leads east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads out to the hall.

rooms.Name: The road to the Keep of Mahn-Tor
rooms.Description:
You walk up a steep rocky road. It leads up a steep grade to the 
east. At the end of this steep road, you see a huge keep. Dust swirls 
all about you and you feel your throat itch from breathing. Blurry 
lights to the east and west are all you can see from here.

rooms.Name: A small guard house
rooms.Description:
You enter a small guard house. A huge fireplace lights and warms the 
room. Looking around, you see that the room is fairly well furnished. 
Thick rugs and curtains help insulate the room and the beds themselves 
look quite warm. A table in the center of the room has the remnants of 
a card game strewn across it. A small door leads south.

rooms.Name: Before the Keep of Mahn-Tor
rooms.Description:
You stand before a huge keep that has been carved into the side of 
the mountain. Huge wooden gates before you provide entrance to the keep. 
It appears as though the storm here has convinced the guards to seek 
shelter inside. You see the lights of the city to the west. You also 
notice small guard houses to the north and south.

rooms.Name: A small guard house
rooms.Description:
You enter a small, but warm, guard house. Deep rugs and thick 
curtains insulate the room. A huge fireplace lights and warms the room. 
Outside, you hear the roar of the wind. A small door leads north out 
into the street.

rooms.Name: The entryway to the Keep of Mahn-Tor
rooms.Description:
You are at the entry hall to the huge keep. The high vaulted ceiling 
is carved from solid stone. Huge stone pillars rise up from the floor to 
meet the ceiling far above. The architecture appears to be dwarven. A 
huge pair of gates stand to the west, protecting the keep from the harsh 
wind outside. A large hall leads east, deeper into the keep.

rooms.Name: The Hall
rooms.Description:
You are in a huge hall. Large tapestries line the walls and huge 
statues of various make and appearance are spread about. The ceiling 
above supports huge candelabras, which light the room. To the east, you 
see a bright light and hear sounds of inhabitation. Looking west, you 
see the entry gates to the keep.

rooms.Name: The Grand Hall
rooms.Description:
You are in the main hall of the Keep of Mahn-Tor. This hall is huge. 
The wide floor of the hall is an expanse of marble. It shimmers in the 
light thrown off by the torches that line the walls. To the east, you 
see what appears to be a huge golden throne. The hall itself stretches 
south and a smaller hall leads to the west.

rooms.Name: The Great Hall
rooms.Description:
You stand in the great hall of the keep. Huge pillars rise up to the 
vaulted ceiling and torch light glimmers off the marble floor here. You 
are amazed at the sheer size of the hall. The hall itself leads north 
and east. You notice a smaller hall leading south, deeper into the keep.

rooms.Name: Standing before the throne
rooms.Description:
You stand before the throne of Xanthias. This golden throne is so 
huge that it takes up almost the entire wall, stretching far above the 
floor. Sitting upon it, you feel small and feeble. It is evident that 
this throne is more of a decoration than anything else. Only the largest 
of kings could sit upon it. The hall leads south and west into other 
parts of the keep.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The golden throne is huge. It takes up the whole wall.........

rooms.Name: The Great Hall
rooms.Description:
You are in a great hall. Huge torches light the room and their light
shimmers off the marble floor below you. To the north, you see a huge 
golden throne. Looking up, you grow dizzy at the height to which the 
vaulted ceiling rises. The hall itself leads north and west.

rooms.Name: The secret hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a small, torch lit hall. It leads from east to west. A 
large gold door is to the west. To the east, you see a heavy stone door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Looks like the back of a secret door of sorts.
A very formidable looking door.

rooms.Name: Entry to the Royal Chambers
rooms.Description:
You are at the entrance to the royal chambers of the keep. A plush 
shag rug covers the stone floor. Large candelabras hang from the 
ceiling, lighting the room. A huge fireplace warms the room. Beaded 
doorways lead south and east. A huge stone door stands in the west wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A huge stone door.......

rooms.Name: The Guard Post
rooms.Description:
The hall here has been built into a guard post of sorts. It appears 
as though it would be quite easy to defend in times of emergency. 
Obviously, something important lies beyond. A small hall leads south, 
while the main hall can be seen to the north.

rooms.Name: The guarded hall
rooms.Description:
You walk down a torch lit hallway. It has been carved out of pure 
stone. It is very quiet in this hall. You notice rows of colored doors 
on each wall. To your east, you see a yellow door. To your west, you see 
a red door. The hall itself leads south and north.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a red door. It has the name "Aegithus" written on it.
You see a yellow door. It has the name "Jocasta" written on it.

rooms.Name: The guarded hall
rooms.Description:
You walk down a small, quiet, torch lit hallway. Doors of different 
colors are in each wall. To your east, you see a maroon door. To your 
west, you see a black door. The hall itself leads north and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a black door. It has the name "Pythian" inscribed on it.
You see a maroon door here. It has the name "Haemon" written on it.

rooms.Name: Jocasta's Sanctum
rooms.Description:
You enter a temple of sorts. A small altar is here and relics of many
religions lie around. It is evident that this is the room of a studying 
cleric. A yellow door leads west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

rooms.Name: Haemon's Arcane Study
rooms.Description:
This room is full of shelves which hold various spell components. The 
center of the room is occupied by a huge pentagram. The entire room 
smells of smoke and incense. The room is obviously used extensively by a 
practicing mage. A maroon door leads west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

rooms.Name: The guarded hall
rooms.Description:
You walk down a quiet hall. The stone walls here are wet with 
moisture. Colored doors can be seen in the walls here. To your east, you 
see a green door. To your west, you see a white door. The hall itself 
leads north and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a white door here. It has the name "Creon" inscribed on it.
You see a green door here. It has the name "Thesus" written on it.

rooms.Name: The Harem Room
rooms.Description:
This appears to be the harem room of the Keep. Huge piles of furs and 
beds fill the room. The lighting is dim, but the room is very warm. You 
can hear music playing quietly from somewhere. Beaded doorways lead 
north and east.

rooms.Name: Thesus's Humble Abode
rooms.Description:
This room is filled with all types of natural items. Trees and plants 
have been lovingly cultivated and grown by hand, in large pots. The room 
is like an indoor garden. A green door leads west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

rooms.Name: The main living room
rooms.Description:
This room is decorated with sturdy stone furniture that is carved and
gilded. Large candles light the room. A thick rug covers the floor. 
Thick furs and tapestries decorate the walls. Beaded doorways lead south 
and west.

rooms.Name: The Master Bedroom
rooms.Description:
This appears to be the master bedroom. A huge bed fills the rooms. 
Piles of furs and other rich furnishings adorn the room. Candles are 
everywhere and they help a huge fireplace light the room. The lavishness 
of the room overwhelms you. Beaded doorways lead north and west.

rooms.Name: The end of the guarded hall
rooms.Description:
You are at the end of the hall. Colored doors line the walls to the 
north. To your west, you see a brown door. To you east, you see a grey 
door. The hall itself leads north back along the rows of doors.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a brown door here. It has the name "Balthazar" written on it.
You see a grey door here. It has the name "Astyanax" written on it.

rooms.Name: Astyanax's Dismal Domicile
rooms.Description:
This room is dirty and unkempt. Odds and ends of different items lie 
all over. It is apparent that some type of pack-rat lives here. It 
appears as though nothing has ever entered this room and ever left 
again. A grey door leads west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads back to the hall.

rooms.Name: Balthazar's Green Room
rooms.Description:
This room is full of green. The furniture and all other items show 
the color of nature. The room smells of pine and forest odors. From the 
items here, it appears as though a woodsman of some sorts lives here. 
A brown door leads east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like it leads to the hall.

rooms.Name: The Corridor of the Broken Horn
rooms.Description:
This corridor is clean and spotless. A nice carpet with motives of 
great battles covers the floor. There are doors to the east and west, 
marked with the roomnumbers and the stairs are leading back down.

rooms.Name: A room in the Broken Inn.
rooms.Description:
Someone is obviously living here, since the bed is unmade and an open 
coffert is standing in the middle of the room. The door is leading back
west and there is a door marked with a heart to the north, and you guess
it must be the bathroom.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The coffert is filled with minotaur underwear. They are not your size 
though.

rooms.Name: A guard post
rooms.Description:
A small sentrybox is here to shelter the guards from the weather.  
A well traveled path is leading north into a military camp.

rooms.Name: In the camp
rooms.Description:
The dusty ground bares witness of heavy exercise.  The camp continues
further to the north, and there is a guard post to the south.  Your east
and west side is flanked by huge green tents.

rooms.Name: Among the tents
rooms.Description:
To the north is a larger tent, obviously hosting someone important, 
since it is marked with a banner.  There are smaller tents to your east 
and west, and a path leading back through the camp.

rooms.Name: The warriors sleeping quarters
rooms.Description:
This tent is in perfect order, not the slightest speck of dust is 
visible and the beds are made so tight that you wonder if they ever has 
been unmade.

rooms.Name: The warriors living quarters
rooms.Description: This tent is almost ready for inspection, the beds are however unmade.

rooms.Name: The officers tent
rooms.Description:
This tent is filled with trophys bearing witness of many glorious 
battles, and it is in flawless order, since the minotaur officers take 
pride in beeing a good example for their soldiers.

rooms.Name: The warriors living quarters
rooms.Description:
This tent is, like the rest, in a very good order.  A chest for 
personal belongings is standing in a corner, and there is a chair 
standing by one of the beds.

rooms.Name: The colonels tent
rooms.Description:
A thick expensive looking carpet is lying on the floor, and there are
trophys from many won battles standing all over.  A large desk is 
standing in the middle of the tent, covered with maps and other papers 
concering battle tactics.

rooms.Name: A Bathroom
rooms.Description:
A bathtub is standing in the middle of the room, filled with warm
water. The mirror is foggy and it looks like someone recently has taken
a bath.

rooms.Name: A bedroom in the Broken Inn
rooms.Description:
In here it is neat and tidy like the rest of the inn. The bed is made 
and a fireplace is providing light and heat to this room.

rooms.Name: Mountain Trail
rooms.Description:
This trail leads high into the mountains. You hope you don't fall because
it would result in instant death. The trail continues to the east. To the south
a half cleared trail leads downward. To the west you can see a large plateau.

Exits.Description: Path to Dwarven Village.

rooms.Name: Mountain Trail
rooms.Description:
You're really high up now. You can keep going even farther up into the
mountains to the east, or go back down to the west.

rooms.Name: Mountain Trail
rooms.Description:
Wispy clouds are beginning to surround you now, and your ears pop due to the
altitude. To the east, you see the summit of the mountain, and from the way the
nearby mountains are arranged behind it, you believe you're on your way to a
big valley. You can also go down to the west.

rooms.Name: Near the Mountain's Peak
rooms.Description:
The peak of this mountain is another couple hundred feet above you, but here
is where the trail leads down into the valley... What an odd valley! The valley
seems to have been filled up by a hundreds of feet of lava many years ago. It
gives the valley an odd, 'flat' look and darkish ground. The path leads down
east into the valley, and west back to civilization.

rooms.Name: Trail to the Valley
rooms.Description:
The trail leads down into the valley, where, by judging by the height of the
trees, the lava had cooled tens of decades ago. Down below you see the path
lead into the small forest in the valley, and disappear out of sight. East
leads into the valley, West back to civilization.

rooms.Name: In the Valley
rooms.Description:
The ground has taken on the texture of dirt on the top, but this valley is
far too flat and too rocky to disguise the catastrophe that happened here so
long ago. Looking up to the mountains ringing this area, you notice several
mountains look as if they had 'exploded', which is strange, considering that
they are not volcanoes. The path leads into the woods to the east, and back up
the mountain to the west.

rooms.Name: In a Clearing
rooms.Description:
You come to a small clearing now, after walking for several minutes through
the silent woods. An odd block sticks up here and there in the ground... ...
wait a minute. These stones seem a little too regular, and from the circle
formation and size you could almost swear that they were... crenellations?
Could some sort of building been buried by the lava here? A rusty ring sticks
out of the earth in the center... a trapdoor? This is almost too good to be
true!

Exits.Description: An ancient trapdoor, grimed with earth and age.

rooms.Name: A Stairwell
rooms.Description:
This small room is the top of a stairwell leading down deep into the tower.
A small trapdoor overhead leaks the light of day around its edges. To the south
is a wooden door, preserved through the ages by means unknown. To the west is a
short hall.

Exits.Description: An ancient trapdoor, grimed with earth and age.

rooms.Name: A Linen Closet
rooms.Description:
This small room holds many types of linen on shelves along the walls. They
are undoubtedly preserved by magic against the toil of the ages, since they
seem freshly washed and folded. You wonder what sort of mage could wield so
much power to waste on such little things.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
White sheets, pillow-cases, etc.  Not really  anything that you need, but
interesting.

rooms.Name: Corridor
rooms.Description:
This is only a clean corridor, that leads back to the stairwell to the east,
and has doors leading to other rooms to the north and south.

rooms.Name: Bathroom
rooms.Description:
This is some sort of bathroom, like you've never seen before... Water
appliances leading from nowhere deliver hot and cold running water to basins
that drain to... where? How strange!

rooms.Name: Master Bedroom
rooms.Description:
This is an opulent room, decorated in silks and gold. There is an ebony desk
against one wall, cooled lava rock spilling over its surface from the window it
once looked out at. A nice, spacious closet is filled with clothes just cleaned
and pressed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Nice clothes, but not your size at all.
The desk is basically uninteresting, as are the papers on top of it...

rooms.Name: The Library
rooms.Description:
A great mages' library is contained on this floor of the tower. You feel you
could learn anything you wanted to if you only looked and read long enough. A
strange chessgame is standing on a oak table in the middle of the room. It 
looks very old, dust have collected all around it, but not on it. To the
east a door leads back to the stairwell.

Exits.Description: A big bookcase, that looks rather odd.
If you go down you enter the magic chessboard.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you examine the chessgame more closely you can see that the small pieces are
moving around. As they played by them self. On a box beside the chessboard
you can read the following words..
"Chessgame of Illusions this is the trap of the two mages Malthus and Turing
 they could never beat each other in chess so they agreed to be transformed
 into a illusionary chessgame. One condition from the maker was that they
 couldn't leave the game before either off them had won. As they never could
 beat each other they where trapped forever."

Created by Coke for Elite mud. To enter go down.
There's lots of books about everything here!

rooms.Name: Stairwell
rooms.Description: This stairwell continues up and down, and there is a door to the west.

rooms.Name: A Hidden Hall
rooms.Description:
This is a small hidden hall with a secret entrance to the library on the
north end of the west wall, and a trapdoor on the south end.

Exits.Description: The backside of a movable bookcase.

rooms.Name: A Stairwell
rooms.Description:
This stairwell continues up and down, and there is a door to the west
opening up onto this level.

rooms.Name: Hidden Treasure Room
rooms.Description: Jackpot! A small room filled with treasure chests! Go get it!

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
This hall runs through the tower. There's more hall to the west, and doors
to your north and south. A door to the east leads back to the stairwell.

rooms.Name: Servant's Room
rooms.Description:
This seems to be a small servant's bedroom, sparsely decorated and outfitted
with a bed, night stand, chair and table, etc. Nothing real important here.

rooms.Name: Servant's Room
rooms.Description:
This seems to be a small servant's bedroom, sparsely decorated and outfitted
with a bed, night stand, chair and table, etc. Nothing real important here.

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
This hallway continues to the east, and has a door to the north. You could
swear that the way this level is arranged... nah, couldn't be.

rooms.Name: Servant's Room
rooms.Description:
This seems to be a small servant's bedroom, sparsely decorated and outfitted
with a bed, night stand, chair and a table, etc. Nothing real important here.

rooms.Name: Stairwell
rooms.Description: This stairwell leads up and down, and there is a big open room to your west.

rooms.Name: Dining Hall
rooms.Description:
This is a large dining hall, with a long table that runs down the length of
it. Chairs are set up along the sides to accommodate approximately 10 people.
There are paintings and tapestries on the walls, adding color to the stonework.
The cooled lava that had poured in the windows makes the place seem eerie
somehow . There is a door to the north, and the stairwell is to the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Many of these show scenes of high magic and heroism. Just like almost every
tapestry and painting you've seen.

rooms.Name: Kitchen Area
rooms.Description:
This is a well-stocked kitchen, the larders still fresh and full as if by
magic. Perhaps this would be a good place to take a break.

rooms.Name: Stairwell
rooms.Description:
The stairwell leads up and down here, and there is a hall you can enter to
the west.

rooms.Name: Hall
rooms.Description:
This area of the tower seems dank and oppressive. The hall runs north-south
and there is an empty cell to your west. The stairwell is to your east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's open, empty, and uninteresting.

rooms.Name: Hall
rooms.Description:
This is the northern end of the hall. There are cells to your right and
left, empty and awaiting occupants.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's open, empty, and uninteresting.

rooms.Name: Hall
rooms.Description:
This is the southern end of the hall. There are cells to your right and
left, empty and awaiting occupants.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's open, empty, and uninteresting.

rooms.Name: Stairwell
rooms.Description: The stairwell continues up and down here. A large room opens up to the west.

rooms.Name: Mage's Office
rooms.Description:
A small desk here is cluttered with magically preserved papers and
documents. None seem of value, except perhaps to a historian. This place seems
vaguely uninteresting...

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's cluttered with all sorts of papers.  Some look half interesting,
actually.

Well, one of the papers relate a story about how the mage of this tower,
Rand, angered many kings, and relates how they set his armies on him. You
wonder if the lava outside was a failed attempt to destroy the armies...

rooms.Name: Stairwell
rooms.Description: The stairs go up and down here, and there is a room to the west...

rooms.Name: Sitting Room
rooms.Description:
This is a simply furnished room, with chairs all about. A fireplace is inset
into an inner wall, the chimney undoubtedly directed by magic... This would be
a nice place to rest awhile...

rooms.Name: Stairwell
rooms.Description: This is where the stairwell finally ends. There is a hall to your west.

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
This small hallway on the former 'ground floor' ran north-south. To the east
is the stairwell that leads up into the shadowy recesses of the tower. To the
west is the entrance way to the tower. The north is completely blocked off by
lava, and the way south is still clear.

rooms.Name: Entranceway
rooms.Description:
This is a grand chamber with giant double-doors to the west. To the east is
the main floor of the tower. This room is arranged highly attractively and very
impressively, with sculptures and tapestries everywhere. The doors seem
impenetrable... you don't think you'd be able to get through them if you really
had to...

Exits.Description: These doors seem incredible. Unfortunately, they're locked.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They look nice, but aren't very valuable.

rooms.Name: Doorway
rooms.Description:
This was the entrance to the tower. Now lava has blocked it up completely.
However: It seems when the lava came down a man was outside the doors. He was
blasted into the doors, and died instantly, but his skeleton still clutches a
staff in perfect condition...

Exits.Description: These double doors have the outline of a man blasted into them...

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
This is the southern part of the hallway. There is a door to the west,
barred with gleaming bands of lights. To the north is more hallway.

rooms.Name: Stairs
rooms.Description:
Stairs lead down here into the tower's basement, or you can head east into
the main floor of the tower.

rooms.Name: Stairs
rooms.Description:
Stairs lead up here to the main level, or you can go east to the basement of
the tower.

rooms.Name: Alcove
rooms.Description:
This alcove leads into a huge room to your north, and to stairs leading down
to the east, and stairs going up to your west.

rooms.Name: Laboratory
rooms.Description:
This laboratory has lots of stuff in it. Beakers, flasks, burners, tongs,
mortars and pestles, jars filled with normal things, jars filled with abnormal
things, jars filled with things you'd rather not think about... A search could
reveal many things...

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Looks like normal, fragile lab equipment to you.

rooms.Name: Stairs
rooms.Description:
Stairs lead down here to the second level of the basement, or back west to
the alcove.

rooms.Name: Stairs
rooms.Description:
Stairs lead up here to the first level of the basement, or you can go east
to another big room.

rooms.Name: Summoning Room
rooms.Description:
This room is darkly lit by a giant glowing pentagram in the center of the
room. Bands of force encircle some sort of being trapped inside. You think that
going inside would be an EXTREMELY BAD idea...

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can't see it clearly through the energy field of the pentagram, but you
sense that whatever it is, it is very, very, very, very angry.
It's centuries old.  You don't think standing close by would be a good idea.

rooms.Name: Inside a Pentagram
rooms.Description:
The small god entrapped by the wizard looks at you with an insane
expression. Four hundred years of imprisonment doesn't do much for ones...
OOPS! He killed you! You are dead, R. I. P.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You are walking on a trail going up the mountain. Further ahead the trail
makes a turn around a large cliff. If you walk north you will go around this
rock and if you walk south you will go down the mountain to its base.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You have almost reached the top of the mountain. To the south you see the
forest of Namir. If you look very closely to the south-west you can see the
city of Midgaard. The trail continues up to the north and down to the south.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You are walking on a old trail up the mountain. Large rocks and cliffs
surround you on both sides. The trail continues up to the north and down to
the south.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You are on a half cleared mountain trail. You are walking between high 
cliffs and large rocks. The trail makes its way upward to the north and to the
south it goes down to the base of the mountain.

rooms.Name: The Start of the Old Trail up the Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the base of the Moria mountains. A half cleared trail
leads up the mountains to the north. To the south a trail leads back to
Midgaard. Far to the west you can see the river flowing into the mountain and
to the east you see the large forest of Namir. A large sign have been placed
on a pole here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads
North, Old Trail to the Dwarven mines.
South, Trail to the city of Midgaard.

rooms.Name: The Plateau
rooms.Description:
A huge rockfall has blocked the narrow pass that once led north 
through the Moria mountains. The plateau continues further to the east,
and to the south, a narrow path passes precariously close to the cliff 
edge.

rooms.Name: Faint Track
rooms.Description:
You are on a faint track in the forest.  As you look around you
notice that the ground is sloping down to the south.  There are
signs of recent use too, the occasional odd-shaped footprint can
be discerned.  The track leads northward uphill into a dense 
forest.  To the south the path becomes muddier and more
indistinct.

Exits.Description:
To the north the track dries out and heads slightly uphill into a
dense forest.

To the south the path disappears into a dense swathe of reeds which
block your view.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ground is wet and soft, giving easily under pressure.  Vague
outlines of some strange footprints can just be made out.

The footprints are too faint to make out in any detail but appear
to have indentations reminiscent of claw marks.

rooms.Name: Boggy Path
rooms.Description:
The surrounding vegetation has turned to tall reeds which make
it difficult to see much detail in the surrounding area.  From the
south comes the roar of a river in full flood, and it is clear
that you are on marshy ground next to the river bank.  The earth
here is very wet and has been churned up by quite a lot of use in
recent days.  To the north the path firms up a bit as it heads up
a slight incline and to the south it disappears from sight into
dense reeds.

Exits.Description: To the north the path leads uphill into a dense forest.

To the south the reeds soon swallow up the path as the ground becomes
increasingly marshy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ground is waterlogged, leaving only a large patch of churned-up
mud.

rooms.Name: River Bank
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the northern bank of a large fast flowing
river.  It comes from the east and turns south just as it reaches
you.  A small channel crosses in front of you isolating a small
island of ground.  It is barely 20 feet across the channel and a
fallen tree 'happens' to bridge the gap to the island.  To the
north a boggy path leads into a dense cluster of reeds.

Exits.Description:
Reeds crowd around this little scrap of ground pinning you to the
river bank.

A fallen tree trunk lies across the channel offering hope of a way
to cross.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Large and fearsome as the river is, you can't help wondering what its
inhabitants might be.

The channel is about 20 feet across and filled with relatively slow
moving water. The main force of the water flows down the eastern
side of the island.

At first glance the tree seems quite innocent.  Closer inspection
reveals that a number of footholds and handholds have been
cunningly cut into the surface to facilitate crossing.

From here the island appears to be a heavily wooded patch of firmer
ground.  The trees and reeds prevent you seeing much more.

rooms.Name: Faint Soggy Path
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the northern shore of what appears to be a
small island. The ground is marshy and an all-pervading air of
dampness and mold hangs around you. A large tree trunk has been
used to bridge the narrow channel to the far bank to the north. To
the south a faint soggy path wends its way into dense marshy
woodland.

Exits.Description: A fallen tree trunk lies across a small channel acting as a bridge.
The path disappears into the reeds and tress.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The full force of a major river flows north to south down the
eastern side of this island.

The channel is about 20 feet across and filled with relatively slow
moving water. The main force of the water flows down the eastern
side of the island.

At first glance the tree seems quite innocent.  Closer inspection
reveals that a number of footholds and handholds have been
cunningly cut into the surface to facilitate crossing.

rooms.Name: Muddy Clearing
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small muddy clearing.  The ground is firm
but damp and large bare patches have been worn in the turf.  Three
faint trails wind off to the north, east and west. A larger and
more established track leads due south.

Exits.Description: A trail disappears off into reeds to the north.
A trail winds off into what looks like a swamp to the east.
A broad track heads through trees to the south.
A very faint trail leads into the reeds to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Many feet have trodden this ground. Numerous impressions have been
left some definitely clear enough to be identified as the tracks of
Lizardmen. This is most unexpected as Lizardmen are considered
solitary, anti-social creatures with no cohesive community to speak
of.

rooms.Name: Outside A Burrow
rooms.Description:
You are standing to the east of a small mud mound with a hole in
it just about big enough for a large human to stoop through. The
trees grow so closely together here that you are permanently in the
gloom of twilight.  The ground is so wet that you can't imagine
that the burrow is not flooded.  A swaying in the reeds to the east
makes you wonder if something isn't waiting to greet you should you
enter them.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The burrow is a mound of mud about 6 foot high in a rough dome. The
entrance hole is about four foot high and two foot across. A tunnel
leads down into darkness.
It is just the wind! Stop being a big baby!

rooms.Name: Small Clearing
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small clearing. The ground is much firmer
here and a mud hut has been erected to the east. The door is simply
a flap made of animal skin. Signs of a small cottage industry are
all around. A skilled potter lives here.

Exits.Description: A door with a large fur pelt pegged across it lies to the east.
A trail leads off into the marsh to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The hut is fairly large and has several shuttered windows.

Although the house has several shuttered windows the door is simply
an animal skin fastened loosely across the door. It will not
present any difficulty to entering the hut.

Two small, wood-fired kilns, sit next to the house. They have wisps
of smoke rising from them indicating that they are in use.

rooms.Name: Inside the Burrow
rooms.Description:
You wish that you hadn't entered here. You are standing waste
deep in murky, brackish water and it really isn't very warm. The
occupier has a strange idea of what a home should be like. The
burrow is a single semi- submerged room. A hammock has been slung
in one corner between pegs hammered into the earthen walls. You can
see many of the trappings of civilized life though, cutlery etc.
stacked on shelves around the edge of the room.

Exits.Description:
A partly submerged hole in the east wall leads up a short, and
rather muddy, tunnel.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The hammock is damp and slimy and the pegs are starting to pull out
of the soft earth.

rooms.Name: Mud Hut
rooms.Description:
You are inside a mud hut. The light from several torches show a
single large room with a firm dry floor. A pile of animal skins in
one corner provide a rather comfortable looking bed. In the center
of the hut is a small table with a couple of chairs. Various nice
little touches, such as decorations on the wall suggest that this
is the scene of a recent party!  A doorway covered with an animal
skin to the west appears to be the only exit.

Exits.Description: A fur has been pegged across the door to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bed is empty but would certainly contain two or three adults
quite comfortably.

Although the house has several shuttered windows the door is simply
an animal skin fastened loosely across the door. It will not  
present any difficulty to leaving the hut.

rooms.Name: Well Trodden Clearing
rooms.Description:
This clearing is obviously something of a cross-roads for the
Lizardmen that live on this island. Paths lead north, south, east
and west. The path to the south is broad and well kept. The trees
have been cut back to ensure that during daylight the area is well
lit and the impression you get is of a well organized, well cared
for, public highway.

Exits.Description:
A soggy path leads into the interminable forest of reeds to the
north.
Another well traveled trail leads into the reeds to the east.

A broad, neatly tended, avenue leads south. Not far away you can
see a large gray building.
To the west a boggy trail leads into the reeds.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The hard packed earth shows few spoor but you are certain that some
of the footprints are those of the lizardchildren.

rooms.Name: A Garden
rooms.Description:
You are now standing in a small garden. The owner obviously
doesn't spend much time on it. Weeds grow everywhere and the
omnipresent reeds crowd around the edges. A small paved path leads
up to a small shack to the west.  The path goes east as a muddy
track.

Exits.Description: A muddy track winds its way through the reeds to the east.

A paved path with a few weeds growing through the cracks lead up to
a small shed, constructed from timber.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An rather unsuccessful attempt has been made to grow some root
crops. A few rather scraggly inedible looking roots have recently
been torn up and thrown to one side. This again is something of a
surprise, Lizardmen are known as voracious carnivores.

rooms.Name: Another Muddy Clearing
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a particularly drab, uninteresting but
rather boggy clearing. A path leads back into the reeds to the west
and up to the door of a nice, neat wooden building to the east. The
door has no visible locking mechanism. Don't they have crime around
here? Obviously not until now!

Exits.Description: A wooden door lies to the east
A muddy track leads into reeds to the west.

rooms.Name: Shack
rooms.Description:
The inside of the shack is virtually empty. The floor is soft
and spongy, covered in some form of dry mossy growth. Apart from a
few animal skins dumped in one corner the only other furnishing is
a large wooden chair.  If it wasn't for the cleanliness it would
look abandoned.

Exits.Description: A wooden door shelters the hut and its contents from the elements.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A simple bed using the springiness of the floor as a mattress and
furs as blankets.

The chair is large, wooden and has been around for a long time.
Someone, or something, has spent a lot of time sitting in it.
Curiously enough, the back has had a large hole punched in it.

rooms.Name: Log Cabin
rooms.Description:
You are inside a large, roomy log cabin. You wonder if there is
something about lizardmen that makes them live in single room
dwellings. The room is tastefully appointed, with table, chairs and
a pile of furs in the corner for a bed. A soft, gentle light comes
from small crystal balls embedded in the timber of the walls.

Exits.Description: A simple wooden door keeps the rain and the wind out of the house.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The globes are obviously enchanted and are quite impossible to
remove from the walls.

rooms.Name: Large Clearing
rooms.Description:
You are in the middle of a large clearing. The earth has been
compacted by many feet and some parts are paved. In the Southwest
corner is a small shelter which you assume is some kind of communal
latrine. From the markings on the ground you guess that some
children have been playing games and messing about. Broad tracks
lead north, west and east. A wide paved road runs due south from
here.

Exits.Description: A broad well maintained avenue leads north.

A broad straight path goes east. You can see a large wooden
building in the distance.

A paved highway, planted with trees down either side in neat rows,
stretches southwards from here.
A well-used path runs west into the inevitable forest of reeds.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks pretty primitive and smells awful. You decide not to
investigate further!

rooms.Name: Little Lane
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the end of a tidy little lane outside a
long, low wooden building. There is no door, but a yellow
shimmering light fills the doorway blocking your view. The building
itself it stark and squat, quite out of character in the lush
greenery here.

Exits.Description: The lane heads off into the reeds and trees to the east.

The yellow light completely blocks any sight into the building.
There is no handle or keyhole to speak of.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The yellow glare seems to pulsate, gradually rising and falling in
intensity.  You cannot see a handle or a keyhole and nothing can be
discerned on the other side.

rooms.Name: Paved Path
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the east end of a long, straight, paved
road. To the east stand a large wooden building. It appears to be a
single story and there is a large, metal reinforced, wooden door.
The road, building and the surrounds are all in immaculate
condition.

Exits.Description:
A heavy wooden door bound with metal straps and sporting a large
iron handle is set into the side of this building.
A broad paved road heads west from here.

rooms.Name: Mage's House
rooms.Description:
The inside of this building is a single room split by curtains
into a series of sections. Several smaller sections have bedding
and furs but a few have tables, benches, cauldrons and other
paraphernalia clearly related to magic. Another surprise as
Lizardmen are not known for scholastic pursuits!  Lighting is
supplied by numerous glowing globes embedded in the walls and
ceiling. The walls are decorated with runes and symbols that
suggest that the owner might well be versed in the mystic arts.
This belief is further supported by the 'door' to the east. A
yellow shimmering wall keeps out the wind and sounds of the world
outside.

Exits.Description: A yellow light fills the door keeping the outside elements at bay.

rooms.Name: Communal Housing
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a large dormitory cum kitchen cum living
room. The room is divided into areas by large curtains strung from
the ceiling on hooks and rails. At least 20 people must sleep, eat
and live here and the general mess and clutter bares this out. One
large area serves as the kitchen. You quickly realize that
Lizardmen tend to eat raw unprepared meat and fish judging from the
implements and remains on a bench. The only exit is to the west,
through a large doorway.

Exits.Description: You see a sturdy reinforced wooden door with an iron handle.

rooms.Name: Large Cleared Area
rooms.Description:
You are in a very large clearing that serves as the village
green of the Lizardmen settlement. A patch of cultivated grass
provides an area for the young and old alike to relax on. Various
tables are arranged around the square, presumably to act as a
market when needed. To the north a broad, paved road leads away
through the trees. To the east a short paved path leads to some
water and to the west a less used track disappears from sight into
the marsh. Almost directly south lies a large stone building.
Although only a single story high it is large in area and you
wonder how the stone was brought here to build it.

Exits.Description:
A paved highway stretches away through a neatly arranged row of
trees to the north.

A body of still water can be seen nearby at the end of a short
paved path.

A set of stone steps leads up to a large pair of iron bound wooden
doors in the side of the chieftains home.

An earth track heads downhill rapidly losing itself in the marshy
edge of the island.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The grass is lush and well tended. Several skins are stacked in one
corner and others are strewn around for people to lie on. You
realize that this point probably gets more sun than any other on
the island. You wonder if the Lizardmen used to be cold blooded in
their ancestral past.

rooms.Name: Pets Corner
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the west shore of the island. The river
flows in a slow trickle through a narrow channel before rejoining
the main flow to the south of the island. A large fence has been
built out into the water to build a water filled pen. Apparently
the lizardmen keep crocodiles as pets!  The only exit appears to be
to the east.

Exits.Description: A narrow track leads uphill away from the shore through dense reeds.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The fence is constructed from heavy wooden posts and a wire mesh.
The area encircled is large enough to comfortably hold several
crocodiles and encompasses a length of the shoreline too. You are
relieved to see that the fence is unbroken!

rooms.Name: Paved Junction
rooms.Description:
You have arrived at a junction. The paved road goes east, west
and south from here. To the west you can see a large cleared area.
To the east you can see a large pool of water and to the south the
path curves out of sight to the east.

Exits.Description: The road reaches the side of a large lake almost immediately.
The paved path bends east almost immediately hiding its destination.
The road leads straight to a large clear area to the west.

rooms.Name: Swimming Pool
rooms.Description:
A large shallow pool has been made by diverting some of the
rivers flow. Tress have been cut back to allow the sunshine to
reach the pool. A path leads north beside the influx. Swimming
across the lake gives access to a ledge used for diving to the east
and the outflow back to the river to the south. To the Southwest a
large fence has sectioned off a small area of the pool to provide a
shallower region for the young to play in.

Exits.Description: A broad track heads into the trees to the north.

You can see a high ledge which is accessed by a crossing the lake and 
walking up a steep slope.

The lake drains through a small channel to the south back into the
river.
A paved path leads away, straight and true to a large clearing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
On the east side of the lake a ledge accessed by a short, steep
ramp can be used as a diving platform about 2 man-lengths high.

This part of the lake is only knee deep and the fence makes an
ideal area for the young to play in with only minimal supervision.

rooms.Name: Creche
rooms.Description:
A patch of ground and a shallow part of a large swimming pool
have been cordoned off using a fence here. Several chairs are here
for mothers to sit on and the area is ideal for children to play
in. The bulk of the pool is off to the Northeast and the water is
pretty cold, fed as it is, by the nearby river. A paved path goes
north to a T-junction and a small channel drains the paddling pool
to the south.

Exits.Description: A short paved path leads to a nearby T-junction.

A small runoff from the pool flows south. It quickly disappears
into the surrounding reeds but should be easy enough to swim along.
A gate in the fence stops the children floating off into the
unknown.

rooms.Name: Safety Net
rooms.Description:
You have ended up inside a large open topped cage. You realize
that you are now in the main flow of the river. From the north and
west you see water flowing into the river. Quite a lot of rubbish
is trapped in the netting, you assume it has been carried in from
the north and west. It seems that this is to stop anything being
lost for ever in the river. You are quite worried to see some holes
have been chewed in the netting.

Exits.Description:
A channel comes from the north from which water pours. It would be
hard work but you should be able to make your way up it.

A channel covered by a small gate leads west into the reeds. You
can see it start to turn north before it disappears.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The netting looks quite strong but powerful jaws have made short
work of it. You wouldn't be surprised to learn that crocodiles
occasionally found edible things trapped in here.

rooms.Name: Diving Ledge
rooms.Description:
You are standing above a deep, inviting swimming pool. It looks
a little cold but very invigorating. It is perhaps two or three
times a typical humans height to the water. You have a strong urge
to show off your diving prowess! You can dive in and head west
across the lake.

Exits.Description:
You can head west across the lake. Flying would be easy but a quick
dive into the lake would be more fun.

rooms.Name: Jetty
rooms.Description:
You have arrived at the villagers main source of food, a small
and quite unstable jetty in a sheltered cove. Several nets are
strung across the river here and large numbers of fish are already
struggling in them. You imagine one of the main problems is keeping
large predators out of the nets. The don't seem to be any boats
about at the moment though and the fish are not being collected.
You wonder if they are stored here alive to provide fresh food as
required.

Exits.Description:
A well used track leads south alongside a channel cut to drain
water from the river into some distant reservoir.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Old and constructed from wood now starting to rot the jetty is not
as sturdy as once it was. Several nets are tied to its legs and to
posts hammered into the river bed to provide a means of catching
and storing fish.

Tough and plentiful these nets are full of fish. Some further into
the river are obviously for catching fish, ones nearer the bank
where the water is calmer for storage. You might be able to catch a
few if you had your own net but otherwise....

rooms.Name: Chieftains House
rooms.Description:
You are impressed by the size of this building. Only a single
floor but one at least five times the height of a human. Some
sections have been cordoned off using magnificent colorful
tapestries. A long, polished wooden table occupies the central
section of the room. At the end is a particularly big and ornate
chair. You are in no doubt that this is the seat of power in this
settlement. Broad double doors to the north leads outside.

Exits.Description:
A large pair of iron bound wooden doors are set in the north wall
of the chieftains home.

A small pool is fed by an inlet about chest high and the wall
behind it has been painted to give the illusion of a small
waterfall. You wonder where the water drains too....

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You marvel at the detail and craftsmanship displayed here. A
beautiful rendering of a cliff and sheltered pool capture your
attention. The picture is vibrant and life-like and the water from
the inlet spills into a pool just about large enough to act as a
bath.
It may not have throne stamped on it but .......

rooms.Name: Chieftains Sanctuary
rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a small pool partly outside a large
building to the north.  A wooden fence has been erected around the
pool and by peering through the cracks you notice that it has been
camouflaged with reeds on the outside. It is very close to the
river with flows past east to west just south of here. On a small
bank you can see a few items of simple furniture and a few personal
effects. The only exit would appear to be to duck under the water
and swim though to the north.

Exits.Description:
A short underwater tunnel leads north under a large stone building.
You can see light through the water so it cannot be far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small table with a chair sits on the bank. Several boxes of
papers sit next to it. On the table are more papers. The owner
would appear to be quite studious.

rooms.Name: MOB Room
rooms.Description:
If you can see this I hope you're an immortal otherwise
something has gone wrong! This room has exits but no entrance in
order to randomly place a few MOBS around this zone.

rooms.Name: Crossing the River
rooms.Description:
A large tree has fallen across the river, bridging the gap between the
north and south banks.  Curiously enough, the tree has several holes cut
into it, as if the bridge is not some sort of coincidence.  The marshy
ground on the river banks north and south of this makeshift bridge appear
to have been recently flooded.

rooms.Name: End of the Catwalk
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a very tiny platform at one end of a long
catwalk.  Looking around you, you can see a vast network of narrow rope
and vine bridges and ladders. The rope bridges are delicately made and
seem to blend naturally into their surroundings.  The catwalk continues
north, or you might be able to climb up a bit.

Exits.Description: The catwalk stretches on ahead of you, inviting you to explore.
You see a tangle of leaves and branches above you.

rooms.Name: Catwalk Intersection
rooms.Description:
The catwalk branches east, north and south at this point.    This
section of the walkway is firmly attached to the tree to your west, and
you examine it closely to see if there is a pathway down to terra firma
from here!  The air is very still around you, and you wonder if the
elves and fairies who live in these trees are asleep or merely hidden
from you.

Exits.Description: The catwalk winds among the trees.
The catwalk branches east from here.
You can see one end of the catwalk to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a large tree of a type unknown to you.  It is, fortunately,
large enough to support this section of the walkway.

rooms.Name: Catwalk in the Trees
rooms.Description:
It is understandable why a catwalk is called a catwalk.  Only someone
as light on its feet as a cat would feel safe here.  The narrow bridge
made from vines and small branches sways with the slightest breeze,
making you uncomfortably aware that your combat gear makes you less
than sure-footed.  You grip each tree that you pass, looking for a way
down, but so far the trees have been remarkably bare of lower branches.

Exits.Description: A huge gray tree with some carving, and a faint orange glow.
You see an intersection in 2 catwalks.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks shaky.

rooms.Name: A Catwalk Ends
rooms.Description:
This small platform is actually carved into the wood of an enormous
tree of a variety you have never seen.  The bark is silver gray and
quite thick, and has been carved by a master's hand with delicate
frescoes of fairies in flight.  There are signs the tree has been
recently singed by fire.  Above the fairies you see in the fresco huge,
vicious winged creatures with sharply hooked beaks and long talons...

Exits.Description: The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The critters look like dragons.

rooms.Name: Along the Catwalk, Between Trees
rooms.Description:
This is a long, unsupported section of the catwalk.  The rope and 
vine bridge sways wildly between the trees, and you try not to look
down as you think of things to occupy your mind while you traverse the 
section.  How many steps till the next tree ...  which is closer, the 
one east or the one west...  Are those wings you hear?

Exits.Description: You see what looks like a fairly secure resting-place.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

rooms.Name: Temporary Safety Among the Trees
rooms.Description:
You are at the eastern end of the longest stretch of unsupported,
narrow, flimsy, wimpy-looking catwalk you ever hope to see.  What were
you thinking climbing up here in the first place?  Where can you get
back down to earth?  What is that nasty-looking
bat-kind-of-but-not-quite creature headed for you outta the sky?  Your
choices from here?  Heading north on that wide limb or south on the
catwalk.

Exits.Description: An apparently short spike of the catwalk heads north.
The wobbly catwalk continues south.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

rooms.Name: Out on a Limb
rooms.Description:
The view from here is fairly okay, if you like heights.  You can see
another portion of the catwalk twisting off to the east and a huge,
strange silvery tree blocks the view to the west.  It is unlike any
tree you have seen before, and you wonder if the tales you heard at
Barns & Nibble of fairy folk and giant dragons have any truth to them.
You may return to your walk on the wild side by heading south.

Exits.Description: The catwalk resumes south of here.

rooms.Name: A Walk on the Wild Side
rooms.Description:
You try to act cool, hummin "doo doo-doo doot doo doo doooooo" as
you stroll along the catwalk, hoping those AWFULLY BIG birdlike critters
have eaten recently.  You can see them, way above you, circling like
you've heard vultures do when they've found something good to eat.
You could go north or east from here.  You hope the birds are just
making lazy circles in the sky ... for exercise!

Exits.Description: The platform looks fairly safe.
The catwalk continues.

rooms.Name: Turning Twisting Catwalk
rooms.Description:
The catwalk must turn and twist as it wraps its way around the
trees.  This particular section looks newer.  The vine is greener,
softer, laced with mistletoe.  Mistletoe, you remember, strengthens
magical enchantments. Perhaps that is the source of the strength of the
seemingly fragile walkway.

Exits.Description: There seems to be a lot more mistletoe in that direction.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

rooms.Name: Mistletoe Path
rooms.Description:
There is quite a bit of mistletoe along this section of the catwalk.
The dark green leaves and waxy white berries make the pedestrian
walkway look enchanted, as indeed it is.  You wonder about the quantity
of mistletoe on this stretch.  Is there some special purpose other than
keeping the catwalk together and properly suspended?  You continue on
your way, either north or south from here.

Exits.Description: The path through the trees continues.
The path through the trees continues.

rooms.Name: The Path Pivots
rooms.Description:
After attaching itself to another large tree of indeterminable
species, the path meanders east and south from this point.  The southern 
route looks laced with mistletoe, the path east looks more ordinary.
The normal soft forest sounds of chirping birds, scurrying small animals
and rustling leaves surround you.  Occasionally you think you hear the
beat of heavy wings and a strange down draft, but you put that down to
your overactive imagination.

Exits.Description: The path through the trees continues.
The path through the trees continues.

rooms.Name: Standing at the Crossroads
rooms.Description:
Your choices are many here - up to a fire lookout, south to what
looks remarkably like a doorstep, or east or west along a more 
indeterminate route.  You don't see any means of climbing down, so you 
must continue on as best you can.  Occasionally you believe you hear 
the rush of large wings, then shake your head in disbelief..

Exits.Description: The path continues for a short distance.
The path continues for a short distance.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.
It looks hot.

rooms.Name: The Element of Fire
rooms.Description:
Living in the woods, the Elves must always be cautious of fire, and
you can see that here, at a lookout, someone has made some magic to 
protect the elven group.  Stones of hematite, beryl, citrine, jasper and 
ruby are arranged here in a careful pattern, calling forth a powerful 
magic to protect the trees.

Exits.Description: The path continues for a short distance.

rooms.Name: Henrietta's Doorstep
rooms.Description:
You are standing outside a door cleverly carved into the huge oak
tree to the east of you.  The ridges and knotholes that are part of this
tree all but hide the entrance, or they would if it weren't for the
little sign proclaiming "Humble Henrietta's Handy Herbs Here".  If you
decide not to visit Henrietta, the catwalk leads back to the north.

Exits.Description: It looks like a crossroads of sorts.
It looks like a knotty tree.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like there may be something stuffed inside.

It was once a naughty dragon.  Henrietta the Mighty ensorcelled it, and
now it is simply a knotty tree.

rooms.Name: Henrietta's
rooms.Description:
You enter a cheery little kitchen, with cheerful yellow curtains
over the sunny windows and a red and white checked cloth on the table.  
This is Henrietta's workshop, her kitchen for cooking up powerful
concoctions that keep the elves strong and resilient.  Henrietta has
lived here ever since her apprenticeship as a child of 83.  She is a
strong and powerful woman, friendly to strangers.  There is a small
sign on the wall.

Exits.Description: The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It reads,
                              Do not meddle
                        in the affairs of wizards        
                           for you are crunchy 
                      and go well with Grey Poupon.

rooms.Name: Along the Catwalk
rooms.Description:
As you walk along the catwalk, you marvel at this example of elven
engineering.  With minimal support from the tall trees surrounding it,
the narrow vine catwalk has become the elevated highway of Tynstri,
allowing its children to play outside in the fresh air without fear of
the dangers that strangers bring to the village below.  There is a
small sign attached to the vine, which serves as a handrail.

Exits.Description: The catwalk continues on for a small distance.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

rooms.Name: A Change in Direction
rooms.Description:
The catwalk changes direction here as if abruptly defining the
limits of the upper village.  The view from here is breathtaking, open 
as it is to the north and west, overlooking mountain and trees with no 
signs of any attempts to tame nature.  The elf king's consort is fond of
saying the best of sunsets are to be seen from the treetops of Tynstri.

Exits.Description: The trees are very green and welcoming.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

rooms.Name: Walking the Catwalk
rooms.Description:
The catwalk is responsive beneath your weight, moving almost as if
it were alive.  All around you the forest is green and swaying and
beautiful.  If you weren't so afraid of falling you would feel a lot
better.  Off in the distance you see what looks like a bright purple
blot against the sky and it seems to be moving towards you!  Your
escape lies either up or south or east.  Pick one and RUN!

Exits.Description: The catwalk appears to bend north of here.
It looks like a small platform surrounded by trees.
A strong vine ladder leads up.

rooms.Name: Surrounded by trees
rooms.Description:
You are surrounded by trees - elder to protect you from negative
spirits, hawthorn (witches' tree) and oak.  The small platform creaks
gently under your feet, and if you look down, you can see it rests on
the top of one of the beautiful arches of the Wiccan monastery below.
It might be possible to climb out over the edge of the platform, wrap
arms and legs tightly around the arch, and slide awkwardly down to the
ground below.

Exits.Description: The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.
There is a way down... look out.

rooms.Name: Another Decision Point on the Catwalk
rooms.Description:
You stand at a catwalk crossroads, your choices from here are down,
south or west.  From where you stand, you can see little to choose
between them.  You are tempted to ask a passerby, but there don't
appear to be many, at least none who are very responsive to a polite
question.

Exits.Description: Another turn in the catwalk.
A turning point in the catwalk.
You COULD try to e_a_s_e your way down the vine ladder.

rooms.Name: One Last Turn
rooms.Description:
You can see the lovely catwalk ending in a small watch-place to the
east, and the path continues north for quite some distance.  You rest a
moment here, wondering yet again about the variety and numbers of trees
that surround you.

Exits.Description: The catwalk continues for a short distance.
There is a cul de sac to the east.

rooms.Name: Cul de sac
rooms.Description:
The catwalk ends here on a large platform looking out on the
beautiful lake to the south.  This is evidently a place where early 
morning ceremonies are held to greet the sun, or perhaps just a sunny 
spot for morning exercise.

Exits.Description: The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

rooms.Name: A Turning Point
rooms.Description:
The catwalk branches east and south here, and you are standing on a
small platform firmly attached to what appears to be an oak tree.
Occasionally you see an elf heading home or out for an adventure, but
mostly the forest is quiet.    You wonder what lies ahead.

Exits.Description: There appears to be a ladder attached to a tree.
The catwalk continues ...

rooms.Name: A Long Walk above the Forest Floor
rooms.Description:
You are treading softly on a long stretch of delicately wrought
catwalk.  Looking closely at the swaying bridge was a mistake, as it
showed you how much the bridge had worn away in time.  You wonder
should you take off your heavy boots with the sharp cleats on them, and
wish you hadn't decided to carry quite so much with you.

Exits.Description: There is a turn in the catwalk to the north.
The catwalk appears to come to a dead end unlike, you hope, yourself.

rooms.Name: Another Dead End
rooms.Description:
You have reached what appears to be another dead end after a long
long time spent up on the catwalk.  There are doors to the west and 
south, and the view to the east is magnificent, of mountains and 
enchanted forests.

Exits.Description: There is a fragile catwalk stretching northwards.
A door painted with a pattern of leaves leads south.
An ornately carved oak door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The door south appears to be covered with spring leaves.

rooms.Name: A Watchroom
rooms.Description:
You enter a comfortable room carved into a huge oak tree.  There are
wide windows facing west to the sunset, overlooking the town.  A large
sofa made from some unusual black leather graces the room. Chairs
carved of oak provide seating, and storybook pictures add color and
charm to an otherwise somber room.  You realize you have stumbled into
someone's parlor and you should probably leave by the door to the east.

Exits.Description: There is a small platform just outside.

rooms.Name: Annie's Room
rooms.Description:
A bedroom for an elven princess ... this one in particular
apparently loves being outdoors.  Two walls are made of sliding slatted 
doors and lead to the verandah that surrounds her room. The other walls 
are filled with pictures of wolves, books of wolf lore and posters
declaring "Free the Elves".  The ceiling is covered with faintly
glowing stars.  Sitting atop the bed is a very large, stuffed purple
dragon.  What is that you see peeking out from underneath her tall bed?
*shudder*  You can go west to visit her closet (a very scary place in
itself) or north to the catwalk.

Exits.Description: You see a leaf-covered door
Annie's closet is this way.

rooms.Name: Annie's Closet
rooms.Description:
Annie's closet is piled high with the discarded gear of her many
sisters.  It is amazing that such a small room could hold so much ...
stuff!  Leggings lie tumbled next to headbands, scepters lean against
corners next to spears and bows.  A #ys#wh#yi#wn#yi#wn#wg#N hammer sits
glowing quietly on a high closet shelf while combat boots and hooves
sit side-by-side on the floor.  Annie generally throws equipment in
here quickly without looking.  Not, of course, because she is afraid of
monsters-who-live-in-the-dark . . . !

rooms.Name: Tightly spiraling staircase
rooms.Description:
This staircase winds tightly upwards with barely enough room for your
body to traverse it.  It is very dark in here, and very quiet.

Exits.Description: It's dark down there!
It's dark up there!

rooms.Name: Tightly winding staircase
rooms.Description:
This staircase appears to be carved from the inside of a tree.  You
turn around and around, getting dizzier and dizzier as you go.  You
would hate to meet an enemy here.  There isn't even enough room for you
to draw a weapon!

Exits.Description: It's dark up there!
It's dark down there!

rooms.Name: Elfking's Home
rooms.Description:
Here is where you will find the elf king when he is not away on a
crusade to combat evil.  The walls are hung with richly colored
tapestries telling of ancient elven heroes.  Young elven children
(under 50 years old) are brought here to learn of their glorious
history.  The good king rules over his forest kingdom from an ornately
carved, shiny golden throne.  The seat looks a bit hard ... perhaps
that has something to do with his frequent absences.  In his absence
the awesome Master Ranger roams the forest, protecting his subjects,
and his Honor Guard remains here, protecting the throne.

Exits.Description: A magnificent public entrance
It looks dark and narrow.

rooms.Name: On the eastern side of a very large tree
rooms.Description:
You are perched precariously on a wide branch in a very large tree.
The tree is covered with a rough, dark bark that tears into your
fingers as you cling to it for balance.  Occasionally a large piece
breaks off in your hands and you rapidly grab for purchase.  Around
you, the forest is filled with the noise of birds and small and
not-so-small animals going about their normal daily activities.  Below
you there appears to be some sort of bridge between trees.  You can
climb down to the bridge or around the tree to the west.

Exits.Description:
The tree has many strong branches.  You could use them like stepping
stones.

Looks like a bridge.  If you are strong, you could grab the branch you
are standing on and swing yourself down.

rooms.Name: On one of several sturdy branches
rooms.Description:
You are standing on one of several sturdy branches high up on the
west side of an enormous tree.  You can see off to the west a sturdy 
tree with a ladder going down, but there appears to be no means of 
getting there.  The tree which is supporting you is enormous.  It is so 
big around that even leaning way out from the trunk, you are unable to 
see the eastern side.  There are many large, thick branches, however 
that you might use to climb around the tree to the other side.  Your 
only other option appears to be a swan dive to the ground.

Exits.Description: Many strong branches.

rooms.Name: The Grand Staircase
rooms.Description:
Managing to look at once quite grand, yet perfectly at home in the
tiny village park, a grand marble staircase rises eastward.  Although 
each golden marble step is shallow, there are many hundreds leading 
upwards.  As you crane your neck to look up, you can see no end to the 
steps.  Perhaps this is an illusion?  Yet the steps feel firm beneath 
your feet.  West from here lies the village park.

Exits.Description: The staircase continues upwards for as far as you can see.
The village park.

rooms.Name: Public Entrance to the Throne Room
rooms.Description:
Perched at the top of an elegant but endless gold and white marble
staircase, the public entrance to the Elf King's home blends perfectly
into its setting in the trees.  The grand columns supporting the roof
are, in fact, living trees.  From this vantage point you can see much
of Tynstri.  The small monastery is still east of you, the village
shops are to the west, and there are large forest areas north and south 
of you.  From here, the throne room is just to the north and the village
lies at the bottom of the steps at your feet.

Exits.Description:
The Elf King welcomes you to his home.  Please wipe your feet before
entering.
It's a l-o-o-o-o-o-ng way down.

rooms.Name: At the base of a very large tree
rooms.Description:
A slight trail through the forest ends here at the base of a very
tall, very thick tree.  The village park for Tynstri is south of here 
and you may wish to head there. The other choice here is to follow the 
faint trail through the deep forest going east.

Exits.Description: You see a faint trail leading east.
A somewhat seedy looking park

rooms.Name: A Faint Trail
rooms.Description:
A faint trail leads through towering trees.  The forest is alive
around you.  You can almost hear the trees growing, feel the sizzling 
magic in the air.  From here, the path leads northwards for a spell, 
or east into a tangle of leaves.

Exits.Description: The path continues.
You could probably squeeze in between the two trees.
There is a huge tree looming west of you.

rooms.Name: A Space Between Two Trees
rooms.Description:
There is a small space here between two enormous trees.  The ground
is flat, and the thin grasses growing there have been squashed by
something quite heavy.  The only exit lies west.

Exits.Description: A faint trail

rooms.Name: A clear path
rooms.Description:
The path is more clearly marked here, and apparently well-traveled.
The vegetation is dense and healthy on both sides of the path, which
continues east, north and south.  It looks green and foresty in all
directions.

Exits.Description: The path turns sharply north of here.
The path continues clearly to the east.
The path appears to come to a turning point south of here.

rooms.Name: Turning in the Path
rooms.Description:
The path turns here rather sharply.  To the west there appears to be
a small open space and you can hear the faint sounds of a woodcutter's
axe.  To the south, the trail has more definition.

Exits.Description: The path looks more well-traveled.
You see more trees.

rooms.Name: The Woodcutter's spot
rooms.Description:
This clearing is clearly the work of some busy dwarven woodcutters.
The wood of this forest is known for its strength and magical
qualities.  It is a bit unpredictable.  That is, there are rumors of
trees attacking those who would cut them.  But that doesn't seem to
stop the dwarves who come here in search of good wood.

Exits.Description: There is a slight path leading east.

rooms.Name: Forest Network
rooms.Description:
From here the forest seems to be a network of trails.  Some are well
defined, some are faint.  In the dirt you can see some large
footprints.  They look roughly human, but much larger.  Caught on twigs
of a nearby bush you can see a tuft of fur shed by a wolf.  It is
impossible to tell how long it has been there, but you find yourself
listening intently to the forest sounds.

Exits.Description: Looks like the path takes another twist north.
You see some bushes.
The network of paths continues west.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Den
rooms.Description:
You stand under a low outcropping of rock, which forms what appears
to be the entrance to a shallow cave.  From the dirt and leaves beneath
your feet, it appears this is the entrance to a wolf den.  The den
continues down a steep slope under the rock.  You will need to crawl to
get any further in that direction.

Exits.Description: The path west is blocked by bushes.
The wolf den.

rooms.Name: Wolf Den West
rooms.Description:
The roof of the cave hangs low over your head, forcing you to crawl
through this area.  Besides the discomfort, it leaves you at a distinct
disadvantage should you come upon any of the residents of this den.
The den cave gets a bit roomier to the east.

Exits.Description: The wolf den continues.

rooms.Name: Wolf Den
rooms.Description:
A few bones of undeterminable origin are scattered in this, the
roomiest part of the wolves' den.  Although the roof of the cave is too
low to allow you to stand upright, it is considerably higher than it is
either to the east or the west of here, where the den continues.

Exits.Description: The roof lowers sharply.
The roof lowers sharply as the cave continues.
Up a steep slope, you can see the entrance to the wolf cave.

rooms.Name: Wolf Den East
rooms.Description:
Even the wolf cubs must crouch to enter this part of their den.  The
rough stone walls encase you like a very uncomfortable coffin.  You can
crawl back to the larger part of the den to the west, probably the best
idea, or slither on your belly through the narrow crack in the rock
leading down into darkness.

Exits.Description: The scents and sights of the den come from the west.
It's hard to see anything, but the smell is pretty gruesome.

rooms.Name: Another turn in the path
rooms.Description:
The well-marked trail through the woods begins a steady slow descent
to the east.  There is a slight smell of charcoal and woodsmoke in the 
air here, and the path has become fairly wide.  To the south there 
appears to be an intersection between this path and another.

Exits.Description: A slow descent down a hill.
An intersection of paths.

rooms.Name: At the top of a hill
rooms.Description:
The trees have thinned out very slightly here, but enough that you
can see the gradual slope of a hill eastwards.  The forest floor is
sparsely covered with small flowers and grasses.  The light is dim
here, filtered by a dense covering of leaves high above you.

Exits.Description: To the west you see another turn in the path.
The path eastwards leads down a gentle slope.

rooms.Name: Yet another ending
rooms.Description:
What looked like a promising path through the trees has very quickly
fizzled into nothing.  You are surrounded by tall trees and an intense
quiet.  The trees to the west, north and east seem to huddle together
