wherever you go.

Exits.Description:
A small (gnome-sized) wooden door painted white reflects the sunlight
back at you.

Fields of bright, hot sunflowers line both sides of this path.  Doesn't
look comfortable.

rooms.Name: Sunflower Path
rooms.Description:
Walking a long a narrow gap in a field of sunflowers, the heat and
light of the plants beats down upon you like an iron club fresh from the
forge.  The gnomes must all have green thumbs, for these sunflowers are
thriving here.

Exits.Description:
The narrow area between the two fields of sunflowers shines brightly in
their light.
The bright light of the sunflowers dims in the distance.

The narrow area between the two fields of sunflowers shines brightly in
their light.

rooms.Name: Sunflower Path
rooms.Description:
The radiant light from both huge fields of sunflowers leaves no place
of shade or shadow.  The sunflowers lift their dark faces to the sun,
bright yellow petals waving with pleasure.  The path between the fields
continues westward for a small distance, coming to a stop at a tall
fence.

Exits.Description: The bright faces of the sunflowers compete with the sun.
The bright fields of sunflowers stop abruptly by a tall fence.

rooms.Name: Shade Trees
rooms.Description:
Low, leafy trees spread long branches, inviting you to find shadows
and cool comfort beneath them.  Remnants of cookies and ham sandwiches
beneath some of the trees, and a long rope hanging from one of them hint
that you may have stumbled on a picnic spot.  The path south is blocked
by a stream.

Exits.Description: Bright fields of sunflowers warm you in their heat.
Just how strong are you?  The rope leads up ... up ... up ...

rooms.Name: The Fence
rooms.Description:
From north and south of you come the heat and light of a million
sunflowers.  It is always summer in the sunflower field, the cycle of
birth and death appears to have stopped here.  To the west is a very
very tall, white painted fence.  A knothole in the fence is just about
at the level of your eye.

Exits.Description:
Bright fields of sunshine extend for some distance, terminating in an
enormous structure made of some clear substance.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You can see nothing but dark and cold with no sunshine.

rooms.Name: Up a Swaying Rope
rooms.Description:
The thick rope rises up and up and up to where it is tied to a sturdy
branch in what, to a gnome, is a very tall tree.  As you climb the rope
it gently swings to and fro over a narrow but apparently deep stream.
Are you about to get a dunking ?

Exits.Description: Leafy green branches reach for the sky and so does your rope.

The rope is swaying rapidly, and the ground beneath you is replaced by
water and again by ground in such rapid succession you may be sick to
your stomach.

rooms.Name: Up a Swaying Rope
rooms.Description:
The thick rope rises up and up and up to where it is tied to a sturdy
branch in what, to a gnome, is a very tall tree.  As you climb the rope
it gently swings to and fro over a narrow but apparently deep stream.
Are you about to get a dunking ?

Exits.Description: Leafy green branches reach for the sky and so does your rope.

The rope is swaying rapidly, and the ground beneath you is replaced by
water and again by ground in such rapid succession you may be sick to
your stomach.

rooms.Name: Intense Vegetation
rooms.Description:
A narrow, deep cold stream runs east to west here in a rather lazy
fashion.  It is just a bit too wide to jump over.  A long rope dangles
down from a tree overhead, and to the south, thick vines, thorny bushes
and intense vegetation appear to block your path.

Exits.Description: Intense vegetation and thick, thorny vines block the path south.
A thick rope dangles just over your head.

rooms.Name: Following a road in the mountains
rooms.Description:
The mountain road whindles as it leads you through the mountainous
terrain. Make sure you do not slip, a fall would be very disastrous.
There seems to be a slight opening in the mountains east of here,
perhaps it is a little valley. Why don't you have a look ?

Exits.Description: The mountain opens up.
A little road trails off.

rooms.Name: A little field in the mountains
rooms.Description:
You have reached a little field placed in the middle of the
mountains.  This looks like a place in harmony. No risk of avalanches.
The grass is green and even a few birds chirp happily in the
surrounding. There is nothing wrong with this picture except the
enormous chasm that opens up the mountain on the east side of the
field. Perhaps you should stay here where you are in guaranteed safety.

Exits.Description: A little house stands on the very verge of falling into the chasm.
A little road trails off.

rooms.Name: A house at a chasm
rooms.Description:
Standing directly on the very verge of falling into a huge chasm is a
little house. It looks a bit shabby but it still stands there. This is a
bit strange as two heavy ropes lead away from the house over the chasm
to the other side.

Exits.Description: A little clearing looks rather inviting.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You now see how very large the chasm is. Very large. And there seems to
be a very strange wind blowing in the chasm. Even if you grew wings it
would not be possible to pass it in that manner. Just forget it.

It leads to another similar house on the other side of the chasm.
Perhaps those ropes can be used to take you over to the other side.

rooms.Name: Standing in a basket inside a wooden house
rooms.Description:
Ah, The house is a start on a ropeway over the chasm.
The powerful ropes that go over the chasm will, probably, take you over
safe. But you have to work for it. Incorporated in the bottom of the
basket you are standing in is a treadmill. Walk in the opposite
direction you came and the basket will take you over the chasm. Neat and
simple.  The door has closed behind you, so start walking.

Exits.Description: You are not going this way, especially if you try.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The basket is woven tightly together by the same kind of rope as the
rope that carries you. How the rope weaver was able to get the treadmill
into the floor is beyond your ability to comprehend.
Fascinating. Start walking or you will hang here forever...

rooms.Name: Hanging in a basket over a chasm
rooms.Description:
The basket is swaying considerably, mostly due to the fact that you
are or were walking around in it and only a little part due to the fact
that a terrible storm roars just a few feet away from you. It seems that
the basket is protected in some kind of safe pocket. You are still not
over so keep on walking or the wind just might get closer...

Exits.Description: Where you came from and where you are not going.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There has got to be some kind of magic involved  in this, the wind
roars and your little carriage is almost totally unaffected. Perhaps
this is used as some kind of limitation to how many and what kind of
guests that should be allowed to pass over.

Hmmmmm...
It is deep, so very deep. But was not there something gleaming down
there?

Hmmmmm...

Darkness should not be gleaming. There is definitely something wrong
with this place. That depth need to be further investigated but where
can one descent safely. Not here for sure. Maybe a long ladder would
help...

Neat and simple.  The door has closed behind you so you better
start walking.

Exits.Description: You are not going this way, especially if you try.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The basket is woven tightly together by the same kind of rope as the
rope that carries you. How the rope weaver was able to get the treadmill

Fascinating. Start walking or you will hang here forever...

rooms.Name: Back in a house at the chasm edge
rooms.Description:
The basket comes in inside a house again. Easy as it completely lacks
the walls towards the chasm. How does it manage to stand, mysterious.
Well now you have two options:   Either jump 'ashore' or start walking
on another trip. You have paid for unlimited travel as long as you
ticket lasts so why not take another spin?

Exits.Description: You have to walk this way to get out on the ropeway again.
A relative safety on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One gone - three to go. When will this shabby pile of rubble called
house fall down? The world is full of unanswered questions. You did not
even know that I was watching, did you ? ....   Mooaahaahaaaaaaaaaaa !!!

rooms.Name: Back in a house at the chasm edge
rooms.Description:
The basket comes in inside a house again. Easy as it completely lacks
the walls towards the chasm. How does it manage to stand, mysterious.
Well now you have two options either jump 'ashore' or start walking on

rooms.Name: A house at a chasm
rooms.Description:
You are standing next to a house on the very edge of a huge chasm. It
looks really shabby but it stands, even though two strong ropes seem to
drag it into the open mountain. Around the house is a little grassy
field stuffed in between the huge mountains. A small path trails of east
through the grass.

Exits.Description: A small path trails off towards the mountains.

rooms.Name: A grassy field in the mountains
rooms.Description:
You have reached a little field in the mountains, but it does not
look as harmonious as one could think or hope. The grass has some
greyish stuff on it that stains your feet when you touch it and on one
of the sides of the field a huge chasm opens up apparently tearing a
house apart.  A little path leads up into the mountains and west to the
house.

Exits.Description: A little house awaits your arrival to fall into the chasm.
A winding path takes you up, up and up.

rooms.Name: On a mountain path
rooms.Description:
The path whindles up and down, up and down, but it looks used. You see
the fine grain dust that covers the path. There have to be some places
that this path connects. Keep walking in either direction and you just
might get there. Below you a little field opens up on the mountainside
while the path continues north into a more mountainous terrain.

Exits.Description: A little path takes you through the mountains.
A small field in the mountains awaits your presence.

rooms.Name: On a mountain path
rooms.Description:
The path winds up and down, up and down, but it looks used. You see
the fine grain dust that covers the path. There have to be some places
that this path connects. Keep walking in either direction and you just
might get there. The path seems as endless as the mountainside you have
beside you. More mountainous terrain awaits you south and east.

Exits.Description: A little path takes you through the mountains.
A little path takes you through the mountains.

rooms.Name: On a mountain path
rooms.Description:
The path winds up and down, up and down, but it looks used. You see
the fine grain dust that cover the path. There have to be some places
that this path connects. Keep walking in either direction and you just
might get there. The path seems as endless as the mountainside you have
beside you. More mountainous terrain await you west and north.

Exits.Description: A little path takes you to the mountain.
A little path takes you through the mountains.

rooms.Name: On a mountain path
rooms.Description:
The whindling mountain path ends here or starts here depending on if
you came travelling down or from the south, shifting over into a set of
stairs. The stairs look really clean, either it is used a lot or
someone sacrifices a good deal of work and time to keep it clean.

Exits.Description: A little path takes you through the mountains.
A loooooooong stairwell.

rooms.Name: A long stairwell in the mountains
rooms.Description:
The steps are somewhat low to make climbing them easy. It is clearly
noticeably that you are in dwarven territory. The well tidied steps go
up and down from here. Below you the lower end of the stairs is visible.

Exits.Description: An even loooooooonger stairwell.
A loooooooong stairwell ends.

rooms.Name: A long stairwell in the mountains
rooms.Description:
The steps are somewhat low to make climbing them easy. It is clearly
noticeably that you are in dwarven territory. The well tidied steps go
up and down from here. Above you the upper end awaits your arrival.

Exits.Description: A loooooooong stairwell ends.
An even loooooooonger stairwell.

rooms.Name: Top of some mountain stairs
rooms.Description:
A fine little road surrounded by some bushes leads you between the top
of some stairs cut out directly from the mountain and something east of
here engulfed in some terrible greyish fog.

Exits.Description:
A big grey road goes towards the grey entrance of some huge grey
complex.
A loooooooong stairwell.

rooms.Name: Following a road in the mountains
rooms.Description:
The mountain road winds as it leads you through the mountainous
terrain. Make sure you do not slip a fall would be very disastrous. The
road goes north and west. Pick one or enjoy the view and the fresh air.

Exits.Description: You see little road trail off.
A little bushed road leads away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Marvellous stone and sky make for a magnificent panorama for you to
enjoy.

rooms.Name: Chute for walking guards
rooms.Description: Takes them in to places between mill entrance and chasm 6554-6562

rooms.Name: The Start of the Old Trail up the Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the base of the Moria mountains. A half cleared
trail leads up the mountains to the north. To the south a trail leads
back to Midgaard. Far to the west you can see the river flowing into the
mountain and to the east you see the large forest of Namir. A large sign
has been placed on a pole here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads
North, Old Trail to the Dwarven mines.
South, Trail to the city of Midgaard.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You are on a half cleared mountain trail. You are walking between
high cliffs and large rocks. The trail makes its way upward to the north
and to the south it goes down to the base of the mountain.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You are walking on a old trail up the mountain. Large rocks and
cliffs surround you on both sides. The trail continues up to the north 
and down to the south.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You have almost reached the top of the mountain. To the south you see
the forest of Namir. If you look very closely to the south-west you can
see the city of Midgaard. The trail continues up to the north and down
to the south.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You are walking on a trail going up the mountain. Further ahead the
trail makes a turn around a large cliff. If you walk north you will go
around this rock and if you walk south you will go down the mountain to
its base.

rooms.Name: The Hidden Room
rooms.Description:
In a small, dark space lit only by a cheery magical fire, a troop of
gnomes swap tales in a storytelling contest.  The smokeless fire has
burned the same logs for many long years, and the outside world seems
far away.  There is a magical quality about this room, and it seems easy
to forget that there IS a world outside this one.

Exits.Description: The rough-hewn planks seem to fit together poorly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Many years ago, the group left their yak farm on the plateau to help
their friends the dwarves.  Iron ore production was down, and the gnomes
relied on the fine plow-heads made by the dwarves, so there was a bit of
self-interest as well.  Once the gnomes had created and installed a
system of pulleys to help harvest the ore, they retreated to this small
cottage for a story-telling competition, the prize to be possession of
an enormous jar of cookies.  They have been here ever since.  No gnome
can resist the lure of a good story.

rooms.Name: The muddy sewer
rooms.Description:
You are standing in mud to your knees. This is not the kind of place for a
picnic. The muddy sewer stretches further into the south.

Exits.Description: You see the muddy sewer continuing into the darkness to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: The muddy sewer junction
rooms.Description:
The muddy sewer stretches into the dark to the south. It looks as if no
person has ever sat his foot here before. It's too muddy for that anyway. The
sewer leads north, south and east from here.

Exits.Description: The muddy sewer stretches into the dark to the north.
East. The muddy sewer leads into a bend that goes south.
South. The muddy sewer ends in a mudhole that way.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: The mudhole
rooms.Description:
You stand in mud all the way up to your thighs and it's not too comfortable
since you are used to a somewhat different environment. The sewer leads to the
north of here. In the middle you can just make out an enormous drainpipe
leading down.

Exits.Description: North. The muddy junction lies in that direction.
The muddy drainpipe leads down through the mud, otherwise it is utterly dark.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: The Dark Pit
rooms.Description:
You are standing by the edge of a dark pit that leads down into even deeper
darkness. >BWWAAADDRR< - The smell from down there is unbearable. The sewer
stretches into the darkness to the east.

Exits.Description: East. The sewer leads into the sewer junction.

The Dark Pit leads down an down and down ... well you can't see the bottom
anyway. There are bars that function as a ladder on the side.

rooms.Name: The muddy sewer
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the middle of a bend of the sewer pipe. It is very dark
around here and the mud is sticking to your legs, not very pleasant. The pipe
leads east and south from here.

Exits.Description: East. The mud stretches on into the darkness.

South. There is even more mud in that direction than where you are now.
Incredible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: The muddy sewer
rooms.Description:
You are standing in something that reminds you very much of porridge, this
has the advantage that it's not hot, it's rather cold actually. The pipe bends
to the north and east.

Exits.Description: The muddy sewer pipe leads into a bend that goes east.

The pipe leads into a bend that goes south. Interesting, there's mud on the
floor there.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: The muddy sewer bend
rooms.Description:
This isn't your idea of a place to stay too long. You're in up to your knees
in something that resembles mud, but you're not quite sure. The bend in which
you stand leads west and south.

Exits.Description:
The pipe leads into a intersection that goes south and east. The floor here is
still covered in mud.

The pipe (still filled with mud) leads into a intersection that goes north and
south. Interesting.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: A muddy intersection
rooms.Description:
You have both your feet safely stuck in mud. It isn't the mud that's wrong
it's the smell, the sounds, the total darkness that surrounds you. Everything
here is so depressing. The pipe leads on with a trail of thick mud to the
north, east and south.

Exits.Description:
North. The pipe goes into a bend with a load of mud all the way up the walls.
The bend leads west.

East. This way like a place for the annual mud festival, although the stench
wouldn't allow any happiness at all. The pipe leads into a bend that leads
north.

South. There's less mud in that direction. *smile*. Your light doesn't cover
enough space for you to see much more than that it leads into some sort of
junction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: The Sewer Junction
rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of a huge junction of sewer pipes right under what
you'd think was an air shaft. The sewer pipes lead to the north, south, east
and west. It look quite impossible to force your way up.

Exits.Description: North. Mud is the floor basis in that direction. Yummy.
YYEEUUCH! BOOH! THAT looks like a nice place for creepy crawlies.

North. This direction looks quite nice actually. The pipe leads into a bend
that goes east.

A few yards ahead - away from this junction - there is a pit leading down, but
the smell from there... >PHEWW<.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: A bend in sewer pipe
rooms.Description:
You are in a bend in the sewer pipe. A strong smell seeps in from the north.
The sewer goes north and east.

Exits.Description: North. You are staring into a huge junction with exits in all directions.
East. The Pipe leads into utter darkness that way.

rooms.Name: The muddy sewer pipe
rooms.Description:
You have entered a kind of tube intersection that leads south, west and
east. Your legs are covered in mud up to the knees. REAL yucky!

Exits.Description: East. There's less mud in that direction, or that's your impression.

That way is lost in darkness, though you sense less mud in that direction,
perhaps even a complete end to this sludge that surrounds you.
West. The mud reaches that way too, all the way up the walls.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: The bend in the Muddy sewer
rooms.Description:
This is not your idea of a holiday. You stand in mud up to your knees. It's
absolutely inconceivable how all this mud could have been placed here. The pipe
leads to the west and south.

Exits.Description:
South. There's even more mud that way, incredible! Although it looks like an
intersection in the sewer system that leads east and south.

West. All you can see, is that the pipe leads into a bend that goes north. But
there's less mud in that direction, however odd that sounds.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: A MUDDY intersection
rooms.Description:
You wouldn't want to know the true feeling of standing in this mud up to
your hips. >BWAADR<. All that fills your mind right now is the dream of a hot
bath. This is NOT very clean mud you know, remember you're in the sewer! The
pipes leads north, south and east.

Exits.Description:
North. Sludge and sediment fills this corridor of the sewer that leads into a
bend going west.

East. You can see absolutely nothing of interest in that direction (Maybe
that's why it's so damn interesting. ??) There's no mud in that direction
either, GREAT!

South. All you can see is more mud! Although the pipe goes into a bend leading
west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's NOT the kind of matter that would concern you too much, normally, but
as you are in the middle of it, it just might become your main concern.
REAL YUCKY!

It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: Muddy sewer
rooms.Description:
You stand in a bend of the pipe system of the sewer with mud up to your
thighs. Contemplating a higher level of existence here would be utterly
inappropriate, as the smell would keep any intelligent creature from even
thinking of anything but getting away from this foul end of the WORLD. The bend
goes from north to west.

Exits.Description:
North. Filled with mud, that place looks like an impassable intersection with
pipes leading north and east.

West. There's less mud that way, maybe you're on your way out of this foul
place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: The old well
rooms.Description:
You are standing by an old and worn well from before this century. The sewer
leads to the east from here and the well leads down into darkness. Metal bars
implanted in the side of the well lead down as a ladder.

Exits.Description:
East. You see, because of the utter darkness that surround you, absolutely
nothing. Your light isn't of much use for that kind of distance.

Down the well there's even less light than up here, so ... sorry, you can't see
a thing. There are metal bars in the side leading down into the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These look like they're pretty slippery, and not very safe, but perhaps safe
enough for you to climb down, WITH both hands on them.

rooms.Name: The ordinary bend
rooms.Description:
You are in the middle of a bend in the pipe system of the sewer system, WHAT
a place!!! The pipe leads to the south and the east.

Exits.Description:
East. What a quiet place you've found there. It's an intersection that has
pipeways going north and east.
South. You see nothing at all in that direction it's too dark anyway.

rooms.Name: The sewer junction
rooms.Description: You are in a junction that leads north, west and south.

Exits.Description: North. You see a bend.

South. It looks like a pipe junction just like this one. Only that one leads
east and west.
West. There's a junction with four pipelines in that direction.

rooms.Name: The ordinary junction
rooms.Description:
This looks like an ordinary junction, actually it seems very quiet here. The
pipelines lead west, east and north.

Exits.Description: To the north you can see a junction like this one, leading north and west.

To the east there's nothing of particular interest, though there's a junction
with pipelines leading north and east.
There's a bend to the west leading north.

rooms.Name: A quiet pipe junction
rooms.Description:
This is the kind of place to rest, though the smell could be a LOT better
than this. The sewer goes east, north and west from here.

Exits.Description: In that direction, you can't see anything. It's just too dark.
There's an ordinary junction in the pipe system to the east

West. There's an ordinary bend leading south into the sewer system in that
direction.

rooms.Name: The odd room with smooth walls
rooms.Description:
As you enter you hear a loud click from one of the walls ... and you fall
and fall and fall ... . . . . ... And come to an abrupt end. THIS is strange
indeed. There's an arched entryway leading down.

Exits.Description:
Down. It's utterly dark that way, though you can make out an intersection of
sewer pipes leading west, north and east.

rooms.Name: The sewer
rooms.Description:
You are standing in mud up to your ankles. This is an intersection with
sewer pipes leading east, south and west.

Exits.Description: To the east there's a peculiar looking round room.
To the south there's another intersection with pipes going south and east.

To the west there's another intersection like this one, with sewer pipes
leading south and west.

rooms.Name: Another intersection
rooms.Description:
You have never seen anything so BORING... This is an intersection with pipes
leading north, south and east.

Exits.Description:
To the north there's an intersection, where the pipes are leading west and
east. You notice that the floor to the west is covered in mud.

East. You see nothing of interest in that direction, just another intersection.
This one leads east and south.
Another intersection lies to the south. It leads west and south.

rooms.Name: A junction
rooms.Description:
This one seems interesting, a big difference from all the other junctions.
It seems cleaner than the rest of them. Weird. Something that looks like an air
shaft leads upwards, but it looks far too slippery to climb. The pipes lead to
the south, west and north.

Exits.Description: North. You see an intersection there, leading north and east.
To the south there's ANOTHER junction leading west and east.

To the west you see a load of mud and sediment in the sewer. That should be an
intersection there but you're not quite sure.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

rooms.Name: The sewer junction
rooms.Description: You stand in a junction of sewer pipes leading north, east and west.

Exits.Description: To the east you can see a bend in the pipe going south.
To the west you can just make out an old well.

rooms.Name: The Triple Junction
rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of a huge junction of concrete sewer pipes. The
pipes lead into three different directions : east, south and west.

Exits.Description: East. You can see a bend in the sewer pipe leading north.

To the south there's a ENORMOUS quadruple sewer junction, all lit up by an odd
light.

To the west you can just make out another junction similar to the one you are
standing in.

rooms.Name: The Quadruple Junction Under the Dump
rooms.Description:
You are standing in something that reminds you of an entry to an ant hive.
There are enormous concrete pipes leading north, south, east and west. There's
also a metal ladder built into the concrete wall leading up through a layer of
garbage.

Exits.Description:
To the north you can see a huge triple junction with sewer pipes leading west
and east.
East. You can see a pit in the floor.
To the south there's a huge junction with pipes leading east and west.
To the west there's an odd looking room with totally smooth walls.

Up through the garbage you can just make out what looks like the Dump in
Midgaard.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks as if it's made of stainless steel, and it would very well function
as a club of considerable power, but alas ...  You can't take at all since
it's firmly set into the concrete wall.

rooms.Name: A triple junction
rooms.Description: You stand in a junction with pipes leading west, north and east.

Exits.Description:
To the north there's a ENORMOUS quadruple sewer junction, all lit up by an odd
light.
East. You can just make out a triple junction leading north and east.
West. You can just make out a triple junction leading north and west.

rooms.Name: A bend in the sewer pipe
rooms.Description: You can look in two directions where the pipe leads : south and west.

Exits.Description: To the south you can see another bend leading west.
West. You can just make out a triple junction leading north and west.

rooms.Name: The sewer pipe bend
rooms.Description:
You can look in two different directions where the pipe goes : west and
north.

Exits.Description: North. You see another bend leading west.

You can see another junction although this one is a triple one with pipes going
south and west.

rooms.Name: The pit
rooms.Description:
You stand in a section of a pipe that leads to a dead end. In the floor
there's a pit leading down. There are bars set in the side of the pit wall
functioning as a ladder.

Exits.Description: West. You can see a dimly lit quadruple junction with an exit up.
Down the pit it's utterly dark you can't see a thing.

rooms.Name: The round room
rooms.Description:
As you enter the room it starts rotating - at first slowly, later faster and
faster - You get totally confused as to where up and down is, but you are
certain that the doorway is in the opposite direction of what it was when you
entered. It now leads east. There was only this one exit.

Exits.Description: You can just make out a smaller room with a chair.

rooms.Name: The three way junction
rooms.Description: You are standing in a junction of pipes that lead west, east and south.

Exits.Description: East. You can make out a dimly lit Guard Room.
To the south you can see what looks like a store room.
West. You see another junction similar to this one leading north and south.

rooms.Name: The Sewer Store Room
rooms.Description:
You stand in a small room lit by a single torch set in the wall. The only
way out of here is to the north.

Exits.Description: To the north you see a pipe junction.

rooms.Name: The Shaft
rooms.Description:
You are standing by the edge of a deep, dark shaft leading down. A single
ladder is your tool to work your way down if you so wish. The sewer pipe leads
south from here.

Exits.Description: To the south you can see the pipe leading further south into darkness.

Down and utter darkness. There's absolutely nothing to be seen in that
direction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Firmly set into the wall of the shaft it's impossible to even rock, is your
estimate.

rooms.Name: The Sewer Entrance
rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of a pipe that leads from north to south. Above you
an air shaft leads up into sunlight. It seems totally impossible to go up that
way.

Exits.Description: To the north you can just make out a huge shaft leading down.
To the south you can see a triple junction leading west and east.

rooms.Name: The junction going three ways
rooms.Description:
You are in a passageway in the pipes of the sewer system leading north, east
and west.

Exits.Description: You see a sewer pipe leading north.

West. You see another junction very similar to this one that leads north and
west.

rooms.Name: The Sewer Room
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a large room with chairs set in the walls. You have the
feeling of being watched. To the south there's an entry to a larger room. The
room is lit by five torches, also set in the walls. To the west there is a
doorway leading out to the sewers.

Exits.Description: You can see an even larger room than this one, filled with light.
To the west you can see the sewers.

rooms.Name: The Sewer room
rooms.Description:
This is a Room with walls that glitters like gold though not quite like it.
This is strange as it looks as if the glitter lights the whole room. It looks
very bright. To the south the floor is covered with yucky water. The North
leads to sort of a Guard Room.

Exits.Description: To the north you can see the guard room.
To the south there is nothing but water and an exit leads east from there.

rooms.Name: The Pool in the sewer
rooms.Description:
You stand in water to your waste. To the north is the entrance to this room.
A single door leads east.

Exits.Description: To the north you see the entrance to this room.
You can see an enormous hall through the doorway.

rooms.Name: The Sewers
rooms.Description:
You stand in a dead end of the sewer. The only way out is south. You can see
a shaft leading up but it looks too difficult to go up that way.

rooms.Name: The junction
rooms.Description: You stand in a junction leading north, west and east.

Exits.Description:
Darkness has closed in on that part of the sewer system, you can't see a thing
in that direction.

West. You see another junction very similar to this one that leads north and
west.

rooms.Name: The small room
rooms.Description:
The only thing in this room of interest is a chair, and that's tight to the
rock floor. A doorway leads south and another leads east into darkness.

Exits.Description: Utter darkness... !
You can see a room with a lot of light in it. You can't make out any details.

rooms.Name: The Sewer pipe
rooms.Description:
You are in what reminds you of a foul sewer, as if you liked being here! You
can see two exits leading either north or south.

Exits.Description: To the south you can see a strange light flowing from there.

rooms.Name: The Grand Sewer
rooms.Description:
You are in a Grand Sewer Pipe. This stretches toward the south. It's large
indeed! A doorway leads to the east from here.

Exits.Description: To the north you can see a doorway.
You can't see anything in that darkness.
In the south end of the pipe the "floor" is completely covered with water.

rooms.Name: The South end of the Grand Pipe
rooms.Description:
You stand in water to your knees. A doorway leads west from here. The Pipe
stretches north.

Exits.Description: You see a lot of pictures decorating the walls.

rooms.Name: The Edge of The Water Sewer
rooms.Description:
You stand in a room where half of the floor is covered in water. The water
leads east and a doorway leads west.

Exits.Description:
You can hardly make out much more than that the next place is in a pipe with
more water.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: The Dark hallway
rooms.Description:
You can't see much of this, even with a light. The hallway goes into a
passageway to the south. A doorway leads west.

Exits.Description: You can see nothing at all because it's completely dark in that direction.
You see a lot of light, bright as daylight, but nothing of interest.

rooms.Name: The dark passageway
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

rooms.Name: The dark passageway
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

rooms.Name: The dark passageway
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

rooms.Name: The dark passageway
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue west and north. To the east there's water covering
the floor and that leads through an arched entry to a watery sewer.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.
You can just make out a triple junction leading north and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: The Watery Sewer Bend
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to bend and lead south and west.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: The Watery sewer
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: The Watery sewer
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: The Watery Sewer Junction
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead into a junction going south, north and east.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: The Watery sewer
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: The Watery sewer junction
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead into a junction that goes north, south and east.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: The Watery sewer
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: The Watery sewer bend
rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to bend and lead west and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: A ledge by the dark pool
rooms.Description:
You can't see much here but the echo tells you that there's quite a drop
down. You can just make out a huge dark pool out there in the darkness, mostly
because of the trickling of water. The water from the sewer actually washes
over this ledge and makes it quite slippery. From here it drops, like a
waterfall, into the pool far down.

Exits.Description: You can't see a thing. It's too dark.
You can't see a thing. It's too dark.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: A ledge by the dark pool
rooms.Description:
You can't see much here but the echo tells you that there's quite a drop
down. You can just make out a huge dark pool out there in the darkness, mostly
because of the trickling of water. The water from the sewer actually washes
over this ledge and makes it quite slippery. From here it drops, like a
waterfall, into the pool far down. Under you there is a small fissure in the
rock. It seems big enough to contain a few people.

Exits.Description: You can't see a thing. It's too dark.
You can't see a thing. It's too dark.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

rooms.Name: The fissure under the ledge
rooms.Description:
This is a small fissure in the solid rock. Under you lies the deep dark
pool. The water trickles quietly down from the ledge above you. The water
smells like the water in a sewer.

Exits.Description: The water edge.

rooms.Name: The Temple of Yanaquri
rooms.Description:
As you reach the end of the temple, a swirling darkness surrounds
you.  The warmth of the jungle fills your very soul as you find
yourself in the most holy of places.  The walls and ceiling once
again depict a night-time jungle, but this time the scene is much
more vivid. In the center of the hall stands an enormous statue.  You
may stay here in awe of this place, or you can continue back towards
the entrance of the temple to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The mural depicts the night-time jungle, but it appears almost too
life-like to be a painting.  As you reach to touch the mural, you can
almost feel the leaves on the trees.  You hear a low growl behind
you, and as you turn to look, you are stunned to see a fierce feline
beast flying through the trees in your direction.  Only when the
sharp claws of the beast do not tear the life from you do you realize
that it is only a part of the painting.

rooms.Name: The Spiral of Life
rooms.Description:
Ever-spiraling inward, life is a mystery to which few hold the
key.  As one reaches what appears to be the end of the spiral, she is
returned back along the same path once more.  While a mortal life may
end, the energy that drove that life never ceases to exist.  The
spiral continues ever-inward

rooms.Name: The Temple of Yanaquri
rooms.Description:
The long hall leads through the center of the magnificent temple. 
The mural in this part of the temple depicts a beautiful woman
dressed in black robes.  You can't seem to shake the feeling that you
are being followed as you wander through the temple.  The large hall
continues to the north and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The woman depicted in the mural is dressed completely in black.  Her
hair is the color of night, and her eyes are the color of the jungle. 
She is bathed by the light of a pure moonbeam as she stands with her
arms outstretched.  A cloud of darkness surrounds her, and as you
inspect it more carefully, you can see the shapes of several
creatures in its smoky depths.

rooms.Name: The Spiral of Life
rooms.Description:
Ever-spiraling inward, life is a mystery to which few hold the
key.  As one reaches what appears to be the end of the spiral, she is
returned back along the same path once more.  While a mortal life may
end, the energy that drove that life never ceases to exist.  The
spiral continues ever-inward.

rooms.Name: The Temple of Yanaquri
rooms.Description:
The long hallway continues through the center of the temple.  The
walls and ceiling are painted with a magnificent mural depicting a
beautiful woman in green robes.  As you wander through the temple,
you become to feel a little unneasy, as if you are being followed. 
When you turn to look, you see nothing but the mural.  The hall
continues to the north and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The mural depicts a beautiful woman dressed in green robes.  She
stands in the center of the jungle with her arms outstretched. 
Behind her is a swirling cloud of both darkness and light. The woman
smiles gently at you from the painting, and you feel as if you have
seen her before.

rooms.Name: The Temple of Yanaquri
rooms.Description:
An enormous hall leads through the center of the temple.  The
walls and ceiling have been painted with a beautiful mural depicting
a night-time jungle.  The floor is covered with a soft, spongy
material, that feels an awful lot like the jungle floor.  In this
place high above the trees, you feel as if you are on the ground
below, surrounded by the jungle and all of its inhabitants.  The hall
continues to the north, and the entrance of the temple is to the
south.

Exits.Description: An enormous door made of pure gold guards the entrance to the temple.
One of the panels appears to be somewhat loose.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The mural depicts the beauty of the jungle as it is at night.  As you
inspect the painting carfully, you notice that several glowing appear
to be gazing out at you from the trees.  Behind one tree, it appears
as if the wall panel is loose, and it might possibly be moved.

rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Temple
rooms.Description:
As you cross the rope bridge leading to the temple, the sounds of
the jungle suddenly cease. It is as if every creature is holding its
breath, waiting to see if you are going to make it inside.  The
entrance to the temple itself is quite magnificent.  Two large
jaguars, carved from the finest mahogany, stand guard on either side
of an enormous door made of pure gold.  You can either attempt to
enter the temple to the north, or return to the village to the south.

Exits.Description: An enormous door made of pure gold guards the entrance to the temple.
A rope bridge leads back to the village.

rooms.Name: Mikuna'wasi
rooms.Description:
The inhabitants of Miki'erke, while great hunters, sometimes want
to just relax and have their food prepared for them.  For this
purpose, Mikuna'wasi is the place to go.  A choice of raw and cooked
foods is offered by the finest chef in these parts, Mikuna himself!
The delicious smell of game permeates the air, making your mouth
water and your stomach growl.

rooms.Name: A Small Hut
rooms.Description:
The small hut appears to be some sort of sleeping area.  Mats line
the floors, many of which appear to still be occupied by sleepy
inhabitants.  A small fire burns warmly in the center of the room,
the smoke escaping through a small hole cut in the ceiling above.  An
open doorway leads to a small rope bridge to the south.

rooms.Name: Miski'wasi
rooms.Description:
Who ever said that all felines are carnivores?  They seem to enjoy
sweets just as much as anyone else, and Miski'wasi is the place to go
for delicious sugar-coated treats.  Prepared by Miski herself, the
yummy sweets here are quite exotic and very delicious.  Everything is
100% natural, with no added sugar or preservatives.  The jungle
provides the sweetness, and the treats never last long enough to need
preservatives!

rooms.Name: On a Rope Bridge
rooms.Description:
The wide rope bridge spans the space between the village and a
large temple.  To the south stands Miqi'erke, as it has for hundreds
of generations.  To the north stands an ominous temple.  Below you is
the expansive jungle, with all the life that it holds.

rooms.Name: A Small Hut
rooms.Description:
The small hut appears to be some sort of sleeping area.  Mats line
the floors, many of which appear to still be occupied by sleepy
inhabitants.  A small fire burns warmly in the center of the room,
the smoke escaping through a small hole cut in the ceiling above.  An
open doorway leads to a small rope bridge to the south.

rooms.Name: The Smiling Para'miqi
rooms.Description:
Laughter fills the air of this fun-filled place.  While the
Miqi'erke are serious about their duties, they are also serious about
enjoying themselves.  Several tables are scattered about the room,
many of which are covered with drinks and games.  A large bar spans
the western wall, and a wide variety of Miqi'erken brews are neatly
shelved behind it.  This is a place to relax and enjoy the good life.

rooms.Name: A Small Hut
rooms.Description:
The small hut appears to be some sort of sleeping area.  Mats line
the floors, many of which appear to still be occupied by sleepy
inhabitants.  A small fire burns warmly in the center of the room,
the smoke escaping through a small hole cut in the ceiling above.  An
open doorway leads to a small rope bridge to the south.

rooms.Name: The Circle of Tuta
rooms.Description:
A large circular platform made of mahogany floats above the
canopy.  The circle appears to be a place of worship.  Offerings of
flowers, fruit, nuts, and flesh have been left at various points at
the edge of the circle.  The circle continues to the south and east.

rooms.Name: The Circle of Tuta
rooms.Description:

canopy.  The circle appears to be a place of worship.  Offerings of
flowers, fruit, nuts, and flesh have been left at various points at
the edge of the circle.  The circle continues to the east and west.

rooms.Name: The Circle of Tuta
rooms.Description:

rooms.Name: The Nursery
rooms.Description:
This small hut is where the young of the village are raised.  Toys
are scattered all over the place, making it very difficult to
traverse the room.  A small rocking chair sits in the corner in front
of several small mats, apparently arranged so that they may be used
for story time or nap time.  In the center of the hut, a small fire
burns surrounded by a large iron rail to keep the kittens away from
the hot embers.  An open doorway leads east onto a rope bridge.

rooms.Name: The End of the Skyway
rooms.Description:
The skyway ends as it branches into three smaller bridges leading
to the north, south, and west.  Small buildings lie at the end of
each bridge.  Smoke rises from a small hole cut in the roof of the
structure to the north.  The buildings to the south and west appear
to be empty, but in this village you can never be quite sure.

rooms.Name: The Skyway
rooms.Description:
The skyway makes its way through the tree-top village on an
east-west route.  The wide planks seem to be quite sturdy, but it's
probably best to keep your eyes from straying to the view into the
canopy far below.  To the north and south, smaller bridges lead into
buildings.

rooms.Name: The Skyway
rooms.Description:
The wide bridge cuts through the jungle sky on its way through the
village.  Smaller bridges branch off to the north and south, leading
into buildings.  A delicious odor reaches your nose from the north. 
The skyway continues through the village to the east and west.

rooms.Name: The Skyway
rooms.Description:
The numerous tree-top walkways and bridges appear to all meet this
broad skyway.  An enormous bridge itself, the skyway is made of large
planks of wood taken from the jungle itself.  The skyway continues
through the village to the east and west, and smaller bridges branch
off to the north and south.

rooms.Name: The Skyway
rooms.Description:
The large skyway allows access to various structures in the
village.  To the north and south smaller bridges lead into tree-top
huts.  The skyway continues through the village to the east and west. 
Strange sounds can be heard coming from the east.

rooms.Name: The Skyway
rooms.Description:
As the skyway continues through the village, you notice that you
are not alone here.  From a rather large structure to the north, you
can hear the sounds of laughter.  To the south stands a smaller
building, with sounds of battle coming from within.  The skyway
continues to the east and west.

rooms.Name: The Skyway
rooms.Description:
The wide bridge cuts through the jungle sky on its way through the
village.  Smaller bridges branch off to the north and south, leading
into buildings.  To the east you can hear strange sounds, almost like
chanting, but in voices unlike any you have ever heard before.  The
skyway also continues through the village to the west.

rooms.Name: The Darkness of Night
rooms.Description:
The darkness of night surrounds you as you make your way across
the wide bridge.  Your light source can barely penetrate the black
void.  Strange sounds come from the east, an eerie chanting in an
unusual voice.  The glow of torchlight attempts to enter this dark
place from the west, but the darkness maintains its presence to the
east.

rooms.Name: The Darkness of Night
rooms.Description:
The blackness of the night surrounds you on your journey through
the sky.  A strange chanting emenates from the east.  The sounds of a
night jungle surround you and attempt to claw their way into your
very being.  You feel a presence on the bridge with you, but you
cannot see it through the darkness!  The darkened skyway continues
above the jungle to the east and west.

rooms.Name: The Circle of Tuta
rooms.Description:
A large circular platform made of mahogany floats above the
canopy.  The circle appears to be a place of worship.  Offerings of
flowers, fruit, nuts, and flesh have been left at various points at
the edge of the circle.  The circle continues to the north and south. 
A small rope bridge serves as an exit from the circle to the west.

rooms.Name: The Center of the Circle
rooms.Description:
At the center of the circular platform, a magnificent statue has
been erected.  A pure beam of moonlight shines down upon the statue,
and you realize that this circle is in a perpetual night.  Several
small offerings have been left in reverance of the statue.  The
circle surrounds this point on every side.

rooms.Name: On a Rope Bridge
rooms.Description:
The rope bridge crosses the space between several very large
trees.  You wonder just how this village stays in place, as there
doesn't seem to be anything supporting it.  The structures appear to
be sturdy, but they do not seem to be resting on anything solid.  The
rope bridge continues into the village to the north, and out of the
village to the south.

rooms.Name: A Small Hut
rooms.Description:
The small hut appears to be some sort of sleeping area.  Mats line
the floors, many of which appear to still be occupied by sleepy
inhabitants.  A small fire burns warmly in the center of the room,
the smoke escaping through a small hole cut in the ceiling above.  An
open doorway leads to a small rope bridge to the north.

rooms.Name: The Training Grounds
rooms.Description:
Stealth and cunning are the tools of the Miqi'erke, but they know
that strength and skill are also quite important.  Many brave
warriors have passed through these doors, and many more will follow. 
A large altar stands in the center of the room, indicating the
Miqi'erke allegiance to their great father.  They will fight to the
death for him if it is necessary, for they know that death is but one
step in the spiral of life.

rooms.Name: On a Rope Bridge
rooms.Description:
As you make your way across the rope bridge, you happen to glance
down into the canopy.  You can barely see the ground below, and it
looks like it's miles away.  The bridge continues into the village to
the north, and the entrance of the village is to the south.

rooms.Name: The Village of Miqi'erke
rooms.Description:
A large village, built into the very jungle itself, fills the
canopy with its splendor.  Hidden from the ground below, this
civilization has remained a secret to all but a few for thousands of
generations.  Replacing the roads of a typical village is a vast
network of rope bridges.  The village itself has been built into the
trees, with magnificent structures made of the finest wood the jungle
has to offer.  A large rope bridge leads to the north, and a small
hut lies to the south.  A strange sound emenates from the northeast -
it resembles chanting, but the voices are like none you have ever
heard before.

Exits.Description: A large rope bridge leads into the village.
A small hut stands guard at the entrance of the village.

rooms.Name: In the Jungle
rooms.Description:
The warm humid air fills your lungs with the essence of the jungle.
You are surrounded on every side by the dense understory of a lush
tropical forest.  Screaming birds can be heard high above, their songs
intermixed with the sounds of larger, and more dangerous, animals
below.  The thick vines that embrace most of the tall trees may allow
you access to the upper reaches of the jungle's canopy.

rooms.Name: Deep in the Jungle
rooms.Description:
The heat and humidity af the dense tropical forest make it rather
difficult for you to make your way through the heavy understory.  As
you gaze up at what should be the sky, all you see is the huge network
of leaf-covered branches and vines that make up the canopy.  This is
a place where myths become reality, and adventurers such as yourself
often spend an eternity attempting to explore the depths of the rich
forest.  The voices of the jungle call out in unison as you travel
through their home.  The jungle continues in every direction, and you
notice thick vines climbing the tall trees as they make their way to
the life-giving sky.

through their home.  A narrow trail appears from nowhere to the south,
and the jungle continues in every other direction.  Thick vines climb
the trees to the sky, allowing you a possible climb in that direction.

rooms.Name: Deep in the Jungle
rooms.Description:
The tall trees gaze down at you as you travel through their home.
A sense of isolation creeps into your body as you realize that unless
you can find your way back to civilization, this jungle may become
a permanent adeventure.  The tropical forest continues all around you.
Thick vines wind their way around your arboreal companions on their
way to the sky above.

rooms.Name: Deep in the Jungle

A sense of isolation creeps into your body as you realize that unless

Thick vines wind their way around your arboreal companions on their
way to the sky above.

rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Dense Jungle
rooms.Description:
The tall trees gaze down at you as you wander along the path through 
their home.  The still air is warm and humid, and you can only wish a
strong breeze would tear through this jungle in an effort to stir the
life within.  Thick vines wind their way up the trees along the trail,
offering you a foothold on their arboreal companions.  The trail
continues to the south, but it disappears without a trace to the north.
A very narrow trail cuts through the thick understory to the east.

rooms.Name: The Narrow Path
rooms.Description:
This path appears to have been made by repetitive use by some jungle
creature, and it is barely wide enough to allow you passage through the
unusually dense understory.  The lush foliage brushes against you,
despite the fact that there is no breeze forcing it to do so.  To the
east, there appears to be a clearing, and a slightly wider trail lies to
the west.

rooms.Name: A Clearing in the Jungle
rooms.Description:
This small clearing in the otherwise dense jungle appears to be
quite out of place.  An enormous tree stands at the edge of the
clearing, covered with unusually thick vines.  You feel the gaze of
many unseen eyes upon you as you examine the clearing further.  A soft
breeze caresses you from somewhere above, and when you look up you can
barely see the outline of some sort of structure at the top of the
enormous tree.  A very narrow trail leads to the west, and you are
surrounded by jungle on every other side.

rooms.Name: Wandering Through the Jungle
rooms.Description:
The deceptively beautiful forest surrounds you on every side.  The
towering trees have silently observed many life and death battles in
this forest, inculding their own battles to survive against the odds.
Established citizens of the forest crowd out the smaller ones in their
fight to reach the nourishing sky above.  Thick vines reach up into the
lush canopy that blocks your view of that very sky.

rooms.Name: Wandering Through the Jungle
rooms.Description:

Established citizens of the forest crowd out the smaller ones in their
fight to reach the nourishing sky above.  Thick vines reach up into the
lush canopy that blocks your view of that very sky.

rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Jungle
rooms.Description:
The small trail wanders through the dense jungle, offering you a
much safer means of travel than the forest that surrounds it.  The
sounds of the tropical forest surround you, and though it is quite
possible to leave the path, it might be safer to stay on it.  Thick
vines climb the trees that border the trail on each side, allowing you
a means to climb their branchless trunks.  The trail continues to the
north and south, into places unknown, and possibly dangerous.

rooms.Name: Wandering Through the Jungle
rooms.Description:

rooms.Name: In the Jungle
rooms.Description:
As you wander through the lush tropical forest, you can't help but
notice the beauty of your surroundings.  Trees surround you on every
side and smaller plants attempt to make their way upwards to the sky
above.  The damp ground is spongy with the life that teems on its
surface.  Large vines wrap themselves around nearly every tree in an
attempt to reach the sky that gives this place its energy.

rooms.Name: In the Jungle
rooms.Description:
As you wander through the lush tropical forest, you can't help but
notice the beauty of your surroundings.  Trees surround you on every
side and smaller plants attempt to make their way upwards to the sky
above.  The damp ground is spongy with the life that teems on its
surface.  Large vines wrap themselves around nearly every tree in an
attempt to reach the sky that gives this place its energy.

rooms.Name: A Small Path Through the Jungle
rooms.Description:
The small path cuts through the dense tropical forest on it's
journey to places unkown.  It appears to be well-worn, but you can not
seem to find any sign of whoever made it.  The jungle extends to the
east and south, and thick vines might allow you to climb one of the
many tall trees that line the trail.  The path continues through the
thick understory to the north and south.

rooms.Description:

above.  The damp ground is spongy with the life that teems on its
surface.  Large vines wrap themselves around nearly every tree in an
attempt to reach the sky that gives this place its energy.

rooms.Name: In the Jungle
rooms.Description:
As you wander through the lush tropical forest, you can't help but
notice the beauty of your surroundings.  Trees surround you on every
side and smaller plants attempt to make their way upwards to the sky
above.  The damp ground is spongy with the life that teems on its
surface.  Large vines wrap themselves around nearly every tree in an
attempt to reach the sky that gives this place its energy.

rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
From this vantage point, you can see that the inhabitants of the jungle
have adapted to life in the various strata of the forest.  Plants and
animals thrive far from the ground below.  The vines continue into the
canopy above.  Most of them also extend to the ground below, with the
scarce yet vital nutrients it offers.

rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  The thick vines continue their journey upwards allowing you to
follow them in that direction.  You may also return to the relative 
safety of the ground below along the path of the vines that return in
that direction.

rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
rooms.Description:

rooms.Description:

been built high above in the limbs of this tree, blocking your view of 
the sky.  The large vines continue towards the structure, and also
return to the ground below.

the vines upon which you climb appears to be hollow, and a large circle

Exits.Description: The large circle appears to be moveable.

nutrients it offers.

rooms.Description:

can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  A large branch extends from the tree that plays host to the vines,
but it appears to be rather unstable.  The vines extend along the
branch, but they do not appear to continue upwards, and you cannot reach
the next branch from here.

rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
rooms.Description:

reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.

have adapted to life in the various strata of the forest.  A strange 
circle has been carved into the tree that the vines call home.  The
vines continue into the canopy above, and most of them also extend to
the ground below.

Exits.Description: The large circle appears to actually be a doorway into the tree.

rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  The thick vines end abruptly here, and you cannot reach the next
branch to continue climbing into the canopy.

rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
The tree that the vines are climbing echoes as you struggle to ascend, 
and you notice a large circle has been carved into its side.  The vines 
continue into the canopy above, and return to the ground below.

Exits.Description: The circle carved into the tree appears to be some sort of door.

rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
rooms.Description:
The vines seem to climb into the very sky itself as you attempt to 
follow them to canopy.  You feel very dizzy as you look down at the
ground so far below.  Thick foliage blocks your way further into the
canopy of the jungle. A large sturdy branch extends south from the
tree, and it looks strong enough to hold your weight.

rooms.Name: On a Large Branch
rooms.Description:
You feel your balance falter as you attempt to move across the large
branch.  As you begin to slip and fall, you manage to catch hold of the
large vines that cling to the branch.  When you regain your balance,
and actually have a chance to survey your surroundings, you are in awe
of the beauty of the jungle.  Large birds fly past you screaming as you
invade their home, and you spot a small group of monkeys in a nearby
tree. If you move all the way to the end of the branch, you might just
be able to drop to the vines of the neighboring tree, or you can return
to the large tree to the north.

rooms.Name: At the Top of a Tree
rooms.Description:
The vines end abruptly as they reach the top of the tree.  This tree
is considerably smaller than the ones surrounding it, but it still races
to reach the sky and the sunlight it needs to flourish.  The air is much
cooler as you approach the canopy, and the humidty disperses as a soft
breeze blows gently through your perch. You can climb back down the
vines to the ground, or you can just stay here and enjoy the view.

rooms.Name: At the Top of a Tree
rooms.Description:

is considerably smaller than the ones surrounding it, but it still races

rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
rooms.Description:
The thick vines continue into the canopy of the jungle on their way
to reach the sky.  Thick foliage obscures your view of the ground
beneath the tree that plays host to the vines.  The foliage becomes even
more dense above you, making it impossible to climb any further in that
direction.

rooms.Name: On a Large Branch
rooms.Description:
This large branch is covered with hundreds of ants, working
diligently to strip it of its leaves to use them for food.  The branch
extends several feet from the tree to the west.  A large tree is just
east of here, and you might just be able to climb onto it from this
perch.  The end of the branch appears to be very weak, so it might be
impossible to return if you decide to take that route.

rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point, and progress into the canopy above is nearly impossible.  You
see a large branch high above, but you cannot reach it from here in
order to continue to the top of the tree.  The least difficult route
would be to climb back down the tree to the ground below.

rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point, and progress into the canopy above is nearly impossible.  The
dense foliage flourishes as you gaze up into the multitude of life in
the canopy.  Several large birds take flight from a nearby branch,
startling you and causing you to nearly fall to your death!  The sounds
of the jungle surround you on every side, and you can feel the gaze of
creatures hidden in the forest around you.

rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point, and progress into the canopy above is nearly impossible.  The
dense foliage flourishes as you gaze up into the multitude of life in
the canopy.  Several large birds take flight from a nearby branch,
startling you and causing you to nearly fall to your death!  The sounds

creatures hidden in the forest around you.

rooms.Name: Climbing an Enormous Tree
rooms.Description:
The heavy vines continue on their route into the canopy, allowing you
access to the very sky that brings this place to life.  Your view of the
sky is obscured by the large leaf-covered branches that extend from the
crown of this enormous tree.  To the east is a large network of vines
that connect this tree and the next one.  A large branch extends to the
south, and the vines continue towards the ground.

rooms.Name: On a Large Branch
rooms.Description:
The large branch is covered with thick vines and many smaller
branches.  To the north lies the tree that this branch extends from.
A small flock of parrots flies past you on their way to some avian
meeting place in the canopy.  You can hear the calls of their feathered
brethren above you.

rooms.Name: Climbing an Enormous Tree
rooms.Description:
The large tree that hosts the vines upon which you climb seems to
extend forever towards the sky.  The dense foliage of the canopy is
just above you and you can barely see the sky through the mutlitude of
leaves.  A large network of vines links this tree to the one just west
of it, and the vines continue into the canopy, allowing you to follow
their passage.

rooms.Name: Climbing the Enormous Tree
rooms.Description:
The enormous tree extends upwards, but your view of the sky is
blocked by a large wooden structure that has been built in the crown
of the tree.  Far below lies a small clearing in the jungle, and the
vines encircling this tree might allow you to reach it.  The vines
also continue upwards, towards the large structure above.

rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point, and progress into the canopy above is nearly impossible.  You
see a large branch high above, but you cannot reach it from here in
order to continue to the top of the tree.  The least difficult route
would be to climb back down the tree to the ground below.

rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
rooms.Description:

point, and progress into the canopy above is nearly impossible.  You
see a large branch high above, but you cannot reach it from here in
order to continue to the top of the tree.  The least difficult route

rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point.  A large branch reaches down to you from above, and you though
you can barely reach it, it might allow you to continue towards the top
of the tree.  The vines return to the relative safety of the ground
below.

rooms.Description:

diligently to strip it of its leaves to use them for food.  The branch

canopy of the jungle. A large sturdy branch extends east from the
tree, and it looks strong enough to hold your weight.

rooms.Name: At the Top of a Tree
rooms.Description:

is considerably smaller than the ones surrounding it, but it still races
