rooms.Name: Inside the Jungle Canopy
rooms.Description:
The top of the tree is alive with the many creatures of the jungle.
A large flock of birds watches you from a nearby tree as you survey
your arboreal perch.  Tiny ants march back and forth across the many
branches that extend from the large tree.  You can see the outline of
a large wooden structure perched several trees over to the east.  The
vines that make their way to the top of this tree also return to the
base of it, allowing you safe passage in that direction.

rooms.Name: Inside the Jungle Canopy
rooms.Description:
The jungle canopy is filled with a multitide of tropical flora and
fauna.  A slight breeze cools your sweat-soaked body as it wanders in
from the east.  The tree upon which you are perched is covered with
vines that extend in every direction.  Several vines make their way
across to a neighboring tree east of here, and in that direction you
notice a large wooden structure has been built in the enormous crown
of the majestic tree.  The branches above you are too small to support
your weight, so you decide it would not be wise to continue toward the
sky.

rooms.Name: Inside the Jungle Canopy
rooms.Description:
The thick foliage of the jungle canopy surrounds you on every side.
The tree appears to extend several more feet into the sky, and you
see a large wooden structure built into it just above you.  A ladder
made of vines makes its way into the structure.  Several large vines
return to the base of the tree, and a few reach out to the tree that
neighbors this one to the west.

rooms.Name: Inside the Jungle Canopy
rooms.Description:
The crown of this large tree extends in every direction across the
jungle canopy.  Thick vines surround the many branches winding their
way back down to the ground.  The large branches sway in the breeze,
making any movement across them very dangerous if not impossible.
You can climb down the tree towards the ground, but the lack of a
sturdy branch above impedes further progress in that direction.

rooms.Name: On a Large Branch
rooms.Description:
The large branch extends from a mighty tree to the west.  You can
see several other branches above you, but they are just out of your
reach.  The drop to the ground below is rather dangerous, so it might
be best to climb the branch to the tree.

rooms.Name: The Tree-top Hut
rooms.Description:
The large tree-top structure appears to be a hut of some sort, made
by the secretive inhabitants of the jungle canopy.  It seems to be
quite deserted, but the remains of a small fire smoulder in the center
of the structure as if it was abandoned only recently.  A large wooden
door has been built into the northern wall, perhaps leading to other
tree-top huts.  A small ladder made of vines extends down from the hut
into the trees below.

Exits.Description: A small wooden door leads to places unknown.

rooms.Name: Inside the Tree
rooms.Description:
The large tree appears to have been hollowed out to form a rather
comfortable shelter.  A small stairway winds around the inside of the
tree allowing you to move up or down.  On the western wall of the
arboreal shelter is a large circular door.

Exits.Description: The doorway leads to the outside of the tree.

rooms.Name: Inside the Tree
rooms.Description:
The small shelter inside the tree extends all the way to the top, but
the stairway ends here.  As you gaze up into the top of the tree, you
notice a large nest has been built there.  Bits of feather float down
to you, landing like a soft snow at your feet.  The stairway continues
down into the tree.

rooms.Name: Inside the Base of the Tree
rooms.Description:
The inside of the large tree has been hollowed out to form a rather
comfortable shelter.  A small spiral stairway winds its way up around 
the inside of the tree.  An eerie light fills this part of the shelter, 
allowing you to see that it is in fact a small home.  A small altar
covered with twigs and leaves stands against one wall, and a mat sits
in front of it for sleeping or worship.

rooms.Name: Inside the Tree
rooms.Description:
The large tree appears to have been hollowed out to form a rather
comfortable shelter.  A small stairway winds around the inside of the
tree allowing you to move up or down.  On the southern wall of the
arboreal shelter is a large circular door.

Exits.Description: The door leads to the outside of the tree.

As you gaze up into the top of the tree, you notice a large nest has 
been built there.  Bits of feather float down to you, landing like a 
soft snow at your feet.  The stairway continues up toward the nest and
down into the tree.

rooms.Name: Inside the Top of the Tree
rooms.Description:
The top of this tree is dominated by a large nest, surrounded by the
spiral staircase that runs around the inside of this shelter.  The nest
is filled with enormous egg shells, discarded by the young birds that 
must have been recently born here.  Large feathers line the nest, making
it a cozy place to raise young ones.  The small stairway winds its way
back down the tree below you.

rooms.Name: Inside the Base of the Tree
rooms.Description:
The inside of the large tree has been hollowed out to form a rather
comfortable shelter.  A small spiral stairway winds its way up around 
the inside of the tree.  An eerie light fills this part of the shelter, 
allowing you to see that it is in fact a small home.  A small altar
covered with twigs and leaves stands against one wall, and a mat sits
in front of it for sleeping or worship.

rooms.Name: Inside the Tree
rooms.Description:
The large tree appears to have been hollowed out to form a rather
comfortable shelter.  A small stairway winds around the inside of the
tree allowing you to move up or down.  On the southern wall of the
arboreal shelter is a large circular door.

Exits.Description: The circular door leads to the outside of the tree.

rooms.Name: Inside the Tree
rooms.Description:
The small shelter inside the tree extends all the way to the top, but
the stairway ends here.  As you gaze up into the top of the tree, you
notice a large nest has been built there.  Bits of feather float down
to you, landing like a soft snow at your feet.  The stairway continues
down into the tree.

rooms.Name: Inside the Base of the Tree
rooms.Description:
The inside of the large tree has been hollowed out to form a rather
comfortable shelter.  A small spiral stairway winds its way up around 
the inside of the tree.  An eerie light fills this part of the shelter, 
allowing you to see that it is in fact a small home.  A small altar
covered with twigs and leaves stands against one wall, and a mat sits
in front of it for sleeping or worship.

rooms.Name: Inside the Tree
rooms.Description:
The large tree appears to have been hollowed out to form a rather
comfortable shelter.  The inside of the tree feels safe and warm, almost
like home!  On the southern wall of the arboreal shelter is a large
circular door.

Exits.Description: The circular door leads to the outside of the tree.

rooms.Name: Under the mudhole
rooms.Description:
You stand in a small room with a great big opening in the ceiling. From this
opening there's mud dripping down in large lumps. >YUCK<. You can smell the
foul stench of the slimy sediment as you try not to get covered by the falling
sludge. To the east there is an entryway leading out from here and it seems
absolutely impossible to force the muddy decent.

Exits.Description: East. You see nothing of interest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You never saw such disgusting matter before, it nearly makes you puke.

rooms.Name: Under the Dark Pit
rooms.Description:
Nice place you found yourself. You stand in the middle of a room with only
two exits, Up and East. A tall ladder is left here so that you can climb up
through the Pit without the use of a rope.

Exits.Description: Up. You can't see a thing up there, it's way too dark.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is funny enough a wooden ladder and, after closer inspection, you
discover it is magically held towards the wall!  You can't, even with your
greatest effort, rock it at ALL!

rooms.Name: A muddy bend in the sewer system
rooms.Description:
You are standing in what looks like a bend in the pipe system of the sewer.
The 'floor' is covered completely by mud! This includes covering your legs up
to you knees as well. The pipe leads west and south.

Exits.Description:
To the south there's less mud than here! It actually seems to end there! You
have a felling it would be nice to have your feet free from mud again.

You can see a room in which mud drips from the roof onto the floor in great
cakes of sludge. There doesn't seem to be any exits from that room apart from
in you direction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You never saw such disgusting matter before, it nearly makes you puke.

rooms.Name: A junction in the sewer pipes
rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of what looks like a triple junction of pipes going
east, west and north.

Exits.Description: You can see a mud area starting in that direction.
East. You can't even make out what it might look like, it's just too dark.
West. There's a room with a ladder leading up.

rooms.Name: Down the old well
rooms.Description:
You are dangling on the slippery sides of the old well leading down and up.
The only secure point here is the metal bars that are cemented into the sides,
the ones that you cling frantically to so that you don't fall. Who knows how
deep this well is? The bars lead down and up and nowhere else.

Exits.Description:
There's a slight, dim light from above, or maybe it's your imagination. Anyway
it SEEMS darker down here than up there, if that is possible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These look like they're pretty slippery, and not very safe, but perhaps safe
enough for you to climb down, WITH both hands on them.

rooms.Name: The northwestern corner of the ledge
rooms.Description:
You stand, swaying out from the ledge, with only a couple of inches of safe,
solid ledge under your feet. The ledge continues to the east but not back
south. It seems that the ledge is too narrow to turn on so you'll have to
continue forward.

Exits.Description: The ledge continues east.
The ledge continues south.
The Abyss lies down there. Who knows what might lurk down there?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks as if it can be opened in a door-like fashion.  Maybe this will lead
the way down.

A small rock sticks out right under it, otherwise the way is DOWN, DOWN, and
SPLAT!!!

This is truly a weird piece of craftsmanship in your eyes.  The edge seems to
form a step leading down, but WHAT a STEP DOWN.  The Abyss opens down there 
leading to seemingly total destruction.

rooms.Name: The narrow ledge
rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

Exits.Description: North. The ledge leads into a corner and turns eastward.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling an utterly unknown distance.
South. The ledge leads further south into utter darkness.

rooms.Name: The narrow ledge
rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

Exits.Description: North. The ledge leads further north.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.
The ledge continues further south into darkness.

rooms.Name: The narrow ledge
rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

Exits.Description: North. The ledge leads further north.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.
The ledge continues south into darkness.

rooms.Name: The narrow ledge
rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

Exits.Description: North. The ledge leads further north.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.
South. You can just make out the south-western corner of this ledge.

rooms.Name: The southwestern corner of the ledge
rooms.Description:
This seems like a ledge that is a little broader than the one just to the
north of here. The ledge seems to lead around some sort of Abyss of total
darkness. The ledge seems to have an odd-looking edge here.

Exits.Description: North. The ledge leads further north.
You see a broad ledge leading eastward.
South of here is the exit from the ledge.
The Abyss lies down there. Who knows what might lurk down there?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks as if it can be opened in a door-like fashion.  Maybe this will lead
the way down.

A small rock sticks out right under it, otherwise the way is DOWN, DOWN, and
SPLAT!!!

This is truly a weird piece of craftsmanship in your eyes.  The edge seems to
form a step leading down, but WHAT a STEP DOWN.  The Abyss opens down there 
leading to seemingly total destruction.

rooms.Name: An odd intersection
rooms.Description:
You stand in a rather odd intersection of pipes. The pipes actually don't
resemble pipes anymore. They look more like a real stone tunnel, or a
passageway hewn directly into the rock. The ways from here lead north, east and
west.

Exits.Description: North. You see a ledge to something that looks like an abyss.

rooms.Name: The narrow ledge going east to west
rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

Exits.Description: The ledge leads further east.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.

rooms.Name: Mid-air
rooms.Description:
You've just stepped into the most unlucky position in the whole of ELITEMUD.
The result of such a foolish act should be punished with death, you know. With
an acceleration of approximately 9. 82 meters per second per second, you are
now descending the Abyss. What awaits you at the bottom will continue to be a
mystery. Bye Cruel World.

rooms.Name: The Broad ledge
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a ledge that seems quite a lot larger than the rest of
the ledges. This one leads to the west and the east, plus it has an exit going
to the south. Though you could jump into mid-air, but it probably wouldn't be
such a good idea. The way south is in utter darkness.

rooms.Name: The northeastern corner of the ledge
rooms.Description:
You stand, swaying out from the ledge, with only a couple of inches of safe,
solid ledge under your feet. The ledge continues to the west and leads south
from here into darkness.

Exits.Description: The ledge continues west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can just make out the outline of a trapdoor here in the soil.  The earth
is probably there to conceal a secret entrance.  This looks as if it leads down
into the seemingly solid rock face of the ledge.

The ground here seems a little different from all the other ledges along the
Abyss.  There's a kind of soft soil on this ledge, maybe you should look 
carefully at this.  It seems to be of some interest.

rooms.Name: The narrow eastern ledge
rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards. And THAT is west of here so watch your step.

Exits.Description: The ledge leads further south.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.

rooms.Name: The narrow eastern ledge
rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards. And THAT is west of here so watch your step.

Exits.Description: The ledge leads further south.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.

rooms.Name: The narrow eastern ledge
rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards. And THAT is west of here so watch your step.

Exits.Description: The ledge leads further south.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.

rooms.Name: The narrow eastern ledge
rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards. And THAT is west of here so watch your step. You
also see a small opening to the east.

Exits.Description: East. You stare into darkness.
The ledge leads further south.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.

rooms.Name: The southeastern corner of the ledge
rooms.Description:
This seems like a ledge that is a little broader than the one just to the
north of here. The ledge seems to lead around some sort of abyss of total
darkness.

Exits.Description: North of here you can see a ledge.
The ledge leads further west.
The Abyss lies down there. Who knows what might lurk down there?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks as if it can be opened in a door-like fashion.  Maybe this will lead
the way down.

A small rock sticks out right under it, otherwise the way is DOWN, DOWN, and
SPLAT!!!

This is truly a weird piece of craftsmanship in your eyes.  The edge seems to
form a step leading down, but WHAT a STEP DOWN.  The Abyss opens down there 
leading to seemingly total destruction.

rooms.Name: Under the pit
rooms.Description:
You stand in a completely dark cavern leading west. The wall looks weird
here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: There is a crack here that looks like it has been made recently.

rooms.Name: Under The Shaft
rooms.Description:
A ladder leads up from here to the Shaft. A small opening leads west from
here.

Exits.Description: You can see a narrow ledge going north and south.
It's too dark up there.

rooms.Name: The sewer line
rooms.Description:
You are in a narrow part of the sewer. Down the sewer continues and to the
north is the ledge.

Exits.Description: You can see the southern part of the ledge.
You look deeper down into the drain.

rooms.Name: The sewer pipe
rooms.Description:
You are in an odd sewer pipe You see some odd scratches on the pipe wall, as
from a gigantic rat. You can see some slimy water gently running down into a
sewer drain, and north the drain continues.

rooms.Name: Mid-air
rooms.Description:
You've just stepped into the most unlucky position in the whole of DikuMUD.
The result of such a foolish act should be punished with death, you know. With
an acceleration of approximately 9. 82 meters per second per second, you are now
descending the Abyss. What awaits you at the bottom will continue to be a
mystery. Bye Cruel World.

rooms.Name: The Edge of the Water
rooms.Description:
The pool side is dimly lit up by your light. You can see absolutely
nothing else nearby. The darkness here seems enormously oppressive here. 
The air is damp and the rock on which you stand is slippery. The pool
seems too dark to make anything clear. The pool seems to extend to the
east. The rock can be climbed upwards from here. 
§N

rooms.Name: The plateau
rooms.Description:
Here the narrow path leads to a plateau. On the plateau the path divides in
one branch going north up the mountain and one going east up the mountain.
To the south the path goes down to the valley.

Exits.Description: The path continues.
Mountain trail

rooms.Name: Narrow path up the mountain
rooms.Description:
You are on a narrow path leading up a ragged mountain. To the south the path
makes its way to a plateau.

Exits.Description: The path continues up the mountain.

rooms.Name: Narrow path at the middle of the mountain
rooms.Description:
Standing on the middle of the mountain, you can easily see the city of 
Midgaard far to the south, and the top of the mountain is very near to the
north.

Exits.Description: The top of the mountain is easily seen from here.

rooms.Name: Top of Mountain
rooms.Description:
You are now on the top of the mountain. To the south you see a path leading
down the mountain. To the east and west you see entrances to what seems like
mines.

Exits.Description: An entrance to the mountain which seems to lead underground.
There is an entrance to the mountain.

rooms.Name: Narrow Path
rooms.Description:
This is a narrow path leading to the Dwarven Kingdom. It looks less
traveled than the others, and it is very creepy. The path opens up to the
south, and continues to the north.

rooms.Name: Entrance to Mountain
rooms.Description:
Here is an entrance to the mountain. The door looks very well built, and you
can hear noise coming from within.

rooms.Name: Bend in Narrow Path
rooms.Description:
This is a narrow path that bends to the east here. The trees hang over the
path, and it is very overgrown. The narrow path continues to the south and to
the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They hang over the road in the most ominous of ways.

rooms.Name: Narrow path
rooms.Description: This path is very narrow, and it continues to the north and west.

rooms.Name: Narrow north-south path
rooms.Description:
This path leads to the north and south. To the north you can see a door, and
to the south the path continues.

rooms.Name: Door to Kingdom
rooms.Description:
Here the path turns to the west. You can see a door in front of you, and the
path continues to the west and south.

rooms.Name: Path to the Castle
rooms.Description:
You are on a path that will eventually lead to the castle. It continues
north to the castle, and there is a door on the southern wall.

rooms.Name: Still on the path to the Castle
rooms.Description:
You are still on the path to the castle, or back to the Dwarven village,
whichever way you wish to go. The path continues to the north and south.

rooms.Name: Door to Castle
rooms.Description:
Here there is a door to the castle to the east. The castle is elegantly
designed, and looks much like a roll of toilet paper standing on it's end.
There is a sign which says: ****************************************** *
WELCOME TO THE CASTLE OF STRANGELOVE * * Here, celibacy is uninvited *
******************************************

rooms.Name: Inside the entrance
rooms.Description:
Everything here is covered in soot and very grimy. The path continues to the
east and north, and there is a door to the west.

Exits.Description: The little underground path continues to the north.
The path leads outside the entrance.
This looks like an entrance to some type of store room.

rooms.Name: Path
rooms.Description:
You are on a path in the dwarven village which leads north to the shops and
south to the corner of the area.

rooms.Name: Turn in road
rooms.Description:
You are on a path that leads to a Hide & Tooth shop to the west, and the
path continues to the south.

Exits.Description: The Hide & Tooth shop is seen to the west.

rooms.Name: Hide & Tooth Shop
rooms.Description:
You are in the Hide & Tooth shop. Here you may buy the finest in Dwarven
weapons and armors. The path continues to the north and east.

rooms.Name: Path to the north of shop
rooms.Description:
You are on a path to the north of the Hide & Tooth shop. The path continues
to the north, and there is Granite Head's bakery to the west.

rooms.Name: North of Shops
rooms.Description:
Here the path bends to the east towards the barracks. To the south you can
see the shops.

rooms.Name: Path by Hospital
rooms.Description:
Here the path passes by the Hospital to the north. It continues to the east
to the barracks, and to the west.

rooms.Name: Path next to barracks
rooms.Description: Here the path continues west, and east to the barracks.

rooms.Name: Entrance to barracks
rooms.Description:
Here there is an entrance to the barracks to the south, and the path
continues to the west.

rooms.Name: Guard House
rooms.Description:
You are in the guard house to the west of the entrance to the castle. There
are nudie posters covering the walls.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: There is a wall poster of a nude Minne Pearl.

rooms.Name: First Barrack room
rooms.Description:
Here is the first of two main rooms of barracks. The barracks continue to
the south, and you can leave the room to the north.

rooms.Name: Back of Barracks
rooms.Description:
Here is the back of the dwarven barracks. There are rows of beds here, and
there is a stench that is unbearable.

rooms.Name: Inside of Castle Strangelove
rooms.Description:
You are just inside the castle. It is very tubular in shape, and it is very
featureless. There is a set of stairs that lead up, and the door leads out of
the castle to the west.

rooms.Name: A store room
rooms.Description:
There is a layer of dust on the floor at least 3 inches thick! It is
probable that not many people have been in here for many months.

Exits.Description: A lighted area that looks like a well worn path.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: After blowing all the dust off the floor, you notice a trapdoor!

rooms.Name: Wine cellar
rooms.Description:
This room smells like wine, and you can only assume it used to be a wine
cellar at one time.

rooms.Name: Stairs in castle
rooms.Description: The stairs continue to circle up and down here.

rooms.Name: Stairs
rooms.Description:
You are still circling around on the stairs. You are starting to get dizzy
from going around and around and around and around and around. The stairs
continue up and down.

rooms.Name: Top of stairs
rooms.Description:
You are at the top of the stairs in the castle. There is an exit to the
east, and the stairs lead down.

rooms.Name: Queen's waiting room
rooms.Description:
This is the Queen's waiting room. Here the men literally "wait" for the
queen. You've heard that the queen really likes to get to 'know' her people, in
the biblical sense. The queen's bedroom is to the north, and you can see stairs
to the west.

rooms.Name: Bedroom
rooms.Description:
This is the Queen's bedroom. The bed is all ruffled, and there is a stack of
dirty sheets piled in the corner. There is a ladder that leads down, out of the
castle, and you can leave the room to the south. There is a sign that says:
------------------------- | I'm busy right now, | | and don't know when | | Ill
be back, but if | | there is a key here | | take it and PLEASE, | | try to get
my birth | | control pills back! | | I've heard they can | | be found
somewhere, | | deep in the mines.. | -------------------------

rooms.Name: North side of Castle Strangelove
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the north side of Castle Strangelove. You notice that
you are no longer inside the mountain anymore either. Along the southern
horizon you see towering mountains. THIS AREA IS NOT OPEN SO GO BACK UP!

rooms.Name: Hospital
rooms.Description:
You are inside the Dwarven Hospital. It smells like rubbing alcohol, and
there is blood all over the walls.

rooms.Name: Granite Head's Bakery
rooms.Description:
The aroma coming from this room is astonishing. You can almost taste the
pastry's dissolving in your mouth.

rooms.Name: Dark path
rooms.Description:
This path is very well worn, and there is an entrance to the mines to the
east, while the path continues to the north and west.

rooms.Name: Mine entrance
rooms.Description:
The little path here leads down toward the mines, while the worn path
continues to the west.

rooms.Name: Bottom of mineshaft
rooms.Description:
You are at the bottom of the mineshaft. The air here is very sooty, and it
is very hard to breath. The mineshaft leads up and east.

rooms.Name: Path in the mine
rooms.Description:
You are deep inside the mine, and you feel very uncomfortable. The path
continues to the east, and leads to the mineshaft to the west.

rooms.Name: Mine crossroad
rooms.Description:
You are at a crossroad in the mine. There is a door to the north, and the
path continues to the south, east, and west.

rooms.Name: Coal Room
rooms.Description:
You are inside the storage area for the raw materials that are found down
here. The room is very unsturdy as the supports are very rickety.

rooms.Name: Mine Maze
rooms.Description:
You have entered the maze of the mines. To the east you can see some
inscriptions, and you can exit to the south.

rooms.Name: Maze inscription
rooms.Description:
You are inside the maze, but not far enough in that you could get lost.
There is an inscription on the wall which says: 1 3 2 4 N W N S This isn't too
tough, so don't take it so rough.

rooms.Name: Maze
rooms.Description: You are in a maze.

rooms.Name: Maze
rooms.Description: You are in a maze.

rooms.Name: Maze
rooms.Description: You are in a maze.

rooms.Name: Mining equipment room
rooms.Description:
This is the storage room for equipment used by the Dwarven miners. It is
very small, and you can tell that not many miners actually use any equipment.

rooms.Name: Solved the Maze
rooms.Description:
You have solved the maze. You can tell by the last few moves that there is
no way that a dumb worker could have figured that out. It seems pretty desolate
here. To the south is a bleak room. To the north, you see the maze. There is a
sign above the south exit: THOSE WHO ENTER, PLAN ON A TIMELY DEATH. (ESPECIALLY
IF YOU'RE LOYAL TO THE QUEEN)

rooms.Name: The Mazekeeper's Room
rooms.Description:
You have entered the Mazekeeper's room. There are pictures of the Queen with
darts thrown in it. Spray painted on the wall are things like 'the queen shall
suffer' and 'Catholics Rule'.

rooms.Name: The Start of the Old Trail up the Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the base of the Moria mountains. A half cleared trail
leads up the mountains to the north. To the south a trail leads back to
Midgaard. Far to the west you can see the river flowing into the mountain and
to the east you see the large forest of Namir. A large sign have been placed
on a pole here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads
North, Old Trail to the Dwarven mines.
South, Trail to the city of Midgaard.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You are on a half cleared mountain trail. You are walking between high 
cliffs and large rocks. The trail makes its way upward to the north and to the
south it goes down to the base of the mountain.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You are walking on a old trail up the mountain. Large rocks and cliffs
surround you on both sides. The trail continues up to the north and down to
the south.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You have almost reached the top of the mountain. To the south you see the
forest of Namir. If you look very closely to the south-west you can see the
city of Midgaard. The trail continues up to the north and down to the south.

rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
rooms.Description:
You are walking on a trail going up the mountain. Further ahead the trail
makes a turn around a large cliff. If you walk north you will go around this
rock and if you walk south you will go down the mountain to its base.

rooms.Name: A Mountain Path
rooms.Description:
You are on a mountain path which ascends a steep mountainside. The trail
curves around the mountain so that you cannot really see what lies ahead. You
do sense great power though coming from the area behind the mountain.

rooms.Name: A Mountain Path
rooms.Description: You are on a small path going up the mountain.

rooms.Name: Mountainside Tombs
rooms.Description:
There are a few stone heaps here and there, the tombs of those who did not
last the arduous journey up the mountain. Curiously you notice a few uncovered
bodies which don't seem to have died of exhaustion. The path curves east around
the mountain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They look as if their necks have been broken and their flesh, chewed.

You are sure glad that YOU aren't under one of those piles!  Many of the 
tombstones have the same name on them, 'Rognab'.  He must come here a lot.

rooms.Name: A Blind Curve on the Mountain Path.
rooms.Description:
This looks like a normal mountain path, but it is NOT! This section of the
path is inhabited by a huge (and of course, man-eating) Cyclops. The path makes
its final ascent to an overlook.

rooms.Name: Vista
rooms.Description:
This is a stunning vista overlooking a canyon. There is a sign here that
says: 	BEHOLD -- ELEMENTAL CANYON Fire leaps up from fire pits in the western
part of the canyon. The sky looks funny, and the air seems hazy to the
northwest. Electricity sparks intermittently in the northeast. To the east you
see a strong, magic-looking river flowing through the canyon. Also to the east
you spy a cave entrance leading into the canyon wall. The path descends to the
north to another overlook.

rooms.Name: The Overlook
rooms.Description:
You see various elemental servants wandering around the canyon. The noise of
humming coming from the canyon gets louder. The path makes a steep descent into
the canyon here.

rooms.Name: Entrance to Elemental Canyon
rooms.Description:
You are awed by the sounds and sights of great powers at works here.
Elemental servants bustle back and forth doing the bidding of the elemental
rulers. You see a sort of cross roads to the north, and you can climb up to the
overlook here.

rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always a incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon continues north and east.

rooms.Name: Elemental Gateway
rooms.Description:
To the west a path dips and winds among some flowing fire pits. To the
northeast a path goes toward the river. Beyond toward the northeast and
northwest are outcrops which rise up from the canyon floor. To the east there
is a cave mouth which leads into the canyon wall. And to the south the path
leads up, away, and out of the canyon. Various pure and cross-breeds of
elemental forms wander the canyon floor, which extends in a wide swath
northwards.

rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always a incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends north and west. There is a cave mouth set into
the canyon wall to the east.

rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends off to the north, east, and south.

rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends in all directions.

rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends north, south, and west. A path follows a stream
to the east.

rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends north, east, and south. To the west a garden is
on fire.

rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
rooms.Description:

going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends in all directions.

going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The Canyon floor extends north, south and west.

rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends east and south. You can climb a rise in the
canyon floor to the north.

rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends east, south, and west.

rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends south and west. You can climb a rise in the
canyon floor to the north.

rooms.Name: Dark Cave
rooms.Description:
You notice a path winding east among some huge boulders. You feel a powerful
source of energy from that direction.

rooms.Name: Darker Caves
rooms.Description:
You can barely see your way even with a light source. The rocks of the cave
are even darker than the darkness. You hear a powerful humming all around you.
Cave paths go south and east roughly, its hard to tell exactly when you can't
see where you are going.

rooms.Name: Darker Caves
rooms.Description:
You can barely see your way even with a light source. The rocks of the cave
are even darker than the darkness. You hear a powerful humming all around you.
Cave paths go south and west roughly; it's hard to tell exactly when you can't
see where you are going.

rooms.Name: Darker Caves
rooms.Description:
You can barely see your way even with a light source. The rocks of the cave
are even darker than the darkness. You hear a powerful humming all around you.
Cave paths go north, south and east roughly; it's hard to tell exactly when you
can't see where you are going.

rooms.Name: Darker Caves
rooms.Description:
You can barely see your way even with a light source. The rocks of the cave
are even darker than the darkness. You hear a powerful humming all around you.
Cave paths go north, south and west roughly, it's hard to tell exactly when you
can't see where you are going.

rooms.Name: Darkest Caves
rooms.Description:
Your light doesn't even seem to work here. Even magical light sources seem
only to illuminate about a foot ahead of you. You suddenly realize that the
path has descended quite a bit but you didn't notice before because of the
darkness. You sense a great presence a way off to the east.

rooms.Name: Darkest Caves
rooms.Description:
Your light doesn't even seem to work here. Even magical light sources seem
only to illuminate about a foot ahead of you. You suddenly realize that the
path has descended quite a bit but you didn't notice before because of the
darkness. You sense a great presence directly to the east.

rooms.Name: Earth Chamber
rooms.Description:
This is the abode of the Earth Ruler. He decides about earthquakes,
landslides, and avalanches. The Earth Ruler sits upon a huge marble throne
carved into the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ruler notices your stare, and doesn't like it one bit!  The whole 
earth seems to shake with his emotion.

rooms.Name: By the River
rooms.Description:
The water in the river seems to bubble and froth with magic. Though it
splashes playfully on you, it does not seem wet. The path leads north closer to
the water. To the west you see a T-intersection.

rooms.Name: In the River
rooms.Description:
To continue you had to walk right in the river. Though you walk along in
water up to your knees, you do not seem to get wet. A bay stretches out to the
north and the river goes south.

rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

rooms.Name: Water Chamber
rooms.Description:
This chamber was magically created here on the floor of the bay. It looks
like it's been here for a long, long time. Though you are 'under water' there
is no difficulty breathing normally, and oddly you do not feel the pressure of
the water above you.

rooms.Name: A Fiery Pathway
rooms.Description:
You tread carefully along a path which dips and turns among geysers of fire.
Miniature volcanoes spew lava in rivers. The fire is hot but not altogether
dangerous. The path extends east and south.

rooms.Name: A Fiery Pathway
rooms.Description:
You tread carefully along a path which dips and turns among pits of fire and
beds of coals. A garden to the west glows with an everlasting fire.

rooms.Name: The Burning Gardens
rooms.Description:
Everywhere around you the landscape is afire; the rocks, the shrubs and even
the air seems to be aflame. Curiously, the magical fire does not seem to
consume its hosts. A path leads east among some fire pits.

rooms.Name: The Fire Chamber
rooms.Description:
The fire ruler sits upon a throne made of blue flame. Little flickers of
flame dance to and fro for the entertainment of the ruler.

rooms.Name: Electric Pathway
rooms.Description:
The pathway glows and hums because of the electricity pulsing through it. It
seems almost soothing to your weary feet. To the north there is a sunken-in
area. A path leads east also.

rooms.Name: The Electric Playground
rooms.Description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by. The electric playground
extends north and east.

rooms.Name: The Electric Playground
rooms.Description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by. There is an electric path
heading away south. The playground extends north and west.

rooms.Name: The Electric Playground
rooms.Description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by. The playground continues
south and east.

rooms.Name: The Electric Playground
rooms.Description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by. The playground is south and
west. Something more important catches your eye to the east.

rooms.Name: Lightning Causeway
rooms.Description:
Up a set of stairs carved into the hill you see intermittent flashes of
lightning. A continuous hum also comes from that direction. To the west is the
electric playground.

rooms.Name: Lightning Chamber
rooms.Description:
There is some sort of control panel here. Apparently the Lightning Ruler
observes and controls electric forces from here. A set of steps carved into the
hill lead down to a causeway.

rooms.Name: Mesa West
rooms.Description:
An electric path starts to the west. The mesa continues to the east. Or you
can climb down to the canyon floor to the south.

rooms.Name: Mesa East
rooms.Description:
A path starts to the north. The mesa continues to the west. Or you can climb
down to the canyon floor to the south. To the east you see a fading trail of
hoof prints.

rooms.Name: Floating in Air
rooms.Description:
Last you knew, you were walking on the mesa. Abruptly the path dropped from
beneath your feet much to quick for you to recover. Instead of plunging to your
death, you seemingly miss the ground and begin walking on air. The space to the
north and east seems just thin air, but you can walk there. The pathway you
came from is to the south.

rooms.Name: Floating in Air
rooms.Description:
You look down and see the ground 100 feet below you. The wind whispering in
your ear seems to reassure you that this is fine. To the north a ways you spy a
portal of sorts. To the west is more thin air.

rooms.Name: Floating in Air
rooms.Description:
You look down and see the ground 100 feet below you. The wind whispering in
your ear seems to reassure you that this is fine. To the east a ways you spy a
portal of sorts. To the south is more thin air.

rooms.Name: Floating in Air
rooms.Description:
You look down and see the ground 100 feet below you. The wind whispering in
your ear seems to reassure you that this is fine. There is a portal hanging in
midair here. It is to the east. You can float south or west if you'd like.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Through the portal you see a tunnel.

rooms.Name: Windy Tunnel
rooms.Description:
A tunnel leads east. To the west you can enter a portal. The wind in this
tunnel is quite fierce, it seems as if it's forced.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Through the portal you see nothing but sky.

rooms.Name: Air Chamber
rooms.Description:
Tiny tornadoes come and go and dance along the ground here. At the back of
the chamber you notice a huge throne made of swirling clouds. A tunnel leads
west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although the cloud throne appears solid enough to sit on, I wouldn't try 
it if I were you!

rooms.Name: Following the Tracks
rooms.Description:
You find yourself walking along a path which leads towards a very noisy
section behind the canyon. The tracks you are following are becoming more
prominent. You think that maybe these tracks are fresh. Back to the west you
see the path to the canyon. To the east, the path continues.

rooms.Name: Following the Tracks
rooms.Description:
You continue to follow the prints intently. So intently, that you run face
first into a large sign. You gently rub your head and wonder how you could have
been so blind. To the south, the path continues over a hill. Back to the west,
the path leads to the canyon.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads:

Mahn-tor     8 strides

rooms.Name: Overlooking the City
rooms.Description:
You top the hill and gasp at the sight. Before you is the grand walls
surrounding a massive city. Around the front gate you can see minotaur men and
women hurrying inside to avoid the upcoming storm. South will take you to the
gates of the city, and hopefully shelter from the harsh winds that have picked
up.

rooms.Name: Near the Gates
rooms.Description:
You stand only a few strides from the gates of the city. The guards standing
there look fierce, but then again so do all minotaurs. Maybe you can outwit
them and get inside. . .

rooms.Name: Along the Southern Path
rooms.Description:
You are heading along a southern leading path. To the south you can see a
very large mountain. Beyond the mountain lies a vast canyon. Did you bring your
hiking equipment?

rooms.Name: Along the Southern Path
rooms.Description:
You are heading along a southern leading path. To the south you can see a
very large mountain. Beyond the mountain lies a vast canyon. Did you bring your
hiking equipment?

rooms.Name: Along the Southern Path
rooms.Description:
You are heading along a southern leading path. To the south you can see a
very large mountain. Beyond the mountain lies a vast canyon. Did you bring your
hiking equipment?

rooms.Description:
You are heading along a southern leading path. To the south you can see a
very large mountain. Beyond the mountain lies a vast canyon. Did you bring your
hiking equipment?

rooms.Name: Along the Southern Path
rooms.Description:
You are heading along a southern leading path. To the south you can see a
very large mountain. Beyond the mountain lies a vast canyon. Did you bring your
hiking equipment?

rooms.Name: Along the Southern Path
rooms.Description:
You are heading along a southern leading path. To the south you can see a
very large mountain. Beyond the mountain lies a vast canyon. Did you bring your
hiking equipment?

rooms.Name: Along the Southern Path
rooms.Description:
You are heading along a southern leading path. To the south you can see a
very large mountain. Beyond the mountain lies a vast canyon. Did you bring your
hiking equipment?

rooms.Name: Along the Southern Path
rooms.Description:
You are heading along a southern leading path. To the south you can see a
very large mountain. Beyond the mountain lies a vast canyon. Did you bring your
hiking equipment?

rooms.Name: Waiting Room
rooms.Description:
Adrenaline surges through your veins as the anticipation of battle 
and death builds.A sign hangs from the wall, look at it if you aren't 
familiar with this style of battle. Only one of you will leave alive, 
so prepare now, and fight well. A doorway will lead upwards when 
the battle begins.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These will be instructions when the zone is complete. (Mental note:
must put a door in here :P)

rooms.Name: Middle Level Of the Arena - South
rooms.Description:
The battle begins, and the time for strategy is now. You can go up, 
to the open hallways, for sniping. Or you can go down, into the dank 
catacombs of the Arena, where sight and movement are impaired. Or, 
you can just stay on the middle level. Exits leave in all directions 
except south.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - South
rooms.Description:
Footsteps echo all around you, and you wonder how near your 
adversary is. Not too near, you hope. This room is bare, save for 
the evidence of battle, and exits leave in all directions save for 
south.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - SouthEast Corner
rooms.Description:
You find yourself cornered here, yet you can use it to your 
advantage, if you so choose. This room is bare and reasonably 
well-lit, allowing you to see the bloodstains and holes in the wall. 
Exits are in all directions except south and east.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - South
rooms.Description:
As is the motif here, this room is bare, with light entering from 
above. Fin d your opponent, and slay him! Exits lead in all directions,
 except south.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - SouthWest Corner
rooms.Description:
You are in the corner of the arena, more vulnerable than in most 
places, yet also in a fair position to set an ambush. Exits lead in
all directions, except south and west.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - Central
rooms.Description:
This room, like all others on this level, is bare. Exits lead in 
all directions, and you find yourself wishing for the security of a 
wall at your back.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - Central
rooms.Description:
This well-lit room is close to the center of the Arena, bloodstains 
attest to the danger of having exits, and entryways, in all directions. 
If you dont have eyes in the back of your head, you had better find a 
more defensible position.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - Central Edge
rooms.Description:
You feel more secure with a solid wall at your back. Echoes of 
footsteps ring all around you, yet you cannot tell in what direction. 
Exits, however, lead in all directions except east, so you could try 
to find out......

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - Central
rooms.Description:
Once again, a pretty bare room, littered with some broken crossbow 
bolts, and as usual, some dried blood. Exits lead in every direction.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - Central Edge
rooms.Description:
Again, you feel secure without a potential sniper at your back. The
worn stone floors of this room are spattered with drops of blood from 
wounded players. Exits lead in every direction except east.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - NorthEast Corner
rooms.Description:
You find yourself in another corner, the pitted floors seem more 
worn than the rest, attesting to the fact that some combatants use 
this room often, for whatever reason. Exits lead in all directions 
except north and east.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - North
rooms.Description:
Little furnishings and bloodstained, pockmarked walls make this 
a dreary room.Exits lead in all directions except for north.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - North
rooms.Description:
The battle begins, and the time for strategy is now. You can go 
up, to the open hallways, for sniping. Or you can go down, into the 
dank catacombs of the Arena, where sight and movement are impaired. 
Or, you can just stay on the middle level. Exits leave in all 
directions except north.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - North
rooms.Description:
The sound of shuffling feet fills your ears, but you cant place the 
sound. It sounds like someone who is trying to walk softly, with little
success. Exits lead everywhere but north.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.
It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Middle Level of the Arena - NorthWest Corner
rooms.Description:
Bones litter the ground beneath your feet, step carefully, your 
opponent will no doubt hear the crunching of bones beneath your feet. 
Another corner room, and exits going everywhere but north and west.

Exits.Description: It looks remarkably like a door.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - SouthWest Corner
rooms.Description:
This room is dark, dank, and cluttered. Bones and other assorted 
junk is strewn across the floor, making accurate and quick movement 
impossible.Exits from this corner lead in all directions but west, 
south, and down.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - South
rooms.Description:
Unidentifiable sounds fill the air, making you very jumpy and wary. 
Your only comfort is that to find you, your opponent must subject 
himself to same confusing catacombs. Exits lead everywhere but south 
and down.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - South
rooms.Description:
The heat and humidity make your eyes water, and the constant 
thundering sounds distract you from proper concentration. Clutter 
surrounds the exits that lead everywhere except south and down.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - South
rooms.Description:
You stumble around this filthy and bleak room for a moment, before 
finding the exits that lead everywhere but down and south.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - SouthEast Corner
rooms.Description:
The sweltering heat combined with the smell of death makes for a 
nauseating combination as you stumble into this corner room. Exits lead
everywhere but down, south, and east.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - Central Edge
rooms.Description:
Stifling heat and steam cloud your vision, blood and gore stays 
moist and quickly decomposes down here. Exits lead everywhere but down
and east.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - Central
rooms.Description:
Sweat drips into your eyes, and the stinging forces you to blink 
repeatedly. The blink of an eye is more than enough time to catch a 
crossbow bolt between the eyes....Wipe the sweat from your brow and 
leave through an exit that leads anywhere but down.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - Central
rooms.Description:
Sounds assail your ears, and the heat makes your head throb. How 
much longer can you remain down here? There is an exit that leads up, 
as well as to the 4 cardinal directions.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - Central
rooms.Description:
Your head swims, your vision is blurry, in this state, your 
vulnerability is clear. But will the other combatants pursue you into
this hellhole? You may soon find out. In the meantime, however, you
can leave in every direction but down.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - Central Edge
rooms.Description:
A wall at your back calms you down, but just barely. Your eyesight 
is almost useless, as is your hearing. You may want to stumble through 
an exit that leads to all directions but down and west, but who knows 
where you'll end up.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - NorthWest Corner
rooms.Description:
You find yourself in another corner, did you come here on purpose? 
Who knows, your mind plays tricks on you due to the constant assaults 
on your senses. Exits lead everywhere but down, north, and west.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - North
rooms.Description:
The clutter becomes impassable to some directions, bones and junk 
line the walls. You can stagger in any direction but north and down.

Exits.Description: This large pile of crap could be obscuring something.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - North
rooms.Description:
Your only consolation is that your opponent is experiencing the 
same agony as yourself. That is, of course, if he is down here. If 
not, well, then all this agony is for naught. Exits lead everywhere 
but north and down.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - North
rooms.Description:
The pain you experience down here is nothing compared to the pain 
of a bolt drilling into your chest. The clutter parts to reveal exits 
to everywhere, save for north and down.

rooms.Name: Arena Catacombs - NorthEast Corner
rooms.Description:
You have a tactical advantage over your opponents by being down 
here, though that is little comfort against the crashing sounds and 
stinging, acrid steam. Exits from this corner lead everywhere but down,
north, and east.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Southeast Corner
rooms.Description:
The fresh air masks the real menace of this upper level. You are 
extremely vulnerable from all directions, then again, so are your 
opponents, if they choose to brave this veritable shooting gallery. 
Exits lead everywhere but up, south, and east.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - South
rooms.Description:
The sky is above you, escape from this deathtrap seems almost 
possible. Think again, the walls are three times as tall as you are, 
and slick with blood. Exits lead everywhere but up and south.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - South
rooms.Description:
These hallways are bare, save for glorious paintings of opponents 
past, most are blood-smeared or damaged. The hallway leads everywhere 
but up and south, and trapdoors go down in every room.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - South
rooms.Description:
The walls, underneath the gristle and sun-dried blood, are made 
of stone, and and inscription is carved here. Exits lead everywhere, 
except up and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You may find it worth your while to stop and examine your 
surroundings from time to time, you may find an exceptional tactical 
advantage. Be sure not to stop too long, or you remains too, will 
litter this arena.....

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - SouthWest Corner
rooms.Description:
You find yourself in another corner, and a femur lies at your feet,
surrounded by scattering of smaller bones. You can lie in wait here, 
or you can move on, through exits to all directions but up, south, and
west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is a small carving on this femur, it reads as follows:

          #wZone by Kurrelgyre, Hope you like it!:)#N

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Central Edge
rooms.Description:
The west wall is smooth and stained, save for a crossbow bolt 
stuck into the wall at angle. Exits lead everywhere but up and west.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Central
rooms.Description:
These rooms are weather-worn, but fresh-smelling from the 
constant influx of air. The smell of death remains, however. 
Exits lead everywhere but up.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Central
rooms.Description:
You're extremely vulnerable here, a well-aimed shot could take you 
down from any of the four directions, and someone can come from below 
and take you by surprise.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Central
rooms.Description:
The center of the upper arena could very well be the most 
indefensible area in the arena, you may want to move around often, 
at they very least. Exits lead in every direction but up.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - Central Edge
rooms.Description:
A nice, seemingly solid wall is on the eastern wall of this room. A 
skull, held fast by a rusty bolt, adorns the center of the wall. Exits 
lead to victory or death in every direction but up, and east.

Exits.Description: Perhaps this skull has something to offer.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - NorthEast Corner
rooms.Description:
You find yourself in another corner, the air rushes in from above, 
obscuring any sounds you might otherwise hear. You can wedge yourself 
into the corner and wait, or you can exit in any direction but up, 
north, and east.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - North
rooms.Description:
Blood streaks the floor here, it glistens, and reveals its freshness.
Exits go everywhere but up and north.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - North
rooms.Description:
A corpse lies here, dessicated by the sun and dry air from above. 
It looks as if this combatant had a painful death. Leave this corpse 
behind, and go in any direction but up and north.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - North
rooms.Description:
The wind whistles through the hallways atop the arena, and you 
can't hear much from below. Could your opponent be drawing a bead on 
you as you stand here, listening? Move quickly, and leave in any 
direction but up and north.

rooms.Name: Open-air Hallways of the Upper Arena - NorthWest Corner
rooms.Description:
Rusted items of useless equipment litter the floor of this corner 
room, most with neat little holes in them, just about the size of a 
crossbow bolt. Leave anywhere buy up, north, and east.

rooms.Name: A Hidden Alcove in the Catacombs
rooms.Description:
This small alcove is a brief respite from the acrid air of the 
catacombs.The air in here is cooler and less foul. You can lie in 
wait for your opponent here, or, if you're a pessimist, consider 
yourself trapped.

Exits.Description: This vent allows air to pass into the chamber.

rooms.Name: A Hidden Alcove on the Middle Level
rooms.Description:
You can rest here, and catch your breath, but pray your opponents 
dont get the same idea....

rooms.Name: A Hidden Alcove among the Open-air Hallways
rooms.Description:
This little room offers a supreme place to snipe an unknowing 
opponent. A stench wafts in from someplace, making it less than ideal
to sit here.

Exits.Description: This vent allows air to pass into the chamber.

rooms.Name: The Spectators Room for the Arena
rooms.Description:
This room was created for the amusement of the spectators watching 
the fights to the death contained within the Arena. While spectators 
rarely get a glimpse of the frenzied combatants, from this room they 
can shout encouragement, and hear the agonized screams of the dying.

rooms.Name: Waiting room
rooms.Description:
Adrenaline surges through your veins as the anticipation of 
battle and death builds. A sign is etched into the wall. Read it 
if you aren't familiar with the art of the crossbow. Only one of 
you will leave alive, so prepare now, and fight well. A doorway will 
lead upwards when the battle begins.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This will be instructions when the code is complete.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Shadow Grove
rooms.Description:
Before you, the grove of shadows lies. Giant grey trees are all that can be
seen through the thick shadows. A great sense of both power and menace
permeates the surrounding area. You have a strange urge to turn back and go
back the way you've come. A small path leads north into the shadows and back
south to the road.

Exits.Description: The shadows cloud your vision.

rooms.Name: The Shadow Grove
rooms.Description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you from all
sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange sounds of moaning
and growling come from all directions. All exits lead into shadows, you are
very confused.

Exits.Description: The shadows cloud your vision.
The shadows cloud your vision.
The shadows cloud your vision.
The shadows cloud your vision.

rooms.Description:

and growling come from all directions. All exits lead into shadows, you are
very confused.

Exits.Description: The shadows cloud your vision.
The shadows cloud your vision.
The shadows cloud your vision.
You see a small clearing in the shadows.
