rooms.Description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way westward between huge, ancient
trees that stand close on all sides. The tree trunks seem to be covered in some
sticky substance which gets much stickier towards the west! Beware!

Exits.Description: The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.

The sticky substance is hanging like ropes between the trees just above the
path. To the west the path seems to be covered with these giant threads covered
with glue. You can sense the forces of evil coming from the west and your bones
tell you it may not be such a good idea to proceed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The substance reminds you of giant threads covered with glue.  If it hadn't
been for the size you could have sworn it was part of a spider web.

The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in
some places, giant gray roots have broken up through its surface.

The sticky substance is hanging like ropes between the ancient trees, crossing
the path just out of reach.  It might be possible to climb one of the sticky
trunks.

rooms.Name: The deadly spider web
rooms.Description:
You are walking along the narrow path, ducking under the sticky ropes as you
advance... > A huge, poisonous spider drops from above! A huge, poisonous
spider drops from above! A huge, poisonous spider drops from above! > The huge,
poisonous spider stings you! You resist the poison! The huge, poisonous spider
stings you! You are poisoned! The huge, poisonous spider stings you! You are
poisoned!

rooms.Name: Up in the tree
rooms.Description:
You are hanging on the outside of a huge tree trunk covered in a sticky
substance. Directly to the west is an immense spider web suspended between
numerous of the giant trees including the one you are hanging on. To the north
is what looks like a large webbed entrance.

Exits.Description:
To the north is what looks like a large expanse of webbing which extends very
far into the trees.
To the west is the immense spider web. It seems to move softly.
Downwards is the narrow forest path.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The spider web stretches out to the west.  It looks as if it is possible to
walk on it.

rooms.Name: On the spider web
rooms.Description:
You are balancing carefully on the giant sticky threads that holds the giant
web in place. To the east is a giant tree trunk and to the west is an entrance
to a cave-like structure made from many layers of spider web.

Exits.Description: To the east is the giant tree trunk.
To the west is the entrance to the cave-like structure.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The immense spider web moves softly.

It covers a ground area corresponding to an irregular circle with a diameter of
about 20 feet and is nearly 10 feet tall.  It looks very old.

rooms.Name: The Den of the Queen Spider
rooms.Description:
You are inside a cave-like structure that seems to be made entirely from
countless layers of spider web. Temperature and humidity is very high making it
hard to breathe the foul air that lingers here. The walls are covered with open
cocoons.

Exits.Description: Compared to this place the east exit looks inviting.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The sticky walls are covered with open cocoons.

The cocoons are burst open as if something inside really wanted to get out.
They are at the size of a human head.

rooms.Name: A dusty trail in the deep, dark forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest. Ancient gray
trees loom all around you. The trail continues north and east.

Exits.Description: The dusty trail leads north through the trees.
The dusty trail leads east through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The ancient gray giants seem to observe you silently.

rooms.Name: A dusty trail in the deep, dark forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest. Ancient,
gray trees loom everywhere. The trail continues south and west. A broad
irregular path leads eastward away from the trail.

Exits.Description: The trees standing on the sides of the path have scratch marks on them.
The dusty trail leads south through the trees.
The dusty trail leads west through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
To the east the ancient gray giants have many marks as if something with huge
claws has been tearing at them in rage.
The trees standing on the sides of the path have scratch marks on them.

The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in
some places, giant gray roots have broken up through its surface.

rooms.Name: At the end of the trail through the deep, dark forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest. Ancient gray
trees loom all around you. To the west you notice a strange building it looks
like a tavern, and as you look north you can make out a stone tower in the
distance.

Exits.Description: You see a large tower.
The dusty trail leads east through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The ancient gray giants seem to observe you silently.

rooms.Name: Outside a cave in the deep, dark forest
rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a broad, irregular path. To the north is a very large
ominous-looking cave opening. The trees here have many marks as if something
with huge claws has been tearing at them in rage.

Exits.Description: The disgusting smell of a large reptile emanates from the cave opening.
The path winds its way westward.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ancient gray giants have many marks as if something with huge claws has
been tearing at them in rage.
The disgusting smell of a large reptile emanates from the cave opening.

rooms.Name: The cave of the Green Dragon
rooms.Description:
You are in a big natural cave. The floor is littered with bones of all sorts
and the stench is so massive that you could cut it with a knife. The only exit
is to the south.

Exits.Description: The exit leads out into the forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Most of the bones on the floor appear to be of human origin.

rooms.Name: The narrow trail
rooms.Description:
This trail looks much spookier than any other that you have seen. The usual
animal claw marks and bites on the trees are getting far and few between. The
trail continues north.

Exits.Description: the narrow trail continues north.
the trail intersects the main forest path.

rooms.Name: The narrow trail
rooms.Description:
This area of the trail is also very peculiar. You can see no signs of animal
life what so ever. The structure of the surrounding trees forces the path to
make a sharp turn to the east.

Exits.Description: the trail bends east.
the start of the trail.

rooms.Name: The circle of trees
rooms.Description:
The trees here seem to form a circle around one HUGE tree that is in the
center of them. You notice a wooden door carved into the huge tree to the east.
The trail that you followed to get here seems to end at the base of the tree.

Exits.Description: The tree door is carved beautifully.
the bend on the trail.

rooms.Name: Inside the great tree
rooms.Description:
You have stepped inside of this hollowed tree. From here steps lead down
into darkness or you can exit the tree by going west.

Exits.Description: The steps appears like they will hold your weight.
the door is carved beautifully.

rooms.Name: The underground hallway
rooms.Description:
This hallway is apparently one of the roots of the tree hollowed out. The
hall leads south to a room where you hear strange noises or you can go up the
steps.

Exits.Description: the steps appear like they will hold your weight.
the hallway looks quite grand.

rooms.Name: The cultist temple
rooms.Description:
This temple which is built to some god that you don't worship is a nice
place visit but you feel very uncomfortable about spending any amount of time
here. The wooden alter seems to almost glow as you enter the room. The only
exit is the way you came in.

Exits.Description: the hallway looks quite grand.

rooms.Name: The Dead Part of the Forest
rooms.Description:
The evergreen forest turns into a dead landscape here.  Rotten trees
and murky grass surround you.  The swampy makes you sink deeper with
each new step you make.  Crows are flying around, picking flesh from
skeletons which are all around.  The swamp path leads further to the
south.

rooms.Name: Deep in the Dead Forest
rooms.Description:
A thick fog floats just above the swamp.  You can't see through it,
hope that you don't in the wrong place.  You look around in fear, as you
notice something moving through the murky water.  Leafless trees are to
your right and left, blocking your view.  Two grim red eyes stare at you 
from a hollow in a dead oak tree.  The path continues to the south and
seems to lead into a clearing, from which the sound of unhuman screams
can be heard. Now, perhaps, is your last chance to return.

rooms.Name: The Swampy Lake
rooms.Description:
The path pours into a large swampy lake.  Thick fog prevents you from
seeing the opposite shore.  Horrific creatures crawl through the thick
fluid, wating for a kill.  Poles stick out from the swamp, each one with
a skull attached to the end.  In the middle of the swampy lake a black
mountain shoots into the sky.  It rears its ugly head high into the sky,
casting an ominous shadow beneath it.  Howling wolves and screaming
creatures can be heared from somwhere deep in the mountain.  The whole 
has a strange aura about it. It seems that you are in an place that is
totally isolated from the rest of the world.  A narrow stone bridge
leads to the black rock.  You notice a horned skull etched into the
black rock, and you realize that you have approached Shamhna territory.

rooms.Name: Cavernous Gate
rooms.Description:
As you enter the area you notice a giant boulder blocking your path.
Upon closer inspection it seems that there is a large iron gate in the
center of the boulder which leads to the area beyond. The only other
exit appears to be back south the way you came.

Exits.Description:
You see a large iron gate with hand rings for opening. The rings
appear to be as big as a human head.
The path leads back the way you came.

rooms.Name: Beyond the Gate
rooms.Description:
The room here is remarkably clean for the inside of a cave. Dim torch
light lines the walls as if someone has been through here recently. More
torches line the walls to the east and the gate is back to the south.

Exits.Description: You see a large iron gate with hand rings for opening.
The dimly lit hall stretches onward.

rooms.Name: Inside South Gate
rooms.Description:
The room here is well lit by torches as well but the only occupants
you see are the small spiders and rats which pass before you from time
to time. There is a large sculpture of some being who you have never
seen before sitting in the corner of the room. From here it appears you
can go north or east but the rooms beyond no longer have a source of
light to guide you.

Exits.Description: The passage leads of into the darkness.
The passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
the statue has the eyes of a demon and they seem to burn right through
anyone who looks at it.

rooms.Name: Cave West Passage
rooms.Description:
The passage is covered in the bones of some humanoid figure or maybe
several you cant really tell. There is a small humming noise coming from
the north but you cant make out exactly where. The passage also leads
south into the darkness.

Exits.Description: The passage leads off into the darkness.
The passage leads off into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Middle West Passage
rooms.Description:
The room contains a weapons rack along the west wall but anything
here is far too old to be of any use or already broken. There is an oak
door in the east wall which is usually closed. The passage also
continues up some 40 feet above.

Exits.Description: A rocky cliff ledge can be barely made out some 40 feet up.
There is an oak door here.
A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Alchemist's Study
rooms.Description:
It is almost immediately apparent that this room belongs to the
alchemist. Broken potion bottles lay everywhere here and there seems to
be a small chest in the northwest corner of the room. There is an oak
door to the west here and strangely enough a window in the north wall.

Exits.Description: There is an oak door here.
You see a small window.

rooms.Name: Beast Lair
rooms.Description:
The room here is covered in some type of some strange animal
droppings.  From the size of the claw marks in the floor a very large
animal. If its not here count yourself lucky and take the exit to the
south.

Exits.Description: You see a small window.

rooms.Name: Cliff Edge
rooms.Description:
From where you stand now you can see that the room is really only a
small ledge. Tracks here show that the ledge is used quite often though.
The ledge continues to the west and the passage leads down to the south 
as well.

Exits.Description: The small ledge continues to the west.
The rocky cliff leads into the darkness below.

rooms.Name: Upper Cavern
rooms.Description:
The room you see has obviously had a lot of work put into it. Someone
has hand carved out of the rocks a set of stairs. The stairs lead up
to the north into the darkness and there is a passage to the east 
here as well.

Exits.Description: A set of stairs leads off into the darkness.
A small ledge continues to the east.

rooms.Name: Northeast Balcony
rooms.Description:
Upon exiting the stairway you come upon a large stone balcony. There
seems to be several pictures here placed on the north wall of strange
creatures. The balcony continues to the west and there is a red colored
door to the east.

Exits.Description: The balcony leads off into the darkness.
You see a red door to the east here.
A passage leads into the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
there is a strange language on the door but you can make out the word
danger.

along all the pictures you see a name followed by another name in large
letters and discover this is sort of a record of kills by the person in
large letters.

rooms.Name: Beyond the Red Door
rooms.Description:
Apparently the construction crew forgot to finish this room. As you
enter you notice the floor is missing. You drop some 75 feet to the cave
bottom below. Miraculously you notice that only your legs are broken and
you are going to survive. Unfortunately you discover you have landed in
a lake of quicksand though and you sink to the bottom and die.

rooms.Name: Northwest Balcony
rooms.Description:
Nothing seems out of the ordinary in this room. The stone balcony
continues to the east and the west from here. There is also another
large sculpture in this room that resembles the one you seen before.

Exits.Description: The balcony continues off into the darkness.
The balcony continues off into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Balcony End
rooms.Description:
From here the balcony leads off north into the darkness and the
passage leads to the east as well. One major difference though is that
the stone floor no longer exists but is now made of marble instead.
There is some more strange writing on the wall here as well.

Exits.Description: The balcony continues off into the darkness.
The passage disappears into the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You have entered the home of Atrolicus master giant. Turn back while you
still can.

rooms.Name: Forbidden Passage
rooms.Description:
As you enter the room you see a very large statue of a knight. It is
wearing full platemail and carrying a massive shield. You notice some
small writing on its shield. There is also a passage to the south here.

Exits.Description: The passage disappears into the darkness.
You hear a faint humming coming from this direction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
What is beyond this door above is a great evil. I have set up a gate to
keep it out and my diamond sword is the only thing that can take it
down. To pass you must get it.

rooms.Name: South Wall
rooms.Description:
The room here is about 50 feet from one end to the other. There is
only a small walkway big enough for one person at a time here and the
floor is covered with stalagmites. The passage runs east and west into
the darkness but better watch your step.

Exits.Description: The passage leads into the darkness.
The passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Southeast Corner of Passage
rooms.Description:
The most distinguishable feature as you enter this room is the small
lake in the center. The water of the lake is crystal clear and appears
to be running off to the north. There is also a passage to the west here
as well.

Exits.Description: The passage leads into the darkness.
You notice a light off in this direction.

rooms.Name: Garden Area
rooms.Description:
As you enter you see many types of plants here which most you dont
recognize. The area is very bright as too get the needed light for the
plants and yet you can seem to find a light source. The lake continues
through the garden to the east here and there is a passage to the south
as well.

Exits.Description: There is a passage that leads off into the darkness.
All you can see is plants this direction.

rooms.Name: Middle Garden
rooms.Description:
As you enter the area you finally discover what was making the
humming noise. There are millions of bees all over the area. The garden
and the lake lead to the east and the west here.

Exits.Description: The garden leads off to the east.
The garden leads off to the west.

rooms.Name: Garden End
rooms.Description:
You finally come to the end of the garden and meet up with a large
stone wall. The lake seems to have entirely disappeared from sight
however.  The garden leads to the west here.

Exits.Description: Large plants are everywhere in sight.
You see a large stone wall.

rooms.Name: Secret Chamber
rooms.Description:
The entire room is decorated with medals of honor and trophies to
match.  The lake as you have now discovered went here and flows through
a narrow opening in the ground. The hall continues through the stone
wall to the west or to the north as well.

Exits.Description: You see a large stone wall.
The hall leads off into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Court Beginning
rooms.Description:
As you enter you notice a red carpet running down the center of the
hall and disappearing to the north. There are two large golden statues
here on either side of the passage. Both statues appear to be great
warriors decorated for battle. The passage also leads to the south as
well.

Exits.Description: The passage disappears into the darkness.
The red carpet runs off to the north.

rooms.Name: Banquet Hall
rooms.Description:
There is a large table in this room that stretches from end to end.
It appears to be set up for a great feast and looks like about 30 people
will be attending. The walla are covered with brightly colored
tapestries and most have the name Atrolicus on them. The red carpet runs
out the door to the north and south here.

Exits.Description: The red carpet runs out the door to the north.
The red carpet runs out the door to the south.

rooms.Name: Court End
rooms.Description:
The red carpet comes to an end here and the two large golden statues
are present here as well. There is a set of large double doors to the
north with a symbol of a lightning bolt across them. The passage leads
to the south as well.

Exits.Description: A set of large double doors lies ahead.
The red capet runs to the south here.

rooms.Name: Main Barracks
rooms.Description:
The area here appears to be some type of training grounds. There are
remains of broken weapons and armor laying on the floor and huge targets
lining the walls at the opposite end of the room. There appears to be a
large crystal door on the west wall and a large diamond door to the east
here.

Exits.Description: A large crystal door is here.
A large diamond door is here.
A set of large double doors lies ahead.

rooms.Name: Southwest Corner of Barracks
rooms.Description:
This room appears to be some sort of sleeping quarters. Several large
mats are placed on the floor here and all appear to have been used
recently. There is a large wooden door to the north and a large crystal
door to the east here as well.

Exits.Description: A large wooden door is here.
A large crystal door is here.

rooms.Name: Northwest Corner of Barracks
rooms.Description:
The room here contains a large weapons rack with a vast assortment of
different weapons. Some appear to be too large and heavy to use however
there may be something to your approval here. The passage to the south
appears to be the only exit here.

Exits.Description: A large wooden door is here.

rooms.Name: Southeast Corner of Barracks
rooms.Description:
The room here appears to be the sleeping quarters of several large
figures. Mats lie on the floor which appear to have been used recently
and some half eaten bread is laying in the corner of the room. There is
a large diamond door to the west here and a passage that leads north as
well.

Exits.Description: A large diamond door is here.
A passage leads off into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Northeast Corner of Barracks
rooms.Description:
As you enter the room the first thing you notice is an extremly large
map on the east wall. The map has about 20 large red X marks on it in
various assorted places. There is also a very large table in the center
of the room and exits to the south and west here as well.

Exits.Description: A passage leads off into the darkness.
A passage leads off into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Inner Sanctum
rooms.Description:
Along the north wall is a huge waterfall that empties into a large
light green colored pool in the center of the room. Along the west wall
sits a huge golden throne surrounded by two huge golden statues of
dragons.  There is a passage to the east here and you seem to see a
small grate in the center of the pool here as well.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
A small grate lies beneath the water.

rooms.Name: Pool Cavern
rooms.Description:
There is a large chest directly in the center of this room on a small
ledge. The water surrounds the ledge but so far you don't see anything 
in the water that looks threatening. The only exit you see is up through
the grate.

Exits.Description: A small grate is here.

rooms.Name: Beyond Balcony
rooms.Description:
The room here has been carefully constructed just like the previous
rooms on the balcony. There is a large diamond hand railing running
along the room and dissapearing to the north. The only other exit
appears to be down the stairs.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
You hear a faint humming coming from this direction.

rooms.Name: Southeast Hallway
rooms.Description:
The room here is of the same construction as the other however very
poorly cared for. Creatures of various kinds wander the halls here
although none seem to dangerous. A passage leads to the south and to the
east here.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: South Wall
rooms.Description:
This room appears to be used as a bathroom for the current occupants.
There is a chamber pot set in the corner and the smell is almost enough
to kill you. The passage leads to the north and west here.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: East Wall
rooms.Description:
The room is made entirely of polished brown stone. Rows of pillars
support the ceiling approximately 12 feet overhead. There is a passage
to the north and south and a door to the east here as well.

Exits.Description: A passage leads off into the darkness.
A passage leads off into the darkness.
You see a large iron door here.

rooms.Name: Private Chamber
rooms.Description:
This small room is lit by a hanging lamp of dull metal. It contains a
bed,chair,and small table. A large iron door to the west appears to be
the only exit.

Exits.Description: A large iron door is here.

rooms.Name: Room of Battle
rooms.Description:
As you walk in you see many colorful paintings of great battles in
the realm of Elite. What is most interesting is that the paintings of
battles are actually alive. There is a passage to the south and to the
west here as well.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you peer closer you recognize the great gods of elite such as
Helm, IO, Phobos, and Kaleen doing battle with the forces of evil.

rooms.Name: North Hall
rooms.Description:
This large chamber is empty and bare. The polished stones of its
floor are exceptionally smooth and close fitted. Each sound here causes
a very alarming echo throughout. There is a passage to the east and west
here as well as a large golden door to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a large golden door here.
A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Lost and Found
rooms.Description:
This large chamber was once an extensive library. Charred books and
scraps of burnt or torn scrolls lie everywhere. A large golden door to
the south appears to be the only exit here.

Exits.Description: A large golden door is here.

rooms.Name: North Corridor
rooms.Description:
This plain room is unfurnished except for a thick carpet on the
floor.  It's walls are solid stone blocks, closely set and polished.
There is a passage to the east and west here.

Exits.Description: A passage leads off into the darkness.
A passage leads off into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Display Room
rooms.Description:
The room is covered wall to wall with gruesome looking weapons of
death.  Unfortunately most of the items have been locked in cases and it
does not look like they have kept well. There is a passage to the east
and west here as well.

Exits.Description: A passage leads off into the darkness.
A passage leads off into the darkness.

rooms.Name: West Wall
rooms.Description:
This room is obviously one of great importance. It is decorated with
tapestries with scenes of great battles from long ago. There are exits
to the north and south as well as a passage to the east here.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Northwest Corner Passage
rooms.Description:
Strange runes cover the walls of the entire room. A set of marble
stairs dissapear up into the darkness in the northwest corner of the
room. You also see a passage that wanders off to the south as well.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
Stairs lead up into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Southwest Corner Passage
rooms.Description:
The room is made up entirely of black stone and covered with strange
runic symbols. There is a large onyx black door to the west and a
passage that leads to the north here. You notice a very large sign
hanging on the door as well.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
A large black onyx door is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Holding Cells Keep Out!

rooms.Name: Ruined Passage
rooms.Description:
The room here although rather large is barely passable. The ceiling
has collapsed slightly due to age and now parts of it lie here. There is
a passage to the south and to the east here.

Exits.Description: A large black onyx door is here.
A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Holding Cell
rooms.Description:
The room is covered in debris from one corner to the other here. You
notice some rusted and broken chains sticking out of the wall and
realize that this used to be where the captives were held. The only
visible exit appears to be to the north.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Stairs End
rooms.Description:
As you reach the top of the staircase you notice something strange.
It appears you are no longer walking on solid ground but the floor has
vanished completely. Fortunately the walls remain to guide you and you
can see a passage to the east and stairs leading down here.

Exits.Description: A staircase leads down into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Main Hall
rooms.Description:
The room here is decorated in tapestries depicting many great
battles. A  faint trail of blood runs along the floor and dissapears to
the north.  Another passage leads to the west here as well.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Trophy Room
rooms.Description:
As you enter you see one of the most disgusting sites you have seen
in your life. This is not your typical trophy room but is displaying the
heads of all the unfortunate victims that have come this way. Exits lead
to the north and south here, better pick one while you still have your
head.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A head stares back at you with a gaze as cold as ice. You would swear
you heard it murmur run!

rooms.Name: Room of Dead
rooms.Description:
Skeletons lie all over the ground here and you can hear the crunch as
you walk on them. There are exits in all four directions here. You can
hear screams of horror and pain echo all through this room.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Window In South Wall
rooms.Description:
The small room here is dirty and dusty as if unused for ages. A small
window displays the outer lands of elite as best can be seen. The
passage leads to the east and west here.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Corridor End
rooms.Description:
This appears to be the remains of an old mages laboratory. Items are
scattered here and there and there is a burnt sigil in the floor. The
only you exit you see is a passage to the east.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Supply Room
rooms.Description:
This room appears to be a supply room for many different types of
objects. Most you have no idea what they are and others are worn out
beyond repair but there may be a few things you can use here. A passage
leads to the east and to the west here.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.
A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Corridor's End
rooms.Description:
The room here appears to be very empty of anything at all. The only
things you notice is a small lamp hanging near the wall and a small
plaque directly beneath it. The only exit appears to be to the west
here.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This zone was created by Rasputen. I hope you all enjoy it very much.

rooms.Name: Altar of Power
rooms.Description:
As you enter the room you see a large glowing altar in the center of
the room. Placed upon the altar is a glowing sword with blue colored
runes burnt into the blade and glowing brightly. The only exit appears
to be a passage to the south.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: To get that which you seek the altar is the key.

rooms.Name: Hidden Room
rooms.Description:
As you enter you realize you have found the remains of the giants
treasure hoard. There is a large chest in the north corner of the room
here as well. The only visible exit is to the south.

Exits.Description: A passage leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Cave entrance
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the cave entrance. It is very dark down here.
There is writing at the wall. There is an exit to the north. A stairway
leads up.

Exits.Description: To the north you can see a small tunnel.
You can see the stairs going up into darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The writing says 'BEWARE adventurer!'

rooms.Name: Cave tunnel
rooms.Description:
You are walking in a tunnel. It is very cold. You can feel the
presence of a living thing ... SOMEWHERE.

Exits.Description: To the north you can see the tunnel continuing.
To the south tunnel continuing.

rooms.Name: Cave room
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a room. It's much cooler now. The walls are
glowing.

Exits.Description: To the east you see the tunnel going downwards.
To the south you see a dark cave tunnel.

rooms.Name: Cave T-cross
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a mudlike substance. The smell here is awful, it
is rotten. To the west you can see some light.

Exits.Description: To the east the tunnel still goes downwards.
You can see some light to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: When you examine the mud, you notice small worms crawling around.
The worms are purple.  They do not look edible.

rooms.Name: Cave turning-point
rooms.Description:
The mud are getting deeper. You are wondering, 'Would it be an idea
to leave, before I disappear?'. To the south you notice a flat round
stone are blocking the way. To the west you can see mud.

Exits.Description: You can see an opening behind the stone.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stone looks very uninteresting.  BUT as you are about to turn away,
you see a light stripe coming through a small hole.  Conclusion: The
stone is moveable.

rooms.Name: The secret room
rooms.Description:
There is dust all over the place. It looks like nobody has been here
for ages. In the middle of the room you see a socket with a crystal
globe. The globe glows with a pulsing light. To the north you see a
stone door. To the south you see a gray block.

Exits.Description: You see a round stone door.
You see a gray block

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The socket looks like the work of a dwarf.  It is VERY beautiful.

The crystal globe is glowing with a pulsing light. It looks like there
is smoke inside it.

rooms.Name: The mudhole
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a lot of mud. The mud goes to your chest. You
feel the presence of something IN the mud. The only obvious exit is to
the west.

Exits.Description: You can see nothing at all.

rooms.Name: Tunnel
rooms.Description: The mud goes to your knees. Otherwise the tunnel looks very normal.

Exits.Description: You can see a mudhole.

rooms.Name: The long tunnel
rooms.Description:
Here there is almost no mud, as you stand at the top of a small
rock. Just beside you there are a sign which says 'WARNING! The worms
are dangerous!'.

Exits.Description: You can see a lot of mud... Yuck!
The tunnel goes a little downwards.

rooms.Name: The hot room
rooms.Description:
You are very surprised, as this room for a change are hot instead of
cold. To the north it goes downwards into some mud. There are also an
exit to the west.

Exits.Description: You see a lot of mud.
You see a entrance to a small room.

rooms.Name: The small room
rooms.Description:
As you look around you notice a small statue. There are exits to the
west and to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a VERY long hallway.
It is pitch dark out there.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a statue of a imp, pointing to the west.  The imp looks like a
man with horns and a tail.

rooms.Name: The stalagmite cave
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a stalagmite cave. Water is dripping from the
walls. It is very cold in here.

Exits.Description: You see a long hallway, and some mud.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The stalagmites are very tall, and looks very beautiful.

rooms.Name: The stalagmite tunnel
rooms.Description:
You has entered a small tunnel. Here it is quite dry. Maybe it would
be a good idea to rest here.

Exits.Description: You can see a small cave to the north.

rooms.Name: The spongy room
rooms.Description:
You definitely NOT like this area. It is very dank, and in most of
the room it is wet.

rooms.Name: The stalagmite T-cross
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a cross. To the north you can see some light.
Otherwise it is dark.

Exits.Description: You see some light ahead.

rooms.Name: The blind end room
rooms.Description:
This room is obviously a blind end. To the north you see a primitive
picture.

Exits.Description: You see a primitive picture.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see some people dancing around a huge sun.  The sun is about 7 feet
in diameter, which shows the size of the picture.

rooms.Name: The treasure room
rooms.Description:
This room is richly ornamented. The walls has been carved to show
people dancing around a sun which is drawn on the floor. It looks very
old, and it is very dusty. To the south you see a secret door.

Exits.Description: You can see a picture with some persons crawling around a huge moon.

rooms.Name: The square lair
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the south-east part of the lair. You can see a
skeleton lying in the corner.

Exits.Description: Another part of the lair.
Another part of the lair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like a adventurer who wasn't lucky.  You'd better watch out...

rooms.Name: The square lair
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the north-east part of the lair. You see a sign
on the wall.

Exits.Description: You see a wooden door.
Another part of the lair.
Another part of the lair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign says 'Gods of War I call you, my sword is by my side,
               I seek a light free from all false pride'
                       Reyemle Grug.....

rooms.Name: The square lair
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the north-west part of the lair. Here there is
another sign. There is an exit from the lair to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a small tunnel leading north.
Another part of the lair.
Another part of the lair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign says 'I'm wandering around in a everlasting tale,
               seeking the light to regain my pride
                           Corama...

rooms.Name: The lair end
rooms.Description:
You can see a table in front of you. It's very dusty. Five skeletons
are sitting around the table. Exits are north and east.

Exits.Description: The northern part of the lair.
The eastern part of the lair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
On the table there is dust, in the center there is a small statue of a
Dragon sleeping.

They've obviously been killed somehow, but it doesn't look like it was
by sword or club.

It looks like a silver dragon.  It is nailed onto the table.  The
dragon sits on a red dragon that looks dead.  But the eyes of the red
dragon are glowing, pulsating red.  You feel drained.

rooms.Name: East tunnel
rooms.Description:
You are standing in dark tunnel, the exits are east and west. To the
west you see a wooden door.

Exits.Description: You can see a wooden door.
You can see a muddy tunnel.

rooms.Name: North tunnel
rooms.Description: You are standing in a dark tunnel, it leads upwards.

Exits.Description: The dark tunnel continues.
You can see the lair.
You can see a cave entrance.

rooms.Name: The L-shaped room
rooms.Description:
You are standing in deep darkness. To the south there is a small
exit. To the east you can see a gaping hole.

rooms.Name: The Circular hall
rooms.Description:
You are standing in round hall. To the north, east and south you can
see a stone head hanging on the walls.

Exits.Description: you see a room far away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
When you study the faces of the heads you see that they are faces of
dragons. The face to the north is red, the face to the east is green,
and the face to the south is blue.
This looks like an evil dragon.
This looks like a neutral dragon.
This looks like a good dragon.

rooms.Name: Dusty tunnel
rooms.Description:
You are standing in dust. This place has not been touched for a long
time. Otherwise it is quite boring here, looks like a place to rest! To
the west you see the outline of a door. A tunnel leads to the east.

Exits.Description: You can see the outline of a door. Just like in the description!
You see a tunnel which leads downwards. It is quite dark.

rooms.Name: The crossing
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a crossing of hallways. You can leave this place
in every direction, except up and down. In the dust you notice strange
footprints.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You have never seen this kind of footprints before!

rooms.Name: The L-shaped room
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a L-shaped room. You can hear noises from the
long tunnel to the east. You feel very afraid! A sign is hanging on the
wall.

Exits.Description: a long dark tunnel.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The sign says 'DANGER!!'.

rooms.Name: Dragons lair
rooms.Description:
You can see burned walls, the floor stones are fiery red. All kinds
of bones are scattered all over the floor. On the walls you can see
some burned shapes. You smell burnt flesh. Two creatures are sort of
melted into the floor.

Exits.Description: You can see a long tunnel.
You can see nothing but darkness.

rooms.Name: The burned room
rooms.Description:
You are in a room, which once had been quite burned. There is
writing on the wall.

Exits.Description: You can see a red glow...

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The writing says 'DANGER!!!'

rooms.Name: The wind tunnel
rooms.Description: You are standing in a tunnel. Above you, you can feel a breeze.

Exits.Description: To dark to tell

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The breeze comes from a hole above you.  NO way to get up there.

rooms.Name: The glittering room
rooms.Description:
This room are all bright. In the walls you can see some silver.
Exits are west, east and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The glittering silver looks like it is INSIDE the walls.

rooms.Name: The secret passage room
rooms.Description:
You have entered a tiny room. There is an exit down, and an exit to
the west.

Exits.Description: You can see a light to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A sign is blocking the way. It says 'This has not been implemented
yet....'

rooms.Name: End of long tunnel
rooms.Description:
You are at a end of a long tunnel. Right in front of you, you can
see a gray mass. To the east you can see a tremendously long tunnel,
but you know that, you were just there.

Exits.Description: A long tunnel. JUST like in the description!
A gray mass is blocking the way.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The mass is nothing but a mass, but it is quite suspicious!

rooms.Name: Stair-room
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small room. Drawings of faces in pain are on
the walls. You can fell darkness is ruling the place. There are two
exits: south and down.  But apparently the exit down is blocked and
impossible to get by.

Exits.Description: Nothing but darkness...
A sign is blocking the way: 'This has not been implemented yet'.

rooms.Name: Dark tunnel
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a dark tunnel. It continues to the north and to
the south. Bones are spread on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like bones of a human.

rooms.Name: Entrance to lair
rooms.Description:
The smell here is awful. To the south you can see some smoke. A
tunnel leads north and east.

Exits.Description: The only thing you can see is smoke.
A small cave is to the east.

rooms.Name: North-eastern part of Basilisk's cave
rooms.Description:
It is hard to see here because of the smoke. To the north you can
barely see a small tunnel. Other exits are to the south and to the
west.

rooms.Name: South-eastern part of Basilisk's cave
rooms.Description:
There are a very small hole in wall from which the smoke is coming
from. Otherwise it is pitch black. Exits are north and west.

Exits.Description: You can see nothing but smoke.
You can see nothing but smoke.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's a small hole, about one foot in diameter.

rooms.Name: North-western part of Basilisk's cave
rooms.Description:
You can see some hay spread on the floor. The smell is awful here,
and it makes you feel sick. This place where the Basilisk sleeps. Watch
out... maybe it is not far from here..

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The hay is very dirty.  The smell of it makes you feel sick.

rooms.Name: South-western part of Basilisk's cave
rooms.Description: You can see nothing but smoke.

rooms.Name: The small cave
rooms.Description:
You are standing in small cave. You can see some light at the end.
Exits are north and south.

Exits.Description: You can see only smoke.
You can see a blue glow. And you feel a fresh breeze.... ahhhh....

rooms.Name: The northern end of the pool
rooms.Description:
You have wet feet, you are standing in water. The water looks calm.
You can see that it's a big lake. Light seeps from the water.

Exits.Description: You can see a small cave.
You can see more water.
You can see water.

rooms.Name: The pool
rooms.Description:
You are swimming in water. It is getting deep here. It is also dark
in this end.

Exits.Description: You see calm water.
You can see some bubbles in the water.

rooms.Name: The south end of the pool
rooms.Description: You standing in water up to your neck! You can only see water.

Exits.Description: You can see calm water.
To dark to tell, but you can feel something nearby.

rooms.Name: The pool
rooms.Description:
You are swimming in DARKNESS. You feel something touching your right
leg.

Exits.Description: To dark to tell.
You can feel a warm breeze.

rooms.Name: The Edge of the Forest
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the end of a dusty road, near the eastern edge of the
large forest of Haon-Dor. To the east you see the road heading back to the
walled city, Midgaard, and to the west is a narrow trail leading through the
forest.

Exits.Description:
To the east a dusty road takes you back to the walls of Midgaard, and its large
west gate.
You see a narrow forest trail winding westward in between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The forest trail winds westwards through the trees.

The trees are quite tall considering most of them appear to be quite young.
On one of the trees, crude letters forming the word "Haon-Dor" have been
carved into the bark.

rooms.Name: A trail through the light forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading through the forest. There seems to be a small
path leading north into the shadows. To the east is the forest edge and to the
west the trail leads further into the forest.

Exits.Description:
You see evidence of a small path leading through a break in the trees to the
north.
The trail continues eastwards out of the forest.
You see the narrow forest trail winding westwards in between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The forest trail winds east-west through the trees.

The trees here are quite young and fresh.  They seem to accommodate many kinds
of birds, insects and other small animals.
Very cute little creatures, they seem to enjoy life.

rooms.Name: A trail through the light forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a narrow trail winding east and west through the forest. To the
west, the forest gradually becomes more dense. A small forest path leads off to
the south.

Exits.Description: The trail continues eastwards through the young trees.
The small path leads south through the young trees.
You see the narrow forest trail winding westwards into the dense forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The forest trail winds east-west through the trees.

The young, slender trees look beautiful, their fresh, green leaves moving
lightly in the wind.

rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail winding east and west through the dense forest. To the
east, the forest gradually seems to become lighter.

Exits.Description: A trail continues.
The trail continues eastwards to the younger part of the forest.
You see the narrow trail winding westwards through the dense forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The forest trail seems almost fragile compared to the massive trunks.

The dense crowns of the mature trees leave only a fraction of the sky to be
seen through the leaves.

rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail winding east and west through the dense forest. To the
west, the trees are so huge and their crowns so dense that forest remains in
total darkness. A small path leads south through the trees.

Exits.Description: The trail continues eastwards through the dense forest.
The small path leads south through the trees.
The narrow trail almost seems to disappear between the enormous trunks.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The forest trail seems almost fragile compared to the massive trunks.
The crowns of the old trees almost cut out all light.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The path
continues north and south.

Exits.Description: The small path leads north through the trees.
The small path leads south through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The path
continues north and east.

Exits.Description: The small path leads north through the trees.
The small path leads east through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks.

rooms.Name: An intersection in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The forest
gradually lightens to the east. Paths lead east, west and south.

Exits.Description: You can barely make out a clearing to the east.
The small path leads south through the trees.
The small path leads west through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks.

rooms.Name: The forest clearing
rooms.Description:
You are in a clearing in the forest. Lots of fresh stumps of varying sizes
protrude from the ground and heavy logs are stacked neatly in a big pile
supported by stakes set into the ground. Paths lead north, east and west.

Exits.Description: The small path leads north through the trees.
The small path leads east through the trees.
The small path leads west through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Even though the logs have been chopped to shorter pieces, they are quite heavy
as they are fresh and still filled with sap.
The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The stakes keep the logs from rolling down.

There are more stumps than logs and some of the stumps are partly covered in
moss.
The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks.

rooms.Name: Outside a small cabin in the forest
rooms.Description:
You are outside a small cabin built entirely from heavy logs. There is a
wooden door to the north and small paths lead west and south through the trees.

Exits.Description: The wooden door is quite sturdy but does not appear to be equipped with a lock.
The small path leads south through the dense forest.
The small path leads west through the light forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks simple but comfortable and the slender trees make the whole place seem
pretty idyllic.  It's a cabin built from wooden logs.
The path is probably used by the cabin's inhabitants.
The trees are fairly young, not much more than a hundred years or so.

rooms.Name: Inside the Cabin
rooms.Description:
You are inside a small one-room cabin made entirely from heavy logs. It is
very sparsely furnished, containing only the most basic housekeeping equipment,
such as a bed, a chair and a table.

Exits.Description: The wooden door leads south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is definitely not the most comfortable bed you have seen in your life.
It is made from oak and looks strong and sturdy.

A heavy table that doesn't even appear to rock. It seems to have something
carved on it.

On the table is carved :
                                                  /) /)
          Danny and Mari, Oct 31, 1991           ( o o )
                                                  = x =
                                                 m     m
                                              ***(========-

rooms.Name: A small path through the light forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the forest. The trees are tall and
slender. Paths lead north and south.

Exits.Description: The path leads north through the young trees.
The path leads south through the young trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees are fairly young, not much more than a hundred years or so.

rooms.Name: An intersection in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest floor in an unreal twilight illumination. Paths lead
north, east and south.

Exits.Description: The small path leads north through the trees.
The small path leads east through the trees.
The small path leads south through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The path
continues east and west.

Exits.Description: The small path leads east through the trees.
The small path leads west through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks.

rooms.Name: An intersection in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. The forest
gradually lightens to the north. Paths lead north, east and west.

Exits.Description: The path leads north to a lighter part of the forest.
The small path leads east through the trees.
The small path leads west through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.

The crowns of the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight
illumination.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The path
continues south and west.

Exits.Description: The small path leads south through the trees.
The small path leads west through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The path
continues north, south and east.

Exits.Description: The small path leads north through the trees.
The small path leads east through the trees.
The small path leads south through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are at a turn on a small path leading through the dense forest. The
forest seems to become lighter to the west. The path continues north and west.

Exits.Description: The small path leads north through the trees.
The small path leads west through the trees to a lighter part of the forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.

The crowns of the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight
illumination.  A large branch looms above you, over the path.
The branch of a large oak stretches out above the path from the east.

rooms.Name: An intersection in the light forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the forest. A path leads north to a
small field and other paths lead east and west into the dense forest.

Exits.Description: The path leads north to a small, grassy field.
The path leads east to a dense part of the forest.
The path leads west to a dense part of the forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The tall trees are young and slender, not much more than a hundred years or so.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. The forest seems
to become lighter to the east. The path continues north and east.

Exits.Description: The small path leads north through the trees.
The small path leads east through the trees to a lighter part of the forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.

The crowns of the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight
illumination.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The path
continues south and west.

Exits.Description: The small path leads south through the trees.
The small path leads west through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. To the west you
see a dark cave entrance, leading into a small hillside. The path continues
north and east.

Exits.Description: The small path leads north through the trees.
The small path leads east through the trees.
The cave is very dark.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.

The crowns of the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight
illumination.

The irregular opening is eight feet wide and six feet tall.  An acrid smell
emanates from within.

rooms.Name: Inside the cave
rooms.Description:
You are in a natural cave. Various sorts of debris cover the stone floor,
emitting a rather unpleasant smell that makes the air thick and hard to
breathe. The only obvious exit is east.

Exits.Description: The cave opening is to the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It consists mostly of gnawed bones mixed with small pieces of torn fur.
Quite uninteresting.
Kind of transparent, but quite noticeable nevertheless.

rooms.Name: A Grassy Field
rooms.Description:
You are in a grass covered field somewhere in the forest. The tall grass
nearly reaches your waist, and the surrounding oaks and beeches form an almost
wall-like thicket on the east side of the field. To the northeast you can see a
small lake. A small path leads south through the trees, and the field opens up
to the north and west.

Exits.Description:
Wind blowing in from the north carries with it the smell of a newly killed
animal, as well as the noise of many birds, which you can see circling there.
The ground slopes gently downward to the eastern tree line.
The small path leads south in between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The tall grass makes a nice hiding place for animals.
The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees form a close thicket, blocking any exit to the west.

Many carrion birds are circling to the north, you presume they are waiting for
their turn to feast on a corpse.

rooms.Name: Lower Part of the Grassy Field
rooms.Description:
You are in a lower part of the grassy field, south of a small lake. The
grass here has been trampled by the many animals coming here for water, leaving
the ground covered in tracks of different types. To the west you see a break in
the wall of trees surrounding the field, and to the north is a small lake.

Exits.Description: The animal tracks lead off to the north, and around the lake there.

To the south-west you see a break in the tree line, leading back to the forest
path.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The tall grass makes a nice hiding place for animals.
The trampled grass path leads to the lake north of here.
The trees form a close thicket, blocking any exit to the south and east.

rooms.Name: Beside the Lake on a Grassy Field
rooms.Description:
The grass stops shortly before the lake, replaced by mud covered in tracks
from the local animals. When you come close many animals scatter into the tall
grass and some even into the forest. To the west you see birds circling in the
high in the air, and to the north you see a small lake, surrounded by tall
reeds. The field continues to the south, and the forest blocks passage to the
east.

Exits.Description:
The lake looks inviting, and you can see some sort of water fowl floating
around among the reeds.

To the south an animal trail leads of towards a the other side of the lower
field.
The smell of carrion drifts down to you from higher on the field to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The tall grass makes a nice hiding place for animals.

Animals from all around come here to drink. The lake itself is not very big,
but it stretches off to the north from here.
The trees form a close thicket, blocking any exit to the north or east.

Many carrion birds are circling to the west, you presume they are waiting for
their turn to feast on a corpse.

You see tracks of both hooved and other sorts of animals. Evidence of all
sizes of animals is here in the mud, showing just how lively the forest is.

rooms.Name: The Northern Section of a Grassy Field
rooms.Description:
As you come close, scavenging animals and birds of all sorts scatter,
leaving only the boldest and stupidest encircling the corpse of a large boar.
Carrion birds circle overhead, and smaller animals stare out of the tall grass
at you. The grass here has been trampled, and a large area around the corpse is
stained by blood. A trail leads down the sloping field to a lake, and to the
south you see the path back to the forest.

Exits.Description:
A small lake lies down the sloping field to the east. Some of the animals that
fled from here have gone there, and are watching, waiting for you to leave so
they can resume their feasting.

The field continues to the south, and you can see the path back to the forest
there.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tall grass makes a nice hiding place for animals. You see some of the
animals you frightened away peeking furtively out at you.
The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees form a close thicket, blocking any exit to the north and west.

Many birds of varying size circle overhead, waiting for you to leave. You hope
they don't decide that you could be a corpse with just a little effort.

Several pairs of eyes peer out at you, urging you to leave.  The just might
decide that en masse they could kill you, so you probably don't want to tarry
here.

rooms.Name: On the Lake
rooms.Description:
You are in the middle of a small lake, fed from a small stream coming
through the forest from the northwest. The water is not that clear, but you can
see fish swimming around below you. The bank is clear to the south, providing a
safe place to get back to the field.

Exits.Description:
Some animals have gathered on the bank to watch you, curious about what you are
doing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Trout and perhaps a catfish or two swim about below your boat, totally
ignoring your presence.

Animals from all around come here to drink. The lake itself is not very big,
but it stretches off to the north from here.
Trees cover the bank on most sides, preventing you from docking there.

Reeds grow up around the edges of the lake, providing cover for the small
water fowl that live here.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The path
continues to the west and south.

Exits.Description: The small path leads west through the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks.

rooms.Name: Near a Large Tree in the Dense Forest
rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a small path leading through the dense forest. The
crowns of the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination.
This rough clearing is dominated by a very large oak tree, probably the largest
in this part of the forest. The path leads back to the north.

Exits.Description: You see the lower branches of the towering oak.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.

The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks, with one large oak off to your
right.

It has some lower branches that you think you could reach if you stretched.
You might even be able to climb all the top, though from here it looks like
something else had that idea before you. There is a faint animal shape pacing
on one of the highest branches.

From here it looks vaguely feline, though you could get a much better view
from in the tree.  You are not sure if it has seen you yet.

They look quite sturdy, certainly capable of holding your weight should you
decide to climb up the tree using them.

You could probably see most of the forest, and perhaps even the city from the
top of the tree...of course, you'd have to deal with whatever that shape is
pacing on one of the upper limbs.

rooms.Name: In the Lower Branches of a Large Oak
rooms.Description:
You are in a huge oak, about one third of the way to the top. The branches
above you block out much of the light, but enough filters through for you to
see. Small animals and birds scatter at your approach, rustling the leaves all
about you. You could easily climb back down to the ground, or continue up the
tree. One large branch juts outward to the west, possibly providing a third
choice of exit.

Exits.Description:
This limb looks large and strong enough for you to walk most of the way along
its length to the west.
More large branches spread out from the tree above you.
The rough clearing is just a quick climb and jump below you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
After a short period of looking, you notice a bird's nest on a limb not far
above you, and a large squirrel's nest in the crook of a large limb that
stretches out towards the west.

A variety of squirrels, chipmunks, and birds make their homes in this and the
surrounding trees.  If you look closely you may be able to see some of their
rapidly emptying nests.

The shape above you moves with definite grace and confidence. You think that
it must be a Bobcat, stalking smaller tree-dwelling animals.

From here it looks feline.  You still don't think it has noticed you, despite
the noise you made while climbing up here.

They look quite sturdy, certainly capable of holding your weight should you
decide to climb around in the tree using them.

You could probably see most of the forest, and perhaps even the city from the
top of the tree...of course, you would have to deal with whatever that shape is
that you see pacing on one of the upper limbs.

rooms.Name: Out on a Limb in a Large Oak
rooms.Description:
This sturdy branch hangs far out over a path to the west, which you might be
able to jump down to. Several squirrels scamper into hiding as you approach,
leaving you alone and swaying slightly with the wind. To your north you can see
a small log cabin through the trees, and to the southeast there seems to be
some sort of clearing, with many birds circling above it.

Exits.Description:
Back to the east you see the tree trunk. It is much less precarious there
compared to here... perhaps you should go back.

Below you is a small path, probably used by the forest animals. You think that
you could jump down with a little effort.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You notice that several of the squirrels sought refuge in a large nest that is
well within your reach.  Looking into the nest, you see two pairs of eyes
staring back at you.

A variety of squirrels, chipmunks, and birds make their homes in this and the
surrounding trees.  If you look closely you may be able to see some of their
rapidly emptying nests.

The shape above you moves with definite grace and confidence. You think that
it must be a Bobcat, stalking smaller tree-dwelling animals.

From here it looks feline.  You still don't think it has noticed you, despite
the noise you made while climbing up here.

The limbs look quite sturdy, certainly capable of holding your weight should
you decide to climb around in the tree using them.

You could probably see most of the forest, and perhaps even the city from the
top of the tree...of course, you would have to deal with whatever that shape is
that you see pacing on one of the upper limbs.

rooms.Name: Midway to the Top of the Large Oak
rooms.Description:
You are in a huge oak, about midway to the top. The branches above you block
out much of the light, but enough filters through for you to see. A few birds
have remained to watch you from the fringe branches, well out of your reach.
Scratches mar the tree here, and torn bark is scattered near you on the branch.
It would seem some large forest cat lives nearby, so you had better be careful!
You can continue a bit farther up the tree, or descend to limbs that don't sway
so much.

Exits.Description:
Above you the tree narrows farther, but it still looks like you could climb up
there. A feline shape is pacing about above you, trying to get to a large
wounded bird. Perhaps you should try to see what sort of cat this is before you
interrupt it's hunt... it might eat you instead of the bird.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A medium sized bird's nest is close to you here, and it looks like it has some
nice looking eggs in it too!

A variety of squirrels, chipmunks, and birds make their homes in this and the
surrounding trees.  If you look closely you may be able to see some of their
rapidly emptying nests.

It looks like a Bobcat, and it seems quite intent on getting to a large bird
that it has wounded.  It has not seen you yet, or perhaps just thinks you are
too easy a meal.

They look quite sturdy, certainly capable of holding your weight should you
decide to climb around in the tree using them.

You could probably see most of the forest, and perhaps even the city from the
top of the tree...of course, you would have to deal with whatever that shape is
that you see pacing on one of the upper limbs.

rooms.Name: High in the Large Oak
rooms.Description:
The tree top gently sways in the wind, and you think you are as high as you
can safely go in the tree. The limbs here show evidence of a small battle, with
ripped bark and loose feathers scattered everywhere. Looking around, you can
see the forest stretching out below you in all directions. To the east you see
Midgaard, and to the south the river runs through a deep chasm. North and west
of here you can see another small village, and on the western horizon you see a
large mountain.

Exits.Description:
Below you many of the animals you frightened earlier have returned to their
various nests and homes. You can see a small hint of the path far below you
through the branches.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Off to the southwest you can see a grass covered field, and a small lake;
northwest of you is a small cabin and a large pile of wood. Far to west the
treetops form a tight canopy, blocking out almost all sunlight and your view.
It is said that large wolves live there. You've also heard rumors of horrible
spiders and drow living there. You'd be best off leaving that area to more
experienced adventurers.

A long mountain range stretches across the horizon to the north and northeast.
You have heard rumors of many different sorts of creatures living there,
varying from Dwarves and Humans to Ogres and various humanoid creatures. Some
say that evil Dark Elves dwell in the underworld deep below the lands of the
Dwarves.  The caves of Moria also are found there, peopled by all sorts of
evil creatures.

To the south you see a river flowing roughly from the northeast to the west.
It emerges from a dark opening in the side of a mountain and flows through
Midgaard, and on into the forest. It has eroded a deep chasm in the soft stone
under the forest floor, and is not visible for long after it enters the forest
proper.

rooms.Name: A shaded path through the forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small shaded path leading through the trees. The forest
gradually lightens to the east. The path continues to the north, and to the
south you see the main trail.

Exits.Description: The path winds its way between the trees.

Through a break in the tree line you see the main trail that heads back towards
Midgaard.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The shaded path is probably used by the small animals living in the forest.
They are mostly young oaks and tall beeches.

rooms.Name: A shaded path through the forest
rooms.Description:
You are at a turn on a small shadowed path leading through the forest. The
forest seems to become lighter to the west. The path continues north and west.

Exits.Description: The path winds its way between the trees.
The path winds its way between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The shadowy path is probably used by the small animals living in the forest.

The crowns of the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight
illumination.  A large branch looms above you, over the path.

rooms.Name: A shaded path through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small shaded path leading through the dense forest. The crowns
of the old trees leave the forest floor in an unreal twilight illumination. To
the north you see a small clearing. Paths lead east and west.

Exits.Description: Through the underbrush you see a small clearing.
The path winds its way between the trees.
The path winds its way between the trees.

south from here.

Exits.Description:
Through the trees to the south you can almost see the main trail leading back
to Midgaard.
The path winds its way between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The shadowed path is probably used by the small animals living in the forest.

rooms.Name: A fork in the shaded path through the forest
rooms.Description:
You are at a fork in the small shaded path winding through the trees. The
forest gradually becomes more dense to the west. The path branches to the north
and south here, and also continues to the east.

Exits.Description: The path winds its way between the trees.

rooms.Name: At the fallen tree
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small clearing, beside a large fallen tree. A large
amount of the tree has already decomposed, but some pieces remain, scattered
about the clearing. Paths border the clearing to the north and south.

Exits.Description: A shaded path winds its way northeast between the trees.
A shaded path winds its way east between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The shaded paths are probably used by the animals living in the forest.

The tree has mostly rotted away, providing nourishment to many small plants
growing here in the clearing.  The few pieces that remain are not all that
large, but one log in particular catches your eye and seems to remind you of
something. Under one of these logs would be a great place for an animal to
make it's den...

When the large tree fell it must have brought a few of the smaller trees down
with it in order to make a clearing like this.

Under a log you think you see some sort of hole, or animal's den. Looking
closer, you can make out the form of what you believe to be a Badger resting
inside of the den.

rooms.Name: An intersection on the shaded path
rooms.Description:

rooms.Description:
You are wandering amongst the trees in the light forest, without the aid of
a path or trail. More sunlight trickles through the treetops here, making your
travel a bit easier. Small animals scurry away as you approach. You are no
longer on a path, so you may go whichever way you please.

The trees seem to part, exposing a trail into the shade.
The trees seem to part, exposing a trail into the shade.
The trees seem to part, exposing a trail into the shade.

The trees are younger here than to those to the west.

rooms.Description:

gradually lightens to the east. Paths lead west and south, and you think you

Exits.Description:

Exits.Description: The path winds its way between the trees.

rooms.Description:

north the terrain becomes quite hilly and rough. The crowns of the old trees
leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The path continues north
and south.

Exits.Description: The path winds its way into the hills and denser forest.
The path winds its way between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The shadowy path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.
The trees are mostly old beeches and oaks.
To the northwest you see hills covered by dense forest.

rooms.Name: A small trail through the forest
rooms.Description:
You have just left the shaded path, and you are now standing at the head of
a very short trail. It looks like someone begin clearing away the underbrush
here, but didn't get finished. You may leave in any direction, but the path is
to the west.

Exits.Description: The trees seem to part, exposing a trail into the shade.

gradually becomes more dense to the west, and to the northwest the terrain is
quite hilly. The path continues north and south. To the east you see a trail

Exits.Description: The path winds its way between the trees.

The path winds its way between the trees.

To the northwest the ground becomes more hilly. You have heard that a halfling
village is somewhere in the hills.

You think you see the beginnings of a small trail to the east, winding through

rooms.Description:

track of the path long ago, and now must rely on your instincts to guide you.
The ground is very rough and rocky here, and only the most hardy plants
survive. The crowns of the old trees leave the hills in an unreal twilight
illumination.

dense forest spreads out all around you, and the crowns of the old trees leave
