rooms.Name: A Road Through the Plains
rooms.Description:
You are on a dust covered east-west road through the western plains. An
occasional hunter or adventurer can be seen, heading to or from the forest. To
the east is the walled city, Midgaard, and to the west the road ends at the
head of a narrow trail into a large forest.

Exits.Description: Far to the east you see the large walls guarding Midgaard.

To the west the dusty trail ends, and becomes a narrow trail into the cool
shadows of the forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The forest trail winds westwards through the trees.
The trees are quite tall considering most of them appear to be quite young.
The road is well used, and quite dusty.

rooms.Name: A Road Through the Plains
rooms.Description:
You are on a dust covered east-west road through the western plains. An
occasional hunter or adventurer can be seen, heading to or from the forest. To
the east is the walled city, Midgaard, and to the west the road continues
towards a large forest.

Exits.Description: Far to the east you see the walls and western gate of Midgaard.

You see the large forest, Haon-Dor, stretching out far to the west, and to the
northwest you the forest gives way to hills.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The large forest of Haon-Dor spreads out to the west. Small and large game
is plentiful there...as is adventure, and of course, danger!

Some small trees grow amongst the underbrush of the plains. These slowly gain
in height as you travel farther westward towards Haon-Dor
The road is well used, and quite dusty.

rooms.Name: A Road Through the Plains
rooms.Description:
You are on a dust covered east-west road crossing the grassy plains between
Midgaard the forest of Haon-Dor. An occasional hunter or adventurer can be
seen, heading to or from the forest. To the east is the walled city, Midgaard,
and to the west the road continues towards a large forest.

Exits.Description: You see a small dirt path.
To the east you see the walls and West Gate of Midgaard.
To the west the road continues towards the forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The large forest of Haon-dor spreads out to the west.  Small and large game
is plentiful there...as is adventure, and of course, danger!
The road is well used, and quite dusty.

rooms.Name: A hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A silver door can be seen
to the north.

rooms.Name: A store room
rooms.Description:
You are in a large store room. Raw materials are neatly bundled and piled
here and here. Many freshly cut staves rods and wands of different sizes are
here. You can see a silver door to the west.

rooms.Name: The master spellbinder's chamber
rooms.Description:
You are in the chambers of the master spell binder. Unlike other work shops
of similar nature, this one is without furnishings or tools. The spell binder
obviously needs none for the working of his art. A silver door can be seen to
the west.

rooms.Name: The spellbinder's cache
rooms.Description:
You have discovered the cache of the master spell binder. There are three
very large silver chased cabinets here, other than that, the room is bare. A
silver door can be seen to the south.

rooms.Name: The golem master's workshop
rooms.Description:
You are in the golem master's workshop. A few unfinished looking humanoid
forms of different make are here, some moving, some not. The animated forms
lunge to attack you.

rooms.Name: A store room
rooms.Description:
You are in a small store room. Large chunks of clay, stone, wood and many
other raw materials are here.

rooms.Name: The golem chamber
rooms.Description:
You are in the golem chamber. Golems made of every imaginable material are
here, ranging in size from a hand-span to nearly the ceiling. They all seem to
be sleeping.

rooms.Name: It is very dark here...
rooms.Description: It is very dark here...

magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
rooms.Description:

which provides enough light to see by. The hallway continues north and east
from here.

rooms.Name: A hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

rooms.Name: A hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. An emerald door can be seen
to the south.

rooms.Name: The master of illusion's chamber
rooms.Description:
You are in the chamber of the master of illusions. The walls here are every
changing in color and texture, as if they were reforming before your very eyes.
Many splendorous treasures lie all around in heaps and piles, or at least they
seem to be treasures...

rooms.Name: A bedroom
rooms.Description:
You are in the bedroom of the master of illusions. Strange looking items and
artifacts float here and there in the air. The ripples of strong magic can be
felt everywhere. The room seems much larger than it looks...

rooms.Name: A hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A glass door can be seen to
the south.

rooms.Name: The meditation chamber
rooms.Description:
You are in a meditation chamber. It is very silent here, in fact you can not
even hear your own footsteps. You feel very peaceful.

rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by. The hallway continues north and west
from here.

rooms.Name: A hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A blackened door can be
seen to the east.

rooms.Name: A dark room
rooms.Description:
You are in a large dark room. The air here seems quite stale, and a sense of
extreme dread comes over you. The stench of rotten flesh seems to be wafting in
from the open doorway to the north.

rooms.Name: A dark room
rooms.Description:
You are in a large dark room. The stench here makes you gag and wretch.
There are body parts and half rotted corpses strewn about with complete
abandon. Several operating tables with still forms that resemble nothing you've
ever seen alive are here. Tortured screams can be heard from the north.

Exits.Description: Upon gazing northwards, you are filled with deep dread.

rooms.Name: The Necromancer's Lair
rooms.Description:
You are in the lair of the evil Necromancer. Undead minions of all types,
human and otherwise stand here waiting to do their master's bidding. Some
glowing arcane sigils have been etched into walls and floor, no doubt to
protect the evil master from his own ungodly creations.

rooms.Name: A hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

rooms.Name: A hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

rooms.Name: The end of the hallway
rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long hallway. The walls here glow with a faint
magical energy which provides plenty of light. Stairs lead up to the next level
here and the hallway continues south.

rooms.Name: A corridor
rooms.Description:
You are at the east end of a long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with
ancient runes of power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to crackle
with power all around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost as if the
corridor it self were alive.

rooms.Name: A corridor
rooms.Description:
You are in a long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with ancient runes of
power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to crackle with power all
around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost as if the corridor itself
were alive.

rooms.Name: A bend in the corridor
rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with ancient
runes of power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to crackle with
power all around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost as if the
corridor itself were alive.

rooms.Name: A corridor
rooms.Description:
You are in a long corridor leading north and south. Obsidian walls engraved
with ancient runes of power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to
crackle with power all around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost as
if the corridor itself were alive.

rooms.Name: An intersection
rooms.Description:
You are at an intersection in the corridor. The obsidian walled halls lead
off in every direction from here, pulsing with the power of their ancient
runes.

rooms.Name: A corridor
rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with ancient
runes of power stretch out before you. A darkened door is to the east. Tendrils
of mist cling to the floor here, they seem to be seeping from under the door.

rooms.Name: The scrying chamber
rooms.Description:
You are in the scrying chamber of the high tower of sorcerery. It is here
that arcane rituals are performed to enable those of the art to look in upon
denizens throughout the world and spy out their darkest secrets. A huge black
cauldron is in the center of the room, bubbling and gurgling, it pours forth a
constant stream of smoky fog into the air about you. Here and there on stands
of different sizes are crystal balls and oddly shaped mirrors.

rooms.Name: A corridor
rooms.Description:
You have reached an end in the long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with
ancient runes of power stretch out before you. The sound of snoring can barely
be heard through the door to the west.

rooms.Name: The entrance to the library
rooms.Description:
You are in the entrance to the great library of magic. A giant desk is here,
covered with books parchments and scrolls. Long shelves loaded with row upon
row of books stretch out in every direction as far as the eye can see.

Exits.Description: All you can see are books.
All you can see are books.

rooms.Name: In the library
rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

rooms.Name: In the library
rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

rooms.Name: In the library
rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

rooms.Name: In the library
rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

rooms.Name: In the library
rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

rooms.Name: In the library
rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

rooms.Name: Between the shelves
rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. The shelves seem uncomfortably close
here, you can barely maneuver between them. The musty smell is still strong,
and the elusive books still hover just out of reach. A faint flicker of light
can barely be made out to the north.

rooms.Name: The reading room
rooms.Description:
You are in a small room completely devoid of furnishings. The only thing
here is an enormous tome, lying face open on the floor. The great book looks
both heavy and ancient. Its jewel encrusted bindings are well worn as the bark
of a tree. Spidery writings seem to crawl across the pages, totally
incomprehensible to your mortal eye. Something seems to be wedged between the
pages.

rooms.Name: A corridor
rooms.Description:
You are in a long corridor leading north and south. Obsidian walls engraved
with ancient runes of power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to
crackle with power all around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost as
if the corridor itself were alive.

rooms.Name: The end of the corridor
rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long corridor. The obsidian walls come to an abrupt
halt at the edge of a golden archway here. The hum of power is so strong it
nearly numbs your body. The archway lies before you, glowing and pulsing with
energy.

rooms.Name: The arched entrance
rooms.Description:
You feel a slight tingle as you pass through the archway, as if the living
magical energies here had infused your body, found it wanting and left. The
intense glow from the arch above you is almost blinding. Through the light you
can barely make out a stairway leading up.

rooms.Name: The landing
rooms.Description:
You are on a small landing in the middle of a long stairway leading up. Your
senses seem dulled here, no sound or smell can be detected at all, and the only
thing you can see in any direction is endless stairway.

rooms.Name: An intersection
rooms.Description:
You are at an intersection of several hallways. You feel as if strange
mystical forces are pushing and pulling at each other from all around you. The
sensation of being trapped, in the middle is almost tangible in the air here. A
grey tiled hallway leads south, black tiled east, white tiled west, and a
multi-colored hallway swirling with patterns that remain just barely
unrecognizable is to the north.

rooms.Name: A grey tiled hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a grey tiled hallway leading north and south. Dim balls of energy
float here and there shedding a warm light, and showing the way. A feeling of
peace and balance comes over you.

rooms.Name: A grey tiled hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a grey tiled hallway leading north and south. Dim balls of energy
float here and there shedding a warm light, and showing the way. A feeling of
peace and balance comes over you. Large grey metal double doors can be seen to
the south.

rooms.Name: The antechamber
rooms.Description:
You are in the antechamber of the master magician of the grey light. A
feeling of strong magic floats in the air about you, almost as if you could
taste the power held within these walls. Once your eyes adjust to the
semi-light, you can make out a larger room to the south.

rooms.Name: The main chamber
rooms.Description:
A feeling of tranquillity comes over you as you enter the main chamber of
neutrality. Some artifacts are hung on the walls here, or set on stands. The
room in general looks both comfortable and official. Probably where the master
of neutrality holds audience.

rooms.Name: The study
rooms.Description:
You are in a large study. Shelves filled with many books or arcane knowledge
are on every wall. A large oaken desk is in the center, with many parchments
and scrolls on it. The most notable thing in the room is a small set of scales,
which floats about eye level. In perfect balance, the scales are no doubt a
sign of the master's neutrality.

rooms.Name: A closet
rooms.Description:
You are in a small closet. It is filled with many cloaks, and some other
apparel.

rooms.Name: A bedroom
rooms.Description:
You are in the bedroom of the master magician of neutrality. Curtained
windows can be seen on the south wall. A large comfortable looking bed takes up
most of the room.

rooms.Name: A dark hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a long dark hallway leading east and west. Not much can be seen
in the unnatural darkness here, but you get a deep sense of dread the further
you go.

rooms.Name: A dark hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a long dark hallway leading east and west. Not much can be seen
in the unnatural darkness here, but you get a deep sense of dread the further
you go.

rooms.Name: The end of the hallway
rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long dark hallway. The darkness here is almost
tangible in its thickness. A deep sense of fear and loathing comes over you. A
pair of obsidian doors can be seen to the east.

rooms.Name: The chamber of darkness
rooms.Description:
You are in a vast chamber. The walls fade into darkness, leaving you with a
very vague idea of the actual size of the room. Swirling here and there in the
dark, are patches of pure black which seem to suck in your light and leave it
that much darker here.

rooms.Name: It is very dark here...
rooms.Description: It is very dark here...

rooms.Name: Torture chamber
rooms.Description:
You are in an ill lit chamber. Instruments of torture hang from a rack on
the wall, they seem to quiver with anticipation of a victim as if they had a
mind of their own. An operating table is here, though it is bare. An extreme
feeling of evil permeates the entire area.

rooms.Name: The inner chamber
rooms.Description:
You are in a small dark chamber. Upon the walls are glowing sigils of dark
power, scrawled and traced in an evil language no longer known to most of this
plane of existence. There is an obsidian altar here which seems to glow, but
does not shed any light, in fact it seems to be taking light in.

rooms.Name: A bright hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a long well lit hallway leading east and west. The walls here are
a milky white color, and glow with a warm luminescence, as does the floor. A
feeling of goodness permeates the area, and you feel unworthy to tread upon
these sacred floors.

rooms.Name: A bright hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a long well lit hallway leading east and west. The walls here are
a milky white color, and glow with a warm luminescence, as does the floor. A
feeling of goodness permeates the area, and you feel unworthy to tread upon
these sacred floors. A huge set of double doors in finely worked ivory can be
seen to the west.

rooms.Name: An antechamber
rooms.Description:
You are in a small antechamber. It is well lit here, though the source of
light cannot be seen. It is almost as if the room itself exudes a warm glow of
goodness. A larger chamber can be seen to the west, but you do not feel worthy
to pass into it.

rooms.Name: The chamber of the white light
rooms.Description:
You are in a vast chamber, its walls floor and ceiling are of an unknown
metallic material, the brightest white, almost blindingly stark. A flickering
flame is in the center of the room, seeming to feed off of darkness and
cleansing the room of any evil. You feel a slight tug at your being as the
flame flickers towards you.

rooms.Name: The meditation chamber
rooms.Description:
You are in a small meditation chamber. White silk cushions are everywhere,
looking very comfortable. You get an easy peaceful feeling of relaxation here,
almost making you want to lie down and fall asleep.

rooms.Name: A study
rooms.Description:
You are in a spacious study. It is extremely tidy here, to an almost
antiseptic nature. One would wonder how anyone could study without a mess all
around them, the master of this chamber obviously can.

rooms.Name: A closet
rooms.Description:
You are in a small closet. Cloaks and vests hang from hooks in the wall, and
a few old boots are all that can be seen here. Rather featureless.

rooms.Name: A wide hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a large hallway, wide enough to accommodate several people
standing abreast. The floor here is a swirl of multicolored patterns, in
constant motion. A huge grey metal door blocks the way north, it looks quite
sturdy.

rooms.Name: A wide hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a large hallway, wide enough to accommodate several people
standing abreast. The floor here is a swirl of multicolored patterns, in
constant motion. A huge black obsidian door blocks the way north, it looks
quite sturdy.

rooms.Name: A wide hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in a large hallway, wide enough to accommodate several people
standing abreast. The floor here is a swirl of multicolored patterns, in
constant motion. A huge white ivory door blocks the way north, it looks quite
sturdy.

rooms.Name: The entrance way
rooms.Description:
You are at the entrance to the audience chamber of the grand master of
magic. Beautiful tapestries displaying the ancient masters of lore are on the
walls, and the floor is covered with a plush multicolored carpet, which seems
to rustle and move at the touch of your boots.

rooms.Name: The audience chamber
rooms.Description:
You are in a large chamber. Small bolts of energy leap from wall to wall,
crackling with power. The floor is a swirl of indeterminable colors and
patterns ever changing. Bright bursts of color seem to explode into the air and
fade again at random times. All this splendor plays about and draws attention
to a large throne in the center of the room, it seems to be cut from a single
enormous emerald.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The giant emerald is flawless, and must be incredibly valuable.

rooms.Name: A dressing room
rooms.Description:
You are in a plush dressing room. Fine garments of many styles and some
outlandish colors hang from a rack suspended in mid air at eye level. The only
other interesting feature in the room is a large silver mirror on a finely
crafted gold stand.

rooms.Name: The library
rooms.Description:
You are in a small cozy looking library. A few well made books sit atop
shelves which span every wall. A large oaken writing table is in the center of
the room with odd papers and parchments on it. The illumination here, to your
surprise is a quite un-magical oil lamp.

rooms.Name: The altar
rooms.Description:
You are in a small chapel designed around a beautifully crafted golden
altar. Many icons to lesser deities line the room, but it is obvious by one
glance at the symbols on the altar, that this room was designed for the worship
of Mantis, the god of magic.

rooms.Name: The treasury
rooms.Description:
You are in a small chamber, the stale air here is testament to the fact that
it has gone undisturbed for many years.

rooms.Name: A passage
rooms.Description:
You are in a small dark passage, which would be unremarkable if not for the
fact that it ends in a blinding blue light to the west. On hooks set into the
wall here there hang several travel worthy cloaks, and a small leather
backpack. It looks as if someone has prepared this room to be used in the event
of a speedy evacuation.

rooms.Name: In the light
rooms.Description:
You seem to be floating in a magical energy field, though you cannot see the
source of the energy, you can feel its power pushing at you from all sides,
completely negating the effects of gravity. An imperfection in the uniform blue
can be seen overhead, it might be an exit.

rooms.Name: Hidden Path
rooms.Description:
Welcome to the Midgaard Honeymoon Resort.  We have designed this area
especially for you on this special day.  Before you, just a little up the
mountain side, is a beautiful cottage with everything you could want on your
honeymoon.  So what are you waiting on, come on up and begin your lives
together here with us at Honeymoon Resort!

Exits.Description: Up the path is a beautiful cottage just waiting for you to enter.

rooms.Name: Front Porch
rooms.Description:
You come up onto the front porch of the cottage. Before you is the door 
to your cottage.  All around you is a beautiful view of the mountains. 
Provided for your comfort is a double wide lounge chair.  Beside the chair is
a bottle of wine for you to enjoy along with the view.

Exits.Description:
On the door is a sign that says:

                     Welcome to honeymoon Resort
                     May your first day of your 
                     lives together only be a 
                     small sample of the joy
                     and happiness that waits you
                     in the coming days together.

                     Midgaard Management HM Resort

The east provides a beautiful view of a mountain lake complete with
a dock and small boat for your pleasure.

Before you is the path down the mountain.  Not to far from the cabin it 
disappears into the trees.

2
  To the west is a beautiful sunset splendid with the glow of reds and 
orange, a more beautiful site you have never seen.
Down below is the path back to the mundane world.

rooms.Name: Cottage
rooms.Description:
The cottage is bigger than you first thought from outside. On one wall is
a huge fireplace already ablaze with a cozy fire.  In front of the
fireplace is a giant bearskin rug.  In the center of the north wall is a
enormous champaign glass that reaches all the way to the upstairs balcony.

Exits.Description: You see small wisps of steam coming from the next room.
You see a large, pool of water.
You see the front porch and a beautiful view of the forest and mountain side.
The bearskin rug looks big enough to climb into.
Up the ladder is a large room, hmm maybe you should take a look.
Down the steps is a nice brightly lit room.

rooms.Name: Sauna
rooms.Description:
This is a large sauna, complete with massage benches, oils, and all the things
you might need for an enjoyable steam bath for two.

Exits.Description: You see the main cottage room.

rooms.Name: The Library
rooms.Description:
A quaint little library is here, stacked with many volumes of poems,
love stories, and how-to-manuals.  If you ever find time, you might even
come down here and take a look around.  To the north is a door leading out
onto an open patio.

Exits.Description: You see a large patio.
The main cottage are is here.

rooms.Name: The Heated Pool
rooms.Description:
Before you is a magnificent olympic size swimming pool. The pool is
enclosed by some type of forcefield that lets in light and heat, but
does not show up from outside.  At least you do not remember seeing it
from the front porch. Around the pool are lounge chairs arranged to capture
the best view from all angles.  You stick your toe in the pool and
find it is the perfect temperature for a swim.

Exits.Description: You see the main cottage area.
You see the deep blue water of the pool.

rooms.Name: bearskin Rug
rooms.Description:
The rug IS big enough to crawl into, actually its -just- big enough for two
people to fit into.  Under the rug you are a little warm with all your cloths
on.  Maybe someone should turn down the heat a bit....or.....

rooms.Name: The Patio
rooms.Description:
The patio is open to the sky and gives you a beautiful view of the 
mountains and the lake below the cottage.  Around you the birds chirp and 
sing love songs to each other.

Exits.Description: You see a windy trial leading down the mountain.
You see a quaint library

rooms.Name: Mountain Path
rooms.Description:
Here the trail winds down the mountain to the lake below.  All around 
you are small birds chirping and you see several rabbits hopping about,
seemingly oblivious of you.

Exits.Description: You see a large patio to the west.
The path continues down the mountain.

rooms.Name: Beside The Lake
rooms.Description:
Before you is a beautiful mountain lake.  A boat dock at the edge of the 
lake has a small boat that looks seaworthy and shipshape.
  As you look out over the lake you see swans swimming slowly by and small
birds diving for fish in the shallows.  There are wildflowers along the 
banks that leave the air with a sweet smell of nectar.

Exits.Description: You see a small boat dock.
Above you is a twisty mountain path.

rooms.Name: Boat Dock
rooms.Description:
Here is a small boatdock complete with a tidy little boat.  Off to the
northwest you notice a little island in the middle of the lake.

Exits.Description: You see the lake before you.
You see the lake front.

rooms.Name: On the Lake
rooms.Description:
The lake is as beautiful from here as it is from the shore.  All around
below the boat you can see fish of all sizes swimming about.  Beautiful
lake trout and fierce pike exist side by side in perfect harmony.

Exits.Description: You see the boat dock.
The middle of the lake.

rooms.Name: Middle of the Lake
rooms.Description:
Here in the middle of the lake all is quiet and relaxing.  Just north of 
you is the island you spotted from the boat dock.  It looks like the perfect
place for a picnic.

Exits.Description: You see a small island.
The lake continues here.

rooms.Name: honeymoon Island
rooms.Description:
This is a beautiful little island covered with tall trees to give you
shade from the noonday sun.  Under a large oak a blanket is spread out and
two picnic baskets await you.  The management seems to have thought of
everything.

Exits.Description: You see a small island.

rooms.Name: Under the Oak
rooms.Description:
You settle down under the oak for a lovely picnic.  Inside the basket 
you find all your favorite foods.  How did they know that.  You also find
a note that says, "May your lives always be as full as these baskets. Please
keep them as our honeymoon gift to you"  
                                         Signed  HR Management.

rooms.Name: The Bedroom
rooms.Description:
This is a bedroom from your fantasies. There is a gigantic bed in the
center of the room that must be 12 feet to a side.  The bed is covered with
satin sheets, and mounds of fluffy pillows are heaped on the bed and around
on the floor.

Exits.Description: A large shower looks inviting.
You see a large balcony that overlooks the downstairs.
Down is the main cottage area

rooms.Name: Balcony
rooms.Description:
Here the balcony looks down over the main cottage area.  In front of you
is the top of the champaign glass.  It seems to be filled with bubbly
liquid of some type.

Exits.Description: The main bedroom area.
Lots of bubbly liquid awaits you.

rooms.Name: In the Champaign Glass
rooms.Description:
The glass is filled with some type of bubbly water that gives you
the most curious sensations as you sit down and relax in its curved sides.

Exits.Description: Above you is the balcony.

rooms.Name: The Shower
rooms.Description:
A large shower with multiple showerheads dominates this room.  Just the
thing after a long day (or night) to refresh you and get your going again.

Exits.Description: You see the master bedroom.

rooms.Name: Under Water
rooms.Description:
Beneath the clear blue water of the pool are many small lights.  The
give off a beautiful glow the illuminates the whole pool.  You look around
and see your Love floating beside you.

rooms.Name: Webbed Entrance
rooms.Description:
Sticky, sticky, sticky! The ground is cluttered with leaves, decayed remains
of webbed crickets, beetle, rats, dogs (?), and even humans. You begin to
wonder about what lies ahead. The air is damp here, and even the little light
that shines through the canopy seems absorbed into the webbing.

rooms.Name: Webby Passage
rooms.Description:
You find that footing here is very good, almost too good. The limbs are
coated with cobwebs and seem unusually strong for tree branches. Paths lead in
four directions. The eastward path goes down a bit.

rooms.Name: Wasp Hive
rooms.Description:
Drones scuttle about in this room. The cells on the walls are honeycomb in
shape and many of the maggots and wasps you see have fang-marks on their
bodies. You sense some order in their markings.

rooms.Name: Webby Passage
rooms.Description:
Another webby passage, all sticky and wet. Tiny ballooning spiders fill the
air. It seems that these young ones are newborns.

rooms.Name: Beneath the Busy Path
rooms.Description:
You hear the sounds of crawling arachnids above. The rhythms of the
footsteps suggest a primitive order in there movement. The light seems brighter
upwards.

rooms.Name: On the Busy Path
rooms.Description:
Spiders, spiders, everywhere! It is almost ant-like in efficiency with one
big difference. The spiders here are carrying ant-corpses, as well as rats,
wolves, and humans.

rooms.Name: On the Busy Path
rooms.Description:
Spiders, spiders, everywhere! It is almost ant-like in efficiency with one
big difference. The spiders here are carrying ant-corpses, as well as cats,
wolves, and humans.

rooms.Name: On the Busy Path
rooms.Description:
Spiders, spiders, everywhere! It is almost ant-like in efficiency with one
big difference. The spiders here are carrying ant-corpses, as well as cats,
dogs, and humans.

rooms.Name: A Split in the Path
rooms.Description:
As always, there is a split in the road. One road is strewn with cricket
feelers. The other is well-kept and suitable for smooth traveling. The webbing
that was prevalent in earlier rooms is almost non-existent now.

rooms.Name: Fuzzy Tree Limb
rooms.Description:
You are on a "fuzzy" tree limb. Interesting, since the branches seem to have
"hairs" sprouting from its bark. As you look closer you see millions of aphids
covering each limb.

rooms.Name: Tree Trunk
rooms.Description:
You feel that you can rest here safely. There is evidence of webbing here,
but it is of a finer quality.

rooms.Name: Tree Lair Entrance
rooms.Description:
It seems the inhabitant of this place does not web her victims, as evidenced
by the remains before you. The area is cluttered with desiccated corpses,
apparently bitten but unwebbed, and drained of their life juices.

rooms.Name: Wolf Spider Lair
rooms.Description:
Very dark, as all lairs of spiders are. Not much of furnishings save an
exit. The wolf spider keeps no corpses here, but rather throws them out at her
leisure.

rooms.Name: The Webless Path
rooms.Description:
Strange. No webbing here. In fact, no sounds whatsoever. The path continues
northward, where you find that you may have to tightrope your way across a
ravine.

rooms.Name: Above the Ravine
rooms.Description:
Stranger still. Your feet get a real firm grip on the spiderline. You are
above a deep ravine. This line connects you between two trees. Below you can
see a prismatic web with lots of animal bones caught in it: some bear and small
deer bones in fact. No human skeletons are visible (yet).

rooms.Name: The Rainbow Web
rooms.Description:
This is the rainbow web--each strand, each link, a hue of violently sharp
colors and contrasts. The resident here seems to have a command of light as
well.

rooms.Name: The Web Forest
rooms.Description:
The trees here take on a different appearance--they are not trees anymore,
but disjointed make-shift silken made shafts, sticky to the touch, and webby in
texture. This is another world it would appear.

rooms.Name: The Slave Pit
rooms.Description:
You have entered the slave pit. A voice blares in the distance, "Get back to
work, maggots!" Rails upon rails of mined gold and silver clutter the trail
beneath you.

rooms.Name: The Tether Path
rooms.Description:
Another tether path just like the rest of them. Surprising well -lit by the
golden orbs that hang from the sides, you can see the paths become finer and
finer in quality.

rooms.Name: A Road Crossing
rooms.Description: Another shifty little strand of webs, almost ethereal in nature.

rooms.Name: A Leader Strand
rooms.Description:
This strand is weightier, more sturdy. It shimmers as you step on it. You
are definitely not in the Midgaardian realms anymore. Just where you are you
can't tell. It feels like you're moving through ether. You can still get back
down to more surer lands.

rooms.Name: The Entrance of the Ethereal Web
rooms.Description:
You are at the entrance to ethereal web. Flickering in and out, in and out,
each strand reveals a different hue from black to green to blue.

rooms.Name: The Young Wormkin's Crib
rooms.Description:
A playpen of sorts, with maggots of wasps and other baby vermin lying about.
You feel that humans have been played with here too, and eaten later. You sense
that the maker of this place has an appetite for dragon meat, and uses this
room as a breeding area.

rooms.Name: The Base of the Web
rooms.Description:
Large strands connect at this point. The node shimmers and flickers within
the ether. You see many flying creatures-- insects, pegasi, and dragon
wormkins--navigate the dangerous passages of the web. Exits go in many
directions.

rooms.Name: Through the Trees
rooms.Description:
This part of the web intersects through the branches of some trees. Various
leaves and other debris that the many drones have not picked up yet lie here.

rooms.Name: Above the Clouds
rooms.Description:
You can see all of Midgaard in this ethereal web. Many of the larger dragons
that do wish to fly seem to fly away from the sticky strands of the web.

rooms.Name: On A Cloud
rooms.Description:
Rather thick in consistency. You realize this is not a typical cloud, but it
might be the nest of an aerial creature.

rooms.Name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
rooms.Description:
This is another link in the ethereal web. Various creatures seem to get
caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands.

rooms.Name: The Tenuous Strand
rooms.Description:
Very windy here since it goes up into the sky somewhat. Still, it's safe
enough to move around.

rooms.Name: The Elder Wormkin's Room
rooms.Description:
A more mature wormkin it seems resides here. Various tomes of arcane lore
clutter the area, along with shards of armor and weaponry.

rooms.Name: Another Tree Limb
rooms.Description:
Once again the web crosses another tree limb. To the side you see the
possible entrance to another creatures lair.

rooms.Name: The Bird Spider's Lair
rooms.Description:
This is a big game hunter among most spiders. Crush jewels and other weapons
suggest the inhabitant must have powerful jaws. Beware!

rooms.Name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
rooms.Description:
This is another link in the ethereal web. Various creatures seem to get
caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands.

rooms.Name: The Quiet Tree Top
rooms.Description:
Here is a quiet tree top. Downwards you can see a familiar path that may
lead back to Midgaard.

rooms.Name: On The Web
rooms.Description:
RRRRRRRRRRROOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAAAAARR! You hear the roar of a powerful
beast. Dragon, you think. You shiver in your boots as you tiptoe on this
section of the web.

rooms.Name: The Ki-Rin Chamber
rooms.Description:
A wise ki-rin was entrapped here many years ago. It is from her that the
ruler of this realm zaps his magical strength.

rooms.Name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
rooms.Description:
This is another link in the ethereal web. Various creatures seem to get
caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands. To the north you sense the heavy
breathing of a fiery animal.

rooms.Name: Yevaud's Lair
rooms.Description:
Yevaud, the Usurper of Midgaard, resides here. A voice cries out, "BEWARE,
the Usurper of Midgaard lives here! FLEE while you can!" But even Yevaud has
his master... or so you deduce.

rooms.Name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
rooms.Description:
This is another link in the ethereal web. Various creatures seem to get
caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands. A single spider line lies to the
north, while ghastly sightings are due south. The grim entrance of Arachnos'
Lair is downward.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Donjonkeep
rooms.Description:
A dark path at the end of the web strand, you see ahead a torch lit chamber
where the souls of unavenged adventurers come and gnash their teeth. The howls
and screams of many echo through the hall ways. You see one definite path
ahead.

rooms.Name: The Guardian's Room
rooms.Description:
A chair sits here for a tireless guardian who ensures that no soul escapes.
The room is undecorated.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: An ordinary chair, well used, glued to the ground by spiderweb.

rooms.Name: Realm of the Hopeless
rooms.Description:
Here you see many misguided souls who think they still live. They search for
those who killed them without warrant, and seek the free souls of living beings
to inhabit and perhaps adventure once more.

rooms.Name: Realm of the Hopeless
rooms.Description:
Here you see many misguided souls who think they still live. They search for
those who killed them without warrant, and seek the free souls of living beings
to inhabit and perhaps adventure once more.

rooms.Name: The Donjonkeep
rooms.Description:
No souls have ever lived in this place. The wails of slaves and the howls of
wolves are the only way you can describe the sounds you hear. The walls are
thin and wispy. The only light you receive is the shimmering from the strand of
the ethereal web you used to get here.

rooms.Name: The Single Spider Line
rooms.Description:
A single spider line supports you once more. As you look across the ether
you seen a single shack up ahead with a light in the window. You sense a great
evil coming from the north and feel inclined to go back on the ethereal web and
take your chances there.

rooms.Name: The Single Spider Line
rooms.Description:
A single spider line supports you once more. The shack comes closer into
view and you are even more inclined to go back now.

rooms.Name: The Hermit's Corner
rooms.Description:
Here you see evidence of a vagrant's abode. The shack is to the north, if
you dare enter it. You get the sneaking feeling you should go back now. The
skies above you darken and roar with the laughter of thunder.

rooms.Name: Mahatma's Inescapable Trap
rooms.Description:
Mahatma, that silly thief, is here, and he steals everything you have. He
says, "Here, have a quick trip to the Temple of Midgaard." He plugs a black
dagger into your back...

rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Arachnos' Lair
rooms.Description:
All strands inevitably lead here, the center of the web, the entrance to
Arachnos' Lair.

rooms.Name: The Sticky Chamber
rooms.Description:
You can still bail out since your knees are shaking from the anticipation
(or is it fear?). The sky is clear on this strand of web, surprisingly
unsticky. The strand does not vibrate like the others. A few ballooning spiders
pass by, cackling "You're gonna die, you're gonna fry. Good bye!"

rooms.Name: The Great Door
rooms.Description:
Before you, you see a large, web-like door. Various designs of ancient runes
and names of Midgaard heroes are etched into the webwork. Perhaps lists of
victims? You can't tell.

rooms.Name: The Lair of Arachnos
rooms.Description:
This is the lair of the Empress Spider, Arachnos. A lavishly adorned rainbow
web, her lair allows her to move to any universe she wishes by using her
magical strands to the Prime Material Plane. Coffers upon coffers of gold,
magical jewels and gems await. Unfortunately Arachnos is a baggy spider too,
and webs all her treasures to her beautiful silken body.

rooms.Name: In the High Grass
rooms.Description:
You are standing in high grass that reaches up to your knees and
dances gracefully in the gentle breeze. This green plain would nicely
camouflage you and make you almost invisible to your foes until they 
practically stepped on you. The plain stretches further on to the south 
and to your east lies a small dark cave.

Exits.Description: To your east lies a small dark cave.
You see a single large oak tree standing in the distance.

rooms.Name: The Cave of Kyre Banorg
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small dark cave and, with skeletons piled up 
in each corner, the stench of death seems to be everywhere. What 
horrible, vile creature could be responsible for this massacre? 
Several astronomical drawings cover the east wall of the cave, glowing 
with a soft blue light. The glow from the drawings gives the cave 
an eerie atmosphere.

Exits.Description: The east wall of the cave is covered with astronomical drawings.
To your west lies the entrance to this cave.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The design of the drawing looks very familiar to you. Several circles
placed inside each other form some kind of elaborate symbol. You
remember reading in an ancient book of wizardry a long time ago. You
remember that this symbol calls upon the ultimate power in the
universe, and is call the "Ultimate Magic Circle of Warding". Only the
gods are able to manipulate this magical power.

rooms.Name: Along the River bank
rooms.Description:
A river flows east and south from here. You could either 
follow the river eastwards along the bank or go on the river 
and let the gentle currents carry you south. Dense vegetation 
covers the river bank and the ground beneath your feet feels 
soft making it awkward to move around. A steep rocky wall to 
your west looks impossible to climb.

Exits.Description: The river gently flows south.
The river bank continues south.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
Quietly, the river runs from north to south. On the east side
of the river there is a dense forest and on the west, dense 
vegetation grows. The water is clean and pure, but looking 
downwards, you are unable to see the river bed. Who knows what
kind of creature lurks down there?

Exits.Description: A dense forest covers the east river bank.
The river gently flows south.
Dense vegetation covers the west river bank.
It is too dark down there to make out anything.

rooms.Name: In the Heavy Woods
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a dense forest composed mainly of oak trees.
Lots of leaves have fallen from the trees and lie all over the forest 
floor, although enough remain on the trees to hide a stealthy assailant.
These oak trees are not really very large, but further to the east you 
can make out some truly ancient ones. Through the branches to the west 
you can make out a river, winding its way southwards.

Exits.Description: You can make out some ancient trees to the east.
The river gently continues south.
The river gently flows south.

rooms.Name: In the Heavy Woods
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a dense forest composed mainly of oak trees.
Lots of leaves have fallen from the trees and lie all over the forest 
floor, although enough remain on the trees to hide a stealthy assailant.
The forest continues further to the south and west.

Exits.Description: You can only make out more trees to the south.
You can only make out more trees to the west.
You could hide up in that large oak tree.

rooms.Name: In the High Grass
rooms.Description:
You are standing in high grass that reaches up to your knees and
dances gracefully in the gentle breeze. This green plain would nicely 
camouflage you and make you almost invisible to your foes until they 
practically stepped on you. The plain stretches further in every 
direction, and to the south you can see a large oak tree.

Exits.Description: The vast green plain stretches on further to the north.
The vast green plain stretches on further to the east.
A lonely oak tree stands south of you.

rooms.Name: In the High Grass
rooms.Description:
You are standing in high grass that reaches up to your knees and
dances gracefully in the gentle breeze. This green plain would nicely 
camouflage you and make you almost invisible to your foes until they 
practically stepped on you. The plain stretches further to the west, 
and to the east you can see thick vegetation. The way north is 
blocked by a steep rocky outcrop and further to the south is a small 
hill.

Exits.Description: You see dense vegetation covering a river bank.
A small hill rises south of you.
The vast green plain stretches on further to the west.

rooms.Name: Along the River Bank
rooms.Description:
You stop alongside a wide river just to the east, which flows from 
north to south. You can either follow the river or take the plunge and 
swim eastwards, letting the currents take you south. Dense vegetation 
covers both river banks and the ground beneath your feet feels soft 
making it hard to move about. A vast green plain of grass lies to your 
west while to the south a small hill peers down at you.

Exits.Description: The river bank continues north.
The river takes a sharp turn to the east.
A small hill rises south of you.
A vast green plain of grass lies to your west.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
The river takes a sharp turn to the east here following around the 
base of a small hill. Dense vegetation covers the west back of the 
river, and on the eastern side you can see a dark forest. Although 
the water is clean and pure, you cannot see very far downwards - who 
knows what might lurk in the depths?

Exits.Description: The river arrives from the north and takes a sharp turn east.
The river continues east around the hill.
A small hill rises south of you.
Dense vegetation covers the west river bank.
It is too dark down there to make out anything.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
The river resumes its course south alongside the small hill. East 
of the river is a dark forest, and the west bank is covered by thick 
vegetation. Although the river water is clean and pure, you cannot 
see very far downwards - who knows what might lurk in the depths?

Exits.Description: A dark forest grows on the river bank.
A dark forest grows on the river bank.
The river gently flows south.
The river arrives from the west and continues south.
It is to dark down there to make out anything.

rooms.Name: In the Heavy Woods
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a dense forest, composed mainly of oak trees. 
The ground beneath your feet is covered by a thick layer of fallen 
leaves, although there are many still on the trees. Although these 
trees are probably too weak to take your weight, there are some 
sturdier looking trees further to the north. To the west, a wide 
river flows south.

Exits.Description: You can make out some ancient trees to the north.
The forest continues south.
The river gently flows south.
You notice a small trapdoor hidden under some leaves.

rooms.Name: A Lonely Oak
rooms.Description:
You are standing in high grass, which reaches as high as your 
knees, dancing gracefully in the gentle breeze. This green plain 
would nicely camouflage you and make you almost invisible to your 
foes until they practically stepped on you. The grassy plain 
continues to the north and south, and a small hill lies to the 
east. A big old oak tree stands here completely isolated, and 
would definitely make a nice hiding place for you.

Exits.Description: The vast green plain stretches on further to the north.
A small hill rises east of you.
The vast green plain stretches on further to the south.
You could hide up in that large oak tree.

rooms.Name: Northwest Side of the Hill
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the northwest side of a small hill. You can 
either climb the hill or walk around it to the east or south. A 
big solitary oak tree stands just west of here, and a wide grassy 
plain spreads out to the north.

Exits.Description: A vast green plain of grass lies to your north.
The hill continues east.
The hill continues south.
A big solitary oak tree stands just west of here.
You see the top of the hill.

rooms.Name: North Side of the Hill
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the north side of a small hill. You can 
either climb the hill or walk around it to the east or west. A 
little further to the northeast you can see a river flowing gentle 
southwards, and beyond the river is a dark forest.

Exits.Description: Dense vegetation covers the west river bank.
The hill continues east, looks muddy over there.
The hill continues west.
You see the top of the hill.

rooms.Name: Northeast Side of the Hill
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the northeast side of a small hill. You can 
either climb the hill or walk around it to the south or west. A 
river flows from the north, around this hill making the ground 
beneath your feel very muddy. Be careful not to fall into the river!

Exits.Description: The river makes a hard turn east just before the hill.
The river gently flows south.
The hill continues south.
The hill continues west.
You see the top of the hill.

Exits.Description: To the north you can see a big oak tree, standing alone.
A small hill rises east of you.
The vast green plain stretches on further to the south.

rooms.Name: West Side of the Hill
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the west side of a small hill. You can either 
walk up the hill or around it to the north and south. To the east is 
a wide grassy plain.

Exits.Description: The hill continues north.
A large flat stone slab lies south on the hill side.
A vast green plain of grass lies to your west.
You see the top of the hill.

rooms.Name: East Side of the Hill
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the east side of a small hill. You can either 
walk up the hill or walk around it to the north or south. To the east
a river runs, making this bank slippery with mud. If you are not 
careful you might slip into the river.

Exits.Description: The hill continues north.
The river gently flows south.
The hill continues west.
You see the top of the hill.

Exits.Description: To your north lies a dense forest.
The vast green plain stretches on further to the south.

Exits.Description: The vast green plain stretches on further to the north.
A hill rises to your east.
The vast green plain stretches on further to the south.

rooms.Name: Southwest Side of the Hill
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the southwest side of a small hill, you can
climb the hill, or try going around it to the north or east. An vast 
grassy plain stretches in every direction. A large flat stone slab 
lies on the floor here.

Exits.Description: The hill continues north.
The hill continues east.
A vast green plain of grass lies to your south.
A vast green plain of grass lies to your west.
You see the top of the hill.

A large big flat stone slab lies here on the floor, it seems like it 
has been moved recently.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large big flat stone slab lies here on the floor, it seems like it    
has been moved recently.

rooms.Name: South Side of the Hill
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the south side of a small hill, you can
climb the hill or walk around it to the east or west. A vast grassy
plain stretches in every direction as far as the eye can see.

Exits.Description: The hill continues east, looks muddy over there.
A vast green plain of grass lies to your south.
The hill continues west.
You see the top of the hill.

rooms.Name: Southeast Side of the Hill
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the southeast side of a small hill, you can
climb the hill or walk around it to the north or west. A vast grassy
plain lies to your south and to your east is a river. The river has
made this side of the hill muddy and very slippery.

Exits.Description: The hill continues north.
The river gently flows south.
A bridge over the river lies southeast from here.
The hill continues west.
You see the top of the hill.

dances gracefully in the gentle breeze. This green plain would camouflage 
you nicely and make you almost invisible to your foes until they 
practically stepped on you. The plain stretches further to the west

Exits.Description: A hill rises north of you.
A bridge over the river lies just east from you.
The vast green plain stretches on further to the west.

rooms.Name: A Bridge over the River
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a bridge that crosses the river. As you lean over 
the side of the bridge and look into the water you are struck by how 
clean and pure the water is. However, the water becomes dark and you are 
unable to see any further than a couple of feet into the depths. The 
bridge supports plunge into the water below you, making a good hiding 
place. On both sides of the bridge a wide grassy plain stretches as far as 
the eye can see.

Exits.Description: Gently the river flows from north to south.
A vast green plain of grass lies to your east.
A vast green plain of grass lies to your west.

rooms.Name: In the High Grass
rooms.Description:
You are standing in high grass that reaches up to your knees and
dances gracefully in the gentle breeze. This green plain would camouflage 
you nicely and make you almost invisible to your foes until they 
practically stepped on you. The plain stretches further to the north
and to the west a bridge spans the river.

Exits.Description: The vast green plain stretches on further to the north.
A bridge over the river lies just west from you.

rooms.Name: Up in a Large Oak Tree
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a sturdy oak branch, with red and brown leaves
tumbling to the ground as you shuffle about. You can see a river a little
further on to the west meandering from north to south. On the far side
of the river you can see a small hill.

Exits.Description: If you could get that damn branch out of your face you might see something.

rooms.Name: Up in a Large Oak Tree
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a sturdy oak branch, with red and brown leaves
tumbling to the ground as you shuffle about. There is a small hill 
just to the east, and to the north you notice a little cave.

Exits.Description: If you could get that damn branch out of your face you might see something.

rooms.Name: The Top of the Hill
rooms.Description:
As you reach the top of the hill you stop and look around you. Your
eyes wander across the landscape, searching out you foes. You notice
a small cave lying just to the north and looking further eastwards 
a river flows from north to south. As your eyes follow the river south, 
you see a bridge, and on the far side a dense forest. To the west, a
large oak tree stands isolated on a vast green plain.

Exits.Description: You notice a small cave lying just to the north.

You see a river gently flowing from north to south, on the far side is
dense forest.
A bridge over the river lies a little further southeast from the hill.
You only see a large oak tree standing isolated.

rooms.Name: In the River
rooms.Description:
You are diving underwater in the river. Long green weeds reach up
from the river bed hiding you from anyone who might be looking for
you in the water.

Exits.Description: Weed, weed, weed, everywhere you look weed.
It's hard to make out anything above the water.

rooms.Name: Inside a Small Tunnel
rooms.Description:
You are crouched inside a cramped dusty tunnel. Dirt rains down from
ceiling as you crawl slowly forward. Roots growing down from above wrap
themselves around your limbs, and get into your eyes. Although low, the 
tunnel is wide enough for two people to pass each other. A small 
trapdoor above your head leads out of the tunnel.

Exits.Description: The tunnel disappears into the darkness.

A small trapdoor that leads out of this tunnel is situated just above

rooms.Name: The Nexus
rooms.Description:
You are standing at a crossroads in time and space. Visions of 
vast green plains, dense forests and a river running alongside a small 
hill fill your mind. You feel as if you exist everywhere at the same
time.

Exits.Description:
As you look north the possibilities of the Nexus rise in your mind you
can travel to vast green plains or a river that runs alongside a small
hill or choose to travel to an ancient oak forrest, that is if you can
control the Nexus.

As you look east the possibilities of the Nexus rise in your mind you
can travel to vast green plains or a river that runs alongside a small
hill or choose to travel to an ancient oak forrest, that is if you can
control the Nexus.

As you look south the possibilities of the Nexus rise in your mind you
can travel to vast green plains or a river that runs alongside a small
hill or choose to travel to an ancient oak forrest, that is if you can
control the Nexus.

As you look west the possibilities of the Nexus rise in your mind you
can travel to vast green plains or a river that runs alongside a small
hill or choose to travel to an ancient oak forrest, that is if you can
control the Nexus.

As you look up the possibilities of the Nexus rise in your mind you
can travel to vast green plains or a river that runs alongside a small
hill or choose to travel to an ancient oak forrest, that is if you can
control the Nexus.

As you look down the possibilities of the Nexus rise in your mind you
can travel to vast green plains or a river that runs alongside a small
hill or choose to travel to an ancient oak forrest, that is if you can
control the Nexus.

rooms.Name: A Dimly Lit Path
rooms.Description:
This path is narrow, REAL narrow.  You draw the conclusion that it
wasn't man-made, or made for man for that matter.  The path continues
north to a village.

Exits.Description: The path continues toward a village.

rooms.Name: A Dimly Lit Path
rooms.Description:
This section of the road is badly worn and frequently traversed.
There is some noise coming from the north.  The road back to the forest
lies to the south.

Exits.Description: The path continues toward the village.
The dimly lit path continues south.

rooms.Name: A Dimly Lit Path
rooms.Description:
This section of the road is badly worn and frequently traversed.  The
noise is getting stronger to the north.  The road back to the forest
lies to the south.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to Hobbit Village.
You see a dimly lit path.

rooms.Name: The Entrance to Hobbit Village
rooms.Description:
You stand at the entrance to a small hobbit village.  You have heard
stories about these little creatures, but you had no idea they really
existed.  You wonder how many people have seen this village before, and
returned to tell about it.  Now go on... explore.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.
You see a dimly lit path.

rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
rooms.Description:
A small narrow road here twists through the village.  Hobbit Road
continues to the north, west, and east.  There is still time to turn
back and head south.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road stretches to the north.
Hobbit Road winds of to the east.
You can make out the entrance to Hobbit Village.
Hobbit Road veers off  to the west.

rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
rooms.Description:
You continue to stroll down Hobbit Road.  The smell of richly scented
smoke assails your senses as you pass house after immaculate house.
This place is not that bad when you think of it, clean, friendly, and
comfortable.  Perhaps that is why nobody ever seems to leave here...
Hobbit Road continues its path to the north, west, and south.   A small
hobbit home lies to the east.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the north.
Hobbit Road continues to the east.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.
Hobbit Road continues to the west.

rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
rooms.Description:
You stroll along down Hobbit Road.  It continues north and south
here.  To the west you can see a small hobbit home.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the north.
You see the tobacco garden.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.
You see a Hobbit Home.

rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
rooms.Description:
The straightforward little Hobbit Road continues in its leisurely
north-south direction. A tobacco garden is to the east.  A stone path
leads west.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the north.
You see the tobacco garden.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.
A stone path lies to the west.

rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
rooms.Description:
A small hospitable well sits neatly by the side of the road, waiting
for you to bring up a bucket of fresh cold well water.  A small garden
is to the east. Hobbit Road continues to the south and west, and a road
leads north towards some purple mountains.  The hobbits have had many
adventures with the dwarves and gnomes who live in the highlands north
of here.

Exits.Description:
A long cart track headed north carries produce from the farms north of
here and marvelous weapons from the steel mill.
You see the tobacco garden.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.
Hobbit Road continues to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small well is here.  Just the right size if you're a hobbit, but just
barely big enough for you to get some water from.  I'm sure no-one would
mind.
It looks high.

rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
rooms.Description:
A corner of Hobbit Road is where you stand.  A high fence blocks
passage to the east or south.  A hobbit home is to the north.  Hobbit
Road goes back to the west.

Exits.Description: You see a Hobbit Home.
Hobbit Road continues to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks high.

rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
rooms.Description:
You are at a bend of Hobbit Road.  You can continue down the road to
the east and north.  You can also visit a hobbit home to the south.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the north.
Hobbit Road continues to the east.
You see a Hobbit Home.

rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
rooms.Description:
You are on Hobbit Road.  A hobbit home is to the west.  Took's
backyard is to the north, but you can't go there.  Hobbit Road continues
to the south and east.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the east.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.
You see a Hobbit Home.

rooms.Name: Stone Path
rooms.Description:
You are walking along a cute little stone path.  To the south lies
Tooks house.  A small house is to the west.  Hobbit Road is to the
east.  Everything is so peaceful here.  You could stay forever.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the east.
You see Tooks House.
You see a Hobbit House.

rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
rooms.Description:
Yet another part of Hobbit Road.  To the west is the last section of
Hobbit Road.  You can go back to the small well to the east.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the east.
Hobbit Road continues to the west.

rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
rooms.Description:
The last part of Hobbit Road.  You can go back the Hobbit Road to the
east.  A nice, beautiful, hobbit home is to the south.  In the distance
to the north you can see the Hobbit Mayor's office.

Exits.Description: You see the path to Mayor's office.
Hobbit Road continues to the east.
You see a Hobbit Home.

rooms.Name: The Tobacco Garden
rooms.Description:
The greatest tobacco in the world is growing here.  If only you were
a smoker... Hobbit Road is back to the west.  Another part of the garden
is to the north.

Exits.Description: The tobacco garden continues to the north.
Hobbit Road continues to the west.

rooms.Name: The Tobacco Garden
rooms.Description:
Another part of the garden.  Small tobacco-leafs is growing here.
The smell is driving your nostrils crazy.  It almost makes you forget
that you don't smoke.  Hobbit Road is to the west, while the garden are
to the north and south.

Exits.Description: The tobacco garden continues to the north.
The tobacco garden continues to the south.
You see Hobbit Road.

rooms.Name: Tobacco Garden
rooms.Description:
The northern part of the tobacco garden.  It smells just as good as
all the rest. Hobbit Road is to the west.  The tobacco garden lies to
the south.

Exits.Description: The tobacco garden continues to the south.
You see Hobbit Road.

rooms.Name: Bilbo's Home
rooms.Description:
This is the home of the famous Bilbo.  You see a desk all covered
with books, but you can't understand a word in them!  Maybe it is
written in Hobbitish.  Hobbit Road is back to the south.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

rooms.Name: Frodo's Home
rooms.Description:
This home looks nice and cozy.  A small sofa is standing in a corner
and the room is covered in papers and books.  Frodo must be a hobbit who
likes to read.  Hobbit Road is back to the west.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

rooms.Name: Merry's Hole
rooms.Description:
This home belongs to Merry.  A hobbit who has shared many adventures
with Frodo.  He is a tough hobbit and if he can carry the sword that is
nailed to the wall, he must be quite strong.  Better not make him angry
with you!  Hobbit Road is back to the north.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

rooms.Name: Sam's Home
rooms.Description:
The home of Sam and Rosa.  The house is all clean and shiny.  Rosa
and Sam must like to have things clean in case they have visitors.
Maybe you should stay a while.  This place is nice.  Hobbit Road to the
east.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

rooms.Name: Pippin's Home
rooms.Description:
The home of Pippin.  A tough hobbit who has been on many adventures.
You have heard rumors about this guy.  People say he is a mean and
strong hobbit, just like his cousin Merry.  Maybe you should leave
before he find you here.  Hobbit Road to the east may be your only
salvation.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

rooms.Name: Bogo's Hole
rooms.Description:
Bogo, the laughing stock of the hobbit village lives here.  This
place is all dirty and dusty.  Maybe Bogo is here somewhere, but you are
not sure.  Anyway, you don't really like the smell of this place.
Hobbit Road is to the north.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

rooms.Name: Took's House
rooms.Description:
Took's home.  The home of Took.  You have heard stories about this
guy.  The other hobbits say he is big and strong and some people say he
knows his way around magic.  You can see a desk here, all covered with
papers.  There seems to be some magic words written on the papers, but
you can't understand them.  A stone  path lies to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a stone path.

rooms.Name: Path to Hobbit Mayor's Office
rooms.Description:
You are walking along a path to the Mayor's office to the North.
Hobbit Road lies to the south.

Exits.Description: Outside the Hobbit Mayor's office.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.

rooms.Name: Outside the Hobbit Mayor's Office
rooms.Description:
You are standing outside the Mayor's office.  You can hear him
screaming at his employees inside from the road.  His office is to the
north, while Hobbit Road is to the south.

Exits.Description: You see the Hobbit Mayor's office.
You see the path to Hobbit Mayor's office.

rooms.Name: The Hobbit Mayor's Office
rooms.Description:
This is the office of the Hobbit Mayor.  You can see a huge desk
where he usually sits and look busy.  The office is quite large with
nice paintings on the walls.  The desk is all covered with papers.

Exits.Description: Outside the Hobbit Mayor's office.

rooms.Name: Rosa's Home
rooms.Description:
This is Rosa's home still, since she and Sam aren't legally wedded
yet. However if she is not here, she is most likely at Sam's.  The only
exit is to the east.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

rooms.Name: Beginning of the Dirt Path
rooms.Description:
You have wandered onto a narrow dirt path. It appears to be a safe and
passable trail. The path continues to the north.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

rooms.Name: A Bend in the Dirt Path
rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. The trail makes a ninety degree turn, with
exits leading to the south and west.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. You sense small animals darting about in the
trees and tall grass surrounding the trail. Exits lead to the east and west.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. To the north you see a small hollow in the
forest. To the south you see a small cave entrance. The dirt path continues to
the east and west.

Exits.Description: A small hollow appears here.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
You see a small cave entrance.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

rooms.Name: Entrance to a Small Cave
rooms.Description:
You climb through a small opening in the rock formation to enter the cave.
You can see the exit which is to the north. However, the light from the cave
entrance is small and you can't see beyond the entrance of the cave. The cave
continues to the south.

Exits.Description: Through the cave entrance you can see the dirt path.
It is to dark to see.

rooms.Name: A Bear's Den
rooms.Description:
You have found the home of a large Cave Bear. He may not be to pleased that
you have entered uninvited. If you are very quiet, he may not hear you. Exits
lead to the north and west.

Exits.Description: The entrance to the cave lies in this direction.
It is to dark to see.

rooms.Name: A Bat's Lair
rooms.Description:
You have gone deeper into the cave. Though you may not see anything
on the ground here, you may want to check above your head. There is an
exit to the east.

Exits.Description: It is to dark to see.

rooms.Name: Entrance to Rabbit Hollow
rooms.Description:
Off the dirt path you have come upon a rabbit hollow. The rabbit's
tend to stay away from the entrance since many travelers often pass
by on the dirt path.

Exits.Description: The rabbit hollow is there.
You can see the dirt path from here.

rooms.Name: Rabbit Hollow
rooms.Description:
You have entered the Rabbit Hollow. Here you can see rabbits darting
here and there. Many of the Rabbits are coming and going from the east.
To the south, you can make out the dirt path which lies beyond the
entrance to the Hollow.

Exits.Description: You can see a small hole in the hollow.
You can see the entrance to the Rabbit Hollow.

rooms.Name: A small hole in the hollow
rooms.Description:
As you wander deeper into the hollow, you have come upon a small hole. You
imagine that the rabbit's use this as there home. The hole looks just big
enough for you to fit through.

Exits.Description: You can see the Rabbit Hollow where many rabbits frolic and play.
Below you, you see a hole in the ground.

rooms.Name: The Rabbit Hole
rooms.Description:
You are now underground. Above you can see opening that leads back up to the
rabbit hollow. To the north there is a small wooden door. A tunnel to the east
leads deeper into the hole.

Exits.Description: You can see a doorway to the north.
You can see a tunnel leading to the east.
Through the hole you can see the rabbit hollow.

rooms.Name: Rabbit storage room
rooms.Description:
You have entered the storage room of the rabbits. However, the rabbits tend
to eat there food more quickly than they can store it. If you are lucky, you
might just find some carrots lying around on the floor.

Exits.Description: You can see a doorway to the south.

rooms.Name: Deeper in the rabbit hole
rooms.Description:
You are deeper in the rabbit hole now. The only exit from here is to
go back to the west.

Exits.Description: You can see a higher in the rabbit hole.

rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. You feel very safe on the path. As you glance
around, you tremble as you think about what lies off the beaten path. Exits
lead to the east and west.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. It is a very calm and peaceful walk. Exits
lead to the east and west.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
You can see the intersection of two paths ahead.

rooms.Name: Intersection of the Dirt Paths
rooms.Description:
You have come upon a crossing of two dirt paths. Paths lead off to the
north, east, and west. To the south, you can see an entrance to a wooded area.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
You see the entrance to the Bird Sanctuary.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Bird Sanctuary
rooms.Description:
You have entered the bird sanctuary. Here you can see several different
types of birds all in one small area. You can wander through, just make sure
that you keep you eyes open for those bird bombs.

Exits.Description: You can see an intersection of two dirt paths.
You can see the bird sanctuary to the south.

rooms.Name: The Bird Sanctuary
rooms.Description:
This area is heavily wooded so that it will attract many different types of
birds. You hear many different bird calls as you enter. There are thousands of
birds who call this sanctuary home, but you will be lucky to see just a few.

Exits.Description: You can see the entrance to the bird sanctuary.
You can see a thickly wooded area.
You can see a thickly wooded area.

rooms.Name: The Bird Sanctuary
rooms.Description:
This area is heavily wooded so that it will attract many different types of
birds. You hear many different bird calls as you enter. There are thousands of
birds who call this sanctuary home, but you will be lucky to see just a few.

Exits.Description: You can see a thickly wooded area.
You can see a thickly wooded area.

rooms.Name: The Bird Sanctuary
rooms.Description:
This area is heavily wooded so that it will attract many different types of
birds. You hear many different bird calls as you enter. There are thousands of
birds who call this sanctuary home, but you will be lucky to see just a few.

Exits.Description: You can see a thickly wooded area.
You can see a thickly wooded area.

rooms.Name: The Bird Sanctuary
rooms.Description:
This area is heavily wooded so that it will attract many different types of
birds. You hear many different bird calls as you enter. There are thousands of
birds who call this sanctuary home, but you will be lucky to see just a few.

Exits.Description: You can see a thickly wooded area.
You can see a thickly wooded area.

rooms.Name: The Bird Sanctuary
rooms.Description:
This area is heavily wooded so that it will attract many different types of
birds. You hear many different bird calls as you enter. There are thousands of
birds who call this sanctuary home, but you will be lucky to see just a few.

Exits.Description: You can see a thickly wooded area.
You can see a thickly wooded area.
