You are in a musty, dark jail cell. Wet and dirty straw covers the 
floor. The walls glisten with slime. You see something stir in the 
straw.

Exits.Description: You see a dark and nasty room.

rooms.Name: Small Mine Shaft
rooms.Description:
You are in a small extension of the mine shaft. The dust on the 
floor is undisturbed by footprints.

Exits.Description: You see a small mine shaft.
You see the shaft.

rooms.Name: Hobgoblin Barracks
rooms.Description:
You are suddenly surrounded by a small army of hobgoblin guards. The 
room itself is a mess with clothes and armor everywhere. The beds are 
unmade and stained.

Exits.Description: You see a large room.
You see the mess hall.
You see the mine shaft.

rooms.Name: Hobgoblin Barracks
rooms.Description:
Yech! As you continue forward, the smell just keeps getting worse. 
What are you DOING here?

Exits.Description: You see a large room.

rooms.Name: Mess Hall
rooms.Description:
You stand in the hobgoblin eating area. There are a few rotting 
tables and many broken dishes scattered around the room. You almost 
slip on a rotten piece of meat, but catch yourself just in time.

Exits.Description: You see a small room.
You see a kitchen.
You see a large room.

rooms.Name: A Store Room
rooms.Description:
You stand in a small room filled with flour, grain, fruit, and bat
droppings.

Exits.Description: You see the mess hall.

rooms.Name: The Kitchen
rooms.Description:
This kitchen hasn't been cleaned since the creation of humans. The 
trash and spoiled food lying on the floor reach up to your knees. Off 
to the side a pot is boiling over. A human hand floats in it.

Exits.Description: You see the mess hall.

rooms.Name: A Small Mine Shaft
rooms.Description:
You come to a place in the mine shaft where a tunnel leads down. The 
small passage continues north and south.

Exits.Description: You see an almost caved in area.
You see a small mine shaft.
You see a hole.

rooms.Name: Hermit's Lair
rooms.Description:
You are in a small section where the mine wall has collapsed to 
reveal a tiny one-room cave. The area is barely lit, but you can 
make out something moving towards you.

Exits.Description: You see a small mine shaft.

rooms.Name: A Hole
rooms.Description: You are in a hole.

Exits.Description: You see a small mine shaft.

rooms.Name: #wThe Academy Archives#N
rooms.Description:
In the vast basement of the Academy of the Midnight Sun huge amounts 
of just about everything is stored. The Academy goes by the rule that 
anything that is not being used at the moment and seems to be the least 
bit useful is to be archived. After all, somebody might need it for their 
studies sometime in the distant future.

rooms.Name: #wBy the Tower#N
rooms.Description:
You see before you a majestic palace of gold, surrounded by rolling 
hills, deep valleys, wooded forests, and deep blue lakes. Not long ago, 
this was the home of the rulers of this world, their companions and 
servants, and their favourites among the mortals.
However, something looks different. The palace is not what it used to be.
There is an all new atmosphere around the place, an atmosphere of wisdom 
and knowledge that you have never felt here before. This used to be a 
quiet place, but now students and lectors are walking around, holding 
intellectual or philosophical discussions. You come to realise that the 
palace has been rebuilt completely, and that it now looks rather small 
compared to the huge tower to the west of it. A huge oak gate leads into 
the tower. There is an inscription on it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Academy of #bT#Ch#we #bM#Ci#wdnig#Ch#bt S#Cu#wn#N.

rooms.Name: #wThe Entrance Room#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter the Academy of the Midnight Sun, an air of freedom
surrounds you, and you feel that you are in the presence of intellectual
atmosphere. At the same time, you get a feeling of peace and tranquility.
Right ahead of you is a small gallery.
#GThere is a sign on the wall.#W

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Welcome to Academy of #bT#Ch#we #bM#Ci#wdnig#Ch#bt S#Cu#wn#N!

                       Some useful directions:

A.  Regen room    (#wMarble Foyer#W)         #wne#W      from here.
B.  Clan board    (#wLibrary#W)              #wnus#W     from here.
C.  Shopkeeper    (#wLounge#W)               #wnn#W      from here.
D.  Donation room (#wThe Academy Archives#W) #wned#W     from here.

         This place from #rtemple#W             #wwnw#W.

rooms.Name: #wThe Gallery#N
rooms.Description:
The walls in this room are covered with paintings of ancient 
philosophers and scientists, as well as contemporary ones. There are also 
a number of busts, of which you recognise some as portraying famous 
champions of peace and equality. In the far end of the room, there is a 
spiral staircase leading up, on the right wall is a door with a sign 
reading "To the Museum" on it and straight ahead you see something that 
reminds you of a tavern, only more calm.

rooms.Name: #wThe Lounge#N
rooms.Description:
During their free time, students at the Academy often come here to 
relax and have a drink or a meal. You could have thought this was a 
tavern, but it isn't quite rowdy enough, and smells much, much too good. 
In the far right of the room is a counter and on the wall behind it you 
see a menu. There are a number of windows and a door on the left wall, 
leading out to the exercising grounds of the Academy.

rooms.Name: #wThe Exercising Grounds#N
rooms.Description:
To this small, enclosed field on the west side of the Academy tower
students often come to bide their time with jousting and fencing or to
practice spellcasting or martial arts. In a roofed area by the tower you 
see a large collection of swords, rapiers, sabres and other odd weapons. 
They all seem to be surrounded by a faint glow. There is a small stable 
next to it.

rooms.Name: #wThe Marble Foyer#N
rooms.Description:
Paintings, chandelliers, marble stairways, murals - nothing can fully
describe the wealth that is on display here. For some reason, it seems a
little quiet today - perhaps everyone is out adventuring.
#GThere is a sign on the wall.#N

Exits.Description: door

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ELITE Palace Museum of The Academy of the Midnight Sun

Welcome to the Palace Museum. In here, we have preserved a part of the 
palace that used to be situated here, so that students at the Academy may 
see what this place used to look like before the Academy was built.
In each room there is a sign describing the past use of that room. Enjoy 
your visit.

The Marble Foyer used to be the majestic entrance to the whole palace, 
and was also the place where its inhabitants took a rest after 
adventuring. As you can see, the sofas, armchairs and divans are still 
here and can still be used.
Feel free to try them out.
The stairs next to this sign lead down to the Academy Archives, which 
have been installed below the old palace.

rooms.Name: #wSpinner's Relaxation Room#N
rooms.Description:
There are a lots of shelfs filled with ancient books, CDs and some odd

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the room of Spinner, one of the former members of the ELITE clan. 
He is now a student here at the Academy, and the superintendent of this 
museum.  This sign has been concealed for the sake of Spinner's privacy, 
so please do not ask us to make it more conspicuous.

rooms.Name: #wThe Throne Room#N
rooms.Description:
Could it be? Yes, this throne is cut out of a single, flawless, 
solitary diamond. A regal red carpet leads up to it, and you kneel down 
out of respect, as the sheer power of the clan eminates before you. 
Thousands upon thousands of gems litter the room, and the sparkle of them 
illuminates the room in an almost surreal manner. It is no wonder that 
only the creme de la creme can be found here, as this is truly elite!
#GThe ELITE clan bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.#N
#GThere is a sign on the wall.#N

Message 2 : #YFri Jan 15#W #c(Cardinal)   #W:: #wIdea of Code for AMS clan#W

                       MORTAL CODE OF ETHICS

I.     Be fair.  This doesn't just mean to try to act fair.  It also 
       means avoiding situations in which your impartiality can be 
       compromised.  These situations can include posting on board cases 
       where clan members, friends, signifigant others or enemies are 
       concerned.  If this means waiting until another non-involved 
       mortal arrives, so be it.

       A.  Fairness is more important than justice.
       B.  If you are personally involved in a rules dispute, odds are 
           you can't be fair.  Get another mortal to adjudicate it.
       C.  Your mortal is a tool to be used to help the mud, not a bonus
           to help your immortals or the immortals of others.  This means
           you should avoid situations where your mortal gives you an 
           edge in politics. Dont cheat - it helps some useless immortals 
           to look as useful. If you found a bug, try to report it to 
           115+, but not to your clannie/RL friend imm.
           If you are online, resist the urge to log on a immortal when
           you see someone stole kill from you.

II.    Listen.  Don't assume things about immortals, and don't act like 
       they all are stupid.  If they are talking to us, they may be have 
       something important to say.

III.   Understand.  Remember, a lot of things on a mud can make people
       angry.  Try to understand why a immortal feels the way he does.
       Put yourself in their shoes, and only if he knows what he acts
       unfair, post case on mortal board.

IV.   Be considerate.  Having an mortal gives you a lot of clout in
      discussions.  Use it, don't abuse it.  Always remember that you
      are an mortal and represent Elite, even when you are playing
      a immortal.

      A.  A special note on consideration.  Remember, many of our users
          speak english as their second language.  Be very courteous when
          dealing with these people, and try your best to understand what
          they are saying.  Sometimes this will mean asking another 
          player to help.

      B.  While there is nothing wrong with playing low level chars,
          try to play main character when actually criticizing immortals.
          If you have reason to hide, consider why;  you may have a 
          conflict of interest (such as the immortal hates you) and in 
          this case, it is better if you ask another mortal to help.

V.    Use common sense.  Don't get angry when dealing with immortals.  It
      only makes it worse.  If they are angry, let them blow off some
      steam first.  If you are angry, stop dealing with them problem and
      let someone else take care of it.  If people are unable to agree,
      never underestimate the value of compromise -- even if one person
      is wrong.

VI.   Don't make a mistake because you're afraid to ask questions.  If 
      you don't know what to do, ask another experienced player to help 
      you.  Also, if you need to make a ruling, be sure to gather the 
      facts before reporting or posting.  It's more important to answer 
      the questions of "why" and "how" than the question of "who" and 
      "what", and all your rulings should have a basis in fact, and not 
      rhetoric or bias.

VII.  The experienced players in here are a team.  The best way for us to
      work is through constructive work and constructive criticism.
      If we have problems, they should be solved among the mortals --
      including the immortals in our conflicts will only make them worse.

VIII. EliteMUD is a hobby for all of us, just as it is a hobby for the
      immortals.  All your actions should be guided by this concept;
      for us is not a job, it is a game.

rooms.Name: #w[ELITE]'s Immroom#N
rooms.Description:
This is the room for [ELITE]'s immortal members. You can often catch 
them in here shooting the breeze, playing poker, and making fun of 
whoever happens to be in jail at the time.
#GThere is a sign on the wall.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This used to be the meeting place of the divine members of the ELITE 
clan. In this room, many an odd thing have taken place.
Research is currently being conducted at the Academy on the subject of 
what the gods of ELITE actually did, and what this room was really for.

rooms.Name: #wThe Assembly Hall#N
rooms.Description:
This is the large assembly hell of the Academy, where all the students
and staff gather for ceremonies, informational meetings and voting
sessions. The hall is very large - 300 persons would have no problem
finding space in here. In the middle of each wall is a small door.

rooms.Name: #wThe Library#N
rooms.Description:
If you did not know about the archives of the Academy, located below
ground level, you would probably think that this must be the greatest
collection of books in all of Midgaard. The walls are all lined with
shelves, and the room itself divided into narrow corridors by bookcases.
You get the feeling that this room holds more wisdom than anyone can ever
grasp in a lifetime.

rooms.Name: #wThe Realm of Chaos#N
rooms.Description:
You open the door and enter the room, thinking it's the study of 
Araga, one of the Deans here at the Academy. You soon realize you must be 
mistaken. What you see you can describe best with one word: chaos. The 
room's floor is approximately ten centimeters above that of the library 
outside it, due to the scrolls and parchments covering it in a number of 
layers. The table in the far end of the room is cluttered with books in 
piles that reach to the ceiling. You can barely make out the small bed 
underneath the huge piles of clothes and books. In at least twenty 
different places in the room you can also see plates with half-eaten 
meals on them. You dare not think of how many more can be found 
underneath the "floor". You recall a vague memory of Araga keeping a 
collection of rare mousetraps in this room, understand that your life may 
be at risk, and leave very, very quickly.

rooms.Name: #wAMS Special Laboratory#N
rooms.Description:
You imagine the best palace you can even see and in same second
you see it here. Then you imagine cold and horror of City of
Sitebanned and suddenly realize it is around you... Your illusions
are stronger, than you, and next time you see Room of Hades, your
sucky 1 HP and letters REBOOT appeared on wall... or Quest EQ store
where you happened to pop after lucky crash...
And you just understand that all your thoughts and feelings were logged
for further statistical processing. You just feel self not a personality,
but only as long structured sequence of zeros and ones which affects 
other sequences...
... which are processing in big computer, placed in this room. After 
short look at it you realize that it used some magical features. Computer 
is connected with some portals, like one which you used to enter in this 
room. Big oak table in center of room is filled by printouts with 
statistical information. Sign of #wxGRD#W on the south wall finally 
explains you where you are... and why. Its not place where anyone can be 
without reason.

Exits.Description: Those who live by feelings, can use this portal to reach happiness...
door
door
door
door

rooms.Name: #wThe Shadowy Room of Deathlord#N
rooms.Description:
The room doesn't look as shadowy as the name might imply...maybe 
that's because there's nobody living here yet. The room is completely 
empty, except for the flower by the window and the chandelier in the 
ceiling. On the inside of the door is a sign reading "Deathlord"

rooms.Name: #wThe Drawing-Room#N
rooms.Description:
In the small drawing-room outside the Council room chairs have been 
placed along all walls, except the north one, in the center of which is a 
large, moderately ornamented oak door leading to said room. On both sides 
of the door are paintings of the Academy building and, on the floor, 
large wooden chests.  You cannot make up your mind as to whether the 
chests are actually used for storing something, or if they are just 
ornamental.

rooms.Name: #wThe Council Room#N
rooms.Description:
The room is dominated by a long table, along which the members of the 
two councils of the Academy gather for their meetings. The table is lined 
with chairs, and the walls with small cabinets at regular intervals. 
Large maps of near and distant lands cover the walls, and in the ceiling 
is a beautiful fresco depicting the world. In the center hangs a large - 
but not too fancy - chandelier.

rooms.Name: #wThe Theoretical Faculty#N
rooms.Description:
The three institutions of the Theoretical Faculty use this room for 
storing their documents in and for having a faculty meeting every now and 
then. The room looks very well organized. There seems to be a place for 
everything and nothing seems to be anywhere else than where it is 
supposed to be. It does give the room a slightly cold look. On the south 
wall is a large chart describing the organizational structure of the 
Academy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Hierarchical structure of the Academy of the Midnight Sun
 
                         AD
                        / \
                       HC LC
                        \ /
                         |---AB
                         |
                -------------------
                |        |        |
                TF      GRD       PF
                |                 |
            ---------         ---------
            |   |   |         |   |   |
            C   I   SD        QS  MS  A

rooms.Name: #wThe Practical Faculty#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter the room you realize that the people working in here must 
be incredibly active. Even though the room is empty right now, you are 
certain that there is somebody in here almost continuously. You remember 
the stories of how the PF people can stay up three days in succession 
without showing any sign of fatigue. Your eye suddenly catches a glimpse 
of a flask inside a half-open cupboard. It has a label reading "Magic, 
Energy Potion". Ah...so that's how they do it...

rooms.Name: #wThe Institution of Global Research and Development#N
rooms.Description:
Being the largest institution of the Academy, the GRD has a meeting 
room of its own. It is, however, not only a meeting room. There are a 
large number of bookcases and cupboards along the walls, filled with 
books, scrolls and strange-looking items. There is a big table in the 
middle of the room, covered with strange plans and drawings.

rooms.Name: #wA corridor at the top of the Tower#N
rooms.Description:
You walk through a rather narrow corridor at the top floor of the 
Academy building. There is a door on each side. The one to the west has a 
sign reading "Eagle", and the one to the east one reading "Frki". The 
corridor continues to the north. There is a stairway leading down.

rooms.Name: #wA corridor at the top of the Tower#N
rooms.Description:
You walk through a rather narrow corridor at the top floor of the 
Academy building. There is a door on each side. The one to the west has a 
sign reading "Miklja", and the one to the east one reading "Pavel". The 
corridor continues to the north and to the south.

rooms.Name: #wA corridor at the top of the Tower#N
rooms.Description:
You walk through a rather narrow corridor at the top floor of the
Academy building. There is a door on each side. The one to the west has a
sign reading "Sprite", and the one to the east one reading "Tin". The
corridor continues to the north and to the south.

rooms.Name: #wEagle's Nest#N
rooms.Description:
High up in the tower eagles are flying in and out through a big 
window. They soar over near and distant lands, gathering information. 
Some of them are resting in a large nest on a shelf, others flying around 
discussing what they have learned. Some are also cleaning up after the 
party their master had the night and morning before.
In one end of the room is a big bed made out of feathers. In the other
you see a big desk, on which is a huge pile of notes and books. A big 
eagle is trying to get som order on the desk.

rooms.Name: #wFrki's Sanitarium#N
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the middle of a large room. The room is very, very
bright. The brightness makes you feel like you're in some kind of a
dream.  Everywhere around you, you can see strange creatures looking at
you. It all seems like some kind of strange world. Everyone seems to be
very strange here.  Right in front of you, you see some soldiers aiming
at you. They are the "Disposable heroes".  On your left, you see a
strange clown dancing all over the place. Is he crazy? He appears
to be living in his own world of fun. He is the "Leper Messiah". He is
holding the "Battery" in his hand which produces a very strange
light.  In the middle of the room you see a large man sitting on his
throne. He is the "Master of Puppets". As he sees you he greets you with
an evil "Welcome home" and says "Damage Inc.". Everywhere around there 
are servants protecting him. Above them there is a large golden "Orion".
This place makes you very uncomfortable. Maybe you should leave? Maybe
you are "The Thing that should not be"?!

rooms.Name: #wMiklja's Torture Chamber#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter a portal you find yourself in a dark and horrible room. 
Around you you can see nothing but blood and corpses. You can't 
understand what a room like this is doing in a place like this, but then 
you remember that Miklja is a member of the Institution of Military 
Studies. This must be his lab. Suddenly you hear a scream and start for 
the door, but as you're trying to escape, Miklja appears in front of you. 
You fall on your knees and start praying for your life...

rooms.Name: #wPavel's Universe#N
rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a strange observatory. There are thousands of 
volumes of books and maps around the wall. A telescope stands in the 
middle of the room, bringing closer far away worlds. You can see two 
interesting pictures: one is of the Midnight Sun and the other of the 
total Solar eclipse. There is something else in the corner ... it looks 
like a football. ... or is it just an illusion? As you look up to the 
sky, through the open roof, you are blinded by the thousands of shining 
stars. On the south part of the sky a modestly bright comet shots through 
right before your very eyes.

rooms.Name: #wAn unfurnished study#N
rooms.Description:
This room is completely empty, except for the flower by the window and 
the chandelier in the ceiling. You guess that somebody is meant to be 
moving in here soon.

rooms.Name: #wTin's Place of Worship#N
rooms.Description:
As you take your first step into this seemingly small room, you are
teleported to a large meadow. You stand in a circle made of large tall 
stones, called obelisks. In the centre is a small cauldron, now empty and 
cold. It looks deep, and worn out by constant uses. You can also notice 
some inscriptions on the obelisks.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
In this cauldron Tin makes all his potions and enchants his weapons. It 
used to be black, but now it looks like a combination of green, red and 
black, and it also emmits a faint smell. Smells like a yummy soup...
The only thing you can make out is the word: JUKKA.

rooms.Name: #wA corridor at the top of the Tower#N
rooms.Description:
You walk through a rather narrow corridor at the top floor of the
Academy building. There is a door on each side, as well as one to the
north. The door to the west has a sign reading "Araga", the one to the
east one reading "Deathlord". Door to the north have no sign, except
for Academy symbol on it.
The corridor continues to the south.

rooms.Name: #wTrophy Room#N
rooms.Description:
The first thing that catches your eye when you enter here is the
vast assortment of decapitated heads stuffed and mounted on the
walls.  Upon closer inspection, you see those heads belong to those
unfortunate souls who have played the parts of Harold, King Welmar,
Froboz, the Holy Avatar, Satan, and the Astrologer. This is
definitely not the room to be caught in without an escort, or your
own head may end up there as well.
#GThere is a sign on the wall.#W

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the room where members of Elite used to place their trophies. A 
trophy could be anything from the corpse of a mighty foe to a piece of 
equipment that is not powerful enough to warrant its being placed in the 
Donation Room, but too valuable to simply be thrown away. As the world 
constantly changes, some is not powerful enough to warrant its being 
placed in the Donation Room, but too valuable to simply be thrown away. 
As the world constantly changes, some of those items are today both very 
rare and very valuable.
Today, this room is where students and staff of the Academy place items 
which currently are more or less worthless, but that they believe might 
gain such value as described above in the future and therefore should be 
placed in the museum.

rooms.Name: #wExplorer's Doom (Shrine of Sandra)#N
rooms.Description:
You see here some strange creature... she looks in your eyes...
you are #Rhappy#W... you are so #rhappy#W... you are extremelly #whappy...
#WPANIC! You cannot escape!...
You are dead!

You are standing on the shore of the beach. You see the big waves rolling

You are standing on the shore of the beach. Some kids have built the King's

You are standing on the shore of the beach. As you look to the horizon to

rooms.Description:
You are standing on the wooden path to the pier. All around you kids are

rooms.Description:
You are at Captain Kidd's Beach Shop. Stacks of stranded goods lies here on

rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. The water is dark and greenish blue so you
can't see the ground here. You hear the faint sound of the waves breaking 
against the beach to the north.

Exits.Description: You see Na-Palm beach to the north.
You see the horizon to the south.

rooms.Name: On the high seas
rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. The water looks so beautiful, glistening and
ever-changing, so dark and yet so transparent. A strong wind is blowing from
the south, filled with salt water. To the north you see barely see the Na-Palm
beach.

Exits.Description: You can barely see the Na-Palm beach to the north.

rooms.Name: On the high seas
rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. The dark water swirls around your boat and
tosses it like a leaf in the wind. To the north you see a faint outline of a
coastline.

Exits.Description: You see a coastline to the north.

rooms.Name: On the sandy path
rooms.Description: You are on a sandy path that leads to Na-Palm beach to the south.

rooms.Name: On the sandy path
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a sandy path that leads down to the sunny Na-Palm beach.
To the north you see the road that leads to Midgaard, the capital of this land.

rooms.Name: On the road through the plains
rooms.Description:
You are on a road through the plains. To the west and east of here young
saplings grows in small groups. To the north the road can take you to the city
of Midgaard. The road turns into a small sandy path to the south.

rooms.Name: On the road through the plains
rooms.Description:
You are on a road through the green plains south of Midgaard. All around you
the grass looks healthy and so green you almost think its artificial. The road
continues to the south.

rooms.Name: On a bend on the road
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a road through the green, nice plains. To the north you
see a big black rock. It is quite out of place from the otherwise so friendly
and peaceful atmosphere. The road bends to the west from here.

rooms.Name: On the road through the plains
rooms.Description:
You are on the green plains south of Midgaard. The road bends to the east
here and far to the north you see the citywalls of Midgaard. Out of the 
corner of your eye you notice an ancient marker stone hidden in the 
undergrowth.

Exits.Description: A narrow overgrown trail leads west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You brush aside the bushes, and look at the marker. Its weathered 
surface indicate that it is very old, and the writing upon it is worn 
and difficult to read. An arrow points west, and above is the name 
'Delray'. Odd, the City of Delray disappeared centuries ago, presumed 
destroyed in a magical accident.

rooms.Name: On the road through the plains
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a road through the plains. To the east you see a black
rock, eroded by the strong wind from the south. To the north you see the
citywalls of Midgaard and to the northeast is the graveyard.

rooms.Name: On the road through the plains
rooms.Description:
You are on a road through the plains just south of Midgaard. To the east you
see the west fence of the haunted graveyard. You see the white citywall to the
north.

rooms.Name: City Entrance
rooms.Description:
You stand on the outskirts of a large city - Midgaard; the capital of this  
land. To the north you see the big gate in the white city wall. To the east
you see the west fence of the haunted graveyard. To the south you see the 
southern plains of this continent.

rooms.Name: Outside the South Gate of Midgaard
rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city wall and
connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate. To the south the
plains stretch out in the distance.

Exits.Description: You see the city gate.
You see the plains to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Both of the towers are built from large grey rocks that have been fastened to 
each other with some kind of mortar, just like the city wall.

It is built from large grey rocks that have been fastened to each other with
some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have been
reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.  One of the
doors is equipped with a very big lock.

rooms.Name: Inside the South Gate of Midgaard
rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city wall and
connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate. To the north you see
the Emerald Avenue.

Exits.Description: You see Emerald Avenue to the north.
You see the gate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have been
reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.  One of the
doors is equipped with a very big lock.

rooms.Name: Overgrown trail
rooms.Description:
You can barely make out the overgrown trail beneath your feet. 
Occasional stones poke up through the ground, their shape indicating 
that this was once a paved highway. It takes you a while to work out 
that the trail turns here.

rooms.Name: A turn in the trail
rooms.Description:
Spurts of dust kick up behind your feet as you shuffle your way 
through the dusty undergrowth. The road twists again here, you can go 
south or west.

rooms.Name: The Old Well
rooms.Description:
The well doesn't look that unused as you thought it should be. In 
fact it looks like it has been used every day. You see rungs leading 
down into the darkness below. The main farm house lies to the north 
and to the west you see a large wild grown field.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look closer you see that some of the rungs have been replaced 
with new ones.

rooms.Name: Down in the well
rooms.Description:
This is a dark and slippery place, filled with maggots and rotten 
smells. The ladder is rusty, and you wonder if the rung will really 
hold you and all that equipment you insist on having with you.

Exits.Description: You see the light of the sky up there.
The ladder leads further down into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Further down in the well
rooms.Description:
The rotten smells are almost intolerable down here. The brick walls 
here is very old and whole sections have fallen down into the dark 
water far below you.

Exits.Description: You see a small dot up there that you think is the sky over EliteMud.

The ladder leads further down into the darkness, but the rung is VERY 
rusty and will probably fall apart if you try them.

There is a hole here that your probably can squeeze you through, if you 
take away some stones.

rooms.Name: Small room
rooms.Description:
This room is quite small, and the stone bricks on the walls are 
marked with erosion. A small stone door is on the west wall, with 
ancient symbols carved into it. There is a hole in the east wall 
that you probably can squeeze you through.

rooms.Name: Entrance room
rooms.Description:
The ancient stonewalls are covered here by black tapestries with 
strange symbols on them. The room extends further to the north and a 
black painted door leads to the west. A small stone door is on the east 
wall.

Exits.Description: The room extends further to the north.
The black door is on this wall, between two black tapestries.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tapestries are very ancient, and now as you look at them, the 
symbols must actually be letters in an unknown language.

rooms.Name: Dark corridor
rooms.Description:
This corridor is filled up to your knees with a gray, thick, slow 
moving smoke. The walls here are completely black with strange symbols 
painted in purple.

Exits.Description: There is a door on this wall.

rooms.Name: Dark corridor
rooms.Description:
This corridor is filled up to your knees with a gray, thick, slow 
moving smoke. The walls here are completely black with strange symbols 
painted in purple.

rooms.Name: Dark corridor
rooms.Description:
The corridor is filled up to your waist with a gray, thick, slow 
moving smoke, making your feet impossible to spot. The corridor opens 
up into a room to the west.

Exits.Description: The room to the west is even more filled with the gray smoke.

rooms.Name: Smoke filled room
rooms.Description:
The room is almost completely filled with the thick smoke. The smoke 
seems to flow through the room in a very strange way. It's almost as if 
you can see the smoke turn into cloaked figures, moving in a ancient 
dance of death.

rooms.Name: Smoke filled room
rooms.Description:
The room is almost completely filled with the thick, gray smoke. Here 
the smoke is almost at rest, only moving by the sudden movements of your 
body.

Exits.Description: The smoke seems to be less thick to the west.

rooms.Name: Smoke filled room
rooms.Description:
The room is almost completely filled with the thick, gray smoke. The 
smoke is moving through this room in a very strange way. It's almost as 
if you can see the smoke turn into cloaked figures, moving in an ancient 
dance of death.

rooms.Name: Smoke filled room
rooms.Description:
The room is almost completely filled with the thick, slow moving 
smoke. The smoke seems to flow around you and grapple your body in a 
most disturbing way.

rooms.Name: Smoke filled room
rooms.Description:
This part of the room IS completely filled with the gray smoke, 
making breathing almost impossible. You wonder if this smoke is 
poisonous to inhale.

Exits.Description: The smoke seems to be less thick to the south.

rooms.Name: Dark corridor
rooms.Description:
The corridor is filled up to your waist with the gray smoke. To the 
east you see a room filled with this strange smoke. The corridor bends 
to the south here.

Exits.Description: The room seems to be completely filled with smoke.

rooms.Name: Dark corridor
rooms.Description:
At last you leave the smoke behind you as you enter this part of the
corridor. The corridor leads into the darkness to the north, and to the 
east into a narrower part of the corridor. To the south there is an 
old oak door.

Exits.Description: Smoke slowly moves towards you from the north.
The corridor stretches further to the east.
Yes, there is definitely a door to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The door must be very old because it fits exactly into the door frame.

rooms.Name: The dining room
rooms.Description:
You have entered a quite big room with rows of tables and chairs. On 
the walls hangs black tapestries of assassins killing king Welmar. The 
air is filled with an aroma of lobsters and sweet wine. Who makes this 
good and expensive food for the foul assassins?

Exits.Description:
The room to the west must be the kitchen. You hear the well-known noises 
of someone making a nice dinner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its certainly King Welmar on one of the tapestries, but he looks much 
younger on it, and quite dead too with a knife in his back.

rooms.Name: The Kitchen
rooms.Description:
The kitchen is filled with tools needed for making food. A big 
cauldron with lobster soup stands here over a small fire. You suddenly 
think back to the loaves of bread you always eat when hungry and wonder 
if the soup is as good as it smells. To the east is the eating area and 
to the west is a small door, probably to the food storage.

Exits.Description: The door to the west is small and very fragile.
The door is very very fragile and would probably break if you bash it.

and the walls is made of packed earth. The 
room is filled with sacks and barrels with food and wine. With all this 
food this organization will not be starving for years. The only exit is 
through the door to the east.

rooms.Name: Dimly lit corridor
rooms.Description:
The corridor's only light source is a small flickering torch on the 
south wall. The bricks here are painted black making this a quite scary 
place. The corridor continues to the west and the east. A black door 
with a small sign is to the north.

Exits.Description: The black door has a sign on it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: There is a sign on the black door.

The sign says:


           THE TRAINING ROOM

rooms.Name: The assassins training room
rooms.Description:
You have entered a big room with gray walls a big nice carpet of 
Arabian quality. A huge amount of wicked weapons hangs on the walls, 
some of them you recognize, others are very strange and old. Three 
dummies stand near the north wall, looking somewhat smashed. The only 
exit is through the door to the south.

Exits.Description: The door leads out to the corridor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The assassins must be fond of cutting these dummies throats because it 
looks like they have been repaired there several times.

The weapons looks extremely deadly. Wonder if the assassins train with 
razor-sharp weapons?

rooms.Name: Dimly lit corridor
rooms.Description:
This part of the corridor is completely silent. You see small 
puddles of fresh blood on the floor. Someone must have been killed here 
recently. The corridor continues to the east and west, and there is a 
door on the north wall with a small sign.

Exits.Description: There is a door on the north wall, made of oak.
You see that the corridor continues to the east.
The corridor continues to the west.

You see that the blood comes from a small trapdoor in the ceiling. 
Suddenly a blood drop lands on your shoulder. Yuck!

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The door is made of oak, and there is a sign on it.

The sign says:

              MEDITATION CHAMBER

The trapdoor is small and fits well into the ceiling. You are very 
lucky that you even saw it.

rooms.Name: Meditation chamber
rooms.Description:
The air in this room is filled with a soft, narcotic aroma that makes 
your head spin. On small tables by the walls stands hundreds of small 
candles which provides a eerie feeling over the place. On the floor is 
a big black carpet with strange golden symbols woven into it. The only 
exit is through the door to the south.

Exits.Description: You see a door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The carpet is very beautiful but too heavy for you to take with you.

rooms.Name: Secret room
rooms.Description:
These assassins must be maniacs! The floor is almost completely 
filled with fresh corpses, and you can't move an inch without steeping 
into a puddle of blood. Is this place a storage room for corpses?

Exits.Description: There is a trapdoor under all the corpses.

rooms.Name: Dimly lit corridor
rooms.Description:
You are at a bend of the corridor. It stretches further to the west 
and to the south. The smell of something sticky and poisonous catch 
your nose from the south corridor. There is a black painted door on the 
north wall.

Exits.Description: There is a door on the north wall.
There is strange smell coming from this corridor.
The corridor continues to the west.

rooms.Name: Barracks
rooms.Description:
This sparsely equipped room must be the assassins sleeping quarters. 
Rows of small and not so comfortable beds stand by the walls, there 
must be some 20 beds here. Why don't you count the beds and then see 
if you have killed the right number of baddies down here? (grin). The 
room extends further to the east, and there is a door to the south here.

Exits.Description: Someone must have a candle lit to the east.
Yes, there is a door there.

rooms.Name: The inner part of the barracks
rooms.Description:
These beds seems even more uncomfortable than the beds in the west 
part of the room. They are made of stone! On a small table by a bed is 
a lit candle. The only apparent exit is to the west.

Exits.Description: The room extends further to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The candle seems to have burned halfway and is firmly attached to the 
table.

rooms.Name: Smelly part of the corridor
rooms.Description:
There is a poisonous smell in the air here, mainly coming from the 
door to the east. There is a sign on the door too. You see the end of 
the corridor to the south and a bend of the corridor to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a bend in the corridor to the north.
There is a door to the east, with a sign on it.
You see three doors at the end of the corridor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign says:

   The hall of the Poisonlord.
    
          Keep out !!

rooms.Name: The hall of the Poisonlord
rooms.Description:
You have entered a great underground hall, probably a natural cave. 
Huge black tapestries cover the gray stone walls, with a very ugly and 
horrible face woven in gold on each of them. To the east you see a pool 
filled with a boiling liquid, the smell of acidic venom is almost 
intolerable in here.

Exits.Description: You the pool to the east.
The door leads out to the corridor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The eyes on the huge ugly faces seems to follow your every move.

rooms.Name: By the Pool
rooms.Description:
You stand by the 10 feet wide pool. Lethal fumes is emerging from the 
boiling surface of the liquid, making you cough.  On tables around the 
pool stands hundreds of small flasks and bottles with weird looking tags 
labels on each of them. A huge humanoid stands by the pool, wearing a 
black robe and a hood that puts its face in shadow. He radiates a 
feeling of complete corruption. Suddenly you realize that this is the 
guy on the tapestries to the west.

Exits.Description: You see the door at the end of the hall.
The pool doesn't look nice to jump into. Do you really wanna try that?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pool is filled with a green boiling liquid that must be poison. 
Bubbles with gray smoke is constantly emerging on the surface.

The stuff in the bottles seems to be ingredients to the liquid in the 
pool. Do not touch them, they must be poisonous too!

rooms.Name: By the end of the corridor
rooms.Description:
You stand at the end of the long corridor. The bricks on the walls 
are really old here, looking like they have been there for thousands of 
years. A steel door is on the east wall, and on the west wall there is 
a completely normal door. Silent screams can be heard from the door to 
the south.

Exits.Description: The corridor goes back to the north.
There is a heavy steel door to the east.
Horrible screams breaks the otherwise complete silence through the door.
The door is very normal.

rooms.Name: The Dungeons
rooms.Description:
This prison is simply constructed, its a square room with steel bars 
running parallel with the ceiling at 8 feet high. The bars must have 
been put there to hang the prisoners upside down through their achilles 
tendons. Hoards of maggots and rats run around on the dirty floor.

Exits.Description: You see the corridor through a small window in the door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The bars are very rusty and there is coagulated blood all over them.

rooms.Name: The torture chamber
rooms.Description:
This room is filled with clever tools to inflict pain into a 
creatures body and soul. Most of the stuff in here are so complex that 
it would take days for you to optimize the efficiency of them. You spot 
a iron maiden in one corner, probably out of use with all the other 
apparently effective tools here. You somehow feel the hopelessness of 
all the victims of these horrible experiment during the centuries past.

Exits.Description: The door leads out to the corridor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The steel tips in the iron maiden is very rusty. Wonder if that will 
help you a bit if you got trapped in it.

rooms.Name: Gontran's room
rooms.Description:
This rooms interior are very luxurious and very different to all the 
other rooms in this complex. The huge bed is made of dharian irontree, 
the furniture of Direwood and the carpet must be from Thalos. Small 
lanterns hangs in the ceiling making this room kind of a nice place. 
But the guy that lives here is probably not nice at all.

Exits.Description: The door leads out to the corridor.
There is a secret door behind the a tapestry.

rooms.Name: Secret room
rooms.Description:
This room is very small and the stone bricks in the walls are heavily 
eroded here. Small puddles of water is on the floor, probably the 
subsoil water that is leaking through the walls.

Exits.Description: The secret door leads to the Gontran's room.

rooms.Name: Entrance room
rooms.Description:
The black tapestries cover most of the walls here, with ancient 
symbols which seems to move around in small circles, although you know 
that they are well woven into the cloth. You spot a door to the west, 
and the room extends further to the south.

Exits.Description: You see the southern part of the room.
There is a door on the west wall.

rooms.Name: A dark corridor
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a dark corridor, very dirty and with spiderwebs 
in the upper corners of the walls. To the west you see a illuminated 
hall with several mirrors reflecting your image back to you. To the east 
there is a door.

Exits.Description: You see a door to the east.
To the west lies the Hall of Mirrors.

rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of

rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

rooms.Name: The Hall of Mirrors
rooms.Description:
You have entered a hall with thousands of mirrors. In the light of 
your light source you see thousands of images of yourself staring at 
you. The mirrors seems to make the proportions of the room very 
unrealistic and strange.

rooms.Name: A dark corridor
rooms.Description:
This corridor doesn't seem to have been used for ages. The dirt on 
the floor is almost ankle-deep and the spiderwebs are really big here. 
To the east you see the strange Hall of Mirrors, and to the west you 
see a well lit room.

Exits.Description: You see the Hall of Mirrors to the east.
You see a room to the west.

rooms.Name: Hall of the Statues
rooms.Description:
The entire room is filled with statues of cloaked figures. On the 
walls and in the ceiling the figures have been carved out with 
perfection from the bare rock. Several statues stands in the middle of 
the room. They look so natural that you almost think that they will 
start moving and stab you in the back! There is an exit to the east and 
one to the south.

Exits.Description: You see a corridor to the east leading to the Hall of Mirrors.
You see one more room to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The statues are carved out of the rock with excellent expertise. Maybe 
they are made by a dwarven artist, captured by the wicked assassins.

rooms.Name: Skull filled room
rooms.Description:
In the ceiling of this room hangs several complete sets of human 
bones, with rotten pieces of flesh hanging from them. In niches lies 
hundreds of humanoid skulls in rows, some half smashed, others very 
fine specimens that you could have on your table at home and recite 
Hamlet to. To the north lies the Hall of Statues and to the south you 
see the entrance to the temple.

Exits.Description: The Hall of Statues lies to the north from here.
The temple to the south seems very old and evil.

rooms.Name: The Temple
rooms.Description:
You have entered the organizations own temple, dedicated to unearthly 
powers of old. The bloodstained floor with ancient inscriptions and the 
presence of something horrible makes you think that you probably should 
leave right now.

Exits.Description: The exit from the temple is to the south.
You see the temple-altar far to the south.

rooms.Name: The eastern tapestries
rooms.Description:
You are standing by a row of stone pillars made of a green unearthly 
type of rock. On the east wall you see huge tapestries of hellish demons entering human bodies. The realistic pictures make your poor stomach 
scream. You sense a very evil presence all around you searching for the 
right moment to steal your soul here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at the tapestries, you suddenly notice a movement in the 
picture. Are the demons for real?

The evil presence is all around you, seeking for a weakness in your 
iron will.

rooms.Name: By a manmade mountain of coffins
rooms.Description:
By the south wall there is a pile of coffins, made for human-sized 
bodies. All of them seems to have been forced open. Are the assassins 
grave robbers too? The columns that supports the ceiling are shaped 
like robed figures, praying to the altar to the south-west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The coffins are all empty.

rooms.Name: By the Pentagram
rooms.Description:
You are standing by a big Pentagram painted in red on the floor. As 
you look at it, it seems to rotate in a strange way on the ground. In 
the center of the pentagram stands a small statue resembling a demon. 
The dark priests probably summons demons here, to wreak the world of 
nice guys like yourself. You sense a strong evil presence from the south.

Exits.Description: You see a mountain of coffins to the east.
You see the Temple Altar to the south.

rooms.Name: By the great fire
rooms.Description:
A big fireplace is here, providing light to the evil temple . As you 
look into the red flames, you think you see faces of people in fear, 
just as if they were trapped into the fire. You also see some pieces of 
bones in the ashes here.

Exits.Description: You see a Pentagram on the floor to the east.

rooms.Name: Dimly lit part of the temple
rooms.Description:
As you look around here, you notice that it's strangely dark. To the 
south you see a big fireplace, but somehow the light fails to get here. 
On the walls you see dark tapestries with strange symbols woven into 
them.

Exits.Description: You see a big fireplace to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You fail to recognize most of the symbols, but catches your eye: 
triangle with a watching eye in the center. Wonder what that means...

rooms.Name: The Temple Altar
rooms.Description:
The evil presence is building up to gigantic proportions around the 
black altar in front of you. The surface of the altar is stained with 
gallons of coagulated blood and pieces of rotten corpses. The only exit 
from this horrible place is to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a pentagram on the floor to the north.

rooms.Name: In the pool
rooms.Description:
As you step into the pool, the acid burns your flesh. You look in 
fear at your feet as they slowly disintegrates. Suddenly you lose the 
grip and fall into the poisonous pool. You scream in agony as the 
poison enters your body and the acidic ingredients eats you raw.


                       Sorry Dude, You Died!!!!
        All that is left of you is some teeth at the bottom of the pool.

rooms.Name: On the ladder
rooms.Description:
As you try the old rungs they suddenly break and falls into the 
darkness below. Unfortunately you are joining them..... 

 AAAAAAAAA
         AAAAAAAAAAA
                   AAAAAAAAAAAA 
                               AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA 
--------------------------------------------------------->DEAD!!!!!!!!!

rooms.Name: On an overgrown old road
rooms.Description:
You are standing on an overgrown old road. High grass and bushes make 
it very hard to see that it actually has been a road. As you move 
further on the road you see some buildings to the north. The buildings 
looks like they once have been a farm. To the west you can see the 
remnants of an old barn and to the north lies the main building, and 
just before it you see an old well. The overgrown road turns eastwards 
here.

rooms.Name: The Overgrown Road
rooms.Description:
The road quickly turns back towards the north and continues uphill 
towards the mountains. The vegetation here is sparse, and not 
particularly healthy, and dry grasses crunch beneath your feet as you 
walk.

rooms.Name: A Narrow Trail
rooms.Description:
The road climbs as you continue north, it becomes more and more 
difficult to make out the old overgrown road, until all that is left 
is a narrow trail through the foothills. You could rediscover the old 
road if you go south from here, but a short steep section of the trail 
appears to lead to a plateau, and might be worth investigating.

rooms.Name: A totally empty last room in the system
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a totally empty room with nothing in it and no 
where to go.

rooms.Name: Entrance to Gnome Village
rooms.Description:
You stand on a dusty path that leads east and west. To the east you 
hear the sounds of a small village.  A large forest stands to the north,
and to the south you see a large field.

rooms.Name: A Dusty Path
rooms.Description:
This is a path leading into the village. It continues east and west 
and there is a small gnome tavern to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a small house.
You see a road.
You see a path.

rooms.Name: A Small Square
rooms.Description:
This little square is the center of the gnome village. At the center
of the square you see a small fountain filled with water. Roads run 
north and south, an old dusty path leads out of the village to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a road.
You see a path.
You see a road.
You see a road.

rooms.Name: A Dusty Path
rooms.Description:
You are on a dusty path on the far side of the village. Houses are 
to the north and south, while the path continues east. There is a sign 
here.

Exits.Description: You see a house.
You see a path.
You see a house.
You see a road.

rooms.Name: A Road in the Village
rooms.Description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village. 
There are a few people moving around, but not many. To the west lies 
the gnome bakery.

Exits.Description: You see a road.
You see a house.
You see a road.
You see a house.

rooms.Name: A Road in the Village
rooms.Description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village. 
There are a few people moving around, but not many. To the west you 
see the gnome post office.

Exits.Description: You see a road.
You see a road.
You see the Post office.

rooms.Name: A Road in the Village
rooms.Description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village. 
There are a few people moving around, but not many. To the east you 
can see the gnome magic shop and to the west you can see the gnome 
general store.

Exits.Description: You see a road.
You see a shop
You see a road.
You see a shop.

rooms.Name: A Road in the Village
rooms.Description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village. 
There are a few people moving around, but not many. To the east you see 
the gnome armor shop and to the west you see the gnome weapon shop.

Exits.Description: You see a road.
You see a shop.
You see a small path.
You see a shop.

rooms.Name: A Small Gnome Tavern
rooms.Description:
This is a small gnome tavern the walls are made from quality wood. 
You can see the expert workmanship that went into making it, but it 
lacks creativity. Along the walls stand large tables filled with 
people eating and drinking. In the north-east corner you see the 
bartender washing some glasses. It is an old gnome not taller than 4 
feet.  Behind him stairs lead up to the private rooms on the second 
floor.

Exits.Description: You see a path.

The way up is solidly blocked by the bar gnome, who frowns to see you
staring at the stairs.

rooms.Name: The Bakery
rooms.Description:
You are standing inside the small bakery. A sweet scent of freshly
baked bread fills the room. The bread is arranged in fine order on the 
shelves, and seems to be of the best quality.

Exits.Description: You see a path.

rooms.Name: A Small Gnome House
rooms.Description:
This is a small suburban house made from quality wood. You 
can see the expert workmanship that went into making it, but it 
lacks creativity.

Exits.Description: You see a path.

rooms.Name: A Small Gnome House
rooms.Description:
This is a small suburban house made from quality wood. You 
can see the expert workmanship that went into making it, but it 
lacks creativity.

Exits.Description: You see a path.

rooms.Name: A Small Gnome House
rooms.Description:
This is a small suburban house made from quality wood. You 
can see the expert workmanship that went into making it, but it 
lacks creativity.

Exits.Description: You see a path.

rooms.Name: A Gnome General Store
rooms.Description:
You are in one of the several shops of this fine town. The wares 
look fine. Lots of odd stuff can be seen all around in the shop.

Exits.Description: You see a road.

rooms.Name: A Gnome Weapon Shop
rooms.Description:
You are in one of the several shops of this fine town. The wares 
look fine. Lots of odd weapons can be seen all around in the shop.

Exits.Description: You see a road.

rooms.Name: A Gnome Armor Shop
rooms.Description:
You are in one of the several shops of this fine town. The wares 
look fine. Lots of odd armors can be seen all around in the shop.

Exits.Description: You see a road.

rooms.Name: Path by a Stream
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading north and west that is surrounded 
on the other two sides by a small stream. The water looks mighty cold.

Exits.Description: You see a road.
You see the stream.
You see a small path.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The stream is pretty small, but it looks too cold to swim.

rooms.Name: Path by a Stream
rooms.Description:
You are on a small east-west path. The path shows new grass, as if 
nognome has walked on it recently. A river is to the south, and a small
hut is to the west.

Exits.Description: You see a small path.
You see the stream.
You see a small hut that is starting to fall apart.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The stream is pretty small, but it looks too cold to swim.
The hut looks well built, but it seems to have taken some damage.

rooms.Name: A Small Hut
rooms.Description:
The hut is a mess! Blood has stained the grass walls into a dark rich
crimson color. Torn clothes and trash lie all around, and you think you 
see a skeleton in the corner.

Exits.Description: You see a small path.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The skeleton still has a little flesh clinging to it and it is 
definitely humanoid.  The skull has been cracked open, but it is 
otherwise undamaged, except by time.

rooms.Name: On the Stream
rooms.Description:
The stream is cold and frigid, yet it supports plenty of life 
beneath its surface. The current trickles west and there is a 
field to the south.

Exits.Description: You see a small path.
You see a grassy field.
You see a small stream.

rooms.Name: On the Stream
rooms.Description:
The current here flows from the east, but a logjam blocks you from
continuing onward.

Exits.Description: You see a small path.
You see a small stream.
The pool created by the logjam has spread south.

rooms.Name: The Field of Mice Dreams
rooms.Description:
This is a large green field of waist high grass. You feel something 
scurry over your feet. There is a cave to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a small stream.
You see a dark mysterious cave.
The island is bounded by a cold stream to the south.

rooms.Name: The Dark Cave
rooms.Description:
The cave gleams as your light reflects off of it. As you squint your 
eyes and try to look ahead, you think you see something move.

Exits.Description: You see a grassy field.

rooms.Name: Darker Cave
rooms.Description:
The cave gets even darker as your terror grows stronger. You fear 
for your life as something emerges out of the shadows.

rooms.Name: A Dusty Path
rooms.Description:
You are on a well traveled path that leads in many directions. To 
the north is a large house, to the west is a fortress and to the east 
lies the fields of training.

Exits.Description: You see a large white house.
You see a large grass field.
You see a road.
You see the gateway to a large fortress.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The fortress is a large gnome stronghold to defend the city.

rooms.Name: The Iron Gateway
rooms.Description:
You stand at the entrance to the gnome fortress. The place seems to 
be well fortified.

Exits.Description: You see a small path.
You see a long hallway.

rooms.Name: A Long Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are now inside the fortress; you are lucky that the guards
haven't killed you. As you glance around, you notice that the walls and 
floors are spotlessly clean. The barracks are to the north and a 
storage room is to the south.

Exits.Description: You see the barracks.
You see the gateway.
You see a storage room.
You see a long hallway.

rooms.Name: A Long Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are now inside the fortress; you are lucky that the guards
haven't killed you. As you glance around, you notice that the walls 
and floors are spotlessly clean. A mess hall is to the south.

Exits.Description: You see a long hallway.
You see the mess hall.
You see a small room.

rooms.Name: The Barracks
rooms.Description:
You now stand in the sleeping quarters of the gnome guards. Every 
bed is made perfectly, and not a single article of clothing is on 
the floor. There is a small storage room to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a small storage room.
You see a long hallway.

rooms.Name: A Small Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This is where the gnomes store all their spare clothing and armor. 
There is not much here, but you might come up with something.

Exits.Description: You see the barracks.

rooms.Name: A Small Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This is where the gnomes store all their spare weapons. A door leads 
off to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a long hallway.
You see a small room.

rooms.Name: A Small Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This is yet another room for storing gnome stuff. Maps and battle 
plans are stored in neat stacks on the shelves.

Exits.Description: You see a small room.

rooms.Name: The Mess Hall
rooms.Description:
You are in the room where the guards come to get their grub. The 
benches and tables are neatly cleaned and straightened, while shiny 
plates line the walls.

Exits.Description: You see a long hallway.

rooms.Name: A Small Room
rooms.Description:
This is a small plain room. Its only interesting feature is a ladder 
down.

Exits.Description: You see a long hallway.
You see darkness.

rooms.Name: A Small Unused Room
rooms.Description:
You stand in a small room in an unused section of the fortress. The 
whole room is coated with dust and cobwebs. The ladder leads back up, 
and a rusty door is to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a rusty door.
You see a small room.

rooms.Name: Dark Hallway
rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a very old section of the fortress. You must be 
the first person to pass through here in years. The hallway continues 
south and a door leads off to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a rusty door.

rooms.Name: Torture Chamber
rooms.Description:
This is a room that was once used to extract lies out of helpless 
victims. The machines look unused, but could still work.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The machine consists of a large rack with winches on each end.  You can 
almost feel them pulling your arms out of their sockets.

rooms.Name: Dark Hallway
rooms.Description:
The hall continues in a north-south direction. The floor is coated 
with some kind of molded slime. Doors lead east and west.

rooms.Name: Dark Hallway
rooms.Description:
The hall continues in a north-south direction. The floor is coated 
with some kind of molded slime. Doors lead east and west.

rooms.Name: Prison Cell
rooms.Description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell. Bodies lying on the floor 
give off an unbearable stench.

rooms.Name: Prison Cell
rooms.Description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell. Bodies lying on the floor 
give off an unbearable stench.

rooms.Name: Prison Cell
rooms.Description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell. Bodies lying on the floor 
give off an unbearable stench.

rooms.Name: Prison Cell
rooms.Description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell. Bodies lying on the floor 
give off an unbearable stench.

rooms.Name: End of the Dark Hallway
rooms.Description:
You have reached the end of the dark hallway and maybe the end of 
your puny life. Something lumbers its way out of the shadows.

Exits.Description: You see a decaying door.

rooms.Name: A Ladder
rooms.Description: You have come into a vertical tunnel with a ladder.

Exits.Description: You see a decaying door.

rooms.Name: Lair
rooms.Description:
You have entered a new lair in the fortress. Anything could be 
lurking around the corner.

rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

rooms.Name: The End of the Hallway
rooms.Description:
You make your way out of the hallway, just to find yourself in 
greater danger. Before you looms the source of the great heat.

rooms.Name: The Altar
rooms.Description:
You finally reach the end of the maze. There is a great altar here 
in the shape of a bat. A passageway leads off to the west.

rooms.Name: The Chief's House
rooms.Description:
You enter into a large and luxurious house. The floor is coated with 
carpets and the walls are covered in paintings. You feel privileged 
just to be stepping inside.

Exits.Description: You see a path.

rooms.Name: The Unused Path
rooms.Description:
You are now on a fairly unused path that leads east out of the 
village. You wonder what could be out this way.

Exits.Description: You see a path.
You see a path.

rooms.Name: The Overgrown Path
rooms.Description:
As the path continues on, the grass grows higher. You can't imagine 
what could possibly be out this way.

Exits.Description: You see a clearing.
You see a path.

rooms.Name: The Clearing
rooms.Description:
Your progress is suddenly stopped by mountains on all sides. The 
path leads back to the west, and there appears to be an old mine 
shaft to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a mine shaft.
You see a path.

rooms.Name: Cleric's Inner Sanctum
rooms.Description:
This is the inner sanctum. A picture of the devine Garnak, is 
hanging on the wall, just above the altar which is set against 
the western wall.

rooms.Name: Entrance to Cleric's Guild
rooms.Description:
The entrance hall is a small modest room, reflecting the true nature 
of the Clerics. The exit leads east to the field of training. A small 
entrance to the practice yard is in the northern wall.

rooms.Name: The Field of Training
rooms.Description:
You stand in a large grass field. To the south you see a stone house 
with a large sign with a sword hanging over the entrance and to the 
east a similar house but with a ancient tome on the sign. The field 
continues to the north.

Exits.Description: You see the magic guild.
You see the warrior guild.

rooms.Name: The Field of Training
rooms.Description:
You stand in a large grass field. To the north you see a stone 
temple and to the east you see an abandoned stone house. The field 
continues to the south.

Exits.Description: You see the Cleric Guild.
You see the Thief Guild.

rooms.Name: Entrance to Mage's Guild
rooms.Description: The entrance hall is a small, poor lighted room.

Exits.Description: You see the field of traning.
You see the mages labratory.

rooms.Name: Mage's Laboratory
rooms.Description:
This is the Magical Experiments Laboratory. Dark smoke-stained 
stones arch over numerous huge oaken tables, most of these cluttered 
with strange-looking pipes and flasks. The floor is covered with 
half-erased pentagrams and even weirder symbols, and a blackboard in 
a dark corner has only been partially cleaned, some painful-looking 
letters faintly visible.

rooms.Name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Thieves
rooms.Description:
The entrance hall to the thieves' and assassins' guild. A place 
where you can lose both your life and your money, if you are not 
careful. To the east lies the field of training and if you go down 
you enter the thieves secret yard.

rooms.Name: The Secret Yard
rooms.Description:
The secret practice yard of thieves and assassins. Up is the 
entrance the the guild.

rooms.Name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Swordsmen
rooms.Description:
The entrance hall to the Guild of Swordsmen. A place where one has 
to be careful not to say something wrong (or right). To the east is 
the practice yard and to the north is the field of training.

Exits.Description: You see the field of training.

rooms.Name: The Tournament and Practice Yard
rooms.Description: The practice yard of the fighters. To the north is the entrance.

rooms.Name: Log Jam
rooms.Description:
Ice cold water has pooled up here, blocked by a log jam.  Not the
work of beavers, you see, because there is still room for the water to
seep through between logs.  Still, it has slowed the rushing current
enough for the water to rise up to your waist (if you're a fairy, you're
probably drowning).

Exits.Description: Cold water leads to a narrow embankment.
Upstream the water becomes more shallow.

rooms.Name: MidStream
rooms.Description:
Standing in a bit of cold water moving slowly at you from the east,
where you can see a waterfall in the far distance, it might occur to you
that getting OUT of the water would be good for your health.  Your
choices are then north to a small island run rampant with mice, or south
east towards a beach area.

Exits.Description: A small troop of mice seem to be ... chortling!
This is the upstream direction of the water ...

The stream is wide at this point, but you can see a beach area southeast
of here.
The stream pools up in front of some logs to the west of here.

rooms.Name: MidStream
rooms.Description:
The cold rushing waters of a mountain fed stream are remarkably clear
all around you.  The streambed is rocky and uncomfortable beneath your
feet, but the rapidly moving water at least ensures it is not too
slippery.  To the east you can hear a waterfall.  To the south a tall
cliff looms over you.  Not a good time for an earthquake!

Exits.Description: In the near distance you can hear the sounds of a waterfall.
Beyond just a bit more stream lies a sunny gnomish picnic beach.
Downstream

rooms.Name: Nearing the Falls
rooms.Description:
There's just something about falling water that enchants the soul of
even the most severely cranky gnome.  You can hear the pounding of water
hitting rock just to the east of here, and in the daytime the sight is
quite awesome.  You are wide awake no matter what the time of day or
night, of course, because you are standing in rapidly moving, frigid
water.

Exits.Description: A steep cliff combines with snowmelt to make an impressive waterfall.

The small stream moves rapidly westwards, swerving around a small
island.

rooms.Name: Waterfalls
rooms.Description:
From high above you a narrow but steady stream of water falls in a
frothy gush down to clean rocks where you stand.  The water falls
thinly, but with a great deal of force due to the height of the cliff
from which it falls.

Exits.Description:
It would be definitely safer for you to head downstream from here.
Besides, it's your only choice.

rooms.Name: At a Wide Spot in a Stream
rooms.Description:
The water is barely deep enough here to drown in standing up, but it
is quite cold and so you understand why the gnomes cross in boats rather
than simply wading through.  To the north you can see a small island
filled with mice and old Trollish loincloths.  To the southeast lie the
Gnomish Picnic Grounds.

Exits.Description: The stream really is quite wide at this point.
Just up ahead and slightly south lies a beach.

rooms.Name: By the Beach
rooms.Description:
The water is shallower here, and a trifle warmer.  The ground beneath
your feet has changed from rocky to a sandy-silt, soft enough to make
you want to take off your shoes and dig in your toes, and soft enough to
make walking across it pull at your calf muscles.  The beach is south of
here, full of small changing tents and the normal detritus of picnics
long past.

Exits.Description: The stream gets much deeper to the north.
The Gnomish Picnic Grounds beckon.
stream

rooms.Name: Beach Blanket Babylon
rooms.Description:
Gaily striped tents strongly resembling tiny circus tents dot this
tiny beach.  Blankets in more subdued colors are stretched here and
there for a gnomish family picnic and barbecue.  The area is protected
by the tall cliff to the south, the only really open area being the
inviting (if freezing) stream to the north.

Exits.Description: A shallow embankment leads to a cold stream, suitable for wading.

As you look more closely at the steep cliff behind you, you note that it
IS climbable.

rooms.Name: Steep cliff
rooms.Description:
Rocky and so steep it would give a mountain goat second thoughts
about climbing, the narrow path makes its way up the treacherous slope,
it's only saving grace being the many rocky outcroppings you may grasp
to keep yourself from falling down.   W-a-y-y-y down.

Exits.Description: The path up the cliff face heads east around some rocks.
The

rooms.Name: Path up a Steep Cliff
rooms.Description:
Here and there this rocky cliff is impossibly dotted with small scrub
brush growing out of cracks in the rock face.  You know that eventually
the hardy vegetation will crumble the mighty cliff, widening cracks and
leaving it vulnerable to the ravages of time and weather.  For now, you
simply wonder if it is hardy enough to bear your weight.

Exits.Description:
The path down is fraught with danger, but still possible.  The path up
is almost sheer rock.
The footholds in the rock lead you up the face of the cliff.

rooms.Name: Clinging to the Cliff
rooms.Description:
In places, the rock is quite brittle, crumbling to gravel beneath
your searching boot, and in others it is so smooth that your hands are
unable to find a place to hold.  Your muscles should ache, but the
adrenalin rushing through your veins is keeping you from feeling the
pain.  You have two choices from here.  Up ...  or down.

Exits.Description:
There is a last sheer stretch of rock before you come to the top of this
cliff.

It is a L-O-N-G way down from here.  But then, it is a long way up as
well.  Neither direction looks safe.  But if you were looking for
safety, why would you be here?

rooms.Name: Just Down from a Cliff Top
rooms.Description:
Grab the edge of the ledge above you and pull yourself up and over,
onto the edge of the cliff.  Even if you thought you were on your way
down, the safe thing to do is climb up and over and find another way
back.  It's a L-O-N-G way down from here, and the beach at the bottom of
the cliff may be soft, but nothing would be soft enough to keep you from
certain death if you fell.

Exits.Description: That's it! Just an arm's reach from here.
It's a LONG way down from here.

rooms.Name: On Top of a High Cliff, Looking Down
rooms.Description:
The view from here is breathtaking.  To the north, across a small
stream and down a steep cliff you can see a tiny village of gnomes.  To
the very distant north you see the thick forests of the magic elf
kingdom of Tynstri.

Exits.Description: a narrow well-beaten path
whoa !  now that's DOWN

rooms.Name: A Narrow Well-Beaten Path
rooms.Description:
A narrow dirt path has been beaten into the wild grasses of this
rolling plateau.  It stretches raggedly in an east-west direction,
seemingly meandering without purpose.
