rooms.Description:
At this "Y" intersection in the path, the main track of the path
heads eastwards, while a small trail of trampled grasses would seem to
lead to the southwest.  The shape of the intersection may help to remind
you of the name of those beasties you see in the distance.

Exits.Description: The well beaten path continues east for a stretch.

A small narrow path has been recently trampled into existence by some
very heavy animal.
The well beaten path continues west for a stretch.

rooms.Name: Drop It!
rooms.Description:
Someone must have taught the beasties well not to leave their
droppings in their barn, for they have left them all over this trail.
Careful where you put your foot, or you'll not be welcome anywhere you
go (except a yak convention, of course).

Exits.Description: The path wends south.
The path continues in its monotonous way.

rooms.Name: An Intersection in the Meadow
rooms.Description:
What looks like the main path curves here from east to north, and
then curves again.  To the south, the grasses have been recently
trampled into submission, so if you follow this particular trail you are
bound to run into something that runs around on 4 cloven hooves.

Exits.Description: A well beaten if somewhat quirky path runs north of here.
A well beaten if somewhat quirky path runs east of here.
A recently trampled dent in the meadow grasses leads south.

rooms.Name: A Very Curvy Path
rooms.Description:
This path seems to wander unnecessarily through the thick meadow
grasses on the high plateau.  You have little opportunity to admire the
beautiful purple mountains to the northeast because you need to keep
watching for the long pointed yaks and their leavings.  This path twists
west and south at this point.

Exits.Description: The path curves around to the south.
The path curves towards where the sun sets.

rooms.Name: A Very Curvy Path
rooms.Description:
The curvy meadow path twists through tall, thick meadow grasses.
Whatever the yaks eat, it apparently isn't this grass.  They have the
look of their vegetarian kindred, but you wonder if, perhaps, they eat
people instead.  The certainly have the built in weaponry to kill
anything they please.  Those horns are really wicked.

Exits.Description: The path curves around to the north.
The path curves around to the east.

rooms.Name: A Gnome Magic Shop
rooms.Description:
You are in one of the several shops of this fine town. The wares 
look fine. Lots of odd magic devices can be seen all around in the 
shop.

Exits.Description: You see a road.

rooms.Name: The Post Office
rooms.Description:
You are in the post office in Gnome village. Piles of assorted mail
lay untouched in the corners, collecting cobwebs. Several large crates 
have been pried open by curious customs agents, and are now stacked 
along the west wall, hiding plenty of 'WANTED' posters. There is a sign
posted on the wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
**********************************************************
*                                                        *
*    Mail Instructions :                                 *
*                                                        *
*      To send a note to someone :                       *
*         MAIL <playername>                              *
*                                                        *
*      To see if you have any mail :                     *
*         CHECK                                          *
*                                                        *
*      To get the Postmaster to give you your mail :     *
*         RECEIVE                                        *
*                                                        *
*         Stamps cost 350 coins per letter               *
*         Type 'HELP MAIL' for more info                 *
**********************************************************
They seem to cover everything here, even the Postmaster himself.

As you know, it is illegal to send contraband items through the 
Midgaard mail. The custom's agents use this as a great excuse to seize
liquor, rare spices, pornography, and just about anything they might 
find useful or profitable.

Faces of various known Player Killers and Player Thieves can barely be
seen behind the crates on the west wall. Some of them look quite 
familar, sorta like that guy who you saw in the Reception a minute ago.
But then again, they are rather hard to see past the crates.

rooms.Name: Nearby the Big Red Barn
rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a wide rolling meadow that
stretches out to the north and west for quite a long distance.  Here and
there the meadow is dotted by the wide curling horns of the yak, raised
here by the gnomes.  The gnomes treat them almost as pets, and the yaks
in turn protect the physically weak gnomes.

Exits.Description: A short path through yak-filled meadows leads to a big red barn.
A curvy little path through the meadow grasses begins here.

rooms.Name: Off the Beaten Path
rooms.Description:
The little yak path gets even littler here, as the grass seems to
spring up behind you as you walk through it, following whatever went
before you.  The main path lies north of here, this little tributary
runs east.

Exits.Description:
A slightly wider path is just this way.  Looking further you see the
beautiful mountains to the northeast.
Large hoofprints lead west.

rooms.Name: Off the Beaten Path
rooms.Description:
Whatever wandered off in this direction apparently kept on going
south, for the track of the large animal head from east to south through
here.  Although the grass is tall here, unless you are a very young
gnome or halfling, you can see over them to the many yaks peacefully
filling their bellies and the beautiful mountains to the north.

Exits.Description: He came from thataway.
He's headed thisaway.

rooms.Name: Where Many Hooves Converge
rooms.Description:
Two narrow, recently beaten paths converge at this point, one coming
from the north, the other from the east, and both seem to be headed
west.  If you are tracking something, then, that would seem to be the
way to go.

Exits.Description:
Something large ventured from that direction.  In the words of Pooh
(hunting Heffalumps), "You see where he's going to and I'll see where he
came from!

rooms.Name: YakkityYak (Don't Look Back!)
rooms.Description:
THE yak tends to hang out here.  His yak harem brings him presents of
the most delicate of meadow flowers, and the gnomes weave them into
garlands to wear about his mighty neck or decorate his serious horns.
Should he become hungry, they are a delicate appetizer, a "starter" to a
more interesting meal of ... say ... adventurer?

Exits.Description: Looking back

rooms.Description:
A faint trail leads off the main path just north of here.  At this
point it twists to the west.  You are standing in a meadow lushly
planted with thick, tall grasses, some of them flowering in many
different colors.  This trail continues west.

Exits.Description: The main path is north of here.
The little path wanders west.

rooms.Name: Off the Beaten Path
rooms.Description:
A very narrow path has been recently trod by a heavy, wide animal
headed east from where you are standing.  The tracks at your feet are
fresh, the trampled meadow grasses still bleeding grassjuice.  Above the
grasses, knee high for a human at this point, you can see a large number
of yaks wandering about the meadow.

Exits.Description: Backtrack the hoofprints this way.

Whatever made this little trail (and for some reason a yak springs to

After struggling up the side of the barrow, you are eventually 
rewarded with a spectacular view over the surrounding countryside. On 
top of the Barrow is a large stone slab, carved deeply with some strange 
writing and what appears to be the symbol of the Crimson Fists, an order 
of knights, who fight for money.

and the heady scent of spring flowers. You wander aimlessly through the 
knee high grass and flowers, but your attention is drawn to the steep
barrow just to the southeast.

rooms.Name: Inside the Barrow
rooms.Description:
Your eyes strain to penetrate the gloom within the barrow, which is 
lit only by the light you carry with you. The air is thick with dust, 
and the whole area is covered with cobwebs. There is a faint musty smell 
of death in the air which appears to emanate from a large crypt in the 
centre of the barrow. The walls are decorated with tattered and ancient 
banners, and burnt out torches crumble in the rusted wall brackets.

Exits.Description: A narrow set of steps lead out of the barrow.
A rusted iron ladder leads down into the darkness.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Labyrinth
rooms.Description:
The iron ladder ends abruptly and you are forced to drop the rest of 
the way to the ground, leaving you unable to climb back the way you 
came. You find yourself at the entrance to an amazing labyrinth with 
sweeping parapets in every direction. The narrow bridges twist and turn, 
climbing and falling as they wind their way through the impenetrable 
darkness. Looking along one of the bridges, you can just about make out 
another platform in the distance. A quick examination of one of the 
bridges brings a worrying conclusion - they are very unsafe and could 
collapse at any time. There must be a safe route through however. You 
hear maniacal laughter in the distance, echoing all around you.

The darkness is oppressive, nothing is visible through the gloom, 
except four narrow bridges which quickly twist out of view. You hesitate 
over which of the fragile bridges to take and search briefly for clues 
to the route through.
#GA bloody corpse lies here.#N

Exits.Description: A narrow sweeping bridge curves off into the darkness.
A narrow sweeping bridge curves off into the darkness.
A narrow sweeping bridge curves off into the darkness.
A narrow sweeping bridge curves off into the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Before he finally expired, he was trying to drag himself west - perhaps 
he knew something?

rooms.Description:

except four narrow bridges which quickly twist out of view. You hesitate 
over which of the fragile bridges to take and search briefly for clues 
to the route through. A gentle breeze wafts towards you from the south.

Exits.Description: A narrow sweeping bridge curves off into the darkness.
A narrow sweeping bridge curves off into the darkness.
You sense a gentle breeze coming from the south.
A narrow sweeping bridge curves off into the darkness.

rooms.Name: End of the Labyrinth
rooms.Description:
One final twist and you find yourself at the end of the labyrinth. 
You stand before a very solid looking citadel hewn from black granite. 
The walls are smooth as glass, the corners sharp and the buttresses 
imposing. Before you stands a huge statue of a mighty warrior standing 
proudly wearing thick protective plate armour and bearing the tattered 
banner of the Crimson Fists.

Exits.Description: A huge black gateway lies a short distance to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wide banner is a deep red colour, and in its time caused fear among 
the enemies of the Crimson Fists. In the centre of the banner, is a 
white circle as pure as snow, and within it a clenched armoured fist 
the colour of fresh blood.

rooms.Name: The Gates to the Citadel
rooms.Description:
The citadel gates are made from some dark metal you have never seen 
before, and looks incredibly heavy. Bolts extend from the gate into the 
black granite surround, and deep into the ground beneath your feet. In 
the centre of the gate is a slot, presumably for a key or talisman of 
some kind. No doubt the Knights of the Crimson Fist can gain entry at 
any time, but the citadel is surely impenetrable to their enemies. 
Dark sentry posts either side of the gate glare angrily at you - you 
hope they are unmanned.

Exits.Description:
You see the exit from the labyrinth behind you and feel glad you do not 
have to pass through it again.
A sentry post lies just to the east.
The immense gates hide what lies within the citadel.
A sentry post lies just to the west.

rooms.Name: Sentry Post
rooms.Description:
This dark tiny room is rather unpleasant, but the Crimson Fists are 
tougher than some wimpy little adventurer and would proudly stand here 
for hours on end, guarding the citadel.

Exits.Description: The Citadel gates lie to the east.

rooms.Name: Sentry Post
rooms.Description:
This dark tiny room is rather unpleasant, but the Crimson Fists are 
tougher than some wimpy little adventurer and would proudly stand here 
for hours on end, guarding the citadel.

Exits.Description: The Citadel gates lie to the west.

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
The inside of the citadel is even more impressive than the outside. 
The walls are decorated with tattered banners and all kinds of weapons. 
Every twenty paces a thick column rises on each side of the hallway 
high above your head, eventually curving into an arch which meets more 
than fifty feet above you. Elaborate chandeliers light the hallway, 
sending your shadow dancing across the floor.

Exits.Description: You see the citadel gates behind you.
A thick wooden door blocks your way east.
The imposing hallway continues south.

rooms.Name: Aaron's Chambers
rooms.Description:
The Chambers of Knight Lieutenant Sir Aaron are sparse to say the 
least. On the other side of the room there is an uncomfortable looking 
bed and a small table. Aside from a candle and a small Crimson Fists 
emblem, carved from a ruby, the table is bare. The only other thing in 
the room is a large armour tree, where Sir Aaron stores his platemail 
and weapons.

Exits.Description: The hallway lies to the west.

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
Huge banners hang on the walls either side of you, between the sturdy 
columns. You recognise the war standards of the Silver Hammers and the 
Sea Hawks among them, both renowned mercenary bands, and both destroyed 
by the Crimson Fists.

Exits.Description: The hallway continues north.
The hallway continues south.
A wooden door bars your way west.

rooms.Name: Cindar's Room
rooms.Description:
Knight Lieutenant Sir Cindar's room is not what you would expect 
from a civilised knight. The walls and floor have been painted in 
crimson, and the room is lit by four thigh-thick candles - one in 
each corner. Sir Cindar obviously sleeps on the floor, there is a 
small pile of blankets near the north wall. A wide table on the south 
side of the room is the only piece of furniture, also painted in 
crimson, but there is nothing on it.

Exits.Description: A large crimson painted wooden door leads east.

rooms.Name: Stone Stairwell
rooms.Description:
A wide stone staircase curves upwards to the second floor of the 
citadel. Wide swathes of crimson silk draped from the ceiling soften 
the appearance of the hard stone walls. A narrow staircase leads 
downwards to the citadel barracks and there is a large wooden door 
to the east.

Exits.Description: A wide hallway continues north.
A wooden door bars the way east.
A wide sweeping staircase leads up.
A narrow stairwell leads downwards.

rooms.Name: Azig's Study
rooms.Description:
The study of Knight Lieutenant Sir Azig is filled with books and 
tomes and scrolls, scattered over all the horizontal surfaces. A wide 
desk is the most striking item in the room, with thick carved legs 
and made from heavily polished oak. A small bed in the corner doesn't 
look large enough for a man of Sir Azig's reputation.

Exits.Description: west desc

rooms.Name: Grand Hallway
rooms.Description:
The hallway is more grand on the second level of the citadel. Thick 
tapestries cover the walls, depicting events in the history of the 
Crimson Fists - mainly their many bloody victories. The hallway 
continues north, and to the south, you can sense the peace of a place 
of worship. A large brass-inlaid wooden door leads east.

Exits.Description: The hallway continues north.
A brass-inlaid wooden door leads east.
An archway leads south.
A wide sweeping staircase leads downwards.

rooms.Name: Crimson Fists Chapel
rooms.Description:
The chapel is a place of solemn dignity and piety and you are 
overcome with a sense of calm. This is where the knights pray to 
their gods three times every day, and where apprentice knights 
spend their vigil, before they become true knights. A plush red 
carpet runs down the length of the chapel, to a knee high rail 
before the altar. The large altar holds only two thick candles 
which are always kept lit. Dark wooden pews are arranged down 
each side of the chapel, enough to seat all of the Crimson Fists 
at once.

Exits.Description: You see a grand hallway to the north.

rooms.Name: Gravin's Room
rooms.Description:
You are impressed with the rich furnishings in Knight Lieutenant Sir 
Gravin's room. A roaring fire burns beneath an ornately carved oak 
mantelpiece and a large war banner hangs above it. On the wall is a huge 
sword, taller than a man - a greatsword, apparently sharpened and ready 
for use.

Exits.Description: You see a wide hallway to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is the war banner of the Emperor's Children, Sir Gravin slew their 
Primarch and Bannerman himself, taking the standard and winning another 
campaign for the Crimson Fists.

rooms.Name: Grand Hallway
rooms.Description:
As you walk down the grand hallway your feel a little 
unworthy. The thick columns are ornately carved, each in a 
different pattern. The floor too is richly decorated, a 
strange geometric arrangement of crimson, white, grey and 
black tiles. The hallway continues north, and there is a 
bronze banded oak door to the west.

Exits.Description: The hallway continues north.
The hallway continues south.
A large bronze banded oak door blocks the way west.

rooms.Name: Stephen's Shrine
rooms.Description:
Knight Captain Sir Stephen's room is as peaceful as a church, the 
walls are panelled with oak, which has been polished to a deep shine. A 
small alcove to the south holds a small cot, but it is clear that Sir 
Stephen spends more time in prayer than sleeping. A wide altar bears a 
single candle, held in a large candle-holder carved from some red-gold 
metal into the shape of a gauntleted fist.

Exits.Description: A large wooden doors least east.

rooms.Name: Grand Hallway
rooms.Description:
The wide corridor ends before a pair of huge oak double doors. The 
doors are edged with gold, and in the middle of each is an inlaid 
crimson fist, made from thousands of rubies. There is also door to the 
east, which has been coated with silver and polished to a mirror finish.

Exits.Description: You see a huge pair of gold-inlaid oak doors.
A silvered door leads east.
A grand hallway leads south.

rooms.Name: Rowland's Apartments
rooms.Description:
The apartments of Knight Captain Sir Rowland are incredibly richly 
appointed. A monstrous black glass mantelpiece runs the entire length 
of the north wall, and on the south side of the room is a long table, 
with ten high-backed carved chairs. A small curtained off area to the 
east holds a small bed and a few personal possessions, but does not 
appear to be used very often.

Exits.Description: A shiny silvered door leads east.

rooms.Name: Grand Throne Room
rooms.Description:
Upon entering the throne room you eye is immediately drawn to the 
high dais opposite you. The throne on top of the dais is ornately 
carved such that it appears to be made from hundreds of clenched 
fists, the plated gauntlets enamelled in a thousand shades of red. A 
rich crimson carpet edged in gold runs the entire length of the throne 
room and up the five shallow steps to the throne. Beside the dais are 
two more large thrones, carved from oak and trimmed in gold leaf, 
presumably for the two Knight Captains. There is no other furniture, 
you assume that any other members of the order must stand in the 
presence of their Primarch and his Captains.

Exits.Description: A wide pair of doors lead south.

rooms.Name: Lost in the Labyrinth
rooms.Description:
You don't get very far before the bridge begins to crumble beneath 
your feet, and it's collapse is so sudden that you have no chance to 
turn back. As you fall into the abyss, you hear the sound of laughter 
echoing around you.

Exits.Description: You can see nothing, you're dead!
You can see nothing, you're dead!
You can see nothing, you're dead!
You can see nothing, you're dead!

rooms.Name: Basement
rooms.Description:
You have entered the training area of the Crimson Fists, deep below 
their citadel. Narrow stone steps lead up, and just to the north this 
corridor appears to open out into a large and very noisy training hall.

Exits.Description: The basement opens out into a large training hall.
A narrow stone stair leads upwards.

rooms.Name: Barracks
rooms.Description:
The barracks of the second company of the Crimson Fists is not 
very tidy, the belongings of the soldiers strewn across the thirty 
two beds along with bits and pieces of armour, and many weapons. 
However, despite the apparent mess, the weapons and armours are very 
well cared for, and in excellent condition. Sir Cindar leads the 
second company, and like their Knight Lieutenant their appearance is 
unkempt, and maybe even a little savage. Their discipline and 
fighting prowess however are legendary, and they are never taken 
lightly by their foes.

Exits.Description: You can hear the clash of weapons coming from the east.

rooms.Name: Training Hall
rooms.Description:
The clash of shields and the ringing of swords assault your ears as 
soon as you enter the training hall of the Crimson Fists. All around you 
are unarmoured soldiers, practicing their swordplay and large racks of 
practice swords and shields. In this area the warriors are honing their 
single combat skills under the watchful eyes of Knight Sergeant Jem. The 
training hall extends further to the north, and there are barracks to 
the east and west.

Exits.Description: The training hall extends further to the north.
There appears to be a barracks area to the east.
You can make out a short corridor and at the end a set of stone steps.
There appears to be a barracks area to the west.

rooms.Name: Barracks
rooms.Description:
The barracks of the first company of the Crimson Fists has a raw feel 
to it, a tension that you can almost taste as you enter. The first 
company lead by Knight Lieutenant Sir Aaron are sometimes referred to 
as the Young Bloods, since they are the newest recruits. Like all new 
soldiers they are always extremely keen to prove their skills, sometimes 
leading to a lapse in discipline, but their savagery is unequalled 
within the Order.

Exits.Description: The training hall lies to the west.

rooms.Name: Barracks
rooms.Description:
The fourth company of the Crimson Fists is the most experienced, and 
consists entirely of veteran fighters. They have fought in many 
campaigns under the leadership of Sir Gravin, and some of them even 
recall the time when Sir Rowland lead them, and Gravin was just another 
one of their company. The beds lining the walls are made with military 
precision, and this is the only barracks hall containing a captured 
enemy war banner - the standard of the Iron Claws.

Exits.Description: The practice halls lie to the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The banner shows gloved hand with razor sharp claws on a field of forest 
green. The banner was captured at a siege as a result of the great bravery 
and skill of the fourth company, under the leadership of the then Knight 
Lieutenant Sir Rowland.

rooms.Name: Training Hall
rooms.Description:
Knights at this end of the training hall are drilling in formations, 
learning the discipline that will bring the Crimson Fists further glory. 
Knight Sergeant Gilbert barks orders at the small groups of sweating 
knights, always pushing them harder, forcing them to improve. The 
training hall continues further south, and there are barracks to the 
east and west.

Exits.Description: To the east you see a barracks.
The training hall continues south.
To the west you see a barracks.

rooms.Name: Barracks
rooms.Description:
The third company is sometimes known as the stalwart company, their 
bravery and devotion is without question. They are experienced troops 
are generally take few losses under the shrewd leadership of Knight 
Lieutenant Sir Azig.

Exits.Description: The training hall lies to the west.

rooms.Name: Fiction for Young Adults
rooms.Description:
Not quite children, but not quite adults, those that fall in
between seem to have their own taste in reading materials.  This
collection was created just for the young adult crowd.  Several small
tables stand covered with books in the center of the room, surrounded
by the enormous bookshelves that fill the library.  The stacks
continue to the south, and an open doorway leads east to a quiet
hallway.

rooms.Name: A Quiet Hallway
rooms.Description:
The quiet hallway leads through the center of the library.  Plush
carpeting on the floors, and large tapestries on the walls muffle any
noise that might otherwise be heard here.  Open doorways lead east   
and west from the hallway into the stacks, and the hallway continues
to the north.  A small wooden staircase leads up to the next floor of
the library.

rooms.Name: The Stacks
rooms.Description:
Several large shelves line the walls, reaching from the floor to
the ceiling.  Each shelf is filled to capacity with all sorts of     
books and scrolls.  This large collection of reading materials is
considered to be one of the finest in the land, an opinion shared by
the librarians who work here.  The stacks continue to the south, and an 
open doorway leads west to a quiet hallway.

rooms.Name: The Stacks

rooms.Name: Nursery Rhymes, Fables, and Other Children's Books
rooms.Description:
This library is known far and wide for its magnificent
collection of children's books.  Here the young, and young at
heart, may browse through wonderful picture books, fairy tales,
and much more.  Several wooden toys are scattered about on the
floor, probably left here by some of the younger patrons.  Large
wooden shelves line the walls, housing the many volumes owned by
this fine library.  The stacks continue to the north and south, and
an open doorway leads to a hallway to the east.

rooms.Name: A Quiet Hallway
rooms.Description:
The quiet hallway leads through the center of the library.  Plush
carpeting on the floors, and large tapestries on the walls muffle any
noise that might otherwise be heard here.  Open doorways lead east   
and west from the hallway into the stacks, and the hallway continues
to the north and south.

rooms.Name: Rare Books and Historical Volumes
rooms.Description:
History buffs from all around flock to this library for a chance
to browse through the magnificent collection of rare books and
historical volumes.  Ancient literary masterpieces sit safely inside
large glass cases, taken out only rarely.  Several volumes detailing
the history of the known world line the shelves, beckoning you to
enjoy their tales of days gone by.  The stacks continue to the north
and south, and a small doorway leads west to a quiet hallway.

rooms.Name: New Arrivals
rooms.Description:
As new volumes are acquired by the library, they are temporarily
housed in this section.  This allows visitors easy access to the
latest books and scrolls.  Several patrons sit around a large round
table, avidly reading their selections.  Large wooden shelves line
the walls, housing the many volumes owned by this fine library.  The
stacks, as the main collection is called by the wonderful librarians,
continue to the north, and an open doorway leads to a hallway to the
east.

rooms.Name: A Quiet Hallway
rooms.Description:
The quiet hallway leads through the center of the library.  Plush
carpeting on the floors, and large tapestries on the walls muffle any
noise that might otherwise be heard here.  Open doorways lead east
and west from the hallway into the stacks, and the hallway continues
to the north and south.

rooms.Name: The Reference Room
rooms.Description:
Dictionaries, encyclopediae, indices, and various other reference
volumes make their home in the reference room.  Conveniently located
next to the librarian's office, the reference room holds a wealth of
information about everything under the sun.  A large wooden table
sits in the center of the room, covered with several enormous books,
some of which appear to be quite ancient.  The stacks, which make up
the bulk of the library's collection, continue to the north.  An open
doorway leads west to a quiet hallway.

rooms.Name: The Circulation Desk
rooms.Description:
A small desk, covered with piles of books and scrolls, sits in the
middle of this room.  The plush carpeting on the floor muffles any
footsteps that would otherwise be heard here.  This is a library
after all!  A large plaque hangs on the wall next to the doorway,
which leads to a hallway to the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The plaque reads:

	Welcome patrons!

	A library card is required to check out any books.
	Read our books at your own risk!
	The library will not be held responsible for any loss
	of life and/or limb from use of our books.

	Thank You,
	The Head Librarian

rooms.Name: A Quiet Hallway
rooms.Description:
The quiet hallway leads through the center of the library.  Plush
carpeting on the floors, and large tapestries on the walls muffle any
noise that might otherwise be heard here.  A small office is just
east of here, and to the west is the Circulation Desk.

rooms.Name: The Librarian's Office
rooms.Description:
A small desk sits in one corner of the room, covered with numerous
books, scrolls, and bits of paper.  While the librarian's office
appears to be quite messy, the librarian knows exactly where
everything is.  Through the doorway to the west, you can see a
carpeted hallway.

rooms.Name: Mythology and Legend
rooms.Description:
Volumes filled with tales of the ancient gods and their mighty
deeds are stacked neatly on the large shelves in what is said to be
the largest single collection of mythological literature.  A large
table stands in the center of the room, covered with books containing
tales of ancient heroes and gods.  The stacks that make up the main
collection of the library continue to the south, and an open doorway
stands east, leading to a quiet hallway.

Exits.Description:
The hallways of the Knights who say Ni open up behind a nice set of
shrubbery.

rooms.Name: A Quiet Hallway
rooms.Description:
The quiet hallway leads through the center of the library.  Plush
carpeting on the floors, and large tapestries on the walls muffle any
noise that might otherwise be heard here.  Open doorways lead east
and west from the hallway into the stacks, and the hallway continues
to the south.  A small wooden staircase leads down to the first floor
of the library.

rooms.Name: The Stacks
rooms.Description:
Several large shelves line the walls, reaching from the floor to
the ceiling.  Each shelf is filled to capacity with all sorts of
books and scrolls.  This large collection of reading materials is
considered to be one of the finest in the land, an opinion shared by
the librarians who work here.  The stacks continue to the south, and an 
open doorway leads west to a quiet hallway.

rooms.Name: Fiction
rooms.Description:
Various books, filled with tales that could only come from the
most creative minds in the land, are spread out across a large table
that dominates the center of this room.  The fiction collection in
this library is one of the most comprehensive known to exist.  Large
bookcases line the walls, filled with hundreds of literary
masterpieces.  The stacks continue to the north from here, and an
open doorway leads to a quiet hallway to the east.

rooms.Name: The Stacks
rooms.Description:

rooms.Name: The Classics
rooms.Description:
Ahhh the classics!  These literary masterpieces have become an
integral part of our culture.  Read by every schoolchild, these
volumes can take you to far-off lands and mystical places.  The books
and scrolls that make up the classics collection are very diverse and
intended for a wide range of audiences.  The stacks that hold this
collection contunie to the northm and an open doorway leads to a
hallway to the west.

rooms.Name: Entrance to Gnome Village
rooms.Description:
You stand on a dusty path that leads south and east. To the east you hear
the sounds of a small village and to the south you can enter the forest of
Namir.

Exits.Description: You see the turning point.

rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading north and west, that is surrounded on the
other two sides by a small stream. The water looks mighty cold.

You see the stream.
You see a small path.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The stream is pretty small, but it looks too cold to swim.

rooms.Name: Path by a Stream
rooms.Description:
You are on a small east-west path. The path shows new grass, as if it has
stopped being used sometime in the recent past. A river is to the south, and a
small hut is to the west.

Exits.Description: You see a small path.
You see the stream.
You see a small hut that is starting to fall apart.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The hut looks well built, but it seems to have taken some damage.
The stream is pretty small, but it looks too cold to swim.

rooms.Name: A Small Hut
rooms.Description:
The hut is a mess! Blood has stained the grass walls into a dark rich
crimson color. Torn clothes and trash lie all around, and you think you see a
skeleton in the corner.

Exits.Description: You see a small path.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The skeleton still has a little flesh clinging to it and it is definitely
humanoid.  The skull has been cracked open, but it is otherwise undamaged,
except by time.

rooms.Name: On the Stream
rooms.Description:
The stream is cold and frigid, yet it supports plenty of life beneath its
surface. The current trickles west and there is a field to the south.

Exits.Description: You see a small path.
You see a grassy field.
You see a small stream.

rooms.Name: On the Stream
rooms.Description:
The current here flows from the east, but a logjam blocks you from
continuing onward.

Exits.Description: You see a small path.
You see a small stream.

rooms.Name: The Field of Mice's Dreams
rooms.Description:
This is a large green field of waist high grass. You feel something scurry
over your feet. There is a cave to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a small stream.
You see a dark mysterious cave.

rooms.Name: The Dark Cave
rooms.Description:
The cave gleams as your light reflects off of it. As you squint your eyes
and try to look ahead, you think you see something move.

Exits.Description: You see a grassy field.

rooms.Name: Darker Cave
rooms.Description:
The cave gets even darker as your terror grows stronger. You fear for your
life as something emerges out of the shadows.

rooms.Name: A Dusty Path
rooms.Description:
You are on a well traveled path that leads in many directions. To the north
is a large house, and to the west is a fortress.

Exits.Description: You see a large white house.
You see a road.
You see the gateway to a large fortress.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The fortress is a large gnome stronghold to defend the city.

rooms.Name: The Iron Gateway
rooms.Description:
You stand at the entrance to the gnome fortress. The place seems to be well
fortified.

Exits.Description: You see a small path.
You see a long hallway.

rooms.Name: A Long Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are now inside of the fortress; you must be lucky that the guards
haven't killed you. As you glance around, you notice that the walls and floors
are spotlessly cleaned. The barracks are to the north and a storage room is to
the south.

Exits.Description: You see the barracks.
You see the gateway.

Exits.Description: You see a long hallway.

rooms.Name: The Barracks
rooms.Description:
You now stand in the sleeping quarters of the gnome guards. Every bed is
made perfectly, and not single article of clothing is on the floor. There is a
small storage room to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a small storage room.
You see a long hallway.

rooms.Name: A Small Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This is where the gnomes store all their spare clothing and armor. There is
not much here, but you might come up with something.

Exits.Description: You see the barracks.

rooms.Name: A Small Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This is where the gnomes store all their spare weapons. A door leads off to
the east.

Exits.Description: You see a long hallway.
You see a small room.

rooms.Name: A Small Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This is yet another room for storing gnome stuff. Maps and battle plans are

Exits.Description: You see a small room.

rooms.Name: The Mess Hall
rooms.Description:
You are in the room where the guards come to get their grub. The benches and
tables are neatly cleaned and straightened, while shiny plates line the walls.

Exits.Description: You see a long hallway.

rooms.Name: A Small Room
rooms.Description: This is a small plain room. Its only interesting feature is a ladder down.

rooms.Description:
You stand in a small room in an unused section of the fortress. The whole
room is coated with dust and cobwebs. The ladder leads back up, and a rusty
door is to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a rusty door.
You see a small room.

rooms.Name: Dark Hallway
rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a very old section of the fortress. You must be the
first person to pass through here in years. The hallway continues south and a
door leads off to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a rusty door.

rooms.Name: Torture Chamber
rooms.Description:
This is a room that was once used to extract lies out of helpless victims.
The machines look unused, but could still work.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The machine consists of a large rack with winches on each end.  You can 
almost feel them pulling your arms out of their sockets.

rooms.Name: Dark Hallway
rooms.Description:
The hall continues in a north-south direction. The floor is coated with some
kind of molded slime. Doors lead east and west.

rooms.Name: The Altar
rooms.Description:
You finally reach the end of the maze. There is a great altar here in the

rooms.Name: The Chief's House
rooms.Description:
You enter into a large and luxurious house. The floor is coated with carpets
and the walls are covered in paintings. You feel privileged just for stepping

must be running low by now. Golden pillars span the hallway, and you notice a
red carpet beneath your feet.

Exits.Description: You see the walkway.

large golden throne against the wall.

Exits.Description: You see a large hall.

rooms.Name: The Treasury
rooms.Description:
You are inside the hobgoblin's treasury. Your eyes are almost blinded by the
gold, silver and copper coins.

rooms.Description:
You are inside a well guarded room. The place is slightly better built than

The guards store their spare weapons and armor here. There are rusty swords

Exits.Description: You see the shaft.

rooms.Name: Mine Shaft
rooms.Description:
You enter a part of the mine shaft where the torches have grown dim and are
almost ready to go out. From what you can see, there are plenty of cobwebs on
the walls and rats at your feet.

Exits.Description: You see the shaft.
You see a dark and nasty room.

rooms.Name: Entrance to a Dungeon
rooms.Description:
The floor dips slightly as you walk into this dark and nasty place. Your
skin crawls as you look at the filth on the walls and see it move. Most of the
exits lead into jail cells.

Exits.Description: You see the shaft.
You see a cell.
You see a dark and nasty room.
You see a cell.

rooms.Name: A Dungeon
rooms.Description:
You are in the deepest and darkest part of the mine shafts. The light from
the torches barely reaches to where you are. Most directions from here lead to
jail cells.

Exits.Description: You see a dark and nasty room.
You see a cell.
You see a cell.
You see a cell.

rooms.Name: A Jail Cell
rooms.Description:

The walls glisten with slime. You see something stir in the straw.

Exits.Description: You see a dark and nasty room.

undisturbed by footprints.

Exits.Description: You see a small mine shaft.
You see the shaft.

rooms.Name: Hobgoblin Barracks
rooms.Description:
You are suddenly surrounded by a small army of hobgoblin guards. The room
itself is a mess with clothes and armor everywhere. The beds are unmade and
stained.

Exits.Description: You see a large room.
You see the mess hall.
You see the mine shaft.

rooms.Name: Hobgoblin Barracks
rooms.Description:
Yech! As you continue forward, the smell just keeps getting worse. What are
you DOING here?

Exits.Description: You see a large room

rooms.Name: Mess Hall
rooms.Description:
You stand in the hobgoblin eating area. There are a few rotting tables and
many broken dishes scattered around the room. You almost slip on a rotten piece
of meat, but catch yourself just in time.

Exits.Description: You see a small room.
You see a kitchen.
You see a large room.

rooms.Name: A Store Room
rooms.Description:
You stand in a small room filled with flour, grain, fruit, and bat
droppings.

Exits.Description: You see the mess hall.

rooms.Name: The Kitchen
rooms.Description:
This kitchen hasn't been cleaned since the creation of humans. The trash and
spoiled food laying on the floor reach up to your knees. Off to the side a pot
is boiling over. A human hand floats in it.

Exits.Description: You see the mess hall.

rooms.Name: A Small Mine Shaft
rooms.Description:
You come to a place in the mine shaft where a tunnel leads down. The small
passage continues north and south.

Exits.Description: You see an almost caved in area.
You see a small mine shaft.
You see a hole.

rooms.Name: Hermit's Lair
rooms.Description:
You are in a small section where the mine wall has collapsed to reveal a
tiny one-room cave. The area is barely lit, but you can make out something
moving towards you.

Exits.Description: You see a small mine shaft.

rooms.Name: A Hole
rooms.Description: You are in a hole.

Exits.Description: You see a small mine shaft.

rooms.Name: #BT#YR#MI #BClan Gates#N
rooms.Description:
You have come upon the front gate of the Tri Clan House. Upon the 
gate you see a plaque. There is also a portal to the west with an odd 
looking triangle on it.

Exits.Description: You see the main meeting area of the house.
Back to town!

rooms.Name: #BT#YR#MI #BClan Meeting Hall#N
rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a room that glows with a light of its own. 
Around you are beautiful paintings of mighty Tri Elders in battle. 
You feel at home here and know that this is a place to rest were you 
can get away from the busy mud traffic. On one wall is a large 
fireplace that adds to the glow of the room.  This room is large 
enough to hold the entire clan and has ample seating for any clan 
meeting if need were to arise.

Exits.Description: You see a comfortable looking lounge.
The front gate of Tri House
You see what looks like a storage room.

rooms.Name: #BStorage and Donations Room#N
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the Donations room. Please help out your 
fellow clan members and leave your unused or unwanted equiptment 
here.

Exits.Description: You see the clan meeting hall.

rooms.Name: #BT#YR#MI #BLounge#N
rooms.Description:
You enter a comfortable lounge area decorated in relaxing colors 
and patterns. This is a great place to get away for a while, kick up 
your feet and just relax or have a nice conversation. Around you are 
chairs and couches provided for your comfort.

Exits.Description: You see a pub.
You see the main meeting area.

rooms.Name: #BT#YR#MI #BClan Pub#N
rooms.Description:
Here you find the perfect pub. Around you are your friends, the 
beer is good and there is no phone, so you dont have to worry about 
calling the wife. Enjoy while you are here.
§N

Exits.Description: You see a door to the back alley.
To the west is the lounge.

rooms.Name: #BBack Alley#N
rooms.Description:
Ok, you come out here for a reason, so lets get at it. If you got 
a problem this is were to solve it. Just remember, there are no rules 
in street fights.

Exits.Description: The back door of the pub is here.

rooms.Name: #BT#YR#MI #Bhallway#N
rooms.Description:
You have reached the inner sanctum of the TRI clan house.  All 
around you are the doors that lead to the personal rooms of the TRI 
Dominators.
§N

rooms.Name: #BAngulion's Corner#N
rooms.Description:
The room is filled with the odour of the many roses around and you 
get a strange feeling of happines and honour towards the clan.  From 
the ceiling, which glows with unearthly colors, hangs a huge skull of 
a dragon.  In the middle of the room is a well-laid table with roses 
and candles on it.  On the east wall hangs a rack with many unique 
weapons and armors.  By the west wall are bookshelves filled with 
books containing the secrets of magic and skills.  In the north wall 
is an alcove with a king size bed. Above the bed is a picture of a 
very lovely girl.  In the south wall is something that seems like a 
window, through which you see strange wagons moving fast, hoovering 
above the ground, there are also huge glass like towers, could it be 
a distant future?
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The candles burn with a clear light. They seem as if the would have
just been lighted.

The candles burn with a clear light. They seem as if the would have
just been lighted.

The roses are of a varity of colors, but a large part are in the 
shades of red.

The roses are of a varity of colors, but a large part are in the 
shades of red.
Under the picture reads 'Anna' in golden letters.

rooms.Name: #BOgy's Room#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered the room of one of the TRI clan leaders, the 
honorable and humble Ogy. The room is filled with a wide variety of 
art and artifact depicting the areas of skill and knowledge, that Ogy 
has chosen to gain power, honor, and glory, in the name of the 
mightiest of all the clans, the TRI clan.
   Against the east wall you see a large and luxurious waterbed, so 
large in fact, you could lay two people end to end and still not span 
the length or width of this masterpiece of aquatic hybernation. On 
the wall above the bed is a large portrait of Ogy in battle against 
the nearly indestructable "ferocious killer rabbit".
   On west wall can be seen a large rack holding a vast arsenal of 
weapons.  It contains practically every type of weapon imaginable. 
You shiver at the thought that any one person could be their master.
   Near the west wall is large cabinet. Peering within you see a 
enormous assortment of healing and recupritive items. Seen are, 
scrolls, potions, vials, herbs, and several other items you've never 
seen before. It is quite clear that Ogy is not just a run of the mill 
healer, but is instead well versed in the healing arts.
   A bookcase stands against the entire north wall. It contains 
volume after volume of magical knowledge from times long forgotten 
upto the present day.  Mastering the knowledge contained in just a 
few of these precious tabloids would most certainly make any man one 
of the most powerful magic-users in the land.  Your mind reels to 
think of the person who could master them all.
§N

rooms.Name: #BT#YR#MI #BHallway#N
rooms.Description:
You have reached the inner sanctum of the TRI clan house.  All 
around you are the doors that lead to the personal rooms of the TRI 
Dominators.
§N

rooms.Name: #BThe seventh side of truth...#N
rooms.Description:
The best day of my life was with you, on that
summer warm beach, remember?...with some people  
in the distance, still... we weren't feeling very disturbed
with that, for a change. That sweet low breeze, really
was a gift from the gods, and the way it balanced your
hair made the impossible thought of loving you more,
could i die there and justice was made on my life...
Yet, the very shadow of misfortune hanged around
our very heads... we knew about the next day and
i can't think how we could find such a peace on such
a dreadfull moment. The next day the dream was over.
How can i survive? I guess im finding out...
- Here lives Kidd, still searching...
  to Mijke

rooms.Name: #BThe Sept of a Deep One.#N
rooms.Description:
You are in a small clearing in what seem to be a endless forest. 
Strange, you think as you are sure that this is within the walls of 
the TRI-clanhouse. But considering it is the home of Egba Glob, you 
are not really surprised. The climate in here is very moist and you 
feel really refreshed. In the centre of the clearing is a small 
statue of some very odd deity. It is surrounded by large heaps of 
gold and jewellery, weapons, bloodstenched armours and one or two 
dismembered peasants. This surely is: the Home of Egba Glob the Furry 
Deep One.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The statue shows a strange entity.
A massive body with large pods,
crude arms, huge leathery bat wings 
and a head that looks like a gigantic octopus. 
And the eyes.......

You hear yourself say : CHUTHULU !!!  I hear and obey !

rooms.Name: #BHath's Lair#N
rooms.Description:
What is this!? - You wonder as you step inside his lair. The room 
that from the outside looked so warm and cozy has turned into an icy 
and dark lair as you step over the threshold. Gloom and sadness is 
lurking here in the shadows, making you feel uncomfortable.  It's 
cold here, so very cold. A chilly wind is blowing from nowhere.  A 
large bed is placed in the middle of the lair. Above the bed there is 
circular window in the roof, from there you can see the dark starlit 
sky and the Northern lights dancing seductively. In the middle of the 
bed you can see an old torn teddy-bear. You smile a bit as you see 
it. Everyone, no matter how strong, needs some comfort and support 
when times are tough.
   On one of the Icy walls you can see a carving of a red dragon on a 
snow-covered mountain top. There are a Sun and a Moon on each side of 
the mountain, facing each other. From the dragon's nostrils and 
mouth, a cone of cold can be seen as it breaths. It is probably the 
first time you've seen a red dragon breathe something other than 
fire. The carving looks very much alive and you can almost feel the 
serpent eyes watch you as you move along. Strange indeed.
   Then on the floor under the bed you can see a half-written book 
about the clan called TRI. "Hath's guide to TRI" it's called. You 
open it andread the first lines in the introduction.

"This is the book written by me, Hath. I am a TRI in heart and will 
always be no matter what. Of me you can ask the way of a true TRI, 
beginner as a master, lawful or chaotic. Everyone is welcome.
Here the story begins..."

rooms.Name: #BGoddess's retreat#N
rooms.Description:
A thousand years ago, supersition and the sword ruled.  It was a time 
of darkness it was the age of gargolyes.  Stone by day warriors by 
night.  As a gargoyle  I have sworn to protect my clan.  I am the 
defender of the TRI Clan. I am Demona the Gargoyle.

Insences fill the room reminding you of a far off land.  Silken 
sashes hang from the ceiling making it hard to judge the size of the 
room.  Eerie melodies waft across the air.  You feel a peace, a 
oneness with yourself and the world around.  You have entered a calm 
state.  Thoughts of the world of mobs and  levels fade like a distant 
stome. A voice speaks out and says, 'Come, relax, and enjoy all I can 
offer.  One request, please check your egos at the door.
§N

rooms.Name: #BA Teddybear's Hideyhole#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter the room a sparkling veil of wind carresses your heart
and soul, cleansing your aura to the deepest of blues. Icecream trees 
and popsical plants spring up amidst the great big flowers which emit an
apple fragrence. You see teddybears playing carefree amongst large
pillows and comfy blankies. A wonderful waterfall flows from a 
refreshing stream of orange juice that circles this teddybear paradise.
The beat of a faint song whispers soothing sounds in your ears,
instinctively moving your body joyfully to its tempting lure. A twinkle
catches your eye and you see a small angel beckoning you to follow her
and you are lead to a trail deep within this haven.
You search around to find that the angel has disappeared. After much 
wandering, you come upon a floating scroll encased in shimmering glass
surrounded by the most beautiful roses ever seen. You feel youself drawn 
to learn of these magical words and discover an angel sitting on the
glass singing the words - it was always you and me, always and forever - 
You are suddenly filled with a peace like no other as you are carried 
by these words. As the angel finishes her song, she whispers to you once
more - welcome to the home of Bod and Drusian - and quickly vanishes
leaving a faint mist of blue sparkles.

rooms.Name: #bThe Entrance to the Fortress#N
rooms.Description:
You have arrived at the entrance to a large fortress.  Even though
the walls are extremely high, you manage to make out a castle in the
distance. You hear clanging from the other side of the wall, loud 
enough to make you wonder if there's a battle on the other side. 
Sparks of bright light emerge from the castle, and sounds of 
explosions can be heard in the distance. If you are not welcome, you 
think it would be a good idea to depart before the occupants realize 
you are here. You wonder if the gargoyle has a copy of the guest 
list?

Exits.Description: The Courtyard
Clara's Field o' Daisies

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Before you stands a gargoyle of immense proportions. It appears to be 
made out of stone, but just like the fortress ahead, it is scary 
enough. It appears ready to come to life at any moment and pounch on 
you.  You wonder who made the gargoyle, for it is so large it would 
have taken an extremely advanced magical expertise to construct it.

rooms.Name: #bThe Courtyard#N
rooms.Description:
You have reached the inside of the fortress. Before you stands the
largest castle you have ever seen. It's not the most beautiful 
fortress you have ever seen, in fact it has the gloomy look of just 
having survived a major siege. Chunks of stone are missing here and 
there. All around you various activity is commencing. You see big 
figures watching little ones. You get the impression that a good deal 
of training is going on here. All around there are various machines 
of war set up. To your left is a catapult, to your right are some 
wooden contraptions. Just as you feel you are getting in someone's 
way the front door to the castle begins to raise.

Exits.Description: Chamber of Wizardry

rooms.Name: #bChamber of Wizardry#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered a room glowing with mystical energy. You see 
many people shrouded in black clothing muttering incantations. You 
can only guess that this is where the occupants test their magical 
abilities. In the corner you see a bookshelf stacked with bound 
books. They surely contain the secrets of these magical masters. 
Through the occaisonal lightning bolt which lingers your way you see 
staves, scrolls, and flasked all along the ground and on tables. You 
decide to leave the room before something powerful strays your way.

rooms.Name: #bThe Reception Room#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter the castle, you can't help but notice all the 
archways and the immense size of the reception room. You don't notice 
any servants, but rather see a whole host of dominant figures wearing 
dark clothing. The floor is decorated with a lush red rug, and there 
are various red and black banners hanging from the wall. It looks as 
if it had been recently redecorated. The battle damage doesn't appear 
as bad in here, but there are overturned articles of furniture laying 
around. Everyone is gathered around something, perhaps you should 
take a look?

rooms.Name: #bThe Council Chamber#N
rooms.Description:
You roam into a room full of arguing people. In the center of the
room is a large table, rectangular in shape, with a large man at the 
head of the table. He looks annoyed to see all his companions out of 
their seats screaming at the top of their lungs. The chairs, mostly 
empty, are exquisitely made, with large bones representing the arm 
rests and skulls for hand rests. The table itself had blood all over 
it, yet none of the arguing parties appear to be injured in any way. 
You decide to leave without asking any questions.

rooms.Name: #bA Junction of Stairs#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered a compact hallway, with steps leading downwards
and upwards. You hear moans coming from both the basement and 
second floor. The downward steps must lead to the crypts below this 
evil castle. The steps up lead to things you can only guess at. The 
hallway itself is stained with large amounts of blood and has 
incomplete skeletons laying all around you.

rooms.Name: #bEntrance to the Crypt#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered perhaps the darkest room you have ever witnessed.
Several skulls are hanging along the walls, glowing with an unnatural
aura. You can barely make out several exits leading in all directions.
The containers of the dead housed in this room of the crypt have been 
overturned, and pieces of the coffins' occupants are strewn about the 
room. You are confronted by moans and groans from each direction, 
helping you very little in deciding a safe path to take.

rooms.Name: #bThe Vault#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered the armory of the current occupants. All around 
you are mass weapons of war. You see swords, staves, maces, axes, 
shields, and armors of all varieties. There are also many occult 
objects with special magical powers such as rings and amulets. Only 
the best can be found in here, demonstrating the wealth of the 
occupying force. Even the simplest of their weapons are inlaid with 
delicate gems and carvings. The rest of the room is a total mess. 
They clearly have used the resting place of countless souls as a 
storage space for their weapons which create even more mindless 
corpses.

rooms.Name: #bThe Mortuary#N
rooms.Description:
The room you have just entered was what was probably a mortuary at
some point. You see all kinds of wonderful gadgets to aid in preparing
dead bodies for their final rest in the crypts. Unfortuantely it has 
changed from a place of eternal rest to a place of eternal life. 
Countless alchemists have set up shop in here, healing both old 
Legionaires and preparing new corpses for eternal service to the 
Legion. As expected you see countless flasks laying around 
everywhere. You also see bodies who would have died easily from their 
wounds brought back to life by the alchemists' sinister magic.

rooms.Name: #bThe Leaders' Chambers#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered the room of all rooms in this structure. All of 
the fortress' activity is coordinated in this room. You see the two 
immortal leaders of the Legion, #bShayde#N and #bVampyre#N, being 
administered by their personal advisors. They are discussing new 
strategies and experimenting on new kinds of powerful magic worthy 
of their devoted attention. You see they act very friendly towards 
their companions, yet the companions have a kind of fear, instilled 
only by utmost terror and respect. There are dozens of maps and books 
sprawled all over the several tables occupying this room. Up above 
you see a bright light, the brightest you have seen in the entire 
castle.  The personal chambers of Vampyre and Shayde lie to the east 
and west, while the northern passage leads into a massive hallway 
toward the council quarters.

Exits.Description: The Dark Realm of Shade lies to the west.

rooms.Name: #bDark Realm of Shayde#N
rooms.Description:
This room is filled with a cold mist that smells of death.
You can feel a powerful energy here, emitting a magical aura
stronger than anything you have ever felt.  There is an open
coffin in the middle of the room, with a name brazed upon the
lid.  Inside the coffin, there are two #bdaggers#N, the blades
crossed to perfect symetry.  In the northwest corner of the
room, there is a misty doorway leading toward Nymph's room.
Shayde is nowhere to be found...  You wonder if all the rumors
about him are true.  Some people say that he is not human at
all, that nobody has ever seen him eat or sleep.  Some even
say that he is immortal, only pretending to be human to serve
his own purposes.  Before you finish that thought, an icy wind
howls past you, and for just one moment, you think you heard
somebody whispering a word to you...  It sounded like...  "Janus".

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The coffin has the name "Dark Shayde" brazed upon the lid in
electric blue letters.  The two daggers belong to Shayde and
Vampyre, and respectively have the words etched into the blades,
"Soren" and "Sartre".

There are many arcane formulas and runes swirling around a central
quotation from some ancient scripture.  It reads, #w"#bThe Black Wind
Howls...#w"#N

You cant seem to make out a bottom to this abyss, and it might not
be a very good idea to examine it any closer.  There are faint 
whisperings coming from deep inside...  You cant seem to make them 
out, but it sounds something like #w"#bSkai Draka, Shay Vampyrica, 
Deth...#w"#N What could this possibly mean?  The cold air sends 
chills up your spine.

rooms.Name: #bVampyre's Lair#N
rooms.Description:
You enter a room covered with mist and fog. It is hard to believe
that this could exist in a castle. In fact it is a room conjured by
powerful magic. In the corner you see a pair of glowing eyes. Surely 
they belong to Vampyre, a powerful mage of the clan, Dark Legion. 
You cannot help but wonder what your fate may be. You quickly 
glance around for an exit. But to no avail, you only find a shelf 
full of potions and books, and a rack full of advanced weapons years 
beyond the current genre of weaponry. Just as you think you are at 
Vampyre's mercy, he smiles and kindly casts the most friendly and 
useful of spells on you.

rooms.Name: #bA Long Dark Hallway#N
rooms.Description:
The hallway continues to the north, or leads south back to the 
chamber of the clan leaders.  There are large wooden doors to the 
east and west that each have a plaque in the center with a name 
engraved in gothic letters.  The western door reads "#bNymph#N", 
while the eastern door reads "#bDrakkon#N".

rooms.Name: #bA Long Dark Hallway#N
rooms.Description:
The hallway continues to the north, or leads south back to the 
southern end of the hallway.  There are large wooden doors to the 
east and west that each have a plaque in the center with a name 
engraved in gothic letters.  The western door reads "#bHalcyon#N", 
while the eastern door reads "#bGenso#N".

rooms.Name: #bA Long Dark Hallway#N
rooms.Description:
The hallway continues to the north, or leads south back to the 
southern end of the hallway.  There are large wooden doors to the 
east and west that each have a plaque in the center with a name 
engraved in gothic letters.  The western door reads "#bLegion#N", 
while the eastern door reads "#bKrypt#N".

rooms.Name: #bThe End of the Hallway#N
rooms.Description:
The hallway has come to an end.  Besides the doors at your sides, 
you have no choice but to head back south down the hallway.  There 
are two last large wooden doors to the east and west that each have a 
plaque in the center with a name engraved in gothic letters.  The 
western door reads "#bDeathlord#N", while the eastern door reads 
"#bSteellord#N".

rooms.Name: #bA Darkened Chamber#N
rooms.Description:
This small, dank chamber is harshly illuminated by a single, 
flickering candle mounted on the far wall.  The cobbled walls are slick 
and damp and reflect the light ominously, giving the appearance of 
constant movement across the mouldy #btapestries#N that hang from them.  
A heavy, granite sarcophagus sits on a wrought-iron pedestal, dominating 
the room.  The carved #brunes#N that decorate the lid give the stone coffin
an undeniable sense of antiquity, while the thick layer of muddy dust 
that cakes the coffin and covers the floor gives the room a cold, dead, 
abandoned feel.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tapestries were once colorful, but have now faded to dull greys.
Cobwebs cloud the images and the yellowing cords that fringe the edge of 
the pictures hang limply, damp and brown.  The tapestry to the left 
appears to be of a #bwoman#N, while the one on the right displays what 
could have been a #bwarrior#N.

A warrior stands in front of smudged figures in this tapestry.  The 
figures are all faceless and the fabric of the tapestry is badly damaged 
where they stand, but the warrior himself is still somewhat colorful.  A 
blue phoenix decorates his tunic, and his sword was once made to appear 
to glow before the brightness faded from the cloth.

A dark-skinned woman with white, braided hair stands in a castle in this
tapestry.  Her wings indicate that she is clearly meant to be an angel, 
but the subtle, menacing look to her grey eyes and they way her knuckles 
are whitened by the way her hands clutch a gem make her appear far too 
malevolent to be angelic.  A closer look shows tears, badly faded by the 
age of the tapestry, in the corners of her eyes.

The old, worn runes bear a few strange words, spaced close together and
lined with deep, simple edging.  The runes are in a language once used 
but which now only appears in scholarly works.  It appears to be nothing 
more than a list of names.

   Sinner  Pendragon  Zumdahl  Percival  Ember  Jade  Vulcan  Rigel  Evil
       Jesta   Mordred   Soulcatcher   Deimos  Kris   Nibor  Darius

rooms.Name: #bDrakkon's Empty Room#N
rooms.Description: This room is in need of a description.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The two statues seem to be made of night itself... dark, black a
sense of foreboding grips you.  Then you see one of the eyes blink
slowly...  Death walks the land.

"Blood to Blood, we stand... by our Dark Power we
Conquer as our friend Death walks the Land."

rooms.Name: #bThe Chambers of Halcyon#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter the chambers of Halcyon, you are suddenly
embraced by a feeling of peace and harmony. The walls
are draped in sky blue silk. The music of windchimes
floats gently in the breeze coming from the eastern
window. Scents of lavender and chamomile hang in the
air. To your right is Halcyon's desk. Its surface is
in an organized state of disarray, piled with pages of
poetry and her journals. The shelves surrounding her
desk contain literature both old and new. To your left
is an inviting bed, made up in white linen. Stacks of
books surround it. Under her pillow is a lock of #rred#N
tied up in a black cord.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This lock of bright ruby-red hair is tied up in a cord
and kept safely by Halcyon.  It looks about the same
color as Genso's hair...

rooms.Name: #bYoung Master Genso's Room#N
rooms.Description:
This room is strangely empty.  There is no furniture
or bed in sight.  Against the wall nearest you, there is
a small shrine, where Genso honors his Samurai ancestors.
There are various weapons, mostly katana swords, resting
on the floor and against the wall.  One sword in particular
looks quite deadly, and has the word "Murasame" engraved
on the blade.  In the same corner that this sword rests,
there is a small mat and pillow on the floor, where Genso
sleeps.  Under his pillow is a lock of #ygold#N tied up in
a black cord.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This lock of yellow hair, as bright as the sun, is tied up
in a cord and kept safely by Genso.  Surely this dazzling
lock of flaxen hair could only belong to fair Halcyon.

rooms.Name: #bDark Legion's Tower#N
rooms.Description:
You are in Legion's Tower. The bottom of the tower
serves as a living area. There is a column of fire
burning in the center of the room. The flame illuminates
the entire room with its fiery glow. The walls are covered
with weapons and armors from all over Elite. Most of the
equipment is bloodstained and shows other signs of use in
battle. Maybe you should leave before Legion returns and your 
blood is the next to stain his blade.....

rooms.Name: #bKrypt's Inner Sanctum#N
rooms.Description:
A large but tidy room filled with candles, smoke and artwork taken
from battles won on every nation known to man.  There is a cool draft
coming from what seems to be every direction.  In the corner there is
a large collection of books, mostly well used and worn.  In the 
middle of the room is a large altar made to the God Yeshua whom he 
serves. Against the far wall is his large collection of equipment and
treasure.

rooms.Name: #bShadowy Room of Deathlord#N
rooms.Description:
As you walk through the walnut door, a narrow cavern is revealed 
which leads you down deep into a smoke filled room.  Its a small room 
that is fogged with cool mist, and it lit only by a few fiery torches 
on the rocky walls.  There is a large hole in the center of the room, 
but you cannot make anything out when you look inside of it.  You can 
only guess at why Deathlord being the powerful mage that he is would 
choose to live in such an atmosphere.  The shadows seem to be 
increasing rapidly, and an eerie moaning echoes from down inside the 
black hole.

rooms.Name: #bShrine of Steellord#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter this room you feel a sirene calmness come over you. A 
subtle scent fills the room. Looking around the room, the first thing 
to catch your eyes is a chest on the far right of the room. As you 
step closer you can see a rather large amethyst crystal ball resting 
on the top of a sillver stand. Scattered around the stand are smaller 
pieces of various crystal. Next to the bed is a small wooden stand 
with a tall, deep green candle sitting on fur.   Lying next to the candle
is a large, very old, leather bound book  that looks to be 
very tattered & torn.  On the other side of the room you see a small 
fountain sitting near the far corner.  Water slowly caresses the 
stone  with a solid black crystal ball spinning on top of the water. 
To the left of the fountain you see an old sword, a shield, set of 
chain armor, and a cloak. Lying upon the floor you see several 
different fur rugs. On the walls there are many different paintings 
of battles & slain dragons. One has a man in it showing off a dragon 
that he has slain.  On the floor oppisite the bed there is a very 
large crystal ball on a stand.  As you start to leave the room you 
notice a small ferret following you nipping at your feet. Just as you 
start to pick it up it scuttles off.

rooms.Name: #C[ #yG#wates of Izumo outside wall #c]#N
rooms.Description:
You stand before the outside wall of the Izumo Empire. The wall is
made of huge granite blocks and a tight archway leads inside. The same
archway has a builtin iron gate widely open. Inside you see vast fields
of green grass cutted by a orange bricked road leading north, wich goes
across a small village leading to a huge white ivory tower.
You can see some strange #Cw#cr#Nitin#cg#Cs #Ncarved in one block in 
your right side.

Exits.Description: You can see clearly the orange road leading to Izumo Castle.
There is no other way than death itself.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
#CI#cz#Nu#cm#Co #CE#cm#Npi#cr#Ce#N.

Enter at your own risk! From this point on, Izumo laws prevail.

rooms.Name: #C[ #yT#whrough the Archway #C]#N
rooms.Description:
You dared to go inside! You are inside of a dark tunel in the
Outside wall of Izumo Empire. The archway is illuminated by the light
of burning torches wich are in the walls, you can see that the orange
road starts some steps ahead of you and leads north.

Exits.Description:
The orange road starts here, and seems to lead to Castle Izumo through
Izumo Village.
You can still see 2 guards guarding the main gate.

rooms.Name: #C[ #yT#whe path to doom #C]#N
rooms.Description:
You made the wrong option, and some weird device just triggered a
gadget wich launched a arrow and that hitted you right between the
eyes. You can still hear the echo of your screams and feel the cold
stell going through your skull shattering everything.

rooms.Name: #C[ #yB#wegining of orange road #C]#N
rooms.Description:
You stand at the begining of the orange road. The distance to Izumo
castle seems much smaller, and the village of Izumo starts right ahead.
You notice that the habitants are rather good looking and nice or bad
looking and unpleasant, there seems to be no middle term in this land
knows as Izumo.

Exits.Description: The orange road continues towards the castle through the village.
To the west far from the village you see a Green House.
The gates and the outside walls seem to be more distant.

rooms.Name: #C[ #yA#wlong the orange road #C]#N
rooms.Description:
You are walking alonside the orange road and the village of Izumo
is right ahead of you. This strange smell in the air is an assault
to your senses, it seems to be the smell of #yb#wurning #yn#wapalm 
#Nmixed with a strange flower based perfume. Over you head vultures 
fly in circles looking for their next meal. You wander if they have 
spoted you.

Exits.Description: The first houses of Izumo village are right ahead.
The main gates seem to be even more far than before.
You can see a small building... Should you go in ?.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These wicked birds are always keeping an eye on food. It seems they
might be interested in you.

rooms.Name: #C[ #yB#weginning of Izumo Village #C]#N
rooms.Description:
You are inside of Izumo Village, right next to the first houses.
You realise that this is a very small village and has only a couple of
houses. From your right you sense a weird smell wich you identify has
wine, on your right you see a flat one floor building made of wood and
stone with a funny yellow roof. It holds a sign on the door. Ahead of
you the orange road continues toward the castle.

Exits.Description: You really hate to walk to much with this hot weather.
Are you afraid of something ? Being followed ?.
You look through the doors and all you can see is fun.
You can't see nothing, but you ear screams coming from inside.

rooms.Name: #C[ #yT#whe Izumo Inn #C]#N
rooms.Description:
You are inside a luxorous Inn, and it seems you are their only
costumer for a long time, by the time you step ahead a young #Ywaiter#N
jumps towards you direction and informs you that the Inn is closed.
You get angry and start cussing at him, he steps back and afraid tells
you that you should visit the floor above. You can see the stairs right
from your position, but just as precaussion you wield your #rb#Rl#wood#Re#rd#N
blade before going up.

Exits.Description:
You notice that the sun is starting to fade by looking the orange brinks
on the road.

The stairs lead up and are made of white marble with a red carpet over
them.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
He looks like a scared fool, you must look very mean and agressive.
You spit on him.

waiter - "#YPlease Sir, dont beat me up! I will serve you well#N"

You grin evilly at him.

rooms.Name: #C[ #yT#whe Penthouse #C]#N
rooms.Description:
You stand in a luxurious room, with a dark oak huge bed wich seems
to be big enough for three persons, you check ur private jacuzzi and
the clean towels. The waiter had followed you and seems to be waiting
for something. You look at the nice black leather mapple near the
fireplace and wonder how good it might be to seat there and enjoy a
relaxed time reading your favourite book, "The history of Izumo".

Exits.Description: You notice that the waiter has disapeared through the stairway.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You - "#rGet lost idiot!!#N" 
You spit on him and he runs away scared.

waiter - "#rHe is mean, I want my mommy!!#N"

rooms.Name: #C[ #yG#wlimsdale's #yS#whack #C]#N
rooms.Description:
You stand in a huge dark navy blue room. On your left side there is
a fireplace with the arms of #yG#wl#Nimsdale#N the #yL#wunatic#N, and the arms of
#rS#wilverstar#N the #rG#worgeous#N. Here is their home. On the wall at your right
you see a wonderfull collection of weapons, Fugu blades, axes, halberds
and a set of weird staff's. In the middle of the room there is huge
dark oak table wich seems that it isnt used for a long time. Ahead of
you is a wall with a huge mirror wich distorts your image making you
look like a fool, indeed a weird place. The room is illuminated by a
dark blue light wich comes from the fireplace, giving the room a
mystical atmosphere.

Exits.Description:
You can see the sun shining outside and you wanna go there because this
room scares you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The are some runes. You try to read them,

"#rLudul Bel Nemeqi Ta#N"
"#rNaramtu Dianau Apsu#N"

You wonder what they mean.

rooms.Name: #C[ #yB#wefore the Castle of Izumo #C]#N
rooms.Description:
You see the Castle of Izumo on the hill ahead of you. This mighty
fortress wich has never been taken stands here making you feel small
and tiny. On your right you have a strange stone building wich has no
seen exits or ways to go in, you ear also very weird noises inside,
screams and sounds wich indicate someone is being beaten up inside, or
even tortured... On your left you have a the last building of the
village wich has a huge board on top with something writed on it. You
have no clue on where to go, north, south or west!

Exits.Description: This path leads to Castle Izumo
Very far you can see the outside walls of Izumo Empire.
You see a huge golden archway wich leads inside of the building.
To the east you can see a huge Shrine, looks like a holy place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: #yI#wzumo #yH#wigh #yC#wouncil

rooms.Name: #C[ #yT#whe Slammer#C }]#N
rooms.Description:
You are in a no exit room, you seem powerless inside of this room.
You can see through the steel bars in the tiny window the Castle of
Izumo on the top of the hill and a huge army of Templar Knights and
Pikers is moving towards the city leaded by their fearless lider
Glimsdale, probably to join the Armies of the Dark Lord Ninja to aid
in the aid of Izumo Emperor in the battle against the Mighty Chicken
of the Yew Forest. Sir Dalamar, the one not so brave as Sir Glimsdale
and not so pure as Dark Lord Ninja, follows Sir Glimsdale. Sir Dalamar
the one who pissed his pants at the Siege of Rome and who fled at the
Battle of Zurandar wields proudly his Ebony Kris.

rooms.Name: #C[ #yI#wzumo High Council#C ]#N
rooms.Description:
You stand in a room with huge carpets hanged on the walls with the
history of Izumo. You feel powerless when compared to the Knights and
people who fought those battles. One special one draws your attention,
the one with the ancestors of Sir Glimsdale, leader of the Royal House
of Dawn, Morgul the bastard, the mighty warrior who gathered the 8
artifacts needed to summon the Sacred Dragon Arsgalt wich defeated the
Evil Sorcerer Madruk in ancient times. You feel like crying and hope
someday there can be one of you and your great deeds. There is also a
pentagonal table for the High Powers of Izumo. One of the house of
Dawn, another for the Ninja the Dark Warlord, one for the represant of
the Izumo Legends, the Kings place and finally one for the representant
of the people, this is indeed ur place.

Exits.Description: The orange road is outside.
There is a small black ivory stairway leading down.
There is a small black ivory stairway leading to the condemned room

rooms.Name: #C[ #yA#wt the gates of Castle Izumo #C]#N
rooms.Description:
From nowhere two huge #RT#wemplar #RK#wnights #Nand Faerlan the
leader of the King's Guard jump over you, they beat you up so hard and
painfully that the blood painted the entire gates of the castle, you
bleed a lot. The entrance to the castle is forbiden to fools like you!.

rooms.Name: #C[ #yT#whe Anarchy Armoury #C]#N
