rooms.Description:
You are standing in the courtyard of the seventh floor. You seemed to have
come in during some form of competition. Warriors are sparring against each
other as the younger trainees look on with awe.

Exits.Description: North is the Shogun's chamber.
Sounds of writing come from the west.

rooms.Name: Shogun of Shin
rooms.Description:
You stand in the chamber dedicated to the Shogun of Shin. His clothing is
bright and powerful. His eyes are piercing. He glares at you, frowns, and draws
his sword. He knows why you are here.

Exits.Description: The courtyard is south of you.
Stairs lead upward

rooms.Name: Eighth Floor Landing
rooms.Description:
You have finally reached the eighth floor, the final floor in this bizarre
and twisted world that mirrors ancient Japan. But wait a minute, you glance out
a nearby window and find that you are not at the top yet. You sigh and continue
onward.

Exits.Description: South of here is something.
West of here is something.

rooms.Name: Shogun of Tei
rooms.Description:
You stand before the Shogun of Tei. This Shogun is the man you always see in
ancient pictures who is helping the aged and humble. You find that this man
looks at you with a caring glance and almost shows you pity before he draws his
weapon.

Exits.Description: A landing is north of you.
Stairs lead upwards from here.

rooms.Name: An Empty Room
rooms.Description:
You are in an empty room. There is nothing in the room. Furniture is not
here, lights are not here (although the walls DO glow). It's rather odd.

Exits.Description: A landing is to your east.
Something lies to your south.

rooms.Name: Musty Room
rooms.Description:
You are in a musty room. You see some older, more experienced samurai here
in a semicircular group around a mark on the floor. They glance up at you and
scream death cries. You kinda stumbled in on a private party . . .

Exits.Description: North of here is an empty room.

rooms.Name: The Top
rooms.Description:
You have finally reached the top of the temple! You find yourself staring
face to face with the ultimate Samurai himself. His presence is overwhelming!
Many people have made guesses about death and dying. Looks like your questions
will soon be answered.

rooms.Name: Northwest end of Concourse
rooms.Description:
You are at the concourse, the city wall is just west. A small promenade goes
east, and the bridge is just north of here. The concourse continues south along
the city wall.

Exits.Description: You see the Bridge.
You see the promenade.
The promenade continues far south.
Wall road continues west of here.

rooms.Name: Promenade
rooms.Description:
The river gently flows west just north of here. The promenade continues
further east and to the west you see the city wall. Park Road leads south from
here.

Exits.Description: The promenade.
Park Road leads south.
You see the Concourse.

rooms.Name: Promenade
rooms.Description:
The river gently flows west just north of here. The promenade continues both
east and west. South of here you see the entrance to the park, and a small
building seems to be just west of the entrance.

Exits.Description: You see the promenade.
You see the park entrance.
You see the promenade.

rooms.Name: Promenade
rooms.Description:
The river gently flows west just north of here. The promenade continues both
east and west. A small path leads south. Looking across the river you see the
levee.

Exits.Description: You see the Concourse.
The small path leads south.
You see the promenade.

rooms.Name: Northeast end of Concourse
rooms.Description:
You are at the Concourse. The city wall is just east and a small promenade
goes west. Looking across the river you see a building that resembles a
warehouse. The Concourse continues south along the city wall.  To the north
beyond large golden gates stands a huge green palace.

Exits.Description:
To the north stands a large school.  So large it blows your mind.  Which,
being a psionicists' school, is undoubtedly what was intended.
The Concourse continues south.
You see the promenade.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each other with
some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

rooms.Name: Park Entrance
rooms.Description:
You are standing just inside the small park of Midgaard. To the north is the
promenade and a small path leads south into the park. To your east is the
famous Park Cafe.

Exits.Description: You see the promenade.
You see Park Cafe.
You see the park.

rooms.Name: Park Cafe
rooms.Description:
You are inside Park Cafe, a very cozy place with many tables and seats where
you can relax and enjoy the view. To the east you can see the entrance to the
park.

Exits.Description: You see the park entrance.

rooms.Name: Small path through the park
rooms.Description:
You are walking along a small path through the park. The path continues
south and east.

rooms.Name: Small path in the park
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a small path inside the park. The park entrance is just
north of here, and Park Cafe is just east of the entrance. The path leads
further east and west.

Exits.Description: You see the northern park entrance.

rooms.Name: Small path in the park
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path running through the park. It continues west and
south and just north of here you see the southern wall of Park Cafe.

rooms.Name: Cityguard Headquarters
rooms.Description: You are inside a tidy office.

Exits.Description: You see the park road.

rooms.Name: Park Road
rooms.Description:
The road continues north and south. A building is just west of here, you
notice a sign on the door. The park entrance is to the east.

Exits.Description: You see the park entrance.
You see the cityguard head quarters.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign on the door says:-

                 Cityguard Head Quarters

           WARNING: Authorized Personnel Only!

rooms.Name: Western Park Entrance
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the western end of the park. A small path leads east
into the park and going west through the entrance you will reach Park Road.

rooms.Name: A path in the park
rooms.Description:
You are in the park. The paths lead north and west. Westward is the park
entrance and to the east you see a small pond.

Exits.Description: You see the pond.
You see the western park entrance.

rooms.Name: The Pond
rooms.Description:
You are swimming around in the pond, feeling rather stupid. You can get back
on the path from the eastern and western end of the pond.

rooms.Name: A path in the park
rooms.Description:
You are in the park. The paths lead north and east. Eastward is the park
entrance and to the west you see a small pond.

rooms.Name: Eastern Park Entrance
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the eastern end of the park. A small path leads west
into the park. Going east through the entrance you will reach Emerald Avenue.

rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the north end of Emerald Avenue. To the north is the
promenade and to the west is the park entrance. To the east is the not very big
Town Hall of Midgaard.

rooms.Name: Park Road
rooms.Description:
You are on Park Road which leads north and south. A cottage is just east of
here.

Exits.Description: You see a small cottage with an oaken door. A name plate has been set on it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The name 'Papi Llon' has been carved into the name plate.

rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
rooms.Description: You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue. The road leads north and west.

rooms.Name: Road Crossing
rooms.Description:
You are in the middle of the road cross. Roads lead in all directions. A
huge black iron chain as thick as a tree trunk is fastened into the ground at
the center of the road cross. Its other end leads directly upwards towards the
sky. A road sign is here.

Exits.Description: The chain disappears in the clouds.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The chain reaches the clouds high above you.  It must take some really
powerful magic to hold such a chain in place.

The sign points in all directions:

   North - Emerald Avenue.
   East  - Park Road.
   South - Emerald Avenue.
   West  - Park Road.

Someone has added the following with red paint:

   Up    - Redferne's Flying Citadel.

rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
rooms.Description: You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue. The road leads south and east.

rooms.Name: Park Road
rooms.Description:
You are on Park Road which leads south and north. Elm Street is east of
here.

rooms.Name: Elm Street
rooms.Description:
You are on Elm street. Park Road is to the west and Elm Street continues in
eastward direction.

rooms.Name: End of Elm Street
rooms.Description: You are at the end of Elm Street. An old elm tree grows here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The fresh young leaves of the elm tree wave gently in the wind.

rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
rooms.Description:
You are on Emerald Avenue which continues north. The Concourse is south of
here.

rooms.Name: Park Road
rooms.Description:
You are on Park Road which continues north. The Concourse is south of here.
An old two-story house is to the east.

Exits.Description: A heavy oaken door is to the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at it, the goblin door knocker comes alive!

The head splutters 'Tiz iz da houze uff Kwiff...  Kuiffe...  Qwiff...  Erhm...'
The head splutters 'Quiff...  Quiffil...  Ne'er mind!  Quiffy livez ere!'

It opens its mouth wide and gobbles 'Unlokk me!'

The house is obviously very old and needs painting.  The heavy oaken door is
equipped with a brass door knocker shaped as a goblin's head.  No name plate
is to be seen anywhere.

rooms.Name: On the Concourse
rooms.Description:
You are at the southwest corner of the city wall. The Concourse leads both
north and east.

rooms.Name: On the Concourse
rooms.Description:
The Concourse continues both east and west. Emerald Avenue is north of here.
To the south you can leave midgaard through the south gate.

rooms.Name: On the Concourse
rooms.Description:
The Concourse continues both east and west. Park Road is north of here and
an iron grate leads south to the graveyard.

Exits.Description: Through the solid iron bars you see the graveyard.

rooms.Name: On the Concourse
rooms.Description:
You are at the southeast corner of the city wall. The Concourse leads both
north and west.

rooms.Name: Park Road
rooms.Description: You are at Park Road which continues north and south.

rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
rooms.Description:
You are at Emerald Avenue which continues north and south. Penny Lane leads
east from here.

rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
rooms.Description:
You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue. To the east the road goes on
and to the south is the Road Crossing.

rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
rooms.Description:
You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue. To the west the road goes on
and to the north is the Road Crossing.

rooms.Name: Park Road
rooms.Description:
You are at a bend on Park Road. To the north the road goes on and to the
east is the Road Crossing.

rooms.Name: Park Road
rooms.Description:
You are at a bend on Park Road. To the south the road goes on and to the
west is the Road Crossing.

rooms.Name: The Waiting Room
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the waiting room at the town hall. Wooden chairs stand
along the walls and a long desk with a typewriter is placed in the middle of
the room.

Exits.Description: It looks like some kind of office.
The exit west leads to Emerald Avenue.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is an ancient Quifatronic T-1000 mk I.  These machines are known for their
incredible durability, and for their even more incredible weight.  They make
a Cray II look like a laptop.

An extremely heavy desk.  It is so large that it doesn't even need drawers.
Everything can be stored on its top.
Not the very least comfortable.

rooms.Name: The Mayor's Office
rooms.Description:
You are in the not very big office of the Mayor of Midgaard. A large and
polished but completely empty desk is standing in front of an armchair that
looks so comfortable that it most of all resembles a bed with the head end
raised slightly.

Exits.Description: The waiting room is to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This chair is really a masterpiece.  A chair where one can sit as comfortably
as in a bed.  All auditoriums should be equipped with these things.  A shame
that there wouldn't be room for the students too, though.

This desk is obviously very old.  Nevertheless it looks as if has never been
used.

rooms.Name: Penny Lane
rooms.Description:
You are on Penny Lane. Emerald Avenue is to the west and Penny Lane
continues in eastward direction.

rooms.Name: Penny Lane
rooms.Description: You are on Penny Lane. The narrow road continues north and west.

rooms.Name: End of Penny Lane
rooms.Description: You are at the end of Penny Lane. The only exit appears to be south.

rooms.Name: #yOn the river before a narrow passage#N
rooms.Description:
Through a narrow passage to the north you can spot the HUMBLE CASTLE
(hmm..) of the NIGHT TRIBE Order lying on top of a large cliff in a 
gigantic cave.  Two immortal DEMONS are guarding the narrow passage to the
cave, trapped here by powerfull magic that seem to eminate from the
castle itself. One of the demons warn you: - You take one more step in
this direction I'll rip your head off.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Well thats probably the understatment of the year but hey we night
tribers are modest.
This is really the best clan around.

The castle seems to glow in the dark from the precious stones decorating
its walls forming an arcane magical pattern.

If your not a night tribe member your in big trouble. Mayby if you keep to 
the middle and run real fast you can get through without the demons 
having you for dinner.

rooms.Name: #yOn the jetty in the gigantic CAVE#N
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a small JETTY on the rocky shore below the
castle. The only way up to the castle seems to be a small path leading 
north from the jetty snakeing itself upwards between the cliffs. A couple 
of small BOATS made of wood are tied to the jetty. To the south you see 
the two guardian demons standing in the water, watching you closely. For 
some reason you get the feeling that they are hungry. (some boats to be
loaded)

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The small wooden jetty is well worn but seems to be in perfect condition.

These small wooden rowingboats are here floating on the water just waiting  
for a member of the Night Tribe to use them.

You can see waterdrops falling from the celing making a small sound 
hitting the cave floor and suddenly you realise that there is a sort of a 
background noise coming from thousands of small waterdrops that almost 
sounds like rain.

The gigantic cave streches out deeper into the hart of the moria mountains 
with thousands of STALACTITES hanging down from the celing.

rooms.Name: #yIn front of the castle#N
rooms.Description:
The castle is only half finised. Lots of workers are here on strike 
blocking the entrance, refusing to finish the castle if they don't get 
paid.  A small path to the south is leading down from the castle to the 
shoreline.

Exits.Description: The huge gate made of black oakwood is still missing.

rooms.Name: #yThe Courtyard#N
rooms.Description:
You are on the inside of the castle walls. Right in front of you is
the main building. Along the walls to your left and right you can see the 
stables, metal workshop and the barraks of the guards and servants. To 
your south lies the huge black gate through which you entered. Some pigs 
and chicken are running around here happy to have escaped their cages and 
some poor servant is trying to catch them again. It looks rather funny 
actually.

Exits.Description:
A guard is standing on both sides of the big oak door leading into the
main building. They are armed with large halberds and look very capable of 
their job, keeping introuders out of the royal halls.
You see a small door at the base of the South-Eastern tower.

You see the door leading into the South-West tower. A guard is standing 
here on duty guarding the entrance.

rooms.Name: #ySouth-West Watchtower#N
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the top of the S-W watchtower. Two guards is 
keeping watch over the ground below for anything suspicious. You have the 
feeling that the viev from up here would be marvelous if you weren't in a 
dark cave. Some servants is running around here updating the Area BOARD. 
To the north you can go by the breastwalk to the North-West Watchtower. To 
the south you can go back down to the courtyard.

rooms.Name: #yNorth-West Watchtower#N
rooms.Description:
A guard is here sleeping on duty. Well what the heck nothing ever 
happens on this mud anyway, does there :). Some servants are here updating 
the Quest BOARD, quietly not to wake the sleeping guard. To your east you 
can follow the brestwalk on the back side of the castle. South the 
South-West Watchtower is towering.

rooms.Name: #yThe Throneroom#N
rooms.Description:
The golden throne of the Bloodking stands here by the northen wall 
decorated with marks of honour and pictures from the history of the Night 
Tribe clan. The kings personal servant stands here keeping track of all 
that consernes the Night Tribe and puts everything of importance on the 
clanboard. Jugs with ale and wine and some grilled pigs and chicken is 
here to eat for the hungry and thirsty members of the clan. To the north 
theres a small door leading out into the castle garden. Before you entered 
the throneroom you noticed a beautifully worked staiway up to the second 
floor with two guards standing half way up watching your every move and a 
little door to the west.

Exits.Description:
To the east you can see the hidden door to the secret escape route out of
the castle.

Since the King can't trust his heirs not looting the Wine cellar, the only 
two to have a key to this door is the King himself and his trusted guard  
Minx.

rooms.Name: #yThe North-East Watchtower#N
rooms.Description:
The guard is probably away taking a snack but he left a note saying 
that he'll be back soon. Well nothing dangerous in the moria mountais 
anyway (hehe). However a few servants are running around here updating
the bulletin BOARD. To the south you can get to the South-East Watchtower
via the breastwalk. West is the breastwalk on the back side of the castle.

rooms.Name: #ySouth-East Watchtower#N
rooms.Description:
Two guard are here playing cards, but they jump up and eagerly start 
scouting the area when they notice your approch. A few servants is here 
managing the Social BOARD.

rooms.Name: #yThe Castle Garden#N
rooms.Description:
A lovely smell reaches your nose when you enter the garden. Different
types of fungus, lichen and moss is growing here almost on the rock itself  
with great variety in size and colour. You get the feeling that the fauna 
has a healing effect on you and you feel relaxed. WATER dropping down from 
a large stalactite in the cave ceiling makes up a small stream through the 
garden and leaves down through a small HOLE in the rock.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The water has probably been seeking its way through the mountain above for 
centuries befor reaching here and is very clear. When you taste it you 
notice how cool and good it tastes. Mayby you should bottle it up and sell 
it as expensive mineral water.

This hole seems to be bottomless  anyway you can't hear the small rock you  
dropped into it hit the ground below. You better not drop anything 
important down it, it might be lost for ever.

rooms.Name: #yOn the breastwalk on the backside of the castle#N
rooms.Description:
You stand on the breastwalk on the backside of the castle between  
two of the watchtowers. East and west leads to the small doors of the 
watchtowers. To your left you can see small stepps leading down to the 
castle garden.

rooms.Name: #y2nd floor#N
rooms.Description:
To the north you see the private quarters of the Bloodking. You 
wouldn't dare to enter without his permission. Through a door to the east 
you  can spot rows of bookshelfs filled with old books containing almost 
forgotten knowledge of the powers of magic. South you see a hallway with 
doors on both sides each door leading to the private chambers of one of 
the Heirs or royal guards.

rooms.Name: #yTournament Grounds#N
rooms.Description:
A large field spreads out along the eastern side of the castle. 
Great flags are raised upward, between large multi colored tents, being
used for many purposes.  Large areas are fenced off for jousts and combats 
being held throughout the day.  People mill about, watching and cheering 
for the various knights of the realm competing here, listening to the 
clanging of armour and fighting.  Great banners and tributes are raised to 
the champions and rulers of this land, Night Tribe. Royal Questors dodge 
amount with uncany skill, teasing the crowd while great clerics of the 
Tribe heal those wounded during the tournament.  Before it all, stands a 
large tent, with beautiful banners, belonging to the royal heirs and the
Blood King himself.
§N

rooms.Name: #yThe Bloodking's Private Chamber#N
rooms.Description:
A large room, richly embroidered with gold and crimson, showing 
beautiful oak trim of the stone walls.  Tapestries and and other works 
from about the countryside decorate the inner hall, leading to the 
chambers of the Blood King.  Beautiful sets of armor and weapons, inlaid 
with designs and emblems of Night Tribe decorate the room in a magnificent 
display.  Large windows open outward onto a grand balcony overlooking the 
tournament grounds of the kingdom.
§N

rooms.Name: #yStar Chamber of the Royal Council#N
rooms.Description:
A large room, with a large star carved into deep stone on the floor.  
small exits drift off to various chambers in the stone walls, half hidden 
by great tapestries.  A large beautifully crafted wooden table fills the 
chamber, cluttered with papers of state and war.  Above you a large
windowed ceiling made of multi-colored glass serves to create an odd 
effect upon the whole of the room with the light drifting in from the
moon. 
§N

rooms.Name: #yThe Castle Winecellar#N
rooms.Description:
You wake up with a terrible headache. You try opening your eyes
but the room just seems to spinn around makeing you feel dizzy so you
close them again. After a minute or so you try again and manage to focus 
on an ITEM in your hand. You have absolutely no recollection of how you
ended up here. When you turn your head you can make out some steps to the 
south that should lead you up from here if you could just get on you feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You roll over and look at the floor very closely seeing small creatures
going along in the own little world.

You lie staring at the celing and studying a little spider weave a net. 
Well it's real fachinating but mayby you should get up now don't you
think.
The steps ought to lead up to the castle.
The whole wall is covered with shelfs packed with winebottles.

When you look closer you see that the item your holding is an empty wine-
bottle though you can't make out the brand (those damned letters just
won't lie still). A bit to your left you see a couple of more empty 
bottles.

rooms.Name: #yRipper's Room#N
rooms.Description:
As you walk into this room, you start to wonder what's been going
through this little mudder's mind. To the north you see a picture of
Jack the Ripper and a picture of Ripper and notice they look exactly
the same. To the south you see a wall of the heads of many mudders
defeated by Ripper. As you look closely at one, you notice it is your
own. To the west you see a wall with weapons and armour made by  
the mightiest of Dwarves. To the east you see a mirror. As you walk 
closer to the mirror you see not your reflection, but the reflection
of Ripper with an ebony kris ready to backstab you!

rooms.Name: #yFinger's Crypt#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter you see torches in ornate gold #Ybrackets#N light the walls
of the crypt with flickering light, reflected off the polished pink
granite of the huge, vaulted room, lending their smell of pitch to the
fragrance of #rroses#N in the dead, still air.  The floor is white #wmarble#N.
A short pillar in the center of the immense room supports the coffin
itself, giving it the effect of floating in the air.  The
gold-enshrouded #Ycoffin#N glows in the torchlight.  Carved symbols cover
its sides, and continue in a ring around the room, cut into the granite
beneath the torches and gold #Yvases#N.  

#GOn a small sign, instructions in an ancient language detail
the process of going to the underworld and back. #N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Master fingers guide us. 
          Master fingers teach us. 
          Master fingers protect us.  
          In your light we thrive. 
          In your mercy we are sheltered.
          In your wisdom we are humbled.  
          We live only to serve. 
          Our lives are yours.

rooms.Name: #yPrivate Chamber of Metalman#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered the private chamber of Sir Metalman.
On the walls hang the mounted heads of many strange creatures. 
In the middle of the room is a huge bed covered in rich furs. 
A warming energy fills the room. 
This inner sanctum is a place to find peace and rest from a bloody and 
dangerous world.
A sign on the wall reads : Well Come Brothers of the Night Tribe.

rooms.Name: #yBlood Council Private Chambers#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered the private chambers of the Blood Council, on one 
wall you see the Council board, please keep all postings to council 
business. On the remaining walls you see ornate tapestries depicting the 
Blood Kings of the past.  In the center of the room is a large round 
table. The ceiling consists of a domed ruby window, bathing all in an 
eerie light.

rooms.Name: #yNC and Enforcer's room#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter NC and Enforcer's room, you are awed at it's furnishings. 
Though it is littered with many items, it has a clean outlook along with 
a powerful magical glow. You wonder what rare pieces of equipment lie 
inside the safes that you see. You feel smaller as you see the two 
gigantic statues of NC and Enforcer looking upon you. There is a large 
poster posted on the wall with the words "NIGHT TRIBE ROCKS!" in the 
room.

rooms.Name: #yZutgoraks Hidingplace#N
rooms.Description:
This place looks like the worst mess you ever saw. Pencils,
brushes and half-finished paintings are scattered everywhere, 
along with various bodyparts from dismembered beings. The walls
are filled with drawings and it feels as if the eyes of the
portraits are recording your every move and screaming at you, 
calling you an intruder. On the southern wall hangs a portrait
with a golden frame. The colors are faint, but there is 
something visible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at the painting it seems to shift colors and
shapes and marvellous images are shown, the next one more
exquisite than the previous. You see a fine draconian, 
dressed as a priest. A minotaur in shining armor and last, 
a demon surrounded by undead minions, all bowing before
their demonic master.

rooms.Name: #bThe Artemisian's Sanctuary#N
rooms.Description:
Before you lies the golden temple of the Artemisian Order.  Behind 
the door you hear the faint whispers of the sisterhood within.  Above
the door you see the words "Boethia Uber Allelon," the Artemisian 
Credo. Although these lovely women are more than happy to help those 
in need, they are not too fond of unwanted guests!

Exits.Description: The Great Hall of Artemis.

rooms.Name: #bThe Great Hall of Artemis#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter this holy temple, you become aware that you are being 
watched...but by whom?  You hear the echoes of footsteps, but see no 
one as you turn to look.  This room smells of the wild flowers that 
are growing from the floor.  Somehow, sunlight filters through the 
arched ceiling, making you feel as if you are still in the forest 
outside.

Exits.Description: The Altar Room
the Temple Entrance

rooms.Name: #bThe Altar Room#N
rooms.Description:
A large statue of the goddess Artemis greets you as you enter the
room.  She stands before a bloodstained altar upon which the unjust 
are slain in her honor.  Several smaller statues of the Goddesses 
stand guard at her side.  As you move about this room, you can feel 
the watchful eyes of the sisterhood upon you.  Perhaps you will 
become the next to lose your life upon their altar?

Exits.Description: Adelphean's Room
Hallway of Secrets
Great Hall of Artemis
Hallway of Immortality
Amazon's Training Room

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The altar is stained with the blood of the men and the beasts 
sacrificed to Artemis.  You notice that the stones at the base do not 
quite fit into the floor...perhaps something is beneath it?

Dark brown hair with just a tint of auburn flows life-like behind the
statue of Melody.  She stands poised, her lithe body ready to pounce
into action in an instant.  As you move around the room you notice 
her hypnotic gaze following you around the room... like a huntress
watching her prey.  Armed only with her claws, you know this
Artemisian goddess would make a formidable adversary as well as a
faithful ally.

Kaleen grins back at you as you gaze upon her statue.  The petite 
ratwoman is the adopted daughter of Lovely and Drogg, and can call 
many of the Artemisians her sisters and brothers.  Her statue is 
adorned with a wreath of laurel leaves, a bow, and a quiver of 
arrows.  She wears the mark of the Artemisians on her left arm as a 
symbol of her allegiance to her proud heritage.

The maiden Goddess Artemis is strong and tall.  She wears only a 
wreath of flowers and a quiver of arrows.  In one hand she holds a 
golden bow, and in the other, a double-headed axe...dripping with 
blood.

rooms.Name: #bThe Adelpheans' Room#N
rooms.Description:
The Artemisian Adelpheans are skilled in the arts of healing and 
magic. They assist the High Priestesses with the preperations of 
rituals and sacrifices.  You see a large pool here, built for the 
ritual bathing of the victims before they are sacrificed.  Most men 
will come here willingly with a beautiful Adelphean, but leave here 
weeping when they realize what is to be done to them.

Exits.Description: The Maiden's Room

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The shimmering pool is quite inviting, but the only souls allowed 
inside are the Artemisians, and those they are to sacrifice.

rooms.Name: #bThe Maiden's Sanctuary#N
rooms.Description:
Before an Artemisian may become an Amazon, she must endure a 
period of intense training as a Maiden.  The Maidens are trained in 
the arts of war, as well as the lore of the forest.  This room is 
where the maidens spend much of their time studying and practicing 
their skills.  The walls are covered with murals of the Artemisian 
hunt, during which Artemis transforms herself into a white doe, which 
the Maidens must capture alive.

rooms.Name: #bThe Amazon's Training Room#N
rooms.Description:
This room is where the mighty Amazon warriors of the Artemisian
Order practice their deadly skills.  the Amazons are skilled hunters,
capable of dispatching man or beast with eerie efficiency.  The walls 
are covered with murals of the many battles fought for the Order 
before Artemis.

rooms.Name: #bThe Amazon's Armory#N
rooms.Description:
This is where the Amazons keep the spoils of their hard fought 
battles.  The treasure in this room is for all of the Artemisians to 
share.

Exits.Description: Training Room

rooms.Name: #bHallway of Secrets#N
rooms.Description:
This hidden hallway is where the private chambers of the Order's  
leaders can be found.  The floor here is covered with a thick blue  
carpet, just right for walking barefoot on.  You can barely hear the
noise from the Altar through the thick wooden door.

Exits.Description: Bronwyn's Chamber
Hallway
BigBird's Chamber
Altar Room

rooms.Name: #bBigBird's Chambers#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered the private chambers of BigBird.  BigBird has
decided to decorate the room with a dungeon motif.  An Iron Maiden 
lies against one wall, and various instruments of torture are 
scattered around the room.  The blood of her latest victim is 
dripping on the floor.  In one corner is a large bookshelf, piled 
high with stuffed animals!?!?!?  Well, perhaps BigBird has a nice 
side after all ...(?)

Exits.Description: Hallway of Secrets

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This shelf is full of cute and fuzzy stuffed animals.  Among them, 
you can see a few bunnies, a couple of bears, and Barney, the purple 
dinosaur.

This pain inflicting device is from the late 1800's.  Although aged 
and less used now adays, it still proves as a worthwhile method of  
distributing pain and extracting valuable information.

rooms.Name: #bBronwyn's Chambers#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered Bronwyn's Chamber. As you look around, all you
can do is smile. Bronwyn may be a grown woman, but looking around, 
you'd think she was a child. You look to the left of the room and you 
see a pile of stuffed bunnies everywhere! As you continue to look 
around the room, straight ahead you see an antique four-poster bed, 
with a handmade comforter on it, probably fifty or more years old 
itself, along with some other antique furniture around the room.  Off 
to the side of the bed, on the nightstand, is a picture in an elegant 
frame. To the right of the bed is a large bay window with a 
picturesque view of Midgaard. Bronwyn can often be found resting in 
her window seat, thinking about what life has in store for her.

Exits.Description: Hallway of Secrets

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at the pile of bunnies, you get the urge to go and jump 
into them like a child would, but you suppress it for now.

As you look at this portrait you see Bronwyn and her sexy, loving 
husband Fresh, her sister Madison and Madison's adorable husband 
Smilex. They all look so cute!

Outside the window, you can see people shuffling about the town. Off 
to the east, you can see Harold the Undertaker doing busineses with a 
bloody person whom you cannot make out at this point.

rooms.Name: #bMystic's #yL#mo#rv#ge #bS#yh#ga#wc#mk#N
rooms.Description:
As you push aside the beads hanging in the doorway, you feast your
eyes on a vibrantly decorated room.  In the very center of the room, 
is a soft, comfy looking bed that has seen many happy nights.  There 
are pictures completely covering the walls of her VERY extended 
family.  There is a soft breeze coming from the balcony, where Mystic 
can often be seen reading or just thinking.  There are several old 
bean bag chairs scattered about the room.  Scattered around the room 
are lava lamp in every color imaginable.  This room would be peaceful 
and calm.  That is if the party girlie would turn down the music.

Exits.Description: Hallway

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
What music is she playing??? #yL#mo#rv#ge #bS#yh#ga#wc#mk#N,
of course!

rooms.Name: #bHallway of Immortality#N
rooms.Description:
This hallway is dark, lit only by the cracks of light escaping 
from underneath four doors.  The northern door looks oddly enough 
like a visor, you can't begin to fathom how to operate it... The door 
to the east and west are small and are located several feet off the 
ground.  The door to the south appears to be made of stout oak.

Exits.Description: The light eminating from the crack is #bc#ro#mo#gl#yi#we#cs#N!
Drogg's Chambers
Kaleen's Chambers
The Altar Room

rooms.Name: #bKarli's Choklit Paradise#N
rooms.Description:
This relatively small room is approximately 20 by 20 feet and made 
of pure solid milk chocolate.  Little Oompa Loompas run about mixing 
chocolate, and creating candies for the kiddie winks.  Chocolate 
kisses line the ceiling, waiting to be eaten.  Many buckets (made of 
chocolate also) are scattered about the room, all marked and 
containing a different kind of scrumdidilyumptious candy.  In a 
special section of the room, several pictures float in mid-air... one 
depicting her beautiful daughter, Medea... one of her whip-mistress 
mommy, Lovely...one of her lovely Goddess and sister, Brigantia... 
and one of the WHOLE Artemisian clan! Whips of all sort lie on the 
ground just beneath the pictures (seemingly used veeeery frequently).  
A great portrait of the Goddess Artemis is carved into the chocolate 
of the back wall.

Welcome to Karli's Choklit Paradise...

Exits.Description: Hallway

rooms.Name: #bHallway of Secrets#N
rooms.Description:
This hidden hallway is where the private chambers of the Order's
leaders can be found.  The floor here is covered with a thick blue
carpet, just right for walking barefoot on.  You can barely hear the
noise from the Altar through the thick wooden door.

Exits.Description: Karli's Chambers
Hallway of Secrets

You hear loud music making you want to dance.  A large neon sign 
reads "#bMystic's #yL#mo#rv#ge #bS#yh#ga#wc#mk#N...#gThe #bCooliest 
#mPlace #yin #gElite#w!!!#N"
Hallway
The Basement...where the bugs live!

rooms.Name: #bJesse's #gHideaway#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter this abode the first thing you feel is the soft plush
green carpeting beneath your feet and at the same time you hear the 
songs of dolphins (which is coming from the small pool in the floor). 
The room is decorated in soft Earth tones which gives it a sort of 
cozy, homey feeling.  On the far wall of the room there is a large 
overstuffed green couch with pillows thrown about and from which one 
can watch their favorite football game on the large screen TV, 
complete with stero on top of it for easy listening or a kick butt 
party tune.  (It's no secret this girl likes to party!)  On the side 
wall there is a loft bed complete with a dark green comforter and 
pillows galore.  The final thing you notice is the computer desk 
strewn with papers and books the only hint that this girl is not as 
organized as she looks.  One the desk there is also a photo album 
that contains pictures of the good times in her life.  There is also
a small plaque here.

Exits.Description: Hallway

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see Jesse's only pet, a baby dolphin named 'Sasha'.

You notice it is a 3 disc changer with Jesse's favorite tunes in for 
the playing '101 Great drinking songs', 'Club Mix Galore', and 
'Celine Dion'

Lots and lots of school books there.(not to mention the occasional 
romance novel *wink*)

You see Jesse in pics with her daughter Claudette and other members 
of her family and friends.

"Good friends and Good times always welcome, sit and take a load  
off!"

rooms.Name: #bHallway of Philos#N
rooms.Description:
This is the hallway upon which you will find the room of the
leaders of the Gargareans, the Philos. The floor here is covered with 
a thick blue carpet, just right for walking barefoot on.

rooms.Name: #bSpellbinder's Chamber#N
rooms.Description: Spellie needs to re-decorate.

rooms.Name: #bSmilex's Rockin Room#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter this spacious abode, the smell of burning incense
overcomes you.  The room is very dark, with candles glowing all 
around, and black lights on the ceiling, giving a florescent glow to 
the posters on the wall.  In the center of the room, there are two 
computers set up, one next to the other, obviously where Smilex and 
Madison sit and play with the internet.  There is a speaker in each 
of the four corners, and the music of Boyz II Men is playing softly.  
The entertainment center is placed so that it can be operated and 
viewed from while sitting at the computers.  On one of the screens 
the words "I love Madison" are moving slowly across, and on the other 
it reads "I love Smilex".  There is a futon in front of the 
entertainment center, to sit on while watching TV, and if you listen 
quietly, you can hear the squeaking of a mouse. Perhaps this is 
Roger, Smilex's pet.  The walls seem to glow, making you think you 
are protected.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's white, kind of dirty, but looks very comfortable.  Have a seat,
relax.

Not much to say, they are computers, they look like computers, they 
sound like computers.  The screen savers announce Smilex's and 
Madison's true love for one another.

Roger is a small mouse, about 3 inches long plus a tail.  He is grey 
and fuzzy, and very cute.  He won't hurt you.  You can even pet him 
if you wish.  He answers to Roger and Rog.

rooms.Name: #bThe Ristorante D'Asilasilab#N
rooms.Description:
Welcome to the Ristorante D'Asilasilab! Please come in, make 
yourself comfortable, and enjoy dining at EliteMUD's first Italian 
restaurant. Sample our fine food while swooning to the styling sounds 
of Johnny "Pibbman" Powell (tips accepted at the door). Our specials 
today are listed on the sign to your right. Here is your menu.
Enjoy!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
THE RISTORANTE D'ASILASILAB
 
Omlette of Suun Lu...........................45 gold pieces
Ogreburger with pitch black coke.............60 gold pieces
Onion Rings of the Universe..................25 gold pieces
Froboz Frappe...............................100 gold pieces
Caesar salad (fresh from Rome)...............25 gold pieces
Katrina's Humble Pie.........................45 gold pieces
 
All entrees served with hot bread and your choice of
Dragon Hatchling Stew or our famous Moria Veggie Medley

Please seat yourself.
 
Our specials today are:
Spellbinder's Mexican Fido Gumbo....75 gold pieces
Mystic's Black Olive Delight........60 gold pieces
Chicken a la Pibbman................65 gold pieces

As you gaze at this large Italian man you get the feeling that you 
should just ignore whatever is going on behind the door he is 
guarding. If you have "business" to discuss, then this is the place 
to go. Just make sure that you show the proper respect to the Family.

rooms.Name: #YZagreus' #bHideaway#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered Zagreus' cluttered study - clearly belonging to a
man of solitary habits.  The candles perched on odd scraps of clear 
space provide only a meager amount of light,  but enough to reveal 
walls lined with floor to  ceiling oak bookcases stuffed with 
manuscripts, scrolls, and bound leather volumes.  A quick scan of 
visible titles reveals subjects ranging from metaphysics, philosophy 
and the occult to histories, folklore, astronomy and scattered 
treatises on sexual practices.  To the right a large desk struggles 
under an deluge of notebooks, spilt containers of ink, puddles of 
candle wax, and small mountains of  books and scrolls.  Behind the 
desk sits a very large comfy chair, worn and ragged but sturdy.  In a 
far, dark corner you catch a glimpse of a large couch covered in 
blankets and pillows causing it to resemble an unmade comfortable 
bed.  A number of simple wooden chairs scattered about the 
room have been put to use holding books and papers,  but are still 
available for guests willing to clear them. Although cluttered and 
dusty, the room tempts you to spend a moment of quiet time, to read 
or engage in casual conversation.

rooms.Name: #bHallway of Secrets#N
rooms.Description:
This hidden hallway is where the private chambers of the Order's
leaders can be found.  The floor here is covered with a thick blue
carpet, just right for walking barefoot on.  You can barely hear the
noise from the Altar through the thick wooden door.

Exits.Description: Jesse's Chambers
Urd's Chambers
Hallway

rooms.Name: #bUrd's Lounge#N
rooms.Description:
You come into a more dimly illuminated room and you find yourself
having to adjust to the dim lighting for a few seconds. On a far side 
of the room you see a the light of a small candle burning over a book 
which glows in it's own distinct way. As you come further into the 
room you catch the aroma of sweet spring flowers drifting in the air 
and you instantly feel relieved. You can now perceive a small desk on 
a wall on which there appears to be little more then some old scrolls 
and a portrait. And on a wall on the opposite side of the room you 
see a comfortable looking sofa with nice big pillows in it.

Exits.Description: Hallway of Secrets

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A family picture of Urd, her parents (daddy Xenos and mama Chani), 
and her grandparents (Helm and Brigantia).

You notice it has a magical air about it, it's flame doesn't seem to
be affected by the small turbulence in the air. It reads "I am the 
light that shines in the darkness."

It's not a particularly beautiful sofa but it looks comfortable in a
strange way with all the big many colored pillows in it. A small 
heart shaped pillow sits tucked away among the other pillows.

rooms.Name: #bRelm's #gTropical #mParadise#N
rooms.Description:
You are surrounded by luscious ferns and tall vine-covered trees,
deep in a tropical jungle.  The air is hot and humid, making you 
sweat. Large exotic flowers bloom throughout the dense foliage in 
striking colors of bright orange, red, and purple.  You can hear 
various animals and birds calling and whistling, forming strange 
melodies that are making you uneasy.  As you look around, you spot 
mysterious cat-like tracks sunk in the rich damp soil.  A small 
stream runs by your feet, glistening in the scattered sunlight that 
tries to break through the dense canopy. Under the darkest shadows, 
you sense that you can see glowing eyes and the glistening of sharp 
teeth, but they disappear quickly, maybe moving in for a closer look
at you, the stranger.  You get a feeling of awe and respect for 
whatever find its home here, living in such beauty, and uncertain 
danger as well..
§N

rooms.Name: A black square
rooms.Description:
You have seen many strange things in the World of Elite - 
gnomes, fairies, hobgoblins, orcs, imps, ancient trees, gishs, a can 
that talks - but never could you have imagined what lies before you.  
Apparently, two very powerful illusionists have conjured life-size 
chess pieces to match their wits against each other.  The landscape 
is large slabs of marble fit snugly together to form a huge 
chessboard.  Far in the distance, you notice that the ground appears 
to be a flat surface of wood.  A table?  All around you are illusions 
of pawns, bishops, knights, rooks, queens and kings.  All of whom 
yearn for battle!

rooms.Name: The Reading Room
rooms.Description:
You are in a small, simple room which is mostly empty, save a few
wooden desks and benches. To the east you hear the bustle of the
Temple of Midgaard, a sharp contrast to the relative quiet of this
peaceful room.

Exits.Description: You see the Temple of Midgaard.

You see a light shimmering across the archway, which seems to hold
something inside the room.  You are guessing noise.
You the Halls of Learning.
The #mNewbie Power#N Clan House

rooms.Name: The Temple Of Midgaard
rooms.Description:
You are in the southern end of the temple hall in the Temple of
Midgaard.  The temple has been constructed from giant marble blocks,
eternal in appearance, and most of the walls are covered by ancient
wall paintings picturing Gods, Giants and peasants. Large steps lead
down through the grand temple gate, descending the huge mound upon
which the temple is built and ends on the temple square below. To the
west, you see the Reading Room. The donation room is in a small
alcove to your east. There is a note for the newbies here.
#rType look note to read note.#N

Exits.Description: At the northern end of the temple hall is a statue and a huge altar.

In the east, you see a small alcove with a rickety wooden sign which
reads "Midgaard Donation Room."
You look down the huge stone steps at the temple square below.
You see the Reading Room.
There is a stairway going up that leads to a Bot room
Stairs lead down to the Catacombs

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The note says:

Welcome to Elite!

For the rules, type :

   policy

For some info, type :

   info

To move in any directions you type the direction.

example to move west you type :
  west

To talk to other players you use say.

  say Hi

More info about this in the Halls of learning

Directions:

   two west then north.

You will also get some free equipment there.

rooms.Name: Cleric's Inner Sanctum
rooms.Description:
This is the inner sanctum. A picture of the mighty Thor, is
hanging on the wall, just above the altar which is set against the
western wall. A well in the middle of the floor leads down into
darkness. Vile smells waft from the depths.

Exits.Description: You see your favorite place, the bar of divination.

You can't see what is down there, it is too dark. Looks like it would be
impossible to climb back up.

rooms.Name: Cleric's Bar
rooms.Description:
The bar is one of the finest in the land, lucky it is members
only. Fine furniture is set all around the room. A small sign is
hanging on the wall.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance.
You see the inner sanctum.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads:
Free instructions provided by the waiter:

   Buy  - Buy something (drinkable) from the waiter.
   List - The waiter will show you all the different drinks and
          specialties, and tell the price of each.

rooms.Name: Entrance to Cleric's Guild
rooms.Description:
The entrance hall is a small modest room, reflecting the true
nature of the Clerics. The exit leads east to the temple square. A
small entrance to the bar is in the northern wall.

Exits.Description: You see the bar, richly decorated with really stylish furniture.

rooms.Name: The Temple Square
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the temple square. Huge marble steps lead up
to the temple gate. The entrance to the Clerics Guild is to the west,
and the old Three Crowns Inn, is to the east. Just south of here you
see the market square, the center of Midgaard.

Exits.Description: You see the temple.
You see the Market Square.

rooms.Name: Entrance Hall of the Three Crowns Inn
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the entrance hall of the Three Crowns Inn. The
hall has been wisely decorated with simple, functional furniture. The
heavy smell of dust and aging paper drifts in from the Post Office to
the north. A small staircase leads up to the reception and the bar is
to the east.

Exits.Description: You see the Midgaard Post Office.
Surprise! You see the bar.
You see the reception.

rooms.Name: The Three Crowns
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the bar. The bar is set against the northern
wall, old archaic writing, carvings and symbols cover its top. A
fireplace is built into the western wall, and through the
southeastern windows you can see the temple square. This place makes
you feel like home. A small sign with big letters is fastened to the
bar.

Exits.Description: You see the exit to the entrance hall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although it is very hard to understand, you think it looks a lot like
beer,
poems about beer, and small beer-mugs.

The sign reads:
Free instructions provided by the Three Crowns Inn.

   Buy  - Buy something (drinkable) from the bartender.
   List - The bartender will show you all the different drinks and
          specialties, and tell the price of each.

rooms.Name: The Reception
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the reception. The staircase leads down to the
entrance hall. An exit to the north leads to the Cryogenic Center.
There is a small sign on the counter.

Exits.Description: Wispy fog crawls out of the room to the north.
You see the entrance hall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
*******************************
                *                             *
                *    This is a no rent MUD    *
                *      so theres no need      *
                *    to pay money to store    *
                *     your equipment, just    *
                *       save and quit!        *
                *                             *
                *******************************

rooms.Name: The Bakery
rooms.Description:
You are standing inside the small bakery. A sweet scent of Danish
and fine bread fills the room. The bread and Danish are arranged in
fine order on the shelves, and seem to be of the finest quality. A
small sign is on the counter.

Exits.Description: You see the main street.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Free instructions provided by the store:

   Buy  - Will buy you some bread or pastry.
   List - The baker will kindly tell you the price and sort of the bread
in
          his bakery.

You see that this is truly delicious pastry.  Must be made by a Dane
from Denmark (which surely is not the capital of Sweden!).  Former
ruler of Scandinavia, England, Northern Germany, Northern France,
Russia, Greenland, Iceland, Estonia etc.  etc.
   The sight of those large, wholesome chokoladeboller makes your
mouth water and your soul sing.

rooms.Name: The General Store
rooms.Description:
You are inside the general store. All sorts of items are stacked
on shelves behind the counter, safely out of your reach. A small note
hangs on the wall.

Exits.Description: You see the main street.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The note reads:

  List  - Show which various items are in the store.
  Buy   - Buy an item.
  Value - The shopkeeper will (free of charge) tell how much he will
          pay for your item.
  Sell  - Sell an item.

rooms.Name: The Weapon Shop
rooms.Description: You are inside the weapon shop. There is a small note on the counter.

Exits.Description: You see the main street.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The note reads:

  List  - Show which various items are in the store.
  Buy   - Buy an item.
  Value - The shopkeeper will (free of charge) tell how much he will
          pay for your item.
  Sell  - Sell an item.

rooms.Name: Main Street
rooms.Description:
You are at the end of the main street of Midgaard. South of here
is the entrance to the Guild of Magic Users. The street continues
east towards the market square. The magic shop is to the north and to
the west is the city gate.

Exits.Description: You see the magic shop.
You see the main street.
You see the entrance to the Guild of Magic Users.
You see the city gate.

rooms.Name: Main Street
rooms.Description:
You are on the main street passing through the City of Midgaard.
South of here is the entrance to the Armory, and the bakery is to the
north. East of here is the market square.

Exits.Description: You see the bakery.
You see the market square.
You see the armory.
You see the main street.

rooms.Name: Market Square
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the market square, the famous Square of
Midgaard. A large, peculiar looking statue is standing in the middle
of the square. Roads lead in every direction, north to the temple
square, south to the common square, east and westbound is the main
street.

Exits.Description: You see the temple square.
You see the main street.
You see the common square.
You see the main street.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
What you see is the Midgaard Worm, stretching around the Palace of
Midgaard.

rooms.Name: The Main Street
rooms.Description:
You are on the main street crossing through town. To the north you
can see the General store, and the main street continues east. To the
west you see and hear the market place, to the south a small door
leads into the Pet Shop.

Exits.Description: You see the general store.
You see the main street.
You see the Pet Shop.
You see the market square.

rooms.Name: The Main Street
rooms.Description:
The main street, to the north is the weapon shop and to the south
is the Guild of Swordsmen. To the east you leave town and to the west
the street leads to the market square.

Exits.Description: You see the weapon shop.
You see the city gate.
You see the swordsmen's guild.
You see the main street leading to the market square.

rooms.Name: Entrance to Mage's Guild
rooms.Description: The entrance hall is a small, poorly lit room.

Exits.Description: You see the main street.
You see your favorite place, the Mage's Bar.

rooms.Name: Mage's Bar
rooms.Description:
The bar is one of the weirdest in the land. Mystical images float
around the air. Illusions of fine furniture appear all around the
room.

Exits.Description: You see the lobby.
You see the laboratory.

rooms.Name: Mage's Laboratory
rooms.Description:
This is the Magical Experiments Laboratory. Dark smoke-stained
stones arch over numerous huge oaken tables, most of these cluttered
with strange- looking pipes and flasks. The floor is covered with
half-erased pentagrams and even weirder symbols, and a blackboard in
a dark corner has only been partially cleaned, some painful-looking
letters faintly visible. A well in the middle of the floor leads down
into darkness. Vile smells waft from the depths.

Exits.Description: You see the bar.

rooms.Name: The Armory
rooms.Description:
The armory with all kinds of armors on the walls and in the
window. You see helmets, shields and chain mails. To the north is the
main street. On the wall is a small note.

Exits.Description: You see the main street.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can use these commands for trading:

  value <item>     To get the price of an item in your possession.
  sell <item>      To sell something.
  buy <item>       To buy something (provided that the shop has it in
store).
  list             Gives you a listing of the shop's inventory.

        WE DON'T GIVE CREDIT; WE DON'T EXPECT TO RECEIVE CREDIT!
                             NO HAGGLING

rooms.Name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Swordsmen
rooms.Description:
The entrance hall to the Guild of Swordsmen. A place where one has
to be careful not to say something wrong (or right). To the east is
the bar and to the north is the main street.

Exits.Description: You see the main street.
You see the swordsmen's bar, many noises comes from there.

rooms.Name: The Bar of Swordsmen
rooms.Description:
The bar of swordsmen, once upon a time beautifully furnished. But
now the furniture is all around you in small pieces. To the south is
the yard, and to the west is the entrance hall.

Exits.Description: You see the practice yard.
You see the entrance hall to the swordsmens guild.

rooms.Name: The Tournament and Practice Yard
rooms.Description:
The practice yard of the fighters. To the north is the bar. A well
leads down into darkness.

Exits.Description: You see the bar.

You can't see what is down there, it is too dark. Looks like it would be
impossible to climb back up.

rooms.Name: Eastern End of Poor Alley
rooms.Description:
You are at the poor alley. South of here is the Grubby Inn and to
the east you see common square. The alley continues further west.

Exits.Description: You see the common square.
You see the Inn.
You see the poor alley.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sparkling circle seems to be some sort of rift. Trough it you see
a swirling haze, occasionally parting to reveal a strange and alien
landscape under a hostile gray sky.  The loud crackling noise that
the circle's spark cause convinces you that trying to squeeze through
it could be perilous.

rooms.Name: The Common Square
rooms.Description:
The common square, people pass you, talking to each other. To the
west is the poor alley and to the east is the dark alley. To the
north, this square is connected to the market square. From the south
you notice a nasty smell.

Exits.Description: You see the market square.
You see the dark alley.
You see a ruined city wall.
You see the poor alley.

rooms.Name: The Dark Alley
rooms.Description:
You stand in an east/west running dark alleyway.  To the west is the
Common Square, while to the east, the alley continues on slightly better
lit. The shadows seem to collect to the north and south.  Peering to the
south, you see the infamous Midgaard Guild of Thieves.  Here, the shadows
gather where some people seem to sneak in and out.

Exits.Description: The alley continues east.
You see the entrance to the thieves guild.
You see the common square.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small black metal plaque is impervious to all damage, but seems
to bear a message on it anyways: #Y

This is the site of the Ancient Clan of Shadowblade, whom were the
watchers for the return of the Old Ones.  When the Ancient Unholy
Pact was broken in recent times, the Old Ones came back to repossess
Midgaard.  In a final fight, Shadowblades were able to seal the
entrance and inscribe an Elder Sign on the wall, preventing further
incursion to this realm.  As the pact was broken, a new one needed
forging at a cost of great sacrifice to the members, hence, Clan
Shadowblade was disolved with the members cursed to wander Elite, yet
always remember what they had.#N

As you look at the seal, you notice it's made up of several varrying
shapes that continue to change even when you are looking at it.  It
seems to be etched on a freshly sealed door (bricked up with the
mortar just dried).  On more closely examining the wall, you sense a
hand in magic on it.  The chaotic motion of the seal captivated your
attention, but now you notice a small adamantine plaque marked below
it.

It is the thieves guild, don't enter if you care about your health or
money.

rooms.Name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Thieves
rooms.Description:
The entrance hall to the thieves' and assassins' guild. A place
where you can lose both your life and your money, if you are not
careful. To the north is the dark alley and to the east is the
thieves' bar.

Exits.Description: You see the alley.
You see the thieves bar, where everything disappears.

rooms.Name: The Thieves Bar
rooms.Description:
The bar of the thieves. Once upon a time this place was
beautifully furnished, but now it seems almost empty. To the south is
the yard, and to the west is the entrance hall. (Maybe the furniture
has been stolen?!)

Exits.Description: You see the secret yard.
You see the entrance hall to the thieves guild.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: As you look at the furniture, the chair you sit on disappears.

rooms.Name: The Secret Yard
rooms.Description:
The secret practice yard of thieves and assassins. To the north is
the bar.  A well leads down into darkness.

Exits.Description: You see the bar.

You can't see what is down there, it is too dark. Looks like it would be
impossible to climb back up.

rooms.Name: The Dump
rooms.Description:
The dump, where the people from the city drop their garbage. Through
the garbage you can see a large junction of pipes, looks like the
entrance to the sewer system, and to the north is the common square.
There is a sign posted here warning that anything dropped, becomes part
of the Midgaard reclamation project -- "YOU DROP IT, YOU LOSE IT FOR
GOOD!  All deposit, no return (or reimbursement)."

Exits.Description: You see a ruined city wall.
You see the sewers.

rooms.Name: The Pet Shop
rooms.Description:
The Pet Shop is a small crowded store, full of cages and animals
of various sizes. There is a sign on the wall.

Exits.Description: You see the main street.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads:

  Use 'List' to see the available pets.
  Use 'Buy <pet>' to buy yourself a pet.

  Instructions for having pets:

  You can use 'order <pet> <instructions>' to order your pets around.
  If you abuse your pet, it will no longer regard you as its master.
  If you have several pets you may use 'order followers <instructions>'

  You can name the pet you buy as : "buy <pet> <name>"

 Regards,
.
 The Shopkeeper

rooms.Name: Pet Shop Store
rooms.Description:
This is the small dark room in which the Pet shop keeps his pets.
It is vital that this room's virtual number is exactly one larger
than the Pet Shop number.

rooms.Name: The Magic Shop
rooms.Description:
Behind the counter you see various items, neatly placed in racks,
presumably most of them are magic.

Exits.Description: You see the main street.

rooms.Name: Inside the West Gate of Midgaard
rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city
wall and connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate.
Main Street leads east and Wall Road leads south from here.

Exits.Description: You see Main Street.

You see the road running along the inner side of the city wall. You
notice that it is called Wall Road.
The city gate is to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

Both of the towers are built from large gray rocks that have been
fastened to each other with some kind of mortar, just like the city
wall.

It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have been
reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.  One of
the doors is equipped with a very big lock.

It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk
across it from one tower to the other.

rooms.Name: Inside the East Gate of Midgaard
rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city
wall and connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate.
Main Street leads west from here. To the south you see the Water
Shop.

Exits.Description: You see the city gate.
You see the water shop.
You see Main Street.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

Both of the towers are built from large gray rocks that have been
fastened to each other with some kind of mortar, just like the city
wall.

It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have
been reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.
One of the doors is equipped with a very big lock.

It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk
across it from one tower to the other.

rooms.Name: Wall Road
rooms.Description:
You are walking next to the western city wall. The road continues
further south and the city gate is just north of here.

Exits.Description: You see the city gate.
The road continues further south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

rooms.Name: Wall Road
rooms.Description:
You are walking next to the western city wall. Wall Road continues
further north and south. A small, poor alley leads east. Some letters
have been written on the wall here.

Exits.Description: The road continues further north.
The alley leads east.
The road continues further south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.
It says 'Who watches the watchmen?'

rooms.Name: Poor Alley
rooms.Description:
You are in the poor alley, which continues further east. You see
the city wall to the west.

Exits.Description: The alley leads east.
The alley leads west.

rooms.Name: Alley at Levee
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the alley which continues east and west. South
of here you see the levee.

Exits.Description: The alley leads east.
You see the levee.
The alley leads west.

rooms.Name: Eastern end of Alley
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the eastern end of the alley, the city wall is
just east, blocking any further movement. A small warehouse is
directly south of here and a mexican food stand has been set up north
of here.

Exits.Description: You see the taco stand.
You see the warehouse.
You see the alley.

rooms.Name: Wall Road
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the road next to the western city wall, which
continues north. South of here is a bridge across the river.

Exits.Description: You see the road.
You see the bridge.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

rooms.Name: Grubby Inn
rooms.Description:
You are inside the old Grubby Inn. This place has not been cleaned
for several decades; vile smells make you dizzy.

Exits.Description: You see the alley.

rooms.Name: Levee
rooms.Description:
You are at the levee. South of here you see the river gently
flowing west.  The river bank is very low making it possible to enter
the river.

Exits.Description: You see the Alley.
You see the river flowing west.

rooms.Name: Warehouse
rooms.Description:
You are inside the warehouse. The room is decorated with various
old items from ships.

Exits.Description: You see the Alley.

rooms.Name: On the Bridge
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the stone bridge crosses the river. The bridge
is built out from the western city wall and the river flows west
through an opening in the wall ten feet below the bridge.

Exits.Description: You see the road.
You see the Concourse.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.
You cannot really see it from here as it is somewhere beneath your feet.

It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each
other with some kind of mortar, just like the wall.

rooms.Name: Outside the West Gate of Midgaard
rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city
wall and connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate. To
the west you can see the edge of a big forest.

Exits.Description: The city gate is to the east.
The forest edge is to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each other
with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

Both of the towers are built from large gray rocks that have been
fastened to each other with some kind of mortar, just like the city wall.

It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have been
reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.  One of
the doors is equipped with a very big lock.

It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk
across it from one tower to the other.

rooms.Name: Outside the East Gate of Midgaard
rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city
wall and connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate. To
the east the plains stretch out in the distance.

Exits.Description: You see a weird path.
You see the plains.
You see the city gate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each other
with some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

Both of the towers are built from large gray rocks that have been
fastened to each other with some kind of mortar, just like the city wall.

It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have been
reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.  One of
the doors is equipped with a very big lock.

It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk
across it from one tower to the other.

rooms.Name: By the Temple Altar
rooms.Description:
You are by the temple altar in the northern end of the Temple Of
Midgaard, A huge altar made from white polished marble is standing in
front of you and behind it are two ten foot tall statues of IO and
Rigel, the two Creators of the whole world. To the north, steps lead
out the back of the temple towards the countryside. To the south you
can see the temple of midgaard and up you can see the door (perhaps
rather disc, it floats up in the air) to the realms of Rigel.

Exits.Description: You see the vast Midgaard countryside.
You see the southern end of the temple.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The statue represents the one-eyed Odin sitting on a his throne.  He has
long, gray hair and beard and a strict look on his face.  On top of the
throne, just above his shoulders, his two ravens Hugin and Munin are
sitting and at his feet are his wolves Gere and Freke.

Even though the altar is more than ten feet long it appears to be made
from a single block of white virgin marble.

rooms.Name: Odin's Store
rooms.Description:
This is the small dark room in which Odin keeps the player items
that he takes care of. It is vital that this room's virtual number is
exactly one larger than the room by the temple altar.

rooms.Name: Uncle Juan's Eatery
rooms.Description:
This place makes your nose run just from the smell of the spicy
food they sell. Spicy as it may be it still looks very tasty. A box
of taco shells is set on the counter. There is a large, friendly sign
hanging on the wall here.

Exits.Description: You see the eastern end of alley.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a hand-written sign with large, friendly letters which say
"If it ain't Uncle Juan's, it ain't any good!"

rooms.Name: Ye Olde Water Shoppe
rooms.Description:
You are in Wally's World O' Water, whose proprietor, Wally, is
sure to have something to meet all of your water needs.

Exits.Description: You see the East Gate.

rooms.Name: Behind the Temple Altar
rooms.Description:
You are on a dirt path leading away from the Temple Altar which is
south of here. To the north, the path continues through the lush
countryside of Midgaard.

Exits.Description: You see the lush, green countryside of Midgaard.
You see the Temple Altar.

rooms.Name: The Great Field of Midgaard
rooms.Description:
You are walking on a wide dirt path through the lush, green, fresh
Midgaard countryside. You can see to the horizon to the north, east,
and west; to busy city of Midgaard lies to the south. All around you
is healthy green grass and an occasional large oak tree. The sun
feels wonderful on your face and a pleasant wind blows through your
hair. Birds chirp quietly to themselves and you can smell the faint
scent of flowers and freshly cut grass. You feel like you could lie
down in the grass and stay here forever, surrounded by powerful
beauty in all directions. The path you are on continues north through
the field and south back to Midgaard.

Exits.Description: You see more of the path through the Great Field.
You see the path which goes back to Midgaard.

rooms.Name: Clara's Field o' Daisies
rooms.Description:
There a wide expanse of daisies as far as you can possibly see.
There are lazy bees, butterflies, and lady bugs flying about the
flowers. In the center of the field there is a humongous old tree,
inviting and friendly, begging you to nap beneath it. Its branches
filled with sweet singing birds, and a bee hive dripping with fresh
warm honey. As you look closely at the trunk of the tree, you notice
that it is shaped like a woman with arms reaching for the sky, the
warm sun... a lithe form with long, flowing hair and a filmy dress;
her eyes gazing always upwards, a smile playing about her lips -
Clara.

Exits.Description: You see a long road.
You see more of the Field.

rooms.Name: The Post Office
rooms.Description:
You are in the central post office for Midgaard. Piles of assorted
mail lay untouched in the corners, collecting cobwebs. Several large
crates have been pried open by curious customs agents, and are now
stacked along the west wall, hiding plenty of 'WANTED' posters. There
is a sign posted on the wall here.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the Three Crowns Inn and Tavern.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Faces of various known Killers and Thieves can barely be seen behind the
crates on the west wall.  Some of them look quite familiar, sorta like
that guy who you saw in the Reception a minute ago...but then again, they
are rather hard to see past the crates.

As you know, it is illegal to send contraband items through the Midgaard
mail. The custom's agents use this as a great excuse to seize liquor,
rare spices, and just about anything they might find useful or
profitable.
They seem to cover everything here, even the Postmaster himself.

**********************************************************
*                                                        *
*    Mail Instructions :                                 *
*                                                        *
*      To send a note to someone :                       *
*         MAIL <playername> <next name> ...              *
*                                                        *
*      To post a postcard to someone :                   *
*         POST <cardname> <playername> <next name> ...   *
*                                                        *
*      To see if you have any mail :                     *
*         CHECK                                          *
*                                                        *
*      To get the Postmaster to give you your mail :     *
*         RECEIVE                                        *
*                                                        *
*         Stamps cost 350 coins per letter               *
*         Type 'HELP MAIL' for more info                 *
**********************************************************

rooms.Name: Midgaard Donation Room
rooms.Description:
You are in a small, undecorated room just off of the main temple.
There are a couple of small wooden benches here where people
occasionally sit while they wait for items to appear. The temple is
to the west.

Exits.Description: The busy temple is back west.

rooms.Name: The Cryogenic Center
rooms.Description:
The walls of this room are covered with frosty patterns, and the
floor is slippery with ice. On one side of the room is a wide cage,
and all around the room are coffin-shaped containers apparently made
of bronze. A faintly glowing sign just next to the entrance might be
worth reading.

Exits.Description: The Reception is to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Each one contains a perfectly preserved adventurer, just waiting to
be thawed out before going adventuring again. Peering into the tiny
crytal window in the top of the container to notice the occupant is
particularly ugly, but hey - they can't all be as beautiful as you!
How amusing, Amok has written his name in the snow.

It says 'The cryo-shopkeeper works just like any other shopkeeper
just type list to see what he can do!'

Note, when you buy cryo, your character is protected against pfile
purges for six months after you log out. BUT, you are automatically
and permanently thawed out when you log back- effectively cancelling
the cryo.

rooms.Name: Wall Road
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the end of Wall Road. To the east is Temple
Street.

rooms.Name: West Temple Street
rooms.Description:
You are on West Temple Street. The city library is to the north,
perhaps you should go there and learn more about the lands round
about. To the south you can see a tailor sewing on the porch of his
shop.

rooms.Name: West Temple Street
rooms.Description:
You are on West Temple Street. You can see Clerics and Paladins
entering the guild to the north, and a fine jeweler displays his
wares to the south. To the east you see the ever busy Temple Square.

rooms.Name: East Temple Street
rooms.Description:
You are on East Temple Street. Temple square is to the west and
stores and other buildings are on each side. Your nose is assaulted
by the pungent smell of flowers from the store to the south, mixed
with the aroma of bitters from the pub to the north.

rooms.Name: East Temple Street
rooms.Description:
You are on East Temple Street. You see a lot of activity around
the building to the north. Lot's of people are eager to lose their
coins in the gambling hall. The building to the south is has a quill
pen and ink bottle for a sign.

rooms.Name: East Temple Street
rooms.Description:
You have reached the East end of East Temple Street. To the south
you can see the East gate of the city. Northward there is a bank. To
