leading in all directions, but quickly twisting out of sight. At a 
glance it look far less prosperous than the homes of the tigers, but a 
closer look reveals that gems and precious metals are to be found 
everywhere, and everything is beautifully crafted.

Exits.Description: Twisting tunnels start off leading north, but quickly change direction.
Twisting tunnels start off leading east, but quickly change direction.
Twisting tunnels start off leading south, but quickly change direction.
Twisting tunnels start off leading west, but quickly change direction.
A twisting tunnel leads upwards.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Boar quarter
rooms.Description:
The boar quarter is like its inhabitants - well built, but rather 
simple. While the boars are powerful fighters, they do not compare to 
the wolves, so they try to be more like the civilised tigers. The home 
of the wereboars lies to the east, and the main street to the west.

Exits.Description: You can make out a particularly hideous fountain to the east.
Main street lies to the west.

rooms.Name: Boar shaped fountain
rooms.Description:
The centre of the Boar quarter is dominated by a large fountain of a 
wereboar. The homes of the wereboars appear to be a series of recessed 
caverns which form an arc about the fountain. You could investigate the 
homes to the north, east and south, or you could leave west.

Exits.Description: The homes of the boars start to the north, curving round to the east.
You can see the homes of the boars, curving round to the north and south.
The homes of the boars start to the south, curving round to the east.
You can leave the boar-quarter to the west.

rooms.Name: Boar House
rooms.Description:
Unlike the elegant homes of the weretigers, those of the boars seem 
a bit gaudy. Any attempt on their part to appear cultured seems instead 
to make them look a bit silly. You wonder how anyone could take the 
boars seriously, but then you remember how large and powerful they are.

Exits.Description: The homes of the boars continue to the east.
You can see a particularly hideous fountain to the south.

rooms.Name: Boar House
rooms.Description:
Unlike the elegant homes of the weretigers, those of the boars seem 
a bit gaudy. Any attempt on their part to appear cultured seems instead 
to make them look a bit silly. You wonder how anyone could take the 
boars seriously, but then you remember how large and powerful they are.

Exits.Description: The homes of the boars continue to the north.
The homes of the boars continue to the south.
You can see a particularly hideous fountain to the west.
Steps lead downwards.

rooms.Name: Boar House
rooms.Description:
Unlike the elegant homes of the weretigers, those of the boars seem 
a bit gaudy. Any attempt on their part to appear cultured seems instead 
to make them look a bit silly. You wonder how anyone could take the 
boars seriously, but then you remember how large and powerful they are.

Exits.Description: You can see a particularly hideous fountain to the north.
The homes of the boars continue to the east.

rooms.Name: Sanctum of the Tiger
rooms.Description:
The hidden sanctuary below the statue is a little surprising, 
considering the tigers' tendancy towards ostentation. This, however, is 
their most sacred place. Only the High Priest, and his acolytes are 
allowed in here normally, and on special occasions the Lords among the 
weretigers are also permitted to gather here.

Exits.Description: There is a trapdoor in the ceiling.

rooms.Name: Sanctum of the wolf
rooms.Description:
The devotion of the wolves is legendary, and the inner sanctum of 
their temple is an amazing shrine, not just to their totem, but also to 
their ancestors, from whom they believe their power partly comes. The 
walls are lined with miniature statues of werewolf heroes and plundered 
treasures. The centre of the room is inlaid with a huge wolfs' head, in 
gold - and represents more wealth than everything else in the city 
together.

Exits.Description: A black door, carved with a wolfshead leads north.

rooms.Name: Main Street
rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of the main street through Werehome. The 
entrance to the city is to the north, and the street continues to the 
south. To the east you can see a narrow pathway, which becomes narrower 
as is twists out of view. The street is lit as bright as day by the 
strange phosphorescent rocks that line the cave high above your head.

Exits.Description: You can see the entrance to Werehome to the north.
A narrow tunnel leads east.
The main street continues to the south.

rooms.Name: Lord Birt's Chambers
rooms.Description:
Talk about slumming it! This place is a real mess, bits of trash 
everywhere. The wererats are notorious scavengers, and it seems that 
Lord Birt gets the lion's share. How anyone stands the smell you'll 
never know. Better not let anyone catch you rummaging in here.

Exits.Description: You can climb back out of the junk pile.

rooms.Name: Twisting Caves
rooms.Description:
These particular caves are the home of one of werehome's more famous 
inhabitants, the werewolf Lord Xamon. The walls are lined with gold, and 
gems, and precious souvenirs of his travels. The room is brightly lit 
by a huge chandelier made from a dragons skull. (You would be right to 
assume that Xamon killed the dragon himself)

Exits.Description: A twisting tunnel leads downwards.

rooms.Name: Kralian's Chambers
rooms.Description:
This comfortable alcove is the home of the leader of the werecats, 
Lord Kralian. There has never been a more graceful and cunning werecat 
in the history of werehome. The walls are lined with flowers, and vines, 
and the floor is carpeted with lush foliage.

Exits.Description: If you are agile, you can fit through a gap in the foliage.

rooms.Name: Lord Dorlan's chamber
rooms.Description:
Simple furnishings, for a simple Lord. Its all very homely, with a 
comfy chair and pictures on the wall. And a huge number of skulls in one 
corner. He may prefer to eat out - but obviously he gets food delivered 
fairly often too.

Exits.Description: Steps lead upwards.

rooms.Name: Outlook
rooms.Description:
The view from this place up at the top of the ship is really nice. You
can not see much but what you see is the better. The illuminated corners
of the town make up the margins and the glowing tunnels of life tube away
into the mountains as glowworm in a glass pipe. Just marvelous...

Exits.Description:
The stone ceiling of the cave making up the harbour basin is not that
far away. This very ship must have been built with this specific place in
mind.
The hard deck of the cargo vessel. Better climb, than jump down.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A brightly shining light comes from the two corners of the harbour.

The harbour town light make the tunnel shine and glow in a real nice
fashion. The dwarfs must be a lucky race to have this at all times.

rooms.Name: Passenger ship gangplank
rooms.Description:
As the standard anchoring place for passenger ships, the sidewalk here
comes equiped with a permanent gangplank leading east onto any waiting
ship. There usually is one there waiting to fill up before its next
journey. So buy a ticket and head out for a nice exploration event. A
little sign hangs on the short pole where the ticketseller use to sit
when he is around.

Exits.Description: The passenger port sidewalk lead off north.

The gangplank lead out towards adventure - Get yourself a ticket and
board a ship to the New World!
The passenger port sidewalk lead off south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The well polished sign reads :


To travel to the New World, purchase a ticket, then activate the
turnstyle and enter it. After a fairly short boat trip, you will
find yourself in an entirely new world, with its own hometown,
recall point and strange new creatures.
The pole is at a perfect height for a old dwarf.

rooms.Name: The passenger port sidewalk
rooms.Description:
The well illuminated sidewalk is the staring and finishing place of
many fascinating journeys. The ships that lie for anchor here carry
people and their luggage only. The current hot spot for travel seems to
be the distant Northern Continent. The waterlevel of the cave basin is
well below the sidewalk to ease up transport on and off the passenger
ships and any movement on the water have been strictly banned to avoid
free passengers. Down below you a staircase leads down into darkness,
while to the north the availability of tickets is reassured by the
travelleader.

Exits.Description: Next to the ships.

You can hear a mixture of faint sounds below as well as a few water
splashes.

rooms.Name: In a wide stone staircase
rooms.Description:
The staircase goes up and down in a helix, 25 dwarf feet in radius.
The view over the Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town that lies before you
is excellent and you can follow its contours into distance, where it
seems to end in a bright light. Above you the stairs continue up through
the stone cave roof.

Exits.Description: The sound of water comes in from above as well. How could that be ?
The sidewalk of the Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town await your feet.

rooms.Name: The passenger port sidewalk
rooms.Description:
The well illuminated side walk is the staring and finishing place of
many fascinating journeys. The ship that lie for anchor here carry people
and their luggage only. The current hot spot for travel seems to be the
distant Northern Continent. The waterlevel of the cave basin is well
below the sidewalk to ease up transport on and off the passenger ships
and any movement on the water have been strictly banned to avoid free
passengers. Down below you a staircase descend into darkness, while to
the north the availability of tickets is reassured by Fritz the
ticketeer.

Exits.Description: Next to the ships.

You can hear a mixture of faint sounds below as well as a few water
splashes.

rooms.Name: In a wide stone staircase
rooms.Description:
The staircase goes up and down in a helix, 25 dwarf feet in raduis.
The view over the Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town that lies before you
is excellent and you can follow its contours into distance, where it
seems to end in a bright light. Above you the stairs continue up through
the stone cave roof.

Exits.Description: The sound of water comes in from above as well. How could that be ?
The sidewalk of the Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town await your feet.

rooms.Name: Entrance to Ultima
rooms.Description:
The blue moongate casts a strange blue light upon a huge gate to the
south. The gate is open and beyond it you see a simple village. Around the
gate there are two pedestals. On the first pedestal, there is a magic
scroll. On the second there is a plaque.

Exits.Description: There is a huge gate

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An image flies out of the scroll and creates a huge image of a face
approximately ten feet off the ground.  It says, "Welcome to Ultima,
where adventure and excitement may be found for all people, and all
levels.  Each of the planes increase in level. Have a nice day!"

The plaque reads, "The Ultima Area was made for Merc 2.0 and converted
to Elite 5.1,"

rooms.Name: New Magincia Road
rooms.Description:
This is the main road of New Magincia. The dirt path continues to
the south and a huge gate lies to the north.

Exits.Description: There is a huge gate.

rooms.Name: New Magincia Road
rooms.Description:
The path continues to the south and the north. You see the tracks
of sheep here.

Exits.Description: The path continues to the north.
There is a shimmering light to the south.

rooms.Name: The New Magincia Moongate
rooms.Description:
You see another moongate here, exactly between the crossing of
two paths.

rooms.Name: New Magincia Road
rooms.Description:
The path continues to the south and north. On the east there seems
to be administrative building.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

rooms.Name: New Magincia Road
rooms.Description:
The dirt road path ends here in a grove. You can continue back to
the north, and there is an old abandoned house to the west.

rooms.Name: Stables
rooms.Description:
This is the stables for the shepherd. There are many fine horses here.
You can return to the barn to the south.

Exits.Description: The front part of the barn is to the south.

rooms.Name: Barn
rooms.Description: This is your basic barn, with hay and stables to the north.

Exits.Description: You hear neighing, intermixed with a strange talking.

rooms.Name: Humility Lane
rooms.Description:
This is an even smaller dirt path that crosses New Maginica Road.
To your north there is a barn, and to the south you see a condemned
building, though you cannot enter this way. The west is blocked off
by a herd of sheep.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light to the east.

rooms.Name: Condemned House
rooms.Description:
This place is wrecked, the rafters have fallen, and light shines
through a large hole in the roof. You wonder what kinds of animals
have taken up residence here.

rooms.Name: Condemned House
rooms.Description:
As you walk into the house, you realize that this house must not
have been reconstructed yet from the ruin of Old Magincia. Faint
intimations of foolish pride can still be seen through the wreckage.

rooms.Name: Attic
rooms.Description: The attic is dark, and you smell some vestiges of bat guano.

Exits.Description: The rest of the house is down.

rooms.Name: House
rooms.Description:
This is a small humble house. You do not see much here, though there
is some faint squeaking.

Exits.Description: You see the faint outline of a trapdoor.

rooms.Name: Humility Lane
rooms.Description:
This is a very small path. It ends here with a fence to the east. To
the west is the Moongate, and to the north there is a small house.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Office
rooms.Description:
Though this room is small, it acts as a meeting place for Katrina
and any other person that she has to meet. You can exit to the west
or enter an office to the south.

rooms.Name: Katrina's Office
rooms.Description:
This office is very sparse... and humble. There are no decorations,
in fact the room is bare except for a simple desk and its chair.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description:
This is an amazingly HUGE library. Its musty smell and the collapsed
bookshelf to your north tell you that it also must be ancient. In any
case you can't get out of the Library so just pick a book and start
reading. The stacks continue to the east and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These shelves deal with the fascinating letter A.  Among the more
interesting books are, "Andersen's tips on Area Building."  "The
Art of Spamming" and "Axes and You."

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These books are about the letters B and C.  Some titles are: 'Boom
Boxes: How large will they become?' and 'Cutlery: The fine points
of Killing' and of course the classic, 'Casret's Titles.'

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This shelf has books dealing with the 'D's'.  'Dracula, Blood Sucker
or Beavis fan?' seems to be the most interesting book here.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The 'E' section is here.  One book, "Howard Stern" doesn't seem to
belong here.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the north and west.

Exits.Description: You see a big desk and a man.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You find 'Fax Fun' and 'Farts: How to Blame it on the Dog.' in this
section of the library.

rooms.Name: Library Office
rooms.Description:
A big desk dominates this room. All books must go through this
office before getting taken out.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the west and east.

Exits.Description: You see a huge desk.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The books here start with 'G'.  'Grating Cheese with Julia Childs' and
'Garamond: What kind of font is this anyway?' lie here.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and south .

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The books here comprise 'H' and 'I'.  'Hiya: The Women who Use it, and
the Man who Uses the Women' and 'Icaza Loves Ya' are here in gaudy and
annoying covers.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the north and east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These books start with the letter 'J'.  'Jokey Smurf's Greatest
Explosions' and 'The Judge take on New York' seem to be the most
popular books.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the west and east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Hmmm this is the 'K' section, and 'Kicking Vs. Bashing' is here.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the west and east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A book titled, 'Lick me, Lick you'  is here.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the west and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
'Mahatma Teaches French' and 'MC Echser: The Rap Star and Paradoxical
Artist'.

rooms.Name: The Library Moongate
rooms.Description: A blue moongate is here, lighting up the otherwise featureless room.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the north and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Hmmm... This is the 'N' section... but 'Nothing' seems to be here.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the 'OP' section.  You hear moaning behind those stacks, yup
there on the floor is another P.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
'Quai Mackdaddy Monk and 'Rhinoplasty, or The Inebriation of Wild
Animals' are here.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and west..

Exits.Description: Hinges on a shelf?

ExtraDescriptions.Description: 'Secret Door: The Shelf' is on the shelf.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the east and north.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: 'Textile Farming' and 'Tempting Miss Daisy' is here.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the south and north.

Exits.Description: There is an odd chattering to the north.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: 'Ultima: The Building of an Area' is here.

rooms.Name: Web
rooms.Description:
There is a Huge Web here, stretching from shelf to shelf... and
stupid you wandered into it.

rooms.Name: Library
rooms.Description: The Library continues here, with exits to the south and east.

Exits.Description: There is a strange chattering noise to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: "Yaz: Grooming Tips" is here.

rooms.Name: The Center of the Tavern
rooms.Description:
The moongate has opened inside a huge party. There are bards and
other townsmen. This must be Britain. There are people everywhere
carrying their drinks and singing everywhere. The party continues to
the north, east, south, and west.

rooms.Name: The Northwest Corner of the Tavern
rooms.Description:
This is where the tavern entrance would be if it wasn't packed with
humans trying to get in or get out. There is no chance of you leaving
the tavern tonight. You leave east or the south.

rooms.Name: The North Wall of the Tavern
rooms.Description:
Party-goers mingle here in front of the bar. They seem to be having
a great time and wish for you to join them. You can continue on to the
south, east or north.

rooms.Name: The Northeast Corner of the Tavern
rooms.Description:
Along this east wall of the tavern are all the tables for the meals.
Outside the windows you see cobblestone streets.

rooms.Name: The West Wall of the Tavern
rooms.Description:
The band has set up here, against the west wall. Many people dance
to the music.

rooms.Name: The East Wall of the Tavern
rooms.Description:
The tables are set up here, and you see many couples and group just
sitting and talking. They have drinks on their tables and smiles on
their faces.

rooms.Name: The Southwest Corner of the Tavern
rooms.Description:
There are many people here, but there seems to be a slight stench
coming from somewhere.

rooms.Name: The South Wall of the Tavern
rooms.Description:
The South Wall windows overlook the sea. There seems to be an island
far to the south, and boats just floating in the ports. The party-goers
wander around here.

rooms.Name: The Southeast Corner of the Tavern
rooms.Description:
There are tables here that continue to the north. The party-goers
just mingle and hit on each other.

rooms.Name: Cellar
rooms.Description:
The stairway seems to lead down into the cellar. It stinks of wine,
beer and snakes here.

rooms.Name: Cellar
rooms.Description:
There are huge wine casks against this wall. Most seem intact though
one is eaten through, and the inside seems to have a gooey green
substance.

Exits.Description: There is the sound of singing in that corner.
There is a shimmering light to the south.

rooms.Name: Cellar
rooms.Description:
There is a chair in corner, and plenty of empty bottles. There is
also the evidence of that green substance here as well.

rooms.Name: Cellar
rooms.Description:
There is a slime trail here. There seems to be much broken glass
down here.

rooms.Name: The Britain Moongate
rooms.Description:
The place around the moongate, as always, seems clean and neat. The
blue light of the moongate has become a comforting sight to you.

rooms.Name: Cellar
rooms.Description:
The walls are leaking here. You can hear the bang of feet and the
shifting of chairs from above.

rooms.Name: Cellar
rooms.Description:
The damp walls of this corner bother you... Not because it's damp -
because it's not water!

rooms.Name: Cellar
rooms.Description: The smells and ventilation of this cellar are overpowering.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

rooms.Name: Cellar
rooms.Description:
This corner of the cellar is the ugliest. From the smell in the corner
it is obvious where the Drunks clear their guts.

rooms.Name: The Yew Entrance
rooms.Description:
To the south you see a large courthouse and a small part of Yew. Most
of Yew is secretly hidden in the branches of the forest. To the north you
see one of the most dangerous parts of this same forest.

rooms.Name: In Front of the Courthouse
rooms.Description:
The immense Courthouse faces this street. All of Britannia's crime goes
here to be tried. There is little crime anymore though, after the great
enlightenment. There is also a pub to the west.

Exits.Description: The courthouse doors lie this way.

rooms.Name: Justice Row
rooms.Description:
The cobblestone road leads into a clearing of the woods to the east and
to a pub to the west. To your south you see a great Courthouse, but its
entrance is on the east.

rooms.Name: Under the Stone Arch
rooms.Description:
You stand under a large stone arch. To your east there is a bonfire.
Around the bonfire are these same stone arches; they form a circle around
the clearing.

Exits.Description: There are chanting druids and a large bonfire to the east.

rooms.Name: Bonfire
rooms.Description:
The heat from the bonfire warms you even at the fringe of the ceremony.
Here, Druids form a circle and chant the sacred mantra.

rooms.Name: Pub
rooms.Description:
You are in a happy little pub. There are many little tables and
citizens are talking here.

rooms.Name: Justice Row
rooms.Description: There are some citizens strolling on the road. There is a Pub to the west.

rooms.Name: Justice Row
rooms.Description:
Perhaps the only real street in a city where all the citizens are
nestled in trees, it leads east to west.

rooms.Name: The Audience Room
rooms.Description:
This is where people would sit to see the cases and wait for the Judge.
To the North you see the actual Bench. All around are the pew-like seats.

rooms.Name: The Bench
rooms.Description:
The Bench is one of the most imposing things you've seen. You have to
crane your neck to even glimpse at the Judge. There are no lawyers, there
is only justice. To the east and west there are the prisons.

rooms.Name: Prison
rooms.Description:
To the north you see a cell. Locks are unnecessary, because the
prisoners are kept in their cells by magic.

Exits.Description: The prisoner looks at you and growls.

rooms.Name: Prison
rooms.Description:
To the north you see a cell. Locks are unnecessary, because the
prisoners are kept in their cells by magic.

Exits.Description: The prisoner is a small man.

rooms.Name: Prison Cell
rooms.Description: This is a cell where they keep dangerous prisoners.

rooms.Name: Prison Cell
rooms.Description: This is a cell where they keep dangerous prisoners.

rooms.Name: Yew Forest
rooms.Description:
The Yew Forest stretches out in every direction. Gnarled yew
trees stand all around, branches reaching down to snag you as you
pass. The ground is mostly bare and the trees all look the same.
The Druids can find their way through the forest, wonder how
they do it? An arrow carved into a nearby tree points south.

Exits.Description: A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is well known that druids will not deface the sacred trees, so
this is most likely a hoax. There are some trail markings near the
eastern path.

rooms.Name: Yew Forest
rooms.Description:
The Yew Forest stretches out in every direction. Gnarled yew
trees stand all around, branches reaching down to snag you as you
pass. The ground is mostly bare and the trees all look the same.
The Druids can find their way through the forest, wonder how
they do it? You can hear the sound of chanting coming from the
north.

Exits.Description: A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
You can see the courthouse in the distance.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

rooms.Description:
The Yew Forest stretches out in every direction. Gnarled yew
trees stand all around, branches reaching down to snag you as you
pass. The ground is mostly bare and the trees all look the same.
The Druids can find their way through the forest, wonder how
they do it? There are muddy footprints all around here.

Exits.Description: A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Most of them lead east.

rooms.Name: Yew Forest
rooms.Description:
The Yew Forest stretches out in every direction. Gnarled yew
trees stand all around, branches reaching down to snag you as you
pass. The ground is mostly bare and the trees all look the same.
The Druids can find their way through the forest, wonder how
they do it? You notice a faint glimmer of bluish light coming
from the east.

Exits.Description: A trail winds its way between the trees.
A faint bluish light comes from this direction.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

rooms.Name: Yew Forest
rooms.Description:
The Yew Forest stretches out in every direction. Gnarled yew
trees stand all around, branches reaching down to snag you as you
pass. The ground is mostly bare and the trees all look the same.
The Druids can find their way through the forest, wonder how
they do it? Two leaves have been impaled on a sharp twig and placed
carefully near the western trail.

Exits.Description: A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A common trail sign - it means head south.

rooms.Description:
The Yew Forest stretches out in every direction. Gnarled yew
trees stand all around, branches reaching down to snag you as you
pass. The ground is mostly bare and the trees all look the same.
The Druids can find their way through the forest, wonder how
they do it? There are scuff marks near the foot of a tree to the
east.

Exits.Description: A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

rooms.Description:
The Yew Forest stretches out in every direction. Gnarled yew
trees stand all around, branches reaching down to snag you as you
pass. The ground is mostly bare and the trees all look the same.
The Druids can find their way through the forest, wonder how
they do it? You can hear chanting sounds coming from all around.

Exits.Description: The chanting seems loudest in this direction.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

rooms.Name: Yew Forest
rooms.Description:
The Yew Forest stretches out in every direction. Gnarled yew
trees stand all around, branches reaching down to snag you as you
pass. The ground is mostly bare and the trees all look the same.
The Druids can find their way through the forest, wonder how
they do it? The leaves on the ground to the east and south have
been disturbed recently.

Exits.Description: A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Hmm...looks like they have been carefully arranged to draw attention
away from the northern trail.

rooms.Name: Yew Forest
rooms.Description:
The Yew Forest stretches out in every direction. Gnarled yew
trees stand all around, branches reaching down to snag you as you
pass. The ground is mostly bare and the trees all look the same.
The Druids can find their way through the forest, wonder how
they do it? There is some faintly glowing moss on a tree to the
east.

Exits.Description: A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The moss refects a bluish light coming from the west. You wonder what
the source of that light could be.

All of a sudden it seems, the trees part and you find yourself before
a blue glowing moongate. It hums with energy, waiting to take you to new
worlds - but only if you have the key! Paths lead off in all directions
through the woods.

Exits.Description: A trail winds its way between the trees.
A trail winds its way between the trees.

rooms.Description:
There is a huge maw of an entrance to one of the terrible Dungeons.
After the Age of Enlightenment only 8 sources of evil still survive in the
world.  These are the eight Dungeons. Now they are being cleaned out.

Exits.Description: A cold draft pours out of the dungeon.

rooms.Name: Minoc
rooms.Description:
The moongate has led to the ocean side city of Minoc. To the north, there
is the sea, and to the south there is the town of Minoc.

rooms.Name: The Armourer
rooms.Description:
The Armourer buys and sells armour. His smithy is impressive with all
of his greatest works hanging on the walls.

rooms.Name: Minoc's Fountain
rooms.Description:
This is the entrance of Minoc. To the east you see the weaponsmith, and
to the west is the Armourer. To the south there seems to be a large road.

rooms.Name: The Weaponsmith
rooms.Description:
The best Weaponsmith in the realm is here. His shop is full of hanging
weapons.

rooms.Name: The Boat seller
rooms.Description: This is the shop where you can purchase vehicles to cross the sea.

rooms.Name: Sacrifice Street
rooms.Description:
This Street goes from east to west. To the west is a shop and to the
south is a home.

rooms.Name: Sacrifice Street
rooms.Description:
This street runs from east to west. To the west there is a shop, and to
the east there is a forge.

rooms.Name: Sacrifice Street
rooms.Description:
This street runs from west to east. There is a home to the south and
forge to the east.

rooms.Name: Forge
rooms.Description:
The heat of this place causes blisters to form. The rhythmic beat of
hammer against the forge causes you to believe that someone is working
here.

rooms.Name: Residence
rooms.Description:
This residence is very small. It befits the teaching of sacrifice
without any item that is extra.

rooms.Name: Residence

rooms.Name: The Beach
rooms.Description: The beach ends here. You can go east or west.

rooms.Name: The Beach
rooms.Description:
The beach extends from west to east, but the waves are too heavy here
to enter the ocean.

rooms.Name: The Beach
rooms.Description:
The beach here is perfect, glistening white sands, perfect sun. Too bad
there is a monster infestation....

rooms.Name: The Beach
rooms.Description: The beach seems so idyllic, too bad these monster keep showing up.

rooms.Name: The Beach
rooms.Description: The beach ends here.

rooms.Name: The Whirlpool
rooms.Description:
The whirlpool rages all around you, whipping the water to a fine
spray which stings your eyes. Bits of wood bob helplessly in the
currents, presumably some boat broken up by the torrent. The whirlpool
looks the same in every direction - how could anyone find their way
through this?

Exits.Description: Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!
Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!

rooms.Description:
All around the whirlpool rages, but there is a calm about this
place. The water is flat as a millpond, and faint light emanating
from the moongate tinges everything blue.

rooms.Name: A Campfire
rooms.Description:
This campfire sits in the middle of the camp. Many of the paladins
stand by it looking at the desert beyond. Some just wander by. To the
south is a small tent, to the north are more tents.

rooms.Name: Between the Tents
rooms.Description: There is a grand tent to the south, entered into through the east.

rooms.Name: In front of the Grand Tent
rooms.Description: To the south, there is a huge tent. To the east lies a smaller tent.

rooms.Name: A Small Tent
rooms.Description:
The paladin's tent is very Spartan, as he has to live without much in
order to develop his Honor.

rooms.Name: A Small Tent
rooms.Description:
The paladin's tent is very Spartan, as he has to live without much in
order to develop his Honor.

rooms.Name: The Treasure Tent
rooms.Description:
There is a HUGE pile of treasure here. It is truly immense. It would
make you easily a millionaire. If you could even take a tenth of it, you
could buy your levels. But the treasure is surrounded by a shield. A
shield that only the truly Honorable could get through. And if you were
truly honorable you wouldn't take the treasure.

rooms.Name: The Grand Tent
rooms.Description:
This tent is absolutely huge. To the east is the map room. To the south
there is Dupre. To the east is the treasure room.

rooms.Name: The Map Tent
rooms.Description:
This room has many maps and scrolls all over the table. There may be
one in particular that interests you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The scroll reads as follows:

Dear Lord British,
   This is Dupre reporting about the paladin expedition.  We are in the
process of clearing the desert of those annoying sandtraps.  Unfortunately
one of my men had wandered into the dragon cave and was slain by that evil
creature.  We need another knight, and also, the dragon had a moonstone.
Thank you, my liege.
                      Your Servant,
                         Dupre

The map has a rough drawing of the camp and to the north a small segment
of the desert, and a drawing of a winged lizard near the very north.

rooms.Name: Dupre's Tent
rooms.Description: This is the commander tent. It is full of commander type things.

rooms.Name: A Small Tent
rooms.Description:
The paladin's tent is very Spartan, as he has to live without much in
order to develop his Honor.

rooms.Name: Desert Entrance
rooms.Description:
You feel the hot desert wind blow sand into your face as you look at
those dunes.

rooms.Name: A Small Tent
rooms.Description:
The paladin's tent is very Spartan, as he has to live without much in
order to develop his Honor.

rooms.Name: The Desert
rooms.Description:
The desert in the northeast part of Britannia is a perfect example of
its kind. Dry, ugly, and lots of sand.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

rooms.Name: The Desert
rooms.Description:
The Desert is an ugly place. Sand whips into your eyes, making you
unsure of where you are and what you see.

rooms.Name: The Desert
rooms.Description: You trudge on. This desert seems endless.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

rooms.Name: The Desert Moongate
rooms.Description:
Your thirst seems to slacken as you see the comforting glow of the
moongate.

rooms.Name: The Desert Moongate
rooms.Description:
Your thirst seems to slacken as you see the comforting glow of the
moongate.

Exits.Description: There is just blue.

rooms.Name: The Desert
rooms.Description:
There is a large cave to the north. Smoke pours out of it at regular
intervals.

Exits.Description: The smoke obscures all vision.

rooms.Name: The Desert
rooms.Description: The sands blows into your ear and eyes.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

rooms.Name: The Desert Moongate
rooms.Description:
Your thirst seems to slacken as you see the comforting glow of the
moongate.

Exits.Description: There is just blue.

rooms.Name: The Dragon Cave
rooms.Description: The cave is smoky. There is a glint of gold.

rooms.Name: The Shrine of Spirituality
rooms.Description:
In this room a huge ankh sits on a pedestal. The Shrine is the source
of all magical power. The Timelord himself lives here. There is a moongate
here also, and last of all there is a huge engraving taking up the west
wall.

Exits.Description: You peer into the blackness, and hear shrieks and sounds totally inhuman.
Peace infuses your body. The graveyard is a solemn and sobering place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Pilgrim,
     You have reached the final step on your way to enlightenment.  In
this last step you will be shown ultimate evil to your north, and ultimate
good to your south.  This is the land of the undead.

Both those whose goodness links them to the land, and those whose evilness
was rejected dead are here.  To have true spirituality one must know both.
Once you have been strengthened and forge through the evil, there is one
final test before you prove yourself equal to the Avatar himself.  You
must endure the test of time.

Through your entire journey you have not understood the real symbol of the
ankh.  Its true beauty only realizes itself to you now.  This knowledge
transcends all that come before.

rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
rooms.Description: The ground itself seems malevolent. It sinks and engulfs you.

rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
rooms.Description: The air sickens you. You choke on whatever flows through the air.

rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
rooms.Description:
It is dark, there is no evidence of light except what you have with
you. And this is swallowed by the darkness within 2 feet.

rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
rooms.Description:
Sounds are very weird in this place. Some sounds, like shrieks and
blood-curdling shouts are amplified, and you hear them frequently. Others
like your own voice, will not travel to beyond a inch from your face.

rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
rooms.Description:
When you enter this place all of your senses are immediately blasted.
You breath in that total evilness and feel dirty. You want to leave right
now.

rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
rooms.Description: You feel things all over your body. Sucking it and hurting it.

rooms.Name: The Graveyard
rooms.Description:
The graveyard background noises seem to soothe you. There is light and
peace. Your own voice carries so well and softly that you seem to be
telepathically communicating.

rooms.Name: The Graveyard
rooms.Description:
When you walk into here you are immediately soothed. Nothing could be
wrong with the world. All your senses are pleased.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

rooms.Name: The Graveyard
rooms.Description: You feel a light breath of air under your clothing. It massages you.

rooms.Name: The Graveyard
rooms.Description:
The ground itself here seems to welcome your footsteps. It is springy
and causes you little fatigue.

rooms.Name: The Graveyard
rooms.Description: The scent of the air refreshes you. It is sweet and lovely.

rooms.Name: The Graveyard
rooms.Description: The light here is bright and lovely.

rooms.Name: Lord British's Castle Entrance
rooms.Description:
This building is awe-inspiring, just smaller then Yaz's own. Anyway,
Lord British's personal Jester is here to entertain you.

Exits.Description: You see a fountain.

rooms.Name: Castle Fountain
rooms.Description: A lovely fountain sits here. To the north you see a guard.

rooms.Name: A staircase
rooms.Description:
There is a magical staircase going up. Beware, for those who go up
shall not return down. The other exits except for the west are closed for
construction.

Exits.Description: You see the altars of enlightenment.

rooms.Name: Hallways
rooms.Description:
This is the entrance for Lord British. Through the great doors to the
north you can enter. Another hallways passes across this one.

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
This is a hallway that would regularly extend from west to east, but it
is closed for reconstruction. There is a room to your north that can be
entered.

rooms.Name: The Throne Room
rooms.Description:
In the Throne Room there are the two most important figures in the
world.  The Avatar and Lord British himself.

rooms.Name: Batlin's Room
rooms.Description: Batlin, the molester of animals, and the general jerk, lives here.

rooms.Name: The Altar of Honesty
rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Honesty is the scrupulous respect for truth, the willingness never to
deceive oneself or another.

rooms.Name: The Altar of Compassion
rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Compassion is non-judgmental empathy for one's fellow creatures.  It is
pure love.

rooms.Name: The Altar of Valor
rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Valor is the courage to take actions in support of one's convictions.

rooms.Name: The Altar of Justice
rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Justice is devotion to truth, tempered by love.

rooms.Name: The Altar of Sacrifice
rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Sacrifice is the courage to give of oneself in the name of love.

rooms.Name: The Altar of Honour
rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Honour is the courage to stand for truth, against any odds.

rooms.Name: The Altar of Spirituality
rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Spirituality is the concern with one's inner being and how one deals with
truth, love, and courage.

rooms.Name: The Altar of Humility
rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment ends there.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Humility is perceiving one's place in the world, not according to one's
own accomplishments, but according to the intrinsic value of all
individuals.

rooms.Name: The Enlightenment
rooms.Description:
A voice booms out, "You are now eight part enlightened. To truly become
an Avatar, though, you must experience what he has experienced. Go through
the time warp and fight his enemies. Beware, only High Mortals should
attempt this challenge."

Exits.Description: The Time Warp changes space, and fluxes its surroundings.

rooms.Name: In the Warp
rooms.Description:
This is a forest. You were sent very far back in time. Before there was
a Britannia. Almost before there was a Lord British. This is the time of
Mondain.  The first enemy that the Avatar met.

Exits.Description: The Time Warp leads you to another place.

rooms.Name: In the Warp
rooms.Description:
You are in a featureless room. You see the apprentice and lover of
Mondain here. She does not seem happy to see you.

Exits.Description: The Time Warp zips to the future.

rooms.Name: In the Warp
rooms.Description:
You see the last of the Triad of Evil. With its destruction came the
breaking of the world.

Exits.Description: The Time Warp continues on.

rooms.Name: The Enlightenment
rooms.Description:
A voice booms out, "You have now truly became Enlightened. You have
fought and defeated the Avatar's enemy of the past. Now the time warp
leads to the future. Only the truly courageous can survive the enemies
there."

Exits.Description: The Time Warp changes space, and fluxes its surroundings.

rooms.Name: In the Warp
rooms.Description:
You seem to be in a castle. But there are torture devices here, and an
angry King.

Exits.Description: The Time Warp sputters and crackles.

rooms.Name: In the Warp
rooms.Description:
You seem to be in a blue room. It appears to be only 2 dimensional as
it sparkles. There is also a big red face here.

rooms.Name: The Lagoon
rooms.Description:
The whirlpool-like ocean is to the north, and the beach is back to the
east.

Exits.Description: The Ocean Roars.
The beach sparkles.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
The deep river flows east and west through a dense forest.  Over the
ages, the river has cut through the bedrock to form a particularly deep
channel for itself.  The banks of the river are very steep, and appear to
be very slippery, so it would be quite impossible to leave the river and
enter the forest.

Exits.Description: The river continues in this direction.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
North of here you see the miserable buildings of the poor alley. The river
flows west towards the bridge. The riverbanks are too steep to climb.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
North of here you see the dump. The river flows from east to west. The
riverbanks are too steep to climb.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
The levee is directly north of here. The river flows in an east west
direction.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
You see the warehouse on the northern riverbank. East of here you see the
city wall. The river flows west towards the levee.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
The river enters from a hole in the eastern city wall. The hole has been
blocked by several vertically positioned iron bars set into the wall.

Exits.Description:
Beyond the bars you see the great plains. With a little effort you should be
able to bend the bars aside.

rooms.Name: On the river south of turning point
rooms.Description:
The river flows gently west through midgaard city wall, strong iron bars
block the passage for everything except water. The river continues east.

rooms.Name: On the river south of turning point
rooms.Description:
The river flows gently west. To the north you can see lots of people
making their way through the turning point from or to the city of Midgaard.
The river continues to the west and to the east.

rooms.Name: A turn in the river
rooms.Description:
The river turns north here, making its way under a stone bridge. To the
east you can see the large castle of king Welmar. The river flows west towards
Midgaard.

rooms.Name: Under the Stone bridge
rooms.Description:
You are on the midgaard river under a stone bridge. On the west side of the 
bridge a ladder leads up to the road. The river continues south and north.

rooms.Name: On the Midgaard River in the Middle of the Plains
rooms.Description:
You are on a river flowing southwards. Around you large plains stretch far
on both sides. To the north you see a small wooden bridge across the river 
and behind it you see the Moria Mountains and to the north-east you can see 
the beginning of a large forest.

rooms.Name: On the Midgaard river at a old bridge
rooms.Description:
You are on a river flowing southwards, a old bridge is spanning the river
here. The river continues north and south and if you dare you can climb up
onto the bridge.

rooms.Name: On the Midgaard River in the Middle of the Plains
rooms.Description:
You are on a river flowing southwards. Around you large plains stretch far
on both sides. To the north you see that the river enters a cave in the Moria 
Mountains and to the east you can see a large forest.

rooms.Name: On the river in a dark cave
rooms.Description:
You are on a river in a dark cave in the Moria Mountains the cave
continues to the north and to the south you see some light.

rooms.Name: At a turn in the river in a dark cave
rooms.Description: Here the river turns to the east.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:

ages, the river has cut through the bedrock to form a particularly deep
channel for itself.  The banks of the river are very steep, and appear to
be very slippery, so it would be quite impossible to leave the river and
enter the forest.

enter the forest.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
The deep river flows east and west through a dense forest.  Over the    
ages, the river has cut through the bedrock to form a particularly deep    
channel for itself.  A small river branches off to the south, cutting a
path through the forest in that direction.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
The deep river flows east and west through a dense forest.  Over the    
ages, the river has cut through the bedrock to form a particularly deep    
channel for itself.  The banks of the river are very steep, and appear to  
be very slippery, so it would be quite impossible to leave the river and   
enter the forest.

rooms.Description:

ages, the river has cut through the bedrock to form a particularly deep    
channel for itself.  The banks of the river are very steep, and appear to  
be very slippery, so it would be quite impossible to leave the river and   
enter the forest.

ages, the river has cut through the bedrock to form a particularly deep

ages, the river has cut through the bedrock to form a particularly deep

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
The lush forest on the north and south banks provide a scenic backdrop
to your journey along the river.  A large tree has fallen across the river
just east of here.  The river continues to the east and west, but the banks
are too steep to climb out to the north and south.

rooms.Name: On the River under a Fallen Tree
rooms.Description:
A large fallen tree bridges the gap between the northern and southern
banks of the river.  The ground on either side of the river appears to be
quite marshy, probably due to recent flooding.  The swiftly flowing river
continues to the east and west, and you might be able to climb out onto
the soggy ground to the north and south.

Exits.Description:
The fallen tree is just out of reach.  Perhaps you can try climbing out of
the river onto the north or south bank.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
The river picks up speed as it flows to the west outside the city.  The
lush forest on the north and south banks provide a scenic backdrop to your
journey along the river.  A large tree has fallen across the river just
west of here, and not far to the east you can see a large stone bridge.

rooms.Name: Under the Bridge
rooms.Description:
The river flows under a large bridge on its journey outside of the
city.  The riverbank is too steep to climb out of the river, so you must
maintain your present path along it.  A short distance to the west you can
see the lush forest that surrounds Midgaard.  To the east, the river 
wanders past several buildings.

rooms.Name: On the River
rooms.Description:
The river flows past the buildings of Midgaard on its way west.  The
steep riverbanks force you to stay in the river.  A large bridge has been
built to the west, and the river continues past the rest of the city to
the east.

rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
rooms.Description:
The deep brown waters of this river appear to be provided by an
underground source.  A tremendous surge of water pushes up from below, its
heat warming the murky river.  To the north is another river, and to the
east and west is a vast forest, but the banks are too steep to venture into
it. The Xynarr River continues on its way to the south.

rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
rooms.Description:
The river widens considerably as it attempts to make its way through the
forest.  As it travels south, the water picks up considerable speed, and
much of the dirt that lines its route.  The resulting murky brown waters
look quite treacherous.  A vast forest of pine lines the river, but the
steep banks make it impossible to leave the river.

rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
rooms.Description:
The murky brown waters of the river make their way through the vast pine
forest.  The river turns east here, deviating from its original southern
route.  A vast forest of pine lines the river, but the steep banks make it 
impossible to leave the river.

rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
rooms.Description:
As the brown waters continue through the forest, the river becomes wider
and stronger.  The waters once again turn to the south, heading off to
their destination.  A vast forest of pine lines the river, but the steep
banks make it impossible to leave the river.

rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
rooms.Description:
The wide brown river cuts through the vast pine forest on its way to the
south.  As it continues to its final destination, the river picks up speed,
and a considerable amount of debris.

rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
rooms.Description:
The river resumes its southern path through the forest, racing to its
final destination.  As the deep brown waters rush through the woods, they
pick up various bits of debris.

rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
rooms.Description:
The river once again turns, this time to the west.  The deep brown
waters rush through the forest, picking up speed as it continues on its
way.  Several branches float past you, plucked from the steep banks of the
river as it races to the west.

rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
rooms.Description:
The river resumes its southern path through the forest, racing to its
final destination.  As the deep brown waters rush through the woods, they 
pick up various bits of debris.

rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
rooms.Description:
As the river winds through the forest, it picks up considerable speed.
The roaring waters race past the trees, taking pieces of them along as
souvenirs.

rooms.Name: On the Xynarr River
rooms.Description:
The churning brown waters of the river are moving at an incredible speed
as they rush through the forest.  To the south, you see the gaping mouth of
the river, where it meets a large body of water.

rooms.Name: The Amber Circle
rooms.Description:
You're are standing outside the Amber Circle's stronghold. On either
side you are flanked by a large tower. On the ground in front of you is a
trench about one human hand deep. The trench has been dug into
the ground, which has been inlaid with mithril. Placed in the mithril is
the Amber, which is so important to the Circle. A translucent barrier of
energy separates you from the interior of the clan house making the
impressive clockwork Minotaur clan guardians pointless. Both obstacles
recognize members of the circle and will let them pass.

Exits.Description: The stronghold of the Amber Circle lies this way.
The Forest lies to the south.

rooms.Name: Circle of the Blade
rooms.Description:
In this area the ground has a slight slope and the grass has grown
long. In the center is a wooden platform shaped like a circle with a
series of runes formed from amber. The platform serves as a combat ring
where warriors of the circle test their skills. The platform's real purpose
is a protection circle during summonings. Groups of warriors stand within
the runes and are thus protected. One warrior will stay within the circle
at all times during summonings, chanting hymns meant to restrain the power
of any demons in the amber circle.

Exits.Description: A training lesson for fighters is in sessios.
A clockwork gnome is wandering around announcing bulletins.
A door blocks you from seeing inside the tower of fire.

rooms.Name: Hear Ye! Hear Ye!
rooms.Description:
This part of the stronghold's courtyard serves as a meeting ground for
hunting parties. The clan message board, a clockwork gnome, is walking
around calling out any important bulletins. An atm is set into an alcove
in the tower of earth awaiting your banking needs.

Exits.Description: You see an enormous metal bowl resting on a platform.
A runic circle dominates the area to your west.
The world of midgaard lies this way.
You see two warriors practice blade routines within a circle of runes.

rooms.Name: Circle of Spells
rooms.Description:
The ground here is grassy and covered in the shade of a tall oak
tree. An amber rune circle was placed here to allow magi and clerics a
chance to practice their craft. The circle has been inscribed on a wood
platform covered by pure gold and inlaid with Amber. It is often used
by young casters practicing their new spells under the watchful eye of
an archmagi or high cleric. During rituals a magi or cleric will sit
here and chant hymns meant to undo any magic a deamon tries to cast.

Exits.Description: A group of spell casters sit here studying their book under the sky.
A door blocks you from seeing inside the tower of earth.
A clockwork gnome is wandering around announcing bulletins.

rooms.Name: Blade and Bludgeon
rooms.Description:
This is where many of the warriors practice their attack and defense
routines. The ground is level providing stable footing and the grass has
been trimmed. A few racks on either side of the area hold every type of
weapon imaginable. Some of the warriors are reading books about attack
and defense styles but most are practicing with the weapons instead. The
area smells of sweat, blood, and determination. A small bucket rests on a
nearby table along with a plate of bread, a dish of butter, and a bowl of
jelly. A strange gnomish invention, powered by a small amber mana battery
is turning three oblong, flat, blunt blades. The mechanism keeps the air
moving so the fighters can cool off. Gnomes sure are useful.

Exits.Description: You see a green house used for growing food.
You see an enormous bowl resting on a platform.
You see two warrior fighting within a runic circle.
You see the tower of water.

rooms.Name: Circle of Binding
rooms.Description:
This area of the courtyard is probably the most important place within
the stronghold. Five amber rune circles have been placed in small mithril
trenches and all are inscribed with smaller runes of protection. Each is
aligned with a different tower and attuned to one of the elemental
powers. In the center a large mithril bowl sits upon a solid amber
framework. The amber framework pierces the bowl in five places creating
another set of runic circles. A pile of wood rests next to the bowl and
has been prepared with spells so that no daemon may touch it. All these
elements combined create a powerful summoning circle.

Exits.Description: The sights and smells of a feast in preparation great you warmly.
You see the more studious members of the clan hard at work.
A clockwork gnome is wandering around announcing bulletins.
Warriors and rouges are all gathered around practicing blade crafts.

rooms.Name: Spell and scroll
rooms.Description:
A few wooden tables rest in this flat grassy area of the courtyard. It
is here, at these tables, that many of the clan's Magi study their craft.
On the table tops are loafs of bread, dishes of butter, jars of jelly,
and pitchers of water.  The area is also spotted with small trees forming
shade to lounge in and maybe even take a nap. Most of the Magi seem to
prefer the tables. You even see one warrior studying a book concerning
the language used to cast spells. It is a very inviting place to sit,
relax, and learn about the arcane arts.

Exits.Description: You see the smithy hard at work creating weapons for the circle.
You see the tower of air.

A group of young magi are practicing their spells under the watch of a
powerful archmage.
The master binding circle lies this direction.

rooms.Name: The Green House
rooms.Description:
Everyone needs food to eat. The green house is the circle's solution to
feeding the clan. The green house is a wooden building frame fitted with
an odd green metal. Each piece of metal is inscribed with a rune meant to
aid the growth of the vegetables, and fruits. A fairly large area has
been fenced off and serves as a chicken coop. All the smells mingled
together create a very relaxing aroma. A young girl is planting new
tomato plants and a boy, who looks to be near her age, is walking around
with a pail watering the plants. Together they grow and care for most of
the food used to feed the clan.

Exits.Description: The sights and smells of a feast in preparation great you warmly.
Warriors and rouges are all gathered around practicing blade crafts.

rooms.Name: Feasting Tables
rooms.Description:
This is where the clan comes to sit and have meals together. Currently
lunch is being prepared. Bread is being baked in a large stone oven next
to a deer roasting on a spit. A semi-circle of fire hosts five huge pots
full of soup. Vegetable beef, clam chowder,  beef stew, and more are all
simmering in their pots waiting to be eaten. On the dining tables rest
platters of bread, pitchers of milk and water, and great slabs of cheese.
A few members of the clan are already sitting here waiting for the food
to be ready. Eating is a very important affair in the stronghold of the
Amber Circle.

Exits.Description: You see the Tower of Soul.
You see the smithy hard at work.
The Master Binding circle greets you.
You see vines of ivy twined around the greenhouse.

rooms.Name: The Smithy
rooms.Description:
To fight daemons you need good weapons and armor to protect you.  An
excellent smith from a local village has agreed to work for the Circle in
return for housing, food, and some spending money. The greatest payment
he receives is the opportunity for his children to read, and learn
from the books the circle possess. The smithy's anvil rests upon a broad
tree trunk. Behind that lies his forge, and a wooden barrel filled with
water stands between the two. Currently the smith is working on a new
breastplate to put in the clan store room.

Exits.Description: You see the more studious members of the clan hard at work.
The sights and smells of a feast in preparation great you warmly.

rooms.Name: Chambers of Healing
rooms.Description:
This is the bottom room of the Tower of Soul. It is enchanted with
powerful spells of regeneration to aid healing. Large comfortable couches
line walls; and a fountain of fresh mead lies in the room's center. A
spiral staircase twists its way up to the second floor.

Exits.Description: The sights and smells of a feast in preparation great you warmly.
The library is upstairs.

rooms.Name: Storage Chamber
rooms.Description:
This room is the bottom floor of the Tower of Water. It serves as a
storage chamber for the less useful pieces of equipment the clan has come
across. Extra tables, chairs, barrels, clothes, boots, swords, shields,
and many other common, but useful, pieces of equipment are stored here.
All the items are stored away in an organized manner either in cabinets,
on shelves, on tables, or in whatever way works best. A staircase runs
along the wall leading to the second floor.

Exits.Description: You see warriors and rogues practicing their blade craft.

rooms.Name: Treasurery of Amber
rooms.Description:
You have entered the Tower of Air. This is the clan's treasure chamber.
Piles of gold litter the floor and pieces of magical equipment lay about
as if they were common items. These are here to be used by anyone in the
clan who might need them. Near the back of the room sit three enormous
oak chests filled with precious amber. The center of the room has a rune
carved into the floor. The rune creates a powerful gust of wind, strong
enough to move you to the second floor through a round opening in the
ceiling. That should be a fun ride.

Exits.Description: You see the more studious members of the Circle hard at work.

rooms.Name: Chamber of the Blade
rooms.Description:
Although the Circle promotes a closeness between all its members, no
matter what their race might be, some distinctions are useful. This room,
the bottom room in the Tower of Fire, serves as barracks for the more
combat oriented members of the clan. Magi and clerics need a quiet place
to rest and study their books. Warriors and rogues often stay up far into
the night drinking and playing dice or card games. Though no one is here
right now, a keg of fine dark ale rests in the corner waiting for the
night to come. A bones alley seems to call you and your money with eager
promises of fun. Despite the rooms rowdy nature every bed is neatly made
and more than one has a book of lore resting on top of the sheets. A
stiarcase lining the back wall leads to the second floor.

Exits.Description: You see warriors engaged in sparing matches.

rooms.Name: Chamber of the Arcane
rooms.Description:
The bottom floor of the Tower of Earth is the sleeping chamber of the
clan's spell casters but serves. Rows of beds line the walls in neat rows
In a small area at the back of the room a table has been placed for
anyone who wants to study late at night. A staircase lining the back
wall leads too the seond floor.

Exits.Description:
You see young magi practicing their spells under the watchful eye of a
powerful archmage.

rooms.Name: The Library
rooms.Description:
Reading and firsthand experience are the quickest ways to learn what
you don't already know. Since firsthand experience can sometimes be very
dangerous, reading is preferred by many. This library is the pinnacle of
what a library is meant to be. Each shelf stands at about the height of
an average troll, and is absolutely stuffed with books of all types. In
the middle of the room is a spiral staircare leading to the different
floors of the tower. Either side of the room hosts innumerable book
shelves. Down the middle of the room is an area with tables instead of
shelves. Surrounding the staircase are several podiums with books of
particular importance to the clan in them. The first is named
"#wMysteries of Amber.#N" The second is titled "#wEncyclopedia  Celestia,#N"
it probably details the different known daemon and  angel orders. The
others are blank.

Exits.Description: The Chamber of Amber is upstrairs.
The Chamber of Healing is downstairs.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The books is opened to a page concerned with the proper incantations for
summoning an imp. You decide to flip through to see if anything catches
you eye. The first things you notice of interest is a picture of a demon
lord being summoned by the Circle. The demon is of a type you don't seem
to remember. A caption at the pages bottle says it is the demon prince
Gratt'z. The oppisite page lists a peculiar occurance at this summoning
that had never occured before. It says that Grattz came into the circle
his own free will to provide the Circle with information about his great
rivals, Orcus, next plot. What made the summoning truly interesting is
that the Amber did not actively restrain Gratt'z as it should have. The
next twenty pages talk about the possible reason for this and the magic
theories behind these ideas. The most notable theory is that since
Gratt'z came into the circle of his own free will that the amber
responded with like action by not restraining him. How interesting...

This book is worn and old though well cared for. It probably been read
through by every member of the order at least once. It is opened to an
entry on a group of Angels known as Star lords. They are rarely seen on
the earthly plane since they are embodiements stars. Its also talks
about a gypsy whose crystal ball can show a person the way to these
beings if she can be found.

rooms.Name: The Chamber of Amber
rooms.Description:
This is the Chamber of Amber. In this room the Morphean Oracles and
the High Seers perform the spells of summoning to "extract" information
from extra-planar beings. In the very center of the room is a small amber
circle. Surrounding it are ten more circles big enough for even a
Half-ogre to sit cross-legged comfortably. Every stone in the walls has
a rune carved into it as well. At the walls' base are rugs for other
members of the clan to sit on. Along the walls are sconces, with candles
enchanted to renew their wax. The light cast by the candles seems to
dance along the edges of the amber cirles before being sucked in by the
power of the runes. Numerous doors lead into private rooms of  different
clan members. The northern door is guarded by a stone golem and a
staircase at the room's back leads down into the library.

Exits.Description: This door leads to the Council Room.
This door leads to Darth's private chambers.
This heavy metal door leads to Malcalypse's chambers.
This door leads to Xorinthalasea's private chambers.
The clan library lies this way.

rooms.Name: The Council Chambers
rooms.Description:
This is the Council Chambers of the Amber Circle. The room contains a
circular wooden table with a number of chairs around it. Each chair is
distinctly different from the others. In the middle of the table is a
glowing orb, It looks as if words are dancing across its surface. The
walls have torches set in sconces. They flicker eternally, and change
colors, thanks to a magical dweamoner.

Exits.Description: The flicker of candles reveals the Chamber of Amber.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
At what looks to be the head of the table rests two chairs. The first
looks like a hovering #Wbowl#N. It has a very soft cushion in it and
looks very comfy. The second chair is a dragon sized #Wpappasan#N with a
mithril base. Other chairs rest around the table as well.

rooms.Name: Darth's Chamber
rooms.Description:
The air in this room is thick with the scent of incense. Candles line
the walls casting a low light on the room's features. The center of the
room is occupied by a low table with cushions laid out in front of them,
which are ideal for kneeling. The table is covered in a plethora of
trinkets and puzzles meant to train the mind & hone perceptions. A pile of
books also rest on the table. A number of object dangle from the walls
and ceiling, just barely illuminated by the candles. You see balls
hanging from chains, hoops on hinges, and lots of other strange devices.
Many of them have ropes tied to them and are set up so they can be moved.
A complex system of pulleys run along the ceiling as well and the ropes
all come together near a series of ten levers. Beneath the levers is a
small metallic monkey with a red button on his forehead. In the corner
you see what can only be Darth's bed. It isn't so much a bed as a pile of
pillows blankets and other soft objects. The room seems to suit its
owner well. The only exit is through an oak door to the west.

rooms.Name: A Dream of Marble.
rooms.Description:
Black and white marble intertwine in the room, creating intricate
patterns on the walls, ceiling and floor. Inlaid in the walls are golden
words forming the history of someone that walked the long road of life,
and tried to enjoy every second of it, in both sunshine and rain. An
exquisite goldplated chandelier lights the room. The flames of the
candles make the shadows dance in front of your eyes. The sweet scent of
honeysuckle fills the room as a slight breeze sweeps the dust from an
opened window to the far left. To the right is a very large fireplace. A
wood pile lies to the side of it, ready to be put into the fire to give
Xorinthalasea warmth. On the right is an oversized chair with books
stacked all around, all with tattered covers that shows how lovingly
they had been read through the ages. Two glasses of chardonnay have been
set out on a table next to the chair. One for the host, Xorinthalasea.
The second for you. The words "Welcome" come to your ear on the noon day
breeze.

rooms.Name: An Ancient Curse
rooms.Description:
As you enter the lair of Malcalypse you suddenly feel at odds with
your own soul.  All around you it seems as though something is trying to
get into, or perhaps more accurately out of your very being.  The runes
of this room represent the darker side of everyones soul.  Of the few
that catch your eye one seems to represent Chaos and another an ancient
Evil whose name no one dares to speak.  Upon closer inspection the wall
furthest from the door seems to be completely covered in fresh blood.  A
large dark amber circle, big enough for a dragon, hangs in the air with
but a single pillow.  In one corner of the room you notice a treasure
hoard and in another the remains of a bonfire.  Melted candles make a
circle in the center of the room but the summoning circle is unlike any
other in the house.  Why would anyone choose to actually live in this
room?  What is Malcalypse trying to summon into this world?  Or is he
attempting to keep something out?  In the corner is that the remains of
dinner or a blood sacrifice?

rooms.Name: On the High Seas
rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. A gusty wind blows from the west.
Far to the south you see a coastline, even darker than the water below
you.

Exits.Description: The Ocean stretches out endlessly to the north.
You see cliffs to the south.

rooms.Name: On the High Seas
rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. A gusty wind blows from the west.
Far to the south you see a coastline, even darker than the water below
you.

Exits.Description: The Ocean stretches out endlessly to the north.
You see cliffs to the south.

rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. A gusty wind blows from the west.
Far to the south you see a coastline, even darker than the water below
you.

Exits.Description: The Ocean stretches out endlessly to the north.
You see cliffs to the south.

rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. A gusty wind blows from the west.
Far to the south you see a coastline, even darker than the water below
you.

Exits.Description: The Ocean stretches out endlessly to the north.
You see cliffs to the south.

rooms.Name: On the High Seas
rooms.Description:

Far to the south you see a coastline, even darker than the water below
you.

Exits.Description: The Ocean stretches out endlessly to the north.
You see cliffs to the south.

rooms.Name: By the cliffs
rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. To the south you see cliffs with
lethal reefs just before them. You also see some wreckage there, probably
from ships that have been crushed.

Exits.Description: You see the Mindorian stretches out endlessly to north.

Exits.Description: You see the Mindorian stretches out endlessly to north.

rooms.Name: By the cliffs
rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. To the south you see the outflow from
the Black Lagoon. Here the ocean water is mixed with the almost black
water from the Black River.

Exits.Description: You see the Mindorian stretches out endlessly to north.
You see the outflow from the Black Lagoon to the south.

rooms.Name: In the outflow of the Black Lagoon
rooms.Description:
You are in the outflow of the Black Lagoon. To the north lies
the Great Mindorian Ocean, and to the south lies the mysterious Black
Lagoon. To the west you can see deadly, dark cliffs.

Exits.Description: To the north lies the Mindorian Ocean.
To the south lies the Black Lagoon.

rooms.Name: In the outflow of the Black Lagoon
rooms.Description:
You are in the outflow of the Black Lagoon. To the north lies
the Great Mindorian Ocean, and to the south lies the mysterious Black
Lagoon. To the east you can see deadly, dark cliffs.

Exits.Description: To the north lies the Mindorian Ocean.
To the south lies the Black Lagoon.

rooms.Name: On the deeper Water
rooms.Description:
You are on the dark water of the Black Lagoon. To the north you see
high impassable cliffs and far to the south you see the shore. Although
the water is not transparent anywhere you have a feeling that it isn't shallow
here.

Exits.Description: You see the shore far to the south.

rooms.Name: On deeper water
rooms.Description:

high impassable cliffs and far to the south you see the shore. Although

Exits.Description: You see the shore far to the south.

the outflow of the Black Lagoon and far to the south you see the shore.
Although the water is not transparent anywhere you have a feeling that it

Exits.Description: The outflow of the Black Lagoon lies to the north.
You see the shore far to the south.
