     /                            / 
    /lue <item>     To get the pri\ 
    \ll <item>      To sell someth/ 
    /y <item>       To buy someth/ 
    \st             Gives you a l\ 
    /                             \ 
   /    WE DON'T GIVE CREDIT; WE DO\ 
   \                         NO HAG/ 
    \_____________________________/

rooms.Name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Swordsmen
rooms.Description:
It used to be that you had to watch what you said in this place, lest 
an over enthusiastic young warrior use you for sparring practice. Now is 
it empty, except for the ash (which seems to be everywhere in this city) 
and a small heap of armor in the corner.

Exits.Description: Main street lies to the north.
You see the Guild bar.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks like it was once a complete set, although its no longer usable, 
someone has punched a hold through it large enough to fit your head!

rooms.Name: The Bar of Swordsmen
rooms.Description:
This room was never well kept - frequent brawling meant that the 
furniture was often broken. Nothing much has changed, the furniture is 
still a mess, but now a layer of the sickly smelling ash covers 
everything. A small door to the south leads outside to a small practice 
yard.

Exits.Description: You see the practice yard.
The entrance to the swordsmans guild lies to the west.

rooms.Name: The Tournament and Practice Yard
rooms.Description:
A strange sensation takes you over as you enter the practice yard. 
You feel suddenly very aggressive, and want to test your skills. You get 
the impression that the raging gods also felt this way, the well that 
stood in the centre of the yard is smashed to smithereens, and someone 
with giant fists has punched a huge hole in the wall to the south.

Exits.Description: Through the red mist before your eyes, you see the guild bar.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its only just too small to crawl through, you wouldn't want to meet 
whoever could punch a hole this big through a brick wall!

rooms.Name: Eastern End of Poor Alley
rooms.Description:
You are in a narrow alley, which runs from the common square east of 
here, to the city walls in the distance to the west. To the south is a 
shabby looking Inn, you can smell burning within. Looking back the way 
you came you see your footprints in the ash, marking your way for 
anyone who might be following.

Exits.Description: You see the common square.
The smell of burning comes from the shabby looking Inn to the south.
The poor alley continues west.

rooms.Name: The Common Square
rooms.Description:
This large open square is connected to the market square north of 
here, narrow alley ways lead west and east. The centre of the square is 
filled with a large heap of the horrible ash that has covered you as you 
have walked around. Maybe its just your imagination, but you swear you 
can see human shapes in the ash.

Exits.Description: You see the Market square
A dark alley leads east.
You see the Old South Gate.
A narrow alley leads west.

rooms.Name: The Dark Alley
rooms.Description:
You stand in a shadowy alley which runs from the common square east 
toward the Midgaard river. The old thieves guild south of here is hidden 
in shadows, but you can make out the sharp edges of broken walls through 
the gloom.

Exits.Description: The dark alley continues east.
You can't make anything out through the shadows.
You can see a great heap of ash in the common square.

rooms.Name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Thieves
rooms.Description:
Always a haven for thieves, assassins and other wandering rogues, 
this has never been a very safe place to be. However, it seems more 
unsafe than usual - there is a certain menace in the air and you 
can't help but feel someone is watching you. You feel you ought to 
leave, only the very brave or very foolish would venture inside the 
guild.

Exits.Description: The dark alley lies to the north.
You can venture into the darkness.

rooms.Name: The Thieves Bar
rooms.Description:
As you enter the thieves bar your attention is immediately drawn to 
some markings in the ash. Someone has been here before you, someone who 
treads very lightly because faint footprints lead south into the yard.

Exits.Description: The footprints lead south.
You see the entrance to the guild.

rooms.Name: The Secret Yard
rooms.Description:
Lying on the ground is a complete suit of clothes, obviously once 
belonging to a thief (who else would wear such unfashionably dark 
clothes?) The clothes are arranged on the ground as if someone were 
still wearing them, but they contain only ash, still warm. One glove 
still clutches a scrap of parchment.

Exits.Description: You see the thieves bar.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You carefully remove the parchment from the glove, and read it:

   __________________________________________________________
  /                                                          \ 
 / My friend                                                  \
/  My time grows short, i pray IO may still save us, but i    / 
\  think it is too late for prayers. The gods have unleashed  \
/  Dagga against us, in their rage. I had long thought that   /
\  Dagga was a myth, but i have since learned the truth. He  /
 \ is pure evil, malevolence personified, and more powerful  \
 / than all the minions of hell combined. I will attempt to  /
 \ rally the other mages to stand against him, but i believe \
 / we will fail, and that we will all be killed.             /
/                                         Lorrigan           \
\____________________________________________________________/

rooms.Name: The Pet Shop
rooms.Description:
Oh the poor little animals never stood a chance, who would do such a 
thing? The cages all round the shop are melted into tiny metallic 
puddles.

Exits.Description: You see the main street.

rooms.Name: Pet Shop Store
rooms.Description: Hey! this rooms doesnt exist - get OUT!

rooms.Name: The Magic Shop
rooms.Description:
The front wall of the magic shop has been melted away, presumably in 
the struggle between the magic users and whatever did this. The back 
wall has been destroyed, blown out by a detonation of magical objects. 
The ceiling looks like it could collapse at any second, you better get 
out of here.

Exits.Description: You see the main street through the melted front wall.

rooms.Name: Inside the West Gate of Midgaard
rooms.Description:
The west towers have been toppled, and the gate hangs forlornly on 
only one of its hinges. The top third of the gate has been totally 
burned away, as has the footbridge that once connected the towers. You 
can see out into the wilderness to the west of the city.

Exits.Description: A narrow road leads north towards a ruined keep.
You see Main Street.

You see a road running alongside the the city wall. Sections of the wall 
have collapsed, almost blocking the road, but you think it is passable.
A desolate grey wasteland extends as far as you can see.

rooms.Name: The Ruined East Gate
rooms.Description:
There are signs of fighting all around you, as you stand inside the 
shattered east gate. All the buildings you can see are badly damaged, 
most don't have roofs, and many are missing some of their walls as well. 
The ground is covered with a dark grey ash that wafts around your feet 
as you move, and the same ash covers every visible surface like a pall.
There is an air of danger, as if the whole city is an elaborate trap.

Exits.Description: You can make your way along the ruined alley to the north.
You see a desolate grey wilderness outside the gates.
The ruins of the water shop lie to the south.
The street continues on towards the market square.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The gates hang awkwardly on broken hinges. Their surfaces are pitted 
by thousands of small burn marks and the bronze studs have melted and 
run down the face of the gate like tears.

rooms.Name: Wall Road
rooms.Description:
You pick your way gingerly along the road beside the west wall. 
Sections of the wall have collapsed, and the thick layer of ash 
covering the ground makes the footing treacherous. Wall road continues 
to the south.

Exits.Description: You see the ruined city gate.
Wall road continues south.

rooms.Name: Wall Road
rooms.Description:
The wall has fallen inwards totally just to the south of here, 
rubble blocking the way. You might be able to get past the rubble with 
a bit of effort though - you can hear a crackling noise coming from 
there, and sounds of movement. Possibly someone has escaped the 
destruction. Wall road leads north from here, or you can head down the
narrow alley to the east.

Exits.Description: You can pick your way through the rubble to the north.
A narrow alley heads east.
You might be able to force a way through to the south.

rooms.Name: Poor Alley
rooms.Description:
You are in a narrow alley, which runs east and west. The walls to 
either side of you are badly scorched, as if a great fire has passed 
this way.

Exits.Description: The poor alley continues east.
You see the city walls to the west.

rooms.Name: Alley at Levee
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the shadowy alley, to the east of the old 
thieves guild. To the south you see the levee, and the alley continues 
east through the ash. This part of town seems relatively untouched by 
the destruction, most of the walls are still standing but the ground 
is still covered with a layer of that horrible ash.

Exits.Description: The alley continues east.
You see the levee.
The alley continues west.

rooms.Name: Eastern end of Alley
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the end of the alley, where the city wall blocks 
any movement east. The top of the wall has collapsed outwards, you can 
just about see over the top, though the other side is only a grey 
wasteland with nothing to see. A small warehouse lies to the south, and 
to the north is a Mexican food stand.

Exits.Description: You see the remains of the Taco stand.
You see a burnt out warehouse.
A Dark alley leads west.

rooms.Name: Wall Road
rooms.Description:
The western wall here is mostly intact, but to the south it ends 
abruptly, and where the bridge used to be is just a hole in the 
ground. Its very hot in here, and the lack of air movement makes it
suffocating. You can hear moaning to the south, and occasional 
growling and the smell of burning flesh hangs in the air.

Exits.Description: You can make your way along the wall road.
It feels even hotter to the south, and you can hear sounds of suffering.

rooms.Name: Grubby Inn
rooms.Description:
You are inside the old Grubby Inn. This place was never well cared 
for, and its odour was legendary so it would be fair to say that nothing 
much has changed in that respect. However, the whole of the Inn is 
gutted, the floorboards are burned through in places and you can see 
into the cellars and the remains of the furniture form a large heap of 
kindling in the far corner.

Exits.Description: You see a narrow alley.

rooms.Name: Levee
rooms.Description:
You are at the levee, where boats that travelled the Midgaard river 
would dock and unload their wares. Looking over the river bank you find 
that there is no river anymore, just a dry river bed, and beyond it a 
desolate grey wilderness.

Exits.Description: You see the dark alley.

rooms.Name: Warehouse
rooms.Description:
All goods coming into the city would be stored here, the shopkeepers 
paid handsomely for the space to keep their goods. The roof of the 
warehouse is full of holes, as if fire rained from the sky, and the 
boxes and crates lie burned and broken along the west wall.

Exits.Description: You see the dark alley.

rooms.Name: Dagga's Lair
rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a living hell. The Avatar of Rage, Dagga, has 
made this his final resting place. There are several prisoners chained 
just to the south of where you stand, and corpses strewn all around. The 
heat is unbearable, and emanates from Dagga himself, who sits in the 
centre of the room torturing his victims. He casually points a finger at 
a young girl, who screams as her bones turn to fire. The scream goes on 
and on, until her tiny body turns completely to ash and crumbles to the 
ground. Now that you understand where all the ash in the city came from, 
you feel nauseous.

Exits.Description: You can escape this hell-hole to the north.

rooms.Name: In the Wilderness
rooms.Description:
Blood red clouds glare angrily at you as you gaze around the 
wilderness that now surrounds Midgaard. Once a verdant forest, the 
land to the west looks as if it has been scoured by a rain of fire. The 
only evidence of trees are several charred limbs clawing forlornly at 
the sky. The ash beneath your feet crunches as you walk.

Exits.Description: You can't see anything through the haze.
The ruined city of Midgaard lies to the east.
You can't see anything through the haze.
You can't see anything through the haze.

rooms.Name: In the Wasteland
rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a waking nightmare. The sky is a threatening 
dark grey colour, and the clouds are blood red. The ground beneath your 
feet is also grey, and as you move it sends up little puffs of foul 
smelling ash to assault your nose and eyes. The terrain is flat as far 
as the eye can see to the north, east and south, but quickly fades into 
an indistinct fog. You imagine that it would be very easy to get lost out 
there in the desolation. However it is the sight to the west that 
captures your attention. You stand before a set of broken gates, melted 
on their hinges, but still just about attached to the crumbling walls. 
Moreover, you recognise these walls, and the city behind them - Midgaard.

Exits.Description: The view north quickly becomes obscured by the fog.
The view east quickly becomes obscured by the fog.
The view south quickly becomes obscured by the fog.
The gates have been broken by a severe magical onslaught

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The gates hang awkwardly on broken hinges. Their surfaces are pitted 
by thousands of small burn marks and the bronze studs have melted and 
run down the face of the gate like tears.

rooms.Name: Behind the Shattered Altar
rooms.Description:
You are behind the temple altar at the north end of the ruined 
Midgaard temple. The huge white marble altar has been broken into 
several fragments and the floor is strewn with debris which has fallen 
from the ceiling. Two large statues of IO and Rigel, the two creators 
of the world lie where they have fallen, IO's head is missing and Rigel 
has been broken in half. A thick layer of grey ash covers everything.

Exits.Description: The main part of the temple lies to the south.

rooms.Name: Uncle Juan's Eatery
rooms.Description:
Mixed in with the acrid smell of the ash, is a sweet spicy smell, 
obviously left over from the time when this was a popular eatery. The 
whole place looks like a whirlwind has passed through, turning all the 
fixtures and fittings to tinder.

Exits.Description: You see the eastern end of the alley.

rooms.Name: The Wrecked Water Shop
rooms.Description:
It used to be a source of refreshment, but the Gods, in their rage, 
have ripped out the inside, scorching the walls and obliterating the 
roof. While dry ash clings to the walls, there is a small puddle of damp 
muck in the corner, where the proprietor once stored his wares.

Exits.Description: The rest of the city awaits.

rooms.Name: The Post Office
rooms.Description:
A vast amount of mail once passed through the post office, not just 
letters and postcards but also crates and packages. Messages still 
magically appear in the sorting box in the far corner, but they 
immediately catch fire. Ash from the burning letters spills out of the 
sorting box, over the floor and out of the door to the south.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the Three Crowns Inn.

rooms.Name: Midgaard Donation Room
rooms.Description:
This tiny alcove, just to the east of the main temple, was the source 
of help to many a young adventurer. People would often donate useful 
items to help the less fortunate. Everything left here before the gods 
came to destroy the city has been destroyed, each item deliberately 
rendered totally useless.

Exits.Description: The main part of the temple lies to the west.

rooms.Name: Wall Road
rooms.Description:
This narrow road follows the west wall northwards until it turns 
east. Just to the north of this place you see a ruined citadel, the 
heavy stone blocks from which it was constructed have been toppled, and 
the ruins it look far too dangerous to enter.

Exits.Description: You see west temple street.
A road follows the west city wall southwards.

rooms.Name: West Temple Street
rooms.Description:
You are on west temple street, picking your way over the rubble, 
and coughing as the ash irritates your lungs. To the north you see 
the old Midgaard library, and to the south you see the burnt out 
shell of the tailor's shop.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the old Midgaard library.
Temple street continues east.
You see the burnt out shell of the tailor's shop to the south.
The street continues west.

rooms.Name: West Temple Street
rooms.Description:
You are on west temple street, just to the east is the temple square. 
The building to the north, which seems to be missing its roof, and one 
of its walls, still bears the battered symbol of brotherhood - it can 
only be the clerics guild house. The building to the south seems to 
glitter like treasure despite the ash that covers it.

Exits.Description: You see the wreckage of the clerics guild.
You see the Temple Square.
The air seems to glitter in the building south of here.
Temple street continues west.

rooms.Name: East Temple Street
rooms.Description:
Ash hangs in the air near here choking you, and stinging your eyes. 
The old Three Crowns Inn lies to the north, and to the south you can 
make out the shattered flower shop.

Exits.Description: You see the burnt out ruin of an Inn
Temple street continues east.
You can make out the ruin of Rosy's flower shop.
Temple square lies to the west.

rooms.Name: East Temple Street
rooms.Description:
The devastation at this end of east temple street seems worse than 
elsewhere in the city. It is impossible to enter the building south of 
here, the charred timbers no longer support the ravaged roof, and the 
walls have all collapsed inwards. The building to the north has also 
sustained severe damage, though it is impossible to tell how much damage 
without taking a closer look.

Exits.Description: If you're careful you could take a look round the building north of here.
East Temple street continues east.
Temple street continues west.

rooms.Name: East Temple Street
rooms.Description:
You have reached the east end of East Temple Street. The ground is 
uneven under foot, and foul smelling grey ash makes you cough and 
wheeze. The building to the north has reinforced walls, and while it has 
sustained damage it seems to be structurally sound. A faint portal to 
the east flickers fitfully, you suspect that it no longer works. To the 
south you can make out the remains of the east gate.

Exits.Description: You can see the gutted shell of the city bank.
You can make out the city's east gate.
East Temple street leads west.

rooms.Name: Tailor's
rooms.Description:
It used to be that you could find the ideal garment here for any 
occasion. But no more, the only thing that remains is a hanging rail 
along the south wall, any clothes that once hung upon it have been 
destroyed by the gods.

Exits.Description: You see temple street to the north.

rooms.Name: Jeweller's
rooms.Description:
The floor of the jewellers is covered with tiny blobs of gold and 
silver, once finely crafted rings that have been melted in the 
destruction. The whole shop seems to glitter, as a result of the 
powdered gemstones embedded on the walls and mingled in with the 
ashes on the floor. Guess diamonds aren't forever after all.

Exits.Description: Temple street lies to the north.

rooms.Name: Rosy's Flowers
rooms.Description:
Rosy's flower shop used to brighten the day of anyone passing by, 
with arrangements of beautiful and fragrant flowers. There are no 
flowers here now, and the only smell is that that of burning timbers

Exits.Description: You see east temple street to the north.

rooms.Name: City Bank
rooms.Description:
The reinforced walls of the bank have saved it from total 
destruction, although it has still sustained alot of damage. A 
wrecked automatic teller winks at you from the corner of the room.

Exits.Description: You see East Temple Street.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Doesn't look so useful lying on its side like this. You poke 
experimentally at it, but it refuses to pay out.

rooms.Name: The Casino
rooms.Description:
Gambling of all types used to be available here; roulette, blackjack, 
craps and even poker. Someone obviously didn't approve however and the 
entire building has been pulled down. Only the entrance where you stand 
remains intact, and it is filled with the wreckage of craps tables, and 
pieces of the roulette wheel.

Exits.Description: The grey ash-filled east temple street lies to the south.

rooms.Name: City Library
rooms.Description:
This building was a source of information to all visitors to 
Midgaard, and a place of discussion. A long hallway used to run 
north from here, although the rest of the building has since been 
destroyed. The second storey, where all the books were stored is 
also no longer in existence.

Exits.Description: You can see west temple street.

rooms.Name: The Old South Gate
rooms.Description:
The Old South Gate had been disused and unguarded for many years, 
before the destruction visited by the gods. The remaining wall sections, 
and moss covered gates have been reduced to a sad pile of rubble, 
blocking any further movement south.

Exits.Description: You see the common square.

rooms.Name: In the Wasteland
rooms.Description:
You don't recall which way you came to get here. The fog is dry, and 
chokes you as you walk. You can travel in any direction but they all 
seem the same.

Exits.Description: You can't make anything out through the fog.
You can't make anything out through the fog.
You can't make anything out through the fog.
You can't make anything out through the fog.

rooms.Name: In the Wasteland
rooms.Description:
You don't remember which way you came, ash wafts round your
ankles, and the blackened skeletal trees all look the same. The 
land is completely flat, but your view in every direction is 
obscured by a foggy haze.

Exits.Description: You can't make anything out through the fog.
You can't make anything out through the fog.
You can't make anything out through the fog.

rooms.Name: Lake of Fire
rooms.Description:
This is where bad folks go when they die. They go to a lake of fire 
and fry!

rooms.Name: A pile of rubble
rooms.Description:
The stairs collapse beneath your weight, and you find yourself crushed 
to death by the falling chunks of marble.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything - you're DEAD! Unless....hmmm...wait a second..
are you an Imm..? Pah...ok...ok...enjoy it while you can...but ill get
you when you're morting :P

rooms.Name: Temple stairs
rooms.Description:
The stairs wobble alarmingly as you ascend towards the old BOT room, 
once a haven for adventurers, and a source of much needed help. The 
thick marble steps beneath your feet are chipped and cracked, and 
looking further ahead you see that the steps could easily collapse 
under your weight.

Exits.Description: I wouldn't try climbing those steps, they could collapse.
You see the main part of the desecrated temple.

rooms.Name: The Outskirts of the Battlefield
rooms.Description:
The trees thin out, allowing you to see a huge field, marked with 
the signs of an ancient battlefield. No natural sounds can be heard at
all, except for the constant whining noise of the wind, blowing over 
the field. To the north lies the path out of here, to the south lies 
the history of an ancient battlefield.

Exits.Description: The tree line
The Ancient Battlefield

rooms.Name: Monument of the Fallen
rooms.Description:
Here, a large monument has been erected to honor those who fell
beneath the evil they were fighting. Peace fills you, but at the same
time a cold evil seeps in to you, chilling your bones and flesh.
The monument shows a priest, holding a fallen soldier in his arms,
while giving the last blessing...praying for his soul. The only exit
is to the east.

Exits.Description: The Ancient Battlefield

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large monument erected to honor those who fell and willing gave up
their life to prevent evil from winning. You wonder if there were any
winners. On a gilded plaque by the bottom of the monument, hundreds of
names have been carved. Gorak Ironfist, Lord Captain Dreilim, Ischii
the sneaky one, Geyrn...So many...so many...

rooms.Name: The Ancient Battlefield
rooms.Description:
The ground here is heavily damaged. Magic and catapults come to your
mind. Metal glimmers everywhere, and you wonder how much mother nature
has managed to hide during all this time. As you look around, you see
the field stretch out in all directions.

Exits.Description: The Ancient Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield

rooms.Name: The Ancient Battlefield
rooms.Description:
Damaged terrain, burned trees...After the war, only destruction
remains. You think, will this ever 'heal', and at once doubt fills you.
The memories will always remain. Around you, the field stretches out.

Exits.Description: The Ancient Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield

rooms.Name: The Ancient Battlefield
rooms.Description:
A battlefield, with the scars of a long done battle. A very fierce
battle. By judging the damage, the remains, you come to the conclusion
that this battlefield, must have held one of the most vicious battles
in history. These scars will always remain. The field stretches out
around you like a carpet of destruction.

Exits.Description: The Outskirts of the Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield

rooms.Name: The Ancient Battlefield
rooms.Description:
The savage scars of great fierce battles mark the ground, and the
surrounding area. Metal glimmers everywhere, arrowheads, swordtips...
even some bones can be seen, half buried by time itself. But not even
time will be able to cover it all. The field goes on in all directions.

Exits.Description: The Ancient Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield
The Ancient Battlefield

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Mausoleum
rooms.Description:
Here, is a pair of huge doors. One of the doors hangs slightly from
one of its hinges. You wonder what tremendous force could have wrecked
theese doors. The mausoleum looks old, very old as it stands among the
shattered remains of a once truly beautiful forrest. Behind you, to
the north, lies the main part of the battlefield, and to the south,
lies the secrets of the temple.

Exits.Description: The Ancient Battlefield
Ruined Hallway

rooms.Name: North Wing Entrance
rooms.Description:
Here is a magnificently decorated chamber. The walls are covered
with great illustrations of all kinds of things. Great beings, holy
relics...Although, one common factor can be found. They all tell of the
the fierce northerners, the cold wintery winds of the north, snowy high
mountainpasses. A hall goes to the north, and to the south you see a
huge chamber, glowing with a pale illuminating light. A stairway leads
down into the dark.

Exits.Description: Ruined Hallway
The Altar of Purification
Shrine of the North

rooms.Name: West Wing Entrance
rooms.Description:
Here is a magnificently decorated chamber. The walls are covered
with great illustrations of all kinds of things. Great beings, holy
relics...Although, one common factor can be found. Everything concerns
forrests, and lakes. You can't help the feeling of spring washing over
you. You even think you can smell life begin to bloom. To the East a
pale light shines in through a huge archway, and a stairway can be 
found leading downwards.

Exits.Description: The Altar of Purification
Shrine of the West

rooms.Name: The Altar of Purification
rooms.Description:
This chamber is huge. Large colored windows in the ceiling let a 
pale light illumine the chamber. A large and incredibly beautiful altar
has been erected in the middle of the room. As you near it, a peace
fills you, making you feel safe and...clean. Huge archways can be found
in every direction.

Exits.Description: North Wing Entrance
East Wing Entrance
South Wing Entrance
West Wing Entrance

rooms.Name: East Wing Entrance
rooms.Description:
Here is a magnificently decorated chamber. The walls are covered
with great illustrations of all kinds of things. Great beings, holy
relics...Although, one common factor can be found. Everything is about
the autumn, the falling of leaves. The cold setting in. Everything
preparing for the cold of the winter. To the west lies a huge chamber,
and some stairs lead down into the darkness.

Exits.Description: The Altar of Purification
Shrine of the East

rooms.Name: South Wing Entrance
rooms.Description:
Here is a magnificently decorated chamber. The walls are covered
with great illustrations of all kinds of things. Great beings, holy
relics...Although, one common factor can be found. Everything tells of
the warmth of the summer, the rising of the sun. Life will be reborn,
everything walks again. To the north, an altar has been erected, also,
some stairs are leading down from here.

Exits.Description: The Altar of Purification
Shrine of the South

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Sir Durhne
rooms.Description:
This is the tomb of Sir Durhne, one of the good forces most 
brilliant swordsmen. The stories tell of him, wielding a shortsword
in each hand, while 'dancing' the blades with his enemies. The tomb
itself, is very plain. No carvings except his name on a small gilded
plaque. The only exit lies to the south.

Exits.Description: A crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: A Ruined Tomb
rooms.Description:
Chaos fills this room. You see the remains of the tomb spread out
all over the room. Parts lie everywhere, but...who would have done such
a thing? You dig some after the nameplate, and find it well concealed
beneath the rubble. But when you try to read the name, you can't help
but fail. The name's been destroyed by someone. The hall can be found
just to the east of here.

Exits.Description: A crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Description:
A large and pretty dark room, with exits in all directions. A large
holy symbol has been placed in the middle of the crossing, glowing with
a faint light. Inscribed on the symbol are the words 'Peace favor those
who fell beneath the shadow'.

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Lady Nemia
rooms.Description:
A large, heavily marked glass chest lies in the middle of this room.
Within it, you can see a beautiful woman, lying on a bed of large green
leaves. She's dressed in a white robe, with her arms folded over her
chest. There's a silvery plaque on the far side of the chest. On it,
the words 'Lady Nemia, her sacrifice will never be forgotten'. The exit
lies to the west.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Description:
This chamber, is being dominated by a huge chest of what seems to be
dark black marble stone. It's magnificent. Cut out on one of it's
sides, are the words 'Gaffyn the Bold, The Northerner. His deeds turned
the winds in our favor'. A large crossing can be seen to the west.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: Shrine of the North
rooms.Description:
In here a small altar has been placed, surrounded by hundreds of
burning candles, making the shadows dance on the walls. The altar
is small and very simple, seemingly made out of white oak. There's a
stairway going up here, and a long hall can be seen going to the north.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs
North Wing Entrance

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Ahania, the Berzerker
rooms.Description:
This is a very grim looking chamber. It resembles a cave, with very
rough walls. You wonder what the meaning is behind this. In the middle
of the room, a tall piedestal has been placed with an urn standing on
top of it. On the piedestal a small plaque with the words 'Ahania,
consumed with fire. Struck down with thunder'. There's a long hallway
just to the east of here.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Sir Wyneh
rooms.Description:
In this chamber, a large stone coffin has been placed in the middle
of the floor. The lid lies on the floor right next to it, broken in
two. Inside the coffin, there's nothing. On a small gilded plaque, the
words 'Sir Wyneh, Destroyer of darkness' have been inscribed. To the
south a crossing can be seen.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: A crossing in the Catacombs

holy symbol has been placed in the middle of the crossing, glowing with
a faint light. Inscribed on the symbol are the words 'May the Eternal
Light, guide our fallen to their final rest.'

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Lord Konrad
rooms.Description:
A very well decorated chamber, full of tapestries decorating the
cold stone walls. Small lanterns are dangling from the ceiling,
spreading a soft light all over the room. A heavily decorated coffin
dominates the chamber. On the far wall, a large sign with the words
'Lord Konrad, sacrificed his life and eternal soul for our success.
He will never be forgotten', written upon it. To the south, you see a
crossing, and a large holy symbol glowing faintly.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Lady Irinah
rooms.Description:
A chamber completely decorated with velvet cloth. Very soft, and not a
single sound can be heard. You feel very relaxed in here, as if nothing
could trouble you here, but then you notice a skeleton lying in a
corner. A large coffin is leaning against the far wall, glowing with
a soft blue light. On it, the words 'Lady Irinah, She found her peace,
may she never be disturbed' cut into it. To the north the crossing can
be found.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Den'Drelich, the Windrider
rooms.Description:
A large spacious chamber, but something strikes you odd. There's no
coffin, no final resting place. Other than that, the walls are very
smooth, and they almost glimmer in the faint light from the torches
that line the walls. Then you see something shining along the far wall.
A large metal ring, and then it strikes you. The whole floor is one
big trapdoor. You wonder, WHAT could be down there? To the south, the
crossing can be found.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs
Chamber of the Winds

beneath the rubble. But it's only a small part of the name that can be
read. '...rgehn, the Fiery La...', nothing else is readable. The hall

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Mistress Silfane
rooms.Description:
A very bright chamber, with large mirrors placed along the walls.
In the middle of the room, a large mirror has been placed, and within
it, you see the reflection of a beautiful woman. She's...glowing with
magic and strength, and you wonder if she really is dead. Then it
strikes you, you have no reflection in this mirror. Along the frame of
the mirror some words have been carved in, 'Silfane, Mistress of the
mirrors. Her light blessed us, her light blinded the evil'. To the
south lies a crossing.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Sir Heilon
rooms.Description:
In here, the first thing you see, is a large throne with a very old
skeleton sitting upon it. It must have been like this for years and
years. By judging the skeleton, you come to the conclusion that the
'owner' was a very tall, and propably very thin man. On a dusty plaque
behind the throne on the far wall, you see the words 'Final resting
place of Sir Heilon. His blade cut the darkness in two'. To the west a
long hallway continues.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Captain Paplaus II
rooms.Description:
A small chamber, with a small coffin in the middle of the room.
A very simple room, and a very simple coffin. On the coffin a few words
have been cut in. 'Captain paplaus II, although small, his heart was
braver and stronger than most. He defied evil in our darkest hours'.
To the east a crossing can be seen.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: A crossing in the Catacombs
rooms.Description:
A large and pretty dark room, with exits in all directions. A large
holy symbol has been placed in the middle of the crossing, glowing with
a faint light. Inscribed on the symbol are the words 'May the Light
shelter those who gave their lives for us'.

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Nioshi, the nimble one
rooms.Description:
A really small burial chamber, and the ceiling is so low you almost
hit your head. In the middle of the room, a tiny transparent coffin has
been placed. Within it, you see a small female body. You can't be sure,
but it seems to be a young gnomish girl. On the glass, some words have
been painted, 'Nioshi, avoided the dark with her tricks and quick
ways'. To the west the crossing can be seen.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: A Passage in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Worsh'ach, the Battlemage
rooms.Description:
The very grim looking burial chamber of Worsh'ach, the Battlemage.
According to a small sign above his coffin, he repelled every single
flow of dark magic that was hurled against the forces of good. But 
finally, a poisoned arrow got through and killed him. To the east,
a crossing can be found.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: The Tomb of Ungir Brimstone
rooms.Description:
Upon entering this chamber, you are struck by the magnificent walls.
Carvings everywhere, extremely beautiful..almost alive. A heavily
decorated coffin has been placed along the northern wall. A flowing
scripts marks the words 'Ungir Brimstone, Master of the blades. He
forged the light and combined it with steel'. To the west lies the exit
out of this chamber.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: A Ruined Tomb
rooms.Description:
Chaos fills this room. You see the remains of the tomb spread out
all over the room. Parts lie everywhere, but...who would have done such
a thing? You dig some after the nameplate, and find it well concealed
beneath the rubble. But when you try to read the name, you get a shock.
On the plate a name has been carved in a rigid script, 'Lord Gaheen,
our latest recruit...' then it becomes to hard to read. A long hallway
can be seen stretch out to the north.

Exits.Description: A Crossing in the Catacombs

rooms.Name: A Ruined Hallway
rooms.Description:
Everything in here is in a shambles. Tapestries have been torn to
pieces. Chairs and tables have been destroyed. Pieces litter the
floor. To the north a pair of huge doors can be seen. They look like
they've been through some heavy beating, since one of the doors is
hanging from one of it's hinges. To the south a hall is leading into a
large chamber.

Exits.Description: Entrance to the Mausoleum
North Wing Entrance

rooms.Name: Chamber of the Winds
rooms.Description:
Here is a huge chamber, with a heavy wind somehow caught inside it.
From time to time, you almost get swept off your feet by the strong 
wind chasing through this chamber. Above you is a large trapdoor, and
a small ladder leads up to it. Then something glimmering catches your
eye. In the faint light from the torches that line the walls, you see
thousands of gems, embedded in the walls.

Exits.Description: The Tomb of Den'Drelich, the Windrider

rooms.Name: A moldy ladder
rooms.Description:
Standing on a rickety and very moldy ladder, you gaze down into the
pitch black darkness below you. You wonder quietly to yourself what
possibly could be down there. No sounds, no movement at all. Then you
feel a slight breeze caressing your cheek. Maybe there's something down
there after all.

Exits.Description: Sloping tunnel
Cavern entrance

rooms.Name: Cavern entrance
rooms.Description:
A small chamber, if it possibly could be called that, with a small
tunnel leading into the darkness to the east. You look up and wonder
if you should head back up the ladder, or walk into the black to the
east. It's cold down here and as you feel a small breeze touching your
skin, shivers run down your back.

Exits.Description: Rocky tunnel
A moldy ladder

rooms.Name: Rocky tunnel
rooms.Description:
A small tunnel, with very rocky walls. You have to dodge, crawl and
God knows what to get past some passages. To the west a faint light can
be seen, illuminating what seems to be a ladder. To the south, the tunnel
goes on.

Exits.Description: Rocky tunnel
Cavern entrance

rooms.Name: Rocky tunnel
rooms.Description:
A small tunnel, with very rocky walls. You have to dodge, crawl and
God knows what to get past some passages. To the north a small tunnel
goes on and to the south, sharp looking rocks form a dangerous looking
passage through the dark.

Exits.Description: Rocky tunnel
Rocky tunnel

rooms.Name: Rocky tunnel
rooms.Description:
A small tunnel, with very rocky walls. You have to dodge, crawl and
God knows what to get past some passages. Southwards, a small tunnel can
be seen through the dim light. North you see sharp looking rocks forming
a tunnel.

Exits.Description: Rocky tunnel
Rocky tunnel

rooms.Name: Rocky tunnel
rooms.Description:
A small tunnel, with very rocky walls. You have to dodge, crawl and
God knows what to get past some passages. To the east you see a large
chamber bathing in an eerie light. To the north it is pitch black, but
you know the rocky tunnel is there. Hoping, it will lead out.

Exits.Description: Rocky tunnel
Eerie cave

rooms.Name: Eerie cave
rooms.Description:
A large cave, illuminated in a faintly ghastly glow. Looking up,
you see small holes leading up to the surface. Letting a little light in
to the cave. Watching the walls, you notice they are covered with some
strange looking moss that almost seems to absorb the little light there
is. To the west, a dark tunnel goes on. And to the south, you see a
tunnel heading into the mist. By one of the walls, you see a large crack
leading downwards into the unknown darkness.

Exits.Description: Foggy deadend
Rocky tunnel
Bottomless hole

rooms.Name: Foggy deadend
rooms.Description:
Entering this cave, you come to what seems to be a deadend. Wandering
around in the heavy mist that clouds this chamber, you come to the
conclusion, there's nothing here. But, strangely as it seems, you still
feel a slight breeze coming from someplace..someplace beyond the mist to
the south. To the north of you, there's a huge cavern filled with a
ghastly pale light.

Exits.Description: Eerie cave

rooms.Name: The other side
rooms.Description:
Strange as it seems, but a large wall of trees surround you. You look
around you, trying to find a way out. A small, almost tiny breach in the
wooden wall can be seen to the south. You wonder amusedly to yourself,
where you are and what happened to the caves you entered through.

Exits.Description: The tree line

rooms.Name: The tree line
rooms.Description:
Following the thin path surrounded by the trees, you finally come to
what seems to be an end to the path. Far ahead of you to the south, you
see light as the trees open up to a world unknown. To the south, the path
goes on into the woods.

Exits.Description: The other side
The Outskirts of the Battlefield

rooms.Name: Bottomless hole
rooms.Description:
Flailing blindly with your arms, you pummel rapidly downwards through
the dark. A scream leaves your lips as terror overwhelms you. And you
fall forever and ever. And you never stop screaming..never..

Exits.Description: The edge of the cliff from which you jumped, willingly.

rooms.Name: Crypt Entrance
rooms.Description:
You enter into a musty smelling anteroom from the main entrance to the 
crypt.  Strangely enough you don't see any indication of coffins or corpses
of any type. Along one wall are ledges that look like they might at one time
have held a body, but they have long since been removed. In one corner you 
do see a very old pile of bones.  Above the bones on the wall you can 
barely make out a message scrawled there.  Maybe you should 'read message'.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Beware of the Trogs, they were to much for me and this is as far as I could
make it.  They busted my legs, but I killed them.  I was stupid to go down
there before I was 5th level.  I hope this message saves someone from the
horrible pain that I am fe..........  The message ends in a dark brown stain.

rooms.Name: Dim Cavern
rooms.Description:
You come down into a tremendous cave-in to the south.  It isn't clear how 
long ago the earth shifted and the roof of the tunnel collapsed, but it is
clear that no further travel to the south is possible this way.  You spot
a few bones and pieces of broken equipment here, and the shadows your light
cast off the large stones among those that block your passage seem to dance
and flicker evilly.  You have a strong urge to flee.

Exits.Description: There seems to be an irregular shape here, hmm maybe a secret passage.

rooms.Name: Ambush!
rooms.Description:
Well, you've found an explanation for the broken bones. A party of
well armed troglodytes have marked your travel down the road and have been
waiting patiently for you to arrive. They seem to have come from a small hole
in the west wall you hadn't noticed before, as it was partially hidden by one
of the large rocks that has fallen from the ceiling.

rooms.Name: Many Tunnels
rooms.Description:
This is a twisty underground tunnel with many exits and entrances. The
ground is more or less even, but the passage walls are so similar in kind that
it is impossible to differentiate one passage from another by them. There are
exits leading to the east and west. The tunnel floor has been worn smooth by
the passage of many feet.

ground is more or less even, but the passage walls are so similar in kind that
it is impossible to differentiate one passage from another by them. There are
exits leading to the west and south. The tunnel floor has been worn
smooth by the passage of many feet.

rooms.Name: Spider Cave
rooms.Description:
This might have been a troglodyte cave at one time, but it is currently
inhabited by a couple of really hungry looking cave spiders. It's hard to read
their expressions, but they seem to be looking at you in a manner that implies
you are going to be lunch. You notice a lot of broken bones on the floor here,
and there are some partially drained troglodyte corpses up in the webbing that
is suspended from the ceiling.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
You have entered a small, smelly cave. There are bits of junk scattered
about the dirty floor, personal things of the cave's occupant - a large and
particularly evil looking troglodyte. The conditions he is living in are
pitiful, and you turn your nose in disgust at the remains of a rotted tunnel
rat that he discards as you enter. Looks like he's found a more appetizing
meal.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
This cave is really nothing more than a slightly larger tunnel than most,
but it serves as an outpost for several troglodyte watchmen, who don't seem to
think much of your visit. They don't like your light very much. In fact, from
their behavior you might even think they don't like you!

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
You seem to have stumbled upon an outpost of the troglodytes that live in
this region. In fact, from the sounds and glimpses to movement you see to the
west, you might have stumbled upon a troglodyte settlement. There are several
large troglodytes here will be glad to show you around. Well, they might be
willing to at least carry bits of you around, after they're done taking you
apart.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
This cave is apparently home to a bunch of real slobs. Not surprisingly,
it is adolescent troglodytes that live here. There are pieces of broken bone
and little bits of metal and glass scattered about the floor, as well as the
"valuables" of the cave's residents. You can hear the sounds of metal hitting
metal coming from the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There are bits of broken armor, the skull of a tunnel rat, pieces of string
and other such items of little worth.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
This cave is clearly a practice area for young troglodytes to hone their
skills of maiming and killing. The cave wall is an impressive dark brown -
dried blood from the less successful of those tutored here. Apparently they
play-fight awfully rough. The broken weapons and scraps of armor lying about
testify to this fact as well. The only exit is to the north.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
Mmm, you can smell some delicious tunnel rat stewing here, a cave that is
quite apparently the cooking area for the troglodytes living around here.
There are a few pots and pans here, though they are barely recognizable as
such. The small fire under the pot from which that yummy rat smell is being
emitted is barely enough to see by, but you can detect some troglodyte matrons
slaving over the cookery. They seem to think you'd make a nice addition to the
meal they're preparing. There is an exit to the south, and you hear what might
be the clatter of weapons coming from the east.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
It's yet another troglodyte strong point. From the density of these things,
you'd have to think the troglodyte people were constantly under attack. Who
could be invading their homeland? You realize it's probably adventurers like
you they guard themselves against. The cave is large and has two exits, one
each to the north and south. There is a funny, slightly unpleasant smell
coming from the north.

rooms.Name: Many Tunnels
rooms.Description:
This is a twisty underground tunnel with many exits and entrances. The
ground is more or less even, but the passage walls are so similar in kind that
it is impossible to differentiate one passage from another by them. There are
exits leading to the north, east and west. The tunnel floor has been worn
smooth by the passage of many feet.

rooms.Description:

smooth by the passage of many feet.

rooms.Description:
This is a twisty underground tunnel with many exits and entrances. The
ground is more or less even, but the passage walls are so similar in kind that
it is impossible to differentiate one passage from another by them. There are
exits leading in all four compass directions. The tunnel floor has been worn
smooth by the passage of many feet.

rooms.Description:

ground is more or less even, but the passage walls are so similar in kind that

smooth by the passage of many feet.

rooms.Description:

ground is more or less even, but the passage walls are so similar in kind that
it is impossible to differentiate one passage from another by them. There are
exits leading in all four compass directions. The tunnel floor has been worn
smooth by the passage of many feet.

Exits.Description:
There is a sign carved in the south wall. It reads:

       _____
      /     \
      | O O |
       \uuu/
       /nnn\
       \___/
    O____ ____O
     ____X____
    O         O

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
This is the entrance of a large cave, that extends to the west and then
branches out further to the north. It is likely that you have found the
beginning of the main troglodyte community, as they are quite numerous here.
>From their reaction to you, you'd think they are of the opinion you are
invading their privacy or something. There are three exits - east back into the
tunnels, west deeper into the caves, and north into the unknown.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
You are in the south westernmost arc of a large cave shaped approximately
like a donut, with an extremely large column in the center of the cavern. The
diameter of the column, you estimate, is probably about two-thirds of that of
the cave itself. It makes for a very strange tunnel-like effect, but it looks
natural though you have no idea what force of nature might have caused it.
This is where the troglodytes hone their weapons and repair their armor. From
the looks of things, it appears as if it's a skill they've been working on for
some time; though their tools are limited their armor and weapons are in
excellent shape. Maybe the Repair Guy had some troglodyte blood, who knows?
As you enter the cave, the many troglodytes working in here eye your armor and
weapons appreciatively.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
This is the northeastern cave of a linked set of four caves, which could
also be characterized as a single cave with an awfully big column in the
center.  From what you can tell, the cave is shaped more or less like a big
donut. In this section of the cave, female troglodytes are working on
extracting those vital vitamins and minerals from recent kills, by crushing
the bones into a powder which gets mixed into an occasional meal. There are
a couple of young trogs running around here, annoying those working. All this
activity ceases when you enter, and they turn to the task of defending their
home. In addition to the exits along the cave to the west and south.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
This cave appears to be the nursery. Normally, the troglodyte young and
their guardians are here, playing games and learning new skills. The cave is
entirely unlit normally, and the presence of your light source appears to be
the brightest thing some of the little trogs have ever seen. Again, it strikes
you that you might be trespassing. There is a larger cave off to the south,
and there are also cavern to the north and west.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
This is a smaller cave than any of the others in this area. It appears to
be a hidden twin strong point to the one directly east of here, from which the
cave you are currently in is not clearly visible. Ordinarily, this position
would be occupied by troglodytes watching over the other strong point to the
east, preparing to reinforce them in case of any trouble.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
You are in the female troglodytes sleeping quarters - as nice a place as
you think you've ever seen, for a cave. It looks like the place has been
cleaned with a toothbrush... even the dirt on the cave floor looks clean. The
rocks are shiny and sparkle at you, hinting at worth in their glittering
cleanliness, even though you know they are without value. There are ordinarily
several female troglodytes here, in serious discussion.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
This large cave is the sleeping quarters of most of the male troglodytes,
a fact that is evinced more than anything by the bad smell and the large mess.
How so many creatures who don't believe in bathing could live together in one
room is beyond comprehension. Perhaps troglodytes have no sense of smell. This
place is such a mess, you imagine they must have bad vision, too, to tolerate
it. The cave is normally occupied by a few troglodyte soldiers, catching a nap
between guard duties.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
The cave you are in resembles a tunnel more than anything, and might be
labeled as such if it weren't so wide. In fact, though, you are in a cavern
with an extremely large column of natural stone in the middle, which blocks
the view of the other side of the cavern from your current position. This part
of the cave is a practice area for adult troglodytes, as there are scraps of
metal and wood scattered about the floor in silent testimony to past rites of
supremacy that determine the clan chief. There are exits to the north and east.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
You are now in the northwest arc of a large, donut shaped cave. This is
likely the place where the soldiers work out their strategy and formations, as
you can see a bunch of rocks set on a stone "table" (really just a large, flat
rock), ostensibly the staging grounds for mock battles and strategic plots by
troglodytes here for many a year, given how smooth the top has now been worn.
There are also several crude drawings on the wall, though what they are of, it
is hard to say for sure. The cave continues to the south and east, and there
are also passageways leading to the west and north.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
This is the chief's "private" cave. Apparently being the leader of these
people has some privileges, at least. The caves furnishings are only slightly
more ornate here than anywhere else, though, so apparently the job isn't
exactly loaded with perks. The chief is here, talking with his top fighters
about prospects of battle. They turn to you, knowing now the battle they had
been anticipating is already upon them. There is an exit to the south.

rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
rooms.Description:
This cave is apparently the place where the troglodyte chief receives his
guests. There is a large case filled with trophies from past victories of the
troglodyte clan. Among the trophies, you spot a battered Golden Shield, the
skull of a cave fisher, with some dents and a big hole just over the right
eye, a small crystal sphere, and dull gray helmet with a plume that was once
probably white. The mementos here range from the unexpected to the astounding.
You are impressed by the ability of such a seemingly limited people to have
defeated such a large and varied set of opponents. You can exit east

rooms.Name: The Entrance to The Catacombs
rooms.Description:
This place feels chilly and faintly damp. It is the burial grounds for many
prominent and other less prominent citizens of Midgaard. Two huge stone doors
stand widely open. The place is dimly lit by torches on the walls. A small sign
is visible on one of the doors. To the south there is a raspberry bush.#N

Exits.Description: Through the doors, the upper Catacombs begin.
Stairs lead up to the temple.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The sign reads:  Beware of undead creatures of the dark

These two huge doors don't seem to have been touched in years.  They must
be so heavy that none have been able to close them.

Behind the raspberry bush you spot a hole. Hmm, seems to be a entrance
to a cave here. There is a strange deep carving on the stone wall... six
runes. You translate... 

"M..E..no..A..L?..yes..I..errr..@$#%^...N..and..A..again"
Yes! It says "Malina!"... What the heck is a Malina?#N

rooms.Name: Upper Catacombs
rooms.Description:
This wide hallway is only dimly lit by torches. Along the north wall,
there are many alcoves, probably graves of some higher ranking Midgaard
citizens. The hallway continues to the east and the west.#N

Exits.Description: The hallway continues to the east.
Through huge stone doors you see the entrance.

rooms.Name: The long hallway
rooms.Description:
Along both sides of this long and cold hallway, there are many more resting
places for the dead. They have all been tightly sealed though, should anyone by
any chance want to disturb the rest of the dead. Far to the east end of this
corridor there is a small staircase leading down into darkness. To the west it
seems to be lighter - probably the entrance.

Exits.Description: The hallway continues to the west, getting brighter.
Small stairs lead down into darkness.

rooms.Name: Cellars of Catacombs
rooms.Description:
Cold and stagnant air fills this place. It smells stale and of death. These
tunnels must be deep below the city. The only thing that disturbs the silence
is water dripping down occasionally from the earth ceiling, and muffled screams
for away. This tunnel continues to the north and west. A small staircase lead
back up.

Exits.Description: Stairs lead up to the Catacombs.

rooms.Name: The Tunnel
rooms.Description:
Bones and debris cover the ground in this tunnel. It leads east-west. There
a iron grate to the north.

Exits.Description: Through the grate you see mounds of unmoving shapes.

rooms.Name: The Tunnel of Death
rooms.Description:
The sense of death is everywhere. In the air, in the ground and in the
silence, that is only disturbed by occasionally dripping water. The tunnel
leads east and north. A ladder is secured on the west wall, leading up.

Exits.Description: A ladder in the west wall leads up. There seems to be light up there.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The ladder seems strong and well made.  Also very well secured to the wall.

rooms.Name: Western End
rooms.Description:
The western end of this corridor is lit with torches. It continues to the
east. A ladder leads down into darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The ladder seem strong enough to hold several persons at a time.

rooms.Name: The Burial Room
rooms.Description:
This huge room smells of death, both ancient and very recent. Skeletons and
semi-decomposed corpses litter the ground. You can hear the squeaks of rats or
other vermin. There don't seem to be any other exit besides a grate to the
south.

rooms.Name: Smelly Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The smell in this tunnel makes even you want to lose your breakfast. Some
corpses lie in small ponds of water. You can see small things moving on the
corpses. Just hope there aren't any big things too.

rooms.Name: Turning Tunnel
rooms.Description:
Besides the usual smell and dripping water, nothing specials is found in
this room. You can continue south or west.

rooms.Name: Large Tunnel
rooms.Description:
This large tunnel connects to all the four bearings. To the east and west,
the tunnel continues. To north and south there seems to be rooms or caves of
some sort.

Exits.Description: To the north a there's a room.
You can see a large cave.

rooms.Name: Turning
rooms.Description:
East and south the tunnel goes on. Rats squeaking and running makes the only
noise. Bones litter and debris cover.

rooms.Name: Dark Tunnel
rooms.Description:
Somehow the earthen walls here seems to suck away the light, shading
everything, making everything gloomy and cold. This north-south passage also
feels more humid, like death was breathing not far away.

rooms.Name: Large Cave
rooms.Description:
This large cave is filled with skeletons, corpses, rats and other vermin
that goes with death.

rooms.Name: The Room of the Dead
rooms.Description:
This cold room differs from the rest of the Catacombs. It has stone walls.
But that is the only difference. It is still cold and smelly, and though no
water drips from the ceiling, the air is still humid. In the north, stairs
descend into deeper darkness.

Exits.Description: The stairs of stone are cracked and lead only to darkness.

rooms.Name: The Lower Catacombs
rooms.Description:
This place feels even colder, as if the earth itself tries to absorb the
little warmth that is left, avoiding to freeze to death. Though still there,
the dripping of water has lessened and the squeaking of vermin too. Besides the
stairs that lead back up to warmth and life, the way leads to east and west.

rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
rooms.Description:
Nothing distinguish this tunnel from the rest you have seen. The cold is
still there. And the dread of what is to come. East or west.

rooms.Name: Turning
rooms.Description:
The tunnel turn here. This place feel vaguely familiar. Nowhere to go
besides west or north.

rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The similarity of this foul place makes it hard to keep bearings. Nothing
besides old roots and bones makes it hard to find a mark. North or south.

rooms.Name: Catacomb T-junction
rooms.Description:
From here you can go in three directions. You are sure you have been here
before.

rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The tunnels seem to continue forever. Will it ever end? This tunnel looks
just like the others. Perhaps little narrower. Or maybe the pressure of the
ground has oppressed your head.

rooms.Name: Turning
rooms.Description:
The tunnel turn here. This place feel vaguely familiar. Nowhere to go
besides west or south.

rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
rooms.Description:
Huge piles of bones litter this tunnel. Crawling of them are bugs and small
creatures of the earth. Creatures that don't need light. Creatures that avoid
light.

rooms.Name: Catacomb T-junction
rooms.Description:
From here you can go in three directions. You are sure you have been here
before.

rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
rooms.Description:
Nothing distinguish this tunnel from the rest you have seen. The cold is
still there. And the dread of what is to come. East or west.

rooms.Name: Another Turning
rooms.Description:
This endless turnings of this tunnel almost makes you dizzy. When will this
end? Will you get out alive or will you join the rest of the dead?

rooms.Name: North-south Tunnel
rooms.Description:
This tunnel feels little warmer in the air. Many small fungus is growing on
the walls. Where can they find anything to grow on you wonder. Maybe from the
corpses of ignorant adventurers.

rooms.Name: Catacomb T-junction
rooms.Description:
From here you can go in three directions. You are sure you have been here
before.

rooms.Name: Low Tunnel
rooms.Description:
Roots from long dead trees hangs down from the earth ceiling above. You try
your best to avoid the bugs on them.

rooms.Name: Turn in the Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The air here feels ancient and heavy, as if you are the first to disturb it
in centuries. That is not true however since you discover tracks of something
that has dragged itself past here.

rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
rooms.Description:
This tunnel is wide. Cobwebs and roots covers the ceiling and bones and
other debris cover the ground. You can go east or west.

rooms.Name: Catacomb Room
rooms.Description:
You have entered a large cavelike room. Stone floor covers the ground but
the ceiling is still earthen and with roots dangling down. The remains of a
seemly huge stone table lies here, broken and tattered.

rooms.Name: Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This room seems to have been used as a storage room of some sort. Piles of
old broken wood lies to the north wall. Some unfinished coffins lie to the
east. A small sign lie on the floor, dusty of age.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It says: Property of Harold & Son

rooms.Name: Altar Chamber
rooms.Description:
This room is dominated by a large altar. Old blood cover the altar, as if
some obscene rite of offering has taken place here. You also discover blood not
so old - only a few days at the most.

rooms.Name: Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This seems to be storage room for tools. Shovels and picks lies everywhere.
All are broken and rusty and of little use now.

rooms.Name: Smelly Room
rooms.Description:
This room smells awful. A large ovenlike structure lies in the middle of
room. The smell comes from burnt flesh. Broken pots and crockery lines the east
wall, all empty and dusty.

rooms.Name: Empty Room
rooms.Description: This room looks empty. Besides dust and dirt there is nothing.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Crypt
rooms.Description:
A huge stone door is to the north is inscribed with the word 'CRYPTS'.
Besides that the rooms seems too clean. No dust or bones or debris cover the
stone floor.

rooms.Name: Torture Room
rooms.Description:
This room was made to torture people in. The sight of the room is enough to
make you shudder. Shackles line the walls. Instruments of torture litter the
floor, rusty of time.

rooms.Name: Demonic Entrance
rooms.Description:
Here is the entrance to the Demon Empire. A large tunnel, heading 
south into the unknown. Bones and skulls litter the floor, and a 
fierce smell haunts this cave. There is a small sign hanging from the 
neck of a skeleton.

Exits.Description: The Guard Station
You can see daylight!

ExtraDescriptions.Description: #RWelcome Mortals!#N

rooms.Name: Guard Station
rooms.Description:
This is the guard station that borders to the world of the pity 
mortals. This is their first line of defence, not usually very well 
defended since demons are quite vain. Who could possibly harm them?
North of here is the exit, and south...lies evil.

Exits.Description: Demonic Entrance
The Way Down

rooms.Name: The Way Down
rooms.Description:
This might be your last chance of getting out of here. In here, is 
a large and very slippery stairway going down. Somewhere below you,
you can hear a gong chime, often followed by terrifying screams and a 
huge roar that sends shivers down your spine.

Exits.Description: Guard Station
Circle Of Illusions

rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through. Here are the stairs up, but there is no chance of 
getting up that way. A complex forcefield bars the way up.
#GA bag full with diamonds.#N

Exits.Description: Circle Of Illusions
Circle Of Illusions

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large black bag, full with glittering stones...but...it is somewhat 
transparent.

rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.
#GA dagger surrounded by darkness.#N

Exits.Description: Circle Of Illusions
Circle Of Illusions

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A common looking dagger seems to attract darkness...but...it isn't 
quite as solid as it seems to be.

rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.
#GA key made of a huge tooth lies here.#N

Exits.Description: Circle Of Illusions
Circle Of Illusions

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A key made of an old tooth...but...you can see straight through it.

rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.
#GA key covered with hot flames.#N

Exits.Description: Circle Of Illusions
Circle Of Illusions

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small key which burns with a hot flame...but...as you try to take it,
your hand can't touch it.

rooms.Name: Well Of Cries
rooms.Description:
Here is a small well made of skulls. Wailing cries flow up from the 
well, filling you with fear and anguish. There's a large door to the 
south, seemingly made of mirrors. Thousands of small mirrors.

Exits.Description: Circle Of Illusions
Bottom Of The Well

rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.

Exits.Description: Circle Of Illusions
Circle Of Illusions

rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.
#GA bloodied axe lies here.#N

Exits.Description: Circle Of Illusions
Circle Of Illusions

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large and very bloody axe lies here...but...it keeps on fading in 
and out of view, all the time.

rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.
#YThe gatekeeper stands here, watching you.#N

Exits.Description: Well Of Cries
Circle Of Illusions
Circle Of Illusions

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The gatekeeper is a truly astonishing creature. It's a shame it isn't 
here for real. Just an illusion...

rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.
#GA bowl filled with a disgusting looking fluid lies here.#N

Exits.Description: Circle Of Illusions
Circle Of Illusions

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A black bowl, filled with a fluid full of what seems to be dead 
insects...Lucky you it is nothing but an illusion.

rooms.Name: Bottom Of The Well
rooms.Description:
Here, screams and sounds of crying bombard you from the south. You 
immediately think of leaving, but is efficiantly stopped by a 
forcefield. Even without the forcefield, it would have been difficult 
to get up. Chains and empty shackles hang from the red walls. There's
a path going south.

Exits.Description: Path Of Tears

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Empty chains and shackles, dangle from the walls. In some of the 
shackles, bits and pieces of fur and skin can be seen.

rooms.Name: Path Of Tears
rooms.Description:
In here, the prisoners are kept chained to the walls. Humans,
elves, dwarves...all kinds of races fill these halls, awaiting
torture and eventually death. Cries of help are shouted at you as
hope fills their eyes, just to fade again as you try to break the
chains, but fail. To the north and the south the path goes on.

Exits.Description: Bottom Of The Well
Path Of Tears

rooms.Name: Path Of Tears
rooms.Description:
In here, the prisoners are kept chained to the walls. Humans, 
elves, dwarves...all kinds of races fill these halls, awaiting torture
and eventually death. Cries of help are shouted at you as hope fills
their eyes, just to fade again as you try to break the chains, but
fail. The path goes on to the north and the south.

Exits.Description: Path Of Tears
Path Of Tears

fail. To the north and the south, the path continues.

Exits.Description: Path Of Tears
Path Of Tears
