rooms.Name: #bHallway of the Elders#N
rooms.Description:
This long hallway is beautifully decorated, with a scarlet red
carpet covering the length. Doors line this hall, presumably leading to
the private rooms of various notable Kai. You can follow the hallway to
the east or the west, or open on of the doors here. The door to the south
has the is engraved with the name "Flagg".
§N

rooms.Name: #bSnicker's Room#N
rooms.Description:
The first thing you notice upon stepping into this room, is the 
clutter.  A dark blue velvet cloak hangs over the lone chair which sits 
near a writing desk piled with journals, papers and scrolls.  Books are 
stacked everywhere, maps and illustrations line the walls, and small 
metal figurines crowd a little shelf.  A worn staff in the corner topped 
with a traditional jester's cap and bells declares the owner's 
occupation.  The bed is the only thing that looks neat, appearing to 
never have been slept in.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Most of the papers seem to be written in a cramped, unreadable script.  
What few you can read seem to be notations on the world you are familiar 
with. One paper in particular is dedicated to the study of extinct flora 
and fauna, including the long-lost "smurfs."

The maps on the walls cover large amounts of territory, both familiar
and strange.  The largest maps cover areas labeled "Elanthia," "Norrath,"
and "Covenia," in addition to a large world map that seems somewhat
familiar, if a bit old.  Although all appear to be drawn by the same 
hand, the Elanthian and Norrath maps are signed by "Talies," and the 
Covenia map is unsigned, and appears to be unfinished.

The metal figurines are each small enough to hold in one hand,
although much heavier than they first appear. Each one is different, and
colorfully painted, and they all seem to be tiny adventurers or monsters.

The cloak appears somewhat worn, but still retains it's original
beauty.  The scent of campfires lingers when you touch it.

Worn by use or travel, you can't tell, but the jester's cap seems to
be a recent addition.

rooms.Name: #bInside a Beautiful Flower#N
rooms.Description:
The sweet scent of the flower is overwhelming and makes you feel a 
little dizzy. As you enter the small opening in the flower, you feel a 
strange sensation goes through your body and everything around you seems 
to increase in size. 

     Looking back up at the opening, you can see a piece of the flower, 
which hangs over the opening acting like an awning. You can see the sky 
from where you are sitting and feel a cool breeze in your hair. On the 
edge of the opening is a small hook, maybe used to fasten the awning in 
bad weather. If you stand up you might be able to look over the edge back 
into the garden. The walls of the small nest are soft like velvet and 
seem to be changing in colors ranging from yellow to green right before 
your eyes. The bottom is covered with small silk pillows in many 
different colors and patterns to sit on. Also, a small chest acts as both 
a table and a place to keep things. On top of it are some small pictures 
in silver frames and a basket with fruit.
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pillows are of many colors, shapes and patterns, their look very 
comfortable.

The small chest is made of wood and has strange patterns carved into it. 
A large metal lock prevents you from opening it.
The yellow and green colors seems to change all the time.

The awning is of a light yellow color with small green spots, on one side 
is a rope hanging, most likely used to secure it when the wind blows.
It is a small hook that seems to have been put there for a reason.

There are a few different kinds of fruit all foreign to you, but they 
look fresh and delicious.
The basket is made of wicker.

You see the garden below you with all it's flowers and grass. When you 
look up you can see the trees above. Everything looks much bigger than 
usual or maybe you remember wrong.

rooms.Name: #bThe Room of Worship#N
rooms.Description:
This is where the Kai pray to their gods. Many idols line the
walls, hold-overs from the Saracen days. In the center of the room is a 
large altar, presumably used for the many ceremonies of the Kai. This is 
where new Kai are initiated, and taught of the days of old, the days of 
the Saracen, and the credo of the Kai.

Exits.Description: You can leave to the hallway.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The idols of Nymph the Angel, Rilarien the Wolf, Odie, Nymph's lover, 
Xman the once-king, and Radagast the Wizard all line the walls.  There 
are other nameless statues, too old to be identified.

The large altar is vaguely translucent, and you see that embedded deep  
within is what appears to be a Sword of Glory.

rooms.Name: #bEnd of the West Wing#N
rooms.Description:
The west wing ends here. Further west lies the humble abode of one 
of the greatest Kai of all, Viv. North is the home of Karen Eth Lanier. 
Like the other hallways in this citadel, there are pillars supporting the 
arched ceiling. However, nothing has been carved into these, perhaps 
leaving room for future Kai.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An ancient dragon, fighting side-by-side a much younger red dragon and
several mortal heroes, battles a mighty demon in this painting. You
identify one of the robed figures as Evil, once-emperor of the Storm
Dragons, and therefore the dragons are likely to be Santa and Reddragon.
The other heroes are unknown to you. Writing on the bottom of the 
painting indicates that this work of art was taken from the world of 
Crimson, from Santa's cave, so that it would always be safe here.
§N

rooms.Name: #bIn the West Wing#N
rooms.Description:
This large hallway leads east and west. The vaulted ceiling is 
supported by huge pillars. Most of them have been carved into statues of 
ancient Kai, others may have been, but have eroded and are 
incomprehensible at their present state. There seems to be room north and 
south for people's rooms.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pillars here have been carved away to form statues of the faded Kai. 
Odie, and Dementorr, are the only statues here that haven't been worn 
away beyond recognition.

rooms.Name: #bJesta's Garden#N
rooms.Description:
The red light fades and you find yourself standing in the middle
of a massive desert, with sand as far as the eye can see... burnt, black 
sand. In the middle there is a small broken-down tower with some dead 
trees around it, and brown vines seem to fill the interior. Inside you 
see a broken swing and a dog's collar lying on the floor. You can still 
smell something in the air, possibly sulfur, possibly something much, 
much worse. You are filled  with an overpowering urge to leave this ruin.

Exits.Description: The desert stretches as far as the eye can see.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is Jesta's swing, where the carefree goddess used to swing for
hours and hours.
This is the collar of Watson, the Sausage dog.

rooms.Name: #bBen Kenobi's Study#N
rooms.Description:
Ben Kenobi, much respected Jedi hero and Kai Lord, once a
high-god in the world of Crimson, now a mere mortal, spends his days 
here, when he is not out in the world of Elite. It took all the magic the 
Kai could muster to salvage this portion of the world he came from. The 
room itself is rather sparse, a bed, a desk, paperwork cluttering it. The 
only objects of note are two statues, one of a fair maiden, and one of an 
elven hero, which seem to guard the stairs against all intruders.
§N

Exits.Description: You can climb down to the Garden.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Alannon the Elven Knight, who instructed Ben in the use of the
sword, and showed Ben the ways of magic. His apparant youth belies his 
talent, and  he is sorely missed by the Kai Lords. He was the Avatar of 
Good, a fabled  warrior in his time.. but now he is dead, and no-one 
speaks of his deeds anymore.

This is a statue of Jesta, Ben's goddess in the world of Crimson.
She looks rather playful, like she was a harmless figure, and her almost  
childlike beauty is marred only by her eyes. They seem too fierce, too  
angry for her face.

rooms.Name: #bA Large Garden#N
rooms.Description:
The garden is filled with flowerbeds and tall beautiful trees. There 
are many trails in the garden, but most of them lead right back to the 
middle. All around the garden is a tall stone wall. On the wall flowers 
and grass is growing and some places the stones have been broken, leaving 
opening in the wall. There is a small flower right next to an old oak 
tree, which looks foreign and out of place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The old tree looks to be many hundreds of years old.
The green and yellow flower has a small opening in the top.
The trail is a dirt trail.

In between the large stones flowers and grass grows. The wall has not 
been kept well.

rooms.Name: #bDeimos's Cave#N
rooms.Description:
It is a lot cooler in here, as the cave you've found shelters you 
from the desert heat. This cave is tremendous on the inside, and every
noise you make echoes off the walls in an eerie fashion. You see a ledge
on the other side of the cave, strewn with treasure, a dragon's treasure,
you suddenly realize. You can't get to it from here, because you are
blocked by a large lake, and all the treasure on this side doesn't really
seem worth it. Mostly books.. a dragon reading? There is also a small
painting on the  ground, mostly completed. You can go back out into the
desert, or try to cross the lake.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a almost complete painting of a young elf. According to the 
frame, this is Lanceor Eth Lanier, the last Jedi. He is depicted here in
battle with the evil denizens of the fabled city of Arnath, with the
spirits of the Jedi Knights Karen Eth Lanier and Ben Kenobi watching 
over him.
Odd, it seems like there is a red glowing shape in the lake.

rooms.Name: #bA Storage Room#N
rooms.Description:
This is where the Kai keep their spare equipment. The shelves in
this room are all kept clean, and it is well lit enough that you can see
far into the storage chamber. If you find yourself in need of some of the
more common items EliteMUD has, check here often. Occasionally you may
find something interesting!

rooms.Name: #bNorth Wing#N
rooms.Description:
This hallway is much shorter than the others, it ends to the north in 
enormous double doors, forming a great arch. Through the doorway, a vast 
garden is visible, and beyond that a giant tree. Pillars line the walls 
here, each with carvings in them. A small blue animal resembling a smurf 
walks into the room east of here, and to the west comes the laughter of 
the greatest Jester to belong to Kai.

Exits.Description: §N
§N
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pillars here have been carved away to form statues of the faded Kai. 
Labria, Larson, and Mithrandir are among the most prominent statues here.

rooms.Name: #bThe East Wing#N
rooms.Description:
This hallway continues off to the east, an endless tribute to faded 
Kai, carved onto the pillars. North leads to the room of Atlantis, and to 
the south is space for a new Kai to live. Rocks crumble from the top of 
the arched ceiling, this hallway is badly in need of repair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pillars here have been carved away to form statues of the faded Kai. 
Xala, Garthos, and Seleena have been carved into these pillars, forever 
honored.

rooms.Name: #gDarren's Woodland Hide-Away#N
rooms.Description:
The Kai have many valued friends, and as a mark of respect, some
of these allies are given dwellings within the fortified walls of the
Kai citadel. The Huntress Soulcatcher is one such person. An experienced  
ranger, she has chosen to live in the peace and serenity of the woods 
just outside the fortress, forsaking the civilization within. When this
warrior maiden is not out aiding her clan, the Pack, or battling in the 
world of Elite, she can occasionally be found resting here. The mystical 
powers of the grove are beneficial to the injured, and many an adventurer 
has tended his wounds here, using the woodland's healing power. The woods 
have been   vacant since Soulcatcher left the land of the mortals, but 
recently, a ranger by the name of Darren has been seen resting here.
§N

rooms.Name: #bThe Heart of the Citadel#N
rooms.Description:
This giant room appears to be the meeting room of the citadel. In its 
center is an enormous round table, with places for all the Kai to sit and 
participate. Off in one corner is a fountain, and in the opposite, a 
lounge for the weary Kai to socialize after a hard day's fighting. In the 
other two corners are staircases, one leading up, another leading down.

rooms.Name: #bThingol's Farm#N
rooms.Description:
In the oasis of the desert the humble peasant Thingol tills the
soil, growing corn and wheat and meatballs for his glorious lords....
well, mostly for his friends and family, but his glorious lords do get a
little bit, if Thingol feels generous.  All peasants are welcome to work
the land and take care of Thingol's animals, and he will protect them
from all harm.
#N

rooms.Name: #cGunter's Mushroom House#N
rooms.Description:
You have just walked into the room of one of the #bKai#N Knights, 
Gunter the #csmurf#N. Being a #csmurf#N with #csmurf#N like natures, he will 
undoubtedly invite you in to talk and what not, although you may have to 
sneak out to get away. One of the first things you notice as you walk in 
is that the room is not very well kept. There are #Cpictures#W of loved 
ones on a counter, and after meeting Gunter, you are afraid to peer into 
the drawers. At the very end of the room you see a small box marked 
Gunters special stock, but of what, you wonder. Some of more interesting 
things you notice are a half open #rcloset#N, a tall #ebookshelf#N that holds 
the many books he reads. Also small, #csmurf#N sized #gbed#N, and even a funny 
shaped #Bhammok#N that Gunter loves to sit in when there is nothing more 
interesting to be done, and #ypool table #Wnear it, in which he boasts 
himself to be the best player around. And lastly you see strange 
#mmantles#N that seem to be glowing, lighting and brighting the room.
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see many pictures of different people,most of them #csmurfs#N and 
other people of Kai. One of the#c smurf #Wpeople you know from the 
pictures is the famed #rgrandpa #csmurf#N!

You peek into the closet, and it is not unlike many you have seen 
before. Shirts with #csmurf#Wish logos and names on them, socks, coats, a 
dress.....How did that get in there?!?

At the top of the shelf you see a lot of the books are dusty 
and have not been used for a while, probally because Gunter cant reach 
them. The ones on the lower shelves seem to be well used though. You look 
at some of the titles: Go Dog Go, Clifford, Curious Gorge... Hmm...

This bed looks much to small for any human to use, but it seems 
perfect for a #csmurf#W. There are blue sheets and a fluffy pillow, maybe 
a favorite of his.

This hammock has been crafted, somehow, into the form of a sitting 
#csmurf#N. It looks very comfortable, and you wonder if you could sit for 
a while in it.

A finely crafted table with, of course, blue felt. Also a slot 
to accept four quarters.... What a cheap smurf!

These are glowing with a bright, warming light because of some magic. 
Items have been encased in the wood, shown though glass. Relics from 
his old homeland of the #csmurfs#W, these are very dear to him.

rooms.Name: #wThe Sanctuary of Sorrow#N
rooms.Description:
As you walk into this room a feeling of anguish and neverending
loss assults your senses. The room's interior is an expanse of a floor 
and walls of white marble. The ceiling is golden but blackened soot 
covers it giving everything a dingy cast. Tapestries of red and blue are 
still up on the walls but they are torn and ripped apart. In the center 
of the room a dias is raised and upon it is a throne of gold and wood, 
covered with a plush blue pillow. The throne itself is covered in ash and 
fire, the pillow has a long claw mark in it and is soaked in blood and a 
smell of brimstone still fills the air. A feeling of sorrow and loss as 
never felt before in this world overcomes you and in your mind you can 
hear the silent screams of the men, women, and children of the family, 
'Eth Lanier' as they died to the demon hordes decades past.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This throne sits upon a the dias of white marble. The blue pillow on it
has long claw marks through it, and the whole pillow is soaked in blood.
Looking at it you can almost imagine the dread demon-lord Beriz, 
wrenching a clawed hand through the lost Patron of the family 'Eth 
Lanier' cutting through sinew and bone to reach the pillow behind him, and then casually tossing him aside.

The tapestries along the wall smell of soot, ash, smoke, and brimstone.
Ripped apart by the conquoring demons they depict a land as fair as the
morning dawn. A land you can only see in the memory of this faded 
tapestry as the guardians of this land were finally over-run.

rooms.Name: #bHallway of the Elders#N
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the long hallway. It is soothingly quiet this 
deep into the Kai Fortress, and as the walls of this citadel dig furthur
into the mountain on which it is built, they get closer to the magic that
binds much of this mystical place to this plane. To the north there is a 
door with a faint red aura around it; the name "Viv" is written upon it 
in golden lettering. To the south is another door with the name "Odie" 
inscribed on it.

rooms.Name: #mViv's Treehouse#N
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small wooden tree house.  This is where
Viv crashes when she gets tired of rocking the mud, and decides to rock 
something else instead. *wink* Lots of cushions, wine bottles, leather 
toys and other stuff can be seen here.  There is a small TV and VCR in 
the corner.
§N

rooms.Name: #bWargas's Sanctuary#N
rooms.Description:
This, quite odd room, belongs to the Master Wizard of the red order.
Quite hard to believe that, since the whole room is absolutely full of
cats. cats, everywhere, small balls of fur racing around on the floor,
stalking and pouncing on eachother. Sounds of purring, everywhere,
there's no way escaping it. Along one wall, a huge bed has been
placed, now very full of cats. By the far end of the room, a small 
altar has been erected, propably dedicated to cats, yes, cats.
Then it hits you; Where does he sleep? He does sleep, doesn't he?
You check the room, the closets, every corner and as you check behind
the entrance door, you find a chair. A simple chair, still showing 
the signs of great use. A chair? You begin wondering, what kind of cat
maniac is this?.           
§N

rooms.Name: #bEnd of the East Wing#N
rooms.Description:
You are at the end of the long hallway. North of here there is a
door with the name "Deimos" inscribed on it. The southern door has the
name "Darren" written on it. To the east is a door with the name 
"Wargas's Sanctuary". Three white marble pillars lining the walls have 
been carved to form statues of lost Kai.
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pillars here have been carved away to form statues of the faded Kai. 
The statues of Nimbus, Takashi, and Sarastro seem rather new, compared 
with the rest of the statues in the citadel.

rooms.Name: #bGeoff and Belephebe's Love Nest#N
rooms.Description:
Upon entering this giant maple tree, you realize that it has been 
carved into a cozy one-room house. In the northwest corner, there is a 
soft fluffy bed, with a nightstand sitting next to it. On the other side 
of the room is the wood stove, with two rocking chairs sitting next to 
each other, looking out through a window. Immediately to the right, there 
is a beautifully carved maple table. Across from that is a white 
loveseat, sitting in front of a bookshelf. Next to the loveseat is a 
small scratching post for Belephebe's fluffy gray kitten, who seems to be 
hunting mice right now, judging by the noises coming from outside. There 
are many windows on each wall, looking out upon spectacular scenery.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Off to the east is a wood stove, used to cook all sorts of food, but more 
importantly, keep the house warm. A little ways away from the stove, 
there lies two rocking chairs made of maple, side by side. They face 
another window, through which a wooden bench, suspended from a higher 
branch on the tree by two metal chains, can be seen.

A fluffy bed rests in the northwest corner of the house. On top of it is 
a magical patchwork quilt, that's kept people warm even in the coldest of 
winters. It is very colorful, and appears to be homemade, which might 
explain its magic. The down pillows are extremely soft, and comfortable, 
much like the rest of the bed. Beside the bed is a nightstand, with two 
candles on it, one blue, and one brown. Also, there are some books on it, 
lying open since the night before.

A worn wooden table, big enough for no more than two, lies in the corner. 
On top of it is a delicious blueberry pie, cooling off before it gets 
eaten. Next to the pie is a vase of daisies, filling the room with a 
sweet smell. Beside the daisies is a picture of Geoff and Belephebe in 
their wedding outfits, with bigger smiles on their face than anyone else 
in the world.

Carved into the side of the wall is a square window. On the sill, there 
is a pair of candles, and a vase of daisies. The rows of blueberry 
bushes, and sugar maple orchards are visible through the crystalline 
window panes.

Bunches of candles are scattered about the room, always in pairs. The two 
candles' aromas combine to make the sweetest smell known to man. Even 
without the other, the smell of blueberries or maple sugar would bring 
any nose to ecstasy.

Standing out in the room are daisies. There are daisies in crystal vases 
everywhere, in the window, in the bookshelf, and on the table. All of 
them are beautiful, as if duplicates of each other, give off a smell that 
tickles every nose that smells it.

Hanging on the wall is a picture of the most beautiful woman you've ever 
seen. Her loving face seems to portray an aura of sweetness throughout 
the room. It's hard to look away from such a captivating woman.

The bookshelf carved into the southwest corner of the room is filled with 
books. The only exception is a row of daisies in the middle shelf. In 
front of the bookshelf is a white loveseat. It's big enough for two 
people and a cat to cuddle in while reading faerie tales, magic books, or 
one of many other books hidden in the bookshelf.

rooms.Name: #bThe Abode of Atlantis#N
rooms.Description:
Embedded into the floor is a #bblue phoenix#N, molded from blue cobolt 
glass.  It seems as if it is lit from below, as a bright blue aura fills
the room.  Rumor has it that this aura is the very heart and soul of that 
which is #bKai#N.  One's safety is guaranteed when surrounded by it.  On the 
eastern wall, hangs a #yportrait#N of Atlantis and his beautiful wife Bronwyn.  
Below the portrait, an engraved #yplaque#N is mounted on a polished wooden 
block.  The #yinscription#N fills the plaque, however a closer look will be 
required to make out the words.  On the ceiling, a #gportal#N to the heavens 
remains open, as an invite to the lords that dwell over this domain.  There
are weapons and armors scattered about the room, and #wbooks#N of magic 
and combat on the #wshelves#N.  One book catches your eye as it seems to 
glow with the very same aura that is #bKai#N.  It is titled "The #cCode#N of 
#CAtlantis#N"

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The noble and brave Atlantis, of #bKai#N and his beautiful 
wife Bronwyn.  Atlantis is dressed head to toe in his finest crystal
armors, wearing the Crown of Alannon, to show his pride in #bKai#N.
Bronwyn, dressed in her skimpiest silken gown, stands beside her
man, giving a sense of prowess and beauty to the painting.  What a 
lucky man Atlantis is.

It reads:

   To my dearest love, 
      My heart will always beat for you, and my love
   will always guide me.  Wherever I am, and wherever you
   go, my soul will always follow.

   Love Bronwyn

This portal leads directly into the heavens.  It is only 
passible by the divine.  In order for a mortal to go through it, he
or she must be escorted by a lord.

You see the following titles:
"Magic & You"
"How to Slay a Dragon"
"Weapons and Armor"
"The Healing Power of Herbs"
"The Potion Cookbook"

I vow to be honest and noble; to uphold the Credo of #bKai#N;
to assist the weak; to protect this realm from any and all evils.  My 
heart will stay pure and my mind focussed -- for I am #bKai#N, and #bKai#N is me.
      #CAtlantis#N

rooms.Name: The Tower Gates
rooms.Description:
You are at the entrance to a tall tower. Lightning flashes periodically and
it is raining. You think it might be a good idea to turn back into the grove.

Exits.Description: You see a large steel gate. Beyond is the Foyer of the Tower.
The shadows cloud your vision.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The gate is tall and secure.  Whoever built it values privacy.

rooms.Name: The Foyer
rooms.Description:
This is the entrance to the Tower. The hallway continues to the north,
leading towards a staircase. You notice a grim painting on the wall, and
quickly look away.

Exits.Description: You see a long hallway.
You see the gate.
You see an old trapdoor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This painting depicts the grisly death of a foolish human.  You hope you do 
not share his fate.
The trapdoor seems to be stuck in the floor. Maybe bolted from the other side.

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
This hallway seems to stretch on forever. You notice a stairway in the
distance.

Exits.Description: You see the foyer.
The hall continues.

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description: You trudge down the hallway. You notice doors to the east and west.

Exits.Description: The hall continues.
You see a door. You notice a sign.
The hall continues.
You see an oak door. There is an inscription on it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The sign says "NURSERY" in bold letters.
It says "STORAGE"

rooms.Name: Nursery
rooms.Description:
It looks like a tornado has been through here. Toys are scattered
everywhere, and a small group of dragon hatchlings are fighting over a bone.

Exits.Description: You see the hallway.
You see a large stone door.

rooms.Name: Storage Room
rooms.Description: This room is covered with dust, it looks as if no one has been here in ages.

Exits.Description: You see the hallway.
You see nothing special.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: As you look closely at the dust, you notice the outline of a trapdoor!

rooms.Name: End of the Hallway
rooms.Description:
You have finally reached the end of the hallway. A huge staircase leads up.
You see a sign at the base of the staircase.

Exits.Description: The hall continues.
The second floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads:
    This area is kind of tough.  You probably shouldn't go up these stairs 
    alone if you are under 25th level, or at all if you under 20th level.  
    Have fun! -- Wench

rooms.Name: Guardian's Room
rooms.Description:
You climb down the rickety stairs and find yourself face to face with a
gargantuan hydra. How fast can you climb UP stairs?

Exits.Description: You see the storage room.
A large grey door.

rooms.Name: The Treasure Room
rooms.Description:
You have made it past the hydra into the vault. You are astounded by the
treasure here. Not only are you now rich, you can probably rest here safely.
The west wall seems to have a large door made entirely of ruby.

Exits.Description: You see nothing special.
You see a ruby door!

rooms.Name: The Second Floor
rooms.Description:
You have made it up to the second floor. You hear hissing and see several
dragon men rushing you. You wonder how long you will be staying here.

Exits.Description: You see the first floor.
You see the court.

rooms.Name: The Court
rooms.Description:
You have entered what seems to be a large court. The people guarding it
don't seem happy to see you ...

Exits.Description: You see nothing special.
You see the court.
You see a wooden door.

rooms.Name: Hall O' Pleasure
rooms.Description:
You stop dead in your tracks as you enter this ornately decorated room - it
is populated with the king's harem.

Exits.Description: You see the Court.

rooms.Name: The Court
rooms.Description: You are continuing down the hall. To the east and west you see ornate doors.

Exits.Description: You see the court.
You see a black door.
You see the court.
You see a white door.

rooms.Name: The Library
rooms.Description:
You have entered a huge room, filled with books. A peaceful man is sitting
at a table, studying.

Exits.Description: You see the court.

rooms.Name: The Sanctum
rooms.Description:
This small room is modestly decorated with small dragon icons. Its sole
occupant is deep in thought.

Exits.Description: You see the Court.

rooms.Name: The Court Ends
rooms.Description:
You have reached the end of the court. A huge Draconian is sitting in a
chair here. As you enter, he motions with his hand and you are rushed by three
of his bodyguards.

Exits.Description: You see the court.
You see a private chamber.

rooms.Name: Bedroom
rooms.Description: This is the personal room of the draconian king. It is not empty.

Exits.Description: You see Court.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Crypt
rooms.Description:
You have entered a large room which smells heavily of reptile. You wonder
what awaits you here.

Exits.Description: You see the Treasure Vault.
You see the Crypt.

rooms.Name: Crypt
rooms.Description:
You are in a large room which continues to the west. You notice many coffins
here. Open coffins reveal remains of something other than man. The smell of
reptile is very strong here.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance.
You see nothing special.

rooms.Name: The Lair
rooms.Description:
You have entered a large room dominated by a great white dragon. It growls
at you before it attacks.

Exits.Description: You the cave opening.

rooms.Name: A Lair
rooms.Description:
You have entered a large room dominated by a great black dragon. It looks as
though it is amused by your presence.

Exits.Description: You the cave opening.

rooms.Name: The Crypt Ends
rooms.Description:
You have come to the end of the Crypt. It seems deserted. There is a strange
coffin lying against the wall.

Exits.Description: You see the Crypt.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A coffin lies a against the east wall.  It is closed.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Great Hall
rooms.Description:
You have entered a huge hall. It has been carefully decorated with beautiful
tapestries depicting a great battle between dragons and men. The dragons appear
to be the victors.

Exits.Description: You see the Nursery.
The Hall continues.

rooms.Name: The Great Hall
rooms.Description:
You are working your way down the Hall. To the north, you notice a smaller
passageway, while the main hall continues to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a narrow passageway.
You see the Hall.
You see the Hall.

rooms.Name: A Narrow Passageway
rooms.Description:
This Passageway branches off from the main hall and leads somewhere ...
where?

Exits.Description: You see a large Lair. It looks dangerous.
You see the great hall.

rooms.Name: Lair
rooms.Description:
You have entered a large lair with bones strewn about the ground. You notice
the source of these as you come face to face with a rather large red dragon.
You notice a trap door in the floor.

Exits.Description: The narrow passageway.
You see a trap door.

rooms.Name: Underground Tunnel
rooms.Description:
You have entered an underground tunnel. It is dark and dirty, and you find
yourself wishing you were back in Midgaard.

Exits.Description: You see the tunnel.
You see the red dragon's lair.

rooms.Name: Underground Tunnel
rooms.Description:
This tunnel has come to a dead end. You feel nervous about being trapped
here.

Exits.Description: You see the tunnel.

rooms.Name: The Great Hall Ends.
rooms.Description:
You have come to the end of the great hall. You see before you a huge golden
door, it must be at least twenty feet tall! It has beautiful etchings of
dragons. You see a sign on the door.

Exits.Description: You see the hall.
You see a great golden door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Congratulations on making it this far!  Watch out, it gets a little
    nasty here... :) - Wench

rooms.Name: THE Lair
rooms.Description:
You have entered a huge lair. You feel that something big lives here or at
least did. The golden door lies back to the west.

Exits.Description: You see a great golden door.

rooms.Name: The End...
rooms.Description:
You have reached the final lair. It is dominated by a huge five headed
dragon. You suddenly realize that you have SERIOUS problems...

Exits.Description: You see the top of the mountain.

rooms.Name: Stairwell
rooms.Description:
This is an old decrepit stairwell that leads to the wine cellar. It looks
like it hasn't been used for decades. Well, at least not by anything living.

Exits.Description: The crypt
A wine cellar

rooms.Name: Wine cellar
rooms.Description:
This is the old wine cellar of the Dragon Tower. The shelves are empty.
Nothing living has been in here for a long time. You see a tunnel leading off
to the east and boy does it smell bad. Kind of like rotting flesh.

Exits.Description: The stairwell
A tunnel

rooms.Name: Tunnel
rooms.Description:
This tunnel seems to stretch for miles. You try to distinguish the end but
your eyes soon tire from the strain. The smell here has increased two fold. The
tunnel continues to go to the east. The wine cellar lies back to the west.

Exits.Description: A cave opening
A tunnel
A tunnel

rooms.Name: A cave opening
rooms.Description:
You stand at the opening of a giant cave. There are many bones strewn across
the room. Some human, some indistinguishable. It smells very bad in here. You
can hear movement in the cave to the north. The tunnel goes back to the south.

Exits.Description: The lair
The tunnel

rooms.Name: The End of the tunnel
rooms.Description:
You have finally come to the end of the tunnel. Back to the west lies the
miles of tunnels you have walked through. You see the faint outline of a
trapdoor above you. A bridge over an underground river lies to the south.

Exits.Description: The tunnel
You see an old trapdoor. Seems like it never have been opened.
bridge

rooms.Name: The Bridge
rooms.Description:
You are walking along an old wooden bridge. Its not that secure. You might
want to hurry along. To the south, on the other side of the bridge, lies a
small opening.

Exits.Description: The tunnel end
A small opening

rooms.Name: A small opening
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small opening. To the north lies the old wooden
bridge. To your south the you can see a clearing. You can see sunlight again.
What a welcome relief!

Exits.Description: bridge
clearing

rooms.Name: Clearing
rooms.Description:
You stand out in a clearing. Mountains are all around you. There is a well
in the middle of the clearing. Lying against the well is a sign. A path leads
up the mountain. The small opening is back to the north.

Exits.Description: the small opening
A path
The well

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You peer over the side of the well.  It looks VERY, VERY deep.  It appears
to be ENDLESS.

The sign reads:
         This is a bottomless pit cleverly disguised as a well.  People have
fallen in and never been heard from again.  Trust me, you don't want to go 
down there.
                        The All Powerful Well Keeper

rooms.Name: A path
rooms.Description:
This path leads up the side of the mountain. A clearing lies below you.
There is a cave opening to the west. The path continues up the mountain.

Exits.Description: cave opening
clearing
the path continues

rooms.Name: A cave opening
rooms.Description:
You stand before a huge cave opening. You hearing heavy breathing from
within the cave. There are a few skeletons lying about. The cave lies to the
south. The path is back to the east.

Exits.Description: A lair
the path

rooms.Name: The path continues
rooms.Description:
The path continues up the mountain to the top. The path also goes down.
That's it, nothing more to see.

Exits.Description: top of the mountain
path

rooms.Name: The top of the mountain
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the top of the mountain. It feels more like the top of
the world. To your north lies a huge platinum door. You hear very pronounced
grumbling from behind the doors. It sounds like something huge and hungry. But
if you don't have the key you don't have to worry because you can't get it. If
you do have the key I would suggest not going in. Some believe the Five Headed
dragon Tiamat was imprisoned here by the gods. But who believes in fairy tales.
Well, if you're scared, you can always go down the mountain.

Exits.Description: The path continues
The platinum door

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A huge platinum door separates you from harm

rooms.Name: Well
rooms.Description:
O h ! N o ! I warned you! You have fallen into the bottomless pit. You life
flashes right before your eyes. Pretty pathetic isn't it? Next time you'll know
to listen to the God of Laughs.

rooms.Name: The Path to Gragloy Castle
rooms.Description:
A small dirt path leads you northward. An old rickety #Csign
 #Wis sticking in the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads:

NO TRESPASSERS

rooms.Name: The Path
rooms.Description:
You are still walking on the dirt path. The castle is in
view but you see nothing else. The grass in this area is
brown, there are no flowers or trees.

rooms.Name: The Path
rooms.Description:
A small bridge is northward, bridging an empty moat.
For some strange reason there is no detail around this castle.
You think to yourself that this place is really dreadful.

rooms.Name: The Entryway
rooms.Description:
A few old, worn down pieces of lumber form a bridge
enabling for you to cross the small moat around the
castle. The outer courtyard spreads to the east and west.

rooms.Name: The Outer Courtyard
rooms.Description:
This is the outer courtyard. Long grasses now grow
here due to lack of care. You can feel many small creatures
crawl over your feet. The wind blowing in the grass creates
haunting, howling sounds. A large boulder can been seen to
the east.

rooms.Name: The Forgotten Rock
rooms.Description:
A large boulder lies here in the field. As you look at
it, a question forms in your head, 'How did this get here?'.
You notice small markings on the rock.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The rock has a small symbol carved upon it, which
glows a deep blue color.  It looks like this:

#b                /\
#b              /____\
#b            /\      /\
#b          /____\  /____\
#N

rooms.Name: The Outer Courtyard
rooms.Description:
The weeds and flowers that once grew here have been
withered from the horrid weather of this area.  You hear
the crackling sound of snail shells as you walk along
this rugged piece of land.  Bare patches on the ground
indicate that this area has been used by other
adventurers, as a campsite.

rooms.Name: The Outer Courtyard
rooms.Description:
Parts of the castle's crumbled walls lie along
this part of the field. A small dirt path lies to the
north.

rooms.Name: The Hidden Path
rooms.Description:
A narrow dirt path covered with small rocks leads north
and south here.  Tall stalks of brown grass grow here making
it hard to see around you.  A deep howl of wind blows
giving this place a very eerie effect.

rooms.Name: The Hidden Path
rooms.Description:
A narrow dirt path covered with small rocks leads north
and south here.  Tall stalks of brown grass grow here making
it hard to see around you.  A deep howl of wind blows
giving this place a very eerie effect.

rooms.Name: The Hidden Path
rooms.Description:
A narrow dirt path covered with small rocks leads north
and south here.  Tall stalks of brown grass grow here making
it hard to see around you.  A turn in the path is visible to
the north.

rooms.Name: A Turn in the Path
rooms.Description:
There is a small bend in the path leading you
to the back of the castle.  The long grasses that
grow here caress your hands causing you to pull
yourself closer.

rooms.Name: The End of the Path
rooms.Description:
You've reached the end of the path to discover
a small passage in the castle walls, but it is too
dark to see where it leads.

rooms.Name: The Castle Gates
rooms.Description:
The power of time has crumbled the castle walls,
and the ground is strewn with chunks of broken stone.
The gates have fallen, and now form piles of large
splinters around your feet. Dead vines twine up parts
of the walls pulling them down even more.

rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

rooms.Name: The Base of the Eastern Tower
rooms.Description:
A small opening in the side of the wall leads
into the eastern tower.  The courtyard continues north
and west.

rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

rooms.Name: The Base of the Western Tower
rooms.Description:
A small opening in the side of the wall leads
into the western tower.  The courtyard continues north
and east.

rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

rooms.Name: On the Western Tower Stairs
rooms.Description:
The stairs seem to be sturdy enough to hold your weight
but you have an uneasy feeling going up these stairs. Small
torches wind up the sides of the walls as do the stairs.

rooms.Name: The Western Tower Stairs
rooms.Description:
A small peep of light glints from above.  You must
be near the top of the tower.  A breeze blows in
from the small hatch at the top.

rooms.Name: The Top of the Western Tower
rooms.Description:
You take a deep breath as you reach the final stair.
From here you can see for miles in every direction. You can
even see the temple of Midgaard. Your eyes wander across the
landscape trying to find landmarks that you recognize.
You notice a chunk of the tower has broken off.

rooms.Name: The Fall of the Fool
rooms.Description:
Ooooooh that's gotta hurt! Walking off of towers
is a dangerous hobby.  Do be more careful next time!
(You're just lucky this wasn't the spot of your death!)

rooms.Name: On the Eastern Tower Stairs
rooms.Description:
The stairs seem to be sturdy enough to hold your
weight but you have an uneasy feeling going up these
stairs. Small torches wind up the sides of the walls as
do the stairs.

rooms.Name: The Eastern Tower Stairs
rooms.Description:
The rickety stairs make you very nervous.  As you
grab hold of the hand rail a piece of it breaks off.
Decay has befallen these stairs.

rooms.Name: The Top of the Eastern Tower
rooms.Description:
A strong gust of wind nearly blows you off the tower.
Lights from villages can be seen in the distance as small
birds fly by your head.

rooms.Name: Inside the Castle Gragloy
rooms.Description:
Large pieces of the walls lie across the floor making
it hard for you to move around.  This castle has held
off many invaders... Minotaurs, Drow, even Trolls, but
nothing could have prepared the previous owners for the
Gargoyles.  A staircase leading down is to the east.

rooms.Name: The Royal Hallway (or what used to be)
rooms.Description:
The halls of this once glamorous hallway are now
crumbled with age.  The walls used to be lined with
paintings of the former royal families but now the walls
are bare.  A long red carpet also used to stretch from
here to the throne room but instead the carpet you walk
along is made of roots and small shrubs.

rooms.Name: The Royal Hallway
rooms.Description:
Statues used to line the sides of this part of the
corridor.  The statues are still there...  But in pieces.
Long vines have grown in the walls and have advanced
their way on to some of the more intact statues. Pieces
of the walls are missing in this segment of the hallway
allowing light to seep in.

rooms.Name: The Throne Room
rooms.Description:
Small torches placed in the corners, illuminate
this room, but you wish they hadn't. This has got to be
the most age-stricken room in the castle.  The walls
are cracked, vines have grown over almost everything and
the ceiling has caved in. What used to be a magnificent
throne room is now a disaster area serving the ruler of
the gargoyles. You see the blood of adventurers smeared
on the floors and walls.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Dungeon
rooms.Description:
A small, black door has been bashed open to reveal
the entrance to the dungeon. The smell of death touches
your nostrils causing you to gag. A small set of stairs
lead downward into the dungeon.

rooms.Name: The Stairs to the Dungeon
rooms.Description:
You notice some of the stairs are broken or cracked.
As you carefully make your way down the stairs you notice
there is no light source except from the door at the top.
Small rodents crawl around your feet trying not to be noticed.

rooms.Name: In the Dungeon
rooms.Description:
The smell of death fully enters your nose as you
enter this room. Torches do line the walls around this
area but they are not lit. Many more rodents race across
the floor here.

rooms.Name: Inside the Dungeon
rooms.Description:
The hallways in this dungeon are so dark you can't
make anything out here.  All you can see is darkness.
You hear the squeals of rats as you step on their small
bodies, also, you hear the cracking of the bones of
former guests.

rooms.Name: Outside the Cells
rooms.Description:
You can make out some bars to the west, and the
hallway continues to the south. You brush yourself
off as cobwebs get caught on your clothing.

rooms.Name: Outside the Cells
rooms.Description:
As you touch along the wall to find your way,
small spiders and bugs crawl up your arm. You
frantically brush them off before they bite you.
A small cell lies to the west.

rooms.Name: Outside the Cells
rooms.Description:
You see a glint of light coming from the east
which provides enough light to see another cell to
the south. A medium sized spider hovers down in front
of your face. Confidently, you smack it away.

rooms.Name: A Dingy Cell
rooms.Description:
A hint of light escapes from a large crack in the
wall to the east. There is nothing in this room most
likely because the light scared the creatures away from
here. The crack looks just big enough for you to fit
through.

rooms.Name: Inside the Crack
rooms.Description:
Light seeps in from the door to the north. You think
to yourself that this once formed part of a catacomb, but
the walls must have caved in from age.

rooms.Name: The Chamber of the Damned
rooms.Description:
The light seems to be coming from the walls themselves.
A large pentagram lies in the middle of the floor leading
downwards, though you cannot see what lies within it. Upside
down crosses and other devil-worshipping artifacts fill this
room making you feel strange.

rooms.Name: The Hole of Fate
rooms.Description:
Congratulations! You've won an all expenses paid
trip...to Hell! You'll spend what feels like an eternity
there, bathing in nice warm weather, hanging out with all
your old deceased friends, and the best part is you get
to meet the ultimate evil...SATAN!
    You're dead, loser. >:P

rooms.Name: Inside a Damp Cell
rooms.Description:
Musty air fills the room as water drips from the
ceiling creating that ever horrifying sound as it echoes
through the hallways of the dungeon. A small pile of bones
sits in the corner covered by cobwebs and rats.

rooms.Name: Inside a Cell
rooms.Description:
Small piles of bones lie about on the ground. Rats
creep in and out of the piles sending shivers down your
spine. A small piece of flesh on the ground, infested
with maggots making you want to leave this dank cell.

rooms.Name: Inside a Rotted Cell
rooms.Description:
As you enter this room, you decide this is where
that smell of death comes from because there are corpses
wrapped in spider webs spread all around. This is not
one of the best places to stay since there is a gigantic
spider nest here.

rooms.Name: The War Room
rooms.Description:
Out of the whole castle this is the only room that
appears to be totally intact.  Paintings of heroes now
forgotten hang on the walls and precious mithril armors
stand at attention along the sides of the room. A long
table lies in the middle of the room, used to plan
strategic battles.  The gargoyles must use this room
frequently.

rooms.Name: Atop the Staircase
rooms.Description:
You are at a staircase which leads downwards. A chandelier
engulfed in vines hangs above your head.  Muddy tracks from
gargoyles lead up and down these stairs many times.

rooms.Name: The Gargoyle's Lodging
rooms.Description:
This is the place where most of the Gargoyles sleep
and congregate. Torches illuminate the room enough to
see that this is quite a small place.  The blood of
other creatures is splattered all around the walls,
convincing you that they feast extravagantly.

rooms.Name: The Wedding Chapel
rooms.Description:
The walls inside the chapel glow with a divine light.  You feel at
ease inside here, all of your worries left at the door.  Rows of
cushioned silvery seats are here for your seating comfort.  Murals of
Elite's great gods line the walls, providing witness to this event.
Upon closer inspection, you realize the stained glass windows are
actually depictions of IO creating the very fabric of existance.  At
the far end of the room you see a magnificent altar constructed of an
unknown, but enchanting alloy. A beautiful silken canopy covers the
wedding platform, where the bride and groom to be will stand and speak
their vows.
§N

rooms.Name: Helm's Sanctuary
rooms.Description:
You have entered a large helmet shaped room of sorts. your footsteps
cause a strange echo as you walk around.  You notice that this room would
be entirely empty except for various pieces of headgear which line the
walls.  As you take a closer look you see that the headwear ranges from
simple caps to ornate battle helmets... probably one of Helm's disguises
that he uses while watching mortals.  You aren't sure but you could swear
that one of the helms winked at you... you feel like you are being watched.
§N

rooms.Name: A Gravel Road on the Graveyard
rooms.Description:
You are on a well-kept gravel road that leads north-south through the
graveyard. On both sides of the road grow dark evergreen trees. An iron grate
is to the north.

Exits.Description: Through the solid iron bars you see the Concourse.
The gravel road continues southward.

rooms.Name: A Gravel Road on the Graveyard
rooms.Description:
You are on a well-kept gravel road that leads north-south through the
graveyard. On both sides of the road grow dark evergreen trees.

Exits.Description: The gravel road continues northwards.
The gravel road continues southward.

rooms.Name: A Gravel Road on the Graveyard
rooms.Description:
You are on a well-kept gravel road that leads north-south through the
graveyard. On both sides of the road grow dark evergreen trees.

Exits.Description: The gravel road continues northwards.
The gravel road continues southward.

rooms.Name: A Gravel Road on the Graveyard
rooms.Description:
You are on a well-kept gravel road that leads north-south through the
graveyard. On both sides of the road grow dark evergreen trees.

Exits.Description: The gravel road continues northwards.
The gravel road continues southward to an open space before a small building.

rooms.Name: In front of the Chapel
rooms.Description:
You are on an open space before a small chapel. A gravel road leads north
through the graveyard and the chapel entrance is to the south.

Exits.Description: The gravel road continues northwards.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.
The chapel door is made of dark wood.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.

rooms.Name: Inside the Chapel
rooms.Description:
You are in a small, dark chapel. The dark brown glass in the tiny windows do
not let much light through. A few rows of worn wooden benches stand here and an
ancient altar sits in the middle of the floor.

Exits.Description: The chapel door is made of dark wood.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The benches are not of the comfortable kind.

rooms.Name: The Gravestones
rooms.Description:
There are several old and weathered gravestones here that mark the graves of
Midgaard's former citizens. It is a cold, silent place.

Exits.Description: There are several old and weathered gravestones there.
There are several old and weathered gravestones there.

rooms.Name: The Gravestones
rooms.Description:
There are several old and weathered gravestones here that mark the graves of
Midgaard's former citizens. It is a cold, silent place.

Exits.Description: There are several old and weathered gravestones there.
There are several old and weathered gravestones there.

rooms.Name: The Gravestones
rooms.Description:
There are several old and weathered gravestones here that mark the graves of
Midgaard's former citizens. It is a cold, silent place.

Exits.Description: There are several old and weathered gravestones there.
There are several old and weathered gravestones there.

rooms.Name: The Gravestones
rooms.Description:
There are several old and weathered gravestones here that mark 
the graves of Midgaard's formor citizens and heros.  One such 
grave has several fresh flowers laid over it and a prominent 
headstone.
This place is very cold and silent.
§N

Exits.Description: There are a few old and weathered gravestones are there.
You see a long row of gravestones.
To the west is the entrance to the Chapel.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at the tombstone and flowers, you see that the
flowers are fell laid out by someone who cares.
You guess that it is done daily.
The tombstone is not large or remarkable, but it simply has:
          STOMPER SHADOWLORD
Devoted Son of Chelendria and Pendragon
Survived by 2 brothers and both parents.
He lies here dead of a terminal heart disease -- a broken heart.
  "May he rests with the shadows which was his home,
   May he live with the friends of long time gone,
   May he run in the life that knows him best,
   May he find and remember all days gone long past."
                          -- Johannes --
§N

rooms.Name: The Gravestones
rooms.Description:
There are several old and weathered gravestones here that mark the graves of
Midgaard's former citizens. It is a cold, silent place.

Exits.Description: There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.

rooms.Description:
There are several old and weathered gravestones here that mark the graves of
Midgaard's former citizens. It is a cold, silent place.

Exits.Description: There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.

rooms.Name: The Open Graves
rooms.Description:
Strange, some of the graves here have been dug up. You see footprints in the
soft earth all about the open graves. A ghastly smell wafts up at you from the
unearthed graves. It is a sickening smell, of something long dead.

Exits.Description: There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.

rooms.Description:
There are several old and weathered gravestones here that mark the graves of
Midgaard's former citizens. It is a cold, silent place.

Exits.Description: There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.

rooms.Name: The Gravestones

about the room.

rooms.Name: Vladamir's Bedchamber
rooms.Description:
This is a room filled with expensive antiques from ages past. A wooden
chair, a vanity, desk, and table are placed in the room. A very expensive rug
covers the floor. A large black coffin is against the south wall.

Exits.Description: An ornately carved wooden door.

rooms.Name: The Library
rooms.Description:
Bookshelves are on all the walls of this room. They are filled with books of
all kinds. Most are of no interest to you whatever. A nice large padded chair
and footstool sits at its center. A small table is at its side.

Exits.Description: An ornately carved door.
A trapdoor is under a padded chair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A splendidly comfortable looking chair.  From the marks on the floor it looks
like this chair gets moved a lot.

rooms.Name: A Stonelined Shaft
rooms.Description:
A shaft that leads deep within the earth. It is lined with stones and
mortar. The walls are very slippery with a brown slimy mold.

Exits.Description: The shaft continues downward into the dark.

rooms.Name: The Spiked Pit
rooms.Description:
O O O O O P S ! You have fallen into a nasty spiked pit! There are several
sharp spikes here to meet you, say HELLO! Strange, they seem to be moving as if
alive?
 
     o-<--< 
    ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ 
    | | | | |

Exits.Description: You see a door concealed within the wall.

rooms.Name: A Large Cavern
rooms.Description:
The floor of the cavern is covered with all sorts of junk. There are bits of
armor and weapons, clothing, bones, and other assorted garbage. You even see
the glint of gold and silver coins here and there.

Exits.Description: A small door is to the west.
An earthen tunnel leads up to the surface.
Under the garbage you find a large stone slab.

rooms.Name: A Small Stone Burial Vault
rooms.Description:
This ancient vault is totally dark, cold and dry. It is bare except for a
large stone sarcophagus against the east wall.

Exits.Description: The entrance to the vault.
The sarcophagus conceals an entrance.

rooms.Name: A Large Stone Burial Vault
rooms.Description:
This vault is huge, but contains only a single large stone sarcophagus. The
entrance you came through has closed by itself. You are alone here. Or are you?

rooms.Name: The Hallway of Learning
rooms.Description:
This is the beginning of the Hallway of Learning. If you are new to mudding
and new to Elite, you should walk through these halls. You will be taught the
basics on survival and also you will be given some equipment to help you on the
way. There will be §RSIGNS§N along the hallways. Read them. There is sign right
here. Read it with: look sign

Exits.Description: You see the reading room

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
_____________________________________________________________________
       / Welcome to EliteMud.                                               /
      / Within these halls, much knowledge will be revealed.               /
     / When you have finished with one room, just continue north to go on./
    / If there is something you have missed or want to look back upon,   /
   / just go back south, or come back here later.  If there is anything /
  / you don't understand, feel free to ask other players here.         /
 / Now go forth north to meet your fate, adventurer!                  /
(____________________________________________________________________(

rooms.Name: The Hallway of Movement
rooms.Description:
This is where the art of movement is taught. If you master that already,
feel free to go on. To move around in the world of Elite, there are some
commands to use. You should already know the basics. There are six directions
to go. North, south, east, west, up and down. You can abbreviate those commands
to n, s, e, w etc. To know where you are able to go from one place you can use
the command EXITS. In Elite as in the real world, you cannot always walk to all
the places. There are water, hills and air. Those must be crossed with other
means. Doors and other obstacles may block your way too. There is a sign here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
+---------------------------------------------------------+
 | Summary of commands involving movement:                 |
 |                                                         |
 | North South East West Up Down Enter Leave               |
 | Look Exits                                              |
 | Lock Unlock Open Close                                  |
 |                                                         |     
 | (Walking around is tiresom business)                    |
 | Sleep Wake Rest Sit Stand                               |
 +---------------------------------------------------------+

rooms.Name: The Hallway of Scores
rooms.Description:
To keep track of your character here in Elite, there are some scores to show
you the characters statisticts. The most important is the DISPLAY command. It
should show you your Hp, Mn and Mv. Hp stands for Hit points and is a way to
value your health. Try to keep it positive and as high as possible, since
failure will mean death. Mn stands for mana, your mental power. This is most
important for spell casters but all will have use for it. Mv stands for
movement, your endurance in other words. Everything involving movement will tax
your movement, so rest now and then when it gets too low. There is a sign here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
_______________________________________________________
( Informatic commands:                                  )
(                                                       )
( Score Stat Levels Skills Spells Practice              )
( Who Whois Where Time Date Toggle Weather              )
( Help News Credit Wizlist Immlist Policy Info          )
(_______________________________________________________)

rooms.Name: The Hallway of Communication
rooms.Description:
The main reason for playing a mud is the social contact it offers. There are
many more better games for any home computer, but seldom can you play with
people from all round the globe. To make the communication easier there are
many commands. Be sure you know how to use them. There is a large sign here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
...............................................................................
 Communication with other players:                              

 Say     ( All in room will hear. Use ' instead of typing say. For ex: 'Hello )
 Tell    ( To any other player in game - Very private indeed. )
 Yell    ( All in your specific area will hear )
 Newbie  ( All with this channel switched on will hear)
 Chat    ( All with this social line on will hear.  Can use . as abbr. Ex: .HI)
 Gossip  ( Like chat )
 Auction ( Another channel for selling/buying stuff )
 Gtell   ( Group-tell.  All in your 'group' will hear )
 Ask
 Whisper

 Socials are commands only for social entertainment.
 Smile Cry Laugh Grin   etc

 To get a complete list, use the commands socials.
...............................................................................

rooms.Name: The Hallway of Refreshment
rooms.Description:
Walking around in this world makes your character both hungry and thirsty.
So have some refreshments before going on. There is a small sign here.

rooms.Name: The Hallway of Equipment
rooms.Description:
Many dangers will fall upon you on your visits here on Elite. To prepare for
the tasks ahead you need to equip yourself with things that will help you. Take
whatever you need here and prepare yourself. There is a battered sign here.

rooms.Name: The Hallway of Battle
rooms.Description:
There are many foul creatures on the earth of this Land. You must use both
strength and courage to prevail. Why don't you practice little here in the art
of battle. There is a sign here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
---===========)**** ****(============---
  Only through practice can you master:

  Kill Flee Assist Consider

 ---===========)**** ****(============---

rooms.Name: The Hallway of Light
rooms.Description:
Throughout the Land, not all places will be as light as this. Where evil
resides there are often darkness. Always bring light with you where ever you
go. The light in your heart may not always be enough. There is a glowing sign
here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
\ /  To brighten up your day:
 -O- 
 / \  Get Hold Remove

rooms.Name: The Hallway of Darkness
rooms.Description:
It is well that you brought light, for this place is else dark. There is
nothing here to see though, just go on.

rooms.Name: The Hallway of Ending and New Beginning
rooms.Description:
You have now been taught the basics of this game. There are however lots
more to learn. Let's hope you learn them on your travels and will have use for
them. By using the HELP command you should be able to get more info. Ask
others, for in asking there is wisdom. Through the portal to the north you will
get back to the Temple. Rest well and ask for the way to your guild, so that
you may practice your skills. Journey then below the temple. Be strong,
adventurer and good luck. There is a sign here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can get a simple map of central Midgaard by typing:
 > help midgaard

rooms.Name: The Library
rooms.Description:
This is the Midgaard library.  You should be very quiet in here in order not
to disturb the others.

rooms.Name: #MThe Gates of Zia#N
rooms.Description:
Awe is what you feel, standing in front of these truly gigantic 
gates, which burn perpetually, keeping those not of Phos from entering 
our sacred refuge. The burning spires tower high above you, seeming to 
singe the clouds and reach for the sun in their marvelous grandeur. 
Amazingly, the spectacular gates are only the beginning of the wonders 
that await you when you enter our sacred fold.

rooms.Name: #MDen of the Eclipse#N
rooms.Description:
The first thing that catches your eye as you enter this immense 
dining room for the followers of Phos is a monstrous marble dining 
table. Each of our esteemed brothers and sisters claims a seat, where 
we discuss our exploits and drink wine until Phos shines upon us once 
again. Richly dark oak pillars stand around the table, and huge fires 
remind us of our Lord when he is away blessing others. A #Ygolden 
#Yplaque#N hangs on the eastern wall. Thick rugs and furs invite you 
to remove your heavy boots and sit for a spell, and talk amongst 
yourselves.

Exits.Description: #MThe Library#N
#MThe Store#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
#yThe Founding Members of #MDragoons #wof #CPhos#N
Ix, Kurrelgyre, Ambryl, Purr, Chani, Tsunami, Wick, Hylar, 
Kieriay, Colosul, Aynjul, Jura, Rage, Ragnar, Nermal, Garf, 
Prophator, Redfang, Snarf
#yMay the Sun shine upon you wherever you may go.#N

rooms.Name: #MPhos' High Altar#N
rooms.Description:
This dedication to our god, Phos, is an immense room with a dome made 
of stained glass. The entire room is golden with the light of our 
beloved Lord of the Sun. Even at night, the room still emanates a warm 
glow, a gift given to his chosen ones by our benevolent Lord. The walls 
glitter with elaborate tapestries of silk, glittering weapons, and 
gilded icons showing our faith. A very warm feeling of replenishment 
flows through your veins as you stand here, for the light from above 
invigorates your weary body. Rest here and Phos will watch over you. 
There is also anther #MShelf #wof #CPhos#N here where we can put items 
that might help you but are not worth enter the #MDragoon Trove#N.

rooms.Name: #MDragoon Trove#N
rooms.Description:
In this room, our brethren leave important items for communal use. 
There is also a #MShelf #wof #CPhos#N where you can place items you find 
you cant drop. Take what you wish, but try to return it once no more 
can be gleaned from it. Another dragoon may find use of it, and the 
favor shall come back to you.

rooms.Name: #MBurning Den#N
rooms.Description:
Warmth encompasses your body as you enter the den. A hearth heats the 
entire room, and fire pits lie spitting and hissing in the Four Corners 
of the room. Two enormous couches sit facing each other, large enough 
to accommodate all the Dragoons and then some. A thick slab of redwood 
serves as a table and a footrest, and engraved mugs of pewter lie 
scattered and empty. While the dining room serves the more serious and 
formal matters, this room is designed purely for comfort. This is also 
where the Dragoons hone their battle skills, so as not forget the reason 
they banded together. They will always remain exceptional warriors.

Exits.Description: #MA Phos Hallway#N
#MA Phos Hallway#N

rooms.Name: #MSith's Shrine Of '#RCore#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter this room, you get the inexplicable urge to Skank. And 
in the background you notice a feverish, up-beat guitar, a melodic, and 
moving baseline which is amplified in effect by a set of horns 
(Trombone, and alto and Bari sax), a throbbing drumbeat, that all 
intertwine behind a blaring set of vocal chords, screaming the anthem 
"We're not gonna take it!" After finally getting adjusted to the music 
of the room, you notice the shape of this "room", it is round, with no 
corners and one visible face that surrounds and encompasses the viewer 
with a #Rmural#N painted onto this surface, the floor is of hard wood 
and slanted at various angles to give a mesmerizing effect if one were 
to stare at it for too long. Along this wall above the mural are many 
various guitars, with a white Yamaha bass as the centerpiece to them 
all. Along the side opposite the door is a stack of speakers resembling 
an amplifier of some sort, the section of floor under this area is 
raised to be a bit higher than that of the rest of the room. To the 
near side of the room are a couple of chairs and couches, with a bed 
resting on two red trunks on the area to the right, just before the 
stage.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This mural depicts 4 men. The first one an older man with a blonde 
receding hairline, he has a big nose and an awkward grin on his face, 
as if he has just done something wrong. The second man is much shorter 
than the first and is wearing allot of necklaces and bracelets. In his 
right hand he holds a paints brush still dripping with red paint. The 
third man is slightly taller than the second, he is very thin and looks 
about as old as the second (but in all reality is not), on his head he 
wears a hat that bears an iron cross on the backside (since he is 
wearing it backwards, that is the side facing), on his right hand in a 
watch, and in the hand is a piece of glass. The fourth and final man is 
the same height as the third, although this man carries a much larger 
and muscular build. He wears a pair of china blue shoes, and on his face 
are the thickest pair of glasses you have ever seen in your life. 
Attached to his shirt in some fashion is some sort of watch, it 
resembles a grandfather clock's face only smaller. The four men look 
confident and indomitable. As you continue to stare at the painting, the 
picture shifts and the men's appearances change, all the while under 
close scrutiny, one can notice other shapes fall in behind the four men, 
some ever seem to stand along side the four. But the only real 
noticeable difference is that the second man seems to have a dark shadow 
over him, and all that look upon this know something has gone awry. The 
only signature to be found on the painting is that of and "S" with two 
vertical lines running through it.

This is a standard issue white Yamaha bass model kpx250 along the neck 
is written the words "#Rfor Stan#N".

rooms.Description:
Amongst these sacred halls lay the rooms of Gods both past and
present who were either members of #MD#wo#CP#N or held by the clan in high
regards for their wisdom and advice. #MD#wo#CP#N salutes and remembers those who
gave unselfishly if their time and energy to create and rule in this
land we call #bElitemud#N!
