rooms.Name: #MThe Library#N
rooms.Description:
As you walk in this great room you realize that this is where the 
#MDragoon#e'#Ms#N come to read the important information being passed down from 
member to member. As you stand in the center you get the feeling that 
there is something different about this room. Its not just that huge 
writing board in the center that #MPhos#N use to pass on information. 
You walk to the center of the room and look up and see a huge 
#Cskylight#N that allows the sun and moon alike to let their rays of 
light into this great hall. Just as you are about to leave this room 
it finally comes to you what is so different about this place. This 
room is devoid of any sound.

Exits.Description: #MDen of the Eclipse#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look up you gaze in awe at the beauty of the skylight directly 
above you. 20 feet in diameter, this giant dome fills the room with the 
glory of the #yday#N and the beauty of the #Bnight#N. It seems to you 
that there is nothing between you and the #bsky#N above.

rooms.Name: #MThe Waiting Room#N
rooms.Description:
As you descend from the #MDragoon Trove#N you realize at once that
this isn't an ordinary room. You get the impression that your being
watched by more then #gMercedes#N the secretary at the center of the room.
You quickly scan the room and see a door to the #Gnorth#N and #Rsouth#N.
Each door has a name over it. There are also quite a few #Bpictures of
beautiful naked women#N on the walls in addition to a #Cstatue#N in the
north corner of the room. Strangely enough there are #Mchairs#N on the
West Side of the room. As you attempt to step towards one of the doors
the secretary blocks your way and points to the south corner of the of
the room where there is a #Csign#N.

Exits.Description: #MDragoon Trove#N
#RDa #BFuzzy #YOne #C, High Lord of #G(HEMP)'s #C Room#N
#MFistandantilus Room of Honor#N

have an appointment, you will just have 
to sit and wait.

the heat of the day, 
or when da Wolf seeks #Bnight#N, the glass ceiling darkens until the 
room has the comfort of a shaded spot in a deep #Gforest#N or a cave 
buried in the face of a mountain. The roof slants gradually from its 
peak 20 feet up the side of the tree to a bare 8 inches from the thick 
dark green moss, which cushions the floor. A very fine screen forms 
the short remaining wall. The mesh seems to disappear when you attempt 
to look closely at it. A bubbling stream fills the pond at the center 
of the room, and the force of the water forms a small magical 
#Bfountain#N that seems to be altered.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Ashlyn's measurements are 34C-22-33 and five foot-three inches tall, 
with shapely legs, a beautifully round ass and breasts that are enticing 
mounds of flesh standing erect. Ashlyn is simply stunning.

Briana is a beautiful blonde, wild, who seems born to be a model. She 
has a 34DD-26-30 figure and long, blonde hair.

As you check out these comfortable leather chairs you realize that you 
may have a long wait before you gain entry into XeNos's and Fistandantilus
rooms.

This is a statue of Kaitlyn our most precious prize. This buxom blonde 
statue is a long legged seducer that boasts a stellar 34D-24-35 figure 
at 5'5''.

Really some fabulous trees, a holdout from the Cretaceous or Pleistocene 
prehistoric time. The Redwood is the world's tallest known tree and one 
of the world's oldest trees. This tree, is nine hundred years old, 
stands 360 feet tall and has a diameter of 15 feet. Redwoods are named 
for the color of their bark and heartwood. The high tannin content of 
the wood gives the trees remarkable resistance to fungus diseases and 
insect infestations. The thick, fibrous bark has an even higher tannin 
content, and insulates them from the periodic fires which have occurred 
naturally down through the centuries. This immense tree has delicate 
foliage. Narrow, sharp-pointed needles only one-half to three-quarters 
of an inch long grow flat along their stems, forming feathery sprays. 
The cones are about an inch long and each cone contains fourteen to 
twenty-four tiny seeds

As you look at the ratton basket chairs you see it's made of wicker with 
very thick reeds instead of thin ones and is almost enclosed on three 
sides.

As you look up into the night you see a vivid display. The night shines 
with the light of the moon and the stars. It is indeed a beautiful site.

rooms.Name: #MFistandantilus Room of Honor#N
rooms.Description:
In this room full of pillage and plunder #MD#wo#CP#N honors one of their own.
The wonderfully awesome spectacular Fistandantilus whose aliases have 
been known to include Darklord, Hawkeye... and the list goes on and on.
This fearless warrior will wipe out entire zones of monsters without
even blinking an eye. This is where he plans out his mass killing sprees
so that the they can be executed to perfection since nothing less than
perfection will do. Just take a look around the room and admire and
look in awe of at all of his trophies and prizes. The one we know as
Fistandantilus is an admired #MD#wo#CP#N Council member.

Exits.Description: #RThe Waiting Room#N

rooms.Name: #MThe Store#N
rooms.Description:
This is where all #MPhos#N come to do their business. As you can see 
you can buy things from the nice merchant. In addition you can do 
banking in case you have too much or too little cash on hand. As you 
look around you notice a small sign on the wall.

Exits.Description: #MDen of the Eclipse#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a place of business. I will not tolerate any violence or 
stealing in my shop. Violators will be punished to the full extent of 
the law!

rooms.Name: #MThrone of the Eclipse Lord#N
rooms.Description:
Closest to Phos is Kurrelgyre, Lord of the Eclipse, and co-founder of 
our wondrous clan. His gilded throne sits here, lined with plush satin 
cushions and endowed with a regal glow. A spire of light illuminates the 
center of the room, piercing through a round window cut from diamond and 
placed directly above the throne. This serves as a constant reminder of 
Kurrelgyre's Lord, and his dedication to the #MDragoons #wof#C Phos#N.

Exits.Description: #MThe Hall of Gods#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you examine the throne more closely, the glare seems to subside and 
you see small, ornate etchings. Reading them more closely, you see the 
names of the mercenaries who embrace Phos.

rooms.Name: #MIx's Humble Abode#N
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small, but ever expanding room. On the walls, 
you see great artwork, which was obviously stolen from art galleries 
around the world. The room is very cozy and you feel right at home.

Exits.Description: #MThe Hall of Gods#N

rooms.Name: #MAynjul's Playroom#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered a room that appears to be completely white. Upon 
closer inspection, you realize that you are surrounded on all sides by 
walls made of moving clouds. The white, fluffy clouds and cool, blowing 
breeze in this room give it a peaceful and relaxing feel. As you turn 
around to get a better look at the rest of the room, you notice a black 
kitten sitting on top of a smaller, stationary cloud just above your 
head looking down ready to pounce!

Exits.Description: #MThe Hall of Rememberence#N

rooms.Name: #MGarf and Ragnar's Room#N
rooms.Description:
This is a not so small room for two people. It has the standard 
equipment; two desks, two closets, a weapons rack and of course a finely 
carved four-poster canopy bed. The heavy oak desk obviously belongs to 
Ragnar as there is an axe holding down a sheet of paper. The other 
lighter desk just has to belong to Garf. The weapons rack has the 
standard tools of the trade locked up in it; a couple of swords, an axe 
or two, and of course a bow with a quiver of arrows A sign at the door 
says: "Wipe Your Feet the rug costs money"

Exits.Description: #MThe Hall of Rememberence#N

rooms.Name: #MKeldron's Swinging Pad#N
rooms.Description:
As you walk into this room the eerie glow of 30 lava lamps surrounds 
you. You smell a faint trace of reefer and notice the bright colors on 
the walls. Over the door hangs a sign proclaiming #r"FREE LOVE MAN!" #N
There is a bean bag chair in the corner and a large flower shaped carpet 
in the middle of the room. The resident has posted several Woodstock 
posters on the wall and there is a stack of records up to waist level 
in the corner. You decide to take a seat and the lights dim and a Jimmy 
Hendrix record begins playing. "Hmm..." you think to yourself, "what a 
swinging pad."

Exits.Description: #MA Phos  Hallway#N

rooms.Name: #MHarlan's Conservatory#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered a place of learning and growth. In this room, Harlan 
studies and cultivates the art of creating music. In the center of the 
room, you see a beautiful #rpiano#N, superbly crafted from ebony. There 
are various other musical instruments surrounding it. Along the west 
wall, many large bookcases made of a dark wood stretch toward the 
ceiling, filled with stacks of handwritten scores. As your eyes follow 
the them upward, you see several large skylights that allow the sultry 
glow of dusk to saturate the room. In the southern stretch of the room, 
you see a huge #bbed#N adorned in fine silk. Beside it is a small 
wooden table. Looking to the north, you see a small area of the floor 
crowded with overstuffed beanbag chairs. It looks like a nice place to 
relax for a while. There are many #gplants#N striving in stone pots all 
around it. You feel a sense of peace and healing here.

Exits.Description: #MA Phos  Hallway#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a fine instrument, unlike any you have seen. The whole piano seems 
to quietly emanate the emotion that has been poured into it. Its lid is 
propped open, revealing the work of a master craftsman. The is a small 
engraving in the sound board that reads: "Without music, life would be a 
mistake." - Nietzsche

The bed is large and round, about ten feet across. The sheets, a cobalt 
pool of silk, are in disarray. There are pillows strewn about the bed 
and the floor around it. The scent of a woman lingers in the air here.

The plants appear to be a fine strain of cannabis sativa. 
They are robust and fragrant.

rooms.Name: #wMinas #gLus#yi#rtania#N
rooms.Description:
You feel a sense of quietness as you enter this room. A dim light 
comes from the walls and a soft tone fills the place. Lying on the 
floor you find a #bbagpipe#N and a #brecorder#N among other musical 
instruments. On a desk some unfinished music scores wait the 
inspiration of their creator. At the other end some rather #Mqueer 
shelves#N keep #bbooks#N and #bscrolls#N of all sizes and for all 
ocasions just next to bottles containing liquids of bizarre colours 
and smells. On a heavy table rests a wizard hat and a wand seeming to 
move with own life. Levitating over a shiny mirror there is a 
#Mplaque#N reading in some weird language.

Exits.Description: #MA Phos Hallway#N

#MAvariel #CPrivate #NLibrary
Tacking a fast look the shelves you see large books, small books, 
weird books with wood covers, elegant books with fine worked leather 
covers, scrolls with strange symbols, bottles filled with exotic 
fluids, multiple flasks containing arcane ingredients. You try to get 
one book out, but when you touch it you feel a pain in the soul that 
force you to drop it. A voice in you head warns you that you're not 
allowed to take that book. You take another look trying to find 
something without a protective aura and your eyes stop in one name 
that you recognize. In one of the books you read '#MThe book of 
Shadows#N by #bAvariel the Warmage#N'. This must be the famous 
library of the migthy wizard.

The #MBook #Cof #NShadows by #MAvariel the Warmage#N
You see a large book with letters and magic symbols of gold and a 
purple silk cover. The book of shadows is more then a spell book, is 
the diary of the wizards progress in the art of magic, were he 
register his thoughs, his visions and his spells. The book is the 
Warmage greater treasure and this one is protected with several
spells that gives it a strange aura of many colours, a aura that keep 
the nosy folks away.

The #MBagpipe #Cof #NWarsongs
The #bbagpipe#N is decorated by a symbol in silver blue from an 
ancient celtic village. It looks as if music comes from it calling 
you to battle. #CGood luck to your quest!#N

#MPalantir#C's #Nrecorder
This #rrecorder#N appears to be very precious indeed to its owner. It 
is as shiny as if it was polished today and it is placed on soft red 
silk. Picking it up and blowing a tune you hear the rumble of a 
thousand warrior coming to help you.

rooms.Name: #MSamas' #NSecret #CPalace#N
rooms.Description:
As enter you notice two haunting golden #Cknights#N on each side of 
the platinum door. You begin to question your existence in such a room 
and start to quiver. However, you begin to hear an inviting chant coming 
from the slaved #Cmonks#N in the corner of the palace. Further in 
tapestries align the walls in a soothing manner. You no longer feel 
apprehension of being lost. You begin to wonder what type of wealth can 
purchase and decorate a room with such soothing discipline. Samas is a 
man of power, deception, and care for his fellow clannies. However, you 
will begin to notice in your stay that there is no expectance of his 
return. A journeyman and nomad, Samas rarely is present in his own 
palace. To the contrary, he has filled this room with gold, herbs, and 
riches to express his wealth and share it with other #MD#wo#CP#N members. You 
now figure that after staying in such wealth for a few hours, it is time 
to leave. You take one last sniff of power and exterminate your 
existence. Wait... what was that? Who was watching you gazing the riches? 
You run out more quickly than you entered.

Exits.Description: #MA Phos  Hallway#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The knight statues, made of the purest gold, diamonds, and platinum, are 
created after darkest days of Elite. Built much like the guardians of 
the ancient Elite Clan, these enormous statues can scare even the second 
toughest warrior of Elite. The only fighter not tainted by their evil 
looks is the owner of this room, Samas. The great sculptor, Michelangelo 
is the artist of these two massive golden pieces. Their value is 
priceless and the shear wonder of how Samas could purchase one, let 
alone two, is an unknown myth.

Hailing from the most secluded mountains of Tibet, these ancient 
Buddhist monks are skilled in the art of muteness and chanting. They all 
have ridded of material needs which makes their presence in this room 
of wealth a wonder in itself. The average value of a monk on the slave 
market is nearly 50m, but as you well know, this is pocket change to the 
great and powerful

rooms.Name: #MWab#No's D#Cojo#N
rooms.Description:
When you walk in to the #CDojo#N you see Wabo in his #wwhite#N 
judogi. And you notice that he knows exactly what to do on the 
#gtatami#N. Wabo looks at you and tells you 'Hey come on join the 
fun!' and #ySmiles#N next to the #gtatami#N you see a table with 
a #bTV#N on it, and in front of the table you see a #rBIG#N fluffy 
#mBED#N and in the corner a Pool table. What a nice place to 
#CRELAX#N in.

Exits.Description: #MA Phos Hallway#N

rooms.Name: #rPuma#e'#rs#e #rA#ercane #rS#eanctuary#N
rooms.Description:
This magical room is filled with thin #egrey#N mist. The walls are 
covered in ancient #yglowing#N #Crunes#N, and there is a round #eblack#N 
table in the middle of the room, filled with different #Gscrolls#N and 
#Mpotions#N. Then you feel like you are being watched, when you turn 
around you see a little #bImp#N looking up at you. Then you realize that 
there are #rmages#N living here, when you sit down you feel a #Rwarm 
#Gfeeling#N flow though you, and you feel #Bsafe#N here

Exits.Description: #MA Phos Hallway#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This little Imp is like all other Imps, short, annoying and loyal to his 
Mage. He looks at you, examining you equipment.

These strange Runes glow with a #rred#N light, they are from an ancient 
order of mages. They seem to heal your wounds quicker.

rooms.Name: #CHigh #Ntower #Mroom#N
rooms.Description:
This is where the mighty dweomer master #CGlobal #Nspends his time
when he doesn't level or is helping other clan members. In his room he
has a lot of books witch contain magic formulas and the history of other
masters and the history of other clans. There is many other stuffs in his
tower room too, he has a small bed where he sleeps and at the wall there
is a large chest with his clothes. At the right side of the window there
is a big fire barrel witch he can use to see great distances. There is 4
statues in here, one of the Greatest Dweomer master Nevyn, the wise elf
Dallandra, Aderyn when he is in his owl shape ready to take off and Jill´s
most loved warrior Rhodry. And on the left side on the wall beside the
window there is a picture of the dragon Arzosah Sothy Lorezohaz.

Exits.Description: #MA Phos Hallway#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You look at a chest on the floor witch contains all the stuffs that 
Global has been collecting under all these years. In the chest you
see a many herbs and clothes, even some weapons is lying in the 
chest.

Here stands Nevyn a great dweomer master, he is holding his staff and 
he is wearing a large coat.

Here is one of the mighty elven dweomer master named Dallandra, she was
Aderyns husband before got contact with the Guardians witch took her to
their world where the time passed much slower then in the land that
Aderyn lives in. She is wearing a coat and backpack, and she is sitting
on a horse.

You want to #rscream#N when you see him in this mood, hes is ready for
a fight and he is already berzerking, with his laugh you just want to
flee far away from him.

Arzosah is a huge black dragon who lives far up in the mountains among
the volcanos, so she can keep warm all the long winter. The only one
that can control her is the one who has the #wsilverring#N. And the one
who has it now is Rhordry.

He is a kind of strange elf, because he looks like an owl. But he is just
as mighty as all the other Dweomer masters.

rooms.Name: #MAdara's abode#N
rooms.Description:
As you walk in this room you immediately smell the #mevocative#N
fragrance of the perfume Adara wears. The apparent source seems to be a
#rrose#N lying on the farthest wall. The wallpaper of the room is pink and
speckled with flowers. There is a marble statue of #MPhos#N in a corner
surrounded by perpetually burning candles. Adara's #Ycomfy bed#N is in the
center of the room with her clothes spread all over it. There is also a
portrait of Adara's true love, that #Cmagically#N changes when her heart
changes. A small #egrey#N kitten with #gbright eyes#N leaps toward you.

Exits.Description: #MA Phos Hallway#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is an elegant #egrey#N kitten with #gbright eyes#N and black
stripes down his sides with one long magnificent black stripe from the
tip of his tail to the top of his head. You can't help but to draw in a
breath and just take in this magnificent creature, its somehow #Cmagical#N.

As you gaze upon this rose, the redness of the petals enchants you and
draws you into it and fills you with its scent which causes you to smile
and feel loved.

rooms.Name: #MRoom of Gilian#N
rooms.Description:
This is not a big room, it looks like a trophy room or something like 
that. On the North wall you see a lot of heads hanging. Mostly orcs 
(from Moria), but there I also saw other evil creatures hanging there. 
You see a sign that says "Balrog". But the balrog doesn't seem to be 
there. On the East wall there is lots of equipment (also from Moria) 
hanging, nothing interesting. On the right side of the door you see 
three stuffed horses. When you look at the first one you see that it is 
a brown colored, fat horse (it looks very lazy). The second is also 
brown, but this one looks underfed, not very nice. When you take a 
closer look on the third horse you see a very muscular white colored 
horse. A very fine horse (it looks like a fake). On the West Side of 
the room you see a very large, blue and white colored bed. Beside it 
lies a #Mnote#N. On the bed you see a small note.
Above the bed is a big #Mpainting #wof four #Cbards#N.

Exits.Description: #MA Phos Hallway#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is my Hästens bed and it was very expensive so do not touch!

The four bards are Hansi Kursh, Andre Olbrich, Markus Siepen and Thomen 
Stauch. These four bards have wandered together in a very long time. 
They call themselves The Blind Guardians.

rooms.Name: #MLoomin's Throne Room#N
rooms.Description:
You have entered the room of Loomin, the mighty warrior. The first
thing that catches your eyes is a big map on the southern wall. It
shows what the world looked like a long time ago when the world was 
still new. You also see a different collection of all kinds of ancient 
weapons and armours. He has saved them during the ages, and when he some
day in the future retires, he will write a history book about armour and
weapons, and how they have developed through the ages.
#GLoomin's Large golden breast plate lies here
A staff of magic lies here
Loomin's Journal lies here
A #yGolden #GDagger lies here

Exits.Description: #MA Phos  Hallway#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
#MOn this armour, you see a banner from a clan long lost.
#CYou can still see the marks of #eswords#C on it.
This is a #MM#Ca#Mg#Ci#Mc#Ca#Ml #wstaff it can only be used by its original owner #ML#Coomi#Mn.

This ancient dagger is made out of pure gold. It was once made by the
hands of an elder priest, to be used in ceremonies. It still keeps
the memory of ancient rituals and sacrifises alive.

rooms.Name: #MThe #cSizzling #MChamber#N
rooms.Description:
As you step into the glowing chamber, your eyes immediately hurt from
a blazing #wsphere#N of white light just in the middle of the room. This
is the recharging room of the being known as #cBalefire#N. There are no
furniture or other objects in the room, for what chairs does a fiery
entity need? When the thing isn't roaming the lands, you can be sure it
is either recharging close to the giant sphere, or it has withdrawn into
it completely. Should it be in this room and regaining lost energy, be
sure to keep away from the uncontrolled bursts of fire which sometimes 
emerges from it's body, as they can kill even before they reach home.

Exits.Description: #MA Phos Hallway#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A ball of electricity, that  now and then strikes out bursts of pure
energy. If you feel your hairs are starting to stand straight out, you're
standing too close.

rooms.Name: #cOutside the #N#CT#ch#wrill #N#CK#ci#wll #N#CK#cu#wlt#N
rooms.Description:
You are standing outside a stone structure looking in, how sad. 
Do you think you have what it takes to get past the animated stone 
monk of the Kult?  If you belong here you have no fears otherwise.  
Well step forward and see.  Don't worry you can only die once.  On 
the other hand how slowly you die is completely up to us.  You note 
that most women are permitted to exit and enter, but one can only 
guess if it is at their leisure.

rooms.Name: #cEntrance Hallway#N
rooms.Description:
You are in the main hallway of the Kult.  Mounted on walls and
in cases all around you see prizes won in battle, like the broken
#Cspear#N of the Avatar and the shattered pitch #Cfork#N of Satan, 
won when the clan went hunting in Hell.  You also see the skins and 
skulls of many monsters slain in the hunt.  Tiamat is here stuffed 
like a teddy #Cbear#N, she doesn't look so tough now does she?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The hide of the Queen of the Dragons is here, stuffed.  Even in death 
you can tell she was a fearsome foe when she was alive.

The pitch fork of the former ruler of hell.  With the paladins dead 
we had to kill satan too, less he got out of control.

This is the spear of the Holy Avatar.  No longer holy now that he is 
dead. Call us sinners huh?  See what he got?

rooms.Name: #cHallway in the Fort#N
rooms.Description:
One word - amazing.  You have to keep your hands locked at your 
sides in fear that you might break something and have to pay for it.  
That Aftershock bottle looks mighty expensive.

rooms.Name: #cGoof off Room#N
rooms.Description:
What's that bud?  You don't feel like killing anything?  Well
maybe you are one of those punks that like to chat a lot.  Or maybe 
you are one of those slow levelers that bring down the clan average 
*slap*. Oh well if you haven't been kicked out on your rear by now 
you must have some good points, eh?  If you have nothing better to do 
come here and relax, goof, chill, talk yer butt off, play come 
#Cdarts#N.  No one really cares.  But don't expect any privacy here.  
And one more thing, KEEP YOUR SMELLY FEET OFF THE FURNITURE.  Hey 
this stuff costs ya know, and you pay for it right out of your dues.  
If you get bored, catch up on the clan bulletin board, which is 
tacked up on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Can you hit the bullseye?
Careful!  You can take someone's eye out with this thing.

rooms.Name: #cPrivacy Corner#N
rooms.Description:
Hmmm, you aren't smooth enough to have your own damn room?  But 
you want to talk in private, huh?  Well come in here and close the 
damn door, it is not like anyone cares what the hell you are talking 
about anyways.

rooms.Name: #cChambers of the Council#N
rooms.Description:
You enter a high-pillared regal chamber with ornately carved
marble statues of members past and present.  Long red drapes hang 
from arches around which the heads of various Klan kills are hung 
on display. In the center of this chamber is a small, round oak 
table where the councillors gather on a periodic basis to carry 
out their ruling.

Exits.Description:
When you try to look over the shoulder of the guard you see a room.
A very black room.

rooms.Name: #cLibrary#N
rooms.Description:
This is where the clan keeps all of their combat gear.  You
never know when the need to kill someone might arise.  All around you 
see various types of armor and weapons stacked on the #Cshelves#N.  
Some brand new and some old, you can tell from the dried blood 
splattered on some of the items.  If you have extra equipment for 
clan members leave it here.  Don't expect too much thanks it is 
expected of everyone to help out, you watch their backs and they will 
watch yours.  And please, no crap items.  Clan members deserve the 
finest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There are rows of shelves on the walls, please stack your gear
neatly.

rooms.Name: #cHall of Nails#N
rooms.Description:
As you peer through the door you see a room filled wall to wall 
with massive speakers thumping to a righteous groove.  Colored lights
pierce through the smoke like daggers allowing you to catch a glimpse 
of some fine young vixens dancing like sluts.  As you try to enter, a
talking piece of clay asks if you're in TKK.  An enormous bouncer in 
a purple suit looms behind him.  Unless you're in TKK you better get 
the hell out while you still can!  Only members are allowed to jam in 
the Hall of Nails.

rooms.Name: #cMacking Room#N
rooms.Description:
No personal room?  Have someone's pants you want to get into ready 
and waiting?  Think you are smooth enough to get some?  Come here and 
have some fun.  Try and think with your head, no not that one.  The 
other one, dummy.  When you bring a partner here to do whatever try 
not to get any stains on the #Cbed#N, and keep the noise down.  
Sheesh!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a lovely queen sized bed here with silk sheets and fluffy
down pillows.

rooms.Name: #cOrdo Dominus#N
rooms.Description:
You follow the dark stairs up into the west tower of the fort.  
This semi-circular chamber has a huge tapestry on the east wall 
depicting various heroes of the Klan's past in bloody scenes of 
violence.  There is a small discolored brain on the floor to the 
south. Three chambers surround this room.  From here, the chambers of 
the Ordo Dominus, the ruling council of the Kult.  You had better not 
tally here unless one of them is expecting you...

Exits.Description:
As you approach the discarded cerebral matter, you find yourself
disoriented.  You have reached...

rooms.Name: #cClan Shrine#N
rooms.Description:
This is a chapel to the clan gods.  Come here if you want to
pray to them.  Of course nothing much will happen of you do, they 
hate suck ups.  Hey they are more likey to strike you down than help 
you. Besides, Zumdahl is always off sweet talking Clara anyways.  I 
doubt they have time for mortals but leave a little something on the 
#Caltar#N anyways and maybe you'll get lucky.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A whirling vortex of blood pulsates and shimmers before you.

This is an altar devoted to #bZumdahl#N#W the god of smoothness and 
his lady #cClara#N#W the goddess of sex.#N

rooms.Name: #cThe Ancient Spectre Ruins#N
rooms.Description:
A grey mist surrounds the ancient spectre ruins of Harad.  Amid 
the ancient ruins of a once mighty castle rises a huge black throne.  
A black throne, carved with figures of ancient creatures and runes or 
power, towers in front of you with a powerful malice.  In this throne 
he rests after great deeds and weaves new diabolical plans.  Tombs of 
great kings and sorcerers long forgotten, raped by time and weather, 
rest here for eternity.  Scattered on the ground lies great 
treasures, items and weapons gathered from vast regions of the world 
and places that do not exist in the mind of the mortal anymore.

rooms.Name: #cDur's Garden of Dreams#N
rooms.Description:
The portal leaves no residue upon you as you step through into
this grove located somewhere within the Abyss.  This is HIS home 
where HE resides and allows none to view without his permission.  
Propped up against a corpse lies a writhing soul-rack, an evil device 
whose purpose you would rather not contemplate.  Etched into the 
bleeding rocks are the blasphemous symbols of the Ancient Ones whose 
power flows through this entire area.  Massive demonic forms stand 
around the grove, a sign of power to ward off the presence of the 
pure and vigilant.  You only hope the portal of blood to the south 
holds open long enough for you to flee back through...

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A whirling vortex of blood pulsates and shimmers before you.

rooms.Name: #cGouki's Twisted Realm#N
rooms.Description:
Impossibly, as you drift here in the utter darkness, you hear that 
you are being assaulted by flashes of unreal color.  The odor here 
feels strange, and you taste a bizarre sound emanating from all 
around.  As you strain to see exactly when you are, you can't imagine 
how anyone  can function in such a state.  You get the impression 
there is a strange apparatus floating just out of the corner of your 
smell.  It tastes like it was constructed so that a person could 
suspend himself from it upside down rather comfortably. You realize 
this must be is Gouki's perch. This is Gouki's Realm.

rooms.Name: #cAegeus' Crib#N
rooms.Description:
This is where Aegeus plans all of his greatest deeds and misdeeds.  
Quite frankly this room is a mess.  It looks like gear was just 
dropped where it was taken off.  There is a sign posted on the wall 
and you also see the only really neat thing in here, his computer 
desk.  There is a vast collection of ready to use weapons on the 
walls, books on how to kill people in a number of ways.  You know you 
will be in trouble if he comes and catches you here if you dont' have 
permission.  You notice a large box of #Ccondoms#N in plain view.  
You also see posters of Malcom X and Dr. Martin Luther King.  You 
can't make up your mind about this man, Aegeus.  Is he a saint or a 
devil?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A box of 100 condoms with half almost gone.  "Trojans ribbed for 
her pleasure - Cherry flavored."

rooms.Name: #cHalls of Terror#N
rooms.Description:
Your last footsteps echo around you for sometime as you finally
reach the bottom of the steps.  A black mist swirls around you 
obscuring your view of this dark place.  You have entered the lower 
levels where the Klan's secrets may be found, only members of 
exceptional merit are permitted to reside in this place...

rooms.Name: #cThe Hall of Silk Drapes#N
rooms.Description:
You enter a long elegant hall with a high-arched roof.  It's 
supported with huge creamy marbled pillars shot through with green 
veins. The whole place is decorated with flowing drapes of silk and 
other luxurious materials.  Only the pampered may grace these halls.

rooms.Name: #cThe Bridge of Spaceball One#N
rooms.Description:
You have stepped through a portal to the bridge of Spaceball One.
You are surrounded by idiots trying to capture Lone Starr and his pal,
Barf.  You don't give much for their chances however, since none of
these idiots know how to handle the ships weapon systems. To make
things even worse, #cMicroft #Njust jammed the radar - with
#mstrawberry#N jam! An instant later Lone Starr's ship enters
hyperspace and shoots off towards the stars.  There is a beaming
chamber to the north.  
#YColonel Sanders wanders around aimlessly,trying to look important.#N
#YDark Helmet orders 'Ludicrous speed now!'#N

rooms.Name: #cClub Momar#N
rooms.Description:
Chicks seem to dig this room.  The bar at the north end of the 
room always has two to three girls waiting for a young man (or woman) 
to pick them up and bring em down to the Mackin' Room. (After a few 
shots they look much cuter).  So why don't ya have a couple brewskies 
on the house and chill out a while.  The DJ is playing the same damn 
song over and over... wait... maybe not, it's just The Smiths.  Do me 
a favor and turn off those stupid disco lights on yer way in.  Oh 
yeah if ya gotta puke, stumble down the hall  and knock on Gouki's 
door he will probably be doin the same.

rooms.Name: #cSmiley's Stink Machine#N
rooms.Description:
Your nose practically leaps from your face and takes off as you 
stand just outside the door.  You think, "My god, what is that 
smell?!"  Now that you ventured inside, your fears materialize.  You 
can almost see the foul #yodor#N rising from the floor, which you can 
only assume is somewhere beneath your feet, hidden by the mountains 
of clutter.  There is some furniture, but what you couldn't begin to 
decipher.  You start to feel faint and your lungs #rexplode#N with 
#rfiery#N pain.  You look frantically for a way out of this room, 
longing for the #cfresh#N,#w sweet air#N. "You should have brought a 
gas mask," someone snickers from behind you.

rooms.Name: #cThe Terrorist's Hide Out#N
rooms.Description:
#WYou walk down the steps into a #Mdark #Wcellar filled with 
strange objects.  To the #Cleft #Wyou notice a list of #Cnames #Wof 
people who have been killed, all with #rchecks #Wnext to them.  To 
the #Cright #Wyou notice a wall full of #Cweapons#w.  All over the 
#Cfloor #ware papers with recipies for #Mdestruction#W.  The only way 
out is the way you came in. Don't be #mSPOTTED #wbecause you might be 
next on his list if he finds out.#N

rooms.Name: #cChe's Bathroom#N
rooms.Description:
As you fumble around in the darkness you accidently hit the 
lightswitch. The scene before you almost strikes you down. Used 
underwear and dirty paper covers the wall and floor. The bathtub is 
filled with a black stinking liquid that makes your nostrils burn. 
The sink is filled with dead bugs that float on a sea of yellowish 
water As you feel sick you cautiously approach the toilet. You slowly 
open the lid...

Che flies in from below.

He says "Hey, get the #RHell#N out of my room!!

Che suddenly circles around you and stabs you in the back.
§N

rooms.Name: #cThe #wTemple #cof #RDrakken#N
rooms.Description:
You leave the canopy of Yavin 4's #Gjungle #Ncanopy and enter a
gigantic ebony temple which once was dedicated to the #MDark lord of 
the sith#N, Exar Kun.  The temple is now under the control of Drakken 
and he uses it to send aid to the #CRebel Alliance#N from the 
EliteMUD #GGUERILLAs#N.  In a corner of the temple there is a crate 
full of #Rheavy blaster pistols#N.  On the walls are posters of 
Drakken's idols such as Eldridge Cleaver, Timothy Leary, and Abby 
Hoffman.
§N

rooms.Name: #cEdge of Forever#N
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the edge of forever, at the end of the
universe.  The land on which you stand was once a thriving sea-shore,
teeming with life on all levels.  As you stroll, you habitually 
adjust your eyesight, still searching for the last vestiges of any 
other life. You remember a time when all one had to do was glance in 
any direction, with any level of vision, to see myriad patterns of 
birth and rebirth. All that could be found now was fast decaying 
remains, as even the smallest organism collapsed back into its 
constituent atoms.  Perhaps it was only a matter of time until even 
the atoms themselves devolved into their own form of death, leaving 
nothing but the ultimate building blocks of the universe once more.
   Stretching your senses to the limit, you observe the death throes
of a star, hoping to see once more the energy of a nova, but seeing 
only the collapse of the complex inter-atomic forces.  Casting your 
eyes about you, you can see the same happening to your home; the 
planet which nurtured and supported your race through billions of 
years of evolution. It was as though the universe was tired of its 
own existence, and is finally opting for the darkness.

rooms.Name: #cDanzig's Domain#N
rooms.Description:
A chill runs down your spine as you hear the rumblings of White
Zombie's "Soul Crusher" as you enter the domain of the legendary 
warrior Danzig, he who has stalked the lands of Elite since the time 
of Apollo and the Shadowblade.  On the far wall you see the symbol of 
the great horned skull, Danzig's personal seal, as well as the mark 
of those who he now pledges his ever-faithful allegence, the 
#CT#ch#wrill #CK#ci#wll #CK#cu#wlt#N. There are weapons of death and 
destruction strewn about the room, as well as a great banquet table 
in the center filled with tankards of ale and spirits.  Danzig's 
concubines pay no attention to you as they scurry around you to 
prepare for their Master's return.  You had better hope that Danzig 
is expecting you...for your next breath may be your last....
§N

rooms.Name: #cDade's Abyss#N
rooms.Description:
A strange bluish mist seeps along the floor covering your
feet entirely. All around the room scamper strange mobs, each
disfigured in some odd way, a Warg walks around blindly uttering 
strange words, not attacking, a minor demon flies by petting a 
rabbit. On the far right wall, you see an odd picture that seems to 
be morphing itself.. at one time it looks like Dade, at other times 
it looks like Krygian. Two beedy #Rred#N eyes stare at you from 
within a strange, glowing gate on the back wall.. a portal of some 
sort you guess. You walk a bit closer to examine those eyes.. only to 
uncover a dark, cloaked wizard grin with his hellstaff pointed 
straight at you, and the message "#CF#cE#wAR #CT#cK#wK#N" in your 
mind!
§N

rooms.Name: #cBeatdown Palace#N
rooms.Description:
As you enter this place of hate, you feel as if something is 
watching you.  You glance at the wall and see a #Cpicture#N.  The 
eyes seem #rred#N and move along with you.  On the floor, a 
#Mmedallion#N symbolizing a man being chopped in half.  You better 
hope you have some juice left in your can of whupass or else you'll 
end up like the skeleton over there.
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see what you believe to be a skeleton of a human, its eyes seemed 
to have been gouged out and it's massively decapitated.

On the wall hangs a picture of a massive being with blood dripping 
from its eyes, and sweat hanging from its chin.
A man has felt the wraith of a chainsaw in full motion.

rooms.Name: #cThe Last Chamber#N
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the middle of a small room without any windows. 
This is where the Council of the Kult come up with new plots against 
the other clans of Elite. Since the guard let you enter here, you must 
be one of them. Remember that the secrets that you discover here NEVER 
shall leave this chamber.

rooms.Name: #cThe Cave Of Kyre Banorg#N
rooms.Description:
You find yourself at the mouth of the Cave Of Kyre Banorg. 
Wherein, carved in mystic runes upon the very living rock, the last 
words of Ulfin Bedweer of Regett proclaim the last resting place of 
the most Holy Grail. The bones of four and fifty men lie strewn about 
a small #rrabbit#N. Yet as you approach the voice of TimTheEnchanter 
whispers "Look, that rabbit's got a viscious streak a mile wide, it's 
a killer. He's got huge, sharp-- he can leap about-- look at the 
bones".
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Well, that's no ordinary rabbit. That's the most foul, cruel, and
bad-tempered rodent you ever set eyes on.

It reads, 'Here may be found the last words of Joseph of Aramathea. 
He who is valiant and pure of spirit may find the Holy Grail in the 
Castle of uuggggggh'.

rooms.Name: #cInside the Cave#N
rooms.Description:
As you push into the opened mouth of the cave thoughts dart 
through your mind, and you find it hard to remember why you came here 
in the first place.  Fewer corpses litter the floor, perhaps the 
danger has passed, or perhaps fewer people made it this far into the 
depths.  Your senses prickle and you are snapped back into reality... 
was that a voice you heard around the corner?
§N

rooms.Name: #cAround the Sharp Corner#N
rooms.Description:
Rounding the corner, you come face to face with a living 
nightmare. Hacked and maimed bodies have been tossed around the room 
like children's toys.  Although most of the corpses have been long 
dead, a single body still twitches in it's death throughs.  Who are 
whatever caused this carnage can not be far from here.  Tearing your 
vision away from the carnage you see that the cave punges deeper into 
the earth.
§N

rooms.Name: #cDeep Within the Cave#N
rooms.Description:
Leaving the carnage of the death scene behind you, you stride 
boldly on.  The stone walls of this terrible place seem close in and 
trap all that would venture into its depths.  Shadows play on the 
irregular surface of the cave and you realize that your enemy could 
be lurking in ambush anywhere.  Legs are heavy with fear and palms 
sweat making the grasp on your weapon difficult to maintain.  Maybe 
talking things over isn't such a bad idea after all.
§N

rooms.Name: #cThe Darkest of Dungeons#N
rooms.Description:
You enter the dungeon in search of #BDarklord#N. Rumor has it he
has claimed the life of yet another young soul. You look under his
bed, but find only torn magazines and food wrappers. Wondering where
he could possibly be, you check in the closet. It is full of jackets
from his favorite band, the #CT#ch#wrill #CK#ci#wll #CK#cu#wlt#N. You
wonder if such an awesome jacket will fit on yourself. You take down
the jacket from a rusty coat-hanger and start to try it on. Before
you can even get 1 sleeve in, you feel the rusty hanger enter your
body, rupturing your spleen and slicing your intestines. It looks
like that coat wasn't your style after all.

rooms.Name: #cRush's Perch#N
rooms.Description:
You enter the spacious room which is well decorated. A large oak
desk is in the middle of the room, with an oak chair. On the desk there
is some literature, together with a bunch of lilies. The lilies
provide aromatic smell which graces the room. At the end of the room
is a comfortable looking bed, with a soft pillow and silk sheets. There
is a violin at the corner of the room, it is carved with some nice
pattern. On the wall there is a shelf, her favourite clothes are lined
here. The music box stands on the shelf, playing some sweet music.

rooms.Name: #cZOiD's Den#N
rooms.Description:
You step in to a spareingly lit room.  As you look around you notices 
heaps of old computer parts lying around among some other crap.  In the 
Corner is a small computer cabinet and a huge stereo pumpin out sound at 
an alarming decibel.  On the floor you notice some strange clotheing, 
apair of PVC pants ,a leather trench coat, a few spiked collars and some 
handcuffs.  You also notice a pair of G strings haning over a chair with 
the name Cissi scratched down on the washing label.

rooms.Name: #cThe Ancient Tomb of Acrisius#N
rooms.Description:
This small piece of Enoch has survived over the years through
someones care and protection.  As you look about the room a strange
feeling of safety permeates you, and relaxes you, making you feel 
totally at home.  The walls are made of sandstone and have strange 
script written on them in some forgotten language.  Off to one side 
of the room there is a black marble coffin which seems to exude a 
strange aura of death.  The ceiling is a mural depicting a fight 
between a man of great bueaty and some horrid beast whose flesh seems 
to drip off of him.  In the center of there room there is a small 
table with some items lying on it.

rooms.Name: #CH#ce#wllfires #gPit of #rBlood #b (and the occasional nap)#N
rooms.Description:
Upon entering this room, you are amazed to find that despite its name 
there is not one single drop of #rblood#N anywhere in sight. In the 
center of the room against the back wall you see a towering canopy bed 
with beautiful #wwhite #Nsilk curtains encompassing it. Atop the bed are 
dozens of satin pillows embroidered with themes from around the globe. 
Upon closer examination, you realize that each tells a similar story. 
One of a great conqueror who has left his mark upon all fronts. The 
images of #rdeath #Nand #gdestruction #Nchill you to the bone. Stepping 
back from the bed, you look around the rest of the room. On the right 
wall stands a tall oak dresser with a mirror framed in brass and etched 
with the most eye-bending pattern you have ever seen. On top of the 
dresser you find not jewelry and combs, but an assortment of the most 
finely crafted daggers. Upon picking one up with a fine detail of 
serpents clutching the handle and rubies inlaid for their eyes, you hear 
a strange sound behind you. Quickly you turn to find that there is 
nothing there. Shaking now, you place the dagger back on the dresser 
and turn towards the window across the room. Looking out on the fields 
to the north of Midgaard, you breathe a sigh of relief and finally 
begin to relax. Suddenly and without warning, a figure springs forth 
from the shadows and places an enchanted mithiril dagger a mere 
millimeter from your lower spine. Before you can scream, he places his 
hand over your mouth and whispers in your ear, "Fool. Always watch 
your back." Smiling, he sheathes the dagger in a silent fluid motion 
and beckons you near. Knowing you are friend has kept you alive this 
day.

rooms.Name: #CThe Bohemian #CB#ca#wchelor's#C place of escape#N
rooms.Description:
Negligence, bohemia, immatureness, you name it. The sucker living
in this once beautiful room's a real lazy slackbum. There're paintings
on the walls, expensive ones too but in each there's a dart or two. 
On the floor lie comfortable although rather dirty clothes (who the 
fuck's gonna wash em anyway). A cosy divan is located in front of the
fireplace, or well you can guess there's a divan underneath all the...
hum... stuff. On one of the walls a "wise" saying is nailed.

        Tomorrow you will have no idea what you did today,
        so why worry about what the fuck you do?

Oh my god, he must've written that himself don't you think? The smirk
on your face keeps growing when you realize that under the divan the
owner's located. You wonder how the hell you could miss that snoring.
#cBaltazar#N for sure don't look very good after yesterday's party.
Because you know, #cBalt#N don't really have the physique that it
takes to party with the #CK#cu#wlt#N.

rooms.Name: #cStarlet's #gJ#Gu#gn#Gg#gl#Ge #cDomain#N
rooms.Description:
You wonder if you still are inside the clanhouse or if you
in some magical way have been transported into a weird jungle.
#GVines#N climb all over the walls, reaching for the cracked ceiling
where you can see the #ystars#N shine through. Pillows are scattered
all over the floor, adding a comfortable touch. You can see the tip
of a #wtail#N sticking out from a specially huge pillow-pile.

Exits.Description: The Goof-off room is down.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Though you could have sworn it was in the middle of the 
day when you entered this room, you can see the #enight 
sky#N through the broken ceiling. You stare at the 
stars for a while and suddenly one blinks at you. 

Go on, make a wish!

It's just like a piece of Miqi'erke has moved into the 
room! Starlet can not live with her kind in the jungle, 
so the jungle has to live with her. A sacrifice the 
#Gnature#N is willing to make, for its more than amazing 
daughter.

It reminds you of someone... You start to remove pillow 
after pillow and when you have removed a few you can see 
that there is a wicked little #cfeline#N lying under 
them. You must have waken her up cause she blinks a few 
times and then opens her big #ggreen#N eyes and stares 
back at you. You can only pray to the gods that she is 
in a good mood.
It's #edark#N and filled with #ystars#N. Beautiful.

She is bizarre, but still interesting. A combination 
of a woman and a cat. #wWhite fur#N covers her slender 
body and the only colourful spot is her eyes, which are 
#gemerald green#N. Starlet looks a lot like the ancient 
mother of all Rit'i, Yuraq.

rooms.Name: A Dark Alleyway (PKOK ZONE)
rooms.Description:
The walls of the alleyway have been spray painted over many times over the
years. One section of graffiti actually looks legible.  It says, "This
section has been designed as a player killer area.  Within this area, there
are few rules #g(See HELP PK  for a listing of them)#N, so if you don't like
that, then please turn back!  There is another section of graffiti saying, 
Raff Rules! There is a boulevard to the east and Wall Road  to the west.
§N

rooms.Name: Beginning of White Dragon Boulevard
rooms.Description:
This section of town has been overrun by the Troll gang. Even the police
stay out of here for fear of being brutalized. This was once a nice lower-
middleclass neighborhood, but know the gangs run the streets. All the shops and
homes have been boarded up and abandoned. An alleyway is to the west and the
street continues east. An over- grown lot is to the south.

rooms.Name: Along White Dragon Boulevard
rooms.Description:
Everywhere you look you see signs of recent violence. Patches of blood lie
everywhere and broken sticks and abandoned knifes are strewn here and there. An
over-grown lot is to the south. White Dragon Boulevard leads east and west.

rooms.Name: White Dragon Boulevard at Armory
rooms.Description:
Only gang members dare wander the streets here. What used to be the armory
lies to the south. White Dragon Boulevard leads east and west.

rooms.Name: White Dragon Blvd.
rooms.Description:
Black Dragon Avenue used to run south from here but the way has been blocked
by the toppling of a building into the street. White Dragon boulevard continues
east and west.

rooms.Name: Corner of Ice and White Dragon
rooms.Description:
Ice Dragon Way leads south from here. It used to run the whole length of the
neighborhood and way lined with beautiful crystal sculptures. White Dragon
boulevard leads east and west from here.

rooms.Name: White Dragon Boulevard
rooms.Description:
A once majestic inn with a white marble facade lies to the south.
Unfortunately, it has fallen into disrepair and decay. You can continue east or
west.

rooms.Name: Corner of Bronze and White Dragon
rooms.Description:
This is the north-east corner of the neighborhood. White Dragon boulevard
heads west and Bronze Dragon street heads south.

rooms.Name: An over-grown lot
rooms.Description:
A huge building was going to be built here, but they gave the project up
when violence took over the town. Now it is just a weed-strewn plot of land.
The lot continues east and there is a road north.

rooms.Name: East end of an over-grown plot of land
rooms.Description:
This was planned to be a park, but the developer was scared out of town by
the gang. Now it is just a dusty square of land. The park was started to the
south. The lot continues west and there is a street to the north.

rooms.Name: Armory
rooms.Description:
Well actually, this is what USED to be the armory. The equipment has all
been stolen or broken beyond repair. The back wall of the building has been
bashed down, allowing you to go south. White Dragon Boulevard is north.

rooms.Name: A Bend in the Way
rooms.Description:
Ice Dragon Way bends east and south from here. You notice a lot of blood
dried into the dirt here.

rooms.Name: Ice Dragon Bend
rooms.Description:
Ice Dragon Way bends to the north and west here. There are footprints here.
They seem to indicate a large struggle took place here recently. What used to
be the town Magic shop is to the east.

rooms.Name: The remains of the magic shop
rooms.Description:
The wizard was tough but he couldn't take on 50 of them at once. So he died
and they took all his stuff and used it on their fellowmen. The front door
leads west back out to the street. There is a back door leading to another
street to the east.

rooms.Name: Bronze Dragon Street at wizard's back door
rooms.Description:
Bronze Dragon street goes north and south. The back door to what remains of
the magic shop is west.

rooms.Name: Dracolich Plaza
rooms.Description:
They began construction of a pleasant plaza here. You wouldn't have known it
though if I hadn't told you. It has been renamed in honor of the Dragon gang's
idol, the Dracolich. It has become sort of a training ground. There is a short
cut to the east and an overgrown lot of land to the north.

rooms.Name: Shortcut
rooms.Description:
This is a shortcut between Dracolich Plaza and the center of town. Dracolich
Plaza is to the west and the shortcut continues south.

rooms.Name: Ice Dragon Way
rooms.Description:
Several smashed crystal statues line the Way here. You begin to wonder who
smashed them, and with what. The Way bends out of sight to the north and
continues south. To the east is a courtyard.

rooms.Name: Courtyard North
rooms.Description:
Once it was the courtyard of a beautiful building complex. But alas, someone
forgot to water the plants and they all died. Then again, you wonder how many
people have died here too. The courtyard extends to the south and there is a
road to the west.

rooms.Name: Bronze Dragon Street
rooms.Description:
There used to be a gate out to the east here which led to distant lands. The
gate has rusted permanently shut. The street goes north and south.

rooms.Name: Shortcut
rooms.Description: The shortcut extends north. There is a street to the east.

rooms.Name: Ice Dragon Way
rooms.Description:
The Way continues north and intersects with Yellow Dragon Avenue to the
south. For some reason, you somehow realize that there is a shortcut to the
west that leads to Dracolich Plaza.

rooms.Name: Courtyard South
rooms.Description:
Once full of lush green plants, it is now barren of growth. A set of stairs
used to extend up to a suite of rooms but the set is missing stairs 3-15. The
courtyard extends north and there is a street to the south.

rooms.Name: Old Abandoned Warehouse
rooms.Description:
Once the center of a lucrative storage business, it has fallen to disrepair
like everything else. It is now the hideout of the Dragon gang. The gang leader
runs his reign of terror from here. There is a wooden door barely on the hinges
to the east.

rooms.Name: Bronze Dragon Street at Warehouse
rooms.Description:
The street runs north and south. There is an old wooden door leading to a
warehouse to the west. The warehouse LOOKS abandoned. . .

rooms.Name: Yellow Dragon Road
rooms.Description:
Yellow Dragon Road is the southern boundary of Troll Territory. The road
extends east. You enter "no-man's land" to the south.

rooms.Name: Yellow Dragon Road
rooms.Description: The road runs east and west. Ice Dragon Way leads north from here.

rooms.Name: Yellow Dragon Road
rooms.Description:
The roads continues east and west. There is a courtyard to the north. You
enter "no man's land" to the south.

rooms.Name: Yellow Dragon Road
rooms.Description:
There is a barred window to the north. There appears to be a light coming
from the cracks around it. The road extends east and west from here. Or you can
enter "no man's land" south from here.

rooms.Name: Yellow Dragon Road
rooms.Description:
Bronze Dragon Street intersects here and runs north. Yellow Dragon ends here
but continues to the west.

rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south and east; or
there is a street to the north.

rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south east and west.

rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south, east and
west; or there is a street to the north.

rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south, east, and
west; or there is a street to the north.

rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south and west.

rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues north and east; or
there is a street to the south.

rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues north, east and
west.

rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues north, east, and
west; or there is a street to the south.

rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues north, east, and
west.

rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south and west; or
there is a street to the south.

rooms.Name: Bend in Hector Street
rooms.Description:
Hector street bends to the east and the south here. "No Man's Land" entrance
is to the north.

rooms.Name: Hector Street at Bakery
rooms.Description:
Hector street runs east and west. The Bakery used to be to the south but the
entrance is sealed off. Probably just a bunch of stale pies in there anyway.

rooms.Name: Another corner of Hector and Achilles streets
rooms.Description:
Achilles street heads to the south and Hector runs east and west. There is
an entrance to "No Man's Land" to the north. On the southwest corner of this
intersection, it looks like a building was recently burned down.

rooms.Name: Hector Street at Jeweler
rooms.Description:
Once a bright spot in the town, it now looks like one of the hardest hit by
the violence. The building could collapse at any moment. The street continues
east and west.

rooms.Name: Corner of Ajax and Hector
rooms.Description:
There is a grand fountain to the east but the water doesn't look good to
drink. Ajax street heads south and Hector goes back west. "No Man's Land" is to
the north.

rooms.Name: Hector Street
rooms.Description:
The street is full of garbage here. An odd building lies to the west, but
you don't seem to be able to find a way into it. The street runs north and
south here.

rooms.Name: Achilles Avenue
rooms.Description:
The town bards sang of the victory parades that used to pass along this
route. It was once a major way through the center of town. The street goes
south to a bend and north to an intersection.

rooms.Name: A small ruined chapel
rooms.Description:
This was a small temple built to honor the minor gods and goddesses. It is
now desecrated by graffiti and vandalism. Perhaps its worst defilement is that
it is the hangout of the Ogre gang. There is a street to the east through a
rusty metal door.

rooms.Name: Ajax Avenue at chapel
rooms.Description:
The temple to honor the minor gods is through a rusty metal door to the
west. The street continues north and south. You hear the muffled sounds of
screams coming from the chapel.

rooms.Name: First intersection of Hector and Achilles
rooms.Description:
There is a large statue here depicting a battle between two great warriors.
You think it's odd that it has not been defiled, but then you sense a aura
protecting it. Achilles runs east and south, while Hector heads out to the
north.

rooms.Name: Hector street
rooms.Description:
A large open space, possibly a cemetery, lies to the south. There is a large
wrought-iron fence with spikes on top which prevents you from entering the
area. The street continues east and west.

rooms.Name: A bend in the road
rooms.Description:
Achilles Avenue bends to the north and west here. There is also a narrow
alley to the south.

rooms.Name: What is left of the weapon shop
rooms.Description:
It doesn't even look like those punks gave the weapon smith a proper burial.
But what a going away present he seems to have received! Blood is splattered
and dried all over the walls here. It looks like a great deal of carnage
happened here. The way out to the east leads out onto a street.

rooms.Name: Ajax street at Weapon shop (or what's left of it)
rooms.Description:
The street goes north and south. The stables used to be to the east, but I
bet all the horses are dead or gone.

rooms.Name: Khan Park
rooms.Description:
Not really a "park" as you and I would think of it but it seems queerly
peaceful here in comparison to the rest of the area. There seems to be some
kind of memorial to the great Mongol warrior Khan being crudely constructed
here. There is a street to the east and another to the south.

rooms.Name: Achilles avenue at entrance to park
rooms.Description:
A ... park?! lies to the west. The street runs south to an intersection and
curves to the north.

rooms.Name: A bend in Ajax
rooms.Description:
The roads bends south and east here. You barely notice a small alley leading
north. Some kind of tunnel entrance is to the west but it has been crushed
under its own weight.

rooms.Name: Ajax street
rooms.Description:
A once prideful guild house was on the northeast corner of this intersection.
Most of the walls and ceiling have long since been demolished. An inn/pub is to
the south. The street bends to the east or west.

rooms.Name: Curve in the road
rooms.Description:
The street goes north or west from here. A narrow street once headed
southeast from here.

rooms.Name: A wide alleyway
rooms.Description:
The sides of the alleyway have been vandalized many times. One patch of
graffiti actually looks readable: This section has been designed for levels 5
through 10 If you are above level 10 please don't expect much. If you are below
level 5 enter at your own risk. In another spot it says "now entering Ogre
territory..." A street lies to the west and a major road to the east.

rooms.Name: Alexander Road
rooms.Description:
You see many gang members walking around looking for fights to pick and
things to break. It seems as if all of the other citizens have been run out of
town. All the former homes are boarded up and uninhabitable. The road continues
east and west.

rooms.Name: Alexander Street at park entrance
rooms.Description:
A park-looking area lies to the north and a passage between two buildings
leads to another street to the south.

rooms.Name: Achilles Avenue
rooms.Description:
The Avenue Runs north and south. You sense you are deep within Ogre gang
territory, and a chill goes up your spine.

rooms.Name: Ajax Street
rooms.Description:
You can see a sinister black wrought-iron fence to the west. You wonder if
it's keeping you out, or the ghouls in?

rooms.Name: The inn/pub
rooms.Description:
The inn actually looks fairly functional despite its lack of repair. The
boys come here to hoot it up and drink them selves into oblivion sometimes. It
looks as if the beer is still on tap!!! A hallway leads south and you spy a
street through the doorway to the north.

rooms.Name: Solomon Street
rooms.Description:
This street forms the southern boundary of Ogre territory. The street
extends far to the east. There is also a pathway between buildings which leads
to another street to the north.

rooms.Name: Intersection of Achilles and Solomon
rooms.Description:
Solomon street is to the east and west. The other part of the T is Achilles
Avenue, starting here and winding to the north.

rooms.Name: Solomon Street
rooms.Description:
A wrought-iron fence blocks off what used to be an entrance to the cemetery
here to the north. The evil just seems too strong to consider entering. You
feel you should stick with the "lesser" evils along the road to the east and
west.

rooms.Name: Intersection of Ajax and Solomon
rooms.Description:
The two roads meet at a corner here. Ajax runs north and Solomon heads west.
An inn/pub is through a back doorway to the east.

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
The hallway heads back north to the main part of the inn/pub. The stairs
leading up to the guest rooms here do not seem advisable to climb. A doorway
empties out into Solomon street to the west.

rooms.Name: Wall Road
rooms.Description:
The road extends south along the inside of the wall surrounding the city.
You spy the start of a bridge to the east.  Their seems to be a trail of 
blood leading south, probably from some poor adventurer straying into the
deadly part of town.
§N

rooms.Name: Wall Road
rooms.Description:
Wall road extends north along the inside of the city wall.  A dark alley
lies to the east.  A trail of blood extends from the north and pools nearby.
Written on a wall is the following inscription: #r
TO THE EAST LIES THE DUELING GROUNDS OF ADVENTURERS #g(PK ZONE)#r
THIS IS A PLACE ADVENTURERS DIE BY THE HANDS OF OTHER ADVENTURERS.
NOW IS A GOOD TIME TO GO BACK. #g(Head North to leave)#y

If you are unfamiliar with the PK rules on Elite, please type:
>HELP PK
If you have questions about the rules, please contact an Imm (see Immlist)
If you have any doubts on this, please go north and back to Midgaard now.
§N

rooms.Name: The Plains
rooms.Description:
You are on the plains, to the north you notice a small path into the hills.
And to the east the plains continue. A sign is on a pole here.

Exits.Description: The plains continue here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign points North, East and south.
To the south it reads "City of Midgaard"
To the North it reads "Moria Mountains"
To the east it reads "Gnome Village"
                    "Dwarf Village"
                    "Elven Forest of Namir"

rooms.Name: The Lane
rooms.Description:
You are strolling along a pleasant, shady lane. The road is lined on both
sides by tall, stately trees which lend the scene with a sense of quiet
serenity. You can follow the road north or south.

rooms.Name: The Turning Point
rooms.Description:
The trees stand close here, and the tall, bushy undergrowth prevents you
from seeing far in any direction save north, where a broad lane leads off into
the distance; and west, where the same lane continues towards what looks like a
fairly large city. The muted sounds of city commotion reach your ears from a
distance; stray dogs barking, children crying, and street salesmen shouting.
A large sign stands on the right side of the road.

Exits.Description: You see a path and a large castle in the distance.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign points to the North, East and to the West.

To the west it reads "City of Midgaard"
To the east it reads "King Welmars Castle"
To the north is reads "Moria Mountains"
                      "Dwarf village"
                      "Gnome village"
                      "Elven Forest of Namir"

rooms.Name: City Entrance
rooms.Description:
You stand on the outskirts of a large city - Midgaard; the capital of this
land. The road leads east into the peace and quiet - and dangers - of the
forest; and to the west it becomes the main street of the town; surrounded by a
confusion of shops, bars, and market places.  A large iron gate stands to 
the south.  You can hear strange sounds coming from the other side.

rooms.Name: The Bridge
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a small, rickety bridge over a small mountain river.
To the south lies the forest Miden'nir. The way north seems to be blocked
by lots of fallen rocks.

Exits.Description: If you go south, you will enter the Miden'Nir.

rooms.Name: The Trail to Miden'Nir
rooms.Description:
You are in a light forest. A path leads south, but the passage to the east
is easy enough. To the west, smoke can be seen rising above the treetops. The
sound of a river can be heard north of here.

Exits.Description: To the north, you see a small bridge.
More light forest.
This path cuts through the darkness of the Miden'Nir.

rooms.Name: The Miden'Nir
rooms.Description:
You are in a dark forest. To the east, mountains block passage. From here,
only the lighter forest to the west or south offer a way to travel.

Exits.Description: The forest is darker to the south.
The forest gets lighter as you go west.

rooms.Name: The Miden'Nir
rooms.Description:
The forest is deep here and the wind blows through the trees and through
your hair. To the north, the forest gets lighter. However, the southern and
eastern paths place you even deeper in the wood.

Exits.Description: The forest is lighter in this direction.
More and darker woods.
There is a small path leading west.

rooms.Name: On a Small Path
rooms.Description:
A path is here, leading east and south. Mountains slash the scenery to the
west of here.

Exits.Description: Wind-swept forest.
To the south, the trail continues.

rooms.Name: The Miden'Nir
rooms.Description:
More trees... You can go north, south or travel toward the Moria mountains 
that lie east of here.

Exits.Description: The trees lighten up a bit this way.
Huge gray mountains lie in this direction.
The forest continues.

rooms.Name: The Crossroads
rooms.Description:
Here foot worn paths lead north, south and east. The trees seem to be closing
in on you at this point.

Exits.Description: Trees as far as the eye can see.
There is an especially dark part of the forest this way.
There is an especially dark section of forest this way.

rooms.Name: The Trail
rooms.Description:
You are on a north-south trail. To the west, impassable mountains glare at
you.

Exits.Description: The trail bends to the north.
To the south, the path re-enters the forest.

rooms.Name: At the Foot of the Moria Mountains
rooms.Description:
You can go west or south and re-enter the forest. The Moria mountains 
prevent passage in any other direction.

Exits.Description: A light section of forest.
The forest continues here.

rooms.Name: The Miden'Nir
rooms.Description:
The forest is light here and gets lighter to the north. To the west
everything gets dark. The wind kicks up as you ponder your options.

Exits.Description: There is a small clearing to the north.
It gets darker and thicker this way.

rooms.Name: Deep Forest
rooms.Description:
It is quite dark here, forest surrounds you. Footsteps can be heard, but
their direction can not be determined. A path lead to the turning point to the
south.

Exits.Description: More forest.
Lighter forest and mountains in the distance.
The forest continues.

rooms.Name: Light Forest
rooms.Description:
The forest is light here and you can easily pick your way through the trail.
To the east, the forest becomes deep again. South, the trail continues.

Exits.Description: A trail leading north-south.
The trees get thicker as you go east.
More trees and some small hills.

rooms.Name: The Sink
rooms.Description:
The ground is quite muddy here and puddles are all around. Your boots make a
disgusting SQUISH as you walk here. You can go in any of the four cardinal
directions from here. Hopefully, it will be dryer. The path to the turning
point can be seen to the east.

Exits.Description: The Miden'Nir continues.
The trees get VERY thick to the south. You can barely see...
Some light trees and daylight.

rooms.Name: Near the Moria Mountains
rooms.Description:
The most prominent feature here is the Moria mountains that lie to the east.
To the south a small path leads back to the turning point, to the north you can 
enter a forest and to the west lies a sink.

Exits.Description: Many trees to the north.
There is a bit of a slope downward to the west.

rooms.Name: The Fading Trail
rooms.Description:
The trail becomes nearly impassable here. You can go south and west, as the
forest is relatively light. To the north, you can see a path.

Exits.Description: You can see a trail this way.
Dark forests.
Light trees and mountains in the distance.

rooms.Name: The Dark Path
rooms.Description:
You are hemmed in by trees on either side of you. There is no way to go east
or west. The wind, which howled earlier, seems to have died in this natural
tunnel.

Exits.Description: Ahhh... daylight.
More darkness.

rooms.Name: On the Verge of Darkness
rooms.Description:
The forest is getting pretty thick here. To the south, the forest is too
dense to venture into. The eastern path seems the only way to go from here.

Exits.Description: Light and a visible trail.

rooms.Name: Carnage
rooms.Description:
Here, you see a gruesome sight. Blood is everywhere... on the trees and
soaked into the ground. Two carcasses lie in front of you, seeming to look up
at you. The forest is impassable to the south, but the path continues north and
west. There is a small dark track to the east.

Exits.Description: Darkness...
More dark forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The corpses looked as if they have been pierced by a large, jagged
spear.  The damage these people sustained is simply amazing.  Worse, the
lips on the bodies are a light shade of blue, hinting at poison in
their systems.

rooms.Name: Stench
rooms.Description:
There is a sickening stench here. It smells of blood and death. To the
north, you catch glimpses of daylight. To the east, you simply cannot see. The
trees are close and stifling.

Exits.Description: Daylight and a trail to follow.
Darkness.. the smell seems to come from here.

rooms.Name: Small Path
rooms.Description:
You walk on a small path that makes its way towards a small forest just at 
the base of the moria mountains.

rooms.Name: Small Path
rooms.Description:
You walk on a small path that makes its way towards a small forest just at 
the base of the moria mountains.

rooms.Name: End of the Clay Road
rooms.Description:
The mighty clay road turns into lesser, but still well traveled
roads here. You feel a surge run through your body as you look east
into the lands that turned Rome into its mighty empire.

Exits.Description:
The Northern Road, linking Rome with Midgaard and other cities,
beckons.
The mighty clay road leads off in this direction.

rooms.Name: Clay Road
rooms.Description:
You travel upon an East-West road wide enough for 30 men to march
abreast. The road is heavy with traffic, both foot and wagons, yet
it is hard and smooth and well drained.

Exits.Description: The broad clay road stretches eastward to unknown regions.
In the far distance you can see the twin spires of Rome's East Gate.

rooms.Name: Clay Road
rooms.Description:
In the distance, to the west, you eyes catch the splendors of a
mighty city.  The road is congested with nobles and their huge
retinues of servants traveling from country estates into the city for
commerce, and with traders bringing treasures and goods for trade from
exotic locations.

Exits.Description: The clay road continues its straight path east as far as you can see.
The road ahead is lined with coffins and sarcophagi.

rooms.Name: Clay Road
rooms.Description:
On both sides of the road lie gravesites.  Large statues adorn
the final resting places of famous and not so famous Romans who have
passed over the river Styx.  To the northwest you can see a funeral
procession with at least a dozen professional mourners.  If someone
important has just died there will be lavish banquets and
entertainments tomorrow, so hurry into the city!

Exits.Description: A wide, straight road goes east as far as you can see.
Far west you can see the spires of Rome's East Gate.

rooms.Name: Clay Road East of Rome
rooms.Description:
Burial within the limited confines of the city of Rome is not
permitted, so the Romans have interred their dead in above-the-ground
coffins called sarcophagi.  The sarcophagi are decorated with
elaborately carved scenes from the person's life.

Exits.Description: A wide, hard packed clay road heads for the hills!
A wide, hard packed clay road heads for the city.

rooms.Name: The Field of Mars
rooms.Description:
On the northern side of the road stretches what is known as the
Field of Mars, a training ground for the mighty Roman soldier.  The
army is open to Roman citizens (males who own land) and is an
opportunity for a man to bring glory and a regular salary home to his
family.  Being soft is frowned upon even for non-combatants, and so
this area is often used by non-soldiers to develop strong muscles and
hard bodies.

Exits.Description: A narrow path through a lovely meadow starts here and heads north.
A broad clay road heads for parts unknown.

You see in the near distance, two tall spires that might be part of
the
gate to Rome.

rooms.Name: Before Rome
rooms.Description:
You travel upon an East-West road wide enough for 30 men to march
abreast. When a victorious general returns to Rome to (modestly)
receive honors due him, his army marches ahead of him down this grand
road.  You can see that it is packed hard through heavy use. To the
west stand the Gates of Rome inviting you to enter and partake of all
the glory and splendor that is Rome.

Exits.Description:
A wide clay road lined with sarcophagi of all varieties heads away
from
Rome.
The Gates of Rome!

rooms.Name: The East Gate of Rome
rooms.Description:
You are standing inside of the eastern gate of Rome. There are two
tall spires built into the city wall, from which the guards can see
the whole eastern side of the city. To the east, there is a heavily
used packed clay road that leads out of Rome. Another road leads
westward into the city.  A third, small narrow walkway leads south.

Exits.Description: A broad and well-traveled clay road leads east out of the city.

A narrow paved walkway leads south along the city wall past some
shops.
via Petrus leads into the city.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There are two tall spires on either side of the gate and are
constantly manned by the city guards.  They are made of stone and stand
about 40 feet tall.

The gate is fabricated from iron and has been designed to keep
intruders out of the city.

rooms.Name: via Petrus
rooms.Description:
The clay road has become a well-paved road made from stone brought
