climb north. Be careful, you do not want to disturb anyone, do you ?

rooms.Name: Above the Centre Stage
rooms.Description:
The view from here is even more marvelous compared with the views
from the sides. You can almost see yourself in the polished floor. Huuu,
it is far down. Perhaps you should get out of this place before
something happens, like you get a sandbag on your head and you fall
down. That would be sooo embarrassing. You can crawl either north or
south from here.

rooms.Name: Above the Stage
rooms.Description:
From here you have a nice view of the stage, but only that. The
lighting does not spread well up here. It could be the dust or just that
it is very narrow. You hardly dare to go down again so for you the thing
is to climb south. Be careful, do not want to disturb anyone, do you ?

rooms.Name: Behind the Curtain
rooms.Description:
Standing on the stage but out of view you are almost surrounded by
ropes that go up and down here. They must be here to allow curtain to
open and close before and after the shows but the controls seems to be
located south of the stage. You can walk south out on the stage, west
into a backstage corridor or if you really want to you just might be
able to climb up the ropes.

Exits.Description: The Mad Drummers part of the stage. Better be careful out there.
You really need to fly to access that part, whatever you might think.

rooms.Name: Corridor behind the Stage
rooms.Description:
This very unglamorous corridor leads east-west and there seems to be
only one door on the side of it. On the other hand this door has a big
golden star encrusted upon it. The scent of flowers and perfumes slips
out through the door. The rest of the corridor is filled with old props
and a dust ball or three.

Exits.Description:
The golden star on the door reveals that beyond lies the Star dressing
room and the star must be Hulio. The smell points in that direction to.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The golden star on the door reveals that beyond lies the Star dressing
room and the star must be Hulio. The smell points in that direction too.

rooms.Name: End of the Corridor
rooms.Description:
The corridor ends abruptly in a heavy ironclad door. There is a sign
on one of the iron bars that is fixed across the door. There are boxes
and casks places upon each other here. A typical dumping place for gear
no longer wanted that still no one dares to throw away.

Exits.Description:
The ironclad door is very well bolted and most probably can not be
opened. Perhaps with the right key it would or maybe not even then.
The sign looks serious and worth reading.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads : This entrance has been closed since too many were
found sneaking in without paying. It will not be opened again.
Ma Glob.

rooms.Name: Star Dressing Room
rooms.Description:
Perfumed candles fill the room together with fresh flowers making you
almost stunned (or ill). This is Hulio's room. Hulio the BIG star. Love
letters are placed carefully on the makeup table among the small caskets
and makeup gadgets that must be Hulio's. There is not much else in the
room, but the table, its chair and a large rocking chair filled with
fluffy pillows.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Looking quickly through the love letters you spot the following names.
Petunia, Auntie Tabitha, Jellie, Clara, Rosy, Nushi(!) and all the
Pleiades.

Oh he has received a lot of letters. Let's see if we can spot some names,
because you do not want to read others' mail do you ?
All flowers look freshly cut and delivered. Hulio has a lot of fans.

Dearest Hulio,

I fell madly in love with you the first time I heard you sing. I will
never forget. I was only 14, but I knew there could only ever be one
man for me. I long for the day we may meet, and you too may realize
that we were fated to be together.

Your adoring loving fan,

Jellie

rooms.Name: In the Prompt-Box
rooms.Description:
The prompt box has been rearranged into a home for the slightly mad
Suss-Ana. Apparently she has not been out of it for a very long time.
There are bits or pieces of most anything in here. Nothing of value to
anyone else, but nice if you like it that way.

Exits.Description: Up to the stage again.

rooms.Name: North-East part of the Kitchen
rooms.Description:
A wonderful smell fills the whole room. This kitchen is famous for
the delicate meals being created here. Some of them are in fact placed
on a little table next to the door. These must be the ones waiting for
the serving personnel. The smell is indescribably good and if you
weren't that well mannered you would stick a finger in a sauce cup just
for one little tiny bit of taste. North of here are the swing doors to
the diner and east is a small staircase.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks so tasty you had better leave before you make a scene.
You see three small plates standing here waiting to be taken in.

rooms.Name: Staircase
rooms.Description:
A small spiral staircase leads down into darkness. The air coming
from below is tainted with the smell of dry fruits and spices. West of
here is the kitchen in all its glamour, down there is soft darkness...

Exits.Description: The smell is soft and welcoming. What is down there in the darkness ?

rooms.Name: Wine cellar
rooms.Description:
Wine, wine and more wine, even some spilled on the dirt floor. The
room is rather big and it is filled to the brim with wines of all brands,
red, white, green and pink, there even ought to be a some champagne
around here somewhere.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Any wine from any district and grape is covered in here.

rooms.Name: Inner parts of the Wine cellar
rooms.Description:
Think Vintage, think gooooood vintage. This is Ma's special corner of
the wine cellar where she keeps the really good wines that she likes to
enjoy with her own special guests. Dust covers all the bottles and it
makes you sneeze.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These wines are not for your wallet. Not that any of the bottles have
price tags but they are very exclusive. Try to get invited to dinner !

rooms.Name: At a Huge Frying board
rooms.Description:
You are standing next to a large flat horizontal hot metal surface
covered with large steaks, bacon, one tiny meatball and one or two eggs.
The smoke stings your eyes but it's hard to move away because it smells
so good. Droool! It is quite hot here too, but it seems to be even
hotter at the oven, south.

Exits.Description: A huge oven takes up most of the corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The frying board is well used. The usage is one of the secrets of good
cooking. Never overclean boards and kettles unnecessarily. The sauces
and tastes remaining in the metal pores add a extra spice to the dish.
Small but very very delicious.

rooms.Name: Next to a big Oven
rooms.Description:
There is an ancient oven here warming up the entire corner. Guess it
pretty much accounts for all the heat in here. There must be room for a
full sized person in there, but temperature inside must be totally
scorching. If you really want to, you can still try to crawl in through
the oven door.

Exits.Description:
The oven door looks very easy to open and to close. There is room in
there for some really big roasts.
Your eyebrows twist. Sure is hot in there. You really wanna go in ?

rooms.Name: Inside a overheated Oven
rooms.Description:
It's hot in here.
It's very Hot.
The oven door slams close behind you.
Oops...
Its Very Hot Indeed !
You burn yourself.
You BURN !!!
You incinerate.
You become dust.
Your ashes blow out through the oven fan.
Sorry.
Death Traps are no Fun.
( But how often do you usually crawl into hot ovens ??? )

Exits.Description: TOO LATE !!!

rooms.Name: South end of the Kitchen
rooms.Description:
A table here is full of empty plates, even the wall is covered with
clean pots. This must be where the dishes start their short life of
glory. East of here is a large oven and north there seems to be a table
full of pastries. The kitchen also continues towards the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The table is filled with clean stuff from the sink.

rooms.Name: Kitchen Center
rooms.Description:
Missy Bean's fabulous dessert table stands in front of you, filled
with the most astonishing cakes and bakeries. Lucky as you are, you can
see two nice recipes here too. But don't eat the wonderful,
mind-boggling and sure GOOD tasting desserts, they are only for paying
customers and you didn't pay, did you ? From here the kitchen stretches
out in all directions, all equally nice.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Your belly hurts. This is too good. Why didn't you pay ?
Currently there seems to be a milk&rum-cake and a rhubarbcake in the
making. Oh!, the recipies are here too. Have a peek !
The table is big, wooden and covered with flour and Ms Bean's creations.

This is really a Nicaraguan dessert, but it is served in just about
every Cuban restaurant in Miami. It is one of the most delicious cakes
ever invented.

1 1/2 cups cake flour
1 teaspoon baking powder
1 cup plus 1 teaspoon sugar
1/2 cup butter, softened
5 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
11/3 cups of milk
1 cup sweetened condensed milk
1 cup evaporated milk
1 tablespoon light rum
1 cup heavy cream.
--
Preheat oven to 350 degreesF. Sift together the cake flour and baking
powder. In a large mixing bowl, cream the 1 cup sugar and the butter
with a mixer until well blended. Add the eggs and 1/2 teaspoon
vanilla extract, and beat until foamy. With a rubber spatula, gently fold
in the flour mixture in increments, alternating with 1/3 cup milk, until
the batter is smooth.

Pour cake batter into a lightly greased cake pan or baking dish, 7 by 11
by 2 inches, and bake for 30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in
the center comes out clean and the top springs back when pressed. Allow
cake to cool in the pan on a wire rack for 20 minutes, then invert onto a
serving platter. Pierce the cake with a fork in many places, and allow it
to cool completely.

In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the condensed milk, evaporated
milk, 1 cup milk and rum until well blended. Pour syrup evenly over the
cake a little at a time, until it is saturated; you may not need the
entire amount. Refrigerate, covered in plastic wrap, for at least 3
hours.

In a large mixing bowl with a mixer, whisk the heavy cream until it
begins to thicken. Add 1 teaspoon sugar and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
extract, and continue whisking until stiff peaks form. Using a spatula,
spread the cream over the top and sides of the cake. Serve, cut into
squares.

450 g  fresh rhubarbs
3 dl sugar
150g almond paste
5 eg
4dl white flower
butter
suger pearls

Whip eggs and sugar to a white and fluffy mass.
Tears the almond paste into the fluff together with the flower
and make it smooth.
Pour it all into a buttered and breaded form.
Cut up the rhubarbs in inchlong pieces
Push them into the mass - desity as you please.
Spread peraled suger over it.
Last thing before baking it in the oven for 40-45 minutes at 175 degreeC
is to cover the whole cake with a thin layer of butter.

Serv either hot or cold with whipped cream and a glass of port.

Yummie !!!

rooms.Name: North wall of the Kitchen
rooms.Description:
A table here is full of almost ready plates. The wall is covered with
spices and other strange additives to make that so famous taste of Ma
Glob's establishment. This is somewhat calm place in the kitchen as the
food 'rests' before its final presentation to the guest. To the west is
a not so peaceful place, the washup. South is the dessert table and east
of here you are going towards the exit into the restaurant.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see several plates standing here to 'soak' just a few moments before
being served. This is a must if you want the tastes to mix perfectly.

rooms.Name: North end of the Sink
rooms.Description:
A lot of good food leads to loads of dirty dishes and they all seem
to end up here. There should be some people here washing, arms deep in
the rising foam, but if there aren't you sure well can expect the
unwashed plates to load up. This is a classy joint so the cleaning of
plates must be rigorous. The sink continues to the south and the rest of
the kitchen to the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The sink is HUGE, wet, foamy and unfortunately inhabited.

rooms.Name: South end of the Sink
rooms.Description:
A large faucet is here flushing the soap off the newly washed plates
that are being supplied from the northern part of the sink. There are
high heaps of warm dry and clean plates here, waiting for someone to
take them to their appropriate table. East of here you see the most
wonderful table you have ever seen and south there seems to some kind of
crossjoint in the kitchen.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The sink is HUGE, wet, foamy and unfortunately inhabited.

Water is splashing out of the faucet from what seems to be a never-ending
supply. The water is needed as there sure are a lot of dishes waiting.

rooms.Name: South-West corner of the Kitchen
rooms.Description:
The southeast corner seems to be some kind of cross path as the sink
is north, the clean empty dishes are to the east and there are two doors
leading south and west. The western door is covered with moisture.

Exits.Description: A little sign on the door tells you who has a break and when.
The door is cold, wet and looks a bit heavy.

rooms.Name: Cold Store
rooms.Description:
This is where all non-vegetables are kept. A cool and chilly place,
you had better make sure the door does not close behind you. Up and
down the walls you see cold meat, goat, pork and even duck. In one
corner there is even a large box with ice and fish lying waiting for you
to order some IN the restaurant. The door which you have kept open seems
to be the only exit.

Exits.Description: The kitchen sure is warmer.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is fresh with just a thin layer of frost on it.

The duck is newly killed and gutted. Some might think that it is
inappropriate to serve duck, but it tastes just too good to leave be.

rooms.Name: Personnel Resting Lounge
rooms.Description:
A very plain room. Some small diorama paintings, a few sofas and a
not so small tables with goodies from the restaurant. This could be why
Ma manages to keep her staff even though she offers rather minimum
wages. The earnings are not really that good in Stanneg, but the food
sure is. All the customers as well as the staff are very satisfied.

Exits.Description: The Office of Ma Glob does not draw that much attention.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The diorama shows a beautiful sunset over some Caribbean islands. One of
the islands even has a volcano that is giving off a faint string of
smoke. All of the islands have palm trees flowing softly in the wind.

Very soft cloth and you could really sink down here and get some good
rest. That is if the staff would allow you to.

A wooden table painted brown stands centrally. It is covered with mostly
leftovers (not served) from the kitchen and the smell is marvelous.

rooms.Name: The Office of Ma Glob
rooms.Description:
This is a very nice office. A bit simple perhaps, but knowing Ma she
likes it that way. The room has a soft sound suppressing cloth
wallcovering with a seaweed design printed on it. A large desk with a
huge chair stands in the room's center. That must be where Ma or some
trusted assistant does the paperwork. East behind the desk there is an
odd gate with a huge something upon it. West goes back to the restroom.

Exits.Description:
Sure is big that gate. A good guess it is securely locked, too.
Perhaps the Glob family treasure is in there?
The resting lounge is there for you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This must be where the finances are straightened up for the Parlor.

The wallcloth gives you a feeling of being underwater. This is not very
usual for a office, but then again the Globs are not that common either.
Well it is huge...
The huge something looks a little like a mountain lodge or maybe not.
It is definitely something...
The whole family of Globs are lined up on it.

A small alcove is the hidingplace for the officeguards.
Only they know the technique to enter and exit. Consider it an extra
precaution from your generous host Ma Glob.

rooms.Name: Red Velvet Room
rooms.Description:
What is this !!! A room in twilight, filled with high hanging
draperies. There is something very odd about this. You really get the
feeling that you should not be here... wherever here might be. The door
out that you need is west of here. Well at least you came in that way.

Exits.Description: The view is slightly blurred, but at least is light out there.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The room is filled with them. At least as far as you can see. There are
voices in a far distance, but trying to wander in among the red cloth
would surely get you lost, very lost.

rooms.Name: Up the Fan
rooms.Description:
The smoke here makes you cough, but used to rough conditions as the
seasoned mudder you are, you persevere. The way the smoke is irritating
you, you almost think it is alive. But that just cannot be true, can it?
The wide chimney allows you to continue both up and down, at least from
here.

Exits.Description: The smoke clears away and you can just maybe see the clear sky.

An odd face with two eggs as eyes, a meatball as nose and some bacon as
lips looks back up to you as they slowly fry on the frying board.

rooms.Name: Top of the Chimney
rooms.Description:
Kraa - Kraa - Kraa !!! The crows circle you as you place yourself in
their huge nest. If it wasn't for the constant assaults from the flying
(and of course out of reach) crow, the view of the surrounding Stanneg
would be marvelous. The mythical forest and the mountains of the dragon
prince to the west and the ancient city of Rome to the north fill your
view. You can almost notice the outskirts of Midgaard somewhere southeast
of here. Better climb down now, before the crows bring more kin.

Exits.Description: Cannot see much as the smoke from the chimney gets in your eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The closest town to Stanneg is the ancient city of Rome. Here you can
find gladiators and chariot drivers, judges and executioners and of
course the great Caesar.
Those are the mountains where the Dragon Prince Aglandiir resides.
The Haon-Dor forest.

You have stuck your upper body right through the crows nest. No wonder
some of them might be angry at you. The nest looks very used.

The old mining town has seen better days, but one day new ore will be
found.

rooms.Name: The Void
rooms.Description:
You don't think that you are not floating in nothing. This is where IO dwelt
for an unimaginable time before he got this unimaginable idea of creating 
the universe.

Exits.Description: void

rooms.Name: Limbo
rooms.Description:
You are floating in a formless void, detached from all sensation of physical
matter, surrounded by swirling glowing light, which fades into the relative
darkness around you without any trace of edges or shadow.

rooms.Name: A totally useless room
rooms.Description:
The walls are completely bare... no nothing at all in the room what so ever.
Strange ...

Exits.Description: You do not see that here.

rooms.Name: The EliteMUD Correctional Institution.
rooms.Description:
So this is what the inside of a jail cell looks like...
 ________________________________________________________________________
|.      .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .|
|.      .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .|
|.      .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .|
|.      .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .|
|________________________________________________________________________|

   Through this little window, you can see into the Temple, but alas, you are
here, and they cannot help you. You had better pray to what ever God put you
here and ask for forgiveness of your sins. For you shall be condemed to this
room until the POWERs that be decide that you are reformed enough to enter the
world of EliteMUD.

rooms.Name: The Morgue
rooms.Description:
This is the morgue, where frozen people go to die.  Please store frozen people
here to avoid cluttering jail.  If you like, have a beer from the fridge, but
don't touch the corpses!
§N

rooms.Name: IO's residence
rooms.Description:
You are in the most weirdest room you have ever seen. The room itself is
large.  Actually it's very large. You can't seem to see where is ends. (Or
how). This room contains little however. A large and neat bed in one part. A
large fridge in another. A bar with an Auto Bartender System, ABS(tm) is in
another place.  Music can be heard, but the source cannot be found. Naturally
there is a small computer somewhere around here where he codes when things gets
boring. There is also a poker table in one part.

rooms.Name: The (Experimental?) Remort Lab
rooms.Description:
This room is very clean, white tile floor, bright lights, you immediately
think of a laboratory.  Looking around, you see that it indeed is.  Flasks
line the shelves with various labels on them such as 'kick', 'sanctuary',
and the ever popular 'backstab' and 'circle' 2-pack.  Further down you
see some strange looking equipment and some vials labeled 'experimental',
one vial is jumping around. . .strange.  As you stray too near the
experimental section you are intercepted and guided to your seat.  Many
others, of whom you have only heard stories of their great exploits have
sat in this seat.  Will you join them in glory or become just another name
on a remort list?
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The vial is rather large and seems to move by some power within
There is a label on it... Experimental:  Whupass
§N

rooms.Name: Outside the Wedding Chapel
rooms.Description:
You seem to be floating in the heavens above Elite.  Directly below
you can see the town of Midgaard, the center of Elite.  Looking around you
can also see Welmar's castle and the fires of Hell dimly burning. You
wonder what mystical power protects you from falling to the earth below.
As you look around, the only thing visible is a white chapel in the
distance.  Two large golden doors and beautiful stained glass windows
decorate this magnificent building.  You conclude that this place must be
the creation of one of Elite's gods.  Putting aside the fear of plummeting
to your death below, you decide to approach the chapel to bear witness to
the events that are about to unfold.
§N

rooms.Name: Inside the Wedding Chapel
rooms.Description:
The golden doors mysteriously open, as if sensing your presence.
At first glance, the interior of this building is as beautiful as its
exterior.  Flowers gathered from the far reaches of Elite can be seen
here decorating the white walls.  Ahead of you a set of crystaline
doors can be seen.  These also open, as if they had a life of their
own.  Your first look at the actual chapel leaves you speechless.  
§N

rooms.Name: The Wedding Chapel
rooms.Description:
The walls inside the chapel glow with a divine light.  You feel at
ease inside here, all of your worries left at the door.  Rows of
cushioned silvery seats are here for your seating comfort.  Murals of
Elite's great gods line the walls, providing witness to this event.
Upon closer inspection, you realize the stained glass windows are
actually depictions of IO creating the very fabric of existance.  At
the far end of the room you see a magnificent altar constructed of an
unknown, but enchanting alloy. A beautiful silken canopy covers the
wedding platform, where the bride and groom to be will stand and speak
their vows.
§N

rooms.Name: Flower Garden
rooms.Description:
You have wandered into a beautiful flower garden.  Every variety of
Elite foliage must be here growing and blossoming.  Looking around
you realize that the flowers form a heart-shape, with a single
golden swing in the middle.  The swing seems perfectly sized for two
people.  You inhale deeply and breath in the wonderful scents that
float around this garden.
§N

rooms.Name: Dining Hall
rooms.Description:
Inside the dining hall you see a gigantic room with foods of all
sorts.  Elite's finest chefs must have gathered and collaborated to
create such a magnificent feast for the eyes as well as the stomachs of
all.  At the head of the room you see a gigantic cake, fit for such an
occassion.  Next to the cake you see the table that belongs to the lucky
couple.  Through the many large glass doors you can see a balcony that
must provide a breathtaking view of the land below.
§N

rooms.Name: Balcony
rooms.Description:
Standing upon the balcony you can see virtually all of Elite below.
Through the clouds, characters the size of ants can be seen scurrying
around below, rushing from one zone to the next.  There appears to be
celebration all around you, including on the world below.  The news of
a wedding must have spread throught the realm.  Looking out above the
clouds, in the very distance you see the palace that contains the
homes of Elite's mighty gods.
§N

rooms.Name: The Grand Gate of Thalos
rooms.Description:
You stand in the archway of a gigantic stone archway. The two steel gates
have been forced open and have rusted in place. A hollow gust of wind blows by
you into the deserted, and seemingly destroyed, city.

Exits.Description: The desert sands stretch on for miles and miles.

You see devastation everywhere. Houses lie in ruin and skeletons litter the
streets. You see strange beasts stalking the shadows.

rooms.Name: Main Street
rooms.Description:
This was once a magnificent street, but now is in total ruin. The streets
are barren and windswept and the silence is unending. To the south you see a
ruined cottage while north leads into a dark back alley. Howls and screams echo
through the deserted city.

Exits.Description: It's a dark alley.
The entrance to the city lies this way.
A ruined shack lies to the south.
Main Street lies this way.

rooms.Name: Main Street
rooms.Description:
This was once a magnificent street, but now is in total ruin. The streets
are barren and windswept and the silence is unending. On one side is a
collapsed house while on the other is the entrance to a large ruined mansion.
Eerie sounds echo within the mansion. Near the center of town you see a large
domed building, relatively intact.

Exits.Description: The remnants of a store lie this way.
It looks like what used to be the main building in the city.
A withered garden path lies this way.

rooms.Name: A garden path
rooms.Description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of the
city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare. Vines and
ivy snake up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves around your feet.
A sudden volley of howls pierces the air.

Exits.Description: The garden path continues around the building.
This is the main street leading to the city's entrance
The garden path continues around the building.

Inside the temple, small patches of light shoot through each doorway as well as
a few holes in the ceiling.

rooms.Name: A garden path
rooms.Description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of the
city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare. Vines and
ivy snake up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves around your feet.

Exits.Description: A side street leads of to the northern half of the city.
The garden path continues around the building.

Inside the temple, small patches of light shoot through each doorway as well as
a few holes in the ceiling.
The garden path continues around the building.

rooms.Name: A garden path
rooms.Description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of the
city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare. Vines and
ivy creep up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves around your feet.

Exits.Description: The garden path continues around the building.

Inside the temple, small patches of light shoot through each doorway as well as
a few cracks in the ceiling.
The garden path continues around the building.
What looks like a market place lies this way.

rooms.Name: A garden path
rooms.Description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of the
city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare. Vines and
ivy creep up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves around your feet.

Exits.Description:
Inside the temple, small patches of light shoot through each doorway as well as
a few cracks in the ceiling.
The garden path continues around the building.
A small side street leads to the southern half of the city.
The garden path continues around the building.

rooms.Name: The market place
rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of a large square lined on each side with baskets,
carts, and stands of all shapes and sizes. Abandoned, these little shops still
contain some of their goods once sold to a demanding public.

Exits.Description:
A small table has been toppled over, spilling fine jewelry and gems onto the
ground.
A small garden path encircles a large domed temple in the center of the city.
Rotted remains of fruits and vegetables lie strewn about.
The market place continues.

rooms.Name: The market place
rooms.Description:
You stand at the end of the market square. Stands and carts line each side,
filled with remnants of fine foods and exquisite goods. A small hole in the
western wall of the city leads back out into the desert.

Exits.Description: Tattered carpets and ruined bales of silk sit idly by a run down stand.
The center of the market lies this way.

>From the massive stench, this must have been a meat and poultry stand. It lies
totally bare.

rooms.Name: A side street
rooms.Description:
This small side street leads east and west into back alleys while to the
south you see the temple. The incessant howling tears at your mind.

rooms.Name: A side street
rooms.Description:
You are in the common section of the city. Ruined buildings made of clay and
stone is all the view has to offer. Most of these homes are nothing but piles
of rubble, but some look almost safe enough to venture into. The street
continues north and south and buildings line the street.

Exits.Description: A small doorway leads into a partially collapsed house.
A small clay dwelling sits here.

rooms.Name: A side street
rooms.Description:
This small side street leads away from the garden path to the south. Around
you stand large piles or rubble where the houses of commoners used to be. A
lone howl makes you worry greatly about your safety here.

Exits.Description: An unusually tall dwelling stands looming over you.
A garden path circles around the temple.
Here lies a small stone house with a thatched roof.

rooms.Name: A side street
rooms.Description:
This small side street leads south away from the temple into the business
section of town. The destruction that leveled this city was not biased; these
important looking buildings have been almost totally destroyed. There is a hole
in the wall of a very large structure to the east.

Exits.Description: A small garden path encircles the temple.
This possibly could be the city hall.
Inside the building you see long pieces of metal, an oven, and some anvils.

rooms.Name: A side street
rooms.Description:
This small side street is lined with the remains of once great buildings. To
the north is a dark, foreboding structure while to the south lies the entrance
to a small tavern. The street continues north and south.

Exits.Description:
>From the looks of it, this was once a two story abode. The entire second floor
has collapsed leaving a very little part of the bar still free from debris.

This seems to be the only guild house in the entire city. It's dark nature
makes you wonder about its' origins.

rooms.Name: A side street
rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long street leading to the center of the city. A
long dark alley runs east and west.

rooms.Name: Under a ruined watchtower
rooms.Description:
You stand at the base of a tall watchtower built to protect the city from
invaders. From the looks of things, it did not do a good job.

rooms.Name: A back alley
rooms.Description:
This alley leads to the rear of what used to be a meat stand. You wince at
the stench. South is one of the city watchtowers.

Exits.Description: You see the back-side of the market place meat stand.
A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.

rooms.Name: The meat stand
rooms.Description:
A large stand has been set up here with metal hooks and wooden racks in the
background. Hanging on the hooks are very small scraps of meat and other game.
This stand is relatively empty, and a sudden burst of howling and screaming
makes you realize why this is so.

Exits.Description: The market place lies this way.
This is a cart full of rotted vegetables and fruits.

rooms.Name: A back alley
rooms.Description:
A narrow alley leads east to a wider street and west to one of the city
watchtowers.

Exits.Description: A small side street greets you.
A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.

rooms.Name: The guild house
rooms.Description:
You are standing in what once was this city's ONLY guild house. Tables and
chairs have been smashed and broken weapons lie strewn about the floor as if
some massive battle had taken place here. Draped along the back wall is a
tattered, jet-black banner with the symbol of the Darkside set upon it.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the building.

rooms.Name: The produce stand
rooms.Description:
A large cart sits here carrying rotted fruit and vegetables. Flies swarm all
about what seems to be the last remaining bits of food left in the city.

Exits.Description: The market place is deserted.
A strong stench emanates from the meat stand next to you.

rooms.Name: The smithy
rooms.Description:
In here you find tools and anvils used to make various weapons and items.
The walls have been stripped clean and only a few incomplete pieces of armor
and weaponry are left.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the building.

rooms.Name: The tapestry stand
rooms.Description:
Tattered and torn tapestries and rugs lie heaped in piles. Fancy robes and
various articles of clothing are now just rags. You stare at the strange piles
for a long time until a piercing howl makes you think these might be beds.

Exits.Description: A fine jewelry stand lies in ruin next to you.
The market place is deserted.

rooms.Name: A back alley
rooms.Description:
A narrow alley leads north to one of the city watchtowers while to the south
there lies a market stand full of torn clothes and rugs.

Exits.Description: A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.

rooms.Name: Under the watchtower
rooms.Description:
You stand under one of the city watchtowers built to protect the city from
invaders. Obviously, it failed.

Exits.Description: Above you looms a tall watchtower.

rooms.Name: The jewelry stand
rooms.Description:
A table has been tipped over, spilling fine jewelry and gems across the
market place. Most of these trinkets are battered and tarnished and few would
have any value anymore.

Exits.Description: The market place is deserted.
Next to you is a stand full of ruined clothes and rugs.

rooms.Name: A ruined clay dwelling
rooms.Description:
This was once a very plain house with nothing more than a few chairs and a
bed. A cold fireplace suggests that the city has been abandoned for quite a
while. Almost nothing remains of this humble abode.

Exits.Description: Outside is a small side street.

rooms.Name: A collapsed stone dwelling
rooms.Description:
This small house has completely collapsed upon itself leaving piles of
debris here and there. A few rafters still stand with thatched straw hanging
down and a hot wind gusts through the hollow dwelling.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the house.

rooms.Name: A back alley
rooms.Description:
A narrow alley leads east to one of the city watchtowers and west to a small
side street.

rooms.Name: An abandoned shop
rooms.Description:
From the outside this place looks like an ordinary pile of rubble, but
inside these cramped quarters you discover what used to be a shop filled with
armor, weapons, and various other goods. A small sign flutters in the wind.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the shop.

rooms.Name: The Tavern of the Sun
rooms.Description:
A glorious place in it's prime, this tavern now lies in ruin; tables and
chairs are broken scattered, bottles and glasses shattered, and a small
performance stage crushed. Musical instruments and personal belongings lie
under the rubble, but the people they once belonged to are not with them.
Looking up you see that the entire second floor and roof has fallen in, leaving
a gaping hole above.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the tavern.

rooms.Name: South wing of the city hall
rooms.Description:
You stand in a large room attached to this end of the hallway which leads
back north to the reception area. Pedestals and columns have fallen and most of
the valuable items have been taken, leaving worthless debris. A few chairs have
survived, as well as a large curved desk. To the east is a vine-covered archway
leading out into a private courtyard.

Exits.Description: The long hallway leads back to the main reception area of the city hall.

rooms.Name: The city hall
rooms.Description:
This is the main reception area of Thalos' city hall. The walls have been
charred and scored massively and debris is spread from wall to wall. A large
gaping hole in the west wall allows you to see out to one of the city's side
streets. Obviously no one will be seeing you through today. Hallways lead south
and east.

Exits.Description: Main street runs past the city hall.
A hallway leads to the east wing of the city hall.
A hallway leads to the south wing of the city hall.

rooms.Name: East wing of the city hall
rooms.Description:
Here lies the remnants of a fancy office, possibly the mayor's. A few
withered plants and broken pieces of furniture make this place anything but
fancy, though. The only thing remaining intact here is a large glass cabinet. A
long hallway leads west back to the reception area and an ivy-covered archway
leads south into a private courtyard.

rooms.Name: The private gardens and courtyard of Thalos
rooms.Description:
What a shame that this mass destruction also touched this once beautiful
place. The temple's garden path has nothing on this garden. Flowers and trees
have been smashed into the ground and lawn benches thrown through walls. A
large marble fountain in the center of the courtyard still stands, though,
defying any attempts to destroy its beauty. Above stands the remnants of one of
the watchtowers. Archways north and west lead back into the city hall.

rooms.Name: A small guard house
rooms.Description:
This was once the barracks for Thalos' Cityguards. Now just an empty shell,
this small shack still stands guarding the entrance both to the city and to the
city hall.

Exits.Description: Main street runs by this building.

rooms.Name: A collapsed home
rooms.Description:
All that's left of this house is a few scattered piles of rubble and a very
large blast crater. Obviously someone or something important was once housed
here. A shrieking howl chills your blood.

Exits.Description: Main street runs past this ruined home.

rooms.Name: A tall dwelling
rooms.Description:
This seems to be the tallest structure remaining in the city. At one time
this could have been an inn of some sort, but now it's just a mess. The back
wall as been completely knocked down revealing an entrance into another
building through yet another collapsed wall. Between the two buildings are a
few blast craters and boulders. An old set of wooden steps leads up to a
creaking second floor.

Exits.Description: A small side street winds past the dwelling.

The stairs and even the entire second floor itself looks very unsafe for
travel. Gusts of wind make them creak and shudder.

rooms.Name: A small shack
rooms.Description:
This cramped dwelling could not have housed more than one person. Now with
the back wall missing, it could hold many more. Looking around you find broken
shelves and workbenches with various vials and pouches spilling contents all
across the floor. This was possibly the magic shop of the city. The doorway to
the east is blocked, making the only exit back west.

rooms.Name: A back alley
rooms.Description:
A narrow back alley goes south to main street and north towards a
watchtower. A mass of howls catches you of guard.

Exits.Description: Main street runs past here.

rooms.Name: A back alley
rooms.Description:
A narrow back alley leads north to one of the city watchtowers and south
towards main street. To the west is a doorway to a small house blocked by
debris.

Exits.Description: A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.

rooms.Name: Under a watchtower
rooms.Description:
You stand under a tall watchtower. Narrow back alleys lead west and south
and a very weak looking ladder leads up into the tower. Above you, you hear the
screams of tens of starving lamias! Beware!

Exits.Description:
Winds howl high above your head in the tower above. You hear the screams of
tens of howling lamias above you!

rooms.Name: A bath house
rooms.Description:
This was once the bath house for the commoners of the city. Hot steamy water
still wells up from a hole in the floor. Obviously there is a hot spring
located under the city (making the decision to put a city here seem much more
reasonable). Closer inspection of the water yields a dead body floating around
in it, skin melted away from months of floating in there. The west wall has
collapsed revealing another collapsed house.

Exits.Description: The wall has collapsed on the adjoining house, creating a new opening in it.

rooms.Name: A back alley
rooms.Description:
A narrow back alley leads west to a small side street and east to one of the
city watchtowers. Great amounts of steam issue forth from the building to the
south.

Exits.Description: A watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.
A side street runs by here.

rooms.Name: An upright house
rooms.Description:
This home is practically the only one around that is still standing. Except
for the massive hole in the east wall, everything else looks intact, including
the windows. Great amounts of steam issue forth from the hole in the east wall.

Exits.Description: A small side street runs past the house.

rooms.Name: On the second floor
rooms.Description:
The minute you step off onto this floor you realize it was a mistake. The
old rotted floorboards suddenly give way and you fall down, impaling yourself
on jagged boards below.

rooms.Name: The north-west watchtower
rooms.Description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent from
here and you can see all the way to the western mountains. No wonder this place
stood for so long.

Exits.Description: The city lies below.

rooms.Name: The south-west watchtower
rooms.Description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent from
here and you can see all the way to the western mountains. To the south the
desert stretches to the horizon. No wonder this place stood for so long.

Exits.Description: The city lies below.

rooms.Name: The north-east watchtower
rooms.Description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent from
here and you can see a great floating pyramid to the north-east. Desert sand
stretches to the horizon. No wonder this place stood for so long. The ladder
leading down seems rotted in some places!

Exits.Description: The city lies below.... far, far below.

rooms.Name: Under a watchtower
rooms.Description:
As you descend the ladder, the rotted rungs break, sending you quickly to
your demise far below on the city street. Splat.

rooms.Name: The Temple of Thalos
rooms.Description:
You stand within one of the most holy places in the realm. This stunning
domed temple once housed the city's worshipers en masse. Unfortunately, it
succumbed to the destruction brought on this city. Long benches lie toppled and
the altar desecrated. Large chunks of stone have fallen from the walls and
roof, sending sunlight streaming in on you. A few books lie about, conveying to
you a holy message in a strange tongue. Wind gusts through the four archways
and howls and screams can be heard from all parts of the city.

Exits.Description: A side street leads to the northern half of the city.
Main street leads out to the main gate of the city.
A side street leads to the southern part of the city.
The market place lies this way.

rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Great Elven City of Illir
rooms.Description:
You are entering the great elven city of Illir. Many elves are 
passing by you on the path that leads to the gates. Before you 
are the walls that surround the city. The only way in is the gates 
that is guarded by armed elves.

Exits.Description: You see the gates that guard the elven city.
You see a forest.

rooms.Name: Inside the Gates of the Great Elven City of Illir
rooms.Description:
You are inside the gates of Illir. Everywhere you see elves walking 
around and there is a sound of elven smiths forging weapons and armors. 
As you look north you see some kind of market square and to the east a 
large tree can be seen.

Exits.Description: You see a market square.
You see the mighty gates of Illir.
You look upon another part of the city.
You see an enormous tree.

rooms.Name: In the City of Illir
rooms.Description:
You are in the great elven city of Illir. There are many houses 
around you and elves are busy working. To the south you see a smith.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the elven smith.
You see some houses inside the gates.
You see a guard house near a small river.

rooms.Name: Under a Great Tree
rooms.Description:
You stand under a very large tree with leaves that are shining like 
gold. As you look up into the tree you see a ladder that leads up 
through the tree. To the west the city gates can be seen.

Exits.Description: Inside the gates.
In the elven city of Illir.
Up in the large tree.

rooms.Name: A Guard House Before the Bridge
rooms.Description:
You are standing at a guard house at a river. Elven 
guards watch for intruders at a bridge that leads over 
a swift stream. Far away you can see the mountains from 
which the river seems to come.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the Dancing Duck.
You see some sort of market.
You see another part of the city.
You see a bridge that leads over the stream.

rooms.Name: The Market Square of Illir
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the middle of a market. Here elves come to buy 
their food or to trade things. There are musicians playing and even 
some elves dancing.

Exits.Description: You see a path that leads to a large house.
You see another part of the city.
You see the gates of the elven city.
You see a bridge that leads over a stream.

rooms.Name: The Elven City of Illir
rooms.Description:
You are standing in another part of the elven city. To the west it 
seems that the elves are holding some sort of market and to the north 
more houses can be seen.

Exits.Description: The northeast corner of the city.
You see a great tree.
You see the market square of Illir.

rooms.Name: The Dancing Duck
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the Dancing Duck. Here elves come to 
feast and to get a good nights sleep. The innkeeper is busy serving 
elves food and wine and there are musicians playing in a corner.

Exits.Description: You see a guard house near a stream.

rooms.Name: On the Trail to a Great Elven House
rooms.Description:
You are walking on a trail that leads up to a house of great 
beauty. The path doesn't seem to be made of mortals as it seems 
to shine on its own. To the south you can see the market square.
There are some guards on the path that stare threateningly at you.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to a great house.
You see some houses in the distance.
As you look back you see the market square.

rooms.Name: Another part of the city
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a part of the elven city that is dominated by 
the houses where the elves live. Here most of the mothers and their 
children spend their time waiting for the fathers to come home 
from their duties.

Exits.Description: As you look south you can see that the city continues.
You see a trail that goes up in the woods.

rooms.Name: In the Smithy
rooms.Description:
You are in an elven smithy. Many young elves are working hard and 
before you an old elf is hammering on an anvil. The sound of battering 
iron is so loud that you want to cover your ears. The only way out is 
the door to the north.

Exits.Description: You see some houses.

rooms.Name: Up in the large tree
rooms.Description:
You are climbing a very large tree. Elven guards are sitting on the
limbs of the tree and you also see children playing around. As you look
up you can see that another ladder leads even further up into the tree.

Exits.Description: The ladder goes even higher up into the great tree.
You see the ground under the great tree.

rooms.Name: At the Top of the Tree
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a house that is built in the great tree. Torches 
are hanging on the walls and there seems to be food stored everywhere. 
As you look around you also see many elven guards approaching you with 
haste. It doesn't like they want you here!

Exits.Description: You see the rope ladder that leads down from the tree.

rooms.Name: The Bridge over the Stream
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a bridge that leads over a swift stream. The 
stream comes down from the imposing mountains that can be seen in 
the north. The area west of the bridge seems to be very wild and 
desolate compared to the city of the elves.

Exits.Description: You see the guard house before the bridge.
You see the hills which are below the mountains.

rooms.Name: The Beginning of the Trail to the Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a path that leads up to the mountains. As you move
on you notice that you are not the only living being on this path. Many
signs show that orcs have been on this path not long ago.

Exits.Description: The trail goes on through the hills.
You see the bridge that leads over the stream.
You see a trail that goes south down to the stream.

rooms.Name: On the Trail Towards the Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are walking on the trail that leads up to the mountain that 
can be seen in the east.

Exits.Description: The trail continues.
You see the trail as it goes down to the bridge.

rooms.Name: On the Trail Towards the Mountains
rooms.Description: You are on the trail that leads up to the moutains.

Exits.Description: The trail seems to be lesser used to the north.
You see the trail as it goes down by the hills.

rooms.Name: In a Bend of the Trail Towards the Mountains
rooms.Description:
The trail seems to be used very little here up in the hills. 
Everywhere bushes and grass are growing on the trail and sometimes 
some evil noise makes your heart stop for awhile.

Exits.Description: The trail continues south.
The trail goes directly towards the mountains.

rooms.Name: Near the Misty Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are standing on the trail that leads up from the elven city 
to the mountains. As you look west you see that the mountains are 
covered with snow and that seems unusual at this time of year.

Exits.Description:
A trail that leads from the mountains seems to turn south after a 
little while.
You see the mountains that are very close now.

rooms.Name: At the Foot of the Misty Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are standing just outside the eastern entrance to the mines of 
Moria. The snowclad mountain seems to darken your thoughts and hope as 
it casts its shadow upon you. Everywhere the sound of orcs and other 
foul creatures gets nearer.

Exits.Description: A trail leads down from the mountains.
You see the eastern entrance to Moria.

rooms.Name: The Eastern Entrance to Moria
rooms.Description:
You are standing inside the entrance that goes into Moria from the 
east. The signs of marauding orcs can be seen everywhere and you also 
see some trees that have been burned just for pleasure. As you look 
further in you see only darkness.

Exits.Description: You see the hills outside of Moria.
You see endless darkness.

rooms.Name: At a swift Stream
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the side of a stream that is making its way 
down from the mountains. To the east the golden woods of Lothlorien 
can be seen and you wonder if you dare to enter. There seems to be 
a small path going along the stream.

Exits.Description: In the distance you see a bridge.
You see a great river and some elven ships.

rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Royal Elven House
rooms.Description:
You are standing before the doors of the house where the elven king 
and queen live. There are guards on both sides of the door and it 
doesn't look like you are invited.

Exits.Description: You see the doors of the house.
You see the city of the Elves.

rooms.Name: In the Great Elven House
rooms.Description:
You have entered the elven house where the king and queen live. 
There are guards patrolling just outside and you can see servants 
working in the halls of the house. The hallway continues north but 
there is also a small door to the east.

Exits.Description: You see the trees outside the house.
You see a joint in the hallway.
You see a small door made of oak.

rooms.Name: A hallway in the elven house
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a hallway in the elven house. To the west a 
small door can be seen and to the east you hear the sounds of elves 
singing.

Exits.Description: You see a small door made of oak.
You see the entrance to a room that appears filled with singing elves.

rooms.Name: The Room of Pleasures
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the entrance to a room where the elves go to 
listen and take part in the choirs singing or to hear the lords tell 
stories about orcs and goblins. In the middle of the room there is a 
dark-haired old elf with a large sword in a sheet. As you look upon 
him you understand that this is a very mighty man.

Exits.Description: You see the hall that leads out from the room.

rooms.Name: At a Nexus in the Hall
rooms.Description:
You have come to the place where the hallway that comes from the 
entrance of the house divides in every direction.

Exits.Description: You see that the hall continues north.
A narrow hall continues east.
You see the hall that goes towards the entrance of the house.
You the hall that goes towards the kitchen.

rooms.Name: In a Small Hallway
rooms.Description: You are standing in a hallway that goes east-west.

Exits.Description: You see a Nexus in the hallway.
You see the end of the hallway.

rooms.Name: At the End of the Hallway
rooms.Description:
You have come to the end of the hallway. There are no elves present 
and you wonder why. In the east part of the room you can see a large 
fireplace that is covered with dust.

Exits.Description: You see the hallway continue east.
You see that there are some strange details on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see that there is a trigger on the side of the fireplace.

rooms.Name: At the Entrance to the Kitchen
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the entrance of the kitchen where the elven 
cooks are preparing meals for the royal court. There is a sweet 
smell and you start too drool as you haven't eaten a decent meal for 
a long time.

Exits.Description: You see a nexus in the hallway.
You see the middle of the elven kitchen.

rooms.Name: The Kitchen of the Elves
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the place where all food is prepared for the 
elven queen and king. There are also many elves making lembas for 
the traveling elves.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the kitchen.

rooms.Name: In the Main Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the hallway that goes from the entrance of the 
great elven house to the stairs that can be see in the north. Some 
elves are moving around carrying food for the court upstairs.

Exits.Description: You see a nexus in the Hallway.
You see the stairs that goes up.

rooms.Name: At the Bottom of the Stairs
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the foot of the spiral stairs that lead up to 
the second floor of the great elven house. These stairs seem very 
ancient and were probably made by dwarves milleniums ago.

Exits.Description: You see the hallway that leads south.
You see the spiral stairs go up, and up, and up......

rooms.Name: At the Top of the Stairs
rooms.Description:
You reach the top of the stairs and come to the great halls 
of the elven court. To the south two great thrones can be seen and 
there are elven guards everywhere.

Exits.Description: You see the stairs go down.
You see the hall of the elven court.

rooms.Name: In a Hall in the Elven Court
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a hall where the elven court is located. To the 
south the throne of the elven queen and king can be seen, and to the 
east and west there are guards watching you.

Exits.Description: You see the stairs.
You see a small alcove that is guarded by a royal guard.
You see the Thrones of the king and queen.
You see a small alcove that is guarded by a royal guard.

rooms.Name: An Alcove in the Royal Hall
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small alcove that is used by the royal elven
guards. There are weapons hanging on the walls and you can also see 
paintings made centuries ago.

Exits.Description: You see the hall of the elven court.

rooms.Name: An Alcove in the Royal Hall
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small alcove that is used by the royal elven
guards. There are weapons hanging on the walls and you can also see
paintings that seem to be made centuries ago.

Exits.Description: You see the hall of the elven court.

rooms.Name: The Thrones of the Elven Queen and King
rooms.Description:
You are standing before the elven queen and king who are sitting on
their thrones. They seem to be very mighty and you get a strong urge 
to run away from this place. At the same time you are caught by the 
beauty of the elven queen whom you have never seen before.

Exits.Description: You see the hallway of the elven court.

You see that there seems to be some sort of hidden room behind the 
throne.
You see a door on the roof that leads to an attic.

rooms.Name: The Attic of the Elven House
rooms.Description:
You are standing in an attic where nobody seems to have stepped  
foot for a long time. There are bats sleeping under the roof and 
you can see many things lying on the ground covered by dust.

Exits.Description: You look down on the thrones of the elven queen and king.

rooms.Name: A Secret Hall Behind the Thrones
rooms.Description:
You have come to a secret hall behind the thrones of the elven 
queen and king. There are many great paintings of elves and the 
other free people of Middle earth. As you look south you can see 
some sort of mirror that shines on its own and you think that it 
would be clever not to go that way.

Exits.Description: You see the elven thrones.
You see the mirror of Galadriel.

rooms.Name: The Mirror of Galadriel
rooms.Description:
As you step into the room you can't help looking into the mirror 
that is placed on the floor. A terrible red eye catches your sight 
and disintegrates your soul.

rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Dungeons
rooms.Description:
You have reached the dungeons where the Elves keep their prisoners. 
It doesn't look like anyone has been here for a long time and you 
start to wonder if there are any living creatures in them.

Exits.Description: You see the dungeons of the Elves.
You see the tunnel up to the fireplace.

rooms.Name: In the Dungeons
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the dungeons under the great elven house. As 
you turn around you can't see from which way you came.....or where 
you should go next.

Exits.Description: You see old prison cells.
You see the dungeons continue.
You see the dungeons continue.

rooms.Name: Lost in the Dungeons
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the dungeons where the elves keep their 
prisoners. Strange sounds can be heard from the old cells and you 
wish you hadn't come here.

Exits.Description: You see nothing special.
You see old prison cells.
You see the dungeons continue.
You see the dungeons continue.

rooms.Name: Lost in the Dungeons
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the dungeons where the elves keep their 
prisoners. Strange sounds can be heard from the old cells and you 
wish you hadn't come here.

Exits.Description: You see nothing special.
You see old prison cells.
You see the dungeons continue.
You see the dungeons continue.

rooms.Name: Lost in the Dungeons
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the dungeons where the elves keep their 
prisoners. Strange sounds can be heard from the old cells and you 
wish you hadn't come here. Some sort of strange smell is coming 
from the south.

Exits.Description: You see old prison cells.
You see nothing special.
You see the entrance to a big cave.
You see the exit from the dungeons.

rooms.Name: Lost in the Dungeons
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the dungeons where the elves keep their 
prisoners. Strange sounds can be heard from the old cells and you 
wish you hadn't come here.

Exits.Description: You see nothing special.
You see old prison cells.
You see the dungeons continue.
You see the dungeons continue.

rooms.Name: The Lair of the Two-Horned Beast
rooms.Description:
You have entered the lair where a great beast has been held captured
for ages. On the floor lots of bones from humans and other creatures can 
be seen and you wonder where they came from. As you stand here you feel 
the noise of some foul creature in the back of you neck.

Exits.Description: You see the exit from the lair.

rooms.Name: The Elf Haven
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the place where the swift stream comes into a 
mighty river. Here are many of the boats the elves use when they 
like to travel on the river and these grey vessels are the finest 
piece of workmanship you have ever seen. An elf can be seen mending 
a golden rudder that apparently must be used to steer the ships.

Exits.Description: You see the trail along the swift stream.

rooms.Name: The Trail In the Plains
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading east. The wide landscape stretches far
away in every direction. To the north you see big Mountains and to
the south you see King Welmar's Castle.

Exits.Description: The plains continue to the west.

rooms.Name: The Plains
rooms.Description:
The wide plain stretches out in front of you, miles upon miles
with nothing more than bushes and solitary flowers growing. It is
almost like there is no apparent end of it.

rooms.Name: The Plains
rooms.Description:
The wide plain stretches out in front of you, miles upon miles
with nothing more than bushes and solitary flowers growing. It is
almost like there is no apparent end of it.

rooms.Name: The Plains
rooms.Description:
The wide plain stretches out in front of you, miles upon miles
with nothing more than bushes and solitary flowers growing. It is
almost like there is no apparent end of it.

rooms.Name: The Plains
rooms.Description:
The wide plain stretches out in front of you, miles upon miles
with nothing more than bushes and solitary flowers growing. It is
almost like there is no apparent end of it.

rooms.Name: The Trail In the Plains
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading east. The wide grassland stretches far
away in every direction. To the north you see big Mountains and to
the south you see King Welmar's Castle.

rooms.Name: The Trail In the Plains
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading east. The wide grassland stretches far
away in every direction. To the north you see big Mountains and to
the south you see King Welmar's Castle. Further east you see a bridge
over a river.

rooms.Name: An Old Bridge
rooms.Description:
You are on a very old bridge. To the east you see a large forest,
to the north you see big mountains and to the south you see King
Welmar's Castle.  You can climb down on to the river on the side of
the bridge.

rooms.Name: The Trail In the Plains
rooms.Description:
The trail makes a turn to the north following the river. To the
north you see big Mountains. And to the east you see a large forest.

rooms.Name: A Trail Along The River
rooms.Description:
You follow a trail leading northwards along the river. To the
south you can see a bridge over the river. To the north you see big
Mountains and to the east you see a large forest.

rooms.Name: A Trail Along The River
rooms.Description:
The trail forks into two branches, one to the north and the other
to the east. A large stone is standing here. To the north you see big
Mountains and to the east you see a large forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stone got something written on it.
To the north lies the Dwarven Village.
To the south lies the City of Midgaard.
To the east lies the Elven Forest of Namir, Gnome Village.

rooms.Name: A Trail Along the River
rooms.Description:
You follow a trail north. The moria mountains don't seem to be
that far away anymore. To the east lies the forest of Namir and to
the west you hear the rippling sound of a river.

rooms.Name: End of trail Along the River
rooms.Description:
You follow a trail north. The Moria mountains don't seem to be
that far away anymore. To the east lies the forest of Namir and to
the west the rippling sound of a river subsides as the trail takes
you away from the river.

rooms.Name: The Edge of the Forest
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a trail, near the eastern edge of the large
forest of Namir. To the west you see the trail leading back to the
walled city of Midgaard, and to the east a trail is leading through
the forest.

rooms.Name: A trail through the forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail winding through the forest. To the west lies
the forest edge and to the east the trail continues deeper into the
forest. As you look closer to the north you see a small path leading
into the forest. And to the south you can leave the trail and go
straight into the forest.

rooms.Name: In the Forest
rooms.Description:
As you leave the trail you sense the tranquillity of the forest
surround you.  Birds singing and animals can be heard making strange
noises in the distance.  To the north you see a trail winding west
and east through the forest and to the south you can continue deeper
into the forest.

rooms.Name: At the Hills
rooms.Description:
As you wander deeper into the forest you see some hills to the
east.  When you get closer you discover a dark cave in one of them.
To the north you can tread back into the forest and if you go to the
west you move closer to the dark cave.

rooms.Name: Entrance to the Dark Cave
rooms.Description:
You stand in front of a dark cave. A large sign have been struck
deep into the ground here. To the east you can move away from the
hills and to the west you can enter the dark cave.

rooms.Name: A small path in the forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the forest. Large trees
loom everywhere. To the south the trail continues through the forest
and to the north the narrow path continues between the large trees.

rooms.Name: A turn in the small path
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading south and east, trees standing
close on all sides. As the forest is getting more dense the light
that comes from above is dimming. To the south the path makes its way
southward and to the east the path continues into the forest.

rooms.Name: A small path in the forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading east and west through the forest.
Large trees looms close on every side. Its getting darker as the
large trees almost block all light from above. The path continues to
the east and to the west.

Exits.Description: Here you can leave the path and go straight into the forest.

rooms.Name: In the forest
rooms.Description:
As you leave the trail you sense the tranquillity of the forest
surround you.  Birds sing and animals are making strange noises in
the distance. To the south you see a trail winding west and east
through the forest.

Exits.Description: As you look closer to the north you see a small path in the distance.

rooms.Name: A trail through the forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading west and east through the forest. To
the east, the forest gradually becomes more dense.

Exits.Description: This way you can leave the trail and go straight into the forest.

rooms.Name: A narrow path in the forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the forest. Large trees
loom everywhere. To the north the trail continues through the forest
and to the south the narrow path continues into the dark forest.

rooms.Name: A turn in the narrow path
rooms.Description:
You are on a narrow path leading north and east, trees standing
close on all sides. As the forest is getting more dense the light
form above can't penetrate the canopies of the trees. To the north
the path makes its way northward and to the east the path continues
into the dark forest.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dark forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading east and west through the dark
forest. Large trees looms close on every side. The path continues to
the east and the west.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dark forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading east and west through the dark
forest. Large trees looms close on every side. The path continues to
the east and the west.

rooms.Name: A small path in the dark forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading east and west through the dark
forest. Large trees loom close on every side. The path branches 
here, getting lighter to the east, but with a narrower trail 
leading north between the trees.

rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading north and south between huge, ancient
trees standing close on all side. To the west a small path leads into
the shadows.

rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading west and east through the forest. The
forest is becoming more dense, huge trees loom on all sides.

rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading west and east through the forest. Here
a well traveled trail from the south join up. A road sign is standing
here pointing south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
To the south lies the splendid Elven City of ILLIR.
If your intentions are evil continue on 
your own risk. To the east lies the gnome
village.

rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading west and east through the forest. The
forest is becoming more dense, huge trees loom on all sides.

rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
Here the east and west roaming trail makes a turn to the north. 
From the east a small path joins with this trail.

rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading north and south through the forest. The
forest is getting very dense, huge ancient trees looms over you form
all sides.

rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading north and south through the forest. The
forest is getting very dense, huge ancient trees looms over you form
all sides.

rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
Here the north and south leading trail makes a turn to the east.
The forest is very dense. Blocking almost all light. As you look east
you see that the forest is getting less dense.

rooms.Name: A trail through the forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading east and west through the forest. The
forest is getting less dense to the east.

rooms.Name: At the edge of the forest
rooms.Description:
You are at the edge of the forest. To the north a dusty path
continues toward the plains. And to the west you can enter the forest
of Namir.

rooms.Name: Narrow path in the dark forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a narrow path leading east and west through the dark
forest.  Large trees looms close on every side. The path continues to
the east and the west. To the east you can see some light in the
distance.

rooms.Name: On a well traveled trail
rooms.Description:
You are on a well traveled trail leading north and both east and
west. Trees stand close on all sides. A strange feeling comes over you.
You feel like something or someone is watching you. Both to the west 
and north, the path leads into the dark forest. To the east the path 
makes its way through the trees next to the river. South there was 
once a wooden bridge forged across a small river, but it is now long
gone.

rooms.Name: On a well traveled trail
rooms.Description:
You are on a well traveled trail leading north and south. Trees
stand close on both sides. A strange feeling comes over you, you feel
like something or someone is watching you.

rooms.Name: A path through the trees
rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading west and east through the trees. This
place doesn't seem to like your intrusion. As you start to move
further east.  "SWISH!" Before you got time to react an arrow passes
by your head one inch from your right ear. Maybe its time to run.

rooms.Name: Elven guard camp
rooms.Description:
As you enter this place you see a campfire burning. You can see
elves sitting around the fire relaxing. "SWWWIIISSH!" Now the elves
seems to be alert. They all readied their bows and aiming at you. You
better get out of here.

rooms.Name: A path through the trees
rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading west and east through the trees. This
place doesn't seem to like your intrusion. As you start to move
further west. "SWISH!" Before you got time to react an arrow passes
by your head one inch from your right ear. Maybe its time to run.

rooms.Name: A small path through the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading west and east through the forest.
The forest becomes a little less dense here. Further east you can
make out the beginning of a marsh. When you continue walking
eastwards you notice that an old overgrown road leads north into the
forest, you can barely see it as high grass and bushes covers almost
all of it.

rooms.Name: A small path through the forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading west and east through the forest.
Further east lies a large marsh.

rooms.Name: The marsh
rooms.Description:
The whole forest has been transformed. The old green trees have
been replaced by dark branches emerging from the marsh. The sound of
birds have been turned into the sound of croaking frogs.

Exits.Description: The marsh continues to the east.

rooms.Name: The marsh
rooms.Description:
You stand in the start of the large marsh. The marsh stretches out
as far as you can see to the north and east. To the south you can go
back into the forest.

rooms.Name: The marsh
rooms.Description:
You stand in the start of the large marsh. The marsh stretches out
as far as you can see to the south and east. To the north you can go
back into the forest.

rooms.Name: A path through the trees
rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading west and east through the trees. From
the south you can hear the faint sound of water.

rooms.Name: A turn in the path through the trees
rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading west and east through the trees. Here
the path turns south. From the south you can hear the sound of water.

rooms.Name: At the north river bank
rooms.Description:
You are on the north side of a river. A path follows the river
east, and to the north a path leads into the forest. On the south
side of the river you can see a path disappearing into the forest.
Maybe its possible to cross the river.

Exits.Description: As you look closer you can see flat stones under the water.

rooms.Name: Along the north side of the river
rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading west and east along a river. To the west
the path goes into the forest and to the east the path continue along
side the river.

rooms.Name: Along the north side of the river
rooms.Description: You are on a path leading west and east along a river.

rooms.Name: Along the north side of the river
rooms.Description: You are on a path leading west and east along a river.

rooms.Name: The Strange Mist
rooms.Description:
Suddenly a strange mist covers the whole area, you cant see more
then ten feet in any direction. The only thing that give you some
kind of direction is the sound of the river to the south.

rooms.Name: Wading over the river
rooms.Description: You try to wade over the river, making your way slowly but safe.

rooms.Name: At the south river bank
rooms.Description:
You are on the south side of a river. A path follows the river
west, and to the south a path makes its way into the forest. On the
north side of the river you can see a path going north and east.
Maybe its possible to cross the river.  A strange feeling comes over
you, you felt like something or someone is watching you.

Exits.Description: As you look closer you can see flat stones under the water.

rooms.Name: A path in the forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a south and north leading path in a forest. The forest
is getting darker as you move further south.

rooms.Name: A dark path in the forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading south and north in a forest. As the
forest is getting more dense, almost no light can make its way
through the trees.

rooms.Name: A dark path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a dark path leading south and north in a dense forest.
Almost no light can make its way through the trees.

rooms.Name: A dark path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a dark path leading south and north in a dense forest.
Almost no light can make its way through the trees.

rooms.Name: A dark path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a dark path leading south and north in a dense forest.
Almost no light can make its way through the trees.

rooms.Name: A dark path in the dense forest
rooms.Description:
You are on a dark path leading south and north in a dense forest.
Almost no light can make its way through the trees.

rooms.Name: Following the river
rooms.Description:
You are on a west and east leading path along a river.  To the
west you can hear some sounds of activity.  A strange feeling comes
over you, you feel like something or someone is watching over you.

rooms.Name: Near the elven city of Illir
rooms.Description:
You stand in a huge clearing in the forest. Around you are lots of
small farms and large fields and pastures. To the northwest you see a
bright shiny stonewall surrounding a city. High towers can be seen
behind the wall. The path continue through the fields to the west and
to the east you can follow a path along the river.

rooms.Name: Near the elven city of Illir
rooms.Description:
You stand in a huge clearing in the forest. Around you are lots of
small farms and large fields and pastures. To the north you see a
bright shiny stone wall surrounding a city. High towers can be seen
behind the wall. The path continues through the fields to the east 
and to the south.

rooms.Name: Near the elven city of Illir
rooms.Description:
You stand in a huge clearing in the forest. Around you are lots of
small farms and large fields and pastures. To the north you see a
