some black bars of steel at the end of room, their purpose seems to be for
preventing people from climbing down a ladder into the darkness.

Exits.Description: You see some metal bars.

rooms.Name: Entrance To The Catacombs
rooms.Description:
You are in a small room at the entrance to the temple's catacombs. This room
is decorated with many small statues and urns, probably in the remembrance of 
those who are buried here. To the south a large archway leads into the 
catacombs. A ladder leads up.

Exits.Description: You see some metal bars.

rooms.Name: In the Catacombs
rooms.Description:
You are in the catacombs under the temple. Around you are rows of coffins
and stone slabs with mummified corpses on them. A few skeletons lay in the
corner and layers of dust covered everything. You notice some footprints in the
dust. The catacombs continue to the east and west. To the north a small archway
leads into the darkness.

rooms.Name: In the Catacombs
rooms.Description:
You are in the catacombs under the temple. Around you are rows of coffins
and stone slabs with mummified corpses on them. A few skeletons lay in the
corner and layers of dust covered everything. You notice some footprints 
in the dust. The catacombs continue to the west and south.

rooms.Name: In the Catacombs
rooms.Description:
You are in the catacombs under the temple. Around you are rows of coffins
and stone slabs with mummified corpses on them. A few skeletons lay in the
corner and layers of dust covered everything. You notice some footprints in the
dust. The catacombs continue to the north and south.

rooms.Name: In the Catacombs
rooms.Description:
You are in the catacombs under the temple. Around you are rows of coffins
and stone slabs with mummified corpses on them. A few skeletons lay in the
corner and layers of dust covered everything. You notice some footprints in the
dust. The catacombs continue to the north and west.

rooms.Name: In the Catacombs
rooms.Description:
You are in the catacombs under the temple. Around you are rows of coffins
and stone slabs with mummified corpses on them. A few skeletons lay in the
corner and layers of dust covered everything. You notice some footprints in the
dust. The catacombs continue to the west and east.

rooms.Name: In the Catacombs
rooms.Description:
You are in the catacombs under the temple. Around you are rows of coffins
and stone slabs with mummified corpses on them. A few skeletons lay in the
corner and layers of dust covered everything. You notice some footprints in the
dust. The catacombs continue to the north and east.

rooms.Name: In the Catacombs
rooms.Description:
You are in the catacombs under the temple. Around you are rows of coffins
and stone slabs with mummified corpses on them. A few skeletons lay in the
corner and layers of dust covered everything. You notice some footprints in the
dust. The catacombs continue to the north and south.

rooms.Name: In the Catacombs
rooms.Description:
You are in the catacombs under the temple. Around you are rows of coffins
and stone slabs with mummified corpses on them. A few skeletons lay in the
corner and layers of dust covered everything. You notice some footprints in the
dust. The catacombs continue to the east and south.

rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Newbie Zoo
rooms.Description:
A large iron gate separates the small zoo from the rest of the city. 
You can hear the sounds of exotic animals from behind the walls of the
zoo, along with the odors characteristic of such a park.  Inside the zoo
you will find not only the exotic creatures native to this world, but many
informative exhibits to help you get acquainted with your new
surroundings.

rooms.Name: Inside the Newbie Zoo
rooms.Description:
As you enter the lovely little zoo, you notice a large wooden building
before you.  A small shaded path leads through the zoo to the east.  You
see a large sign posted on one of the trees along the path, perhaps you
should look at it!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:

rooms.Name: Along the Shaded Path in the Newbie Zoo
rooms.Description:
The shaded path is quiet except for the exotic animals and children's
voices.  The characteristic smell of the zoo is strangely enticing as you
move further into the zoo.

rooms.Name: The Three-way Intersection on the Shaded Path
rooms.Description:
The shady path branches off to the south here.  You may may continue to
the east or west, but most of the action in zoo seems to be taking place
to the south of here.

rooms.Name: The Shaded Path through the Newbie Zoo
rooms.Description:
The shaded path continues along the east and west here.  The chirping
birds mingled with the roars of nearby animals creates a melodious chorus
of nature.  Children can be heard somewhere nearby, squealing with delight
as they see strange and exotic animals for the first time.

rooms.Name: The Shaded Path through the Newbie Zoo
rooms.Description:
The east-west path meanders through the shady zoo here.  You can hear
the sounds of animals somewhere to the south, and the air carries their
strange odors right to your nose.

rooms.Name: The Shaded Path through the Newbie Zoo
rooms.Description:
The shady path is covered with bird droppings here.  As you gaze up
into the trees, you can see a small nest high above.  Frantic chirps
emanate from the nest, and a pair of small birds begin to dive at you. 
They must have a nest full of babies, so you should probably leave them
alone.

rooms.Name: The Information Station at the Bend in the Path
rooms.Description:
A small table is set up here with various pamphlets and maps placed
upon it.  A light breeze rustles through the papers at this bend in the
shaded path.  The path continues to the west and south.

rooms.Name: The Information Room
rooms.Description:
This room is filled with information about Midgaard and the Newbie Zoo. 
Two large maps cover the west wall, one of Midgaard and one of the zoo.  A
table sits in the corner covered with several pamphlets.  The main
corridor of the Education Building lies to the east.

rooms.Name: Inside the Newbie Zoo Education Building
rooms.Description:
You are in a large hallway that runs through the center of the
Education Building.  Small rooms lie to the east and west, both of which
are full of important newbie Education materials!

rooms.Name: The Newbie Board Room
rooms.Description:
This room contains a bulletin board full of information for newbies. 
You may post questions and problems on the board, and just read it for
answers to questions you may have that have already been asked.

rooms.Name: Another Three-way Intersection
rooms.Description:
You are at the intersection of two paths.  A small gravel path leads
further into the zoo to the east, and the wider dirt path continues to the
north and south.

rooms.Name: A Path Through the Newbie Zoo
rooms.Description:
The gravel path is covered with discarded popcorn boxes and candy
wrappers.  It looks like the groundskeepers haven't been doing their jobs
too well here lately!

rooms.Name: A Path Through the Newbie Zoo
rooms.Description:
The gravel path continues to the east and west.  Just east of here you
see a large stone building.  You hear strange sounds coming from within
the building.

rooms.Name: Outside the Small Mammal House
rooms.Description:
The gravel path runs east and west outside of a large stone building. 
The gray stones of the building lend to it a cold and dark appearance. 
You can feel warm humid air coming from the doorway however, and the
sounds coming from inside let you know that many animals can be found
within.  A small metal sign is hanging next to the doorway.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Small Mammal House

rooms.Name: Another Three-way Intersection
rooms.Description:
The gravel path intersects here with a wider dirt path.  Tall shady
trees line the eastern side of the dirt path, and you can barely see the
outline of a large stone wall behind them.  The dirt path continues to the
north and south while the gravel path continues to the west.

rooms.Name: The Newbie Training Room
rooms.Description:
The newbie training facilities have been provided to you as a service
of the Save the Newbies Fund.  They have provided a master instructor to
help you find your way to enlightenment.  You may practice any of your
skills in this room with this great instructor.  Simply type "practice" to
see what skills and spells you can practice, then "practice <skill/spell>"
to practice them.

rooms.Name: Inside the Newbie Zoo Education Building
rooms.Description:
You are in a large hallway that leads down the middle of the Education
Building.  The walls are covered with murals painted by the children of
Midgaard.  Rooms lie to the east and west, full of educational facilities
for you as a newbie.  Take advantage of them while you can!

rooms.Name: The Newbie First-Aid Station
rooms.Description:
Most people have to pay for the services of a healer, but here at the
Newbie Zoo, one is provided for free!  You should probably rest here for a
little while before you venture back out into the zoo... we don't want to
have to scrape anyone off of the buildings!

rooms.Name: A Path Through the Newbie Zoo
rooms.Description:
You are on a wide dirt path that runs to the north and south.  Through
the trees to the west, you can see a large building.  You hear some
strange whoops coming from the south, and you can smell the strong odors
of several large animals.

rooms.Name: The Pygmy Marmoset Enclosure
rooms.Description:
The eastern wall of this room is made of a strange, clear material. 
You can see several people pointing and waving at you on the other side. 
Several small trees fill up the room, and you can hear strange noises
coming from above.  perhaps some small animals are hiding in here!

rooms.Name: Inside the Small Mammal House
rooms.Description:
The smell in this building is nearly unbearable.  The zookeepers must
not have cleaned it out yet today.  You can hear strange squeaks coming
from behind a large, clear wall to the west.  On the other side of the
wall you see several large trees.  A small door is cut into the wall,
barely large enough for you to pass through, if you can even open it.

Exits.Description: A small door has been cut in the glass, allowing entry to the room within.

rooms.Name: A Path Through the Newbie Zoo
rooms.Description:
The north-south path is rather serene here.  You can hear the distant
voices of the animals, but for some reason they are not so evident on this
part of the path.

rooms.Name: The Snack Shop
rooms.Description:
The Newbie Zoo staff has thought of everything!  They figured you would
need a place to stop and eat on your tour, so they provided a snack shop! 
The best thing about this shop is that everything is free!  Just help
yourself to the food sitting on the counter.

rooms.Name: The Director's Reception
rooms.Description:
This is where the Director of the Newbie Zoo welcomes all patrons.  A
large podium stands here for the director to stand behind while he gives
you a brief history of the Newbie Zoo, as well as an informative lecture
on the areas surrounding Midgaard.  The Director can also answer some
questions, such as what routes you should follow to find the animal
houses.  Just stand here long enough and he'll talk your ear off!

rooms.Name: The Souvenir Shop
rooms.Description:
Here in the Newbie Zoo Souvenir Shop, you can find low-cost,
comfortable Zoo attire.  All proceeds from this shop go toward providing
the many services to newbies in the zoo.  To see what you can buy, type
"list."  Then just buy the item you would like by typing "buy <item>." 
You can also help yourself to the many free samples that have been left
here.

rooms.Name: A Path Through the Newbie Zoo
rooms.Description:
The path runs north and south here, The trees to the west slightly
obscure a large building.  To the south you can see another large building
down the path.  Strange sounds seem to be coming from within it.  A
shorter distance to the south is the entrance to a dark building.  You can
hear an occasional roar coming from within.

rooms.Name: The Tiger Cage
rooms.Description:
You are inside a large metal cage.  The zookeepers have filled the cage
with large plants.  You can hear the footsteps of some large animal
somewhere inside the cage.  You better watch out, or you may get eaten!

rooms.Name: The Golden Lion Tamarin Enclosure
rooms.Description:
The warm humid room is filled with many tall trees.  A large clear
window opens up into the room to the east.  You see several people outside
the window looking in at you.  A small door is cut into the window leading
to the room.

rooms.Name: Inside the Small Mammal House
rooms.Description:
As you continue into the small mammal house, you come upon another wall
of the same clear material.  Behind the wall you see a room full of trees,
and some small furry animals.  A small door is cut into the wall, through
which you may gain entry to the room within.  The small mammal house also
extends to the north.

Exits.Description: A small door is cut in the glass.

rooms.Name: A Path Through the Zoo
rooms.Description:
The path continues through the zoo here.  To the west is a large black
building.  This part of the zoo is much more quiet for some reason.  The
path continues to the north and south.

rooms.Name: The Mata Mata Tank
rooms.Description:
The large tank is full of warm, murky water.  You have a hard time
seeing what might lie beneath the surface of the water.  You feel small
fish swimming between your legs, at least you hope they are fish!  You can
climb out of the tank to the south.

rooms.Name: The Gila Monster's Enclosure
rooms.Description:
The sandstone floor of this dry room is bare but for a few small cacti. 
A large bright lantern warms the entire room.  The wall to the south is
transparent, allowing you to see the adjacent room.  A small door has been
cut into the wall for passage in and out of the room.

rooms.Name: A Path Through the Zoo
rooms.Description:
The north-south path is bordered by trees on the west, and the outside
wall of a large stone building to the east.  You can hear menacing roars
coming from within the building, and even stranger sounds coming from the
building further to the south.

rooms.Name: Inside the Dark Building
rooms.Description:
The rooms don't seem to get any brighter as you move further into the
building.  Two large cages are inside of this room.  One lies to the
north, filled with several large plants that seem to be hiding a rather
large animal inside.  The other cage lies to the east.  You can see a set
of large eyes reflecting your light back at you from behind the bars.

rooms.Name: The Lion's Den
rooms.Description:
The floor of this dark cage is covered with tall dry grasses.  The
smell of blood overwhelms your senses and makes you quite nauseous.  The
hair on the back of your neck stands on end as you feel the movement of a
large body just behind you.

rooms.Name: The Kiwi's Hiding Place
rooms.Description:
This dark room is home to the elusive kiwi.  He only comes out at
night, so in order to see him, please try not to shine any bright lights
his way.  A large black curtain separates this room from the rest of the
bird house to the south.

rooms.Name: Outside the Reptile House
rooms.Description:
A large obsidian building stands east of the dirt path here.  A large
sign over the door informs you that you have reached the reptile house. 
The Newbie Zoo is famous for its collection of rare and exotic reptiles,
so you should most definitely take a look inside.

rooms.Name: Inside the Reptile House
rooms.Description:
The large Newbie Zoo Reptile House is home to several interesting
reptile species.  A large glass tank lies to the north, filled with
brownish water.  The building continues to the east, and you can exit to
the west.

rooms.Name: Inside the Reptile House
rooms.Description:
The Reptile House is home to several rare species of large lizards. 
Behind the large transparent walls to the north and south you can see the
rooms of two such lizards.  The komodo dragon's pit lies to the south, and
the gila monsters enclosure lies to the north.  You may enter the rooms
through the small doors that have been cut into the walls.

rooms.Name: Outside the Menacing Building
rooms.Description:
You are outside of a large stone building.  Menacing roars can be heard
from within.  The building looks dark and frightening inside.  The path
continues further to the north and south.  A large gray building lies at
the end of the path a short distance to the south.

rooms.Name: A Dark Room
rooms.Description:
The building is dark and menacing.  You have an incredible urge to turn
around and walk back through the entrance.  The loud roars coming from
within definitely do not help calm your feels at all.  You can venture
further into the building to the north, or leave for the path to the west.

rooms.Name: The Bird House
rooms.Description:
The collection of birds at the Newbie Zoo is housed in this spacious
aviary.  The tall glass ceiling allows you to see the sky above the zoo. 
Most of the birds housed here are flightless to maintain their residency
within this building.  The birds are free to roam about the room.  That
combined with the lush tropical foliage makes you feel as if you have
entered a sort of avian paradise.  A small room lies to the north of the
aviary.  A thick black curtain hides your view of what lies inside.

rooms.Name: A Path Through the Zoo
rooms.Description:
The path passes between two buildings here.  To the west is a small
building made of greenish stone.  To the east is a larger building made of
an obsidian material.  The path continues to the north and south.

rooms.Name: The Komodo Dragon's Pit
rooms.Description:
As you climb into the large pit, you feel a warm blast of humid air.  A
large burrow leads deeper into the room, but it is too small for you to
enter.  You can exit the pit through the small door on the north wall.  As
you look towards the exit, you see looks of horror on the faces of the
people in the adjacent room.  Perhaps you should turn around...slowly.

rooms.Name: Another Three-way Intersection
rooms.Description:
The three-way intersection appears to be well-worn, as if many visitors
have traveled to this part of the zoo.  A large gray building lies a short
way down the path to the south, and a large menacing building of stone
lies a short way to the north.

rooms.Name: On the Path Outside the Souvenir Shop
rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues to the east and west here.  A small wooden
building lies just south of the path.  You can see several articles of
clothing displayed in a small case next to the doorway.

rooms.Name: A Path Through the Zoo
rooms.Description:
The small dirt path continues to the east and west.  The exotic animal
chorus that you have heard on your visit here accompanies you on your
passage.

rooms.Name: Outside the Bird House
rooms.Description:
A small building made of greenish stones stands just north of the dirt
path.  You hear birds chirping and singing from within.  The path
continues to the east and west.

rooms.Name: Outside the Snack Shop
rooms.Description:
At the bend in the dirt path, you find yourself enticed by the smell of
the snack shop to the south.  Fresh buttered popcorn and delicious roasted
hot-dogs are almost begging you to come in for a bite.  The path continues
on its merry way through the zoo to the north and west.

rooms.Name: Outside the Ape House
rooms.Description:
A large gray building stands just south of here at the path's end.  The
sounds of many strange animals can be heard within.  Loud whoops and hoots
pique your interest as to what creatures abide within.  As you approach
the building you notice the large sign that hangs above the door informing
you that this is the Ape House.

rooms.Name: The Souvenir Shop
rooms.Description:
The souvenir shop is always stocked with all of your zoo-going needs. 
Small stuffed animals are piled high on a shelf which sits next to a table
containing a display of reading materials on various types of animals. 
Behind the display case containing various animal artifacts is a young man
who can help you with your selections.

rooms.Name: The Snack Shop
rooms.Description:
The snack shop at the Newbie Zoo is always free!  The Save the Newbies
Foundation funds parts of the zoo to provide visitors with many different
services.  Just help yourself to the food and beverages.  If you would
like to have something added to the menu, please contact the management or
an information aide!

rooms.Name: A Tree-filled Room
rooms.Description:
This rather large room is filled with all types of tall trees.  The
many branches are perfect for swinging and climbing.  The east wall of the
room is made of a clear material, allowing you to see into the adjacent
room.  A small door has been cut into the clear wall allowing access to
the room outside.

rooms.Name: Inside the Ape House
rooms.Description:
The Newbie Zoo Ape House was named by a former zoo director who wasn't
very well versed in the terminology of primates.  The building is home to
several species of not only apes, but other primates as well.  The walls
to the east and west afford spectacular views of the animals in the
adjacent rooms.  The Ape House also continues further to the south.

rooms.Name: Tucker's Room
rooms.Description:
This room is filled with large blocks of wood and chewed up leather
hats.  Ropes hang from the large tree-like structure in the center of the
room.  Piles of straw are scattered about the room, some of them covered
with pieces of burlap.  A large clear wall dominates the west side of the
room.  A small metal door is set into the clear wall to allow access to
the room outside.

rooms.Name: The Monkey Room
rooms.Description:
A large tree-like structure stands in the middle of the room.  The
ceiling here is made of glass, allowing a lovely view of the sky above. 
The clear eastern wall allows you to see into the room adjacent to this
one.  A small door is cut into the wall.

rooms.Name: Inside the Ape House
rooms.Description:
The large room is surrounded on three sides by clear walls.  On the
other side of each of the walls you can see the habitats of various large
primate species.  This building houses a very interesting collection of
ape and monkey species.

rooms.Name: A Tree-filled Room
rooms.Description:
This is another tree-filled room.  Like all of the other rooms, one
wall (the west wall) is made of a clear material allowing visitors to see
inside, and allowing the animals to see out.  A small door is cut into the
wall allowing access to the room outside.

rooms.Name: Katu's Room
rooms.Description:
This spacious room is filled with several large pieces of soft
furniture.  A small bed made of straw has been placed in one corner of the
room.  Several pieces of paper covered with bright paints are pasted to
the walls of this room.  A large clear wall stands to the north allowing
the occupant of this room to see the people outside.  A small metal door
has been placed in the wall.

rooms.Name: Cave Entrance
rooms.Description:
You are before an entrance to a cave which reaches back into the hills. 
As you look inside, you see nothing but shadows and darkness.  You think 
to yourself, "Self, what a wonderful place to find vile, evil creatures 
worth slaying."  Then you think to yourself, "If they don't get me 
first."

rooms.Name: Inside the Dark Cave Entrance
rooms.Description:
Just inside the cave, you see darkness quite clearly.  The darkness 
turns quickly to absolute blackness.  You wonder how anyone with 
infravision could even see in that.  You see scratchings on the cave 
walls which make you think this might not be a completely natural cave.

rooms.Name: Deeper Inside the Cave
rooms.Description:
As you wait here, your eyesight starts to become more accustomed to the 
dark.  You see the cave entrance vaguely starting to widen out to the 
east.  The natural cuts in the grey rock wall seems to absorb your light
as you walk through here.

rooms.Name: Cave Junction
rooms.Description:
You see what looks like an obvious guard post here.  It is perfect for 
watching all three paths, especially those coming into the cave.  The
natural grey walls to the north and south almost seem to be cut.

rooms.Name: E/S Turn
rooms.Description:
The corridor turns south to east.  The hard grey stone wall is covered
with a green moss that is slick to the touch.  The tunnel south is 
obviously been cut from the stone as is the tunnel to the east.

rooms.Name: Four Way Corridor Junction
rooms.Description:
The corridor branches in all four cardinal directions.  You can see 
the corridors continuing.  Leaning against the edge between two openings,
you balance some and notice the stone seems to be very hard and holds an
edge quite well.  The path east looks well worn from use.

rooms.Name: Corridor Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The corridor runs north - south having been enlarged from a natural 
tunnel.  The stone here almost sparkles when light reflects off the 
walls.  It is like little rainbows of light.

rooms.Name: East/South Turn
rooms.Description:
The corridor turns east from the south.  It seems to travel a ways
ahead in both directions, but then again, appearances could be 
deceiving.  The stone here is the same basic grey stone.

rooms.Name: East/West Corridor
rooms.Description:
You stand in an East/West corridor with a passage to the north.  
Looking north, you see what might be the start of a cavern.  To the 
east, the passage appears to end.

rooms.Name: A Large Empty Cavern
rooms.Description:
You stand in the south part of a large, empty, cavern.  The cavern 
extends to the north and returns to a corridor to the south.  A trickle
of water runs down the west wall and seeps down a small hole in the 
floor.

rooms.Name: A Large Empty Cavern
rooms.Description:
You stand in the north end of a large, empty, cavern.  As you prepare 
to leave, you see a faint brown stain on the floor that is crusty and
easily brushed off with your foot.

rooms.Name: End of the Corridor
rooms.Description:
You stand at the east end of a corridor.  You can go back west or try 
to sneak around a rock to the north, which you can see leads into a 
room.

rooms.Name: Troll Wardroom
rooms.Description:
In here, you see some furniture with some battered and oversized piece 
of worthless armor casually tossed over it.  You wonder that the armor
can even protect anything as it's so full of holes.  You realize that 
most of this stuff, if you could haul it out, might fetch a copper bit, 
if you were that lucky. This is obviously a place where troll guards dump 
their stuff before going to sleep.

rooms.Name: SW Quadrant of a Guard Barracks
rooms.Description:
You either stepped inside of a pig pen or else inside of a troll guard 
barracks.  Raising your nose and taking a deep sniff, you realize it must
be trolls, because pigs smell better.  The room continues east and north
with a passage back to the west.

rooms.Name: SE Quadrant of a Troll Barracks
rooms.Description:
Pig pen is a more common response by now.  There seems to be straw, or 
something else that is stringy like it, matted together with filth and
sweat.  You think if it wasn't for the sweat and filth, it might be a 
place to sleep.  You see the room continue north and west.

rooms.Name: NW Quadrant of a Guard Barracks
rooms.Description:
More of the same garden variety stinky, smelly, troll beds are here. 
The only seeming thing of worth here is what is with you right now.  
You start to wonder what a troll might consider a valuable treasure.

rooms.Name: NE Quadrant of a Guard Barracks
rooms.Description:
You see more of the same, a pile of sleeping pallets with openings to the 
west and south. A door, or a peace of wood slammed so hard it hasn't fallen
yet is on the north wall.  One of the pallets here seems to be more special
then the rest in that it has some hides crumpled across it.

rooms.Name: A Lesser Used Tunnel
rooms.Description:
This tunnel is smaller then the other one.  It also seems artificially 
widened as the grey rock looks smoother then what you have seen in these 
tunnels.  This path seems not well used as it turns east and north.

rooms.Name: A Lesser Used Tunnel
rooms.Description:
This dusty tunnel widened through the grey rock makes a turn south 
from the west.  There is still dust on the floor, though it looks a
little stirred.  That probably was from a breeze at some time.

rooms.Name: A Widening of the Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The tunnel becomes wider to the east and narrower to the north.  
Peering to the east you see it starting to open up to a room.  Looking
north you see it turn left up a ways.

rooms.Name: SW Corner of the Ogre Chamber
rooms.Description:
This room has a disgusting aroma.  Smells like someone or something is 
living here and is not to particular about cleanliness.  The floor seems
splotched with something dark brown, which covers some of the natural 
grey stone.  Bits and pieces of bones and hides are also scattered 
across the floor.  This room is large and extends north and west.  A 
cave tunnel runs west of here.

rooms.Name: SE Corner of the Ogre Chamber
rooms.Description:
The room still smells, but now worse then before.  The carpet of dark 
brown still stains the floor, though some reddish brown seems to have 
muddied into the mixture.  To the north, you see a pile of stuff all 
over the floor.

rooms.Name: NE Corner of the Ogre Chamber
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the biggest pile of trash and refuse you have seen 
in ages.  You wonder how anything can live here.  You also wonder how 
you haven't slipped and fallen down yet when you step around the stuff.
The room opens west and south.

rooms.Name: NW Corner of the Ogre Chamber
rooms.Description:
To the east comes a vulgar smell to match the garbage strewn all over 
the place.  Most of the stink seems to be coming from the east.  The 
large room extends south and east.

rooms.Name: Southern corridor
rooms.Description:
This cut grey stone corridor ends with an entrance to the east. Peering
some into the room to the east, it looks more like a large chamber.  A
fourway junction is to the north of here.

rooms.Name: Large Empty Chamber
rooms.Description:
This room is a large,natural chamber that wasn't cut by any creatures
hand.  As you gaze to the east, you see the chamber continue.  You see
stalactites above you with some sort of clear water dripping down.  A 
less then natural exit was cut to the west, leading into a corridor.

rooms.Name: Large Empty Chamber
rooms.Description:
The beauty of this room, you think, is lost on the those living here,
but you think you do see the source of some of their stone clubs.  Some 
of the stalactites seem to have broken off the ceiling and fallen to the 
floor as several lay scattered here.  The room extends west of here.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
The grey stone corridor is cut deep into the rock, with the walls 
slightly smooth.  The corridor winds north and snakes west.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
Looking at the walls, you can tell this must not have been a natural
cave or tunnel, but something that bored through the rock.  Whatever it
was, it's something you probably wouldn't like to meet here.  The grey
stone corridor turns south and east.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
The grey stone corridor's north wall is slightly stratified with some 
other type of rock as it layers with a grayish green stone.  The stone 
seems to crumble easier then the grey rock does.  The corridor goes 
east to a southern turn and west quite a ways.

rooms.Name: Junction in a Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
You are in a T-intersection which runs east and west, but also has a 
path to the south.  Looking east, the corridor retreats into darkness,
while looking south, it seems to enter into a larger room of some sort.

rooms.Name: NW Corner of a Large Trollop Room
rooms.Description:
This room is large and full of furs strewn across the room.  This 
looks cozy and comfortable in a strange sort of way, like a room where 
some young are suckled by their mothers.  The room is large and extends
east and south, while an opening to the north leads to a corridor.

rooms.Name: SW Corner of a Large Trollop Room
rooms.Description:
This large room extends north and east, and as you walk around here,
you start to wonder what a female troll might be called.  As you look
at the furs, you notice that they almost seem to be more carefully 
laid out then just scattered about.

rooms.Name: SE Corner of a Large Trollop Room
rooms.Description:
This large room continues north and west of here.  The floor almost 
seems clean.  At least, less dirty then the rest of the cave.

rooms.Name: NE Corner of a Large Trollop Room
rooms.Description:
More of the large room still lays further to the south and west of 
here.  Furs are scattered all around this room, but a couple seem to 
catch your eye.  One in particular which looks well worn.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you move the worn fur when examining it, you notice that its old
and worn, but more importantly, you notice a trapdoor hidden under it.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
The corridor is cut deep into the same grey boring rock, with the 
walls slightly smooth.  The corridor continues east and west of here.

rooms.Name: End of the Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
The bored (or boring) corridor finally ends.  To the east you see a 
what looks like a guard station in front of a heavy door.  To the north 
and south, you see what looks like a some sort of small niche of a 
room. The corridor continues west.

rooms.Name: Guard Room
rooms.Description:
This small room has been cut from the same rock that is commonly 
found all over the place.  Its not only small, but is mostly occupied
by a table and two chairs.  This must be a place to sleep when no one 
is looking as the table doesn't look good for much else.  An opening 
is in the south wall, leading to a corridor cut from the same grey 
stone.

rooms.Name: Guard Room
rooms.Description:
This small room has more space then the one to the north as it has one
less chair here then the other does.  Other then that, it's identical, 
except the opening is to the north and not the south.

rooms.Name: Outside Throne Room
rooms.Description:
This seems to be a good spot to guard a throne room, providing you
had a throne room to guard here.  It is obvious from the worn floor and 
scuffed wall that this is well used area.  There are doors to the east 
and the corridor continues west of here.

rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
rooms.Description:
This is a large room with a Throne on the east side of the room, many 
steps a way.  The room is also cut from the native grey rock.  The room 
continues to the north, south, and east, while the doors are behind you 
to the west.

rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
rooms.Description:
This is a large room with a Throne to the south and east of here. The
hard grey stone seems worn smooth on the walls.  The room continues to 
the south, and east.

rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
rooms.Description:
This is a large room with a Throne to the south and east.  If you go 
east some, you think you might be able to stand in front of the throne.
Feeling the north wall, it feels cold to the touch.  The large room 
continues to the south, west, and east.

rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
rooms.Description:
This is a large throne room with the customary throne a few steps
east of here.  A door leading to a corridor lies west of here.  The 
room continues in all directions from here.

rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
rooms.Description:
You stand in the southwest corner of a large throne room.  The room
opens to the north and east from here.  A large dark brown stain 
decorates the wall at about, um, (measuring it with your eye), human
head height.  Obviously someone (or thing) had a mild disagreement here.

rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
rooms.Description:
The large room throne room extends to the north, west and east from 
here.  The throne itself lies some to the west and north from here. You
figure you might sneak to in front of the throne by inching west then
north from here.

rooms.Name: In Front of the Troll Throne
rooms.Description:
You stand before the awesome throne of the Troll King.  The throne is
large and cut from a single piece of (what else) grey stone.  The throne
isn't very ornate, but it can fit the rather large bulk of the troll king
in it.  Peering at the side of the throne, you notice a small pathway 
moving around throne to the east.  The rest of the room continues north, 
south, and west of here.

rooms.Name: Behind the Troll Throne
rooms.Description:
You stand behind the throne in a slightly cramped area.  After looking 
around, you see a trapdoor.  Examining the trapdoor, you see a small 
keyhole.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
The corridor is cut from a hard rock that is not grey (more a black 
stone) and appears slightly narrower then the enlarged corridors upstairs.  
You are at the bottom of some stairs cut into the stone.  The corridor 
goes west a short ways and south from here.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
The corridor cut from a black rock ends in a door to the west.  The 
tunnel continues to the east from here.  The Door looks solid and capable
of resting many futile attempts at smashing it open.

rooms.Name: Large Treasure Room
rooms.Description:
This large room holds many chests, most of which seem empty.  Others 
seem filled with rotted trash.  You start to wonder what the trolls 
thought was so valuable here.  The room extends north and west, while a
heavy door to the east leads out of this room.

rooms.Name: Large Treasure Room
rooms.Description:
This large room HAS to have SOMETHING of value, in here you think, 
but who knows what they consider valuable?  The rock wall here seems 
slightly chipped like someone tried taking an axe to it, with the wall
wining the fight.  The room opens to the west and south from here.

rooms.Name: Large Treasure Room
rooms.Description:
This large room holds many chests, containing trash.  Some of it looks
like it might have held something of worth a long time back.  the room 
opens to the east and south.

rooms.Name: Large Treasure Room
rooms.Description:
A Strong barred door lies to the south in this rather large but 
worthless room.  The room that was cut from black stone opens to the 
north and east of here.

rooms.Name: Secret Treasure Room
rooms.Description:
This room holds many chests, most of which seem empty.  Others seem 
filled with rotted trash, but there are a few things tucked around here
-- or at least there should be.  A door lies to the north of here leading
out of this room.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
This corridor is cut from a strange black rock, but is narrower then the
corridors above.  To the north, the hall extends and turns left.  To the 
south stands a room.

rooms.Name: Large Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This room seems to be large, extending west and south from here and
containing many creates and barrels.  The barrels contain a foul smelling
brew of some sort.  Drawing some out in a cup, you see it slightly colored 
yellow, like a very weak beer.  You hesitate at sampling the stuff.

rooms.Name: Large Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This room seems to be large, containing many creates and barrels.  You 
are in the northwest corner with the rest of the room opening to the south
and east of here.  Looking in a crate are the remains of something that 
had to be living at one time.  Little bugs seem to be crawling around in 
it.  About this time, you are positive you don't want to be a dinner
guest here (especially if you ARE the dinner).

rooms.Name: Large Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This room seems to be large, containing many creates and barrels.  You 
are in the southwest corner with the rest of the room laying to the north 
and east of here.  A passage stretches to the south, which leads to a 
corridor cut from black rock.

rooms.Name: Large Storage Room
rooms.Description:
This room seems to be large, containing many creates and barrels.  
Inside one of the crates are some bag of dust. Sampling some, you are
sure it's grain that is about as old as IO. You are in the southeast 
corner with the room stretching north and west of here.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
The corridor is cut from a hard black rock, slightly narrower then the 
enlarged corridors upstairs.  The corridor continues west while to the
north is a passage leading into a large room.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
A black rock makes up the walls here.  It crumbles some to a good
sharp blow, but not by much.  The corridor is slightly narrower then the 
enlarged corridors upstairs. The corridor turns both to the west and south.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
The cut black rock corridor is still slightly narrower then the 
enlarged corridors upstairs, but seems better used.  the stone seems to
eat any light that radiates from sources, making infravision real tough
down here. The corridor seems to go north and east from here.

rooms.Name: End of an Unused Tunnel
rooms.Description:
This is a little used tunnel which has collected much dust on the 
floor.  It seems like it was hastily made at one time to allow smaller
creatures than trolls a means of sneaking in and out of here.  It runs
south from here.

rooms.Name: Unused Tunnel
rooms.Description:
This north/south tunnel is obviously not made for trolls, which has
you wondering who might have made it.  It is to large for dwarves, but
too small for trolls.  Humans wouldn't have a need to live here, so who
made this tunnel?

rooms.Name: Unused Tunnel
rooms.Description:
A stair case cut from the stone leads up from here to parts unknown,
since a trapdoor seems to block the path.  You stand at the south end 
of a small, narrow tunnel that seems little used from all the dust 
scattered on the floor.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
The corridor is cut from the same hard black rock seen all over
down here and is slightly narrower then the enlarged corridors found
upstairs. The corridor winds west and south.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
Looking east, you see a dark path continuing on.  Looking north, you
see some more dark path continuing on.  You start wondering why trolls 
like living in places like this that have a lot of walking just to go 
nowhere.

rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
rooms.Description:
The corridor is cut from a hard rock, slightly narrower then the 
enlarged corridors upstairs. The corridor goes west and north.  The 
north passage leads to an apparent room.

rooms.Name: Maze
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

rooms.Name: Maze
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

rooms.Name: Maze
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

rooms.Name: Maze
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.
