rooms.Name: The Cell
rooms.Description: You are in a cold, cramped chamber with only one exit.

rooms.Name: The Cell
rooms.Description: You are in a cold, cramped chamber with only one exit.

rooms.Name: The Cell
rooms.Description: You are in a cold, cramped chamber with only one exit.

rooms.Name: The Cell
rooms.Description: You are in a cold, cramped chamber with only one exit.

rooms.Name: A Hall
rooms.Description:
You stand in a large cedar wood hall leading east and west.  On the
floor lies a thin and narrow purple rug.  The hall leads west inside the
Palace and east to the Grand Entrance.

rooms.Name: A Path Through The Mountains
rooms.Description: The narrow path turns here heading south and west.

rooms.Name: A Path Through The Mountains
rooms.Description:
Travel is hard and slow as you almost have to climb around large
boulders strewn about the path.

rooms.Name: The Edge Of The Ravine
rooms.Description:
The ground drops off below down to a rushing river.  A small rope
bridge sways to and fro in the wind giving you access to the other
side.

rooms.Name: On A Rope Bridge
rooms.Description:
The small rope bridge shudders under your weight as you make your
way across the valley.

rooms.Name: The Ledge Around The Valley
rooms.Description:
You are walking around a small ledge overlooking a large valley
deep within the eastern mountains.  The ledge turns north following
the shape of the valley and a steep trail continues to the east.

rooms.Name: A Path Through The Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are walking through a rock strewn path deep within the mountains
east of Midgaard.  The going is rough and you constantly twist your
ankle on the small stones lying about.

rooms.Name: On The Eastern Edge Of The Mountains
rooms.Description:
You stand on the eastern edge of the eastern mountains.  The high
peaks lie to the west and rolling hills and plains open up to your
east.

rooms.Name: In The Foothills
rooms.Description:
The path curves down the face of the mountain allowing you to
move up or down the face of this missive hunk of stone.

rooms.Name: In The Foothills
rooms.Description:
The path curves down the face of the mountain allowing you to
move up or down as you please.

rooms.Name: A Rocky Trail
rooms.Description:
The faint sound of a flowing river reaches your ears from the south and 
through the trees you can see water.  The path you are on continues north
and east from here.

rooms.Name: On A Road
rooms.Description: This long road continues to the east and south.

rooms.Name: On A Road
rooms.Description: The well kept road continues east and west from here.

rooms.Name: On A Road
rooms.Description:
You stand on a well maintained road leading east towards New Thalos
and west towards the Eastern Mountains.  To the north you can see wide
plains stretching out as far as the eye can see.  South of you begins
a dark green forest.

rooms.Name: The Headwaters Of The River Of Lost Souls
rooms.Description:
The waters of the swamp pool in this low area and begin to flow
southward.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
The river calms a bit after being thrashed in the interior of
the mountain.  Although still deep within the rocks you can see
faint traces of green to the east.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description: The river flows east and west through the hills.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
The river begins its decent out of the mountains now and continues
its flow to the east.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
The river flows under the wall of the city to the east and stretches
off towards high snow capped mountains far to the west.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
The river flows out from the city down a long winding gully towards
the Sea of Dragons.  To the south of you lies the Great Eastern Desert
and north a wide open expanse of grass.  You can just barely make out
a road that seems to be traveling along side the river but the
banks are to steep for you to see very far.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
The river continues its descent down the lowlands flowing ever so
gently south.  It is hard to believe this is the same river that came
cascading down the mountainside.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
Small animals and herd animals can be heard in the distance, though 
you don't actually see any near the river.  Perhaps the steep slopes
prevent them from using the river.

rooms.Name: The Edge Of The Ravine
rooms.Description:
You stand at the edge of a really long drop down.  A small rope
bridge has conveniently been placed here to allow you access to the
other side of the bridge.  Unfortunately the wind seems to be kicking
up making the bridge sway slightly.  The path leads off through the
mountains to the east.

rooms.Name: A Path Through The Mountains
rooms.Description:
The narrow path makes its way through the mountains east
and west.  You hear the squawking of a large bird over head
most likely a buzzard waiting for you to drop.

rooms.Name: A Path Through The Mountains
rooms.Description:
A large boulder suddenly decides it wants to occupy the same space
you are currently standing in.

rooms.Name: On A Road
rooms.Description: The road you are on continues east and west.

rooms.Name: On A Road
rooms.Description: The road you are on continues east and west.

rooms.Name: On A Road
rooms.Description: The road you are on continues east and west.

rooms.Name: On A Road
rooms.Description:
The road bends here toward the riverbank giving access to
the River Ishtar.  The road continues north and west from the
river bank.

rooms.Name: The River Of Lost Souls
rooms.Description:
The river flows south through a valley in the mountains.  You can see
a small village to the west.

rooms.Name: The River Of Lost Souls
rooms.Description:
The river flows south in the southern end of this wide valley.  The
walls of the valley close in to the south.

rooms.Name: The River Of Lost Souls
rooms.Description:
The river begins to speed up as it cascades down this mountain
crevice.  High above you a small rope bridge sways in the wind.

rooms.Name: The River Of Lost Souls
rooms.Description:
The river rapidly flows down this crack in the side of the mountain
to the south.  Hopefully you will hear any approaching rapids.

rooms.Name: The River Of Lost Souls
rooms.Description:
The river seems to calm a bit as the crevasse widens lessens
its stranglehold on the waters.  The river continues to the north 
through a crack and flows to the south.

rooms.Name: A Split In The River
rooms.Description:
The waters of the river crash down upon a rock and split into
two bodies of water.  The river you are on continues its southern
course and the new river heads off to the east.  To your west you
notice that the rocks have split and crumbled as if torn asunder
by some massive force.  It looks impossible to traverse.  The River
of Lost Souls also continues to the north.

rooms.Name: The River Of Lost Souls
rooms.Description:
The river continues north and south from here through a water
eroded valley.

rooms.Name: The River Of Lost Souls
rooms.Description:
The river continues north and south from here through a water
eroded valley.

rooms.Name: The River Of Lost Souls
rooms.Description:
The river continues north and south from here through a water
eroded valley.

rooms.Name: The River Of Lost Souls
rooms.Description:
The river makes a sharp bend here and heads south into a large
mountain and north through a valley.  On a ledge above you, and to
the west, you can see movement.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
The river widens here, no longer bounded by rock, and flows east
towards a plain.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
The river continues here east to east.  There is a landing area to
the north where you can gain access to the shore.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
The river meanders through the foothills of the eastern mountains.
The air is dryer on this side of the continental divide and it seems
a bit warmer.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
The river continues its journey eastward flowing through the
plains.  To the west you see the peaks of large snow capped
mountains and to the east you see the outline of a large city.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description: The river flows east and west from here.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
The river slows as it widens and meanders through the lowlands.  A
small dock give access to the north shore.

rooms.Name: In The Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are walking over rocks and stones through the mountains between 
the Ishtar and Dark rivers.
   It is funny how all the rocks look alike.

rooms.Name: In The Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are walking over rocks and stones through the mountains between 
the Ishtar and Dark rivers.
   It is funny how all the rocks look alike.

rooms.Name: In The Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are walking over rocks and stones through the mountains between 
the Ishtar and Dark rivers.
   It is funny how all the rocks look alike.

Exits.Description: You see a large boulder blocking your path.

rooms.Name: In The Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are walking over rocks and stones through the mountains between 
the Ishtar and Dark rivers.
   It is funny how all the rocks look alike.

rooms.Name: In The Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are walking over rocks and stones through the mountains between 
the Ishtar and Dark rivers.
   It is funny how all the rocks look alike.

rooms.Description:
You are walking over rocks and stones through the mountains between

   It is funny how all the rocks look alike.

rooms.Description:
You are walking over rocks and stones through the mountains between

   It is funny how all the rocks look alike.

rooms.Description:
You are walking over rocks and stones through the mountains between 
the Ishtar and Dark rivers.
   It is funny how all the rocks look alike.

rooms.Name: In The Mountains
rooms.Description:
You are walking over rocks and stones through the mountains between 
the Ishtar and Dark rivers.
   It is funny how all the rocks look alike.

rooms.Name: The Headwaters Of The Dark River
rooms.Description:
A large natural spring issues forth from the heart of the mountain
and flows west down the mountain.  It looks like there was a terrible
earthquake here not too long ago, and a path that leads eastwards
through the mountains is covered with rocks, making passage difficult.

rooms.Name: On The Dark River
rooms.Description:
The river flows down the mountain through a large crevasse to the west
and up into the mountains east.

rooms.Name: On The Dark River
rooms.Description:
The walls of this canyon tower overhead as the river continues east
and west from here.

rooms.Name: On The Dark River
rooms.Description:
The walls of rock around you slowly shrink to ground level as the river 
flows out of the mountains and onto the plains.

rooms.Name: On The Dark River
rooms.Description:
The river continues east and west from here out of the foothills
to the east down into the mountains south of here.

rooms.Name: On The Dark River
rooms.Description:
The river, following a low spot in the foothills, bends and twists.
Tall mountains can be seen off to the south and east.

rooms.Name: On The Dark River
rooms.Description: The river makes a wide sweeping turn here into the mountain.

rooms.Name: On The Dark River
rooms.Description:
The river flows west from here into the heart of the mountain and
east towards the foothills once more.

rooms.Name: On The Dark River
rooms.Description:
You can barely make out what is ahead of you as the river flows
quietly through the passageway.

rooms.Name: On The Dark River
rooms.Description:
The river slowly flows west towards the heart of the mountain.  There
are small cracks in the passage wall to the north where you might be able
to get up out of the water.

rooms.Name: On The Dark River
rooms.Description:
The river continues east and west from here flowing south of a dark
ledge high above the water level.

rooms.Name: On The Dark River
rooms.Description:
The river flows south through a narrowing part of the passage as it
progresses deeper into the mountain.

rooms.Name: On A Small Ledge
rooms.Description:
You clamber out of the water up onto this narrow ledge to see if
it leads deeper into the mountain.  Unfortunately, the ledge is only
wide enough to rest upon for a while and there does not appear to be
any other exits other than rejoining the underground river.

rooms.Name: On The Plains
rooms.Description:
You stand on an open expanse of grass extending in all directions.
To the south of you stand the might northern gates of New Thalos.  East
and west of you the grassy fields continue and north, in the distance,
you see a line of trees.

rooms.Name: On The Plains
rooms.Description:
You stand on an open field of grass.  The forest to the north is
closer but still a good distance away.  To the south a small dirt
path has been trodden into the ground heading towards New Thalos.

rooms.Name: The Edge Of The Forest
rooms.Description:
You stand at the edge of a huge forest.  The line of trees
continues as far as the eye can see to the east and west.  A
large expanse of grass spreads out to the south.

rooms.Name: River Ishtar
rooms.Description:
The river broadens even more here and the waters become murky.
The smell of saltwater has reached you from the east.  The Dragon
Sea cannot be far away.  To the east you can see the faint outline
of a city and to the north you see a large expanse of grass.

rooms.Name: The River Delta
rooms.Description:
This is where the river empties out into the Dragon Sea.  The backwash
of water has kicked up a lot of sand and the blue sea is stained where
the river empties.  Looking west all you can see is water... all the way
to the horizon.  North of here is a small dock you think you should be
able to reach with out too much trouble.  The river stretches off to the
west back towards New Thalos.

rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
rooms.Description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.  Water extends
in all directions as far as the eye can see.  Off in the distance
you think you might see a small dock to the north.

rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
rooms.Description:
The Dragon Sea comes up along the shore here.  The deep blue waters
rolling in and crashing against the beach.  To the north you see a 
small dock jutting out into the surf.

rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
rooms.Description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.  Water extends
in all directions as far as the eye can see.  Off in the distance
you think you might see a small dock to the west.

rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
rooms.Description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.  Water extends
in all directions as far as the eye can see.  Off in the distance
you think you might see a small dock to the west.

rooms.Name: On A Road
rooms.Description:
The people of New Thalos take great pride in the services their
city may provide.  One of these services is the construction crews
the go to great lengths to keep all the roads in order.  Although
the taxes in New Thalos are higher then other cities in the realm
most of the money is used for the good of the people.

rooms.Name: On A Road
rooms.Description:
You walk along a well used road with beautiful scenery.  To the north
tall pine trees form a wall that goes on for miles.  Between the road
and the trees lies a great expanse of grassy plains.  South of here, 
beyond the river, lies the Great Eastern Desert.  The road continues
east and west.

rooms.Name: On A Road
rooms.Description:
The Dragon Sea can be seen to the east now spreading out to unknown
lands.  The road continues east and west.  To the south you hear the
sounds of boats traveling the River Ishtar delivering goods.

rooms.Name: On A Road
rooms.Description:
This is the man land route through the land.  Merchants can bring
their goods to the coastline and have them ferried onto ships for
export.  Travel by foot west will take you through New Thalos up and
over the Eastern Mountains and down into Midgaard.

rooms.Name: Near The Shore
rooms.Description:
The road ends here turning into a small dirt path leading down the
beach and onto a dock.  To the north and south you see the coastline
stretching out before you.  West of here the lowlands roll up into
huge snow capped mountains.

rooms.Name: On A Dock
rooms.Description:
You stand on a simple wooden dock that acts as an extension of the
road to the west.  The dock seems to have been here for quite a long
time but is still sturdy.  A small ladder has been built on the eastern
end to allow easy access to and from ships.

rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
rooms.Description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.  Water extends in
all directions as far as the eye can see.  Off in the distance you think
you might see a small dock to the west.

rooms.Name: The Dragon Sea
rooms.Description:
The ocean spreads out in all directions rolling gently.  In the
distance you can see an island on the horizon.  To the west you see
the mainland.

rooms.Name: Under The dock
rooms.Description:
You are swimming underneath the dock.  You can see the four wooden
pylons that support the structure.  The murky water clouds you vision
as you gaze westward, but you think you can make out an iron grating
in that direction.

rooms.Name: The Lair Of The Ixitxachitl
rooms.Description:
Blood swirls around in the water as the Ixitxachitl devours the 
last of its meal.  Swirling around quickly as you intrude upon his
meal the large sting ray attacks!

rooms.Name: The End of the Northern Road
rooms.Description:
The road bends sharply here to the west, travelling slowly upwards
towards a large mountain of ancient, obviously volcanic origin.  The
path to the south is straight and well travelled.  A small trail
leads north into magnificent rolling hills.

Exits.Description: The path leads westwards towards a large mountain.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path ends abruptly at a tiny cave.  It looks barely large
enough to fit into.  A faint breeze coming from the cave carries the scent
of flowers upon it.  How very odd!  You may enter the small cave to the
north, and the small path returns back into the woods to the east,
allowing you passage in that direction.  You may also venture into the
woods to the south, but they are too dense to allow further passage to the
west.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path leads you through the dense forest.  The trees continue
in every direction, but the path cuts through them to the west and south.
The forest continues to the north and east, but passage to the north is
impeded by an enormous wall of thorns.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The forest surounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home.  The foliage grows quite dense to the
north, impeding any further progress in that direction.  You can wander
through the woods in every other direction.  Through the trees to the
west, you spy a small path cutting through the forest.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The forest surounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home.  The foliage grows quite dense to the
north, impeding any further progress in that direction.  You can wander
through the woods in every other direction.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The forest surounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home.  The foliage grows quite dense to the
north, impeding any further progress in that direction.  You can wander
through the woods in every other direction.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The forest surounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home.  The foliage grows quite dense to the
north, impeding any further progress in that direction.  You can wander
through the woods in every other direction.  You spot a small path through
the trees to the east.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path makes its way through the dense woods, leading you into
places unknown.  Almost hidden by the trees, you see a large iron gate to
the east.  The path continues to the south, and the dense forest may be
entered to the west, however the foliage is impenetrable to the north,
making further progress in that direction impossible.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The beautiful forest surrounds you on every side.  To the north and
east you see a small path through the tall trees.  The forest continues to
the south, but it grows too dense to continue to the west.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path meanders through the forest on its north-south journey.
You can follow it through the woods, or enter the forest itself to the
east and west.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The forest surrounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home. You can wander through the woods
to the north, east, and south.  Through the trees to the west, you spy a
small path cutting through the forest.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The lovely forest surrounds you in every direction.  The tall trees
gaze down at you as you wander through their home.  A small bird swoops
down from his tree-top dwelling, buzzing just past your head in an attempt
to frighten you away.  You may continue through the woods in any
direction.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The lovely forest surrounds you in every direction.  The tall trees    
gaze down at you as you wander through their home.  You hear tiny
footsteps behind you, but when you turn to see who is making them, you
only see the trees.  You may continue through the forest to the north,
east, south, or west.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
As you wander through the woods, you get the sense that someone, or
something, is watching you!  Should you be afraid?  Only if you don't know
what sort of creatures live in these woods!  The trees continue in every
direction, and you notice a small path cutting through them to the south
and east.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path leads through the woods to the north and south.  Through
the tall trees, you see what appears to be a large wall to the east.  You
may enter the forest to the west, or continue along the path to the north
or south.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
Wandering through the woods, you hear the sounds of the forest
creatures all around you.  The trees continue in every direction, but they
become too dense to pass any further to the west.  Through the trees, you
can see a small path making its way through the forest to the east.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path meanders through the forest on its north-south journey.
You can follow it through the woods, or enter the forest itself to the
east and west.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The forest surrounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home. You can wander through the woods
to the north, east, and south.  Through the trees to the west, you spy a
small path cutting through the forest.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
You can feel the eyes of the forest creatures upon you as you wander
through their home.  The trees continue to the north, west, and south, and
to the east you can see a small path wandering through the woods.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path wanders through the forest to the south and east.
You can hear birds chirping in the trees lining the path as you wander
through the forest.  The forest continues to the north and west, allowing
you to leave the path and wander there.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path continues through the woods to the east and west.  The
trees that line the path are apparently home to many small creatures, as
you can feel their eyes watching you as you wander through their home.
You may enter the forest itself to the north and south, or stay on the
path by following it east or west.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path leads through the woods to the north and west.  Through
the tall trees, you see what appears to be a large wall to the east.  You
may enter the forest to the south, or follow the path to the north or
west.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The forest continues in every direction, but it is too dense to pass to
the south or west.  Through the trees you can see a small path making its
way through the woods to the east.  You may also continue through the
woods to the north.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path wanders through the forest to the north and south.  The
trees that line the path gaze down at you as you make your way through
their home.  You may continue along the path to the north and south, or
wander into the woods to the east or west.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The trees of the forest continue their domain in every direction.
Through the branches, you see a small path making its way through the
woods to the west and south.  As you wander through his home, a small bird
chirps angrily at you!

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
Wandering through the woods you can sense the eyes of the forest
creatures upon you.  They seem harmless enough, but you can never tell
what the trees may hide.  The woods continue to the north and west, and to
the south and east you see a small path making its way through the forest.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path winds through the dense forest, allowing you to follow
its journey.  The path continues to the north and south, and you can
wander through the trees to the east and west.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The dense foliage surrounds you in every direction.  The forest becomes
impossible to pass through to the south, but you may move in any other
direction.  Through the trees, you notice a small path making its way
through the forest to the north and west.

rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
rooms.Description:
The dense forest surrounds you on every side.  Through the tall trees,
you notice what appears to be a wall to the east.  To the west and south
is more forest, but the thick foliage keeps you from moving any further
south.  You can see a small path cutting through the forest to the north.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

rooms.Name: A Split in the Path
rooms.Description:
The small path splits here, leading off through the forest to the
north, east and south.  The trees grow quite dense along the path, forcing
you to stay on it.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The path wanders through the woods to the east and west here.  The tall
trees gaze down at you as you follow the path through their home.  The
forest is too dense to travel further south, but it is passable to the
north.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The path wanders through the woods to the east and west here.  The tall
trees gaze down at you as you follow the path through their home.  The
forest is too dense to travel further south, but it is passable to the
north.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path bends sharply as it meets a dense growth of trees to the
east.  Through the trees, you can barely see a large wall.  The dense
forest continues to the south, but you wouldn't be able to make your way
through the underbrush in that direction.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path winds through the forest to the north and south.  The
trees lining the path grow quite close together, forcing you to stay on
the path.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path continues through the woods to the east and south.  The
forest lining the path is too dense to travel in any other direction.  As
you wander along the path, you can hear birds chirping, and a small
creature hastily scurries away at your approach somewhere in the trees.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path winds through the forest to the north and west.  The
trees lining the path grow quite close together, forcing you to stay on
the path.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path leads you through the forest on its north-south
journey.  The trees grow very close together along the path, making it
impossible to wander into the woods.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many
others have on your way north or south.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path leads you through the forest on its north-south 
journey.  The trees grow very close together along the path, making it    
impossible to wander into the woods.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many
others have on your way north or south.

rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
rooms.Description:
The small path leads you through the forest on its north-south 
journey.  The trees grow very close together along the path, making it    
impossible to wander into the woods.  To the south, you see that the path
leads toward a narrow path at the edge of the woods.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
The wide road cuts through the northern lands on its way to places
unknown.  To the east, a narrow road branches off of this one.  It takes a
path along the southern edge of a great forest.  To the north, the road
continues on its way through a dense forest.  A wide clay road branches off
to the west, leading towards a large city.  The northern road also
continues to the south, towards another large city.

rooms.Name: A Narrow Road
rooms.Description:
The narrow road is the northern border of a large rolling plain.  To
the north of the road is a large forest, filled with all sorts of
wildlife.  The narrow road seems to have been built to accomodate the
passage of wagons judging from the twin ruts that have been cut into it
over time.  The road continues to the east and west.

rooms.Description:
The narrow road is the northern border of a large rolling plain.  To
the north of the road is a large forest, filled with all sorts of
wildlife.  The narrow road seems to have been built to accomodate the
passage of wagons judging from the twin ruts that have been cut into it
over time.  The road continues to the east, leading into a small village
at the edge of the forest.  To the north, a small path branches off this
narrow road.  The road also continues back along the edge of the plains to
the west.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
The rolling plains extend east for quite some distance, eventually
leading into hills and mountains.  To the west is a large, dark forest.
The road continues towards the north, into places unknown.  To the south,
the road leads towards a large city.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
The rolling plains extend east for quite some distance, eventually
leading into hills and mountains.  To the west is a large, dark forest.
The road continues towards the north, into places unknown.  To the south,
the road leads towards a large city.

rooms.Description:
The rolling plains extend east for quite some distance, eventually 
leading into hills and mountains.  To the west is a large, dark forest.   
The road continues towards the north, into places unknown.  To the south,
the road leads towards a large city.

rooms.Name: The Northern Road
rooms.Description:
The rolling plains extend east for quite some distance, eventually 
leading into hills and mountains.  To the west is a large, dark forest.   
The road continues towards the north, into places unknown.  To the south,
the road leads towards a large city.

rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
rooms.Description:
The small trail winds its way through the hills as it leaves the
Northern Road.  In the distance to the north, you see the snowcapped
peaks of a mountain range.  The path continues to the north, and
leads to the Northern Road to the south.

rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
rooms.Description:
The small trail follows the terrain of the rolling hills.  As the
hills crest and fall, so does the trail.  The air is much cooler as
you progress towards the north, closer to the snowapped peaks you can
see in the distance.  The trail continues through the hills to the
north and south.

rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
rooms.Description:
The small trail follows the terrain of the rolling hills.  As the
hills crest and fall, so does the trail.  The air is much cooler as
you progress towards the north, closer to the snowapped peaks you can
see in the distance.  The trail continues through the hills to the
north and south.

rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
rooms.Description:
As the trail continues through the hills, the terrain becomes
considerably more treacherous.  The rolling hills have become more
steep as they approach the still-distant mountains.  The trail
continues through the hills to the north and south.

rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
rooms.Description:
As the trail continues through the hills, the terrain becomes 
considerably more treacherous.  The rolling hills have become more   
steep as they approach the still-distant mountains.  The trail 
continues through the hills to the north and south.

rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
rooms.Description:
The trail winds its way through the hills, apparently heading
towards the snowcapped mountains in the not-so-distant north.  The
cool, crisp air is invigorating!  The trail turns to the east,
apparently to avoid a large boulder that has been left here by the
forces of nature.  It also heads south, into more gently rolling
hills.

rooms.Name: A Winding Trail Through the Hills
rooms.Description:
As the trail winds its way through the increasingly steep hills,
you begin to notice that the air is much more thin.  Perhaps the
altitude is to blame.  Upon reaching the crest of one particularly
large hill, you realize that you can see for miles in every distance.
To the north you see the snowcapped peaks of a large mountain range.
The range appears to curve southwards along the east and west ends,
forming a sort of basin within which these hills reside. A steep
incline leads down and north into what appears to be a boulder
field.  To the south, the hills roll gently, and past them is a large
forest.  The trail continues through the hills to the north and west.

rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
rooms.Description:
Boulders are strewn about everywhere, by the forces of nature...
or perhaps they have been placed here intentionally.  The boulder
field continues to the north and east, but becomes too treacherous to
pass to the west.  A short climb to the south would take you to a
small trail that winds its way through the hills in that direction.

rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
rooms.Description:
Large boulders have been thrown haphazardly about, making it
rather difficult to maneuver through this terrain.  The boulder field
continues to the north, towards a large mountain range, and south
towards the hills.

rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
rooms.Description:
As the boulder field approaches the mountains, you notice that a
small pass cuts through the range not far to the north.  Perhaps if
you are able to make your way through this field, access to the other
side of the range would be attainable.  The large boulders make your
journey difficult, but a somewhat clear path leads to the north and
south.

rooms.Name: Approaching the Mountain Pass
rooms.Description:
As you reach the base of the mountain range, you see that there is
indeed a pass through it.  However, it has been quite blocked by a
recent landslide.  Passage through the rubble is quite impossible to
the north, but a somewhat clear path leads into a boulder field to
the south.

rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
rooms.Description:
Enormous boulders litter the field, making it very difficult to
make your way through.  Passage to the north and south is blocked by
particularly large boulders.  Their placement seems too precise to be
natural, as if the "path" you are on was made intentionally.  While 
treacherous, the boulder field continues to the east and west.

rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
rooms.Description:
The large boulders that line the field keep you on an east-west
path as you venture through the rocky terrain.  Past the boulders to
the north, you can see a large mountain range, meeting the sky with
its snowcapped peaks.

rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
rooms.Description:
Large boulders line a sort of path through the field.  They guide
you on a north and west journey, further into the field.  A short
distance to the north, the path appears to end abruptly at a large
boulder, but you may continue through the field to the west.

rooms.Name: Gates before the Psionicist School
rooms.Description:
You stand before the world renown school for the Psionics.  This is
the place where all young and aspiring would be psionicists come to study.
The school is housed in a large palace that is made of a glowing bright
green stone.  There is a tall spire that extends above most of the school.
The spire glows a bright green and seems to fade in and out of existence
as you look at it.  North of you are the large gold and platinum gates
that lead into the school.  A cobblestone path wanders off to the south.

Exits.Description: A pair of large gold and platinum gates welcomes you to the school.

rooms.Name: Psionicist School Foyer
rooms.Description:
This is the foyer for the psionicist school.  You are looking at a
small courtyard where students and teachers alike take time to rest and
relax.  The walls and vaulted ceilings are constructed of the same
brilliant green stone.  The courtyard leads north and west.  A large gold
and silver gate marks the path to the south.

Exits.Description: The courtyard continues north.
Large platinum and gold gates mark the exit of the school.
The courtyard continues west.

rooms.Name: Southern part of the Courtyard
rooms.Description:
The green vaulted ceiling looms high above.  Trees and flowers are
growing here despite being indoors because of the eerie light cast by the
green ceiling.  You can hear a water fountain somewhere to the north.
The courtyard continues east, west, and north.

Exits.Description: The courtyard continues north.
The courtyard continues east.
The courtyard continues west.

rooms.Name: Southwestern part of the Courtyard
rooms.Description:
The green vaulted ceiling looms high above.  Trees and flowers are 
growing here despite being indoors because of the eerie light cast by the
green ceiling. You can hear a water fountain somewhere to the northeast.
A hallway leads off to the west and the courtyard continues east and 
north.

Exits.Description: The courtyard continues north.
The courtyard continues east.
A hallway leads west.

rooms.Name: Western part of the Courtyard
rooms.Description:
The green vaulted ceiling looms above.  Trees and flowers are growing
here despite being indoors because of the eerie green light cast by the
ceiling.  You can hear a water fountain somewhere to the east.  The
courtyard continues east, north and south.

Exits.Description: The courtyard continues north.
The courtyard continues east.
The courtyard continues south.

rooms.Name: Center of the Courtyard
rooms.Description:
The green vaulted ceiling looms high above.  You can see a water
fountain carved in the shape of giant fish in the center of the room.  The
fountain is carved of the same green stone as walls.  There are also
various tables and benches scattered around for people to sit and enjoy a 
little peace and quiet.  The courtyard leads north, south, east, and west.

Exits.Description: The courtyard continues north.
The courtyard continues east.
The courtyard continues south.
The courtyard continues west.
A spiral set of stairs leads down.

rooms.Name: Eastern part of the Courtyard
rooms.Description:
The green vaulted ceiling looms high above.  Trees are growing here
despite being indoors, and you can hear a water fountain somewhere to the
west.  The courtyard continues north, south, and west.  A small archway
leads east.

Exits.Description: The courtyard continues north.
A small archway leads east.
The courtyard continues south.
The courtyard continues west.

rooms.Name: Painting Gallery
rooms.Description:
You are standing in the middle of a small gallery apparently used
by the owners of the palace to store pieces of art.  Paintings of various
styles cover the walls. There is an unnatural glow to the room, coming
from the green stone walls themselves.  The courtyard is to the west and
there is a small door to the east.

Exits.Description: A small doorway leads to a workshop.
An archway leads to the courtyard.

rooms.Name: Artists Workshop
rooms.Description:
The room appears to be an artists workshop, though it seems
nobody uses this room any more.  At one time there was probably an artist
who was in charge of keeping the gallery in shape, but he is no where to
be found.  The shelves here are stocked with art supplies.  The only exit
is a small doorway to the west.

Exits.Description: A small doorway leads west to a gallery.

rooms.Name: Northern-Eastern part of the Courtyard
rooms.Description:
The green vaulted ceiling looms high above.  Trees and flowers are
growing here despite being indoors because of an eerie green light cast by
the ceiling.  You can hear a water fountain somewhere to the southwest.
The courtyard continues south and west.

Exits.Description: The courtyard continues south.
The courtyard continues west.

rooms.Name: North part of the Courtyard
rooms.Description:
The green vaulted ceiling looms high above.  Trees are growing here
despite being indoors, and you can hear a water fountain somewhere to the
south.  The main hallway of the psionicist school is north.  The courtyard
continues south east and west.

Exits.Description: The courtyard leads to the main hall.
The courtyard leads east.
The courtyard leads south.
The courtyard leads west.

rooms.Name: North-Western part of the Courtyard
rooms.Description:
The green vaulted ceiling looms high above.  Trees are growing here
despite being indoors, and you can hear a water fountain somewhere to the
southeast.  The courtyard continues south and east.

Exits.Description: The courtyard continues east.
The courtyard continues south.

rooms.Name: Hallway to the Practice Room
rooms.Description:
You are in a short crooked hallway which leads to the students
practice room.  This part of the castle is made of a plain gray granite,
and the hallway is so empty you can hear your footsteps echo.  The hallway
curves south, and the courtyard opens up to the east.

Exits.Description: The hallway opens up to the Courtyard.
The crooked hallway leads south.

rooms.Name: Hallway to the Practice Room
rooms.Description:
You are in a short crooked hallway which leads to the students
practice room.  This part of the castle is made of a plain gray granite,
and the hallway is so empty you can hear your footsteps echo.  A large set
of stone stairs lead down to the practice room itself. The hallway
curves north.

Exits.Description: The crooked hallway leads north.
The heavy steps lead down.

rooms.Name: Practice Room
rooms.Description:
This area of the castle is set aside for apprentices and new students
to practice.  The plain granite walls seem to fade in and out of existance
leaving you staring into the darkness.  A large set of stairs leads up,
out of the practice room.  You are free to wander in any direction.

Exits.Description: The practice room continues north.
The practice room continues east.
The practice room continues south.
The practice room continues west.
Stairs lead up out of the practice room.

rooms.Description:
This area of the castle has been set aside for apprentices and new
students to practice.  The ceiling and floor appears to be the same gray
granite as the stairs, however no matter how yard you look, the walls seem
to fade in and out.  You are free to wander in any direction.

Exits.Description: The practice room continues north.
The practice room continues east.
The practice room continues south.
The practice room continues west.

rooms.Name: Main Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the southern end of the main hallway of the
Psionicist School.  The walls floor and ceiling are made of the same green
stone that comprises the rest of the palace.  Sconces on the walls hold
small glowballs in place of torches.  The floor has a very large 
intricately woven black and white rug, which continues north through the
hallway.  You can see into the classrooms to the west, the courtyard
to the south, and there is a door to the east.

Exits.Description: The hallway stretches north.
A doorway leads to the novice bunks.
The hallway leads into the courtyard.
An archway leads to a classroom.

rooms.Name: Novice Bunks
rooms.Description:
These are the bunks where the novices of this school live.  Three of
the walls have bunk beds lined up against them.  The wall to the east 
contains two wardrobes where the novices keep their robes when not in use. 
The green stone of the palace has been replaced with plain wood.  A table
in the middle of the room has a number of candles on it lighting the room
with their warm gentle glow.  The only exit is the door leading west.

Exits.Description: The door leads out to the hallway.

Exits.Description: The hallway stretches south.
A spiral staircase leads up.
A spiral staircase leads down.

rooms.Name: Storage Room
rooms.Description:
You appear to be in a small storage room underneath the palace.
There are many shelves with old dusty books, boxes, and many objects you
simply can't identify.  The only footsteps you see in the dust on the
floor are your own, nobody has been down here in a while.  The only exit
is the spiral staircase which leads up to the hall.

Exits.Description: The spiral staircase leads up.

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a short hallway that branches off to the west
of the main hall.  This wing of the building is used to house the
classrooms for the novices that come to this school.  There is a row of
heavy oak benches along the south wall which are polished smooth from many
years of use.  Sconces which hold glowballs instead of torches provide the
light.  The hallway continues west, north into a classroom, and east
through an archway into the main hall.

Exits.Description: A psionicist classroom is to the north.
The archway leads to the main hall.
The hallway stretches west.

rooms.Name: Classroom
rooms.Description:
You are in one of eight classrooms used by the psionic masters of the
school to teach novices.  At one end of the room is a large ebony desk
which is covered with books and trinkets.  You see a sundial, several
glowballs, a skull, and several eagle feathers on the desk.  There are
also several rows of desks which are for the novices themselves.

Exits.Description: The novices hallway is to the south.

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a short hallway to the west of the main hall. 
This wing of the building is used to house the classrooms for the novices
that come to this school.  There is a row of heavy oak benches along the
south wall which are polished smooth from many years of use.  Sconces
which hold glowballs instead of torches provide the light.  The hallway
continues east, west, and north into a classroom.

Exits.Description: A psionicist classroom is to the north.
The hallway stretches east.
The hallway stretches west.

rooms.Name: Classroom
rooms.Description:

desk which is covered with books and trinkets.  There is a large shelf

Exits.Description: The novices hallway is to the south.

The hallway stretches west.

rooms.Name: Classroom
rooms.Description:
You are in one of eight classrooms used by the psionic masters of the
school to teach novices.  At one end of the room is a large ebony desk
which is covered with books and trinkets.  You see a preserved fish in a
glass jar, a very extensive collection of various bugs on the desk, and
a piece of polished wood on the desk.  There are also several rows of
desks which are for the novices themselves.

Exits.Description: The novices hallway is to the south.

rooms.Name: Hallway
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a short hallway to the west of the main hall.
This wing of the building is used to house the classrooms for the novices
that come to this school.  There is a row of heavy oak benches along the
south wall which are polished smooth from many years of use.  Sconces
which hold glowballs instead of torches provide the light.  The hallway
continues east, west, and north into a classroom.

Exits.Description: A psionicist classroom is to the north.
The hallway stretches east.
The hallway stretches west.

rooms.Name: Classroom
rooms.Description:
You are in one of eight classrooms used by the psionic masters of the
school to teach novices.  At one end of the room is a large ebony desk
which is covered with books and trinkets.  You see a large quill, an
inkpot, a small jar of sand, and a stack of unused parchment on the desk. 
There are also several rows of desks which are for the novices themselves.

Exits.Description: The novices hallway is to the south.

script.  There are also several rows of desks which are for the novices
themselves.

Exits.Description: The novices hallway is to the south.

school to teach novices.  At one end of the room is a large ebony desk
which is covered with books and trinkets.  You see a large leather-bound
book on a pedastal.  A large ball of fur 3 paces wide is setting on a
heavy iron table in the corner.  There are also several rows of desks
which are for the novices themselves.

Exits.Description: The novices hallway is to the south.

rooms.Name: Second floor hallway
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the north end of a hallway on the second
floor of the school that runs north and south directly above the main
hallway on the floor below.  The bright green stone is still used for the
walls and ceiling.  However the floor has been replaced with a checkered
pattern of red and blue colored marble.  The green stone ceiling on this
floor seem to glow brightly, brightly enough to illuminate the hallway
without the use of torches or glowballs.  The floor is very worn from the
countless years that the psionic masters have walked these halls.

Exits.Description: The hallway stretches south.
A spiral staircase leads down.

rooms.Name: Second floor hallway
rooms.Description:
You are standing in a hallway on the second floor of the school
that runs north and south directly above the main hallway on the floor
below.  The bright green stone is still used for the walls and ceiling. 
However the floor has been replaced with a checkered pattern of red and
blue colored marble.  The green stone ceiling on this floor seem to glow
brightly, brightly enough to illuminate the hallway without the use of
torches or glowballs.  The floor is very worn from the countless years
that the psionic masters have walked these halls.

Exits.Description: The hallway stretches north.
The hallway stretches south.

rooms.Name: Second floor hallway
rooms.Description:

Exits.Description: The hallway stretches north.
A doorway opens into apprentice quarters.
The hallway stretches south.

The hallway stretches south.

rooms.Name: Second floor hallway
rooms.Description:
You are standing at the south end of a hallway on the second floor
of the school that runs north and south directly above the main hallway on
the floor below.  The bright green stone is still used for the walls and
ceiling.  However the floor has been replaced with a checkered pattern of
red and blue colored marble.  The green stone ceiling on this floor seem
to glow brightly, brightly enough to illuminate the hallway without the
use of torches or glowballs.  To the east is one of the rooms where the
upper level students are housed and to the west is the lecture and 
training hall.  A glowing green spiral staircase leads up to the third
floor of the school.

Exits.Description: The hallway stretches north.
A doorway opens into apprentice quarters.
A square arch leads to the lecture hall.
A glowing staircase leads up.

rooms.Name: Lecture Hall
rooms.Description:
This is the main lecture hall used for large gatherings at the
school. This is also the room in the school where the apprentices study
and practice psionics.  The psionics taught in this room are more
difficult than those taught downstairs to the novices in the classrooms.
The room itself is made of the same glowing green stone that comprises the
second floor of the school.  This side of the hall is mainly occupied
tables and benches for students and teachers alike.  The hall continues
north and west.

Exits.Description: The lecture hall continues north.
The square arch leads west.
The lecture hall continues west.

rooms.Name: Lecture Hall
rooms.Description:
This is the main lecture hall used for large gatherings at the
school.  This is also the room in the school where the apprentices study
and practice psionics.   The psionics taught in this room are more
difficult than those taught downstairs to the novices in the classrooms. 
The room itself is made of the same glowing green stone that comprises the
second floor of the school.  This side of the hall is mainly occupied
tables and benches for students and teachers alike.  The hall continues
south and west.

Exits.Description: The lecture hall continues south.
The lecture hall continues west.

rooms.Name: Lecture Hall
rooms.Description:

The room itself is made of the same glowing green stone that comprises the
second floor.  The floor here is empty so that there is plenty of room for
apprentices to practice.  The hall continues north east and west.

Exits.Description: The lecture hall continues north.
The lecture hall continues east.
The lecture hall continues west.

Exits.Description: The lecture hall continues east.
The lecture hall continues south.

rooms.Name: The tower
rooms.Description:
You are in the northern most part of the school, inside the tall spire
that you saw when you approached the school.  The customary glowing green
stone is used for the construction of the tower except it glows even
brighter here than it does in other parts of the school.  The stone
glows so bright in fact that it is as bright as day.  The only difference
being that everything looks green here.  The room itself is circular in
shape and continues south and straight up. You barley notice a large
hidden door on the rough hewn surface of the south wall.

Exits.Description: The hall stretches south.
The tower heads up.

rooms.Name: Upper level hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in the top floor of the psionicist school.  As with the
rest of the building, green stone was used for construction.  In the
middle of the floor is a giant gold inlaid triskelion.  The construction
on the north wall of this area appears unfinished.  The wall has a rough
hewn surface of green stone, and it does not glow like everywhere else.

Exits.Description: The hallway leads into the tower.
The hallway stretches south.

rooms.Name: Upper level hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in the top floor of the psionicist school.  As with the
rest of the building, green stone was used for construction.  The floor
has a very polished look because of the countless times the psionic
masters of the school have paced these halls.  Small golden triskelions
are inlaid in the green stone on both the floors and walls.  The hallway
continues both north and south.

Exits.Description: The upper hallway stretches north.
The hallway stretches south.

rooms.Name: Upper level hallway
rooms.Description:

door with a triskelion leads east into a psionic masters room.  The
hallway continues both north and south.

Exits.Description: The hallway stretches north.
The circular door leads to a room.
The hallway stretches south.

rooms.Name: Upper level hallway
rooms.Description:
You are in the top floor of the psionicist school.  As with the
rest of the building, green stone was used for construction.  The floor
has a very polished look because of the countless times the psionic
masters of the school have paced these halls.  Small golden triskelions
are inlaid in the green stone on both the floors and walls.  A circular
door with a triskelion leads east into a psionic masters room.  The
hallway continues north, while a glowing green staircase leads down to the
apprentice level of the school.

Exits.Description: The hallway stretches north.
The circular door leads to a room.
A glowing staircase leads down.

rooms.Name: Room of the masters
rooms.Description:
This is the private bedchamber and study of one of the psionic
masters.  The room has a large bed, a desk, and a number of bookshelves
which hold the personal library of the psionicist who inhabits this room.
The floor is a beautifully polished oak, and the bed and desk are ornately
carved in oak and gilded.  Light is provided by a large glowball which is
sitting on the desk.

Exits.Description: A circular door leads back to the hall.

rooms.Name: Room of the masters
rooms.Description:
This is the private bedchamber and study of one of the psionic
masters.  The room has a large bed, a desk, and a number of bookshelves
which hold the personal library of the psionicist who inhabits this room.
The floor is a beautifully polished oak, and the bed and desk are ornately
carved in oak and gilded.  Light is provided by a large glowball which is
sitting on the desk.

Exits.Description: A circular door leads back to the hall.

rooms.Name: Room of the masters
rooms.Description:
This is the the private bedchamber and study of one of the psionic
masters.  The room has a large bed, a desk, and a number of bookshelves

The floor is a beautifully polished oak, and the bed and desk are ornately
carved in oak and gilded.  Light is provided by a large glowball which is

Exits.Description: A circular door leads back to the hall.

rooms.Name: The tower
rooms.Description:
You are in the northern most part of the building, inside the tall
spire
that you saw when you first approached the school.  The customary glowing
green stone is used for the construction of the tower except it glows even
brighter here than it does in other parts of the school. The stone glows  
so bright in fact that it is as bright as day, the only difference being
that everything looks green here.  There are no stairs or hand holds on
the walls.  The only way to move around in this tower is to fly.  The room
itself is circular in shape and continues straight up and down.

Exits.Description: The tower heads up.
The tower leads down.

rooms.Name: The tower
rooms.Description:
You are in the northern most part of the building, the top of the 
tall spire that you saw when you approached the school.  The customary
glowing green stone is used for the construction of the tower except it
glows even brighter here than it does in other parts of the school.  The
stone glows so bright in fact that it is as bright as day, the only
difference being that everything looks green here.  There are no stairs or
hand holds on the walls.  The only way to move around in this tower 
is to fly.  The room itself is circular in shape and continues straight
down.  There is also a doorway to the south.

Exits.Description: A doorway leads south.
The tower leads down.

rooms.Name: Creston's Room
rooms.Description:
You are in the room of the master psionicist Creston.  The construction
of the room is vastly different from the rest of the school.  The walls
ceiling and floor seem to be made of a semi-transparent glass like
substance that changes colors when you look at it.  The walls are so shiny
that the torches and candles that provide illumination send a dazzling
array of colored light dancing across every surface of the room.  A large
platinum triskelion is inlaid into the floor.  There is a doorway to the
north.

Exits.Description: A doorway leads north.

rooms.Name: Basement
rooms.Description:
This is the basement below the school.  You are actually in a very
small cramped tunnel that is made of a dull gray stone instead of the
brilliant glowing green of the rest of the school.  It appears to be
carved out of the bedrock as an afterthought and not part of origional
plans.  A thick layer of dust and cobwebs cover everything, and by the
lack of footsteps, apparently nobody has been down here in a while.  There
is a staircase leading up to the courtyard, while the tunnel winds off to
the east.

Exits.Description: The tunnel winds east.
A spiral set of stairs leads up.

rooms.Name: Basement
rooms.Description:
This is the basement below the school.  You are actually in a very
small cramped tunnel that is made of a dull gray stone instead of the
brilliant glowing green of the rest of the school.  It appears to be
carved out of the bedrock as an afterthought.  The further you travel
through the tunnel, the smaller it gets.   A thick layer of dust and
cobwebs cover everything, and by lack of footsteps, apparently nobody
has been down here in a while.  The tunnel winds off to the north and
west.

Exits.Description: The tunnel winds north.
The tunnel winds west.

rooms.Name: Basement before the Cage
rooms.Description:
This is the basement below the school.  The tunnel openes up into
a small room, again carved out of the dull gray bedrock instead of the
bright green stone.  A thick layer of dust and cobwebs cover everything,
and by the lack of footsteps, apparently nobody has been down here in a
while.  There is an rusted iron gate bolted to the west wall apparently to
keep something inside.  The tunnel winds off to the south.

Exits.Description: The tunnel winds south.
The gateway leads into the cage.

rooms.Name: The Cage
rooms.Description:
You are inside the cage that usually contains the Lhurgoif.  The walls 
of this cage are a gray stone that has been polished over the years from 
the giant beast beating and clawing at the walls.  There are many bones 
lying everywhere, the remains of the Lhurgoifs meals.  A gate leads out
of the cage to the east.

Exits.Description: The gateway leads out of the cage.

rooms.Name: Apprentice Quarters
rooms.Description:
This room is one of the apprentice quarters, where the upper level
students of the school live.  The rooms here are of a much higher quality
than that of the novice quarters below.  The desks and beds are made out
of oak and  carved with intricate designs of animals and plants.  The
floor has a large rug on it with a golden triskelion woven into it.  A few
tapestries adorn the walls with pictures of powerful psionicists.  A small
door along the west wall leads back to the hall.

Exits.Description: The doorway leads into the hall.

rooms.Name: Apprentice Quarters
rooms.Description:
This room is one of the apprentice quarters, where the upper level
students of the school live.  The rooms here are of a much higher quality
than that of the novice quarters below.  The desks and beds are made out
of oak and  carved with intricate designs of animals and plants.  The
floor has a large rug on it with a golden triskelion woven into it.  A few
tapestries adorn the walls with pictures of powerful psionicists.  A small
door along the west wall leads back to the hall.

Exits.Description: The doorway leads into the hall.

rooms.Name: Apprentice Quarters
rooms.Description:

students of the school live.  The rooms here are of a much higher quality

of oak and  carved with intricate designs of animals and plants.  The

Exits.Description: The doorway leads into the hall.

rooms.Description: Mob Chute

Exits.Description: north

rooms.Name: The Guard Post
rooms.Description:
You climb down the ladder into a damp room. The only light comes 
from the north where a little campfire burns. To the east you hear 
the faint sound of footsteps.

rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The entire tunnel gradually slopes downward, and the floor is 
covered with small rocks from holes in the wall. It looks like 
someone has been mining for something.

Exits.Description: You see the guard post.

rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The entire tunnel gradually slopes downward, and the floor is 
covered with small rocks from holes in the wall. It looks like 
someone has been mining for something.

rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The entire tunnel gradually slopes downward, and the floor is 
covered with small rocks from holes in the wall. It looks like 
someone has been mining for something.

rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The tunnel makes a sharp turn to the east. You can see light 
flickering ahead.

Exits.Description: You see some flickering lights ahead.

rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The tunnel continues and to the east you see a large cave. The 
flickering light is getting stronger and you can make out a 
campfire at the end of the cave.

Exits.Description: You see a large cave.

rooms.Name: The Large Cave
rooms.Description:
The tunnel comes out in large cave. Further east you see a large 
black door covered with strange runes. A campfire makes the whole 
cave light up. To the north you see a couple of beds made of straw.

Exits.Description: You see a couple of mattresses made of straw.
You see a the huge black door.
You see the mining tunnel.

rooms.Name: The Beds
rooms.Description:
Around you are four beds made of straw. A table and two chairs is 
the only furniture besides the beds. To the east you see a large pile 
of stone.

Exits.Description: You see a large pile of stone.
You see the entrance to the cave.

rooms.Name: The North-East Corner
rooms.Description:
In front of you is a large pile of stone. The stone probably comes 
from the mining in the tunnel. To the south you see the campfire 
and the huge black door. The straw beds are to the west.

Exits.Description: You see the huge black door.
You see a couple of beds made of straw.

rooms.Name: In Front of the Black Door
rooms.Description:
Who or what ever built this door must have been enormous. The 
door measures ten meters in height and five meters in width, and 
the whole door is covered with arcane writings. Maybe you should 
turn back while you can.

Exits.Description: You see a large pile of stone.
The black door towers above you. Two meters up you see a large keyhole.
You see the entrance to the cave.

rooms.Name: The Staircase
rooms.Description:
Before you a huge staircase formed of gray stone leads down into 
darkness. To the west you hear the sound of fire burning.

Exits.Description: The black door towers above you. Two meters up you see a large keyhole.

rooms.Name: The Dark Mining Tunnel
rooms.Description:
As you enter the dark mining tunnel you notice a draft coming 
from within. The tunnel continues into the dark. To the West you 
here a fire burning.

Exits.Description: You see the guard post.

rooms.Name: The T-cross
rooms.Description:
The mining tunnel divides into two tunnels, one north and one 
south. From the south you hear footsteps and distant muttering.

rooms.Name: Turn in the Mining Tunnel
rooms.Description: The mining tunnel makes a sharp turn to the east.

rooms.Name: The Cave-In
rooms.Description:
The mining tunnel comes to an abrupt end. The tunnel in front of 
you looks like it has collapsed.

Exits.Description: You see a little opening at the top of the stones.

rooms.Name: The Collapsed Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The whole tunnel seems too have collapsed. Remains of two skeletons 
can be found on the floor. Maybe you should get out of here before you 
join them.

rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
rooms.Description:
The tunnel makes a sharp turn to the east. Further east you see 
light flickering.

rooms.Name: The Mining Tunnel
rooms.Description:
As you move forward you smell the scent of roasted meat. The sound 
of muttering is getting louder.

Exits.Description: You see a light in the distance.

rooms.Name: The Huge Cave
rooms.Description:
The tunnel emerges into a huge cave. To the south you see the cause 
of the smell, a large cauldron over a campfire.

Exits.Description: You see a large Cauldron.

rooms.Name: The Huge Cave
rooms.Description: Lots of bones and junk have been thrown away here.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the cave.

rooms.Name: The Huge Cave
rooms.Description: A large cauldron is placed over a campfire here.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the cave.

rooms.Name: The Huge Cave
rooms.Description:
In this corner of the cave the Black Orcs practice their fighting 
skills.

Exits.Description: You see a large Cauldron and some beds made of straw.

rooms.Name: The Staircase
rooms.Description:
You are in a very large cave room. You can see a metal sign nailed 
on the wall. To the north a large corridor continues into the unknown 
and a huge staircase leads up.

rooms.Name: The Corridor
rooms.Description: You are in a large north-south leading corridor.

rooms.Name: The Cave Entrance
rooms.Description:
You see a large cave filled with stalagmites and stalactites to 
the north and east. You can enter a corridor to the south.

rooms.Name: The South-East Corner of Stalagmite Cave
rooms.Description:
You are in a large stalagmite cave. The air is very moist here and 
water is dripping from the walls. The cave continues to the north and 
the west.

rooms.Name: The South-West Corner of the Stalagmite Cave
rooms.Description:
You are in a large stalagmite cave. The air is very moist here and 
water is dripping from the walls. The cave continues to north and east.

rooms.Name: The Stalagmite Cave
rooms.Description:
You are in a large stalagmite cave. The cave seems much bigger now. 
The cave continues in all directions.

rooms.Name: The Stalagmite Cave
rooms.Description:
You are in a large stalagmite cave. You can see big stalagmites 
hanging above your head. The cave continues to the north, south 
and west.

rooms.Name: Near the Big Boulder
rooms.Description:
You are in the large stalagmite cave near a big boulder. You can 
see a carving on the boulder's left side. The cave continues to the 
north, south and east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You can read the words 'OPEN ME'

rooms.Name: The Stalagmite Cave
rooms.Description:
You are in the middle of a large stalagmite cave. The cave 
continues in all directions.

rooms.Name: The Stalagmite Cave
rooms.Description:
You are in the middle of a large stalagmite cave. The floor is 
covered with water puddles. The cave continues in all directions.

rooms.Name: The Stalagmite Cave
rooms.Description:
You are in a large stalagmite cave. The floor is covered with water 
puddles. The cave continues to the north and west.

rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue north into the abyss 
(not a very wise decision) or continue south and east.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss

rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue north into the abyss 
(not a very wise decision) or continue south, east and west.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss

rooms.Name: Near the Narrow Stone Bridge
rooms.Description:
You see a narrow stone bridge to the North. The cave continues to 
the south, east and west.

Exits.Description: You see a stone bridge

rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue north into the abyss 
(not a very wise decision) or continue south and west.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss

rooms.Name: In the abyss
rooms.Description: You are faaaaaaalling down into the dark abyss.

rooms.Name: In the Abyss
rooms.Description: You are faaaaaaaling down into the dark abyss.

rooms.Name: On the Narrow Stone Bridge
rooms.Description:
You are standing on a narrow stone bridge. It looks very slippery 
and wet. You better be careful because it's a long way down. You can 
continue east and west into the abyss or south and north to the cave.

rooms.Name: In the Abyss
rooms.Description: You are faaaaaaaling down into the dark abyss.

rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue south into the abyss 
(not a very wise decision) and east to the cave.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss.

rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue south into the abyss (not 
a very wise decision), east, west and north to the cave.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss.

rooms.Name: Near the Narrow Stone Bridge
rooms.Description:
You see a narrow stone bridge to the South. The cave continues to 
the east and west.

Exits.Description: You see the caves go north.
You see a stone bridge.

rooms.Name: Near the Abyss
rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a very deep abyss. Hot smoke is 
drifting out of the abyss. You can continue south into the abyss (not 
a very wise decision) and west to the cave.

Exits.Description: Into the abyss.

rooms.Name: The Corridor
rooms.Description: You are in a large south-west leading corridor.

rooms.Name: The Crypt Entrance
rooms.Description:
The corridor ends up at a huge stone door to the west. You can see 
a large inscription on the door. The corridor continues to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a huge stone door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You can read the words 'Sealed by the last dwarfs in moria year 781'

rooms.Name: The Passage
rooms.Description:
You are in a very narrow tunnel. The floor is covered with dust. 
The  tunnel continues into a large crypt to the south and east to 
a corridor.

Exits.Description: You see a huge stone door.
You see the crypt.

rooms.Name: The Crypt
rooms.Description:
Lit torches line the walls of the crypt. You can see a big throne 
at the end of the room. A thick layer of dust covers the floor. It 
looks like nobody has been here for ages. In the middle of the room 
you see a large stone chest with arcane writings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This was the former throne of the Dwarven  king. On the side you can 
read the history of the king and about his many brave adventures.
The lid on the stone chest seems too be moveable.

rooms.Name: The Tomb of the Dwarven king
rooms.Description:
You climb down into the stone chest. Something about this makes your 
backbone shiver. This place does not seem to like your intrusion. You 
can see the remains of a powerful looking dwarf. He wears a shining 
plate and wields two-handed axe. Maybe you shouldn't disturb him. The 
only exit seems to be up.

rooms.Name: In the Cottage
rooms.Description:
You are in a very small and dirty cottage. The floor is covered with 
garbage and junk. The only furniture in the room is a small straw bed 
and a cabinet. The only exit is to the south.

Exits.Description: You can see a small rickety door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The cabinet is filled with jars and rather disgusting food.

rooms.Name: Outside the Cottage
rooms.Description:
You are on a small island outside a cottage. You can continue North 
into the cottage or East into the water.

Exits.Description: You can see a small rickety door.

rooms.Name: On the Lake
rooms.Description:
You are on a small lake in the cave. This part of the lake seems to 
be very deep. The lake continues to the east and you can see a small 
island to the west.

rooms.Name: On the Lake
rooms.Description:
You are on a small lake in the cave. The water seems to be almost 
black. The lake continues to the west and you can see a small beach 
to the north.

rooms.Name: The Small Beach
rooms.Description:
You are on a very small beach. The only exits are up on a 
ladder or south on a small lake.

Exits.Description: You can see a large boulder.

rooms.Name: Behind the Cabinet
rooms.Description: You step in behind the cabinet. The only exit is back to the east.

rooms.Name: An Empty Room
rooms.Description: Hey you, get outta here!  This is an empty room!

rooms.Name: Start of trail
rooms.Description:
You stand at the bottom of a long, gradually winding roadway leading
up a smooth sloped mountain. Countless travelers have pounded a wide
roadway into the side of the mountain looming west of you.  You may
follow the path west, or head east along a more level road.  A small
sign proclaims, "Welcome to #bElysium#N, all those who come in peace."
